## **Chapter 42 - Recurrence Rules**

### 42.1 Recurrence Purpose

Recurrence rules enable **automated periodic task creation** for:
- Regular maintenance tasks
- Recurring reports
- Periodic reviews
- Scheduled operations
- Time-based reminders

### 42.2 Recurrence Rule Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class RecurrenceRule {
        +RecurrenceFrequency Frequency
        +int Interval
        +List~DayOfWeek~ DaysOfWeek
        +int? DayOfMonth
        +int? WeekOfMonth
        +DateTime? EndDate
        +int? MaxOccurrences
        +TimeSpan? TimeOfDay
        +Guid? WorkingCalendarId
        
        +DateTime CalculateNextOccurrence(DateTime from)
        +List~DateTime~ GenerateSchedule(DateTime start, DateTime end)
        +ValidationResult Validate()
    }
    
    class RecurrenceFrequency {
        <<enumeration>>
        Daily
        Weekly
        Monthly
        Yearly
        Custom
    }
```

### 42.3 Recurrence Patterns

**Daily Recurrence:**
```yaml
recurrence:
  frequency: Daily
  interval: 1  # Every day
  timeOfDay: "09:00"
  endDate: "2025-12-31"
  
# Example: Daily standup reminder
```

**Weekly Recurrence:**
```yaml
recurrence:
  frequency: Weekly
  interval: 1  # Every week
  daysOfWeek: [Monday, Wednesday, Friday]
  timeOfDay: "14:00"
  maxOccurrences: 24
  
# Example: Code review reminder 3x per week
```

**Monthly Recurrence:**
```yaml
recurrence:
  frequency: Monthly
  interval: 1  # Every month
  dayOfMonth: 1  # First day of month
  timeOfDay: "08:00"
  
# Example: Monthly report generation
```

**Complex Recurrence:**
```yaml
recurrence:
  frequency: Monthly
  interval: 1
  weekOfMonth: 2  # Second week
  daysOfWeek: [Tuesday]  # Second Tuesday
  timeOfDay: "10:00"
  
# Example: Monthly team meeting (second Tuesday)
```

### 42.4 Recurrence Calculation

**Next Occurrence Algorithm:**
```csharp
public DateTime CalculateNextOccurrence(DateTime from)
{
    var calendar = GetWorkingCalendar();
    var candidate = from;
    
    switch (Frequency)
    {
        case RecurrenceFrequency.Daily:
            candidate = calendar.AddBusinessDays(from, Interval);
            break;
            
        case RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly:
            candidate = AddWeeks(from, Interval);
            candidate = GetNextMatchingDayOfWeek(candidate, DaysOfWeek);
            break;
            
        case RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly:
            candidate = from.AddMonths(Interval);
            
            if (DayOfMonth.HasValue)
            {
                candidate = new DateTime(
                    candidate.Year, 
                    candidate.Month, 
                    Math.Min(DayOfMonth.Value, DateTime.DaysInMonth(candidate.Year, candidate.Month))
                );
            }
            else if (WeekOfMonth.HasValue && DaysOfWeek.Any())
            {
                candidate = GetNthDayOfWeekInMonth(
                    candidate.Year, 
                    candidate.Month, 
                    WeekOfMonth.Value, 
                    DaysOfWeek.First()
                );
            }
            break;
            
        case RecurrenceFrequency.Yearly:
            candidate = from.AddYears(Interval);
            break;
    }
    
    // Apply time of day if specified
    if (TimeOfDay.HasValue)
    {
        candidate = candidate.Date + TimeOfDay.Value;
    }
    
    // Check end conditions
    if (EndDate.HasValue && candidate > EndDate.Value)
        return DateTime.MaxValue; // No more occurrences
    
    return candidate;
}
```

### 42.5 Recurrence Worker

**Background Service:**
```csharp
public class RecurringTaskWorker : IBackgroundWorker
{
    public async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            // Find blueprints with due recurrence
            var blueprints = await _repository.GetRecurringBlueprintsDueAsync();
            
            foreach (var blueprint in blueprints)
            {
                try
                {
                    // Calculate next occurrence
                    var lastCreated = await GetLastCreatedInstanceDateAsync(blueprint.Id);
                    var nextOccurrence = blueprint.Recurrence.CalculateNextOccurrence(lastCreated);
                    
                    // Check if due now
                    if (nextOccurrence <= DateTime.Now)
                    {
                        // Create new task instance
                        await _taskFactory.CreateFromBlueprintAsync(blueprint.Id);
                        
                        // Emit event
                        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new RecurringTaskGeneratedEto
                        {
                            BlueprintId = blueprint.Id,
                            OccurrenceDate = nextOccurrence
                        });
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to generate recurring task for blueprint {BlueprintId}", blueprint.Id);
                }
            }
            
            // Wait 5 minutes before next check
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5), cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 44 - Blueprint Versioning Aggregate**

### 44.1 Version Purpose

Blueprint versioning ensures:
- Task instances maintain original structure
- Changes don't break existing tasks
- Audit trail of template evolution
- Safe experimentation with templates

### 44.2 Version Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class TaskBlueprintVersion {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid BlueprintId
        +int VersionNumber
        +DateTime CreatedAt
        +Guid CreatedBy
        +bool IsActive
        +string ChangeNotes
        
        <<Snapshot Data>>
        +string Title
        +string Description
        +List~ActionStep~ StepsSnapshot
        +List~AcceptanceCriterion~ CriteriaSnapshot
        +Dictionary~string,object~ DefaultValues
        +RecurrenceRule RecurrenceSnapshot
        
        +bool CanBeUsedForNewTasks()
        +void Deprecate()
        +void Reactivate()
    }
```

### 44.3 Versioning Workflow

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft: Create Blueprint
    Draft --> Published: PublishVersion()
    Published --> Active: Activate()
    Active --> Deprecated: Deprecate()
    Deprecated --> Active: Reactivate()
    Active --> Archived: Archive (no usage)
    Archived --> [*]
    
    note right of Published
        Version becomes immutable
        Snapshot taken
    end note
```

### 44.4 Version Selection Logic

```csharp
public async Task<TaskBlueprintVersion> GetVersionForNewTaskAsync(Guid blueprintId)
{
    var blueprint = await _repository.GetAsync(blueprintId);
    
    // Use active version
    if (blueprint.IsActive)
    {
        var activeVersion = await _versionRepository.GetActiveVersionAsync(blueprintId);
        return activeVersion;
    }
    
    // Fallback to latest version
    var latestVersion = await _versionRepository.GetLatestVersionAsync(blueprintId);
    return latestVersion;
}
```

### 45.2 Blueprint Validation Service

**Comprehensive validation before publishing.**

```csharp
public interface ITaskBlueprintValidationService
{
    ValidationResult ValidateStructure(TaskBlueprint blueprint);
    ValidationResult ValidateActionSteps(TaskBlueprint blueprint);
    ValidationResult ValidateAcceptanceCriteria(TaskBlueprint blueprint);
    ValidationResult ValidateRecurrence(TaskBlueprint blueprint);
    ValidationResult ValidateComplete(TaskBlueprint blueprint);
}

public ValidationResult ValidateComplete(TaskBlueprint blueprint)
{
    var errors = new List<string>();
    
    // Title required
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(blueprint.Title))
        errors.Add("Title is required");
    
    // Action steps validation
    if (blueprint.ActionSteps.Count > 50)
        errors.Add("Maximum 50 action steps allowed");
    
    var sequences = blueprint.ActionSteps.Select(s => s.Sequence).OrderBy(s => s).ToList();
    for (int i = 0; i < sequences.Count; i++)
    {
        if (sequences[i] != i + 1)
            errors.Add($"Action step sequence must be continuous (found {sequences[i]}, expected {i + 1})");
    }
    
    // Acceptance criteria validation
    if (blueprint.AcceptanceCriteria.Count > 20)
        errors.Add("Maximum 20 acceptance criteria allowed");
    
    foreach (var criterion in blueprint.AcceptanceCriteria)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(criterion.Given) || 
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(criterion.When) || 
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(criterion.Then))
        {
            errors.Add($"Criterion '{criterion.Description}' must have complete Given-When-Then");
        }
    }
    
    // Recurrence validation
    if (blueprint.IsRecurring)
    {
        if (blueprint.Recurrence == null)
            errors.Add("Recurrence rule required for recurring blueprint");
        else
        {
            var recurrenceValidation = blueprint.Recurrence.Validate();
            if (!recurrenceValidation.IsValid)
                errors.AddRange(recurrenceValidation.Errors);
        }
    }
    
    if (errors.Any())
        return ValidationResult.Failure(errors);
    
    return ValidationResult.Success();
}
```

### 45.3 Task Recurrence Service

**Manages recurring task generation.**

```csharp
public interface ITaskRecurrenceService
{
    Task<DateTime> CalculateNextOccurrenceAsync(Guid blueprintId);
    Task<List<DateTime>> GenerateScheduleAsync(Guid blueprintId, DateTime start, DateTime end);
    Task<TaskInstance> CreateRecurringInstanceAsync(Guid blueprintId);
    Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetRecurringInstancesAsync(Guid blueprintId);
}

public async Task<TaskInstance> CreateRecurringInstanceAsync(Guid blueprintId)
{
    var blueprint = await _blueprintRepository.GetAsync(blueprintId);
    
    if (!blueprint.IsRecurring)
        throw new DomainException("Blueprint is not configured for recurrence");
    
    // Get active version
    var version = await _versionRepository.GetActiveVersionAsync(blueprintId);
    
    // Calculate due date for this occurrence
    var nextOccurrence = blueprint.Recurrence.CalculateNextOccurrence(DateTime.Now);
    
    // Create task instance
    var task = await _taskFactory.CreateFromBlueprintVersionAsync(
        versionId: version.Id,
        dueDate: nextOccurrence,
        assigneeId: blueprint.DefaultAssigneeId
    );
    
    // Mark as recurring instance
    task.MarkAsRecurringInstance(blueprintId, nextOccurrence);
    
    await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(task);
    
    // Emit event
    await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new RecurringTaskGeneratedEto
    {
        BlueprintId = blueprintId,
        TaskInstanceId = task.Id,
        OccurrenceDate = nextOccurrence
    });
    
    return task;
}
```

### 45.4 Blueprint Versioning Service

**Manages version lifecycle.**

```csharp
public interface ITaskBlueprintVersioningService
{
    Task<TaskBlueprintVersion> PublishVersionAsync(Guid blueprintId, string changeNotes);
    Task ActivateVersionAsync(Guid versionId);
    Task DeprecateVersionAsync(Guid versionId);
    Task<List<TaskBlueprintVersion>> GetVersionHistoryAsync(Guid blueprintId);
}

public async Task<TaskBlueprintVersion> PublishVersionAsync(Guid blueprintId, string changeNotes)
{
    var blueprint = await _blueprintRepository.GetAsync(blueprintId);
    
    // Validate before publishing
    var validation = await _validationService.ValidateComplete(blueprint);
    if (!validation.IsValid)
        throw new DomainException($"Cannot publish invalid blueprint: {string.Join(", ", validation.Errors)}");
    
    // Create version
    var version = blueprint.CreateVersion();
    version.ChangeNotes = changeNotes;
    
    await _versionRepository.InsertAsync(version);
    
    // Emit event
    await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TaskBlueprintVersionPublishedEto
    {
        BlueprintId = blueprintId,
        VersionId = version.Id,
        VersionNumber = version.VersionNumber
    });
    
    return version;
}
```

## **Chapter 47 - Blueprint Integration Patterns**

### 47.1 Blueprint → Task Instance Integration

**Template Instantiation:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Factory as TaskFactory
    participant Blueprint as Blueprint Context
    participant Task as Task Instance Context
    
    User->>Factory: CreateTask(blueprintId)
    Factory->>Blueprint: GetActiveVersion(blueprintId)
    Blueprint-->>Factory: BlueprintVersion
    
    Factory->>Factory: Copy ActionSteps
    Factory->>Factory: Copy AcceptanceCriteria
    Factory->>Factory: Apply DefaultValues
    
    Factory->>Task: CreateTaskInstance(data)
    Task-->>Factory: TaskInstance
    Factory-->>User: Created Task
```

**Instantiation Logic:**
```csharp
public async Task<TaskInstance> CreateFromBlueprintAsync(Guid blueprintId, CreateTaskInput input)
{
    // Get active blueprint version
    var version = await _blueprintVersionService.GetActiveVersionAsync(blueprintId);
    
    // Create task instance
    var task = new TaskInstance
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        BlueprintVersionId = version.Id,
        TaskTypeId = input.TaskTypeId ?? version.TaskTypeId,
        ProjectId = input.ProjectId,
        Title = input.Title ?? version.Title,
        Description = input.Description ?? version.Description,
        
        // Copy action steps
        ActionSteps = version.StepsSnapshot.Select(s => new ActionStepCompletion
        {
            StepId = s.Id,
            Title = s.Title,
            IsComplete = false
        }).ToList(),
        
        // Copy acceptance criteria
        AcceptanceCriteria = version.CriteriaSnapshot.Select(c => new AcceptanceCriterionResult
        {
            CriterionId = c.Id,
            Description = c.Description,
            IsMet = false
        }).ToList(),
        
        // Apply default values
        Importance = input.Importance ?? version.DefaultImportance,
        Urgency = input.Urgency ?? version.DefaultUrgency,
        EstimatedMinutes = input.EstimatedMinutes ?? version.EstimateMinutes,
        DueDate = input.DueDate ?? version.DefaultDueDate,
        AssigneeId = input.AssigneeId ?? version.DefaultAssigneeId,
        
        // Copy custom fields
        CustomFields = version.DefaultCustomFields ?? new Dictionary<string, object>()
    };
    
    // Override with input values
    foreach (var (key, value) in input.CustomFields ?? new Dictionary<string, object>())
    {
        task.CustomFields[key] = value;
    }
    
    await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(task);
    
    return task;
}
```

```csharp
public async Task<List<CustomFieldDefinition>> GetApplicableFieldsAsync(Guid blueprintId)
{
    var blueprint = await _blueprintRepository.GetAsync(blueprintId);
    var taskType = await _taskTypeRepository.GetAsync(blueprint.TaskTypeId);

}
```

# **PART VII - TASK INSTANCE DOMAIN**

---

## **Chapter 48 - Task Instance Domain Overview**

### 48.1 Domain Purpose

The Task Instance Domain is the **operational heart** of the Work Management System, managing runtime task execution including:

- Task lifecycle and status progression
- Assignment and delegation
- Scheduling and time tracking
- Blocking conditions and dependencies
- Discussion threads and collaboration
- Approval integration
- Complete audit history
- Hierarchical relationships (subtasks)

**Key Innovation:** Task Instance is decomposed into **11 specialized aggregates** to prevent the "god object" anti-pattern and enable high scalability.

### 48.2 Task Instance Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Task Instance** | Runtime execution of a task blueprint or ad-hoc task |
| **Progress** | Current workflow status and completion percentage |
| **Schedule** | Planned and actual dates for task execution |
| **Assignment** | Current assignee, watchers, and participant roles |
| **Delegation** | Temporary transfer of task responsibility |
| **Blocking** | Condition preventing task progress |
| **Dependency** | Execution ordering constraint with other tasks |
| **Discussion** | Comments, attachments, and collaborative communication |
| **History** | Complete audit trail of all task changes |
| **Hierarchy** | Parent-child relationships between tasks |
| **Approval Status** | State of approval workflow if required |
| **Time Tracking** | Actual time spent working on task |
| **Resolution** | Outcome or reason recorded upon completion |

### 48.3 Why Aggregate Decomposition?

**Problems with Monolithic TaskInstance:**
- High concurrency contention (many users modifying same aggregate)
- Large transaction boundaries causing performance issues
- Complex invariant management across unrelated concerns
- Difficult to scale horizontally
- Unclear responsibility boundaries

**Solution: Decompose into focused aggregates:**
```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Root[TaskInstance Root<br/>Lightweight Orchestrator]
    
    Root --> P[Progress Aggregate]
    Root --> S[Schedule Aggregate]
    Root --> A[Assignment Aggregate]
    Root --> D[Delegation Aggregate]
    Root --> B[Blocking Aggregate]
    Root --> Dep[Dependency Aggregate]
    Root --> Dis[Discussion Aggregate]
    Root --> H[History Aggregate]
    Root --> Hier[Hierarchy Aggregate]
    Root --> App[Approval Aggregate]
    Root --> T[TimeTracking Aggregate]
    
    style Root fill:#FFD700
    style P fill:#90EE90
    style S fill:#87CEEB
    style A fill:#DDA0DD
```

---

## **Chapter 49 - TaskInstance Root Aggregate**

### 49.1 Root Aggregate Responsibility

The TaskInstance root is a **lightweight orchestrator** that:
- Holds identity and core metadata
- References all sub-aggregates
- Coordinates multi-aggregate operations
- Enforces cross-aggregate invariants
- Emits domain events

**It does NOT contain business logic** - that lives in sub-aggregates.

### 49.2 Root Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class TaskInstance {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid TenantId
        +Guid? BlueprintVersionId
        +Guid ProjectId
        +Guid TaskTypeId
        +Guid WorkflowVersionId
        +string Title
        +string Description
        
        <<Core Metadata>>
        +Guid CreatedBy
        +DateTime CreatedAt
        +double Importance
        +double Urgency
        +EisenhowerQuadrant Quadrant
        +List~string~ Tags
        
        <<Sub-Aggregate References>>
        +Progress Progress
        +Schedule Schedule
        +Assignment Assignment
        +Delegation Delegation
        +Blocking Blocking
        +Dependency Dependency
        +Discussion Discussion
        +History History
        +Hierarchy Hierarchy
        +Approval Approval
        +TimeTracking TimeTracking
        
        <<Custom Fields>>
        +Dictionary~string,object~ CustomFields
        
        <<Orchestration Methods>>
        +Task Start()
        +Task Complete(resolution)
        +Task Block(reason)
        +Task Unblock()
        +Task Assign(userId)
        +Task Delegate(toUserId, reason)
        +Task AddComment(comment)
        +Task UpdateSchedule(dates)
    }
```

### 49.3 Root-Level Invariants

**Immutable Identity:**
- Id cannot change after creation
- TenantId cannot change
- BlueprintVersionId cannot change (if set)

**Required References:**
- Must have valid ProjectId
- Must have valid TaskTypeId
- Must have valid WorkflowVersionId
- CreatedBy must be active user

**Cross-Aggregate Consistency:**
- Cannot complete if required action steps incomplete
- Cannot complete if required approval pending
- Cannot delete if has unblocked dependents
- Cannot assign if blocked by approval

### 49.4 Root Behaviors (Orchestration)

**Start() - Multi-Aggregate Coordination:**
```csharp
public async Task Start()
{
    // 1. Check blocking conditions
    if (Blocking.IsBlocked)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot start blocked task");
    
    // 2. Check dependencies
    if (!await Dependency.CanStartAsync())
        throw new DomainException("Cannot start - dependencies not met");
    
    // 3. Update schedule
    Schedule.MarkStarted();
    
    // 4. Update progress via workflow
    await Progress.TransitionToInProgressAsync();
    
    // 5. Record history
    History.AddEntry(new HistoryEntry
    {
        Type = TaskHistoryChangeType.Started,
        ChangedBy = _currentUserId,
        ChangedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
    
    // 6. Emit event
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskStartedEto
    {
        TaskId = Id,
        StartedBy = _currentUserId,
        StartedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**Complete() - Complex Orchestration:**
```csharp
public async Task Complete(CompletionInput input)
{
    // 1. Validate completion requirements
    var validationResult = await ValidateCanCompleteAsync();
    if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        throw new DomainException($"Cannot complete: {validationResult.ErrorMessage}");
    
    // 2. Check action steps
    if (!ActionStepsComplete())
        throw new DomainException("All required action steps must be completed");
    
    // 3. Check acceptance criteria
    if (!AcceptanceCriteriaMet())
        throw new DomainException("All required acceptance criteria must be met");
    
    // 4. Check approval requirement
    if (Approval.RequiresApproval && !Approval.IsApproved)
        throw new DomainException("Task requires approval before completion");
    
    // 5. Update schedule
    Schedule.MarkCompleted();
    
    // 6. Update progress
    await Progress.TransitionToCompleteAsync();
    
    // 7. Record resolution
    Progress.SetResolution(input.ResolutionCode, input.ResolutionNotes);
    
    // 8. Update time tracking
    TimeTracking.Finalize();
    
    // 9. Update parent hierarchy
    if (Hierarchy.HasParent)
    {
        await Hierarchy.NotifyParentOfCompletionAsync();
    }
    
    // 10. Record history
    History.AddEntry(new HistoryEntry
    {
        Type = TaskHistoryChangeType.Completed,
        ChangedBy = _currentUserId,
        ChangedAt = DateTime.Now,
        Description = $"Completed with resolution: {input.ResolutionCode}"
    });
    
    // 11. Emit event
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskCompletedEto
    {
        TaskId = Id,
        CompletedBy = _currentUserId,
        CompletedAt = DateTime.Now,
        Resolution = input.ResolutionCode,
        ActualMinutes = TimeTracking.ActualMinutes
    });
}
```

### 1. Aggregate Root: TaskInstance – Invariants & Rules

| Invariant | Enforced When | Failure Result |
|---------|----------------|--------------|
| Title cannot be empty | Create / UpdateTitle | DomainException |
| DueDate ≥ CreatedAt | Any change | DomainException |
| EstimatedHours ≥ 0 | Any change | DomainException |
| Assignee must be active user in tenant | Assign | DomainException |
| Cannot transition if HasBlockingDependencies() and not unblocked | ApplyTransition | TransitionBlockedByDependencyEto |
| Cannot start if CurrentStatus is not a "Todo" category | Start() | InvalidTaskStateTransition |
| Cannot complete if Approval.Status == Pending | Complete() | ApprovalRequiredException |
| Cannot have circular dependency chain | Adding any dependency | CircularDependencyDetectedException |
| Custom field values must pass schema validation | SetValue() | CustomFieldValidationFailed |

### 2. Task Instance Decomposition (To Avoid Gigantic Aggregate)

The TaskInstance root only holds IDs and lightweight value objects. Heavy collections are loaded via Domain Services when needed:

| Sub-Aggregate / Collection | Loaded | Concurrency Strategy |
|----------------------------|------|----------------------|
| Comments | Lazy (via CommentService) | Optimistic concurrency per Comment |
| Attachments | Lazy (via AttachmentService) | Separate aggregate per file |
| Timeline Entries | Event-sourced, read via projection | Immutable events |
| Custom Field Values | Stored in JSONB column on TaskInstance | Version-checked on root |

### 3. Full Domain Event Catalog (TaskInstance Context)

```csharp
// Lifecycle
TaskCreatedEto
TaskStartedEto
TaskCompletedEto
TaskReopenedEto
TaskCancelledEto
TaskDeletedEto (soft)

// Assignment & Collaboration
TaskAssignedEto

TaskMentionedEto

// Progress & Effort
TaskProgressUpdatedEto
TaskEstimatedHoursChangedEto
TaskDueDateChangedEto

// Blocking
TaskBlockedEto

// Approval linkage

// Custom Fields

```

All events include:
- TaskId, TenantId, ProjectId
- ActorId (who triggered)
- Timestamp
- Version (for optimistic concurrency)
- CorrelationId / CausationId

### 4. Concurrency & Optimistic Locking Strategy

```sql
-- PostgreSQL row-level versioning
CREATE TABLE TaskInstances (
    Id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    TenantId UUID NOT NULL,
    Version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    -- other columns...
    CONSTRAINT TaskInstances_Version_Check CHECK (Version > 0)
);
```

- Every command loads TaskInstance with `FOR UPDATE` or checks Version
- On save: `WHERE Id = @Id AND Version = @ExpectedVersion`
- On conflict → ConcurrencyException → client retry with merge UI (last-write-wins with merge screen for comments/fields)

### 5. CQRS Read Models (Finally Specified)

| View | Backed By | Updated Via | Used For |
|------|----------|------------|---------|
| TaskBoardView | task_board_view (Materialized View) | TaskStatusChangedEto, TaskAssignedEto | Kanban boards |
| TaskListView | task_list_view | All task events | My Tasks, Project Task List |
| TaskDetailView | task_detail_projection | All events | Task detail page |
| CalendarView | task_calendar_projection | DueDate/Duration changes | Calendar/Gantt |
| TimelineFeed | timeline_entries | All events | Activity stream |
| SearchIndex | Elasticsearch | All events | Global search |

Example projection (TaskBoardView):

```sql
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW task_board_view AS
SELECT 
    t.Id,
    t.ProjectId,
    t.Title,
    t.CurrentStatusId,
    s.Name AS StatusName,
    s.Category,
    t.AssigneeId,
    t.Priority,
    t.DueDate,
    t.Health
FROM TaskInstances t
JOIN WorkflowStatuses s ON t.CurrentStatusId = s.Id;
```

Refreshed in real-time via event handlers.

### 6. State Machine Integration (Shared Kernel)

```csharp
public class TaskStateMachine
{
    private readonly StateMachineKernel _kernel;
    private readonly WorkflowVersion _workflow;

    public bool CanTransition(Guid fromStatusId, Guid toStatusId, TransitionContext context)
    {
        return _kernel.CanTransition(_workflow, fromStatusId, toStatusId, context);
    }

    public async Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        Guid transitionId,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        var result = await _kernel.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
            workflowVersionId: task.WorkflowVersionId,
            entity: task,
            transitionId: transitionId,
            context: context);

        // Auto-actions from workflow
        foreach (var action in result.Actions)
        {
            if (action.Type == "InitiateApproval") task.InitiateApproval(...);
            if (action.Type == "Notify") _notificationService.Send(...);
        }

        return result;
    }
}
```

### 7. Snapshot Strategy (Event Sourcing Hybrid)

- Events stored forever (immutable audit)
- TaskInstance table is a snapshot (current state)
- Snapshot taken every 50 events or every 24h
- Rehydration possible from event store for legal/compliance requests

### 8. Background Jobs & Sagas

| Saga / Job | Trigger | Responsibility |
|-----------|--------|-----------------|
| TaskOverdueJob | Daily | Mark overdue, notify, escalate |
| DependencyUnblockerSaga | TaskCompletedEto | Unblock successors |
| ApprovalTimeoutWatcher | ApprovalRequestCreatedEto | Monitor SLA |
| RecurrenceEngine | Blueprint + Schedule | Create new TaskInstances |

### 9. Final Integration Flow Example (Most Common Path)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant UI
    participant TaskCmd as Task Command Handler
    participant Task as TaskInstance
    participant WF as Workflow Engine
    participant AP as Approval Context
    participant Proj as Project Context

    User->>UI: Click "Complete Task"
    UI->>TaskCmd: CompleteTaskCommand
    TaskCmd->>Task: Load + Start()
    Task->>WF: CanTransition(To = Done)?
    WF-->>Task: Yes, but requires approval
    Task->>AP: InitiateApproval(ExpenseApprovalWorkflow)
    AP-->>Task: ApprovalRequestCreatedEto
    Task->>Task: Status = PendingApproval
    Task-->>TaskCmd: TaskCompletionBlockedByApprovalEto
    TaskCmd-->>UI: Show "Waiting for approval"
    
    Note over AP,Proj: Later...
    AP-->>Task: ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto (Approved)
    Task->>Task: Complete()
    Task-->>Proj: TaskCompletedEto
    Proj->>Proj: Recalculate health, critical path
    Task-->>UI: TaskCompletedEto → Refresh UI
```

## **Chapter 50 - Progress Aggregate**

### 50.1 Aggregate Purpose

Tracks **status, workflow state, and completion progress** with workflow integration.

### 50.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Progress {
        +Guid TaskId
        +Guid WorkflowStatusId
        +string StatusName
        +WorkflowStatusCategory Category
        +double PercentComplete
        +bool IsNextAction
        +ResolutionInfo Resolution
        
        <<Action Steps>>
        +List~ActionStepCompletion~ ActionSteps
        +int TotalSteps
        +int CompletedSteps
        
        <<Acceptance Criteria>>
        +List~AcceptanceCriterionResult~ AcceptanceCriteria
        +int TotalCriteria
        +int MetCriteria
        
        +void UpdateStatus(statusId)
        +void UpdateProgress(percent)
        +void MarkStepComplete(stepId)
        +void MarkCriterionMet(criterionId)
        +void SetResolution(code, notes)
        +bool AllRequiredStepsComplete()
        +bool AllRequiredCriteriaMet()
    }
    
    class ActionStepCompletion {
        +Guid StepId
        +string Title
        +bool IsComplete
        +DateTime? CompletedAt
        +Guid? CompletedBy
        +string Notes
        +List~Guid~ AttachmentIds
    }
    
    class AcceptanceCriterionResult {
        +Guid CriterionId
        +string Description
        +bool IsMet
        +string Evidence
        +DateTime? VerifiedAt
        +Guid? VerifiedBy
    }
    
    class ResolutionInfo {
        +string Code
        +string Notes
        +DateTime ResolvedAt
        +Guid ResolvedBy
    }
    
    Progress "1" --> "*" ActionStepCompletion
    Progress "1" --> "*" AcceptanceCriterionResult
    Progress "1" --> "0..1" ResolutionInfo
```

### 50.3 Progress Invariants

**Status Rules:**
- WorkflowStatusId must be valid status from workflow
- Category must match status's category
- Cannot move to terminal status without meeting completion requirements

**Percentage Rules:**
- PercentComplete: 0-100
- Auto-calculated from steps + criteria if available
- Manual override allowed if no steps/criteria defined

**Action Step Rules:**
- Cannot mark non-existent step complete
- Cannot un-complete if task in terminal status
- Required steps must be complete before task completion

**Acceptance Criteria Rules:**
- Required criteria must be met before completion
- Evidence required for evidence-based criteria
- Verification must be by authorized user

### 50.4 Progress Calculation

```csharp
public void RecalculateProgress()
{
    double progress = 0;
    
    // Calculate from action steps (60% weight)
    if (ActionSteps.Any())
    {
        var stepProgress = (double)CompletedSteps / TotalSteps * 100;
        progress += stepProgress * 0.6;
    }
    
    // Calculate from acceptance criteria (40% weight)
    if (AcceptanceCriteria.Any())
    {
        var criteriaProgress = (double)MetCriteria / TotalCriteria * 100;
        progress += criteriaProgress * 0.4;
    }
    
    // If no steps or criteria, use manual percentage
    if (!ActionSteps.Any() && !AcceptanceCriteria.Any())
    {
        // Keep existing manual percentage
        return;
    }
    
    PercentComplete = Math.Round(progress, 2);
}
```

## **Chapter 51 - Schedule Aggregate**

### 51.1 Aggregate Purpose

Manages **all temporal aspects** of task execution.

### 51.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Schedule {
        +Guid TaskId
        
        <<Planned Dates>>
        +DateTime? PlannedStartDate
        +DateTime? PlannedDueDate
        +int? PlannedDurationMinutes
        
        <<Actual Dates>>
        +DateTime? ActualStartDate
        +DateTime? ActualDueDate
        +DateTime? CompletedAt
        +int? ActualDurationMinutes
        
        <<Calendar>>
        +Guid? WorkingCalendarId
        
        <<Derived Properties>>
        +bool IsOverdue
        +TimeSpan? TimeRemaining
        +TimeSpan? TimeElapsed
        +double? ScheduleVariance
        
        +void SetPlannedDates(start, due)
        +void MarkStarted()
        +void MarkCompleted()
        +void Postpone(newDue)
        +DateTime CalculateEarliestStart()
        +bool IsWithinSchedule()
    }
```

### 51.3 Schedule Invariants

**Date Constraints:**
- PlannedDueDate ≥ PlannedStartDate (if both exist)
- ActualStartDate ≤ ActualDueDate (if both exist)
- ActualStartDate ≤ CompletedAt (if both exist)
- Cannot set past dates (except for migration)

**Status Consistency:**
- If ActualStartDate set → task must be in InProgress or later
- If CompletedAt set → task must be in terminal status
- Cannot set CompletedAt twice

**Calendar Awareness:**
- Duration calculations respect working calendar
- Business days only if calendar configured
- Holidays excluded from calculations

### 51.4 Schedule Behaviors

**MarkStarted():**
```csharp
public void MarkStarted()
{
    if (ActualStartDate.HasValue)
        throw new DomainException("Task already started");
    
    ActualStartDate = DateTime.Now;
    
    // If no planned start, set it
    if (!PlannedStartDate.HasValue)
        PlannedStartDate = ActualStartDate;
}
```

**MarkCompleted():**
```csharp
public void MarkCompleted()
{
    if (CompletedAt.HasValue)
        throw new DomainException("Task already completed");
    
    if (!ActualStartDate.HasValue)
        ActualStartDate = DateTime.Now; // Started and completed same time
    
    CompletedAt = DateTime.Now;
    ActualDueDate = CompletedAt;
    
    // Calculate actual duration
    ActualDurationMinutes = (int)(CompletedAt.Value - ActualStartDate.Value).TotalMinutes;
}
```

**Overdue Detection:**
```csharp
public bool IsOverdue
{
    get
    {
        if (CompletedAt.HasValue)
            return false; // Completed tasks not overdue
        
        if (!PlannedDueDate.HasValue)
            return false; // No due date = can't be overdue
        
        return DateTime.Now > PlannedDueDate.Value;
    }
}
```

**Schedule Variance:**
```csharp
public double? CalculateScheduleVariance()
{
    if (!PlannedDurationMinutes.HasValue || !ActualDurationMinutes.HasValue)
        return null;
    
    // Variance = (Actual - Planned) / Planned * 100
    var variance = (ActualDurationMinutes.Value - PlannedDurationMinutes.Value) 
                   / (double)PlannedDurationMinutes.Value * 100;
    
    return Math.Round(variance, 2);
}
```

## **Chapter 52 - Assignment Aggregate**

### 52.1 Aggregate Purpose

Manages **who is working on the task** and participation tracking.

### 52.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Assignment {
        +Guid TaskId
        +Guid? AssigneeId
        +string AssigneeName
        +DateTime? AssignedAt
        +Guid? AssignedBy
        
        <<Watchers>>
        +List~Guid~ Watchers
        +int MaxWatchers
        
        <<Participation>>
        +List~Participant~ Participants
        +int CommentsCount
        +int AttachmentsCount
        
        <<Assignment Rules>>
        +bool AllowReassignment
        +bool NotifyOnAssignment
        
        +void Assign(userId)
        +void Unassign()
        +void AddWatcher(userId)
        +void RemoveWatcher(userId)
        +void AddParticipant(userId, role)
        +bool IsUserAssigned(userId)
        +bool IsUserWatching(userId)
    }
    
    class Participant {
        +Guid UserId
        +ParticipantRole Role
        +DateTime JoinedAt
    }
    
    Assignment "1" --> "*" Participant
```

### 52.3 Assignment Invariants

**Assignee Rules:**
- Only one assignee at a time
- Assignee must be active user in same tenant
- Cannot assign to blocked or deleted task
- Cannot assign if task already assigned (must unassign first, or allow reassignment)

**Watcher Rules:**
- Maximum 50 watchers per task
- Watchers must be unique
- Cannot watch if not in project team (optional constraint)
- Assignee automatically becomes watcher

**Participant Rules:**
- Anyone who comments becomes participant
- Anyone who edits becomes participant
- Roles: Owner, Assignee, Watcher, Contributor, Reviewer

### 52.4 Assignment Behaviors

**Assign():**
```csharp
public void Assign(Guid userId, Guid assignedBy)
{
    if (AssigneeId.HasValue && !AllowReassignment)
        throw new DomainException("Task already assigned. Unassign first or enable reassignment.");
    
    var previousAssignee = AssigneeId;
    
    AssigneeId = userId;
    AssignedAt = DateTime.Now;
    AssignedBy = assignedBy;
    
    // Auto-add as watcher
    AddWatcher(userId);
    
    // Add as participant
    AddParticipant(userId, ParticipantRole.Assignee);
    
    // Emit event
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskAssignedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        NewAssigneeId = userId,
        PreviousAssigneeId = previousAssignee,
        AssignedBy = assignedBy,
        AssignedAt = AssignedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**AddWatcher():**
```csharp
public void AddWatcher(Guid userId)
{
    if (Watchers.Count >= MaxWatchers)
        throw new DomainException($"Maximum {MaxWatchers} watchers allowed");
    
    if (Watchers.Contains(userId))
        return; // Already watching
    
    Watchers.Add(userId);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new WatcherAddedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        WatcherId = userId,
        AddedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

## **Chapter 53 - Delegation Aggregate**

### 53.1 Aggregate Purpose

Handles **temporary reassignment** with structured state transitions and audit trail.

### 53.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Delegation {
        +Guid TaskId
        +Guid DelegatedBy
        +Guid DelegatedTo
        +DelegationStatus Status
        +DateTime DelegatedAt
        +DateTime? RespondedAt
        +DateTime? CompletedAt
        +string Reason
        +string ResponseNote
        +bool RequiresAcceptance
        
        +void Delegate(toUserId, reason)
        +void Accept()
        +void Decline(reason)
        +void Revoke()
        +void Complete()
        +bool IsActive
    }
```

### 53.3 Delegation Lifecycle

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Pending: Delegate()
    Pending --> Accepted: Accept()
    Pending --> Declined: Decline()
    Pending --> Revoked: Revoke()
    Accepted --> Completed: Complete Task
    Accepted --> Revoked: Revoke()
    Declined --> [*]
    Revoked --> [*]
    Completed --> [*]
    
    note right of Pending
        Awaiting delegatee response
        if RequiresAcceptance
    end note
```

### 53.4 Delegation Invariants

**Delegation Rules:**
- Cannot delegate to self
- Cannot delegate already delegated task (must revoke first)
- Cannot delegate completed task
- Delegator must have permission to delegate
- Delegatee must be active user

**Status Rules:**
- Pending → Accepted: only by delegatee
- Pending → Declined: only by delegatee
- Any → Revoked: only by delegator
- Accepted → Completed: automatic on task completion

**Response Rules:**
- Decline must include reason
- Cannot accept after declined
- Cannot decline after accepted

### 53.5 Delegation Behaviors

**Delegate():**
```csharp
public void Delegate(Guid fromUserId, Guid toUserId, string reason, bool requiresAcceptance = true)
{
    if (fromUserId == toUserId)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot delegate to self");
    
    if (Status == DelegationStatus.Accepted || Status == DelegationStatus.Pending)
        throw new DomainException("Task already delegated. Revoke first.");
    
    DelegatedBy = fromUserId;
    DelegatedTo = toUserId;
    DelegatedAt = DateTime.Now;
    Reason = reason;
    RequiresAcceptance = requiresAcceptance;
    Status = requiresAcceptance ? DelegationStatus.Pending : DelegationStatus.Accepted;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskDelegatedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        DelegatedBy = fromUserId,
        DelegatedTo = toUserId,
        Reason = reason,
        DelegatedAt = DelegatedAt
    });
}
```

**Accept():**
```csharp
public void Accept()
{
    if (Status != DelegationStatus.Pending)
        throw new DomainException("Can only accept pending delegation");
    
    Status = DelegationStatus.Accepted;
    RespondedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new DelegationAcceptedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        DelegatedTo = DelegatedTo,
        AcceptedAt = RespondedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**Decline():**
```csharp
public void Decline(string reason)
{
    if (Status != DelegationStatus.Pending)
        throw new DomainException("Can only decline pending delegation");
    
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reason))
        throw new DomainException("Decline reason required");
    
    Status = DelegationStatus.Declined;
    RespondedAt = DateTime.Now;
    ResponseNote = reason;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new DelegationDeclinedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        DelegatedTo = DelegatedTo,
        Reason = reason,
        DeclinedAt = RespondedAt.Value
    });
}
```

### 54.3 Blocking Categories

```mermaid
flowchart TB
```

### 54.4 Blocking Invariants

**State Rules:**
- Cannot block completed task
- Cannot block twice (must unblock first)
- Reason and description required when blocking
- Cannot unblock without notes (recommended)

**Category Rules:**
- Dependency blocks must reference valid task
- Approval blocks must reference approval request
- Resource blocks should reference resource

**Auto-Unblock Rules:**
- Dependency block auto-unblocks when dependency resolves
- Approval block auto-unblocks when approved
- Other blocks require manual unblock

### 54.5 Blocking Behaviors

**Block():**
```csharp
public void Block(BlockingReason reason, string description, Guid blockedBy, BlockingCategory category = BlockingCategory.Other)
{
    if (IsBlocked)
        throw new DomainException("Task already blocked");
    
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
        throw new DomainException("Blocking description required");
    
    IsBlocked = true;
    Reason = reason;
    Description = description;
    Category = category;
    BlockedAt = DateTime.Now;
    BlockedBy = blockedBy;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskBlockedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        Reason = reason,
        Description = description,
        BlockedBy = blockedBy,
        BlockedAt = BlockedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**Unblock():**
```csharp
public void Unblock(string notes, Guid unblockedBy)
{
    if (!IsBlocked)
        throw new DomainException("Task not blocked");
    
    IsBlocked = false;
    UnblockedAt = DateTime.Now;
    UnblockedBy = unblockedBy;
    UnblockNotes = notes;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskUnblockedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        UnblockedBy = unblockedBy,
        UnblockedAt = UnblockedAt.Value,
        BlockedDuration = BlockedDuration()
    });
}
```

**Auto-Unblock on Approval:**
```csharp
public async Task HandleApprovalCompletedAsync(ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto evt)
{
    if (Category == BlockingCategory.Approval && 
        RelatedEntityId == evt.RequestId &&
        evt.Outcome == ApprovalOutcome.Approved)
```

## **Chapter 55 - Dependency Aggregate**

### 55.1 Aggregate Purpose

Manages **task-level dependencies** using the shared Dependency Kernel.

### 55.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Dependency {
        +Guid TaskId
        +List~TaskDependency~ Dependencies
        +DateTime? EarliestStartDate
        +bool HasBlockingDependencies
        +List~Guid~ BlockingTaskIds
        
        +void AddDependency(dependency)
        +void RemoveDependency(dependencyId)
        +bool CanStart()
        +List~TaskDependency~ GetUnresolvedDependencies()
        +void RecalculateEarliestStart()
    }
    
    class TaskDependency {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid DependsOnTaskId
        +DependencyType Type
        +int LagMinutes
        +bool IsBlocking
        +DependencyStatus Status
        
        +bool IsResolved()
        +DateTime CalculateEarliestStart()
    }
    
    Dependency "1" --> "*" TaskDependency
```

### 55.3 Dependency Types

**Finish-to-Start (Most Common):**
```
Task A must complete before Task B can start
A: [====] 
B:         [====]
```

**Start-to-Start:**
```
Task B can start when Task A starts (parallel execution)
A: [========]
B:   [========]
```

**Finish-to-Finish:**
```
Task B must finish when Task A finishes
A: [========]
B:     [========]
```

**Start-to-Finish (Rare):**
```
Task B can finish only when Task A starts
A:     [====]
B: [========]
```

### 55.4 Dependency Invariants

**Graph Rules:**
- No circular dependencies
- Task cannot depend on itself
- Cannot depend on deleted task
- Dependencies must be within same project (optional constraint)

**Status Rules:**
- Blocking dependencies must resolve before task can complete
- Non-blocking dependencies are informational only
- Resolved dependencies remain for audit

**Lag Rules:**
- Lag ≥ 0 minutes
- Lag applies after predecessor event (start/finish)
- Lag respects working calendar

### 55.5 Dependency Behaviors

**AddDependency():**
```csharp
public async Task AddDependency(TaskDependency dependency)
{
    // Check for circular dependency
    var wouldCreateCycle = await _dependencyService.WouldCreateCycleAsync(
        TaskId, 
        dependency.DependsOnTaskId
    );
    
    if (wouldCreateCycle)
        throw new DomainException("Adding this dependency would create a circular dependency");
    
    Dependencies.Add(dependency);
    
    // Recalculate earliest start
    await RecalculateEarliestStartAsync();
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskDependencyAddedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        DependsOnTaskId = dependency.DependsOnTaskId,
        Type = dependency.Type,
        IsBlocking = dependency.IsBlocking
    });
}
```

**CanStart():**
```csharp
public bool CanStart()
{
    var blockingDependencies = Dependencies.Where(d => d.IsBlocking);
    
    foreach (var dep in blockingDependencies)
    {
        if (!dep.IsResolved())
            return false;
    }
    
    return true;
}
```

**RecalculateEarliestStart():**
```csharp
public async Task RecalculateEarliestStartAsync()
{
    if (!Dependencies.Any())
    {
        EarliestStartDate = null;
        return;
    }
    
    var dependentTasks = await _taskRepository.GetManyAsync(
        Dependencies.Select(d => d.DependsOnTaskId).ToList()
    );
    
    DateTime? latest = null;
    
    foreach (var dep in Dependencies)
    {
        var dependentTask = dependentTasks.Single(t => t.Id == dep.DependsOnTaskId);
        var depDate = dep.CalculateEarliestStart(dependentTask);
        
        if (!latest.HasValue || depDate > latest.Value)
            latest = depDate;
    }
    
    EarliestStartDate = latest;
}
```

```mermaid
        +int Position
    }
    
    class Attachment {
        +Guid Id
        +string FileName
        +long SizeBytes
        +string ContentType
        +string StorageProvider
        +string StoragePath
        +Guid UploadedBy
        +DateTime UploadedAt
        +bool IsVirusScanned
        +bool IsUnderLegalHold
        
        +void ApplyLegalHold()
        +void MarkVirusScanned(clean)
    }
    
    Discussion "1" --> "*" Comment
    Discussion "1" --> "*" Attachment
    Comment "1" --> "*" Mention
```

### 56.3 Discussion Invariants

**Comment Rules:**
- Text required (minimum 1 character)
- Maximum comment length: 10,000 characters
- Cannot edit others' comments (unless admin)
- Cannot delete if locked discussion
- Deleted comments marked as deleted, not removed

**Attachment Rules:**
- Maximum 500 attachments per task
- Maximum 10 GB total per task
- Virus scanning required before access
- Cannot delete if under legal hold
- File types may be restricted by policy

**Locking Rules:**
- Only authorized users can lock/unlock
- Lock reason required
- Cannot add comments/attachments to locked discussion
- Existing content remains readable

**Mention Rules:**
- Mentioned users automatically become watchers
- Mentioned users receive notifications
- Maximum 20 mentions per comment

### 56.4 Discussion Behaviors

**AddComment():**
```csharp
public void AddComment(Comment comment)
{
    if (IsLocked)
        throw new DomainException("Discussion is locked");
    
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(comment.Text))
        throw new DomainException("Comment text required");
    
    if (comment.Text.Length > 10000)
        throw new DomainException("Comment exceeds maximum length of 10,000 characters");
    
    // Process mentions
    var mentions = ExtractMentions(comment.Text);
    comment.Mentions = mentions;
    
    Comments.Add(comment);
    CommentsCount++;
    
    // Emit event
    AddDomainEvent(new CommentAddedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        CommentId = comment.Id,
        AuthorId = comment.AuthorId,
        Text = comment.Text,
        Mentions = mentions.Select(m => m.UserId).ToList(),
        CreatedAt = comment.CreatedAt
    });
    
    // Emit mention events
    foreach (var mention in mentions)
    {
        AddDomainEvent(new UserMentionedEto
        {
            TaskId = TaskId,
            CommentId = comment.Id,
            MentionedUserId = mention.UserId,
            MentionedBy = comment.AuthorId
        });
    }
}
```

**AddAttachment():**
```csharp
public async Task AddAttachment(Attachment attachment)
{
    if (IsLocked)
        throw new DomainException("Discussion is locked");
    
    // Validate total size
    var totalSize = Attachments.Sum(a => a.SizeBytes) + attachment.SizeBytes;
    if (totalSize > 10_000_000_000) // 10 GB
        throw new DomainException("Total attachment size exceeds 10 GB limit");
    
    // Validate count
    if (Attachments.Count >= 500)
        throw new DomainException("Maximum 500 attachments allowed");
    
    // Queue for virus scanning
    await _virusScanService.QueueForScanAsync(attachment.Id);
    
    Attachments.Add(attachment);
    AttachmentsCount++;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new AttachmentUploadedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        AttachmentId = attachment.Id,
        FileName = attachment.FileName,
        SizeBytes = attachment.SizeBytes,
        UploadedBy = attachment.UploadedBy,
        UploadedAt = attachment.UploadedAt
    });
}
```

**Extract Mentions:**
```csharp
private List<Mention> ExtractMentions(string text)
{
    var mentions = new List<Mention>();
    var regex = new Regex(@"@\[([^\]]+)\]\(([a-f0-9-]+)\)");
    var matches = regex.Matches(text);
    
    foreach (Match match in matches)
    {
        var userName = match.Groups[1].Value;
        var userId = Guid.Parse(match.Groups[2].Value);
        var position = match.Index;
        
        mentions.Add(new Mention
        {
            UserId = userId,
            UserName = userName,
            Position = position
        });
    }
    
    return mentions;
}
```

```mermaid
        +Json Metadata
        
        +string GetDisplayText()
    }

```

### 57.3 History Entry Types

```csharp
public enum TaskHistoryChangeType
{
    Created,
    StatusChanged,
    Assigned,
    Unassigned,
    Delegated,
    DelegationAccepted,
    DelegationDeclined,
    Started,
    Completed,
    Cancelled,
    Blocked,
    Unblocked,
    DueDateChanged,
    PriorityChanged,

```

### 57.4 History Invariants

**Append-Only:**
- History entries never deleted (soft-delete only)
- Entries never modified after creation
- Order preserved by timestamp

**Attribution:**
- Every entry must have ChangedAt timestamp
- ChangedBy nullable only for system changes
- System changes marked with special flag

**Content:**
- Field changes must include old and new values
- Description should be human-readable
- Metadata can contain structured details

### 57.5 History Behaviors

**AddEntry():**
```csharp
public void AddEntry(HistoryEntry entry)
{
    // Validate entry
    if (entry.ChangedAt == default)
        entry.ChangedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry.Description))
    {
        // Auto-generate description based on type
        entry.Description = GenerateDescription(entry);
    }
    
    Entries.Add(entry);
    
    if (!FirstEntryAt.HasValue || entry.ChangedAt < FirstEntryAt.Value)
        FirstEntryAt = entry.ChangedAt;
    
    if (!LastEntryAt.HasValue || entry.ChangedAt > LastEntryAt.Value)
        LastEntryAt = entry.ChangedAt;
}
```

**Generate Description:**
```csharp
private string GenerateDescription(HistoryEntry entry)
{
    switch (entry.Type)
    {
        case TaskHistoryChangeType.StatusChanged:
            return $"Status changed from '{entry.OldValue}' to '{entry.NewValue}'";
        
        case TaskHistoryChangeType.Assigned:
            return $"Assigned to {entry.NewValue}";
        
        case TaskHistoryChangeType.Completed:
            return "Task completed";
        
        case TaskHistoryChangeType.CommentAdded:
            return $"Comment added by {entry.ChangedByName}";
        
        case TaskHistoryChangeType.CustomFieldChanged:
            return $"Field '{entry.Field}' changed from '{entry.OldValue}' to '{entry.NewValue}'";
        
        default:
            return entry.Type.ToString();
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 58 - Hierarchy Aggregate**

### 58.1 Aggregate Purpose

Manages **parent-child relationships** between tasks enabling breakdown of work.

### 58.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Hierarchy {
        +Guid TaskId
        +Guid? ParentTaskId
        +int Level
        +int OrderInParent
        +List~Guid~ SubtaskIds
        +int SubtaskCount
        +int CompletedSubtasks
        +double SubtasksProgress
        
        +void SetParent(parentId)
        +void RemoveParent()
        +void AddSubtask(subtaskId)
        +void RemoveSubtask(subtaskId)
        +void ReorderSubtasks(order)
        +bool AllSubtasksDone()
        +void UpdateProgress()
    }
```

### 58.3 Hierarchy Invariants

**Structure Rules:**
- Maximum nesting level: 5
- Task cannot be its own parent/child
- Cannot create circular hierarchy
- Parent must exist in same project

**Order Rules:**
- OrderInParent unique among siblings
- OrderInParent continuous (1, 2, 3...)

**Completion Rules:**
- Parent cannot complete if required subtasks incomplete (policy)
- Completing parent auto-completes all subtasks (optional policy)
- Deleting parent orphans or deletes subtasks (configurable)

**Progress Rules:**
- Parent progress auto-calculated from subtasks
- Manual override allowed if no subtasks

### 58.4 Hierarchy Behaviors

**SetParent():**
```csharp
public async Task SetParent(Guid parentId)
{
    if (parentId == TaskId)
        throw new DomainException("Task cannot be its own parent");
    
    if (ParentTaskId.HasValue)
        throw new DomainException("Task already has parent. Remove first.");
    
    // Check for circular reference
    var wouldCreateCycle = await _hierarchyService.WouldCreateCycleAsync(TaskId, parentId);
    if (wouldCreateCycle)
        throw new DomainException("Setting this parent would create circular hierarchy");
    
    // Check depth
    var parentLevel = await _hierarchyService.GetLevelAsync(parentId);
    if (parentLevel >= 4) // Max 5 levels (0-4)
        throw new DomainException("Maximum nesting level (5) would be exceeded");
    
    ParentTaskId = parentId;
    Level = parentLevel + 1;
    
    // Add to parent's subtask list
    await NotifyParentOfNewSubtaskAsync(parentId);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new SubtaskAddedEto
    {
        ParentTaskId = parentId,
        SubtaskId = TaskId,
        Level = Level
    });
}
```

**UpdateProgress():**
```csharp
public void UpdateProgress()
{
    if (SubtaskCount == 0)
        return; // No subtasks, progress set manually
    
    // Calculate from subtasks
    SubtasksProgress = (double)CompletedSubtasks / SubtaskCount * 100;
    
    // Update parent's progress aggregate
    AddDomainEvent(new SubtaskProgressChangedEto
    {
        ParentTaskId = ParentTaskId.Value,
        SubtaskId = TaskId,
        NewProgress = SubtasksProgress
    });
}
```

**AllSubtasksDone():**
```csharp
public bool AllSubtasksDone()
{
    return SubtaskCount > 0 && CompletedSubtasks == SubtaskCount;
}
```

### 59.3 Approval Integration

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Task as Task Instance
    participant Approval as Task Approval Aggregate
    participant ApprovalCtx as Approval Context
    
    Task->>Approval: RequireApproval(workflowId)
    Approval->>ApprovalCtx: InitiateApprovalRequest
    ApprovalCtx-->>Approval: ApprovalRequestId

    Note over ApprovalCtx: Approval process happens
```

### 59.4 Approval Behaviors

**RequireApproval():**
```csharp
public async Task RequireApproval(Guid workflowId)
{
    if (RequiresApproval && Status == ApprovalStatus.Pending)
        throw new DomainException("Approval already pending");
    
    RequiresApproval = true;
    Status = ApprovalStatus.Pending;
    RequestedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    // Initiate approval in Approval Context
    var requestId = await _approvalService.InitiateAsync(
        workflowId: workflowId,
        entityType: "Task",
        entityId: TaskId,
        requestedBy: _currentUserId
    );
    
    ApprovalRequestId = requestId;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TaskApprovalRequestedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        ApprovalRequestId = requestId,
        WorkflowId = workflowId,
        RequestedAt = RequestedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**Handle Approval Completion:**
```csharp
public async Task HandleApprovalCompletedAsync(ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto evt)
{
    if (evt.RequestId != ApprovalRequestId)
        return; // Not our approval
    
    CompletedAt = evt.CompletedAt;
    Outcome = evt.Outcome;
    
    switch (evt.Outcome)
    {
        case ApprovalOutcome.Approved:
            Status = ApprovalStatus.Approved;
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskApprovedEto
            {
                TaskId = TaskId,
                ApprovedAt = CompletedAt.Value
            });
            break;
        
        case ApprovalOutcome.Rejected:
            Status = ApprovalStatus.Rejected;
            RejectionReason = evt.RejectionReason;
            AddDomainEvent(new TaskRejectedEto
            {
                TaskId = TaskId,
                Reason = RejectionReason,
                RejectedAt = CompletedAt.Value
            });
            break;
        
        case ApprovalOutcome.TimedOut:
            Status = ApprovalStatus.TimedOut;
            break;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 60 - TimeTracking Aggregate**

### 60.1 Aggregate Purpose

Tracks **actual time spent** working on task with start/stop functionality.

### 60.2 Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class TimeTracking {
        +Guid TaskId
        +int TotalMinutes
        +List~TimeEntry~ Entries
        +DateTime? CurrentEntryStart
        +bool IsTracking
        
        +void Start()
        +void Stop()
        +void LogTime(minutes, description)
        +void AdjustTime(entryId, minutes)
        +TimeSpan GetTotalDuration()
        +void Finalize()
    }
    
    class TimeEntry {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid UserId
        +DateTime StartTime
        +DateTime? EndTime
        +int Minutes
        +string Description
        +bool IsBillable
        
        +TimeSpan GetDuration()
    }
    
    TimeTracking "1" --> "*" TimeEntry
```

### 60.3 TimeTracking Invariants

**Tracking Rules:**
- Only one active time entry per user per task
- Cannot start if already tracking
- Cannot stop if not tracking
- Minutes must be > 0

**Entry Rules:**
- EndTime must be > StartTime
- Total minutes ≥ 0
- Cannot modify finalized entries

**Finalization Rules:**
- Finalize when task completes
- Finalized entries immutable
- Stops any active tracking

### 60.4 TimeTracking Behaviors

**Start():**
```csharp
public void Start(Guid userId)
{
    if (IsTracking)
        throw new DomainException("Time tracking already active");
    
    CurrentEntryStart = DateTime.Now;
    IsTracking = true;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TimeTrackingStartedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        UserId = userId,
        StartedAt = CurrentEntryStart.Value
    });
}
```

**Stop():**
```csharp
public void Stop(Guid userId, string description = null)
{
    if (!IsTracking)
        throw new DomainException("Time tracking not active");
    
    var endTime = DateTime.Now;
    var duration = (int)(endTime - CurrentEntryStart.Value).TotalMinutes;
    
    if (duration < 1)
        duration = 1; // Minimum 1 minute
    
    var entry = new TimeEntry
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        UserId = userId,
        StartTime = CurrentEntryStart.Value,
        EndTime = endTime,
        Minutes = duration,
        Description = description
    };
    
    Entries.Add(entry);
    TotalMinutes += duration;
    
    CurrentEntryStart = null;
    IsTracking = false;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TimeTrackingStoppedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        UserId = userId,
        StoppedAt = endTime,
        MinutesTracked = duration
    });
}
```

**LogTime():**
```csharp
public void LogTime(int minutes, Guid userId, string description)
{
    if (minutes <= 0)
        throw new DomainException("Minutes must be greater than 0");
    
    var entry = new TimeEntry
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        UserId = userId,
        StartTime = DateTime.Now,
        Minutes = minutes,
        Description = description
    };
    
    Entries.Add(entry);
    TotalMinutes += minutes;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TimeLoggedEto
    {
        TaskId = TaskId,
        UserId = userId,
        Minutes = minutes,
        LoggedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

### 61.4 Task Transition Orchestrator

**Bridges Workflow and Task Instance contexts.**

```csharp
public interface ITaskTransitionOrchestrator
{
    Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid transitionId,
        Guid userId,
        Dictionary<string, object> fieldValues,
        string comment
    );
    
    Task<List<AvailableTransition>> GetAvailableTransitionsAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid userId
    );
}

public async Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
    Guid taskId,
    Guid transitionId,
    Guid userId,
    Dictionary<string, object> fieldValues,
    string comment)
{
    // 1. Load task
    var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(taskId);
    
    // 2. Validate with workflow
    var canTransition = await _workflowService.ValidateTransitionAsync(
        task.WorkflowVersionId,
        task.Progress.WorkflowStatusId,
        transitionId,
        userId
    );
    
    if (!canTransition.IsValid)
        return TransitionResult.Failure(canTransition.Errors);
    
    // 3. Execute workflow transition
    var transitionResult = await _workflowService.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        workflowVersionId: task.WorkflowVersionId,
        fromStatusId: task.Progress.WorkflowStatusId,
        transitionId: transitionId,
        context: new TransitionContext
        {
            EntityId = taskId,
            EntityType = "Task",
            UserId = userId,
            FieldValues = fieldValues,
            Comment = comment
        }
    );
    
    // 4. Update task progress
    task.Progress.UpdateStatus(transitionResult.ToStatusId);
    
    // 5. Execute transition actions
    foreach (var action in transitionResult.Actions)
    {
        await _actionExecutor.ExecuteAsync(action, task);
    }
    
    // 6. Save task
    await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task);
    
    return TransitionResult.Success(transitionResult);
}
```

## **Chapter 63 - Organization & Identity Domain Overview**

### 63.1 Domain Purpose

The Organization & Identity Context provides the **foundational identity and organizational structure** used by all other contexts. It manages:

- User identity and authentication integration
- Team structure and membership
- Organizational units and hierarchy
- Role definitions and assignments
- Manager relationships
- External identity provider integration
- Delegation profiles and permissions
- Historical membership tracking

**Strategic Importance:** This is a **foundational domain** - every other context depends on it for identity resolution, but it remains independent of business workflows.

### 63.2 Why Separate Bounded Context?

**Isolation Benefits:**
- Used by every other context without coupling
- Changes slowly (org structure is relatively stable)
- Requires own consistency rules and lifecycle
- Supports synchronization with enterprise IdPs
- Needs historical tracking for audit compliance
- Different scaling characteristics than workflow domains

**Anti-Pattern to Avoid:**
Embedding organization structure in each domain creates:
- Duplication and inconsistency
- Complex synchronization problems
- Audit trail fragmentation
- Performance bottlenecks

### 63.3 Organization Domain Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Tenant** | Billing and isolation boundary (company/organization) |
| **User** | Human or service identity that performs actions |
| **Person** | Real-world individual (may have multiple User accounts) |
| **Team** | Stable group of users with shared responsibility |
| **Organizational Unit (OU)** | Department, division, business unit, or cost center |
| **Role** | Named permission set (Admin, Manager, Approver, etc.) |
| **Membership** | Time-bound link between User and Team/OU |
| **External Identity** | Identity from IdP (Azure AD, Okta, Google, etc.) |
| **Delegation Profile** | User's delegation rights and constraints |
| **Manager Relationship** | Hierarchical reporting structure |
| **Service Account** | Non-human identity for automation |

### 63.4 Context Position in Architecture

```mermaid

        IdP[Identity Providers<br/>Azure AD, Okta, Google]
```

| Feature | Free | Starter | Pro | Enterprise |
|---------|------|---------|-----|------------|
| Max Users | 5 | 25 | 100 | Unlimited |
| Storage | 1 GB | 10 GB | 100 GB | Custom |
| Projects | 10 | 50 | 500 | Unlimited |
| Custom Workflows | 3 | 10 | 50 | Unlimited |
| API Access | Limited | Standard | Advanced | Full |
| Support | Community | Email | Priority | Dedicated |
| SSO/SAML | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Advanced Security | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Custom Retention | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |

### 64.4 Tenant Lifecycle

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Created: Create Tenant
    Created --> Active: Activate()
    Active --> Suspended: Suspend()
    Suspended --> Active: Resume()
    Active --> PendingDeletion: InitiateDeletion()
    Suspended --> PendingDeletion: InitiateDeletion()
    PendingDeletion --> Active: CancelDeletion()
    PendingDeletion --> Deleted: 30 days elapsed
    Deleted --> [*]
    
    note right of PendingDeletion
        30-day grace period
        Data archived
        Users notified
    end note
```

### 64.5 Tenant Invariants

**Status Rules:**
- Cannot activate deleted tenant
- Cannot suspend tenant with active subscriptions (must cancel first)
- Deletion requires 30-day grace period
- Cannot perform operations on suspended tenant (except resume)

**Quota Rules:**
- Cannot create user if MaxUsers reached
- Cannot upload if StorageQuota exceeded
- Warnings at 80% and 95% usage

**Configuration Rules:**
- FeatureFlags immutable for Free tier (predefined)
- RetentionPolicy minimum 1 year (compliance)
- Region cannot change after activation

### 64.6 Tenant Behaviors

**Suspend():**
```csharp
public void Suspend(string reason, Guid suspendedBy)
{
    if (Status == TenantStatus.Deleted)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot suspend deleted tenant");
    
    if (Status == TenantStatus.Suspended)
        throw new DomainException("Tenant already suspended");
    
    Status = TenantStatus.Suspended;
    SuspendedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantSuspendedEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        Reason = reason,
        SuspendedBy = suspendedBy,
        SuspendedAt = SuspendedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**InitiateDeletion():**
```csharp
public void InitiateDeletion(Guid requestedBy)
{
    if (Status == TenantStatus.Deleted)
        throw new DomainException("Tenant already deleted");
    
    Status = TenantStatus.PendingDeletion;
    DeletedAt = DateTime.Now.AddDays(30); // Grace period
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantDeletionScheduledEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        RequestedBy = requestedBy,
        ScheduledDeletionDate = DeletedAt.Value,
        GracePeriodDays = 30
    });
}
```

### 65.3 User Status Lifecycle

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Invited: Create User
    Invited --> Active: Activate()
    Active --> Suspended: Suspend()
    Suspended --> Active: Reactivate()
    Active --> Deactivated: Deactivate()
    Suspended --> Deactivated: Deactivate()
    Deactivated --> Active: Reactivate()
    Deactivated --> Deleted: Hard Delete (rare)
    Deleted --> [*]
    
    note right of Suspended
        Temporary block
        User cannot login
        Data preserved
    end note
    
    note right of Deactivated
        Long-term inactive
        Can be reactivated
        Licenses released
    end note
```

### 65.4 User Invariants

**Identity Rules:**
- Email must be unique within tenant
- UserName must be unique within tenant
- ExternalId must be unique if from IdP
- Must belong to exactly one tenant

**Status Rules:**
- Cannot perform actions if Suspended or Deactivated
- Cannot delete if user has active assignments
- Cannot delete without archiving data first

**Role Rules:**
- Cannot remove last Admin role from tenant
- Cannot assign Enterprise-only roles to Free tier
- Maximum 10 roles per user

**Team Membership Rules:**
- Cannot be member of more than 50 teams
- Cannot leave team if only owner
- Active memberships have LeftAt = null

### 65.5 User Behaviors

**AssignRole():**
```csharp
public void AssignRole(Guid roleId)
{
    if (Status != UserStatus.Active)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot assign role to inactive user");
    
    if (RoleIds.Count >= 10)
        throw new DomainException("Maximum 10 roles per user");
    
    if (RoleIds.Contains(roleId))
        return; // Already has role
    
    RoleIds.Add(roleId);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new UserRoleAssignedEto
    {
        UserId = Id,
        RoleId = roleId,
        AssignedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**JoinTeam():**
```csharp
public void JoinTeam(Guid teamId, MembershipRole role)
{
    if (Status != UserStatus.Active)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot join team while inactive");
    
    // Check if already member
    var existing = TeamMemberships.FirstOrDefault(m => m.TeamId == teamId && m.IsActive);
    if (existing != null)
        throw new DomainException("Already a member of this team");
    
    if (TeamMemberships.Count(m => m.IsActive) >= 50)
        throw new DomainException("Maximum 50 team memberships");
    
    var membership = new TeamMembership
    {
        TeamId = teamId,
        Role = role,
        JoinedAt = DateTime.Now,
        IsActive = true
    };
    
    TeamMemberships.Add(membership);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new UserJoinedTeamEto
    {
        UserId = Id,
        TeamId = teamId,
        Role = role,
        JoinedAt = membership.JoinedAt
    });
}
```

**Deactivate():**
```csharp
public void Deactivate(Guid deactivatedBy, string reason)
{
    if (Status == UserStatus.Deactivated)
        throw new DomainException("User already deactivated");
    
    // Check for blocking conditions
    var activeAssignments = await _taskService.GetActiveAssignmentsAsync(Id);
    if (activeAssignments.Any())
        throw new DomainException($"Cannot deactivate user with {activeAssignments.Count} active task assignments");
    
    Status = UserStatus.Deactivated;
    
    // End all active team memberships
    foreach (var membership in TeamMemberships.Where(m => m.IsActive))
    {
        membership.IsActive = false;
        membership.LeftAt = DateTime.Now;
    }
    
    AddDomainEvent(new UserDeactivatedEto
    {
        UserId = Id,
        TenantId = TenantId,
        DeactivatedBy = deactivatedBy,
        Reason = reason,
        DeactivatedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**Hierarchy Rules:**

- Child team inherits parent permissions (optional)
- Parent team owners can manage child teams

### 66.5 Membership Roles

```csharp
public enum MembershipRole
{
    Owner,        // Full control, can delete team
    Leader,       // Can manage members, cannot delete
    Member,       // Standard member
    Contributor,  // Limited permissions
    Observer      // Read-only
}
```

### 66.6 Team Invariants

**Membership Rules:**
- Must have at least 1 owner
- Cannot remove last owner (must transfer first)
- Maximum members based on tenant tier (50-500)
- Active members have LeftAt = null

**Hierarchy Rules:**
- Parent team must exist in same tenant
- Cannot create circular hierarchy
- Maximum 5 nesting levels

**Visibility Rules:**
- Private teams require invitation
- Public teams allow self-join if enabled
- Archived teams are read-only

### 66.7 Team Behaviors

**AddMember():**
```csharp
public void AddMember(Guid userId, MembershipRole role, Guid addedBy)
{
    if (!IsActive)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot add members to archived team");
    
    // Check if already member
    var existing = Members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == userId && m.IsActive);
    if (existing != null)
        throw new DomainException("User already a member");
    
    if (Members.Count(m => m.IsActive) >= MaxMembers)
        throw new DomainException($"Maximum {MaxMembers} members allowed");
    
    var membership = new TeamMembership
    {
        UserId = userId,
        Role = role,
        JoinedAt = DateTime.Now,
        IsActive = true,
        IsOwner = role == MembershipRole.Owner
    };
    
    Members.Add(membership);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TeamMemberAddedEto
    {
        TeamId = Id,
        UserId = userId,
        Role = role,
        AddedBy = addedBy,
        AddedAt = membership.JoinedAt
    });
}
```

**RemoveMember():**
```csharp
public void RemoveMember(Guid userId, Guid removedBy)
{
    var membership = Members.FirstOrDefault(m => m.UserId == userId && m.IsActive);
    if (membership == null)
        throw new DomainException("User not an active member");
    
    // Check if last owner
    if (membership.IsOwner && Members.Count(m => m.IsActive && m.IsOwner) == 1)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot remove last owner. Transfer ownership first.");
    
    membership.IsActive = false;
    membership.LeftAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TeamMemberRemovedEto
    {
        TeamId = Id,
        UserId = userId,
        RemovedBy = removedBy,
        RemovedAt = membership.LeftAt.Value
    });
}
```

## **Chapter 68 - Role Aggregate**

### 68.1 Role Purpose

Roles define **named permission sets** that can be assigned to users, providing:
- Centralized permission management
- Consistent access control
- Auditable permission changes
- Role-based authorization

### 68.2 Role Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Role {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid TenantId
        +string Name
        +string Description
        +RoleScope Scope
        +bool IsSystemRole
        +bool IsActive
        +List~string~ Permissions
        +DateTime CreatedAt
        
        +void AddPermission(permission)
        +void RemovePermission(permission)
        +bool HasPermission(permission)
        +void Archive()
    }
```

### 68.3 System Roles

**Predefined Roles (Cannot Delete):**
```yaml
systemRoles:
  - name: "System Administrator"
    scope: Global
    permissions:
      - "*"  # All permissions
    
  - name: "Tenant Administrator"
    scope: Tenant
    permissions:
      - "Users.Manage"
      - "Teams.Manage"
      - "Projects.Manage"
      - "Workflows.Manage"
      - "Settings.Manage"
    
  - name: "Project Manager"
    scope: Project
    permissions:
      - "Projects.View"
      - "Projects.Update"
      - "Tasks.Manage"
      - "Sprints.Manage"
      - "Reports.View"
    
  - name: "Developer"
    scope: Project
    permissions:
      - "Tasks.View"
      - "Tasks.Update"
      - "Tasks.Comment"
      - "Tasks.Transition"
    
  - name: "Viewer"
    scope: Tenant
    permissions:
      - "*.View"  # All view permissions
```

### 68.4 Permission Hierarchy

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Permissions ["Permission Structure"]
        P1[Tasks.Manage<br/>Full control]
        P2[Tasks.Update<br/>Edit tasks]
        P3[Tasks.Comment<br/>Add comments]
        P4[Tasks.View<br/>Read-only]
        
        P1 -->|includes| P2
        P2 -->|includes| P3
        P3 -->|includes| P4
    end
```

**Permission Format:** `<Resource>.<Action>`
- Resources: Tasks, Projects, Workflows, Users, etc.
- Actions: View, Create, Update, Delete, Manage, Approve, etc.
- Wildcards: `Tasks.*` (all task actions), `*.View` (view all)

## **Chapter 69 - External Identity Integration**

### 69.1 Identity Provider Support

**Supported Providers:**
- Azure Active Directory (Microsoft Entra ID)
- Okta
- Google Workspace
- OneLogin
- Auth0
- SAML 2.0 (generic)
- OpenID Connect (generic)

### 69.2 Identity Sync Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant IdP as Identity Provider
    participant Sync as Identity Sync Service
    participant Org as Organization Context
    participant Events as Event Bus
    
    IdP->>Sync: Webhook: User Created
    Sync->>Sync: Map External to Internal
    Sync->>Org: CreateOrUpdateUser
    Org->>Org: Upsert User
    Org->>Events: UserCreatedEto or UserUpdatedEto
    
    IdP->>Sync: Webhook: User Deactivated
    Sync->>Org: DeactivateUser
    Org->>Events: UserDeactivatedEto
```

### 69.3 Identity Mapping

```csharp
public class ExternalIdentityMapping
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public string ExternalId { get; set; }
    public string IdentityProvider { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string> Claims { get; set; }
    public DateTime LastSyncAt { get; set; }
    
    // Mapping configuration
    public Dictionary<string, string> AttributeMapping { get; set; }
    
    // Example:
    // "givenName" -> "FirstName"
    // "surname" -> "LastName"
    // "mail" -> "Email"
    // "jobTitle" -> "JobTitle"
    // "department" -> "Department"
}
```

### 69.4 Sync Strategies

**Real-Time Sync (Webhooks):**
- Immediate user provisioning/deprovisioning
- Real-time attribute updates
- Requires webhook configuration in IdP

**Scheduled Sync (Polling):**
- Periodic full sync (hourly, daily)
- Catches missed webhook events
- Reconciles discrepancies

**Just-In-Time (JIT) Provisioning:**
- User created on first login
- Attributes populated from SAML/OIDC claims
- No pre-provisioning needed
