### 70.4 Role Permission Provider

**Purpose:** Resolve effective permissions.

```csharp
public interface IRolePermissionProvider
{
    Task<List<string>> GetRolePermissionsAsync(Guid roleId);
    Task<bool> HasPermissionAsync(Guid userId, string permission);
    Task<bool> HasPermissionInProjectAsync(Guid userId, string permission, Guid projectId);
    Task<List<string>> GetEffectivePermissionsAsync(Guid userId);
}

// Permission check with inheritance
public async Task<bool> HasPermissionAsync(Guid userId, string permission)
{
    var userContext = await _userResolver.GetUserContextAsync(userId);
    
    // Check direct permissions
    if (userContext.Permissions.Contains(permission))
        return true;
    
    // Check wildcard permissions
    var permissionParts = permission.Split('.');
    if (permissionParts.Length == 2)
    {
        var wildcard = $"{permissionParts[0]}.*";
        if (userContext.Permissions.Contains(wildcard))
            return true;
        
        wildcard = $"*.{permissionParts[1]}";
        if (userContext.Permissions.Contains(wildcard))
            return true;
    }
    
    // Check global wildcard
    if (userContext.Permissions.Contains("*"))
        return true;
    
    return false;
}
```

## **Chapter 72 - Organization Integration Patterns**

### 72.1 Identity Resolution in Other Contexts

**Approval Context - Approver Resolution:**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Approval
    participant Org as Organization Context
    
    Approval->>Org: GetUsersByRole("Approver")
    Org-->>Approval: List<User>
    
    Approval->>Org: GetTeamMembers(teamId)
    Org-->>Approval: List<User>
    
    Approval->>Approval: Aggregate Eligible Approvers
```

**Workflow Context - Permission Check:**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Workflow
    participant Org
    
    Workflow->>Org: GetUserContext(userId)
    Org-->>Workflow: UserContext with Roles & Permissions
    
    Workflow->>Workflow: Check if user has "Tasks.Transition"
```

**Task Instance - Assignment Validation:**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Task
    participant Org
    
    Task->>Org: GetUser(userId)
    Org-->>Task: User or NotFound
    
    Task->>Task: Validate user is Active
    Task->>Org: IsUserInTeam(userId, projectTeamId)
    Org-->>Task: true/false
```

### 72.2 Event Subscribers

**Search Context subscribes to:**
- UserCreatedEto → Index user in search
- UserDeactivatedEto → Remove from search
- TeamCreatedEto → Index team

**Notification Context subscribes to:**
- UserJoinedTeamEto → Send welcome notification
- TeamMemberRemovedEto → Update notification preferences
- ManagerChangedEto → Notify new manager

**Security Context subscribes to:**
- UserRoleChangedEto → Invalidate permission cache
- UserDeactivatedEto → Revoke sessions and tokens

# **PART IX - CASE MANAGEMENT CONTEXT**

---

## **Chapter 73 - Case Management Domain Overview**

### 73.1 Domain Purpose

The Case Management Context handles **long-running, dynamic business processes** that don't fit the structured project model. Cases represent:

- Employee onboarding/offboarding
- Incident response and resolution
- Customer support escalations
- Legal matter management
- Procurement processes
- M&A deal tracking
- Compliance investigations
- HR grievances and reviews

**Key Distinction from Projects:**
- Cases are **dynamic** - structure evolves during execution
- Cases are **participant-centric** - focus on roles rather than hierarchy
- Cases span **multiple projects** or exist independently
- Cases have **stages** rather than fixed timelines
- Cases are **event-driven** rather than plan-driven

### 73.2 Case Management Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Case** | Long-running business process with dynamic structure |
| **Case Template** | Reusable blueprint for common case types |
| **Case Stage** | Major phase (Initiation → Investigation → Resolution → Closure) |
| **Case Participant** | User or team involved with specific role |
| **Case Task** | Work item spawned by case (linked to Task Instance) |
| **Case Milestone** | Significant achievement or gateway decision |
| **Case Evidence** | Documents, files, or records attached to case |
| **Case Timeline** | Chronological record of all case activities |
| **Case Status** | Current state (Open, InProgress, OnHold, Resolved, Closed) |
| **Case Priority** | Urgency classification (Critical, High, Normal, Low) |
| **Case Category** | Classification (HR, Legal, Support, IT, Compliance) |

### 74.4 Case Invariants

**Status Rules:**
- Cannot close without resolution summary
- Cannot resolve if required milestones not achieved
- Cannot delete case with active tasks
- Can only reopen within retention period

**Stage Rules:**
- Must follow stage order (unless exception approved)
- Cannot skip required stages
- All stage tasks must complete before advancing
- Stage progression may require approval

**Participant Rules:**
- Must have at least 1 owner
- Cannot remove last owner
- Maximum 50 participants per case
- Active participants have LeftAt = null

**Evidence Rules:**
- Evidence immutable after verification
- Chain of custody must be maintained
- Required evidence defined by case type
- Attachments virus-scanned

**Timeline Rules:**
- DueDate must be > StartDate
- ClosedAt must be > ResolvedAt
- All dates must be sequential

### 74.5 Core Case Behaviors

**Start():**
```csharp
public void Start(Guid startedBy)
{
    if (Status != CaseStatus.Open)
        throw new DomainException("Can only start open cases");
    
    Status = CaseStatus.InProgress;
    StartDate = DateTime.Now;
    
    // Activate first stage
    var firstStage = Stages.OrderBy(s => s.Order).First();
    AdvanceToStage(firstStage.Id);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new CaseStartedEto
    {
        CaseId = Id,
        StartedBy = startedBy,
        StartedAt = StartDate.Value
    });
}
```

**AdvanceToStage():**
```csharp
public void AdvanceToStage(Guid stageId)
{
    if (Status != CaseStatus.InProgress)
        throw new DomainException("Case must be in progress to advance stages");
    
    var targetStage = Stages.SingleOrDefault(s => s.Id == stageId);
    if (targetStage == null)
        throw new DomainException("Stage not found");
    
    // Validate current stage completion if not first stage
    if (CurrentStageId.HasValue)
    {
        var currentStage = Stages.Single(s => s.Id == CurrentStageId.Value);
        
        if (!currentStage.CanAdvance())
            throw new DomainException($"Cannot advance: {currentStage.Name} requirements not met");
        
        // Complete current stage
        currentStage.IsActive = false;
        currentStage.CompletedAt = DateTime.Now;
    }
    
    // Activate new stage
    CurrentStageId = stageId;
    targetStage.IsActive = true;
    targetStage.EnteredAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    // Spawn stage tasks
    var tasks = SpawnStageTasks(targetStage);
    GeneratedTaskIds.AddRange(tasks.Select(t => t.Id));
    
    AddDomainEvent(new CaseStageAdvancedEto
    {
        CaseId = Id,
        FromStageId = CurrentStageId,
        ToStageId = stageId,
        AdvancedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**Resolve():**
```csharp
public void Resolve(string summary, string category, Guid resolvedBy)
{
    if (Status != CaseStatus.InProgress)
        throw new DomainException("Can only resolve in-progress cases");
    
    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(summary))
        throw new DomainException("Resolution summary required");
    
    // Check all required milestones achieved
    var unachievedMilestones = Milestones
        .Where(m => m.IsRequired && !m.IsAchieved())
        .ToList();
    
    if (unachievedMilestones.Any())
    {
        var names = string.Join(", ", unachievedMilestones.Select(m => m.Name));
        throw new DomainException($"Cannot resolve: Required milestones not achieved: {names}");
    }
    
    Status = CaseStatus.Resolved;
    ResolvedAt = DateTime.Now;
    ResolutionSummary = summary;
    ResolutionCategory = category;
    
    AddDomainEvent(new CaseResolvedEto
    {
        CaseId = Id,
        ResolvedBy = resolvedBy,
        ResolvedAt = ResolvedAt.Value,
        Summary = summary,
        Category = category
    });
}
```

### 75.3 Stage Completion Rules

```csharp
public enum StageCompletionRule
{
    AllTasksComplete,        // All spawned tasks must be done
    RequiredTasksComplete,   // Only required tasks must be done
    AllMilestonesAchieved,   // All milestones met
    ManualCompletion,        // User explicitly completes
    TimeElapsed,             // Minimum time passed
    ApprovalGranted,         // Stage approval received
    CustomScript             // Custom completion logic
}
```

**Example Stage Configuration:**
```yaml

  order: 2
  type: Investigation
  completionRule: AllTasksComplete
  requiredTaskBlueprints:
    - "Collect Witness Statements"
    - "Gather Documentation"
    - "Review Logs"
  minDurationDays: 3
  maxDurationDays: 14
  requiresApprovalToAdvance: true
  approvalWorkflow: "investigation-completion-approval"
  onEntryActions:
    - type: "AssignInvestigator"
    - type: "SendNotification"
      to: "stakeholders"
```

### 75.4 Stage Advancement Validation

```csharp
public bool CanAdvance()
{
    switch (Rule)
    {
        case StageCompletionRule.AllTasksComplete:
            var tasks = GetStageTasks();
            return tasks.All(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed);
        
        case StageCompletionRule.RequiredTasksComplete:
            var requiredTasks = GetRequiredTasks();
            return requiredTasks.All(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed);
        
        case StageCompletionRule.AllMilestonesAchieved:
            var milestones = GetStageMilestones();
            return milestones.All(m => m.IsAchieved());
        
        case StageCompletionRule.TimeElapsed:
            if (!EnteredAt.HasValue || !MinDurationDays.HasValue)
                return false;
            var duration = DateTime.Now - EnteredAt.Value;
            return duration.TotalDays >= MinDurationDays.Value;
        
        case StageCompletionRule.ApprovalGranted:
            return ApprovalRequestId.HasValue && IsApprovalCompleted();
        
        case StageCompletionRule.ManualCompletion:
            return CompletedAt.HasValue;
        
        default:
            return false;
    }
}
```

### 76.2 Participant Management

```csharp
public void AddParticipant(Guid userId, ParticipantRole role, Guid addedBy, string notes = null)
{
    if (Participants.Count(p => p.IsActive) >= 50)
        throw new DomainException("Maximum 50 participants allowed");
    
    // Check if already participant
    var existing = Participants.FirstOrDefault(p => p.UserId == userId && p.IsActive);
    if (existing != null)
        throw new DomainException("User already a participant");
    
    var participant = new CaseParticipant
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        UserId = userId,
        Role = role,
        JoinedAt = DateTime.Now,
        IsActive = true,
        Notes = notes
    };
    
    Participants.Add(participant);
    
    // Auto-add as watcher in generated tasks
    foreach (var taskId in GeneratedTaskIds)
    {
        await _taskService.AddWatcherAsync(taskId, userId);
    }
    
    AddDomainEvent(new CaseParticipantAddedEto
    {
        CaseId = Id,
        UserId = userId,
        Role = role,
        AddedBy = addedBy,
        AddedAt = participant.JoinedAt
    });
}
```

```csharp
public class CaseParticipantPermissions

    public static bool CanAddEvidence(ParticipantRole role)

               role == ParticipantRole.Investigator ||
               role == ParticipantRole.Analyst;

    public static bool CanResolve(ParticipantRole role)
    {
        return role == ParticipantRole.Owner ||
               role == ParticipantRole.Resolver;
    }
    
    public static bool CanApproveStage(ParticipantRole role)

    }
}
```

### 77.3 Chain of Custody

**Purpose:** Maintain audit trail for evidence handling, critical for legal and compliance cases.

```csharp
public void TransferCustody(Guid toUserId, Guid byUserId, string reason)
{
    if (!IsVerified)
        throw new DomainException("Cannot transfer unverified evidence");
    
    var transfer = new CustodyTransfer
    {
        FromUserId = byUserId,
        ToUserId = toUserId,
        TransferredAt = DateTime.Now,
        Reason = reason
    };
    
    Transfers.Add(transfer);
    
    // Update chain of custody narrative
    ChainOfCustody += $"\n{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}: Transferred from {byUserId} to {toUserId}. Reason: {reason}";
    
    AddDomainEvent(new EvidenceCustodyTransferredEto
    {
        EvidenceId = Id,
        CaseId = CaseId,
        FromUserId = byUserId,
        ToUserId = toUserId,
        TransferredAt = transfer.TransferredAt
    });
}
```

### 77.4 Evidence Verification

```csharp
public void Verify(Guid verifiedBy)
{
    if (IsVerified)
        throw new DomainException("Evidence already verified");
    
    // Validate integrity if has hash
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Hash))
    {
        var currentHash = CalculateHash();
        if (currentHash != Hash)
            throw new DomainException("Evidence integrity check failed - hash mismatch");
    }
    
    IsVerified = true;
    VerifiedBy = verifiedBy;
    VerifiedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    ChainOfCustody += $"\n{DateTime.Now:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}: Verified by {verifiedBy}";
    
    AddDomainEvent(new EvidenceVerifiedEto
    {
        EvidenceId = Id,
        CaseId = CaseId,
        VerifiedBy = verifiedBy,
        VerifiedAt = VerifiedAt.Value
    });
}
```

## **Chapter 79 - Case Domain Services**

### 79.1 Case Factory Service

```csharp
public interface ICaseFactoryService
{
    Task<Case> CreateFromTemplateAsync(Guid templateId, CreateCaseInput input);
    Task<Case> CreateAdHocAsync(CreateCaseInput input);
    Task<List<TaskInstance>> GenerateStageTasksAsync(Guid caseId, Guid stageId);
}

public async Task<Case> CreateFromTemplateAsync(Guid templateId, CreateCaseInput input)
{
    var template = await _templateRepository.GetAsync(templateId);
    var version = await _versionRepository.GetActiveVersionAsync(templateId);
    
    var caseEntity = new Case
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        TenantId = input.TenantId,
        TemplateVersionId = version.Id,
        Title = input.Title ?? template.Name,
        Description = input.Description,
        Category = template.Category,
        Priority = input.Priority ?? template.DefaultPriority,
        OwnerId = input.OwnerId,
        CreatedBy = input.CreatedBy,
        CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
        Status = CaseStatus.Draft
    };
    
    // Copy stages from template
    foreach (var stageTemplate in version.StageTemplates)
    {
        var stage = new CaseStage
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Name = stageTemplate.Name,
            Description = stageTemplate.Description,
            Order = stageTemplate.Order,
            Type = stageTemplate.Type,
            Rule = stageTemplate.Rule,
            RequiredTaskBlueprintIds = stageTemplate.TaskBlueprintIds.ToList(),
            RequiresApprovalToAdvance = stageTemplate.RequiresApproval
        };
        
        caseEntity.Stages.Add(stage);
    }
    
    // Copy milestones
    foreach (var milestoneTemplate in version.MilestoneTemplates)
    {
        var milestone = new CaseMilestone
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Name = milestoneTemplate.Name,
            Description = milestoneTemplate.Description,
            IsRequired = milestoneTemplate.IsRequired,
            Status = MilestoneStatus.NotStarted
        };
        
        caseEntity.Milestones.Add(milestone);
    }
    
    // Add default participants
    foreach (var roleTemplate in version.ParticipantRoles)
    {
        if (roleTemplate.DefaultAssigneeId.HasValue)
        {
            caseEntity.AddParticipant(
                userId: roleTemplate.DefaultAssigneeId.Value,
                role: roleTemplate.Role,
                addedBy: input.CreatedBy
            );
        }
    }
    
    // Apply custom fields
    caseEntity.CustomFields = template.DefaultCustomFields ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
    
    // Override with input values
    foreach (var (key, value) in input.CustomFields ?? new Dictionary<string, object>())
    {
        caseEntity.CustomFields[key] = value;
    }
    
    await _caseRepository.InsertAsync(caseEntity);
    
    return caseEntity;
}
```

### 79.2 Case Progression Service

```csharp
public interface ICaseProgressionService
{
    Task<bool> CanAdvanceStageAsync(Guid caseId);
    Task AdvanceStageAsync(Guid caseId, Guid userId);
    Task<List<Case>> GetStalledCasesAsync(int daysStalled);
    Task<CaseHealthReport> CalculateHealthAsync(Guid caseId);
}

public async Task AdvanceStageAsync(Guid caseId, Guid userId)
{
    var caseEntity = await _caseRepository.GetAsync(caseId);
    
    if (!caseEntity.CurrentStageId.HasValue)
        throw new DomainException("No active stage");
    
    var currentStage = caseEntity.Stages.Single(s => s.Id == caseEntity.CurrentStageId.Value);
    
    // Validate can advance
    if (!currentStage.CanAdvance())
        throw new DomainException($"Stage {currentStage.Name} requirements not met");
    
    // Check approval if required
    if (currentStage.RequiresApprovalToAdvance)
    {
        if (!currentStage.ApprovalRequestId.HasValue)
        {
            // Initiate approval
            var approvalId = await _approvalService.InitiateAsync(
                workflowId: currentStage.ApprovalWorkflowId.Value,
                entityType: "CaseStage",
                entityId: currentStage.Id,
                requestedBy: userId
            );
            
            currentStage.ApprovalRequestId = approvalId;
            await _caseRepository.UpdateAsync(caseEntity);
            
            throw new DomainException("Stage advancement requires approval");
        }
        
        var approval = await _approvalService.GetStatusAsync(currentStage.ApprovalRequestId.Value);
        if (approval.Status != ApprovalStatus.Approved)
            throw new DomainException("Stage advancement approval not yet granted");
    }
    
    // Find next stage
    var nextStage = caseEntity.Stages
        .Where(s => s.Order > currentStage.Order)
        .OrderBy(s => s.Order)
        .FirstOrDefault();
    
    if (nextStage == null)
    {
        // No more stages - resolve case
        caseEntity.Resolve(
            summary: "All stages completed",
            category: "Completed",
            resolvedBy: userId
        );
    }
    else
    {
        // Advance to next stage
        caseEntity.AdvanceToStage(nextStage.Id);
    }
    
    await _caseRepository.UpdateAsync(caseEntity);
}
```

### 79.3 Case Task Generation Service

```csharp
public async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GenerateStageTasksAsync(Guid caseId, Guid stageId)
{
    var caseEntity = await _caseRepository.GetAsync(caseId);
    var stage = caseEntity.Stages.Single(s => s.Id == stageId);
    
    var tasks = new List<TaskInstance>();
    
    foreach (var blueprintId in stage.RequiredTaskBlueprintIds)
    {
        var task = await _taskFactory.CreateFromBlueprintAsync(
            blueprintId: blueprintId,
            input: new CreateTaskInput
            {
                ProjectId = caseEntity.ProjectId, // If case linked to project
                Title = $"[Case: {caseEntity.Title}] {stage.Name}",
                AssigneeId = caseEntity.AssignedToId,
                CustomFields = new Dictionary<string, object>
                {
                    ["CaseId"] = caseId.ToString(),
                    ["CaseStageId"] = stageId.ToString()
                }
            }
        );
        
        tasks.Add(task);
        
        // Link task to case
        caseEntity.GeneratedTaskIds.Add(task.Id);
        
        // Add case participants as watchers
        foreach (var participant in caseEntity.Participants.Where(p => p.IsActive))
        {
            await _taskService.AddWatcherAsync(task.Id, participant.UserId);
        }
    }
    
    await _caseRepository.UpdateAsync(caseEntity);
    
    return tasks;
}
```

## **Chapter 82 - Resource & Cost Domain Overview**

### 82.1 Domain Purpose

The Resource & Cost Management Context provides **capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking** capabilities essential for:

- Professional services firms (consulting, agencies)
- Project-based organizations
- Resource-constrained environments
- Budget-conscious teams
- Portfolio optimization
- Earned value management

**Key Capabilities:**
- Resource capacity planning
- Allocation management (hard/soft bookings)
- Cost tracking and forecasting
- Budget management
- Utilization analysis
- Rate card management
- Time-and-materials tracking
- Earned value calculations

### 82.2 Resource Domain Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Resource** | Human, equipment, or fixed asset available for allocation |
| **Capacity** | Available working time for a resource in a period |
| **Allocation** | Assignment of resource capacity to work (project/task) |
| **Utilization** | Percentage of capacity actually used |
| **Rate Card** | Pricing structure defining hourly/daily costs |
| **Budget** | Financial plan for project or portfolio |
| **Actual Cost** | Real expenses incurred |
| **Earned Value** | Value of work actually completed |
| **Forecast** | Projected cost at completion |
| **Burn Rate** | Rate of budget consumption |
| **Resource Pool** | Group of similar resources (e.g., Java developers) |
| **Conflict** | Overlapping allocation exceeding capacity |

### 83.3 Resource Capacity Calculation

```csharp
public double GetAvailableHours(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
{
    var calendar = GetWorkingCalendar();
    
    // Calculate total working hours in period
    var totalWorkingHours = calendar.CalculateBusinessHours(startDate, endDate);
    
    // Subtract time off
    var timeOffHours = TimeOffPeriods
        .Where(t => t.Status == TimeOffStatus.Approved && 
                    t.Overlaps(startDate, endDate))
        .Sum(t => t.Hours);
    
    // Subtract existing allocations (hard bookings only)
    var allocatedHours = Allocations
        .Where(a => a.Status == AllocationStatus.Confirmed &&
                    a.Type == AllocationType.Hard &&
                    a.Overlaps(startDate, endDate))
        .Sum(a => a.AllocatedHours);
    
    var availableHours = totalWorkingHours - timeOffHours - allocatedHours;
    
    return Math.Max(0, availableHours);
}
```

### 83.4 Utilization Calculation

```csharp
public double CalculateUtilization(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
{
    var calendar = GetWorkingCalendar();
    
    // Total capacity (working hours minus time off)
    var totalCapacity = calendar.CalculateBusinessHours(startDate, endDate);
    var timeOffHours = TimeOffPeriods
        .Where(t => t.Status == TimeOffStatus.Approved && 
                    t.Overlaps(startDate, endDate))
        .Sum(t => t.Hours);
    
    var netCapacity = totalCapacity - timeOffHours;
    
    if (netCapacity <= 0)
        return 0;
    
    // Actual allocated hours
    var allocatedHours = Allocations
        .Where(a => a.Status == AllocationStatus.Confirmed &&
                    a.Overlaps(startDate, endDate))
        .Sum(a => a.AllocatedHours);
    
    // Utilization = Allocated / Net Capacity * 100
    return (allocatedHours / netCapacity) * 100;
}
```

**Utilization Targets:**

```yaml
    warning: 60%     # Below this triggers alert
    overutilized: 95% # Above this indicates overload
  
  nonBillable:

    training: 5%     # Learning & development
    bench: 5%        # Unallocated time
```

### 83.6 Conflict Detection

```csharp
public List<AllocationConflict> DetectConflicts()
{
    var conflicts = new List<AllocationConflict>();
    
    // Group allocations by date range
    var allocationsByPeriod = Allocations
        .Where(a => a.Status == AllocationStatus.Confirmed)
        .GroupBy(a => (a.StartDate, a.EndDate));
    
    foreach (var group in allocationsByPeriod)
    {
        var (startDate, endDate) = group.Key;
        var allocationsInPeriod = group.ToList();
        
        // Calculate total allocated hours
        var totalAllocated = allocationsInPeriod.Sum(a => a.AllocatedHours);
        
        // Calculate available capacity
        var availableCapacity = GetTotalCapacity(startDate, endDate);
        
        // Check for overallocation
        if (totalAllocated > availableCapacity)
        {
            conflicts.Add(new AllocationConflict
            {
                ResourceId = Id,
                StartDate = startDate,
                EndDate = endDate,
                Capacity = availableCapacity,
                Allocated = totalAllocated,
                Overallocation = totalAllocated - availableCapacity,
                ConflictingAllocations = allocationsInPeriod.Select(a => a.Id).ToList()
            });
        }
    }
    
    return conflicts;
}
```

### 84.2 Rate Card Structure

```mermaid
        <<Client Specific>>

        +decimal ApplyMultipliers(baseRate, context)
```

### 84.3 Rate Calculation

```csharp
public decimal CalculateRate(RateCalculationContext context)
{
    decimal baseRate = 0;
    
    // 1. Get base rate by priority
    if (context.ResourceId.HasValue)
    {
        var resourceRate = ResourceRates.FirstOrDefault(r => r.ResourceId == context.ResourceId);
        if (resourceRate != null)
            baseRate = resourceRate.HourlyRate;
    }
    
    if (baseRate == 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Skill))
    {
        var skillRate = SkillRates.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Skill == context.Skill);
        if (skillRate != null)
            baseRate = skillRate.HourlyRate;
    }
    
    if (baseRate == 0 && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Role))
    {
        var roleRate = RoleRates.FirstOrDefault(r => r.Role == context.Role && 
                                                      r.Level == context.Level);
        if (roleRate != null)
            baseRate = context.Unit == RateUnit.Hourly ? 
                       roleRate.HourlyRate : 
                       roleRate.DailyRate;
    }
    
    if (baseRate == 0)
        throw new DomainException("No applicable rate found");
    
    // 2. Apply multipliers
    var finalRate = ApplyMultipliers(baseRate, context);
    
    // 3. Apply client discount if applicable
    if (ClientId.HasValue && DiscountPercent.HasValue)
    {
        finalRate *= (1 - DiscountPercent.Value / 100);
    }
    
    return Math.Round(finalRate, 2);
}

private decimal ApplyMultipliers(decimal baseRate, RateCalculationContext context)
{
    var rate = baseRate;
    
    foreach (var multiplier in Multipliers.Where(m => m.Applies(context)))
    {
        rate *= multiplier.Factor;
    }
    
    return rate;
}
```

```yaml
    type: TimeOfDay

    condition: "Hour > 18 OR Hour < 8"
  
  - name: "Weekend"

    factor: 2.0
    condition: "DayOfWeek = Saturday OR DayOfWeek = Sunday"
  
  - name: "Holiday"

    factor: 2.5

  - name: "Emergency"

  - name: "Senior Multiplier"
```

### 85.4 Budget Calculations

**Variance Analysis:**
```csharp
public decimal CalculateVariance()
{
    // Cost Variance (CV) = Earned Value - Actual Cost
    var earnedValue = CalculateEarnedValue();
    return earnedValue - ActualCost;
}

public decimal CalculateScheduleVariance()
{
    // Schedule Variance (SV) = Earned Value - Planned Value
    var earnedValue = CalculateEarnedValue();
    var plannedValue = CalculatePlannedValue();
    return earnedValue - plannedValue;
}
```

**Performance Indices:**
```csharp
public double CalculateCostPerformanceIndex()
{
    // CPI = Earned Value / Actual Cost
    if (ActualCost == 0)
        return 1.0;
    
    var earnedValue = CalculateEarnedValue();
    return (double)(earnedValue / ActualCost);
}

public double CalculateSchedulePerformanceIndex()
{
    // SPI = Earned Value / Planned Value
    var plannedValue = CalculatePlannedValue();
    if (plannedValue == 0)
        return 1.0;
    
    var earnedValue = CalculateEarnedValue();
    return (double)(earnedValue / plannedValue);
}
```

**Forecast at Completion:**
```csharp
public decimal CalculateForecastAtCompletion()
{
    // EAC = BAC / CPI (if current performance continues)
    var cpi = CalculateCostPerformanceIndex();
    
    if (cpi == 0)
        return PlannedCost;
    
    var eac = PlannedCost / (decimal)cpi;
    
    // Add contingency
    eac += ContingencyReserve;
    
    return Math.Round(eac, 2);
}
```

**Burn Rate:**
```csharp
public decimal CalculateBurnRate()
{
    // Calculate average daily spending
    var daysElapsed = (DateTime.Now - StartDate).TotalDays;
    
    if (daysElapsed <= 0)
        return 0;
    
    return ActualCost / (decimal)daysElapsed;
}

public DateTime? EstimateDepletionDate()
{
    var burnRate = CalculateBurnRate();
    
    if (burnRate <= 0)
        return null;
    
    var remainingBudget = PlannedCost - ActualCost;
    var daysRemaining = (double)(remainingBudget / burnRate);
    
    return DateTime.Now.AddDays(daysRemaining);
}
```

### 85.5 Budget Health

```csharp
public BudgetHealth CalculateHealth()
{
    var variance = CalculateVariance();
    var cpi = CalculateCostPerformanceIndex();
    var utilizationPercent = (ActualCost / PlannedCost) * 100;
    
    // Determine health based on multiple factors
    if (cpi >= 1.0 && variance >= 0)
        return BudgetHealth.OnTrack;
    
    if (cpi >= 0.9 && variance >= -0.1m * PlannedCost)
        return BudgetHealth.AtRisk;
    
    if (cpi >= 0.8 || ActualCost > PlannedCost)
        return BudgetHealth.OverBudget;
    
    return BudgetHealth.Critical;
}
```

## **Chapter 86 - Earned Value Management**

### 86.1 EVM Purpose

### 86.2 EVM Metrics

### 86.3 EVM Calculations

```csharp
public class EarnedValueCalculator
{
    public EarnedValueMetrics Calculate(Project project, Budget budget)
    {
        // BAC (Budget at Completion)
        var bac = budget.PlannedCost;
        
        // Planned Value (PV) - where we should be
        var plannedProgress = CalculatePlannedProgress(project);
        var pv = bac * (decimal)plannedProgress;
        
        // Earned Value (EV) - where we actually are
        var actualProgress = project.ProgressPercentage / 100;
        var ev = bac * (decimal)actualProgress;
        
        // Actual Cost (AC) - what we've spent
        var ac = budget.ActualCost;
        
        // Cost Variance
        var cv = ev - ac;
        
        // Schedule Variance
        var sv = ev - pv;
        
        // Cost Performance Index
        var cpi = ac > 0 ? (double)(ev / ac) : 1.0;
        
        // Schedule Performance Index
        var spi = pv > 0 ? (double)(ev / pv) : 1.0;
        
        // Estimate at Completion
        var eac = cpi > 0 ? bac / (decimal)cpi : bac;
        
        // Estimate to Complete
        var etc = eac - ac;
        
        // Variance at Completion
        var vac = bac - eac;
        
        // To Complete Performance Index
        var tcpi = (bac - ev) / (bac - ac);
        
        return new EarnedValueMetrics
        {
            BAC = bac,
            PV = pv,
            EV = ev,
            AC = ac,
            CV = cv,
            SV = sv,
            CPI = cpi,
            SPI = spi,
            EAC = eac,
            ETC = etc,
            VAC = vac,
            TCPI = (double)tcpi
        };
    }
}
```

### 86.4 EVM Interpretation

```yaml
interpretation:
  CPI:
    "> 1.0": "Under budget - spending less than planned"
    "= 1.0": "On budget - spending as planned"
    "< 1.0": "Over budget - spending more than planned"
  
  SPI:
    "> 1.0": "Ahead of schedule - progressing faster than planned"
    "= 1.0": "On schedule - progressing as planned"
    "< 1.0": "Behind schedule - progressing slower than planned"
  
  CV:
    "> 0": "Cost savings"
    "= 0": "On budget"
    "< 0": "Cost overrun"
  
  SV:
    "> 0": "Ahead of schedule"
    "= 0": "On schedule"
    "< 0": "Behind schedule"
```

### 87.1 Resource Allocation Service

```csharp
public interface IResourceAllocationService
{
    Task<AllocationResult> AllocateAsync(AllocationRequest request);
    Task<List<Resource>> FindAvailableResourcesAsync(ResourceQuery query);
    Task<List<AllocationConflict>> DetectConflictsAsync(Guid resourceId);
    Task ResolveConflictAsync(Guid conflictId, ConflictResolution resolution);
    Task<CapacityReport> GetCapacityReportAsync(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate);
}

public async Task<AllocationResult> AllocateAsync(AllocationRequest request)
{
    // 1. Validate resource exists and is active
    var resource = await _resourceRepository.GetAsync(request.ResourceId);
    if (!resource.IsActive)
        throw new DomainException("Resource is not active");
    
    // 2. Check availability
    var availableHours = resource.GetAvailableHours(request.StartDate, request.EndDate);
    if (availableHours < request.RequiredHours && request.Type == AllocationType.Hard)
    {
        return AllocationResult.Failure($"Insufficient capacity. Available: {availableHours}h, Required: {request.RequiredHours}h");
    }
    
    // 3. Create allocation
    var allocation = new ResourceAllocation
    {
        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
        ResourceId = request.ResourceId,
        ProjectId = request.ProjectId,
        TaskId = request.TaskId,
        StartDate = request.StartDate,
        EndDate = request.EndDate,
        AllocatedHours = request.RequiredHours,
        Type = request.Type,
        Status = request.Type == AllocationType.Hard ? 
                 AllocationStatus.Confirmed : 
                 AllocationStatus.Requested,
        Notes = request.Notes
    };
    
    resource.AddAllocation(allocation);
    await _resourceRepository.UpdateAsync(resource);
    
    // 4. Emit event
    await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new ResourceAllocatedEto
    {
        ResourceId = resource.Id,
        AllocationId = allocation.Id,
        ProjectId = request.ProjectId,
        AllocatedHours = request.RequiredHours,
        AllocatedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
    
    return AllocationResult.Success(allocation);
}
```

### 87.3 Cost Calculation Service

```csharp
public interface ICostCalculationService
{
    Task<decimal> CalculateProjectCostAsync(Guid projectId);
    Task<decimal> CalculateTaskCostAsync(Guid taskId);
    Task<CostBreakdown> GetCostBreakdownAsync(Guid projectId);
    Task<decimal> ForecastRemainingCostAsync(Guid projectId);
}

public async Task<decimal> CalculateProjectCostAsync(Guid projectId)
{
    var project = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(projectId);
    var resources = await _resourceRepository.GetProjectResourcesAsync(projectId);
    
    decimal totalCost = 0;
    
    foreach (var resource in resources)
    {
        var allocations = resource.Allocations
            .Where(a => a.ProjectId == projectId && 
                       a.Status == AllocationStatus.Confirmed)
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var allocation in allocations)
        {
            // Get rate card
            var rateCard = await _rateCardService.GetActiveRateCardAsync(resource.RateCardId);
            
            // Calculate rate
            var rate = rateCard.CalculateRate(new RateCalculationContext
            {
                ResourceId = resource.Id,
                ProjectId = projectId,
                StartDate = allocation.StartDate,
                EndDate = allocation.EndDate
            });
            
            // Calculate cost
            var cost = allocation.AllocatedHours * rate;
            totalCost += cost;
        }
    }
    
    return totalCost;
}
```

## **Chapter 90 - Resource Optimization Algorithms**

### 90.1 Resource Leveling

**Purpose:** Smooth resource usage over time to avoid peaks and valleys.

```csharp
public class ResourceLevelingService
{
    public List<AllocationAdjustment> LevelResources(
        List<Resource> resources, 
        List<ResourceAllocation> allocations,
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate)
    {
        var adjustments = new List<AllocationAdjustment>();
        
        // Calculate daily resource demand
        var dailyDemand = CalculateDailyDemand(allocations, startDate, endDate);
        
        // Identify peaks
        var peaks = dailyDemand.Where(d => d.Demand > d.Capacity).ToList();
        
        // For each peak, try to shift flexible allocations
        foreach (var peak in peaks)
        {
            var flexibleAllocations = allocations
                .Where(a => a.Type == AllocationType.Soft && 
                           a.StartDate <= peak.Date && 
                           a.EndDate >= peak.Date)
                .OrderBy(a => a.Priority)
                .ToList();
            
            foreach (var allocation in flexibleAllocations)
            {
                // Try to shift allocation
                var newStartDate = FindOptimalStartDate(
                    allocation, 
                    dailyDemand,
                    startDate,
                    endDate
                );
                
                if (newStartDate != allocation.StartDate)
                {
                    adjustments.Add(new AllocationAdjustment
                    {
                        AllocationId = allocation.Id,
                        OldStartDate = allocation.StartDate,
                        NewStartDate = newStartDate,
                        Reason = "Resource leveling"
                    });
                    
                    // Update demand calculation
                    dailyDemand = RecalculateDemand(dailyDemand, allocation, newStartDate);
                }
                
                // Stop if peak resolved
                if (dailyDemand[peak.Date].Demand <= dailyDemand[peak.Date].Capacity)
                    break;
            }
        }
        
        return adjustments;
    }
}
```

### 90.2 Resource Matching

**Purpose:** Find best resource match for requirements.

```csharp
public class ResourceMatchingService
{
    public List<ResourceMatch> FindBestMatches(ResourceRequirement requirement)
    {
        var candidates = _resourceRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(r => r.IsActive)
            .Where(r => r.Type == requirement.ResourceType)
            .ToList();
        
        var matches = new List<ResourceMatch>();
        
        foreach (var resource in candidates)
        {
            var score = CalculateMatchScore(resource, requirement);
            
            if (score >= requirement.MinimumScore)
            {
                matches.Add(new ResourceMatch
                {
                    Resource = resource,
                    Score = score,
                    AvailableHours = resource.GetAvailableHours(
                        requirement.StartDate,
                        requirement.EndDate
                    ),
                    EstimatedCost = CalculateEstimatedCost(
                        resource,
                        requirement.RequiredHours
                    )
                });
            }
        }
        
        return matches
            .OrderByDescending(m => m.Score)
            .ThenBy(m => m.EstimatedCost)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private double CalculateMatchScore(Resource resource, ResourceRequirement requirement)
    {
        double score = 0;
        
        // Skill match (0-40 points)
        var skillMatch = resource.Skills
            .Intersect(requirement.RequiredSkills)
            .Count();
        score += (skillMatch / (double)requirement.RequiredSkills.Count) * 40;
        
        // Experience level match (0-20 points)
        if (resource.Level == requirement.PreferredLevel)
            score += 20;
        else if (resource.Level > requirement.PreferredLevel)
            score += 15; // More experienced is good
        else
            score += 5;  // Less experienced is acceptable
        
        // Availability match (0-20 points)
        var availableHours = resource.GetAvailableHours(
            requirement.StartDate,
            requirement.EndDate
        );
        var availabilityRatio = availableHours / requirement.RequiredHours;
        score += Math.Min(availabilityRatio, 1.0) * 20;
        
        // Location match (0-10 points)
        if (resource.Location == requirement.PreferredLocation)
            score += 10;
        
        // Cost efficiency (0-10 points)
        var rate = resource.StandardHourlyRate ?? 0;
        if (rate <= requirement.MaxHourlyRate)
            score += 10;
        else if (rate <= requirement.MaxHourlyRate * 1.2m)
            score += 5;
        
        return score;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 91 - Tenancy Domain Overview**

### 91.1 Domain Purpose

The Tenancy Context provides the **foundational isolation boundary** for the entire multi-tenant SaaS platform. It ensures:

- Complete data isolation between tenants
- Per-tenant configuration and customization
- Scalable multi-tenant architecture
- Tenant lifecycle management
- Fair resource allocation
- Compliance with data residency requirements
- Tenant-specific feature enablement

**Strategic Importance:** This is the **most foundational domain** - it wraps all other contexts and provides the security and isolation guarantees necessary for SaaS operations.

### 91.2 Tenancy Domain Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Tenant** | Isolated customer organization with own data and configuration |
| **Tenant Tier** | Service level (Free, Starter, Professional, Enterprise) |
| **Tenant Status** | Lifecycle state (Created, Active, Suspended, Deleted) |
| **Data Residency** | Geographic location where tenant data is stored |
| **Isolation Strategy** | Method of data separation (shared DB, separate schema, dedicated DB) |
| **Tenant Configuration** | Per-tenant settings, features, and customizations |
| **Cross-Tenant Access** | Strictly prohibited operations across tenant boundaries |
| **Tenant Quota** | Resource limits (users, storage, API calls, etc.) |
| **Tenant Branding** | Custom appearance, logos, colors per tenant |
| **Tenant Deletion** | Soft delete with grace period, then hard purge |

```mermaid
        S2[Shared DB<br/>Separate Schema<br/>Medium Isolation]
```

### 92.2 Tenant Status Lifecycle (Detailed)

### 92.4 Tenant Invariants (Enhanced)

**Lifecycle Invariants:**
- Cannot activate tenant in Provisioning state (must complete provisioning)
- Cannot suspend tenant with active payment (must resolve payment first or force suspend)
- Cannot permanently delete tenant with active legal holds
- Deletion requires 30-day grace period (configurable for Enterprise)
- Soft-deleted tenants retain data for 90 days minimum

**Quota Invariants:**
- Free tier cannot exceed 5 users (hard limit)
- Storage quota enforced at upload time
- API rate limits enforced per hour and per day
- Quota violations trigger notifications at 75%, 90%, 100%
- Enterprise tier can have custom quotas

**Configuration Invariants:**
- Subdomain must be unique globally
- Region cannot change after initial data creation
- Isolation strategy cannot change after provisioning
- Tier downgrades validated against current usage

**Compliance Invariants:**
- GDPR tenants must have EU region or consent
- HIPAA tenants require dedicated database strategy
- Retention policy minimum = 1 year (regulatory)
- Cannot delete tenant with active compliance holds

### 92.5 Tenant Behaviors (Enhanced)

**Activate():**
```csharp
public void Activate(Guid activatedBy)
{
    if (Status != TenantStatus.Provisioning)
        throw new DomainException($"Can only activate tenant in Provisioning state. Current: {Status}");
    
    // Validate provisioning completed
    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(DatabaseConnectionString) && IsolationStrategy != IsolationStrategy.SharedDatabase)
        throw new DomainException("Database not provisioned");
    
    Status = TenantStatus.Active;
    ActivatedAt = DateTime.Now;
    
    // Initialize default configuration
    Configuration ??= TenantConfiguration.CreateDefault();
    
    // Set initial quotas based on tier
    Quotas = TenantQuotas.ForTier(Tier);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantActivatedEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        TenantName = Name,
        Tier = Tier,
        ActivatedBy = activatedBy,
        ActivatedAt = ActivatedAt.Value
    });
}
```

**UpgradeTier():**
```csharp
public void UpgradeTier(TenantTier newTier, Guid upgradedBy)
{
    if (newTier <= Tier)
        throw new DomainException("Can only upgrade to higher tier");
    
    var oldTier = Tier;
    Tier = newTier;
    
    // Update quotas
    Quotas = TenantQuotas.ForTier(newTier);
    
    // Enable new features
    Configuration.EnableFeaturesForTier(newTier);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantTierUpgradedEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        OldTier = oldTier,
        NewTier = newTier,
        UpgradedBy = upgradedBy,
        UpgradedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**DowngradeTier():**
```csharp
public void DowngradeTier(TenantTier newTier, Guid downgradedBy)
{
    if (newTier >= Tier)
        throw new DomainException("Can only downgrade to lower tier");
    
    // Validate current usage fits in new tier
    var newQuotas = TenantQuotas.ForTier(newTier);
    var validationResult = ValidateUsageAgainstQuotas(newQuotas);
    
    if (!validationResult.IsValid)
    {
        throw new DomainException(
            $"Cannot downgrade: Current usage exceeds new tier limits. {validationResult.ErrorMessage}"
        );
    }
    
    var oldTier = Tier;
    Tier = newTier;
    Quotas = newQuotas;
    
    // Disable features not available in new tier
    Configuration.DisableFeaturesNotInTier(newTier);
    
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantTierDowngradedEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        OldTier = oldTier,
        NewTier = newTier,
        DowngradedBy = downgradedBy,
        DowngradedAt = DateTime.Now
    });
}
```

**InitiateDeletion():**
```csharp
public void InitiateDeletion(Guid requestedBy, string reason)
{
    if (Status == TenantStatus.PendingDeletion || Status == TenantStatus.Deleted)
        throw new DomainException("Tenant already scheduled for deletion");
    
    // Check for active legal holds
    if (HasActiveLegalHolds())
        throw new DomainException("Cannot delete tenant with active legal holds");
    
    var previousStatus = Status;
    Status = TenantStatus.PendingDeletion;
    
    // Enterprise gets 90 days, others get 30 days
    var gracePeriodDays = Tier == TenantTier.Enterprise ? 90 : 30;
    DeletedAt = DateTime.Now.AddDays(gracePeriodDays);
    
    // Archive critical data immediately
    AddDomainEvent(new TenantDeletionScheduledEto
    {
        TenantId = Id,
        TenantName = Name,
        RequestedBy = requestedBy,
        Reason = reason,
        ScheduledDeletionDate = DeletedAt.Value,
        GracePeriodDays = gracePeriodDays,
        PreviousStatus = previousStatus
    });
}
```

**UpdateUsage():**
```csharp
public void UpdateUsage(UsageType type, int amount)
{
    CurrentUsage.LastUpdated = DateTime.Now;
    
    switch (type)
    {
        case UsageType.Users:
            CurrentUsage.ActiveUsers = amount;
            if (CurrentUsage.ActiveUsers > Quotas.MaxUsers && !Quotas.UnlimitedUsers)
            {
                AddDomainEvent(new TenantQuotaExceededEto
                {
                    TenantId = Id,
                    QuotaType = "Users",
                    Limit = Quotas.MaxUsers,
                    Current = CurrentUsage.ActiveUsers
                });
            }
            break;
        
        case UsageType.Storage:
            CurrentUsage.StorageUsedBytes += amount;
            var storagePercent = (double)CurrentUsage.StorageUsedBytes / Quotas.MaxStorageBytes * 100;
            
            if (storagePercent >= 75 && storagePercent < 90)
            {
                AddDomainEvent(new TenantQuotaWarningEto
                {
                    TenantId = Id,
                    QuotaType = "Storage",
                    PercentUsed = storagePercent,
                    WarningLevel = "75%"
                });
            }
            else if (storagePercent >= 90 && storagePercent < 100)
            {
                AddDomainEvent(new TenantQuotaWarningEto
                {
                    TenantId = Id,
                    QuotaType = "Storage",
                    PercentUsed = storagePercent,
                    WarningLevel = "90%"
                });
            }
            else if (storagePercent >= 100)
            {
                AddDomainEvent(new TenantQuotaExceededEto
                {
                    TenantId = Id,
                    QuotaType = "Storage",
                    Limit = Quotas.MaxStorageBytes,
                    Current = CurrentUsage.StorageUsedBytes
                });
            }
            break;
        
        case UsageType.ApiCall:
            CurrentUsage.ApiCallsThisHour++;
            CurrentUsage.ApiCallsToday++;
            
            if (CurrentUsage.ApiCallsThisHour > Quotas.MaxApiCallsPerHour)
            {
                throw new QuotaExceededException("API", "Hourly API call limit exceeded");
            }
            break;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 93 - Isolation Strategies**

### 93.1 Strategy Comparison

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Strategy1 ["Shared DB + Shared Schema"]
        S1_1[Single Database]
        S1_2[TenantId in every table]
        S1_3[Query filters on TenantId]
        S1_4[Lowest cost, highest density]
        
        S1_1 --> S1_2 --> S1_3 --> S1_4
    end
    
    subgraph Strategy2 ["Shared DB + Separate Schema"]
        S2_1[Single Database]
        S2_2[One schema per tenant]
        S2_3[Connection string with schema]
        S2_4[Medium isolation, moderate cost]
        
        S2_1 --> S2_2 --> S2_3 --> S2_4
    end
    
    subgraph Strategy3 ["Dedicated Database"]
        S3_1[Separate database per tenant]
        S3_2[Complete data isolation]
        S3_3[Dedicated connection pool]
        S3_4[High isolation, higher cost]
        
        S3_1 --> S3_2 --> S3_3 --> S3_4
    end
```

### 93.2 Strategy Selection Logic

```csharp
public class IsolationStrategySelector
{
    public IsolationStrategy SelectStrategy(Tenant tenant)
    {
        // Enterprise tier with compliance requirements
        if (tenant.Tier == TenantTier.Enterprise)
        {
            if (tenant.ComplianceFrameworks.Contains("HIPAA") ||
                tenant.ComplianceFrameworks.Contains("FedRAMP"))
            {
                return IsolationStrategy.DedicatedDatabase;
            }
            
            // Large enterprise without special compliance
            return IsolationStrategy.SeparateSchema;
        }
        
        // Professional tier
        if (tenant.Tier == TenantTier.Professional)
        {
            return IsolationStrategy.SeparateSchema;
        }
        
        // Free and Starter tiers
        return IsolationStrategy.SharedDatabase;
    }
}
```

### 93.3 Shared Database Strategy

**Implementation:**
```csharp
public class SharedDatabaseIsolation : IIsolationStrategy
{
    public void ApplyTenantFilter<T>(IQueryable<T> query, Guid tenantId) 
        where T : IMultiTenant
    {
        // EF Core global query filter applied automatically
        // Configured in DbContext:
        // modelBuilder.Entity<Task>().HasQueryFilter(t => t.TenantId == _currentTenant.Id);
    }
    
    public void ValidateEntity<T>(T entity, Guid tenantId) 
        where T : IMultiTenant
    {
        if (entity.TenantId != tenantId)
            throw new CrossTenantAccessException($"Entity belongs to different tenant");
    }
    
    public async Task ProvisionTenantAsync(Tenant tenant)
    {
        // No database provisioning needed - uses shared database
        tenant.DatabaseConnectionString = _sharedConnectionString;
        tenant.SchemaName = "dbo"; // Shared schema
    }
}
```

**Pros:**
- Maximum tenant density (thousands per database)
- Lowest infrastructure cost
- Simplest to manage
- Easy horizontal scaling

**Cons:**
- Lower isolation
- Noisy neighbor risk
- Harder to provide tenant-specific SLAs
- Query performance can degrade with many tenants

### 93.4 Separate Schema Strategy

**Implementation:**
```csharp
public class SeparateSchemaIsolation : IIsolationStrategy
{
    public async Task ProvisionTenantAsync(Tenant tenant)
    {
        var schemaName = $"tenant_{tenant.Id.ToString("N").Substring(0, 8)}";
        
        // Create schema
        await _database.ExecuteSqlAsync($"CREATE SCHEMA [{schemaName}]");
        
        // Create all tables in tenant schema
        var migrations = _migrationService.GetAllMigrations();
        foreach (var migration in migrations)
        {
            await _database.ExecuteSqlAsync(
                migration.Sql.Replace("[dbo].", $"[{schemaName}].")
            );
        }
        
        // Store schema info
        tenant.SchemaName = schemaName;
        tenant.DatabaseConnectionString = _sharedConnectionString;
    }
    
    public void SetTenantContext(DbContext context, Guid tenantId, string schemaName)
    {
        // Change default schema for this connection
        context.Database.ExecuteSqlRaw($"SET SEARCH_PATH TO {schemaName}");
        // OR for SQL Server:
        // context.Database.ExecuteSqlRaw($"EXEC('USE [{schemaName}]')");
    }
}
```

**Pros:**
- Good isolation (database-level separation)
- Moderate cost
- Easier to provide tenant-specific SLAs
- Easier to backup/restore individual tenants
- Better query performance per tenant

**Cons:**
- More complex than shared database
- Schema limit per database (PostgreSQL: unlimited, SQL Server: ~30k)
- More complex connection management

### 93.5 Dedicated Database Strategy

**Implementation:**
```csharp
public class DedicatedDatabaseIsolation : IIsolationStrategy
{
    public async Task ProvisionTenantAsync(Tenant tenant)
    {
        var dbName = $"tenant_{tenant.Id:N}";
        
        // Create database
        await _database.ExecuteSqlAsync($"CREATE DATABASE [{dbName}]");
        
        // Build connection string
        var connectionString = _connectionStringBuilder.Build(dbName);
        tenant.DatabaseConnectionString = connectionString;
        tenant.SchemaName = "dbo";
        
        // Run migrations on new database
        using (var dbContext = _contextFactory.Create(connectionString))
        {
            await dbContext.Database.MigrateAsync();
        }
        
        // Seed default data
        await _seeder.SeedDefaultDataAsync(tenant.Id);
    }
    
    public async Task DeprovisionTenantAsync(Tenant tenant)
    {
        var dbName = ExtractDatabaseName(tenant.DatabaseConnectionString);
        
        // Backup before deletion
        await BackupDatabaseAsync(dbName);
        
        // Drop database
        await _database.ExecuteSqlAsync($"DROP DATABASE [{dbName}]");
    }
}
```

**Pros:**
- Maximum isolation
- Complete resource isolation (CPU, memory, I/O)
- Easy to backup/restore entire tenant
- Easy to migrate tenant to different server
- Can provide dedicated infrastructure for large tenants
- Best security for regulated industries

**Cons:**
- Highest infrastructure cost
- More complex management (many databases)
- More complex monitoring
- Connection pool per tenant

## **Chapter 94 - Tenant Provisioning Service**

### 94.1 Provisioning Workflow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant API
    participant ProvService as Provisioning Service
    participant Tenant as Tenant Aggregate
    participant DB as Database Service
    participant Queue as Background Queue
    
    User->>API: Create Tenant Request
    API->>ProvService: Provision(request)
    ProvService->>Tenant: Create(data)
    Tenant-->>ProvService: Tenant (Provisioning state)
    
    ProvService->>Queue: Enqueue Provisioning Job
    Queue-->>ProvService: Job Queued
    ProvService-->>API: Tenant Created (Provisioning)
    API-->>User: Provisioning In Progress
    
    Note over Queue: Background Worker
    
    Queue->>DB: Provision Database/Schema
    DB-->>Queue: Provisioned
    
    Queue->>ProvService: Database Ready
    ProvService->>Tenant: Activate()
    Tenant-->>ProvService: Activated
    
    ProvService->>User: Email: Tenant Ready
```

### 94.2 Provisioning Service Implementation

```csharp
public class TenantProvisioningService
{
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
    private readonly IIsolationStrategyFactory _strategyFactory;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobQueue _jobQueue;
    private readonly IEmailService _emailService;
    
    public async Task<Tenant> ProvisionTenantAsync(ProvisionTenantRequest request)
    {
        // 1. Validate subdomain availability
        var subdomainExists = await _tenantRepository
            .AnyAsync(t => t.Subdomain == request.Subdomain);
        
        if (subdomainExists)
            throw new DomainException($"Subdomain '{request.Subdomain}' already taken");
        
        // 2. Create tenant in Provisioning state
        var tenant = new Tenant
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Name = request.CompanyName,
            DisplayName = request.CompanyName,
            Subdomain = request.Subdomain,
            Status = TenantStatus.Provisioning,
            Tier = request.Tier,
            Region = request.Region,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
            BillingEmail = request.Email
        };
        
        // 3. Determine isolation strategy
        var strategySelector = new IsolationStrategySelector();
        tenant.IsolationStrategy = strategySelector.SelectStrategy(tenant);
        
        // 4. Save tenant
        await _tenantRepository.InsertAsync(tenant);
        
        // 5. Queue provisioning job
        await _jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new ProvisionTenantJob
        {
            TenantId = tenant.Id,
            IsolationStrategy = tenant.IsolationStrategy
        });
        
        // 6. Send provisioning started email
        await _emailService.SendAsync(new Email
        {
            To = request.Email,
            Subject = "Your workspace is being set up",
            Template = "TenantProvisioningStarted",
            Data = new { tenant.Name, tenant.Subdomain }
        });
        
        return tenant;
    }
    
    public async Task CompleteProvisioningAsync(Guid tenantId, Guid activatedBy)
    {
        var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetAsync(tenantId);
        
        if (tenant.Status != TenantStatus.Provisioning)
            throw new DomainException("Tenant not in provisioning state");
        
        // Activate tenant
        tenant.Activate(activatedBy);
        await _tenantRepository.UpdateAsync(tenant);
        
        // Create default admin user
        await CreateDefaultAdminAsync(tenant);
        
        // Seed default data
        await SeedDefaultDataAsync(tenant);
        
        // Send activation email
        await _emailService.SendAsync(new Email
        {
            To = tenant.BillingEmail,
            Subject = $"Welcome to {tenant.Name}!",
            Template = "TenantActivated",
            Data = new 
            { 
                tenant.Name, 
                tenant.Subdomain,
                LoginUrl = $"https://{tenant.Subdomain}.workmanagement.com"
            }
        });
    }
}
```

### 94.3 Provisioning Background Worker

```csharp
public class TenantProvisioningWorker : BackgroundService
{
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var job = await _jobQueue.DequeueAsync<ProvisionTenantJob>(stoppingToken);
            
            if (job != null)
            {
                try
                {
                    await ProvisionTenantInfrastructureAsync(job);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to provision tenant {TenantId}", job.TenantId);
                    
                    // Update tenant status to ProvisioningFailed
                    var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetAsync(job.TenantId);
                    tenant.Status = TenantStatus.ProvisioningFailed;
                    await _tenantRepository.UpdateAsync(tenant);
                    
                    // Retry logic
                    if (job.RetryCount < 3)
                    {
                        job.RetryCount++;
                        await _jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(job, delay: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), stoppingToken);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProvisionTenantInfrastructureAsync(ProvisionTenantJob job)
    {
        var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetAsync(job.TenantId);
        
        // Get isolation strategy
        var strategy = _strategyFactory.Create(job.IsolationStrategy);
        
        // Provision database/schema
        await strategy.ProvisionTenantAsync(tenant);
        
        // Update tenant with connection info
        await _tenantRepository.UpdateAsync(tenant);
        
        // Complete provisioning
        await _provisioningService.CompleteProvisioningAsync(
            tenant.Id,
            systemUserId: Guid.Empty
        );
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 95 - Tenant Context Resolution**

### 95.1 Current Tenant Provider

**Purpose:** Resolve current tenant from request context.

```csharp
public interface ICurrentTenantProvider
{
    Guid? GetTenantId();
    Task<Tenant> GetTenantAsync();
    void SetTenant(Guid tenantId);
    void ClearTenant();
}

public class HttpCurrentTenantProvider : ICurrentTenantProvider
{
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
    
    public Guid? GetTenantId()
    {
        // Strategy 1: From subdomain
        var subdomain = ExtractSubdomain();
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(subdomain))
        {
            var tenant = _tenantRepository
                .Query()
                .FirstOrDefault(t => t.Subdomain == subdomain);
            
            return tenant?.Id;
        }
        
        // Strategy 2: From header
        var tenantIdHeader = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?
            .Request.Headers["X-Tenant-Id"].FirstOrDefault();
        
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdHeader, out var tenantId))
            return tenantId;
        
        // Strategy 3: From JWT claim
        var tenantClaim = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User
            .FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantClaim, out tenantId))
            return tenantId;
        
        return null;
    }
    
    private string ExtractSubdomain()
    {
        var host = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.Request.Host.Host;
        
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(host))
            return null;
        
        // Extract subdomain from host
        // Example: acme.workmanagement.com -> "acme"
        var parts = host.Split('.');
        
        if (parts.Length >= 3)
            return parts[0];
        
        return null;
    }
}
```

### 95.2 Tenant Resolution Middleware

```csharp
public class TenantResolutionMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(
        HttpContext context,
        ICurrentTenantProvider tenantProvider,
        ITenantRepository tenantRepository)
    {
        var tenantId = tenantProvider.GetTenantId();
        
        if (tenantId.HasValue)
        {
            // Validate tenant is active
            var tenant = await tenantRepository.GetAsync(tenantId.Value);
            
            if (tenant.Status == TenantStatus.Suspended)
            {
                context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
                {
                    error = "Tenant suspended",
                    message = "Your account has been suspended. Please contact support."
                });
                return;
            }
            
            if (tenant.Status == TenantStatus.Deleted || 
                tenant.Status == TenantStatus.PendingDeletion)
            {
                context.Response.StatusCode = 410;
                await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
                {
                    error = "Tenant deleted",
                    message = "This account no longer exists."
                });
                return;
            }
            
            // Set tenant context
            tenantProvider.SetTenant(tenantId.Value);
        }
        
        await _next(context);
        
        // Clear tenant context
        tenantProvider.ClearTenant();
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class TenantConfiguration
```

## **Chapter 97 - Tenant Deletion & Data Purging**

### 97.1 Deletion Workflow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Admin
    participant API
    participant Tenant
    participant Archiver
    participant Notifier
    participant Scheduler
    
    Admin->>API: Request Deletion
    API->>Tenant: InitiateDeletion()
    Tenant->>Tenant: Status = PendingDeletion
    Tenant->>Notifier: Send Notifications
    Notifier->>Admin: Deletion Scheduled Email
    
    loop Daily for 30 days
        Scheduler->>Notifier: Send Reminder
        Notifier->>Admin: Days Remaining Email
    end
    
    alt Cancellation
        Admin->>API: Cancel Deletion
        API->>Tenant: CancelDeletion()
        Tenant->>Tenant: Status = Active
    else 30 Days Elapsed
        Scheduler->>Archiver: Archive Data
        Archiver->>Archiver: Compress & Store
        Scheduler->>Tenant: SoftDelete()
        Tenant->>Tenant: Status = SoftDeleted
        
        Note over Tenant: 90-day retention
        
        Scheduler->>Tenant: PurgePermanently()
        Tenant->>Tenant: Status = PermanentlyDeleted
        Archiver->>Archiver: Delete Archives
    end
```

### 97.2 Deletion Service

```csharp
public class TenantDeletionService
{
    public async Task ProcessScheduledDeletionsAsync()
    {
        // Find tenants scheduled for deletion today
        var tenants = await _tenantRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(t => t.Status == TenantStatus.PendingDeletion &&
                       t.DeletedAt <= DateTime.Now)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var tenant in tenants)
        {
            await SoftDeleteTenantAsync(tenant.Id);
        }
        
        // Find soft-deleted tenants ready for purge (90 days)
        var tenantsToPurge = await _tenantRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(t => t.Status == TenantStatus.SoftDeleted &&
                       t.DeletedAt.Value.AddDays(90) <= DateTime.Now)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var tenant in tenantsToPurge)
        {
            await PurgeTenantPermanentlyAsync(tenant.Id);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task SoftDeleteTenantAsync(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 1. Archive all data
        await _archiveService.ArchiveTenantDataAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 2. Disable all users
        await _userService.DeactivateAllUsersAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 3. Cancel subscriptions
        await _billingService.CancelSubscriptionAsync(tenant.SubscriptionId);
        
        // 4. Update tenant status
        tenant.Status = TenantStatus.SoftDeleted;
        await _tenantRepository.UpdateAsync(tenant);
        
        // 5. Emit event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TenantSoftDeletedEto
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            TenantName = tenant.Name,
            DeletedAt = DateTime.Now
        });
    }
    
    private async Task PurgeTenantPermanentlyAsync(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var tenant = await _tenantRepository.GetAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 1. Delete all tenant data
        await _dataService.DeleteAllTenantDataAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 2. Drop database/schema based on isolation strategy
        var strategy = _strategyFactory.Create(tenant.IsolationStrategy);
        await strategy.DeprovisionTenantAsync(tenant);
        
        // 3. Delete archived data
        await _archiveService.DeleteArchivedDataAsync(tenantId);
        
        // 4. Update tenant status
        tenant.Status = TenantStatus.PermanentlyDeleted;
        await _tenantRepository.UpdateAsync(tenant);
        
        // 5. Emit event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TenantPermanentlyDeletedEto
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            TenantName = tenant.Name,
            PurgedAt = DateTime.Now
        });
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 99 - Search Domain Overview**

### 99.1 Domain Purpose

The Search Context provides **unified, high-performance search** across all entities in the system, enabling:

- Full-text search across tasks, projects, cases, comments
- Faceted navigation and filtering
- Semantic search with AI-powered relevance
- Real-time indexing with minimal latency
- Permission-trimmed results (never leak data)
- Saved searches and custom views
- Search analytics and optimization

**Strategic Importance:** Search is a **cross-cutting supporting domain** that improves user experience and productivity by enabling fast discovery of information across the entire platform.

### 99.2 Search Domain Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Search Index** | Denormalized, optimized data structure for fast querying |
| **Searchable Entity** | Entity type that can be searched (Task, Project, Comment, etc.) |
| **Search Query** | User's search request with keywords, filters, and facets |
| **Facet** | Category for filtering results (status, assignee, date range) |
| **Semantic Search** | AI-powered search using meaning, not just keywords |
| **Search Scope** | Boundary of search (All, My Items, Project, Team) |
| **Saved Search** | Named query with filters for reuse |
| **Search Rank** | Relevance score determining result order |
| **Index Projection** | Event-driven update of search index from domain events |
| **Permission Trimming** | Filtering results based on user's access rights |

### 99.3 Search Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Sources ["Event Sources"]
        TE[Task Events]
        PE[Project Events]
        CE[Case Events]
        AE[Approval Events]
        CME[Comment Events]
    end
    
    subgraph Indexing ["Search Indexing Pipeline"]
        EP[Event Processor]
        TR[Transformer]
        EN[Enricher]
        Validator[Validator]
    end
    
    subgraph Storage ["Search Storage"]
        ES[ElasticSearch<br/>Primary]
        PG[PostgreSQL FTS<br/>Fallback]
```

## **Chapter 101 - Search Indexing Pipeline**

### 101.1 Event-Driven Indexing

```csharp
public class SearchIndexProjector :
    IEventHandler<TaskInstanceCreatedEto>,
    IEventHandler<TaskInstanceUpdatedEto>,
    IEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>,
    IEventHandler<CommentAddedEto>,
    IEventHandler<ProjectCreatedEto>,
    IEventHandler<CaseCreatedEto>
{
    private readonly ISearchIndexService _searchService;
    private readonly ISemanticVectorService _vectorService;
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(TaskInstanceCreatedEto evt)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(evt.TaskId);
        
        // Transform to search document
        var document = await TransformToSearchDocumentAsync(task);
        
        // Index document
        await _searchService.IndexAsync(document);
    }
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(TaskInstanceUpdatedEto evt)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(evt.TaskId);
        var document = await TransformToSearchDocumentAsync(task);
        
        // Update existing document
        await _searchService.UpdateAsync(document);
    }
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(CommentAddedEto evt)
    {
        // Comments are indexed as part of parent entity
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(evt.TaskId);
        var document = await TransformToSearchDocumentAsync(task);
        
        // Re-index parent with updated comments
        await _searchService.UpdateAsync(document);
    }
    
    private async Task<SearchDocument> TransformToSearchDocumentAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var document = new SearchDocument
        {
            Id = task.Id,
            EntityId = task.Id,
            EntityType = "Task",
            TenantId = task.TenantId,
            
            // Content
            Title = task.Title,
            Description = task.Description,
            BodyText = BuildBodyText(task),
            Tags = task.Tags,
            
            // Classification
            Category = task.TaskType.Category,
            Type = task.TaskType.Name,
            Status = task.Progress.StatusName,
            Priority = CalculatePriority(task),
            
            // People
            OwnerId = task.CreatedBy,
            AssigneeId = task.Assignment.AssigneeId,
            ParticipantIds = task.Assignment.Participants.Select(p => p.UserId).ToList(),
            
            // Hierarchy
            ProjectId = task.ProjectId,
            ParentId = task.Hierarchy.ParentTaskId,
            
            // Dates
            CreatedAt = task.CreatedAt,
            DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
            CompletedAt = task.Schedule.CompletedAt,
            
            // Custom fields
            CustomFields = task.CustomFields,
            
            // Security
            AllowedUsers = await GetAllowedUsersAsync(task),
            AllowedTeams = await GetAllowedTeamsAsync(task),
            
            IndexedAt = DateTime.Now
        };
        
        // Generate semantic vector for AI-powered search
        document.SemanticVector = await _vectorService.GenerateEmbeddingAsync(
            $"{task.Title} {task.Description}"
        );
        
        return document;
    }
    
    private string BuildBodyText(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        
        // Title and description
        sb.AppendLine(task.Title);
        sb.AppendLine(task.Description);
        
        // Comments
        foreach (var comment in task.Discussion.Comments)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(comment.Text);
        }
        
        // Action steps
        foreach (var step in task.Progress.ActionSteps)
        {
            sb.AppendLine(step.Title);
        }
        
        // Custom fields
        foreach (var (key, value) in task.CustomFields)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{key}: {value}");
        }
        
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}
```

### 101.2 Bulk Indexing

```csharp
public class BulkIndexingService
{
    public async Task ReindexAllAsync(Guid tenantId)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting full reindex for tenant {TenantId}", tenantId);
        
        // Index tasks
        await ReindexTasksAsync(tenantId);
        
        // Index projects
        await ReindexProjectsAsync(tenantId);
        
        // Index cases
        await ReindexCasesAsync(tenantId);
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Completed full reindex for tenant {TenantId}", tenantId);
    }
    
    private async Task ReindexTasksAsync(Guid tenantId)
    {
        const int batchSize = 1000;
        var offset = 0;
        
        while (true)
        {
            var tasks = await _taskRepository
                .Query()
                .Where(t => t.TenantId == tenantId)
                .OrderBy(t => t.Id)
                .Skip(offset)
                .Take(batchSize)
                .ToListAsync();
            
            if (!tasks.Any())
                break;
            
            // Transform to search documents
            var documents = new List<SearchDocument>();
            foreach (var task in tasks)
            {
                var doc = await _transformer.TransformToSearchDocumentAsync(task);
                documents.Add(doc);
            }
            
            // Bulk index
            await _searchService.BulkIndexAsync(documents);
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Indexed {Count} tasks (offset: {Offset})", tasks.Count, offset);
            
            offset += batchSize;
        }
    }
}
```
