## **Chapter 102 - Search Query Processing**

### 102.1 Query Parser

```csharp
public class SearchQueryParser
{
    public ParsedSearchQuery Parse(string queryString)
    {
        var query = new ParsedSearchQuery();
        
        // Extract quoted phrases
        var quotedPhrases = ExtractQuotedPhrases(queryString);
        query.ExactPhrases = quotedPhrases;
        queryString = RemoveQuotedPhrases(queryString);
        
        // Extract field-specific searches
        // Example: "title:bug assignee:john status:open"
        var fieldQueries = ExtractFieldQueries(queryString);
        query.FieldQueries = fieldQueries;
        queryString = RemoveFieldQueries(queryString);
        
        // Extract operators
        // Example: "bug AND (priority:high OR priority:critical)"
        query.Operators = ExtractOperators(queryString);
        
        // Remaining terms are general keywords
        query.Keywords = queryString.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        
        return query;
    }
    
    private List<string> ExtractQuotedPhrases(string query)
    {
        var phrases = new List<string>();
        var regex = new Regex("\"([^\"]*)\"");
        var matches = regex.Matches(query);
        
        foreach (Match match in matches)
        {
            phrases.Add(match.Groups[1].Value);
        }
        
        return phrases;
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, string> ExtractFieldQueries(string query)
    {
        var fieldQueries = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        var regex = new Regex(@"(\w+):(\S+)");
        var matches = regex.Matches(query);
        
        foreach (Match match in matches)
        {
            var field = match.Groups[1].Value;
            var value = match.Groups[2].Value;
            fieldQueries[field] = value;
        }
        
        return fieldQueries;
    }
}
```

### 102.2 Search Executor

```csharp
public class SearchExecutor
{
    public async Task<SearchResults> ExecuteAsync(SearchRequest request)
    {
        // 1. Parse query
        var parsedQuery = _parser.Parse(request.Query);
        
        // 2. Build search query
        var searchQuery = BuildElasticQuery(parsedQuery, request);
        
        // 3. Apply permission filters
        ApplyPermissionFilters(searchQuery, request.UserId);
        
        // 4. Apply facets
        ApplyFacets(searchQuery, request.Facets);
        
        // 5. Execute search
        var response = await _elasticClient.SearchAsync<SearchDocument>(searchQuery);
        
        // 6. Transform results
        var results = new SearchResults
        {
            TotalCount = response.Total,
            Items = response.Documents.Select(d => TransformToSearchResult(d)).ToList(),
            Facets = ExtractFacetResults(response.Aggregations),
            ExecutionTime = response.Took,
            Query = request.Query
        };
        
        // 7. Track search analytics
        await _analyticsService.TrackSearchAsync(request, results);
        
        return results;
    }
    
    private SearchDescriptor<SearchDocument> BuildElasticQuery(
        ParsedSearchQuery parsed,
        SearchRequest request)
    {
        return new SearchDescriptor<SearchDocument>()
            .Index("search_index")
            .From(request.Skip)
            .Size(request.Take)
            .Query(q => q
                .Bool(b => b
                    .Must(BuildMustClauses(parsed))
                    .Filter(BuildFilterClauses(request))
                    .Should(BuildShouldClauses(parsed))
                )
            )
            .Sort(BuildSortClauses(request.SortBy))
            .Highlight(h => h
                .Fields(
                    f => f.Field(d => d.Title),
                    f => f.Field(d => d.Description)
                )
            );
    }
    
    private List<Func<QueryContainerDescriptor<SearchDocument>, QueryContainer>> 
        BuildMustClauses(ParsedSearchQuery parsed)
    {
        var clauses = new List<Func<QueryContainerDescriptor<SearchDocument>, QueryContainer>>();
        
        // Exact phrases
        foreach (var phrase in parsed.ExactPhrases)
        {
            clauses.Add(q => q.MatchPhrase(m => m
                .Field(f => f.BodyText)
                .Query(phrase)
            ));
        }
        
        // Field-specific queries
        foreach (var (field, value) in parsed.FieldQueries)
        {
            clauses.Add(q => q.Match(m => m
                .Field(field)
                .Query(value)
            ));
        }
        
        // General keywords
        if (parsed.Keywords.Any())
        {
            clauses.Add(q => q.MultiMatch(m => m
                .Fields(f => f
                    .Field(d => d.Title, 3.0)      // Boost title
                    .Field(d => d.Description, 2.0) // Boost description
                    .Field(d => d.BodyText, 1.0)
                )
                .Query(string.Join(" ", parsed.Keywords))
                .Type(TextQueryType.BestFields)
            ));
        }
        
        return clauses;
    }
}
```

### 102.3 Permission-Aware Search

```csharp
public class PermissionFilterService
{
    public void ApplyPermissionFilters(
        SearchDescriptor<SearchDocument> query,
        Guid userId)
    {
        // Get user context
        var userContext = _userResolver.GetUserContext(userId);
        
        query.PostFilter(f => f.Bool(b => b
            .Should(
                // Documents where user is explicitly allowed
                s => s.Terms(t => t
                    .Field(d => d.AllowedUsers)
                    .Terms(userId)
                ),
                // Documents where user's team is allowed
                s => s.Terms(t => t
                    .Field(d => d.AllowedTeams)
                    .Terms(userContext.TeamIds)
                ),
                // Documents where user's role is allowed
                s => s.Terms(t => t
                    .Field(d => d.AllowedRoles)
                    .Terms(userContext.Roles)
                ),
                // Public documents
                s => s.Term(t => t
                    .Field(d => d.Visibility)
                    .Value(AccessLevel.Public)
                ),
                // Documents owned by user
                s => s.Term(t => t
                    .Field(d => d.OwnerId)
                    .Value(userId)
                )
            )
            .MinimumShouldMatch(1)
        ));
    }
}
```

### 103.1 Vector Embedding Generation

```csharp
public class SemanticVectorService
{
    private readonly IOpenAIClient _openAIClient;
    
    public async Task<double[]> GenerateEmbeddingAsync(string text)
    {
        // Use OpenAI's text-embedding-3-large model
        var response = await _openAIClient.Embeddings.CreateAsync(
            model: "text-embedding-3-large",
            input: text,
            dimensions: 1536
        );
        
        return response.Data[0].Embedding;
    }
    
    public async Task<List<double[]>> GenerateBatchEmbeddingsAsync(List<string> texts)
    {
        var response = await _openAIClient.Embeddings.CreateAsync(
            model: "text-embedding-3-large",
            input: texts,
            dimensions: 1536
        );
        
        return response.Data.Select(d => d.Embedding).ToList();
    }
}
```

### 103.2 Semantic Search Execution

```csharp
public class SemanticSearchService
{
    public async Task<SearchResults> SemanticSearchAsync(string query, Guid userId)
    {
        // 1. Generate query embedding
        var queryVector = await _vectorService.GenerateEmbeddingAsync(query);
        
        // 2. Execute vector similarity search
        var searchQuery = new SearchDescriptor<SearchDocument>()
            .Index("search_index")
            .Size(20)
            .Query(q => q
                .ScriptScore(ss => ss
                    .Query(qq => qq.MatchAll())
                    .Script(s => s
                        .Source($"cosineSimilarity(params.query_vector, 'semanticVector') + 1.0")
                        .Params(p => p.Add("query_vector", queryVector))
                    )
                )
            );
        
        // 3. Apply permission filters
        _permissionFilter.ApplyPermissionFilters(searchQuery, userId);
        
        // 4. Execute
        var response = await _elasticClient.SearchAsync<SearchDocument>(searchQuery);
        
        // 5. Combine with keyword search for hybrid results
        var keywordResults = await _searchExecutor.ExecuteAsync(new SearchRequest
        {
            Query = query,
            UserId = userId,
            Take = 20
        });
        
        // 6. Merge and re-rank
        var mergedResults = MergeResults(response.Documents, keywordResults.Items);
        
        return new SearchResults
        {
            Items = mergedResults,
            TotalCount = mergedResults.Count,
            IsSemanticSearch = true
        };
    }
    
    private List<SearchResultItem> MergeResults(
        IEnumerable<SearchDocument> semanticResults,
        List<SearchResultItem> keywordResults)
    {
        // Hybrid scoring: 70% semantic, 30% keyword
        var merged = new Dictionary<Guid, (SearchResultItem item, double score)>();
        
        var semanticList = semanticResults.ToList();
        for (int i = 0; i < semanticList.Count; i++)
        {
            var doc = semanticList[i];
            var semanticScore = (semanticList.Count - i) / (double)semanticList.Count;
            merged[doc.EntityId] = (TransformToResult(doc), semanticScore * 0.7);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < keywordResults.Count; i++)
        {
            var result = keywordResults[i];
            var keywordScore = (keywordResults.Count - i) / (double)keywordResults.Count;
            
            if (merged.ContainsKey(result.EntityId))
            {
                var existing = merged[result.EntityId];
                merged[result.EntityId] = (existing.item, existing.score + keywordScore * 0.3);
            }
            else
            {
                merged[result.EntityId] = (result, keywordScore * 0.3);
            }
        }
        
        return merged.Values
            .OrderByDescending(v => v.score)
            .Select(v => v.item)
            .ToList();
    }
}
```

### 104.2 Facet Aggregation

```csharp
public class FacetService
{
    public void ApplyFacetAggregations(
        SearchDescriptor<SearchDocument> query,
        List<string> requestedFacets)
    {
        foreach (var facetName in requestedFacets)
        {
            var facetConfig = _facetConfig.GetFacet(facetName);
            
            switch (facetConfig.Type)
            {
                case FacetType.Terms:
                    query.Aggregations(a => a
                        .Terms(facetName, t => t
                            .Field(facetConfig.Field)
                            .Size(facetConfig.Size ?? 10)
                        )
                    );
                    break;
                
                case FacetType.Range:
                    query.Aggregations(a => a
                        .Range(facetName, r => r
                            .Field(facetConfig.Field)
                            .Ranges(facetConfig.Ranges.Select(range => 
                                new AggregationRange 
                                { 
                                    From = range.From, 
                                    To = range.To 
                                }
                            ).ToArray())
                        )
                    );
                    break;
                
                case FacetType.DateRange:
                    query.Aggregations(a => a
                        .DateRange(facetName, dr => dr
                            .Field(facetConfig.Field)
                            .Ranges(facetConfig.DateRanges.Select(range =>
                                new DateRangeExpression
                                {
                                    From = range.From,
                                    To = range.To
                                }
                            ).ToArray())
                        )
                    );
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    public Dictionary<string, FacetResult> ExtractFacetResults(
        AggregateDictionary aggregations)
    {
        var results = new Dictionary<string, FacetResult>();
        
        foreach (var (key, aggregation) in aggregations)
        {
            if (aggregation is BucketAggregate bucketAgg)
            {
                results[key] = new FacetResult
                {
                    Name = key,
                    Items = bucketAgg.Items.Select(item => new FacetItem
                    {
                        Value = item.Key,
                        Count = item.DocCount ?? 0
                    }).ToList()
                };
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}
```

### 105.2 Saved Search Service

```csharp
public class SavedSearchService
{
    public async Task<SavedSearch> CreateAsync(CreateSavedSearchInput input)
    {
        var savedSearch = new SavedSearch
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = input.TenantId,
            OwnerId = input.UserId,
            Name = input.Name,
            Description = input.Description,
            Query = new SearchQuery
            {
                QueryString = input.QueryString,
                Filters = input.Filters,
                SelectedFacets = input.SelectedFacets,
                SortBy = input.SortBy,
                Scope = input.Scope
            },
            IsPublic = input.IsPublic,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now
        };
        
        await _repository.InsertAsync(savedSearch);
        
        return savedSearch;
    }
    
    public async Task<SearchResults> ExecuteSavedSearchAsync(Guid savedSearchId, Guid userId)
    {
        var savedSearch = await _repository.GetAsync(savedSearchId);
        
        // Verify access
        if (!CanUserAccessSavedSearch(savedSearch, userId))
            throw new UnauthorizedException("Cannot access this saved search");
        
        // Execute search
        var results = await _searchExecutor.ExecuteAsync(new SearchRequest
        {
            Query = savedSearch.Query.QueryString,
            Filters = savedSearch.Query.Filters,
            UserId = userId,
            Scope = savedSearch.Query.Scope
        });
        
        // Record usage
        savedSearch.RecordUsage();
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(savedSearch);
        
        return results;
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class SearchAnalyticsService
{
    public async Task TrackSearchAsync(SearchRequest request, SearchResults results)
    {
        var analytics = new SearchAnalytics
        {

    public async Task TrackClickAsync(Guid searchId, Guid resultId, int position)
    {
        var analytics = await _analyticsRepository.GetAsync(searchId);
        
        analytics.ClickedResults.Add(resultId);
        analytics.ClickThroughRate = CalculateCTR(analytics);
        
        await _analyticsRepository.UpdateAsync(analytics);
    }
    
    public async Task<SearchAnalyticsReport> GetReportAsync(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate)
    {
        var searches = await _analyticsRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(a => a.Timestamp >= startDate && a.Timestamp <= endDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        return new SearchAnalyticsReport
        {
            TotalSearches = searches.Count,
            AverageExecutionTime = searches.Average(s => s.ExecutionTime),
            AverageCTR = searches.Average(s => s.ClickThroughRate),
            TopQueries = GetTopQueries(searches),
            ZeroResultQueries = searches.Where(s => s.ResultCount == 0).ToList(),
            MostClickedResults = GetMostClickedResults(searches)
        };
    }
}
```

### 106.2 Search Optimization

```csharp
public class SearchOptimizationService
{
    public async Task OptimizeIndexAsync()
    {
        // 1. Analyze query patterns
        var queryPatterns = await AnalyzeQueryPatternsAsync();
        
        // 2. Update synonym lists
        await UpdateSynonymsAsync(queryPatterns);
        
        // 3. Adjust field weights
        await AdjustFieldWeightsAsync(queryPatterns);
        
        // 4. Update stop words
        await UpdateStopWordsAsync(queryPatterns);
        
        // 5. Re-index affected documents
        await ReindexAffectedDocumentsAsync();
    }
    
    private async Task UpdateSynonymsAsync(QueryPatternAnalysis patterns)
    {
        var synonyms = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
        
        // Extract synonym candidates from search patterns
        foreach (var pattern in patterns.CommonQueryPairs)
        {
            if (pattern.SimilarResults && pattern.EditDistance < 3)
            {
                synonyms.GetOrAdd(pattern.Query1, () => new List<string>())
                    .Add(pattern.Query2);
            }
        }
        
        // Update ElasticSearch synonym filter
        await _elasticClient.Indices.PutSettingsAsync("search_index", s => s
            .IndexSettings(i => i
                .Analysis(a => a
                    .TokenFilters(tf => tf
                        .Synonym("synonym_filter", syn => syn
                            .Synonyms(synonyms.SelectMany(kvp => 
                                kvp.Value.Select(v => $"{kvp.Key}, {v}")
                            ).ToArray())
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        );
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 109 - Notification Domain Overview**

### 109.1 Domain Purpose

The Notification & Activity Context provides **unified communication and activity tracking** across the entire platform, enabling:

- Multi-channel notifications (email, push, SMS, in-app)
- User-configurable preferences
- Real-time activity streams
- Notification batching and digests
- Template-based messaging
- Delivery tracking and analytics
- Smart notification prioritization
- Do-not-disturb and quiet hours

**Strategic Importance:** This is a **critical supporting domain** that keeps users informed and engaged while respecting their preferences and attention.

### 109.2 Notification Domain Ubiquitous Language

| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| **Notification** | Message sent to user about system event or action |
| **Notification Channel** | Delivery method (Email, Push, SMS, In-App) |
| **Notification Template** | Reusable message structure with variables |
| **Notification Preference** | User's channel and frequency settings per event type |
| **Activity** | Timestamped record of user or system action |
| **Activity Stream** | Chronological feed of related activities |
| **Notification Digest** | Batched notifications sent at scheduled intervals |
| **Notification Priority** | Urgency level (Critical, High, Normal, Low) |
| **Delivery Status** | State of notification (Pending, Sent, Delivered, Failed) |
| **Quiet Hours** | Time period when non-critical notifications are suppressed |

### 110.3 Notification Channels

```csharp
public enum NotificationChannel
{
    InApp,      // In-application notification center
    Email,      // Email delivery
    Push,       // Mobile/web push notification
    SMS,        // Text message
    Webhook,    // HTTP callback
    Slack,      // Slack integration
    Teams       // Microsoft Teams integration
}

public enum NotificationPriority
{
    Critical = 4,   // Immediate delivery, ignore quiet hours
    High = 3,       // High priority, may override some preferences
    Normal = 2,     // Standard priority, respects all preferences
    Low = 1         // Low priority, batch when possible
}

public enum DeliveryStatus
{
    Pending,        // Queued for delivery
    Sent,           // Sent to delivery service
    Delivered,      // Confirmed delivered
    Read,           // User opened/read
    Failed,         // Delivery failed
    Bounced,        // Email bounced
    Suppressed      // User preference prevented delivery
}
```

### 110.4 Notification Behaviors

```csharp
public class Notification
{
    public void MarkAsRead(Guid userId)
    {
        if (RecipientId != userId)
            throw new DomainException("Cannot mark notification for different user");
        
        if (ReadAt.HasValue)
            return; // Already read
        
        ReadAt = DateTime.Now;
        Status = NotificationStatus.Read;
        
        AddDomainEvent(new NotificationReadEto
        {
            NotificationId = Id,
            RecipientId = RecipientId,
            ReadAt = ReadAt.Value
        });
    }
    
    public void RecordDelivery(NotificationChannel channel, DeliveryStatus status, string errorMessage = null)
    {
        var attempt = new DeliveryAttempt
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Channel = channel,
            AttemptedAt = DateTime.Now,
            Status = status,
            ErrorMessage = errorMessage,
            RetryCount = DeliveryAttempts.Count(a => a.Channel == channel)
        };
        
        DeliveryAttempts.Add(attempt);
        ChannelStatus[channel] = status;
        
        // Update overall status
        if (status == DeliveryStatus.Delivered && !SentAt.HasValue)
        {
            SentAt = DateTime.Now;
            Status = NotificationStatus.Sent;
        }
        
        AddDomainEvent(new NotificationDeliveredEto
        {
            NotificationId = Id,
            Channel = channel,
            Status = status,
            DeliveredAt = attempt.AttemptedAt
        });
    }
    
    public bool CanBeBatched()
    {
        // Critical and High priority notifications are not batched
        if (Priority >= NotificationPriority.High)
            return false;
        
        // Check notification type configuration
        var typeConfig = NotificationTypeConfig.Get(Type);
        return typeConfig.Batchable;
    }
}
```

### 111.2 Preference Filtering

```csharp
public class NotificationPreferenceFilter
{
    public async Task<List<NotificationChannel>> GetEnabledChannelsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        NotificationType type,
        NotificationPriority priority)
    {
        var preferences = await _preferencesRepository.GetByUserIdAsync(userId);
        
        // Critical notifications override all preferences
        if (priority == NotificationPriority.Critical)
        {
            return new List<NotificationChannel>
            {
                NotificationChannel.InApp,
                NotificationChannel.Push,
                NotificationChannel.Email,
                NotificationChannel.SMS
            };
        }
        
        // Check Do Not Disturb
        if (preferences.DoNotDisturbEnabled)
        {
            if (priority < NotificationPriority.High)
                return new List<NotificationChannel>(); // Suppress non-urgent notifications
        }
        
        // Check quiet hours
        if (preferences.IsInQuietHours())
        {
            if (priority < NotificationPriority.High)
                return new List<NotificationChannel> { NotificationChannel.InApp }; // In-app only
        }
        
        // Get type-specific preferences
        var channels = new List<NotificationChannel>();
        
        if (preferences.TypePreferences.TryGetValue(type, out var typePrefs))
        {
            if (typePrefs.InAppEnabled)
                channels.Add(NotificationChannel.InApp);
            
            if (typePrefs.EmailEnabled && preferences.EmailEnabled)
                channels.Add(NotificationChannel.Email);
            
            if (typePrefs.PushEnabled && preferences.PushEnabled)
                channels.Add(NotificationChannel.Push);
            
            if (typePrefs.SMSEnabled && preferences.SMSEnabled)
                channels.Add(NotificationChannel.SMS);
        }
        else
        {
            // Use defaults
            var defaultChannels = NotificationTypeConfig.Get(type).DefaultChannels;
            channels.AddRange(defaultChannels.Where(c => IsChannelEnabled(preferences, c)));
        }
        
        return channels;
    }
    
    private bool IsChannelEnabled(NotificationPreferences prefs, NotificationChannel channel)
    {
        return channel switch
        {
            NotificationChannel.InApp => prefs.InAppEnabled,
            NotificationChannel.Email => prefs.EmailEnabled,
            NotificationChannel.Push => prefs.PushEnabled,
            NotificationChannel.SMS => prefs.SMSEnabled,
            _ => false
        };
    }
}
```

### 112.3 Template Rendering

```csharp
public class NotificationTemplateRenderer
{
    private readonly ITemplateEngine _templateEngine;
    
    public async Task<RenderedNotification> RenderAsync(
        string templateKey,
        NotificationChannel channel,
        Dictionary<string, object> variables)
    {
        var template = await _templateRepository.GetAsync(templateKey, channel);
        
        if (template == null)
            throw new DomainException($"Template not found: {templateKey}");
        
        // Validate required variables
        var missingVars = template.RequiredVariables
            .Where(v => !variables.ContainsKey(v))
            .ToList();
        
        if (missingVars.Any())
            throw new DomainException($"Missing required variables: {string.Join(", ", missingVars)}");
        
        // Add default values for missing optional variables
        foreach (var (key, value) in template.DefaultValues)
        {
            if (!variables.ContainsKey(key))
                variables[key] = value;
        }
        
        // Render based on channel
        return channel switch
        {
            NotificationChannel.Email => new RenderedNotification
            {
                Subject = _templateEngine.Render(template.Subject, variables),
                BodyText = _templateEngine.Render(template.BodyText, variables),
                BodyHtml = _templateEngine.Render(template.BodyHtml, variables)
            },
            
            NotificationChannel.Push => new RenderedNotification
            {
                Title = _templateEngine.Render(template.PushTitle, variables),
                Body = _templateEngine.Render(template.PushBody, variables)
            },
            
            NotificationChannel.SMS => new RenderedNotification
            {
                Body = _templateEngine.Render(template.SMSText, variables)
            },
            
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException($"Channel not supported: {channel}")
        };
    }
}
```

### 113.3 Activity Stream Service

```csharp
public class ActivityStreamService
{
    public async Task RecordActivityAsync(Activity activity)
    {
        // Set timestamp
        activity.Timestamp = DateTime.Now;
        
        // Determine visibility
        if (activity.Visibility == ActivityVisibility.Auto)
        {
            activity.Visibility = DetermineVisibility(activity);
            activity.VisibleToUsers = await GetVisibleUsersAsync(activity);
        }
        
        // Save activity
        await _activityRepository.InsertAsync(activity);
        
        // Publish event for real-time updates
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new ActivityRecordedEto
        {
            ActivityId = activity.Id,
            EntityType = activity.EntityType,
            EntityId = activity.EntityId,
            ActorId = activity.ActorId,
            Timestamp = activity.Timestamp
        });
    }
    
    public async Task<ActivityStream> GetStreamAsync(
        Guid userId,
        ActivityStreamFilter filter)
    {
        var query = _activityRepository.Query()
            .Where(a => a.TenantId == filter.TenantId);
        
        // Filter by visibility
        query = query.Where(a => 
            a.Visibility == ActivityVisibility.Public ||
            a.VisibleToUsers.Contains(userId) ||
            a.ActorId == userId
        );
        
        // Apply filters
        if (filter.EntityType != null)
            query = query.Where(a => a.EntityType == filter.EntityType);
        
        if (filter.EntityId.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(a => a.EntityId == filter.EntityId);
        
        if (filter.ProjectId.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(a => a.ProjectId == filter.ProjectId);
        
        if (filter.ActorId.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(a => a.ActorId == filter.ActorId);
        
        if (filter.StartDate.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(a => a.Timestamp >= filter.StartDate.Value);
        
        // Order and paginate
        var activities = await query
            .OrderByDescending(a => a.Timestamp)
            .Skip(filter.Skip)
            .Take(filter.Take)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        // Group by time periods
        var grouped = GroupActivitiesByTime(activities);
        
        return new ActivityStream
        {
            Activities = grouped,
            TotalCount = await query.CountAsync()
        };
    }
    
    private List<ActivityGroup> GroupActivitiesByTime(List<Activity> activities)
    {
        var groups = new List<ActivityGroup>();
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        
        // Group: Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month, Older
        groups.Add(new ActivityGroup
        {
            Label = "Today",
            Activities = activities.Where(a => a.Timestamp.Date == now.Date).ToList()
        });
        
        groups.Add(new ActivityGroup
        {
            Label = "Yesterday",
            Activities = activities.Where(a => a.Timestamp.Date == now.Date.AddDays(-1)).ToList()
        });
        
        var thisWeekStart = now.Date.AddDays(-(int)now.DayOfWeek);
        groups.Add(new ActivityGroup
        {
            Label = "This Week",
            Activities = activities.Where(a => 
                a.Timestamp.Date >= thisWeekStart && 
                a.Timestamp.Date < now.Date.AddDays(-1)
            ).ToList()
        });
        
        return groups.Where(g => g.Activities.Any()).ToList();
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 114 - Notification Delivery Service**

### 114.1 Multi-Channel Delivery

```csharp
public class NotificationDeliveryService
{
    public async Task DeliverAsync(Notification notification)
    {
        // Get enabled channels based on user preferences
        var channels = await _preferenceFilter.GetEnabledChannelsAsync(
            notification.RecipientId,
            notification.Type,
            notification.Priority
        );
        
        notification.EnabledChannels = channels;
        
        // Deliver to each channel in parallel
        var deliveryTasks = channels.Select(channel => 
            DeliverToChannelAsync(notification, channel)
        );
        
        await Task.WhenAll(deliveryTasks);
    }
    
    private async Task DeliverToChannelAsync(Notification notification, NotificationChannel channel)
    {
        try
        {
            switch (channel)
            {
                case NotificationChannel.Email:
                    await DeliverEmailAsync(notification);
                    break;
                
                case NotificationChannel.Push:
                    await DeliverPushAsync(notification);
                    break;
                
                case NotificationChannel.SMS:
                    await DeliverSMSAsync(notification);
                    break;
                
                case NotificationChannel.InApp:
                    await DeliverInAppAsync(notification);
                    break;
                
                case NotificationChannel.Webhook:
                    await DeliverWebhookAsync(notification);
                    break;
            }
            
            notification.RecordDelivery(channel, DeliveryStatus.Sent);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to deliver notification {Id} to {Channel}", 
                notification.Id, channel);
            
            notification.RecordDelivery(channel, DeliveryStatus.Failed, ex.Message);
            
            // Retry logic
            if (ShouldRetry(notification, channel))
            {
                await _retryQueue.EnqueueAsync(new RetryDeliveryJob
                {
                    NotificationId = notification.Id,
                    Channel = channel,
                    RetryCount = notification.DeliveryAttempts.Count(a => a.Channel == channel)
                });
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 114.2 Email Delivery

```csharp
public class EmailNotificationDeliveryService
{
    private readonly IEmailService _emailService;
    private readonly ITemplateRenderer _templateRenderer;
    
    public async Task DeliverAsync(Notification notification)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(notification.RecipientId);
        
        // Build template variables
        var variables = BuildTemplateVariables(notification, user);
        
        // Render template
        var rendered = await _templateRenderer.RenderAsync(
            templateKey: notification.Type.ToString(),
            channel: NotificationChannel.Email,
            variables: variables
        );
        
        // Send email
        var email = new Email
        {
            To = user.Email,
            ToName = user.DisplayName,
            Subject = rendered.Subject,
            BodyText = rendered.BodyText,
            BodyHtml = rendered.BodyHtml,
            ReplyTo = GetReplyToAddress(notification),
            Headers = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                ["X-Notification-Id"] = notification.Id.ToString(),
                ["X-Notification-Type"] = notification.Type.ToString(),
                ["X-Entity-Type"] = notification.SourceEntityType,
                ["X-Entity-Id"] = notification.SourceEntityId?.ToString()
            }
        };
        
        await _emailService.SendAsync(email);
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, object> BuildTemplateVariables(Notification notification, User user)
    {
        var variables = new Dictionary<string, object>
        {
            ["RecipientName"] = user.DisplayName,
            ["RecipientEmail"] = user.Email,
            ["NotificationTitle"] = notification.Title,
            ["NotificationBody"] = notification.Body,
            ["ActionUrl"] = notification.ActionUrl,
            ["CompanyName"] = _tenant.DisplayName,
            ["PreferencesUrl"] = $"{_baseUrl}/settings/notifications"
        };
        
        // Add metadata
        foreach (var (key, value) in notification.Metadata)
        {
            variables[key] = value;
        }
        
        return variables;
    }
}
```

### 114.3 Push Notification Delivery

```csharp
public class PushNotificationDeliveryService
{
    private readonly IFirebaseService _firebase;
    private readonly IAPNSService _apns;
    
    public async Task DeliverAsync(Notification notification)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(notification.RecipientId);
        var devices = await _deviceRepository.GetUserDevicesAsync(user.Id);
        
        foreach (var device in devices.Where(d => d.IsActive))
        {
            try
            {
                switch (device.Platform)
                {
                    case DevicePlatform.Android:
                        await DeliverToAndroidAsync(notification, device);
                        break;
                    
                    case DevicePlatform.iOS:
                        await DeliverToiOSAsync(notification, device);
                        break;
                    
                    case DevicePlatform.Web:
                        await DeliverToWebAsync(notification, device);
                        break;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to deliver push to device {DeviceId}", device.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task DeliverToAndroidAsync(Notification notification, Device device)
    {
        var message = new FirebaseMessage
        {
            Token = device.PushToken,
            Notification = new FirebaseNotification
            {
                Title = notification.Title,
                Body = notification.Body
            },
            Data = new Dictionary<string, string>
            {
                ["notificationId"] = notification.Id.ToString(),
                ["type"] = notification.Type.ToString(),
                ["entityType"] = notification.SourceEntityType,
                ["entityId"] = notification.SourceEntityId?.ToString(),
                ["actionUrl"] = notification.ActionUrl
            },
            Android = new AndroidConfig
            {
                Priority = notification.Priority == NotificationPriority.Critical 
                    ? AndroidPriority.High 
                    : AndroidPriority.Normal,
                Notification = new AndroidNotification
                {
                    ClickAction = "OPEN_NOTIFICATION",
                    Sound = "default",
                    Color = "#0066CC"
                }
            }
        };
        
        await _firebase.SendAsync(message);
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 115 - Notification Batching & Digests**

### 115.1 Batch Aggregator

```csharp
public class NotificationBatchService
{
    public async Task ProcessBatchingAsync()
    {
        // Get pending notifications eligible for batching
        var pendingNotifications = await _notificationRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(n => n.Status == NotificationStatus.Pending &&
                       n.CanBeBatched() &&
                       !n.IsBatched)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        // Group by recipient
        var byRecipient = pendingNotifications.GroupBy(n => n.RecipientId);
        
        foreach (var group in byRecipient)
        {
            var userId = group.Key;
            var preferences = await _preferencesRepository.GetByUserIdAsync(userId);
            
            // Check if user wants batching
            if (!ShouldBatch(preferences))
                continue;
            
            // Create batch
            var batch = await CreateBatchAsync(group.ToList(), userId);
            
            // Update notifications
            foreach (var notification in group)
            {
                notification.BatchId = batch.Id;
                notification.IsBatched = true;
            }
            
            await _notificationRepository.UpdateManyAsync(group);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<NotificationBatch> CreateBatchAsync(
        List<Notification> notifications,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var batch = new NotificationBatch
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = userId,
            NotificationIds = notifications.Select(n => n.Id).ToList(),
            CreatedAt = DateTime.Now,
            Status = BatchStatus.Pending
        };
        
        await _batchRepository.InsertAsync(batch);
        
        return batch;
    }
}
```

### 115.2 Digest Generation

```csharp
public class NotificationDigestService
{
    public async Task GenerateAndSendDigestsAsync()
    {
        var now = DateTime.Now;
        
        // Get users who should receive digests
        var users = await _preferencesRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(p => p.ReceiveDailyDigest &&
                       p.DigestDeliveryTime.Hours == now.Hour &&
                       p.DigestDeliveryTime.Minutes == now.Minute)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var userPrefs in users)
        {
            await GenerateUserDigestAsync(userPrefs.UserId);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task GenerateUserDigestAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        // Get unread notifications from last 24 hours
        var since = DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1);
        var notifications = await _notificationRepository
            .Query()
            .Where(n => n.RecipientId == userId &&
                       n.CreatedAt >= since &&
                       !n.ReadAt.HasValue)
            .OrderByDescending(n => n.Priority)
            .ThenByDescending(n => n.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        if (!notifications.Any())
            return; // No notifications to digest
        
        // Group notifications by category
        var grouped = notifications.GroupBy(n => GetDigestCategory(n.Type));
        
        // Build digest email
        var digest = await BuildDigestEmailAsync(userId, grouped);
        
        // Send digest
        await _emailService.SendAsync(digest);
        
        // Mark notifications as included in digest
        foreach (var notification in notifications)
        {
            notification.IsBatched = true;
            notification.SentAt = DateTime.Now;
        }
        
        await _notificationRepository.UpdateManyAsync(notifications);
    }
    
    private async Task<Email> BuildDigestEmailAsync(
        Guid userId,
        IEnumerable<IGrouping<string, Notification>> groups)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(userId);
        
        var htmlBuilder = new StringBuilder();
        htmlBuilder.AppendLine("<h2>Your Daily Digest</h2>");
        htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"<p>Hi {user.DisplayName},</p>");
        htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"<p>Here's what happened in the last 24 hours:</p>");
        
        foreach (var group in groups)
        {
            htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"<h3>{group.Key} ({group.Count()})</h3>");
            htmlBuilder.AppendLine("<ul>");
            
            foreach (var notification in group.Take(10)) // Limit to 10 per category
            {
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"<li>");
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"  <strong>{notification.Title}</strong><br/>");
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"  {notification.Body}<br/>");
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"  <a href='{notification.ActionUrl}'>View</a>");
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"</li>");
            }
            
            if (group.Count() > 10)
            {
                htmlBuilder.AppendLine($"<li>... and {group.Count() - 10} more</li>");
            }
            
            htmlBuilder.AppendLine("</ul>");
        }
        
        return new Email
        {
            To = user.Email,
            Subject = $"Your Daily Digest - {DateTime.Now:MMMM dd, yyyy}",
            BodyHtml = htmlBuilder.ToString()
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 141 - SLA Domain Overview**

### 141.1 Context Purpose

The SLA (Service Level Agreement) Context provides **time-based performance tracking and enforcement** across work items, enabling organizations to:

- Define measurable service level objectives (SLOs)
- Track compliance in real-time
- Automatically escalate breaches
- Report on performance metrics
- Integrate with approval and task contexts

This context is critical for:
- Customer support organizations
- Professional services firms
- Compliance-driven industries
- Operations with contractual commitments
- High-stakes project delivery

### 141.2 Context Position in Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph SLA ["SLA Context"]
        Policy[SLA Policy]
        Tracker[SLA Tracker]
        Monitor[SLA Monitor]
        Reporter[SLA Reporter]
    end
    
    subgraph Monitored ["Monitored Contexts"]
        Task[Task Instance]
        Approval[Approval Request]
        Case[Case]
        Project[Project Milestone]
    end
    
    subgraph Shared ["Shared Kernels"]
        Calendar[Calendar Kernel]
        Timeline[Timeline Kernel]
    end
    
    subgraph Actions ["Response Actions"]
        Notify[Notification Service]
        Escalate[Escalation Engine]
        Audit[Audit Log]
    end
    
    Task -.->|has SLA| Policy
    Approval -.->|has SLA| Policy
    Case -.->|has SLA| Policy
    Project -.->|has SLA| Policy
    
    Policy --> Calendar
    Tracker --> Calendar
    Tracker --> Timeline
    
    Monitor -->|checks| Task
    Monitor -->|checks| Approval
    Monitor -->|checks| Case
    
    Monitor -->|breach detected| Notify
    Monitor -->|breach detected| Escalate
    Monitor -->|logs| Audit
```

## **Chapter 142 - SLA Ubiquitous Language**

### 142.1 Core Terms

**Service Level Agreement (SLA)**  
A commitment to measurable service standards, typically contractual or policy-based.

**Service Level Objective (SLO)**  
A specific, measurable target within an SLA (e.g., "First Response within 4 hours").

**SLA Policy**  
A reusable definition of SLOs that can be applied to task types, projects, or customers.

**SLA Clock**  
The running timer tracking elapsed time against an SLO target.

**SLA Pause**  
Temporary suspension of the clock (e.g., when task is blocked or awaiting customer response).

**SLA Breach**  
Occurs when actual time exceeds target time.

**SLA Warning**  
Alert triggered when a percentage threshold is reached (e.g., 70% of target consumed).

**Resolution Time**  
Total time from creation to completion of a work item.

**Response Time**  
Time from creation to first meaningful action (e.g., first comment, first transition).

**Working Time**  
Time calculated using business hours and calendar rules.

**Elapsed Time**  
Absolute time including non-business hours.

**Escalation Path**  
Predefined sequence of actions taken on breach or warning.

**SLA Exemption**  
Manual override excluding a work item from SLA tracking.

### 142.2 SLO Types

**Response SLO**  
Measures time to first response or acknowledgment.

**Resolution SLO**  
Measures total time to complete or close.

**Approval SLO**  
Measures time to obtain required approvals.

**Milestone SLO**  
Measures time to reach specific project milestones.

**Stage Transition SLO**  
Measures time to move between workflow stages.

**Custom SLO**  
User-defined measurement based on specific events.

## **Chapter 143 - SLA Policy Aggregate**

### 143.1 Aggregate Structure

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class SLAPolicy {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid TenantId
        +string Name
        +string Description
        +SLAPolicyScope Scope
        +Guid? ProjectId
        +Guid? TaskTypeId
        +Guid? CustomerId
        +int Priority
        +bool IsActive
        +List~SLO~ Objectives
        +List~EscalationRule~ OnBreach
        +List~EscalationRule~ OnWarning
        +Guid WorkingCalendarId
        +void AddObjective()
        +void AddEscalationRule()
        +void Activate()
        +void Deactivate()
    }
    
    class SLO {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +SLOType Type
        +Duration TargetDuration
        +SLOMeasurementMode Mode
        +bool PauseWhenBlocked
        +bool PauseWhenAwaitingCustomer
        +List~string~ PauseOnStatuses
        +double WarningThreshold
        +bool IsEnabled
    }
    
    class EscalationRule {
        +Guid Id
        +EscalationTrigger Trigger
        +int Priority

        +bool IsEnabled
    }

        +EscalationActionType Type
        +Json Configuration
        +int ExecutionOrder
    }
    
    SLAPolicy "1" --> "*" SLO
    SLAPolicy "1" --> "*" EscalationRule
    EscalationRule "1" --> "*" EscalationAction
```

### 143.2 Policy Scope Types

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Global[Global SLA Policy]
    Global -->|applies to all| AllTasks[All Tasks in Tenant]
    
    Project[Project-Scoped Policy]
    Project -->|overrides global for| ProjTasks[Tasks in Project]
    
    TaskType[Task Type Policy]
    TaskType -->|overrides for| TypeTasks[Specific Task Types]
    
    Customer[Customer-Scoped Policy]
    Customer -->|overrides for| CustTasks[Customer Tasks]
    
    Priority[Priority: Customer > Project > TaskType > Global]
```

### 143.3 SLA Policy Invariants

**Policy-Level Invariants:**
- Must have at least one SLO to be active
- Policy name must be unique within scope
- Priority determines precedence when multiple policies apply
- Cannot delete policy with active SLA trackers
- Working calendar must exist and be valid

**SLO-Level Invariants:**
- Target duration must be positive
- Warning threshold must be between 0.0 and 1.0
- Pause conditions must reference valid statuses
- Response SLO only valid for entities with response concept
- Resolution SLO requires terminal state definition

**Escalation Rule Invariants:**
- Actions must execute in priority order
- Cannot have duplicate triggers in same policy
- Actions must have valid configuration
- Disabled rules ignored during execution

### 143.4 Policy Application Logic

```csharp
public class SLAPolicyResolver
{
    public SLAPolicy ResolvePolicyForTask(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Priority order: Customer > Project > TaskType > Global
        
        var customerPolicy = GetCustomerPolicy(task.CustomerId);
        if (customerPolicy?.IsActive == true)
            return customerPolicy;
            
        var projectPolicy = GetProjectPolicy(task.ProjectId);
        if (projectPolicy?.IsActive == true)
            return projectPolicy;
            
        var taskTypePolicy = GetTaskTypePolicy(task.TaskTypeId);
        if (taskTypePolicy?.IsActive == true)
            return taskTypePolicy;
            
        return GetGlobalPolicy(task.TenantId);
    }
}
```

### 144.2 Clock State Machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> NotStarted
    NotStarted --> Running : Start Tracking
    Running --> Paused : Pause Event
    Running --> WarningTriggered : Threshold Reached
    WarningTriggered --> Breached : Target Exceeded
    Running --> Completed : Entity Completed
    Paused --> Running : Resume Event
    Paused --> Completed : Entity Completed
    WarningTriggered --> Completed : Entity Completed
    Breached --> Completed : Entity Completed
    Completed --> [*]
    Breached --> [*]
```

### 144.3 Tracker Lifecycle

**Creation:**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Entity as Task/Approval/Case
    participant Policy as SLAPolicyResolver
    participant Tracker as SLATracker
    participant Calendar as WorkingCalendar
    
    Entity->>Policy: Entity Created Event
    Policy->>Policy: Resolve Applicable Policy
    Policy->>Tracker: Create Tracker
    Tracker->>Calendar: Initialize Clocks
    Calendar-->>Tracker: Business Time Baseline
    Tracker->>Tracker: Start All Clocks
    Tracker->>Entity: SLATrackingStartedEto
```

**Clock Updates:**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Monitor as SLA Monitor Worker
    participant Tracker as SLATracker
    participant Clock as SLOClock
    participant Calendar as WorkingCalendar
    participant Action as Escalation Engine
    
    Monitor->>Tracker: Check Active Trackers
    Tracker->>Clock: Update Elapsed Time
    Clock->>Calendar: Calculate Business Time
    Calendar-->>Clock: Updated Elapsed
    
    alt Warning Threshold Reached
        Clock->>Action: SLOWarningTriggeredEto
        Action->>Action: Execute Warning Actions
    else Target Exceeded
        Clock->>Action: SLOBreachedEto
        Action->>Action: Execute Breach Actions
    end
```

### 144.4 Pause/Resume Logic

**Automatic Pause Triggers:**
- Task transitioned to "Blocked" status
- Task transitioned to "Awaiting Customer" status
- Task moved to any status in SLO's PauseOnStatuses list
- Approval step delegated
- Case stage marked as customer-dependent

**Automatic Resume Triggers:**
- Task unblocked
- Customer response received
- Task moved out of pause status
- Delegation accepted
- Stage marked as internal-dependent

**Example Configuration:**
```json
{
  "sloId": "guid",
  "pauseWhenBlocked": true,
  "pauseWhenAwaitingCustomer": true,
  "pauseOnStatuses": ["Blocked", "Customer Response", "On Hold"],
  "customPauseConditions": [
    {
      "field": "Priority",
      "operator": "equals",
      "value": "Low",
      "pauseDuration": "P7D"
    }
  ]
}
```

## **Chapter 145 - SLA Measurement Modes**

### 145.1 Business Time vs Elapsed Time

**Elapsed Time Mode:**


```mermaid
    Mode -->|Elapsed Time| System[System Clock]
```

### 145.3 Multi-Timezone Support

**Scenario:** Global team working on tasks

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Task[Task Created in NYC]
    Task -->|assigned to| Team1[London Team]
    Task -->|escalated to| Team2[Sydney Team]
    
    Task -.->|uses| Cal1[London Calendar]
    Cal1 -->|GMT Business Hours| 9AM-5PM
    
    Task -.->|escalates to| Cal2[Sydney Calendar]  
    Cal2 -->|AEDT Business Hours| 9AM-5PM
```

**Resolution Rules:**
1. Use assignee's calendar by default
2. Fall back to project calendar
3. Fall back to tenant calendar
4. Use system default calendar

```json
{
  "slaPolicy": {

    "escalationRules": [
      {
        "trigger": "WarningThresholdReached",
        "threshold": 0.7,

          {
            "type": "EscalateToRole",

              "createEscalationTask": true
            },
            "executionOrder": 1
          },
          {
            "type": "IncreaseTaskPriority",
            "config": {
              "newPriority": "Critical"
            },
            "executionOrder": 2

      {
        "trigger": "RepeatBreach",
```

## **Chapter 147 - SLA Domain Services**

### 147.1 SLA Monitor Worker

**Purpose:** Background service that continuously evaluates SLA tracker states.

**Execution Pattern:**
```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Start[Worker Starts]
    Start --> Query[Query Active Trackers]
    Query --> Batch[Batch by Tenant]
    Batch --> Process[Process Batch]
    
    Process --> Update[Update Clock Times]
    Update --> Check[Check Thresholds]
    
    Check -->|Warning| Warn[Emit Warning Event]
    Check -->|Breach| Breach[Emit Breach Event]
    Check -->|OK| Next[Next Tracker]
    
    Warn --> Next
    Breach --> Next
    Next --> More{More Trackers?}
    
    More -->|Yes| Process
    More -->|No| Wait[Wait Interval]
    Wait --> Start
```

**Configuration:**
- Check interval: 1-5 minutes (configurable)
- Batch size: 500-1000 trackers
- Parallel processing: Tenant-level parallelism
- Error handling: Continue on error, log failures

**Optimization Strategies:**
1. **Index on Status + NextCheckTime**
2. **Query only trackers due for check**
3. **Tenant isolation for parallel processing**
4. **Clock update batch commits**
5. **Event buffering for high-volume scenarios**

### 147.2 SLA Calculator Service

**Purpose:** Performs precise time calculations using calendar rules.

```csharp
public class SLACalculatorService
{
    public Duration CalculateElapsedBusinessTime(
        DateTime start,
        DateTime end,
        WorkingCalendar calendar,
        List<SLAPauseRecord> pauses)
    {
        var totalDuration = Duration.Zero;
        var currentTime = start;
        
        while (currentTime < end)
        {
            // Skip if in pause period
            if (IsInPausePeriod(currentTime, pauses))
            {
                currentTime = GetNextResumeTime(currentTime, pauses);
                continue;
            }
            
            // Skip if not business hours
            if (!calendar.IsBusinessHour(currentTime))
            {
                currentTime = calendar.GetNextBusinessHour(currentTime);
                continue;
            }
            
            // Add business hour
            var nextCheckPoint = GetNextCheckPoint(currentTime, end, pauses, calendar);
            totalDuration += CalculateDuration(currentTime, nextCheckPoint);
            currentTime = nextCheckPoint;
        }
        
        return totalDuration;
    }
    
    public DateTime CalculateTargetDateTime(
        DateTime start,
        Duration target,
        WorkingCalendar calendar)
    {
        var remaining = target;
        var currentTime = start;
        
        while (remaining > Duration.Zero)
        {
            if (!calendar.IsBusinessHour(currentTime))
            {
                currentTime = calendar.GetNextBusinessHour(currentTime);
                continue;
            }
            
            var businessHourEnd = calendar.GetBusinessDayEnd(currentTime);
            var availableInDay = businessHourEnd - currentTime;
            
            if (availableInDay >= remaining)
            {
                return currentTime + remaining;
            }
            
            remaining -= availableInDay;
            currentTime = calendar.GetNextBusinessDay(currentTime.Date);
        }
        
        return currentTime;
    }
}
```

### 148.2 Event Subscription Patterns

**Notification Service:**
```csharp
public class SLANotificationHandler : 
    IEventHandler<SLOWarningTriggeredEto>,
    IEventHandler<SLOBreachedEto>
{
    public async Task HandleAsync(SLOWarningTriggeredEto @event)
    {
        // Notify assignee: "Task ABC approaching SLA breach"
        await _notificationService.NotifyAsync(
            recipientId: @event.AssigneeId,
            type: NotificationType.SLAWarning,
            urgency: NotificationUrgency.High,
            content: BuildWarningMessage(@event)
        );
    }
    
    public async Task HandleAsync(SLOBreachedEto @event)
    {
        // Critical notification to multiple channels
        await _notificationService.BroadcastAsync(
            recipients: GetEscalationRecipients(@event),
            channels: [Channel.Email, Channel.Slack, Channel.SMS],
            type: NotificationType.SLABreach,
            urgency: NotificationUrgency.Critical,
            content: BuildBreachAlert(@event)
        );
        
        // Create incident ticket
        if (@event.Severity == "Critical")
        {
            await _incidentService.CreateAsync(new CreateIncidentInput
            {
                Title = $"Critical SLA Breach - {@event.SLOName}",
                RelatedEntityType = @event.EntityType,
                RelatedEntityId = @event.EntityId
            });
        }
    }
}
```

**Analytics Service:**

```csharp
public class SLAAnalyticsProjector :

                wasBreached = @event.WasBreached
            }

}
```

### 151.2 Caching Strategy

**Policy Caching:**
```csharp
public class SLAPolicyCacheService
{
    private IDistributedCache _cache;
    private TimeSpan _cacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromHours(4);
    
    public async Task<SLAPolicy> GetPolicyAsync(Guid policyId)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"sla:policy:{policyId}";
        
        var cached = await _cache.GetAsync<SLAPolicy>(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        
        var policy = await _repository.GetAsync(policyId);
        await _cache.SetAsync(cacheKey, policy, _cacheDuration);
        
        return policy;
    }
    
    public async Task InvalidatePolicyCache(Guid policyId)
    {
        await _cache.RemoveAsync($"sla:policy:{policyId}");
    }
}
```

**Calendar Caching:**
```csharp
// Cache working calendars aggressively
// They change infrequently but are used constantly
_cache.Set(
    $"calendar:{calendarId}",
    calendar,
    TimeSpan.FromHours(24)
);
```

### 151.3 Batch Processing Optimization

```csharp
public class OptimizedSLAMonitor
{
    public async Task ProcessBatchAsync()
    {
        var batchSize = 1000;
        var trackers = await GetActiveTrackersForCheck(batchSize);
        
        // Parallel processing by tenant
        var tenantGroups = trackers.GroupBy(t => t.TenantId);
        
        await Parallel.ForEachAsync(
            tenantGroups,
            new ParallelOptions { MaxDegreeOfParallelism = 10 },
            async (group, ct) =>
            {
                await ProcessTenantBatchAsync(group.ToList(), ct);
            }
        );
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessTenantBatchAsync(
        List<SLATracker> trackers,
        CancellationToken ct)
    {
        // Batch load calendars and policies
        var calendarIds = trackers.Select(t => t.CalendarId).Distinct();
        var calendars = await LoadCalendarsBatchAsync(calendarIds);
        
        var updates = new List<SLATracker>();
        var events = new List<DomainEvent>();
        
        foreach (var tracker in trackers)
        {
            var result = UpdateTracker(tracker, calendars);
            updates.Add(result.Tracker);
            events.AddRange(result.Events);
        }
        
        // Batch commit
        await _repository.UpdateManyAsync(updates);
        await _eventBus.PublishManyAsync(events);
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 152 - SLA Edge Cases & Special Scenarios**

### 152.1 Timezone Changes

**Scenario:** Task assigned to user in different timezone.

**Resolution:**
- Use assignee's calendar on reassignment
- Recalculate target time using new calendar
- Log timezone change in pause history
- Adjust elapsed time calculation retroactively

### 152.2 Calendar Updates

**Scenario:** Working calendar modified (e.g., new holiday added).

**Resolution:**
- Invalidate cached calendars
- Recalculate all active trackers using that calendar
- Adjust target times if holidays affect period
- Emit CalendarChangedEto for audit

### 152.3 Policy Changes

**Scenario:** SLA policy updated after trackers created.

**Resolution Options:**

**Option 1: Immutable (Recommended)**
- Active trackers continue using original policy
- New trackers use updated policy
- Clear migration path for enterprises

**Option 2: Update Existing**
- Recalculate all active trackers
- Adjust targets and thresholds
- Risk of compliance issues

### 152.4 Retroactive Exemptions

**Scenario:** Task breached SLA but exemption granted afterward.

```csharp
public class SLAExemptionService
{
    public async Task GrantExemptionAsync(Guid trackerId, GrantExemptionInput input)
    {
        var tracker = await _repository.GetAsync(trackerId);
        
        tracker.GrantExemption(
            reason: input.Reason,
            grantedBy: input.UserId,
            grantedAt: _clock.Now
        );
        
        // Update compliance metrics
        await _metricsService.AdjustBreachCountAsync(
            trackerId,
            adjustment: -1
        );
        
        // Audit trail
        await _auditLog.LogAsync(new AuditEntry
        {
            Action = "SLAExemptionGranted",
            EntityId = trackerId,
            PerformedBy = input.UserId,
            Reason = input.Reason
        });
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new SLAExemptionGrantedEto
        {
            TrackerId = trackerId,
            Reason = input.Reason,
            GrantedBy = input.UserId
        });
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 153 - Import/Export Domain Overview**

### 153.1 Context Purpose

The Import/Export & Migration Context enables **data portability, system migration, and bulk operations** across the Work Management Platform, providing:

- Bulk import from CSV, Excel, and structured files
- Migration from external systems (Jira, Asana, Azure DevOps, etc.)
- Complete tenant data export
- Legal/compliance data exports (eDiscovery, GDPR)
- Backup and disaster recovery support
- Data transformation and mapping
- Validation and error handling
- Rollback and recovery mechanisms

### 153.2 Strategic Importance

**Business Value:**
- Enables customer onboarding from competing platforms
- Reduces migration friction for enterprise customers
- Supports regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA data portability)
- Facilitates backup and disaster recovery
- Enables data analytics via export to warehouses

**Technical Value:**
- Validates domain model completeness
- Tests anti-corruption layer effectiveness
- Exercises full aggregate reconstruction
- Proves event sourcing capabilities

## **Chapter 154 - Import Ubiquitous Language**

### 154.1 Core Terms

**Import Job**  
A long-running process that brings external data into the platform.

**Import Source**  
The origin system or file format (Jira, CSV, API, etc.).

**Import Mapping**  
Configuration defining how source fields map to platform entities and attributes.

**Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)**  
Translation component that protects domain model from external schemas.

**Dry Run**  
Validation-only execution that simulates import without persisting data.

**Import Batch**  
Subset of records processed as a transactional unit.

**Import Error**  
Validation or processing failure for a specific record.

**Rollback Point**  
Snapshot enabling partial or complete import reversal.

**Field Transformer**  
Component that converts source data format to platform format.

**Entity Resolver**  
Service that matches external IDs to internal entities.

**Import Template**  
Reusable mapping configuration for common import scenarios.

**Migration Wizard**  
Guided UI workflow for configuring and executing migrations.

**Export Job**  
Process that extracts platform data to external format.

**Export Scope**  
Definition of what data to include (tenant, project, date range, etc.).

**Data Subject Export**  
GDPR-compliant export of all data related to a specific person.

**eDiscovery Export**  
Legal hold export in standardized formats (EDRM XML).

### 155.2 Import Job State Machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Created
    Created --> Validating : Start
    Validating --> ValidationFailed : Errors Found
    Validating --> Ready : Validation Passed
    Ready --> Running : Execute
    Running --> Paused : Pause
    Paused --> Running : Resume
    Running --> Failed : Critical Error
    Running --> PartialSuccess : Some Failures
    Running --> Completed : All Success
    PartialSuccess --> [*]
    Completed --> [*]
    Failed --> [*]
    ValidationFailed --> [*]
    
    note right of Validating
        Dry run execution
        Schema validation
        Mapping verification
    end note
    
    note right of Running
        Batch processing
        Entity creation
        Relationship mapping
    end note
```

### 155.3 Import Job Invariants

**Job-Level Invariants:**
- Cannot start job without valid mapping configuration
- Dry run jobs cannot create actual entities
- Cannot modify mapping after job starts
- Batch size must be between 100 and 5000 records
- Cannot process more than tenant's quota limits
- Must validate required field mappings before execution

**Batch-Level Invariants:**
- Batches must be processed sequentially by default
- Failed batch can be retried independently
- Batch rollback must be atomic
- Cannot skip batches in sequential mode

**Error Handling Invariants:**
- All errors must be logged with source context
- Critical errors (schema mismatch) stop execution
- Non-critical errors (validation) mark record as failed
- Maximum error threshold configurable per job

### 156.2 CSV/Excel Adapter

**Configuration:**
```json
{
  "sourceType": "CSV",
  "file": {
    "path": "tasks.csv",
    "encoding": "UTF-8",
    "delimiter": ",",
    "hasHeader": true,
    "skipRows": 0
  },
  "columns": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "name": "Task ID",
      "dataType": "string"
    },
    {
      "index": 1,
      "name": "Title",
      "dataType": "string",
      "required": true
    },
    {
      "index": 2,
      "name": "Assignee Email",
      "dataType": "string"
    },
    {
      "index": 3,
      "name": "Due Date",
      "dataType": "datetime",
      "format": "MM/dd/yyyy"
    },
    {
      "index": 4,
      "name": "Priority",
      "dataType": "string",
      "allowedValues": ["Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical"]
    }
  ]
}
```

**Implementation:**
```csharp
public class CsvImportAdapter : IImportSourceAdapter
{
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<SourceRecord> ReadRecordsAsync()
    {
        using var reader = new StreamReader(_filePath, _encoding);
        using var csv = new CsvReader(reader, _config);
        
        // Skip header if configured
        if (_hasHeader)
            await csv.ReadAsync();
        
        int rowIndex = 0;
        while (await csv.ReadAsync())
        {
            var record = new SourceRecord
            {
                SourceId = rowIndex.ToString(),
                RowIndex = rowIndex,
                Fields = new Dictionary<string, object>()
            };
            
            foreach (var column in _columnMappings)
            {
                try
                {
                    var value = csv.GetField(column.Index);
                    record.Fields[column.Name] = ParseValue(value, column);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    record.Errors.Add(new ParseError
                    {
                        Column = column.Name,
                        Message = ex.Message
                    });
                }
            }
            
            rowIndex++;
            yield return record;
        }
    }
    
    private object ParseValue(string value, ColumnMapping column)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            return null;
            
        return column.DataType switch
        {
            "string" => value,
            "int" => int.Parse(value),
            "decimal" => decimal.Parse(value),
            "datetime" => DateTime.ParseExact(value, column.Format, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            "bool" => bool.Parse(value),
            _ => value
        };
    }
}
```

### 156.3 Jira Import Adapter

**Configuration:**
```json
{
  "sourceType": "Jira",
  "connection": {
    "apiUrl": "https://company.atlassian.net",
    "apiKey": "encrypted_key",
    "email": "integration@company.com"
  },
  "query": {
    "jql": "project = PROJ AND status != Closed",
    "fields": ["summary", "description", "assignee", "priority", "created", "updated"],
    "expand": ["changelog", "comments"]
  },
  "mapping": {
    "includeSubtasks": true,
    "includeLinks": true,
    "includeAttachments": true,
    "maxRecords": 10000
  }
}
```

**Implementation:**
```csharp
public class JiraImportAdapter : IImportSourceAdapter
{
    private readonly JiraClient _client;
    private readonly JiraImportConfig _config;
    
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<SourceRecord> ReadRecordsAsync()
    {
        int startAt = 0;
        const int maxResults = 100;
        bool hasMore = true;
        
        while (hasMore)
        {
            var response = await _client.SearchIssuesAsync(new JiraSearchRequest
            {
                Jql = _config.Query.Jql,
                StartAt = startAt,
                MaxResults = maxResults,
                Fields = _config.Query.Fields,
                Expand = _config.Query.Expand
            });
            
            foreach (var issue in response.Issues)
            {
                yield return MapJiraIssue(issue);
                
                // Include subtasks if configured
                if (_config.Mapping.IncludeSubtasks && issue.Subtasks?.Any() == true)
                {
                    foreach (var subtask in issue.Subtasks)
                    {
                        yield return MapJiraIssue(subtask, parentKey: issue.Key);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            startAt += maxResults;
            hasMore = response.Total > startAt;
        }
    }
    
    private SourceRecord MapJiraIssue(JiraIssue issue, string parentKey = null)
    {
        return new SourceRecord
        {
            SourceId = issue.Key,
            SourceSystem = "Jira",
            Fields = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["jira_key"] = issue.Key,
                ["jira_id"] = issue.Id,
                ["type"] = issue.Fields.IssueType.Name,
                ["title"] = issue.Fields.Summary,
                ["description"] = issue.Fields.Description,
                ["status"] = issue.Fields.Status.Name,
                ["priority"] = issue.Fields.Priority?.Name,
                ["assignee_email"] = issue.Fields.Assignee?.EmailAddress,
                ["assignee_name"] = issue.Fields.Assignee?.DisplayName,
                ["reporter_email"] = issue.Fields.Reporter?.EmailAddress,
                ["created"] = issue.Fields.Created,
                ["updated"] = issue.Fields.Updated,
                ["due_date"] = issue.Fields.DueDate,
                ["parent_key"] = parentKey,
                ["labels"] = issue.Fields.Labels,
                ["components"] = issue.Fields.Components?.Select(c => c.Name).ToList(),
                ["custom_fields"] = issue.Fields.CustomFields,
                ["comments"] = issue.Fields.Comment?.Comments.Select(MapComment).ToList(),
                ["attachments"] = issue.Fields.Attachment?.Select(MapAttachment).ToList(),
                ["links"] = issue.Fields.IssueLinks?.Select(MapLink).ToList()
            },
            Metadata = new SourceRecordMetadata
            {
                SourceCreatedAt = issue.Fields.Created,
                SourceUpdatedAt = issue.Fields.Updated,
                SourceUrl = $"{_config.Connection.ApiUrl}/browse/{issue.Key}"
            }
        };
    }
}
```

### 157.1 ACL Architecture

### 157.2 Field Mapping Engine

**Mapping Configuration:**

**Mapping Engine Implementation:**
```csharp
public class FieldMappingEngine
{
    private readonly ITransformerRegistry _transformers;
    private readonly IEntityResolverRegistry _resolvers;
    
    public async Task<ImportedEntity> MapAsync(
        SourceRecord source,
        ImportMapping mapping)
    {
        var entity = new ImportedEntity
        {
            EntityType = mapping.TargetType
        };
        
        foreach (var fieldMapping in mapping.FieldMappings)
        {
            try
            {
                // Extract source value
                var sourceValue = ExtractValue(source, fieldMapping.SourcePath);
                
                // Validate if required
                if (fieldMapping.Required && sourceValue == null)
                {
                    throw new MappingException(
                        $"Required field {fieldMapping.SourcePath} is missing");
                }
                
                // Transform if specified
                object targetValue = sourceValue;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldMapping.Transform))
                {
                    var transformer = _transformers.Get(fieldMapping.Transform);
                    targetValue = await transformer.TransformAsync(
                        sourceValue,
                        fieldMapping.TransformConfig);
                }
                
                // Set target value
                SetValue(entity, fieldMapping.TargetPath, targetValue);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                entity.MappingErrors.Add(new MappingError
                {
                    SourcePath = fieldMapping.SourcePath,
                    TargetPath = fieldMapping.TargetPath,
                    Message = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Handle complex mappings
        foreach (var complexMapping in mapping.ComplexMappings)
        {
            await ApplyComplexMapping(source, entity, complexMapping);
        }
        
        return entity;
    }
}
```

### 157.3 Data Transformers

**Built-in Transformers:**

```csharp
public class HtmlToMarkdownTransformer : IFieldTransformer
{
    public Task<object> TransformAsync(object value, Json config)
    {
        if (value == null) return Task.FromResult<object>(null);
        
        var html = value.ToString();
        var markdown = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert(html);
        return Task.FromResult<object>(markdown);
    }
}

public class UserResolverTransformer : IFieldTransformer
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    
    public async Task<object> TransformAsync(object value, Json config)
    {
        if (value == null) return null;
        
        var email = value.ToString();
        var user = await _userRepo.FindByEmailAsync(email);
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            // Handle missing user based on config
            var strategy = config["missingUserStrategy"]?.ToString() ?? "skip";
            
            return strategy switch
            {
                "create" => await CreateUserAsync(email, config),
                "assign_default" => config["defaultUserId"],
                "skip" => null,
                _ => throw new TransformException($"User not found: {email}")
            };
        }
        
        return user.Id;
    }
}

public class StatusMappingTransformer : IFieldTransformer
{
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepo;
    
    public async Task<object> TransformAsync(object value, Json config)
    {
        var statusName = value.ToString();
        var workflowId = Guid.Parse(config["workflowId"].ToString());
        
        var workflow = await _workflowRepo.GetAsync(workflowId);
        var status = workflow.Statuses.FirstOrDefault(
            s => s.Name.Equals(statusName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        
        if (status == null)
        {
            // Map to closest match or default
            status = MapToClosestStatus(statusName, workflow);
        }
        
        return status.Id;
    }
}
```

### 157.4 Entity Resolver Service

**Purpose:** Match external identifiers to internal entities.

```csharp
public class EntityResolverService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Guid> _resolvedCache = new();
    
    public async Task<Guid?> ResolveUserAsync(string externalIdentifier)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"user:{externalIdentifier}";
        if (_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out var cached))
            return cached;
        
        // Try email match
        var user = await _userRepo.FindByEmailAsync(externalIdentifier);
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            // Try external ID match
            user = await _userRepo.FindByExternalIdAsync(externalIdentifier);
        }
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            // Try name fuzzy match
            user = await _userRepo.FindByNameFuzzyAsync(externalIdentifier);
        }
        
        if (user != null)
        {
            _resolvedCache[cacheKey] = user.Id;
            return user.Id;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    public async Task<Guid?> ResolveProjectAsync(string externalIdentifier)
    {
        // Similar pattern for projects
        var cacheKey = $"project:{externalIdentifier}";
        if (_resolvedCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out var cached))
            return cached;
        
        var project = await _projectRepo.FindByExternalKeyAsync(externalIdentifier);
        
        if (project != null)
        {
            _resolvedCache[cacheKey] = project.Id;
            return project.Id;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
}
```
