## **Chapter 187 - Change Tracking and Diffing**

### 187.1 Change Set Extraction

```csharp
public class ChangeSetExtractor
{
    public ChangeSet ExtractChanges(
        object beforeState,
        object afterState,
        string entityType)
    {
        var changeSet = new ChangeSet
        {
            EntityType = entityType,
            Changes = new List<FieldChange>(),
            BeforeSnapshot = JsonSerializer.Serialize(beforeState),
            AfterSnapshot = JsonSerializer.Serialize(afterState)
        };
        
        // Get all properties
        var properties = beforeState.GetType().GetProperties();
        
        foreach (var property in properties)
        {
            var oldValue = property.GetValue(beforeState);
            var newValue = property.GetValue(afterState);
            
            if (!AreEqual(oldValue, newValue))
            {
                changeSet.Changes.Add(new FieldChange
                {
                    FieldPath = property.Name,
                    OldValue = oldValue,
                    NewValue = newValue,
                    Type = DetermineChangeType(oldValue, newValue),
                    ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }
        
        return changeSet;
    }
    
    private ChangeType DetermineChangeType(object oldValue, object newValue)
    {
        if (oldValue == null && newValue != null)
            return ChangeType.Added;
        
        if (oldValue != null && newValue == null)
            return ChangeType.Removed;
        
        return ChangeType.Modified;
    }
    
    private bool AreEqual(object obj1, object obj2)
    {
        if (obj1 == null && obj2 == null)
            return true;
        
        if (obj1 == null || obj2 == null)
            return false;
        
        // Handle collections
        if (obj1 is IEnumerable enum1 && obj2 is IEnumerable enum2)
        {
            return CollectionsEqual(enum1, enum2);
        }
        
        return obj1.Equals(obj2);
    }
}
```

### 187.2 Nested Change Tracking

```csharp
public class DeepChangeTracker
{
    public List<FieldChange> TrackDeepChanges(
        object before,
        object after,
        string basePath = "")
    {
        var changes = new List<FieldChange>();
        
        if (before == null && after == null)
            return changes;
        
        var type = (before ?? after).GetType();
        
        foreach (var property in type.GetProperties())
        {
            var oldValue = before != null ? property.GetValue(before) : null;
            var newValue = after != null ? property.GetValue(after) : null;
            
            var fieldPath = string.IsNullOrEmpty(basePath)
                ? property.Name
                : $"{basePath}.{property.Name}";
            
            if (IsComplexType(property.PropertyType))
            {
                // Recursively track nested changes
                var nestedChanges = TrackDeepChanges(oldValue, newValue, fieldPath);
                changes.AddRange(nestedChanges);
            }
            else if (!AreEqual(oldValue, newValue))
            {
                changes.Add(new FieldChange
                {
                    FieldPath = fieldPath,
                    OldValue = oldValue,
                    NewValue = newValue,
                    Type = DetermineChangeType(oldValue, newValue),
                    ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }
        
        return changes;
    }
    
    private bool IsComplexType(Type type)
    {
        return !type.IsPrimitive 
            && type != typeof(string) 
            && type != typeof(DateTime)
            && type != typeof(Guid)
            && !type.IsEnum;
    }
}
```

### 187.3 Visual Diff Rendering

```csharp
public class ChangeSetRenderer
{
    public string RenderHtmlDiff(ChangeSet changeSet)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        
        sb.AppendLine("<div class='changeset'>");
        sb.AppendLine($"<h3>Changes to {changeSet.EntityType}</h3>");
        
        foreach (var change in changeSet.Changes)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("<div class='field-change'>");
            sb.AppendLine($"<label>{FormatFieldName(change.FieldPath)}</label>");
            
            if (change.Type == ChangeType.Added)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"<div class='added'>+ {FormatValue(change.NewValue)}</div>");
            }
            else if (change.Type == ChangeType.Removed)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"<div class='removed'>- {FormatValue(change.OldValue)}</div>");
            }
            else
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"<div class='removed'>- {FormatValue(change.OldValue)}</div>");
                sb.AppendLine($"<div class='added'>+ {FormatValue(change.NewValue)}</div>");
            }
            
            sb.AppendLine("</div>");
        }
        
        sb.AppendLine("</div>");
        
        return sb.ToString();
    }
    
    public string RenderTextDiff(ChangeSet changeSet)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        
        sb.AppendLine($"═══ Changes to {changeSet.EntityType} ═══");
        sb.AppendLine();
        
        foreach (var change in changeSet.Changes)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"• {FormatFieldName(change.FieldPath)}");
            
            if (change.Type == ChangeType.Added)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"  + {FormatValue(change.NewValue)}");
            }
            else if (change.Type == ChangeType.Removed)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"  - {FormatValue(change.OldValue)}");
            }
            else
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"  - {FormatValue(change.OldValue)}");
                sb.AppendLine($"  + {FormatValue(change.NewValue)}");
            }
            
            sb.AppendLine();
        }
        
        return sb.ToString();
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 188 - Timeline Query Patterns**

### 188.1 Query Service

```csharp
public class TimelineQueryService
{
    private readonly ITimelineRepository _repository;
    
    // Get timeline for specific entity
    public async Task<List<TimelineEntry>> GetEntityTimelineAsync(
        string entityType,
        Guid entityId,
        TimelineQueryOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= new TimelineQueryOptions();
        
        var query = _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => e.EntityType == entityType && e.EntityId == entityId)
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.Timestamp);
        
        if (options.FromDate.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(e => e.Timestamp >= options.FromDate.Value);
        
        if (options.ToDate.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(e => e.Timestamp <= options.ToDate.Value);
        
        if (options.Categories?.Any() == true)
            query = query.Where(e => options.Categories.Contains(e.Category));
        
        if (options.EventTypes?.Any() == true)
            query = query.Where(e => options.EventTypes.Contains(e.EventType));
        
        if (options.ActorId.HasValue)
            query = query.Where(e => e.ActorId == options.ActorId.Value);
        
        return await query
            .Skip(options.Skip)
            .Take(options.Take)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    
    // Get activity feed for user
    public async Task<List<TimelineEntry>> GetUserActivityFeedAsync(
        Guid userId,
        TimelineQueryOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= new TimelineQueryOptions();
        
        // Get user's relevant entities (assigned tasks, projects, etc.)
        var relevantEntityIds = await GetUserRelevantEntitiesAsync(userId);
        
        var query = _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => relevantEntityIds.Contains(e.EntityId) 
                     || e.ActorId == userId
                     || e.Metadata.ContainsKey("mentioned_users") 
                        && e.Metadata["mentioned_users"].Contains(userId))
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.Timestamp);
        
        return await query
            .Skip(options.Skip)
            .Take(options.Take)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    
    // Get correlation chain
    public async Task<List<TimelineEntry>> GetCorrelationChainAsync(
        string correlationId)
    {
        return await _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => e.CorrelationId == correlationId)
            .OrderBy(e => e.Timestamp)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    
    // Get causation chain (what caused what)
    public async Task<List<TimelineEntry>> GetCausationChainAsync(
        Guid rootEventId)
    {
        var chain = new List<TimelineEntry>();
        var visited = new HashSet<Guid>();
        
        await BuildCausationChainAsync(rootEventId, chain, visited);
        
        return chain;
    }
    
    private async Task BuildCausationChainAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        List<TimelineEntry> chain,
        HashSet<Guid> visited)
    {
        if (visited.Contains(eventId))
            return;
        
        visited.Add(eventId);
        
        var entry = await _repository.GetAsync(eventId);
        if (entry == null)
            return;
        
        chain.Add(entry);
        
        // Find events caused by this event
        var caused = await _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => e.CausationId == eventId.ToString())
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var causedEvent in caused)
        {
            await BuildCausationChainAsync(causedEvent.Id, chain, visited);
        }
    }
    
    // Get recent changes to entity
    public async Task<List<FieldChange>> GetRecentChangesAsync(
        string entityType,
        Guid entityId,
        string fieldPath = null,
        int count = 10)
    {
        var entries = await _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => e.EntityType == entityType 
                     && e.EntityId == entityId
                     && e.ChangeSet != null)
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.Timestamp)
            .Take(count)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        var allChanges = entries
            .SelectMany(e => e.ChangeSet.Changes)
            .ToList();
        
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldPath))
        {
            allChanges = allChanges
                .Where(c => c.FieldPath == fieldPath)
                .ToList();
        }
        
        return allChanges;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 189 - Activity Stream Generation**

### 189.1 Activity Feed Builder

```csharp
public class ActivityFeedBuilder
{
    public async Task<ActivityFeed> BuildFeedAsync(
        Guid userId,
        ActivityFeedOptions options)
    {
        var feed = new ActivityFeed
        {
            UserId = userId,
            Items = new List<ActivityItem>()
        };
        
        // Get timeline entries
        var entries = await _timelineQuery.GetUserActivityFeedAsync(
            userId,
            new TimelineQueryOptions
            {
                FromDate = options.FromDate,
                Take = options.PageSize,
                Skip = options.Skip
            });
        
        // Group by time buckets
        var grouped = GroupByTimeBuckets(entries);
        
        foreach (var group in grouped)
        {
            feed.Items.Add(new ActivityItem
            {
                TimeBucket = group.Key,
                Entries = group.Value,
                Summary = GenerateSummary(group.Value)
            });
        }
        
        return feed;
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, List<TimelineEntry>> GroupByTimeBuckets(
        List<TimelineEntry> entries)
    {
        var grouped = new Dictionary<string, List<TimelineEntry>>();
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        foreach (var entry in entries)
        {
            var bucket = GetTimeBucket(entry.Timestamp, now);
            
            if (!grouped.ContainsKey(bucket))
                grouped[bucket] = new List<TimelineEntry>();
            
            grouped[bucket].Add(entry);
        }
        
        return grouped;
    }
    
    private string GetTimeBucket(DateTime timestamp, DateTime now)
    {
        var diff = now - timestamp;
        
        if (diff.TotalMinutes < 5)
            return "Just now";
        
        if (diff.TotalHours < 1)
            return $"{(int)diff.TotalMinutes} minutes ago";
        
        if (diff.TotalHours < 24)
            return $"{(int)diff.TotalHours} hours ago";
        
        if (diff.TotalDays < 7)
            return timestamp.ToString("dddd");
        
        if (diff.TotalDays < 30)
            return $"{(int)diff.TotalDays} days ago";
        
        return timestamp.ToString("MMM d, yyyy");
    }
    
    private string GenerateSummary(List<TimelineEntry> entries)
    {
        if (entries.Count == 1)
            return entries[0].Description;
        
        var groupedByType = entries.GroupBy(e => e.EventType);
        
        var summaryParts = groupedByType
            .Select(g => $"{g.Count()} {GetEventLabel(g.Key)}")
            .ToList();
        
        return string.Join(", ", summaryParts);
    }
}
```

### 189.2 Personalized Feed Filtering

```csharp
public class PersonalizedFeedFilter
{
    public async Task<List<TimelineEntry>> FilterAsync(
        List<TimelineEntry> entries,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var preferences = await _userPreferences.GetAsync(userId);
        
        // Filter by user preferences
        var filtered = entries.Where(e =>
        {
            // Skip muted projects
            if (preferences.MutedProjects.Contains(e.Metadata["project_id"]))
                return false;
            
            // Skip muted users
            if (e.ActorId.HasValue && 
                preferences.MutedUsers.Contains(e.ActorId.Value))
                return false;
            
            // Include only subscribed event types
            if (preferences.SubscribedEventTypes?.Any() == true &&
                !preferences.SubscribedEventTypes.Contains(e.EventType))
                return false;
            
            return true;
        }).ToList();
        
        // Apply relevance scoring
        foreach (var entry in filtered)
        {
            entry.Metadata["relevance_score"] = CalculateRelevance(entry, userId);
        }
        
        // Sort by relevance and recency
        return filtered
            .OrderByDescending(e => e.Metadata["relevance_score"])
            .ThenByDescending(e => e.Timestamp)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private double CalculateRelevance(TimelineEntry entry, Guid userId)
    {
        double score = 0;
        
        // Direct mentions
        if (entry.Metadata.ContainsKey("mentioned_users") &&
            entry.Metadata["mentioned_users"].Contains(userId))
            score += 10;
        
        // Assigned to user
        if (entry.Metadata["assignee_id"]?.ToString() == userId.ToString())
            score += 8;
        
        // User is watcher
        if (entry.Metadata.ContainsKey("watchers") &&
            entry.Metadata["watchers"].Contains(userId))
            score += 5;
        
        // Recent activity
        var age = DateTime.UtcNow - entry.Timestamp;
        if (age.TotalHours < 1)
            score += 5;
        else if (age.TotalHours < 24)
            score += 3;
        
        // Important event types
        if (entry.Category == EventCategory.ApprovalDecision)
            score += 7;
        
        if (entry.Category == EventCategory.StatusChanged)
            score += 4;
        
        return score;
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class AuditReportGenerator
{
    public async Task<AuditReport> GenerateComplianceReportAsync(
        AuditReportRequest request)
    {
        var report = new AuditReport
        {
            ReportId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            RequestedBy = request.UserId,
            Period = request.Period,
            Scope = request.Scope
        };
        
        // Gather all relevant timeline entries
        var entries = await GatherAuditEntriesAsync(request);
        
        // Categorize by compliance requirement
        report.Sections = new List<AuditReportSection>
        {
            await GenerateAccessLogSection(entries),
            await GenerateChangeLogSection(entries),
            await GenerateApprovalLogSection(entries),
            await GenerateSecurityEventSection(entries),
            await GenerateDataModificationSection(entries)
        };
        
        // Generate statistics
        report.Statistics = GenerateStatistics(entries);
        
        // Detect anomalies
        report.Anomalies = await DetectAnomaliesAsync(entries);
        
        return report;
    }
    
    private async Task<AuditReportSection> GenerateAccessLogSection(
        List<TimelineEntry> entries)
    {
        var section = new AuditReportSection
        {
            Title = "Access Log",
            Description = "All access attempts and permission changes"
        };
        
        var accessEvents = entries
            .Where(e => e.Category == EventCategory.SecurityEvent)
            .OrderBy(e => e.Timestamp)
            .ToList();
        
        section.Entries = accessEvents.Select(e => new AuditLogEntry
        {
            Timestamp = e.Timestamp,
            User = e.ActorName,
            Action = e.EventType,
            Resource = $"{e.EntityType}:{e.EntityId}",
            Result = e.Metadata.ContainsKey("success") 
                ? (bool)e.Metadata["success"] ? "Success" : "Failed"
                : "Success",
            IPAddress = e.SourceIP
        }).ToList();
        
        return section;
    }
    
    private async Task<AuditReportSection> GenerateChangeLogSection(
        List<TimelineEntry> entries)
    {
        var section = new AuditReportSection
        {
            Title = "Change Log",
            Description = "All modifications to entities"
        };
        
        var changeEvents = entries
            .Where(e => e.Category == EventCategory.EntityUpdated 
                     && e.ChangeSet != null)
            .OrderBy(e => e.Timestamp)
            .ToList();
        
        section.Entries = changeEvents.Select(e => new AuditLogEntry
        {
            Timestamp = e.Timestamp,
            User = e.ActorName,
            Action = "Modified",
            Resource = $"{e.EntityType}:{e.EntityId}",
            Details = FormatChangeSet(e.ChangeSet),
            Before = e.ChangeSet.BeforeSnapshot,
            After = e.ChangeSet.AfterSnapshot
        }).ToList();
        
        return section;
    }
}
```

### 191.1 Partitioning Strategy

```sql
-- Partition by month for efficient queries and archival
CREATE TABLE TimelineEntries (
    Id UUID NOT NULL,
    TenantId UUID NOT NULL,
    Timestamp TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    EntityType VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    EntityId UUID NOT NULL,
    EventType VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    Category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    ActorId UUID,
    Description TEXT,
    Metadata JSONB,
    ChangeSet JSONB,
    -- ... other columns
    PRIMARY KEY (Id, Timestamp)
) PARTITION BY RANGE (Timestamp);

-- Create monthly partitions
CREATE TABLE TimelineEntries_2025_01 
PARTITION OF TimelineEntries
FOR VALUES FROM ('2025-01-01') TO ('2025-02-01');

CREATE TABLE TimelineEntries_2025_02
PARTITION OF TimelineEntries
FOR VALUES FROM ('2025-02-01') TO ('2025-03-01');

-- Indexes per partition
CREATE INDEX idx_timeline_2025_01_entity 
ON TimelineEntries_2025_01(TenantId, EntityType, EntityId, Timestamp DESC);

CREATE INDEX idx_timeline_2025_01_actor
ON TimelineEntries_2025_01(TenantId, ActorId, Timestamp DESC);
```

### 191.2 Archival Strategy

```csharp
public class TimelineArchivalService
{
    public async Task ArchiveOldEntriesAsync()
    {
        var cutoffDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMonths(-6);
        
        // Move to archive storage
        var entriesToArchive = await _repository.Query()
            .Where(e => e.Timestamp < cutoffDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var batch in entriesToArchive.Batch(10000))
        {
            // Export to cold storage
            await _archiveStorage.WriteAsync(batch);
            
            // Delete from hot storage
            await _repository.DeleteManyAsync(batch.Select(e => e.Id));
        }
    }
}
```

### 191.3 Compression

```csharp
public class TimelineEntryCompressor
{
    public byte[] Compress(TimelineEntry entry)
    {
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(entry);
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
        
        using var output = new MemoryStream();
        using var gzip = new GZipStream(output, CompressionMode.Compress);
        
        gzip.Write(bytes, 0, bytes.Length);
        gzip.Close();
        
        return output.ToArray();
    }
    
    public TimelineEntry Decompress(byte[] compressed)
    {
        using var input = new MemoryStream(compressed);
        using var gzip = new GZipStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress);
        using var reader = new StreamReader(gzip);
        
        var json = reader.ReadToEnd();
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TimelineEntry>(json);
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 192 - Calendar Kernel Overview**

### 192.1 Purpose and Scope

The Calendar & Time Kernel provides **unified temporal management and scheduling capabilities** across all bounded contexts, enabling:

- Calendar management and event scheduling
- Time zone aware date/time handling
- Business hours and availability management
- Recurring event patterns (RFC 5545 RRULE)
- Meeting scheduling and conflict detection
- Resource booking and capacity management
- Working day calculations
- Holiday and vacation tracking
- Time-based rule evaluation
- Deadline and reminder scheduling

**Used By:**
- Task Management (due dates, scheduling)
- Workflow Engine (time-based triggers)
- Notification System (scheduled reminders)
- Approval System (timeout handling)
- Resource Management (booking, availability)
- Project Planning (timelines, milestones)
- Reporting (period calculations)

### 192.2 Core Value Proposition

**Problem Without Calendar Kernel:**
- Inconsistent time zone handling
- Complex recurring event logic duplicated
- No unified availability checking
- Manual business day calculations
- Conflicting scheduling logic
- Poor meeting coordination

**Solution With Calendar Kernel:**
- Centralized time zone management
- RFC-compliant recurrence rules
- Unified availability service
- Business calendar abstraction
- Smart conflict detection
- Integrated scheduling workflows

### 193.2 Calendar Invariants

**Calendar-Level Invariants:**
- Name is required and max 200 characters
- TimeZone must be valid IANA time zone
- Default calendar must exist for each user
- Owner must be valid user in tenant

**Event-Level Invariants:**
- StartTime must be before EndTime (unless all-day)
- All-day events have no specific time component
- TimeZone required for non-all-day events
- Title is required and max 500 characters
- Cannot have more than 500 attendees
- Recurrence rule must be valid RFC 5545 format

**Recurrence Invariants:**
- Interval must be positive integer
- Frequency must be valid (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
- ByDay only valid for Weekly/Monthly/Yearly
- ByMonthDay only valid for Monthly/Yearly
- EndCondition must have either Count or Until date
- RRule string must parse successfully

**Availability Invariants:**
- StartTime must be before EndTime
- Cannot overlap with higher priority blocks
- Status must be valid (Busy, Free, Tentative, OutOfOffice)

## **Chapter 194 - Calendar Service**

### 194.1 Calendar Management Service

```csharp
public class CalendarService : ICalendarService
{
    private readonly ICalendarRepository _calendarRepo;
    private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepo;
    private readonly ITimeZoneService _timeZoneService;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    
    public async Task<Calendar> CreateCalendarAsync(CreateCalendarCommand command)
    {
        // Validate
        await ValidateCalendarCreationAsync(command);
        
        // Create calendar
        var calendar = new Calendar
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId.Value,
            Name = command.Name,
            Description = command.Description,
            Type = command.Type,
            OwnerId = command.OwnerId ?? _currentUser.UserId,
            TimeZone = command.TimeZone ?? _currentUser.TimeZone ?? "UTC",
            Color = command.Color ?? CalendarColor.Blue,
            IsDefault = command.IsDefault,
            IsVisible = true,
            Settings = new CalendarSettings
            {
                DefaultReminderMinutes = 15,
                AllowInvitations = true,
                ShowDeclinedEvents = false
            }
        };
        
        // Ensure domain invariants
        calendar.Validate();
        
        // Persist
        await _calendarRepo.InsertAsync(calendar);
        
        // Publish event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new CalendarCreatedEto
        {
            CalendarId = calendar.Id,
            Name = calendar.Name,
            OwnerId = calendar.OwnerId.Value,
            TenantId = calendar.TenantId
        });
        
        return calendar;
    }
    
    public async Task<List<Calendar>> GetUserCalendarsAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        // Get owned calendars
        var ownedCalendars = await _calendarRepo.Query()
            .Where(c => c.TenantId == _currentUser.TenantId.Value
                     && c.OwnerId == userId)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        // Get shared calendars
        var sharedCalendars = await GetSharedCalendarsAsync(userId);
        
        return ownedCalendars.Concat(sharedCalendars).ToList();
    }
    
    public async Task UpdateCalendarAsync(Guid calendarId, UpdateCalendarCommand command)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyCalendarAsync(calendar);
        
        // Update properties
        calendar.Name = command.Name ?? calendar.Name;
        calendar.Description = command.Description ?? calendar.Description;
        calendar.Color = command.Color ?? calendar.Color;
        calendar.TimeZone = command.TimeZone ?? calendar.TimeZone;
        calendar.IsVisible = command.IsVisible ?? calendar.IsVisible;
        
        if (command.Settings != null)
        {
            calendar.Settings = command.Settings;
        }
        
        // Validate
        calendar.Validate();
        
        // Update
        await _calendarRepo.UpdateAsync(calendar);
        
        // Publish event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new CalendarUpdatedEto
        {
            CalendarId = calendar.Id,
            TenantId = calendar.TenantId
        });
    }
    
    public async Task DeleteCalendarAsync(Guid calendarId)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        // Cannot delete default calendar
        if (calendar.IsDefault)
            throw new BusinessException("Cannot delete default calendar");
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyCalendarAsync(calendar);
        
        // Check if has events
        var hasEvents = await _eventRepo.Query()
            .AnyAsync(e => e.CalendarId == calendarId);
        
        if (hasEvents)
        {
            // Offer to move events to default calendar
            throw new BusinessException(
                "Calendar has events. Move events to another calendar first.");
        }
        
        // Delete
        await _calendarRepo.DeleteAsync(calendarId);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new CalendarDeletedEto
        {
            CalendarId = calendarId,
            TenantId = calendar.TenantId
        });
    }
}
```

### 194.2 Calendar Query Service

```csharp
public class CalendarQueryService
{
    public async Task<List<CalendarEvent>> GetEventsInRangeAsync(
        Guid calendarId,
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        CalendarQueryOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= new CalendarQueryOptions();
        
        // Get base events in range
        var baseEvents = await _eventRepo.Query()
            .Where(e => e.CalendarId == calendarId
                     && e.StartTime < endDate
                     && e.EndTime > startDate)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        // Expand recurring events
        var expandedEvents = new List<CalendarEvent>();
        
        foreach (var evt in baseEvents)
        {
            if (evt.Recurrence != null)
            {
                // Generate occurrences
                var occurrences = await _recurrenceService.GenerateOccurrencesAsync(
                    evt,
                    startDate,
                    endDate);
                
                expandedEvents.AddRange(occurrences);
            }
            else
            {
                expandedEvents.Add(evt);
            }
        }
        
        // Apply filters
        if (options.Status != null)
        {
            expandedEvents = expandedEvents
                .Where(e => e.Status == options.Status)
                .ToList();
        }
        
        if (options.IncludeDeclined == false)
        {
            expandedEvents = expandedEvents
                .Where(e => !IsDeclinedByUser(e, options.UserId))
                .ToList();
        }
        
        // Sort
        return expandedEvents
            .OrderBy(e => e.StartTime)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    public async Task<List<CalendarEvent>> GetUpcomingEventsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        int daysAhead = 7)
    {
        var calendars = await _calendarService.GetUserCalendarsAsync(userId);
        var allEvents = new List<CalendarEvent>();
        
        var startDate = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var endDate = startDate.AddDays(daysAhead);
        
        foreach (var calendar in calendars.Where(c => c.IsVisible))
        {
            var events = await GetEventsInRangeAsync(
                calendar.Id,
                startDate,
                endDate);
            
            allEvents.AddRange(events);
        }
        
        return allEvents
            .OrderBy(e => e.StartTime)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    public async Task<CalendarEvent> GetNextEventAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var upcoming = await GetUpcomingEventsAsync(userId, 30);
        
        return upcoming
            .Where(e => e.StartTime > DateTime.UtcNow)
            .OrderBy(e => e.StartTime)
            .FirstOrDefault();
    }
}
```

```csharp
    private readonly IRecurrenceService _recurrenceService;
    private readonly IConflictDetectionService _conflictService;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    
    public async Task<CalendarEvent> CreateEventAsync(CreateEventCommand command)
    {
        // Validate calendar access
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(command.CalendarId);
        await EnsureCanModifyCalendarAsync(calendar);
        
        // Create event
        var evt = new CalendarEvent
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CalendarId = command.CalendarId,
            Title = command.Title,
            Description = command.Description,
            StartTime = command.StartTime,
            EndTime = command.EndTime,
            TimeZone = command.TimeZone ?? calendar.TimeZone,
            IsAllDay = command.IsAllDay,
            Status = EventStatus.Confirmed,
            Visibility = command.Visibility ?? EventVisibility.Default,
            Location = command.Location,
            CreatedBy = _currentUser.UserId
        };
        
        // Validate times
        ValidateEventTimes(evt);
        
        // Set up recurrence if specified
        if (command.RecurrenceRule != null)
        {
            evt.Recurrence = await _recurrenceService.ParseRuleAsync(
                command.RecurrenceRule);
        }
        
        // Add attendees
        if (command.Attendees?.Any() == true)
        {
            evt.Attendees = command.Attendees.Select(a => new Attendee
            {
                Email = a.Email,
                Name = a.Name,
                Role = a.Role,
                Status = AttendeeStatus.NeedsAction,
                IsOptional = a.IsOptional
            }).ToList();
        }
        
        // Set up reminders
        if (command.Reminders?.Any() == true)
        {
            evt.Reminders = command.Reminders.Select(r => new Reminder
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Type = r.Type,
                MinutesBefore = r.MinutesBefore,
                Method = r.Method,
                IsSent = false
            }).ToList();
        }
        else
        {
            // Add default reminder from calendar settings
            evt.Reminders = new List<Reminder>
            {
                new Reminder
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    Type = ReminderType.BeforeStart,
                    MinutesBefore = calendar.Settings.DefaultReminderMinutes,
                    Method = ReminderMethod.Notification,
                    IsSent = false
                }
            };
        }
        
        // Check for conflicts
        if (command.CheckConflicts)
        {
            var conflicts = await _conflictService.DetectConflictsAsync(evt);
            if (conflicts.Any())
            {
                throw new EventConflictException(
                    "Event conflicts with existing events", conflicts);
            }
        }
        
        // Persist
        await _eventRepo.InsertAsync(evt);
        
        // Send invitations
        if (evt.Attendees?.Any() == true)
        {
            await SendInvitationsAsync(evt);
        }
        
        // Publish event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new EventCreatedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            CalendarId = evt.CalendarId,
            Title = evt.Title,
            StartTime = evt.StartTime,
            HasAttendees = evt.Attendees?.Any() ?? false
        });
        
        return evt;
    }
    
    public async Task UpdateEventAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        UpdateEventCommand command,
        UpdateScope scope = UpdateScope.ThisEvent)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyEventAsync(evt);
        
        if (evt.Recurrence != null && scope != UpdateScope.ThisEvent)
        {
            await UpdateRecurringEventAsync(evt, command, scope);
            return;
        }
        
        // Track changes for notification
        var changes = new EventChanges();
        
        // Update properties
        if (command.Title != null && command.Title != evt.Title)
        {
            changes.TitleChanged = true;
            evt.Title = command.Title;
        }
        
        if (command.StartTime.HasValue && command.StartTime != evt.StartTime)
        {
            changes.TimeChanged = true;
            evt.StartTime = command.StartTime.Value;
        }
        
        if (command.EndTime.HasValue && command.EndTime != evt.EndTime)
        {
            changes.TimeChanged = true;
            evt.EndTime = command.EndTime.Value;
        }
        
        if (command.Location != null)
        {
            changes.LocationChanged = true;
            evt.Location = command.Location;
        }
        
        // Validate
        ValidateEventTimes(evt);
        
        // Update attendees if changed
        if (command.Attendees != null)
        {
            await UpdateAttendeesAsync(evt, command.Attendees, changes);
        }
        
        // Check for new conflicts
        if (changes.TimeChanged)
        {
            var conflicts = await _conflictService.DetectConflictsAsync(evt);
            if (conflicts.Any())
            {
                throw new EventConflictException(
                    "Updated event conflicts with existing events", conflicts);
            }
        }
        
        // Update
        await _eventRepo.UpdateAsync(evt);
        
        // Notify attendees of changes
        if (changes.HasChanges && evt.Attendees?.Any() == true)
        {
            await NotifyEventChangesAsync(evt, changes);
        }
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new EventUpdatedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            CalendarId = evt.CalendarId,
            Changes = changes
        });
    }
    
    public async Task DeleteEventAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        DeleteScope scope = DeleteScope.ThisEvent,
        string cancellationMessage = null)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyEventAsync(evt);
        
        if (evt.Recurrence != null && scope != DeleteScope.ThisEvent)
        {
            await DeleteRecurringEventAsync(evt, scope);
            return;
        }
        
        // Notify attendees of cancellation
        if (evt.Attendees?.Any() == true)
        {
            await NotifyEventCancellationAsync(evt, cancellationMessage);
        }
        
        // Delete
        await _eventRepo.DeleteAsync(eventId);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new EventDeletedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            CalendarId = evt.CalendarId
        });
    }
    
    private void ValidateEventTimes(CalendarEvent evt)
    {
        if (evt.IsAllDay)
        {
            // All-day events should have time component zeroed
            evt.StartTime = evt.StartTime.Date;
            evt.EndTime = evt.EndTime.Date;
        }
        else
        {
            if (evt.EndTime <= evt.StartTime)
            {
                throw new BusinessException(
                    "Event end time must be after start time");
            }
        }
        
        // Maximum event duration: 30 days
        if ((evt.EndTime - evt.StartTime).TotalDays > 30)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "Event duration cannot exceed 30 days");
        }
    }
    
    private async Task SendInvitationsAsync(CalendarEvent evt)
    {
        foreach (var attendee in evt.Attendees)
        {
            await _notificationService.SendAsync(new EventInvitationNotification
            {
                EventId = evt.Id,
                EventTitle = evt.Title,
                StartTime = evt.StartTime,
                EndTime = evt.EndTime,
                Location = evt.Location?.Name,
                OrganizerName = _currentUser.UserName,
                AttendeeEmail = attendee.Email,
                AttendeeName = attendee.Name,
                AcceptUrl = GenerateAcceptUrl(evt.Id, attendee.Email),
                DeclineUrl = GenerateDeclineUrl(evt.Id, attendee.Email)
            });
        }
    }
}
```

### 195.2 Attendee Management

```csharp
public class AttendeeService
{
    public async Task RespondToInvitationAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        string attendeeEmail,
        AttendeeStatus response,
        string comment = null)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        var attendee = evt.Attendees
            .FirstOrDefault(a => a.Email.Equals(
                attendeeEmail, 
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        
        if (attendee == null)
            throw new NotFoundException("Attendee not found");
        
        // Update status
        var oldStatus = attendee.Status;
        attendee.Status = response;
        attendee.ResponseTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        // Update event
        await _eventRepo.UpdateAsync(evt);
        
        // Notify organizer
        await NotifyOrganizerOfResponseAsync(
            evt,
            attendee,
            oldStatus,
            response,
            comment);
        
        // Publish event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new AttendeeRespondedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            AttendeeEmail = attendeeEmail,
            Response = response,
            PreviousResponse = oldStatus
        });
    }
    
    public async Task<List<Attendee>> ProposeNewTimeAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        string attendeeEmail,
        DateTime proposedStartTime,
        DateTime proposedEndTime)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        var attendee = evt.Attendees
            .FirstOrDefault(a => a.Email.Equals(
                attendeeEmail,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        
        if (attendee == null)
            throw new NotFoundException("Attendee not found");
        
        // Check if proposed time works for all required attendees
        var availabilityCheck = await CheckGroupAvailabilityAsync(
            evt.Attendees.Where(a => !a.IsOptional),
            proposedStartTime,
            proposedEndTime);
        
        if (!availabilityCheck.AllAvailable)
        {
            // Return list of unavailable attendees
            return availabilityCheck.UnavailableAttendees;
        }
        
        // Notify organizer of proposed time
        await NotifyOrganizerOfProposedTimeAsync(
            evt,
            attendee,
            proposedStartTime,
            proposedEndTime);
        
        return new List<Attendee>(); // All available
    }
    
    public async Task AddAttendeesAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        List<AttendeeDto> newAttendees)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyEventAsync(evt);
        
        // Maximum attendees
        if ((evt.Attendees?.Count ?? 0) + newAttendees.Count > 500)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "Cannot exceed 500 attendees per event");
        }
        
        evt.Attendees ??= new List<Attendee>();
        
        foreach (var dto in newAttendees)
        {
            // Check if already invited
            if (evt.Attendees.Any(a => a.Email.Equals(
                dto.Email, 
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                continue; // Skip duplicates
            }
            
            var attendee = new Attendee
            {
                Email = dto.Email,
                Name = dto.Name,
                Role = dto.Role,
                Status = AttendeeStatus.NeedsAction,
                IsOptional = dto.IsOptional
            };
            
            evt.Attendees.Add(attendee);
            
            // Send invitation
            await SendInvitationToAttendeeAsync(evt, attendee);
        }
        
        await _eventRepo.UpdateAsync(evt);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new AttendeesAddedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            NewAttendeeCount = newAttendees.Count
        });
    }
    
    public async Task RemoveAttendeeAsync(
        Guid eventId,
        string attendeeEmail)
    {
        var evt = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(eventId);
        
        // Check permissions
        await EnsureCanModifyEventAsync(evt);
        
        var attendee = evt.Attendees
            .FirstOrDefault(a => a.Email.Equals(
                attendeeEmail,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        
        if (attendee == null)
            return;
        
        evt.Attendees.Remove(attendee);
        
        await _eventRepo.UpdateAsync(evt);
        
        // Notify removed attendee
        await NotifyAttendeeRemovedAsync(evt, attendee);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new AttendeeRemovedEto
        {
            EventId = evt.Id,
            AttendeeEmail = attendeeEmail
        });
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 196 - Recurrence Patterns (RFC 5545)**

### 196.1 Recurrence Rule Parser

```csharp
public class RecurrenceRuleParser
{
    // Parse RRULE string into RecurrenceRule object
    public RecurrenceRule Parse(string rruleString)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rruleString))
            throw new ArgumentException("RRULE string cannot be empty");
        
        // Remove RRULE: prefix if present
        if (rruleString.StartsWith("RRULE:", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            rruleString = rruleString.Substring(6);
        
        var parts = rruleString.Split(';');
        var rule = new RecurrenceRule { RRule = rruleString };
        
        foreach (var part in parts)
        {
            var keyValue = part.Split('=');
            if (keyValue.Length != 2) continue;
            
            var key = keyValue[0].Trim().ToUpper();
            var value = keyValue[1].Trim();
            
            switch (key)
            {
                case "FREQ":
                    rule.Frequency = ParseFrequency(value);
                    break;
                    
                case "INTERVAL":
                    rule.Interval = int.Parse(value);
                    break;
                    
                case "COUNT":
                    rule.EndCondition = new RecurrenceEnd
                    {
                        Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count,
                        Count = int.Parse(value)
                    };
                    break;
                    
                case "UNTIL":
                    rule.EndCondition = new RecurrenceEnd
                    {
                        Type = RecurrenceEndType.Until,
                        Until = ParseDateTime(value)
                    };
                    break;
                    
                case "BYDAY":
                    rule.ByDay = ParseByDay(value);
                    break;
                    
                case "BYMONTHDAY":
                    rule.ByMonthDay = value.Split(',')
                        .Select(int.Parse)
                        .ToList();
                    break;
                    
                case "BYMONTH":
                    rule.ByMonth = value.Split(',')
                        .Select(int.Parse)
                        .ToList();
                    break;
                    
                case "BYSETPOS":
                    rule.BySetPos = int.Parse(value);
                    break;
            }
        }
        
        // Validate
        ValidateRecurrenceRule(rule);
        
        return rule;
    }
    
    // Build RRULE string from RecurrenceRule object
    public string Build(RecurrenceRule rule)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        
        // FREQ (required)
        parts.Add($"FREQ={rule.Frequency.ToString().ToUpper()}");
        
        // INTERVAL (optional, default 1)
        if (rule.Interval > 1)
            parts.Add($"INTERVAL={rule.Interval}");
        
        // End condition
        if (rule.EndCondition != null)
        {
            if (rule.EndCondition.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Count)
                parts.Add($"COUNT={rule.EndCondition.Count}");
            else if (rule.EndCondition.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Until)
                parts.Add($"UNTIL={FormatDateTime(rule.EndCondition.Until)}");
        }
        
        // BYDAY
        if (rule.ByDay?.Any() == true)
        {
            var dayStrings = rule.ByDay.Select(d => FormatDayOfWeek(d));
            parts.Add($"BYDAY={string.Join(",", dayStrings)}");
        }
        
        // BYMONTHDAY
        if (rule.ByMonthDay?.Any() == true)
        {
            parts.Add($"BYMONTHDAY={string.Join(",", rule.ByMonthDay)}");
        }
        
        // BYMONTH
        if (rule.ByMonth?.Any() == true)
        {
            parts.Add($"BYMONTH={string.Join(",", rule.ByMonth)}");
        }
        
        // BYSETPOS
        if (rule.BySetPos.HasValue)
        {
            parts.Add($"BYSETPOS={rule.BySetPos.Value}");
        }
        
        return "RRULE:" + string.Join(";", parts);
    }
    
    private RecurrenceFrequency ParseFrequency(string value)
    {
        return value.ToUpper() switch
        {
            "DAILY" => RecurrenceFrequency.Daily,
            "WEEKLY" => RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly,
            "MONTHLY" => RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly,
            "YEARLY" => RecurrenceFrequency.Yearly,
            _ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid frequency: {value}")
        };
    }
    
    private List<DayOfWeek> ParseByDay(string value)
    {
        return value.Split(',')
            .Select(s => s.Trim().ToUpper() switch
            {
                "SU" => DayOfWeek.Sunday,
                "MO" => DayOfWeek.Monday,
                "TU" => DayOfWeek.Tuesday,
                "WE" => DayOfWeek.Wednesday,
                "TH" => DayOfWeek.Thursday,
                "FR" => DayOfWeek.Friday,
                "SA" => DayOfWeek.Saturday,
                _ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid day: {s}")
            })
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private void ValidateRecurrenceRule(RecurrenceRule rule)
    {
        if (rule.Interval < 1)
            throw new ValidationException("Interval must be at least 1");
        
        if (rule.Interval > 1000)
            throw new ValidationException("Interval cannot exceed 1000");
        
        if (rule.ByDay?.Any() == true &&
            rule.Frequency == RecurrenceFrequency.Daily)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                "BYDAY not valid for DAILY frequency");
        }
        
        if (rule.ByMonthDay?.Any() == true &&
            (rule.Frequency == RecurrenceFrequency.Daily ||
             rule.Frequency == RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly))
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                "BYMONTHDAY not valid for DAILY or WEEKLY frequency");
        }
        
        if (rule.EndCondition?.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Count &&
            rule.EndCondition.Count < 1)
        {
            throw new ValidationException("COUNT must be at least 1");
        }
        
        if (rule.EndCondition?.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Count &&
            rule.EndCondition.Count > 1000)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                "COUNT cannot exceed 1000 occurrences");
        }
    }
}
```

### 196.2 Occurrence Generator

```csharp
public class RecurrenceOccurrenceGenerator
{
    public async Task<List<CalendarEvent>> GenerateOccurrencesAsync(
        CalendarEvent masterEvent,
        DateTime rangeStart,
        DateTime rangeEnd,
        int maxOccurrences = 1000)
    {
        if (masterEvent.Recurrence == null)
            return new List<CalendarEvent> { masterEvent };
        
        var occurrences = new List<CalendarEvent>();
        var rule = masterEvent.Recurrence;
        
        var current = masterEvent.StartTime;
        var duration = masterEvent.EndTime - masterEvent.StartTime;
        int count = 0;
        
        while (ShouldContinue(current, rangeEnd, rule, count, maxOccurrences))
        {
            if (current >= rangeStart)
            {
                // Check if this occurrence matches the recurrence pattern
                if (MatchesPattern(current, masterEvent.StartTime, rule))
                {
                    // Create occurrence
                    var occurrence = CloneEventForOccurrence(
                        masterEvent,
                        current,
                        current + duration);
                    
                    occurrences.Add(occurrence);
                    count++;
                }
            }
            
            // Move to next candidate date
            current = GetNextCandidate(current, rule);
        }
        
        return occurrences;
    }
    
    private bool ShouldContinue(
        DateTime current,
        DateTime rangeEnd,
        RecurrenceRule rule,
        int count,
        int maxOccurrences)
    {
        // Check range
        if (current > rangeEnd)
            return false;
        
        // Check count limit
        if (count >= maxOccurrences)
            return false;
        
        // Check recurrence end condition
        if (rule.EndCondition != null)
        {
            if (rule.EndCondition.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Count &&
                count >= rule.EndCondition.Count)
                return false;
            
            if (rule.EndCondition.Type == RecurrenceEndType.Until &&
                current > rule.EndCondition.Until)
                return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private bool MatchesPattern(
        DateTime candidate,
        DateTime startTime,
        RecurrenceRule rule)
    {
        // Check BYDAY constraint
        if (rule.ByDay?.Any() == true)
        {
            if (!rule.ByDay.Contains(candidate.DayOfWeek))
                return false;
        }
        
        // Check BYMONTHDAY constraint
        if (rule.ByMonthDay?.Any() == true)
        {
            if (!rule.ByMonthDay.Contains(candidate.Day))
                return false;
        }
        
        // Check BYMONTH constraint
        if (rule.ByMonth?.Any() == true)
        {
            if (!rule.ByMonth.Contains(candidate.Month))
                return false;
        }
        
        // Check BYSETPOS (for "2nd Tuesday" style rules)
        if (rule.BySetPos.HasValue && rule.ByDay?.Any() == true)
        {
            var weekOfMonth = GetWeekOfMonth(candidate);
            if (weekOfMonth != rule.BySetPos.Value)
                return false;
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private DateTime GetNextCandidate(DateTime current, RecurrenceRule rule)
    {
        return rule.Frequency switch
        {
            RecurrenceFrequency.Daily => current.AddDays(rule.Interval),
            RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly => current.AddDays(7 * rule.Interval),
            RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly => current.AddMonths(rule.Interval),
            RecurrenceFrequency.Yearly => current.AddYears(rule.Interval),
            _ => current.AddDays(1)
        };
    }
    
    private CalendarEvent CloneEventForOccurrence(
        CalendarEvent master,
        DateTime startTime,
        DateTime endTime)
    {
        return new CalendarEvent
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CalendarId = master.CalendarId,
            Title = master.Title,
            Description = master.Description,
            StartTime = startTime,
            EndTime = endTime,
            TimeZone = master.TimeZone,
            IsAllDay = master.IsAllDay,
            Status = master.Status,
            Visibility = master.Visibility,
            Location = master.Location,
            Attendees = master.Attendees?.Select(a => new Attendee
            {
                Email = a.Email,
                Name = a.Name,
                Role = a.Role,
                Status = a.Status,
                IsOptional = a.IsOptional
            }).ToList(),
            MasterEventId = master.Id, // Link to master
            RecurrenceId = startTime, // Original start time of this occurrence
            CreatedBy = master.CreatedBy
        };
    }
    
    private int GetWeekOfMonth(DateTime date)
    {
        var firstDayOfMonth = new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, 1);
        var daysOffset = (int)firstDayOfMonth.DayOfWeek;
        var weekNumber = (date.Day + daysOffset - 1) / 7 + 1;
        return weekNumber;
    }
}
```

### 196.3 Common Recurrence Patterns

```csharp
public static class RecurrencePatterns
{
    // Every day
    public static RecurrenceRule Daily(int interval = 1, int? count = null)
    {
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Daily,
            Interval = interval,
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = $"FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL={interval}" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    // Every weekday (Monday-Friday)
    public static RecurrenceRule Weekdays(int? count = null)
    {
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly,
            Interval = 1,
            ByDay = new List<DayOfWeek>
            {
                DayOfWeek.Monday,
                DayOfWeek.Tuesday,
                DayOfWeek.Wednesday,
                DayOfWeek.Thursday,
                DayOfWeek.Friday
            },
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = "FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    // Every week on specific day(s)
    public static RecurrenceRule Weekly(
        List<DayOfWeek> days,
        int interval = 1,
        int? count = null)
    {
        var dayStrings = days.Select(d => FormatDayOfWeek(d));
        
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly,
            Interval = interval,
            ByDay = days,
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = $"FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL={interval};BYDAY={string.Join(",", dayStrings)}" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    // Monthly on specific day of month (e.g., 15th of each month)
    public static RecurrenceRule MonthlyByDay(
        int dayOfMonth,
        int interval = 1,
        int? count = null)
    {
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly,
            Interval = interval,
            ByMonthDay = new List<int> { dayOfMonth },
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = $"FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL={interval};BYMONTHDAY={dayOfMonth}" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    // Monthly on specific weekday (e.g., 2nd Tuesday of each month)
    public static RecurrenceRule MonthlyByWeekday(
        int weekNumber,
        DayOfWeek dayOfWeek,
        int interval = 1,
        int? count = null)
    {
        var dayString = FormatDayOfWeek(dayOfWeek);
        
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly,
            Interval = interval,
            ByDay = new List<DayOfWeek> { dayOfWeek },
            BySetPos = weekNumber,
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = $"FREQ=MONTHLY;INTERVAL={interval};BYDAY={dayString};BYSETPOS={weekNumber}" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    // Yearly on specific date
    public static RecurrenceRule Yearly(
        int month,
        int day,
        int interval = 1,
        int? count = null)
    {
        return new RecurrenceRule
        {
            Frequency = RecurrenceFrequency.Yearly,
            Interval = interval,
            ByMonth = new List<int> { month },
            ByMonthDay = new List<int> { day },
            EndCondition = count.HasValue
                ? new RecurrenceEnd { Type = RecurrenceEndType.Count, Count = count.Value }
                : null,
            RRule = $"FREQ=YEARLY;INTERVAL={interval};BYMONTH={month};BYMONTHDAY={day}" +
                   (count.HasValue ? $";COUNT={count}" : "")
        };
    }
    
    private static string FormatDayOfWeek(DayOfWeek day)
    {
        return day switch
        {
            DayOfWeek.Sunday => "SU",
            DayOfWeek.Monday => "MO",
            DayOfWeek.Tuesday => "TU",
            DayOfWeek.Wednesday => "WE",
            DayOfWeek.Thursday => "TH",
            DayOfWeek.Friday => "FR",
            DayOfWeek.Saturday => "SA",
            _ => throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid day: {day}")
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 197 - Time Zone Management**

### 197.1 Time Zone Service

```csharp
public class TimeZoneService : ITimeZoneService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, TimeZoneInfo> _timeZoneCache;
    
    public TimeZoneService()
    {
        _timeZoneCache = new Dictionary<string, TimeZoneInfo>();
        LoadTimeZones();
    }
    
    public DateTime ConvertToTimeZone(
        DateTime dateTime,
        string fromTimeZone,
        string toTimeZone)
    {
        var fromTz = GetTimeZone(fromTimeZone);
        var toTz = GetTimeZone(toTimeZone);
        
        // Convert to UTC first
        var utcTime = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(dateTime, fromTz);
        
        // Then convert to target time zone
        return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcTime, toTz);
    }
    
    public DateTime ConvertToUtc(DateTime dateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        var tz = GetTimeZone(timeZone);
        return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeToUtc(dateTime, tz);
    }
    
    public DateTime ConvertFromUtc(DateTime utcDateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        var tz = GetTimeZone(timeZone);
        return TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(utcDateTime, tz);
    }
    
    public string GetUserTimeZone(Guid userId)
    {
        // Get from user settings
        var userSettings = _userSettingsRepo.GetByUserId(userId);
        return userSettings?.TimeZone ?? "UTC";
    }
    
    public TimeZoneInfo GetTimeZone(string timeZoneId)
    {
        if (_timeZoneCache.TryGetValue(timeZoneId, out var tz))
            return tz;
        
        try
        {
            tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(timeZoneId);
            _timeZoneCache[timeZoneId] = tz;
            return tz;
        }
        catch (TimeZoneNotFoundException)
        {
            // Try IANA to Windows mapping
            var windowsId = TryMapIanaToWindows(timeZoneId);
            if (windowsId != null)
            {
                tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(windowsId);
                _timeZoneCache[timeZoneId] = tz;
                return tz;
            }
            
            throw new BusinessException($"Invalid time zone: {timeZoneId}");
        }
    }
    
    public List<TimeZoneDto> GetAllTimeZones()
    {
        return TimeZoneInfo.GetSystemTimeZones()
            .Select(tz => new TimeZoneDto
            {
                Id = tz.Id,
                DisplayName = tz.DisplayName,
                StandardName = tz.StandardName,
                UtcOffset = tz.BaseUtcOffset,
                SupportsDaylightSavingTime = tz.SupportsDaylightSavingTime
            })
            .OrderBy(tz => tz.UtcOffset)
            .ThenBy(tz => tz.DisplayName)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    public bool IsDaylightSavingTime(DateTime dateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        var tz = GetTimeZone(timeZone);
        return tz.IsDaylightSavingTime(dateTime);
    }
    
    public TimeSpan GetUtcOffset(DateTime dateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        var tz = GetTimeZone(timeZone);
        return tz.GetUtcOffset(dateTime);
    }
    
    private void LoadTimeZones()
    {
        // Pre-load commonly used time zones
        var commonTimeZones = new[]
        {
            "UTC",
            "America/New_York",
            "America/Chicago",
            "America/Denver",
            "America/Los_Angeles",
            "Europe/London",
            "Europe/Paris",
            "Asia/Tokyo",
            "Australia/Sydney"
        };
        
        foreach (var tzId in commonTimeZones)
        {
            try
            {
                var tz = TimeZoneInfo.FindSystemTimeZoneById(tzId);
                _timeZoneCache[tzId] = tz;
            }
            catch
            {
                // Ignore if not available
            }
        }
    }
    
    private string TryMapIanaToWindows(string ianaId)
    {
        // IANA to Windows time zone ID mapping
        var mapping = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["America/New_York"] = "Eastern Standard Time",
            ["America/Chicago"] = "Central Standard Time",
            ["America/Denver"] = "Mountain Standard Time",
            ["America/Los_Angeles"] = "Pacific Standard Time",
            ["Europe/London"] = "GMT Standard Time",
            ["Europe/Paris"] = "Romance Standard Time",
            ["Europe/Berlin"] = "W. Europe Standard Time",
            ["Asia/Tokyo"] = "Tokyo Standard Time",
            ["Asia/Shanghai"] = "China Standard Time",
            ["Australia/Sydney"] = "AUS Eastern Standard Time",
            // Add more mappings as needed
        };
        
        return mapping.TryGetValue(ianaId, out var windowsId) 
            ? windowsId 
            : null;
    }
}
```

### 197.2 Time Zone Aware Event Display

```csharp
public class EventDisplayService
{
    public EventDisplayDto FormatEventForUser(
        CalendarEvent evt,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var userTimeZone = _timeZoneService.GetUserTimeZone(userId);
        
        // Convert event times to user's time zone
        var userStartTime = _timeZoneService.ConvertToTimeZone(
            evt.StartTime,
            evt.TimeZone,
            userTimeZone);
        
        var userEndTime = _timeZoneService.ConvertToTimeZone(
            evt.EndTime,
            evt.TimeZone,
            userTimeZone);
        
        return new EventDisplayDto
        {
            Id = evt.Id,
            Title = evt.Title,
            StartTime = userStartTime,
            EndTime = userEndTime,
            TimeZone = userTimeZone,
            OriginalTimeZone = evt.TimeZone,
            FormattedStartTime = FormatDateTime(userStartTime, userTimeZone),
            FormattedEndTime = FormatDateTime(userEndTime, userTimeZone),
            TimeZoneAbbreviation = GetTimeZoneAbbreviation(userStartTime, userTimeZone),
            IsAllDay = evt.IsAllDay,
            Duration = evt.EndTime - evt.StartTime
        };
    }
    
    private string FormatDateTime(DateTime dateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        // Format: "Monday, December 9, 2025 at 2:30 PM EST"
        var dayOfWeek = dateTime.DayOfWeek.ToString();
        var monthName = dateTime.ToString("MMMM");
        var time = dateTime.ToString("h:mm tt");
        var tzAbbr = GetTimeZoneAbbreviation(dateTime, timeZone);
        
        return $"{dayOfWeek}, {monthName} {dateTime.Day}, {dateTime.Year} at {time} {tzAbbr}";
    }
    
    private string GetTimeZoneAbbreviation(DateTime dateTime, string timeZone)
    {
        var tz = _timeZoneService.GetTimeZone(timeZone);
        var isDst = tz.IsDaylightSavingTime(dateTime);
        
        // Common abbreviations
        return (tz.Id, isDst) switch
        {
            ("Eastern Standard Time", false) => "EST",
            ("Eastern Standard Time", true) => "EDT",
            ("Pacific Standard Time", false) => "PST",
            ("Pacific Standard Time", true) => "PDT",
            ("Central Standard Time", false) => "CST",
            ("Central Standard Time", true) => "CDT",
            ("Mountain Standard Time", false) => "MST",
            ("Mountain Standard Time", true) => "MDT",
            ("GMT Standard Time", _) => "GMT",
            ("UTC", _) => "UTC",
            _ => tz.StandardName
        };
    }
}
```
