## **Chapter 198 - Availability Management**

### 198.1 Availability Service

```csharp
public class AvailabilityService : IAvailabilityService
{
    public async Task<List<TimeSlot>> GetAvailableSlotsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        TimeSpan slotDuration,
        AvailabilityOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= new AvailabilityOptions();
        
        // Get user's calendar events
        var events = await GetUserEventsInRangeAsync(userId, startDate, endDate);
        
        // Get user's availability blocks
        var availabilityBlocks = await GetAvailabilityBlocksAsync(
            userId,
            startDate,
            endDate);
        
        // Get business hours
        var businessHours = await GetBusinessHoursAsync(userId);
        
        // Generate all possible slots within business hours
        var allSlots = GeneratePotentialSlots(
            startDate,
            endDate,
            slotDuration,
            businessHours);
        
        // Filter out slots that conflict with events
        var availableSlots = allSlots.Where(slot =>
        {
            // Check if slot conflicts with any event
            var hasConflict = events.Any(evt =>
                slot.StartTime < evt.EndTime &&
                slot.EndTime > evt.StartTime);
            
            if (hasConflict)
                return false;
            
            // Check availability blocks
            var block = availabilityBlocks.FirstOrDefault(b =>
                slot.StartTime >= b.StartTime &&
                slot.EndTime <= b.EndTime);
            
            if (block != null)
            {
                // Respect availability status
                if (block.Status == AvailabilityStatus.Busy ||
                    block.Status == AvailabilityStatus.OutOfOffice)
                    return false;
            }
            
            // Check buffer time
            if (options.BufferMinutes > 0)
            {
                var bufferBefore = slot.StartTime.AddMinutes(-options.BufferMinutes);
                var bufferAfter = slot.EndTime.AddMinutes(options.BufferMinutes);
                
                var hasBufferConflict = events.Any(evt =>
                    bufferBefore < evt.EndTime &&
                    bufferAfter > evt.StartTime);
                
                if (hasBufferConflict)
                    return false;
            }
            
            return true;
        }).ToList();
        
        return availableSlots;
    }
    
    public async Task<GroupAvailability> FindGroupAvailabilityAsync(
        List<Guid> userIds,
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        TimeSpan meetingDuration,
        GroupAvailabilityOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= new GroupAvailabilityOptions();
        
        // Get availability for each user
        var userAvailabilities = new Dictionary<Guid, List<TimeSlot>>();
        
        foreach (var userId in userIds)
        {
            var slots = await GetAvailableSlotsAsync(
                userId,
                startDate,
                endDate,
                meetingDuration,
                new AvailabilityOptions
                {
                    BufferMinutes = options.BufferMinutes
                });
            
            userAvailabilities[userId] = slots;
        }
        
        // Find common slots
        var commonSlots = FindCommonTimeSlots(
            userAvailabilities,
            options.RequireAllAttendees);
        
        return new GroupAvailability
        {
            RequestedUserIds = userIds,
            CommonSlots = commonSlots,
            UserAvailabilities = userAvailabilities,
            MeetingDuration = meetingDuration
        };
    }
    
    public async Task SetAvailabilityBlockAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateTime startTime,
        DateTime endTime,
        AvailabilityStatus status,
        string reason = null)
    {
        // Validate
        if (endTime <= startTime)
            throw new BusinessException("End time must be after start time");
        
        // Check for overlapping blocks
        var overlapping = await _availabilityRepo.Query()
            .Where(b => b.UserId == userId
                     && b.StartTime < endTime
                     && b.EndTime > startTime)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        if (overlapping.Any())
        {
            // Handle overlap based on priority
            await ResolveOverlappingBlocksAsync(
                overlapping,
                status,
                startTime,
                endTime);
        }
        
        // Create block
        var block = new AvailabilityBlock
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = userId,
            StartTime = startTime,
            EndTime = endTime,
            Status = status,
            Reason = reason,
            Priority = DeterminePriority(status)
        };
        
        await _availabilityRepo.InsertAsync(block);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new AvailabilityChangedEto
        {
            UserId = userId,
            StartTime = startTime,
            EndTime = endTime,
            Status = status
        });
    }
    
    private List<TimeSlot> GeneratePotentialSlots(
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        TimeSpan slotDuration,
        BusinessCalendar businessHours)
    {
        var slots = new List<TimeSlot>();
        var current = startDate.Date;
        
        while (current < endDate)
        {
            // Get working hours for this day
            var workingHours = businessHours.WorkingHours
                .FirstOrDefault(wh => wh.DayOfWeek == current.DayOfWeek);
            
            if (workingHours?.IsWorkingDay == true)
            {
                // Check if it's a holiday
                var isHoliday = businessHours.Holidays
                    .Any(h => h.Date.Date == current.Date);
                
                if (!isHoliday)
                {
                    // Generate slots for this working day
                    var dayStart = current.Date + workingHours.StartTime;
                    var dayEnd = current.Date + workingHours.EndTime;
                    var slotTime = dayStart;
                    
                    while (slotTime + slotDuration <= dayEnd)
                    {
                        slots.Add(new TimeSlot
                        {
                            StartTime = slotTime,
                            EndTime = slotTime + slotDuration
                        });
                        
                        slotTime += slotDuration;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            current = current.AddDays(1);
        }
        
        return slots;
    }
    
    private List<TimeSlot> FindCommonTimeSlots(
        Dictionary<Guid, List<TimeSlot>> userAvailabilities,
        bool requireAll)
    {
        if (!userAvailabilities.Any())
            return new List<TimeSlot>();
        
        // Start with first user's slots
        var commonSlots = userAvailabilities.First().Value.ToList();
        
        // Intersect with each other user's slots
        foreach (var userSlots in userAvailabilities.Values.Skip(1))
        {
            commonSlots = commonSlots
                .Where(slot => userSlots.Any(us =>
                    us.StartTime == slot.StartTime &&
                    us.EndTime == slot.EndTime))
                .ToList();
            
            if (!commonSlots.Any() && requireAll)
                break; // No common slots
        }
        
        return commonSlots;
    }
    
    private int DeterminePriority(AvailabilityStatus status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            AvailabilityStatus.OutOfOffice => 100,
            AvailabilityStatus.Busy => 75,
            AvailabilityStatus.Tentative => 50,
            AvailabilityStatus.Free => 25,
            _ => 0
        };
    }
}
```

### 198.2 Conflict Detection

```csharp
public class ConflictDetectionService : IConflictDetectionService
{
    public async Task<List<EventConflict>> DetectConflictsAsync(
        CalendarEvent newEvent)
    {
        var conflicts = new List<EventConflict>();
        
        // Get user's existing events
        var existingEvents = await GetUserEventsInRangeAsync(
            newEvent.CreatedBy.Value,
            newEvent.StartTime,
            newEvent.EndTime);
        
        foreach (var existing in existingEvents)
        {
            if (HasTimeOverlap(newEvent, existing))
            {
                conflicts.Add(new EventConflict
                {
                    ConflictingEventId = existing.Id,
                    ConflictingEventTitle = existing.Title,
                    ConflictingStartTime = existing.StartTime,
                    ConflictingEndTime = existing.EndTime,
                    ConflictType = DetermineConflictType(newEvent, existing),
                    Severity = DetermineConflictSeverity(newEvent, existing)
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Check attendee conflicts if applicable
        if (newEvent.Attendees?.Any() == true)
        {
            var attendeeConflicts = await DetectAttendeeConflictsAsync(newEvent);
            conflicts.AddRange(attendeeConflicts);
        }
        
        return conflicts;
    }
    
    public async Task<List<EventConflict>> DetectAttendeeConflictsAsync(
        CalendarEvent evt)
    {
        var conflicts = new List<EventConflict>();
        
        foreach (var attendee in evt.Attendees.Where(a => a.UserId.HasValue))
        {
            var attendeeEvents = await GetUserEventsInRangeAsync(
                attendee.UserId.Value,
                evt.StartTime,
                evt.EndTime);
            
            var conflictingEvents = attendeeEvents
                .Where(e => HasTimeOverlap(evt, e))
                .ToList();
            
            if (conflictingEvents.Any())
            {
                foreach (var conflicting in conflictingEvents)
                {
                    conflicts.Add(new EventConflict
                    {
                        ConflictingEventId = conflicting.Id,
                        ConflictingEventTitle = conflicting.Title,
                        ConflictingStartTime = conflicting.StartTime,
                        ConflictingEndTime = conflicting.EndTime,
                        ConflictingUserId = attendee.UserId.Value,
                        ConflictingUserName = attendee.Name,
                        ConflictType = ConflictType.AttendeeConflict,
                        Severity = ConflictSeverity.Medium
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        
        return conflicts;
    }
    
    private bool HasTimeOverlap(CalendarEvent evt1, CalendarEvent evt2)
    {
        // Convert to same time zone for comparison
        var evt1Start = _timeZoneService.ConvertToUtc(evt1.StartTime, evt1.TimeZone);
        var evt1End = _timeZoneService.ConvertToUtc(evt1.EndTime, evt1.TimeZone);
        var evt2Start = _timeZoneService.ConvertToUtc(evt2.StartTime, evt2.TimeZone);
        var evt2End = _timeZoneService.ConvertToUtc(evt2.EndTime, evt2.TimeZone);
        
        return evt1Start < evt2End && evt1End > evt2Start;
    }
    
    private ConflictType DetermineConflictType(
        CalendarEvent evt1,
        CalendarEvent evt2)
    {
        // Full overlap - one event completely contains the other
        if ((evt1.StartTime >= evt2.StartTime && evt1.EndTime <= evt2.EndTime) ||
            (evt2.StartTime >= evt1.StartTime && evt2.EndTime <= evt1.EndTime))
        {
            return ConflictType.FullOverlap;
        }
        
        // Partial overlap
        return ConflictType.PartialOverlap;
    }
    
    private ConflictSeverity DetermineConflictSeverity(
        CalendarEvent evt1,
        CalendarEvent evt2)
    {
        // Both are busy/confirmed
        if (evt1.Status == EventStatus.Confirmed &&
            evt2.Status == EventStatus.Confirmed)
        {
            return ConflictSeverity.High;
        }
        
        // One is tentative
        if (evt1.Status == EventStatus.Tentative ||
            evt2.Status == EventStatus.Tentative)
        {
            return ConflictSeverity.Medium;
        }
        
        return ConflictSeverity.Low;
    }
}
```

### 199.1 Business Calendar Service

```csharp
public class BusinessCalendarService : IBusinessCalendarService
{
    private readonly IBusinessCalendarRepository _calendarRepo;
    private readonly IHolidayRepository _holidayRepo;
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepo;
    
    public async Task<BusinessCalendar> CreateBusinessCalendarAsync(
        CreateBusinessCalendarCommand command)
    {
        var calendar = new BusinessCalendar
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId.Value,
            Name = command.Name,
            TimeZone = command.TimeZone ?? "UTC",
            WorkingHours = command.WorkingHours ?? GetDefaultWorkingHours(),
            Holidays = new List<Holiday>()
        };
        
        // Validate
        ValidateBusinessCalendar(calendar);
        
        await _calendarRepo.InsertAsync(calendar);
        
        return calendar;
    }
    
    public async Task<BusinessCalendar> GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync()
    {
        var tenantId = _currentUser.TenantId.Value;
        
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.Query()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.TenantId == tenantId && c.IsDefault);
        
        if (calendar == null)
        {
            // Create default calendar
            calendar = await CreateDefaultBusinessCalendarAsync(tenantId);
        }
        
        return calendar;
    }
    
    public async Task SetWorkingHoursAsync(
        Guid calendarId,
        List<WorkingHours> workingHours)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        // Validate
        ValidateWorkingHours(workingHours);
        
        calendar.WorkingHours = workingHours;
        
        await _calendarRepo.UpdateAsync(calendar);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new WorkingHoursChangedEto
        {
            CalendarId = calendarId,
            TenantId = calendar.TenantId
        });
    }
    
    public async Task AddHolidayAsync(
        Guid calendarId,
        string name,
        DateTime date,
        HolidayType type,
        bool isRecurring = false)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        var holiday = new Holiday
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Name = name,
            Date = date.Date,
            Type = type,
            IsRecurring = isRecurring
        };
        
        calendar.Holidays ??= new List<Holiday>();
        calendar.Holidays.Add(holiday);
        
        await _calendarRepo.UpdateAsync(calendar);
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new HolidayAddedEto
        {
            CalendarId = calendarId,
            HolidayName = name,
            Date = date,
            TenantId = calendar.TenantId
        });
    }
    
    public async Task ImportHolidaysAsync(
        Guid calendarId,
        string countryCode,
        int year)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        // Get holidays from external service or predefined list
        var holidays = await _holidayProvider.GetHolidaysAsync(countryCode, year);
        
        foreach (var holiday in holidays)
        {
            // Check if already exists
            var exists = calendar.Holidays?.Any(h =>
                h.Date.Date == holiday.Date.Date &&
                h.Name == holiday.Name) ?? false;
            
            if (!exists)
            {
                calendar.Holidays ??= new List<Holiday>();
                calendar.Holidays.Add(holiday);
            }
        }
        
        await _calendarRepo.UpdateAsync(calendar);
    }
    
    private List<WorkingHours> GetDefaultWorkingHours()
    {
        return new List<WorkingHours>
        {
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(9, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(17, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = true
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Tuesday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(9, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(17, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = true
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Wednesday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(9, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(17, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = true
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Thursday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(9, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(17, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = true
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Friday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(9, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(17, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = true
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Saturday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = false
            },
            new WorkingHours
            {
                DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Sunday,
                StartTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0),
                EndTime = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0),
                IsWorkingDay = false
            }
        };
    }
    
    private void ValidateWorkingHours(List<WorkingHours> workingHours)
    {
        // Must have entry for all 7 days
        if (workingHours.Count != 7)
            throw new ValidationException("Must specify working hours for all 7 days");
        
        // Must not have duplicates
        var distinctDays = workingHours.Select(wh => wh.DayOfWeek).Distinct().Count();
        if (distinctDays != 7)
            throw new ValidationException("Cannot have duplicate days");
        
        foreach (var wh in workingHours.Where(w => w.IsWorkingDay))
        {
            if (wh.EndTime <= wh.StartTime)
                throw new ValidationException(
                    $"End time must be after start time for {wh.DayOfWeek}");
            
            if (wh.StartTime < TimeSpan.Zero || wh.StartTime >= TimeSpan.FromHours(24))
                throw new ValidationException(
                    $"Invalid start time for {wh.DayOfWeek}");
            
            if (wh.EndTime <= TimeSpan.Zero || wh.EndTime > TimeSpan.FromHours(24))
                throw new ValidationException(
                    $"Invalid end time for {wh.DayOfWeek}");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateBusinessCalendar(BusinessCalendar calendar)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(calendar.Name))
            throw new ValidationException("Calendar name is required");
        
        if (calendar.WorkingHours == null || !calendar.WorkingHours.Any())
            throw new ValidationException("Working hours must be specified");
        
        ValidateWorkingHours(calendar.WorkingHours);
    }
}
```

### 199.2 Working Day Calculations

```csharp
public class WorkingDayCalculator
{
    private readonly IBusinessCalendarService _calendarService;
    
    public async Task<DateTime> AddWorkingDaysAsync(
        DateTime startDate,
        int workingDays,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        var calendar = calendarId.HasValue
            ? await _calendarService.GetAsync(calendarId.Value)
            : await _calendarService.GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync();
        
        var current = startDate.Date;
        var daysAdded = 0;
        var direction = workingDays >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
        var targetDays = Math.Abs(workingDays);
        
        while (daysAdded < targetDays)
        {
            current = current.AddDays(direction);
            
            if (IsWorkingDay(current, calendar))
            {
                daysAdded++;
            }
        }
        
        // Preserve time component
        return current.Date + startDate.TimeOfDay;
    }
    
    public async Task<int> GetWorkingDaysBetweenAsync(
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        var calendar = calendarId.HasValue
            ? await _calendarService.GetAsync(calendarId.Value)
            : await _calendarService.GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync();
        
        if (startDate > endDate)
        {
            var temp = startDate;
            startDate = endDate;
            endDate = temp;
        }
        
        var workingDays = 0;
        var current = startDate.Date;
        
        while (current <= endDate.Date)
        {
            if (IsWorkingDay(current, calendar))
            {
                workingDays++;
            }
            
            current = current.AddDays(1);
        }
        
        return workingDays;
    }
    
    public async Task<DateTime> GetNextWorkingDayAsync(
        DateTime date,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        return await AddWorkingDaysAsync(date, 1, calendarId);
    }
    
    public async Task<DateTime> GetPreviousWorkingDayAsync(
        DateTime date,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        return await AddWorkingDaysAsync(date, -1, calendarId);
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> IsWorkingDayAsync(
        DateTime date,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        var calendar = calendarId.HasValue
            ? await _calendarService.GetAsync(calendarId.Value)
            : await _calendarService.GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync();
        
        return IsWorkingDay(date, calendar);
    }
    
    public async Task<TimeSpan> GetWorkingHoursInPeriodAsync(
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        var calendar = calendarId.HasValue
            ? await _calendarService.GetAsync(calendarId.Value)
            : await _calendarService.GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync();
        
        var totalHours = TimeSpan.Zero;
        var current = startDate.Date;
        
        while (current <= endDate.Date)
        {
            if (IsWorkingDay(current, calendar))
            {
                var workingHours = calendar.WorkingHours
                    .First(wh => wh.DayOfWeek == current.DayOfWeek);
                
                var dayStart = current + workingHours.StartTime;
                var dayEnd = current + workingHours.EndTime;
                
                // Clip to requested range
                if (dayStart < startDate)
                    dayStart = startDate;
                
                if (dayEnd > endDate)
                    dayEnd = endDate;
                
                if (dayEnd > dayStart)
                {
                    totalHours += dayEnd - dayStart;
                }
            }
            
            current = current.AddDays(1);
        }
        
        return totalHours;
    }
    
    public async Task<DateTime> GetEndOfWorkingDayAsync(
        DateTime date,
        Guid? calendarId = null)
    {
        var calendar = calendarId.HasValue
            ? await _calendarService.GetAsync(calendarId.Value)
            : await _calendarService.GetTenantBusinessCalendarAsync();
        
        var workingHours = calendar.WorkingHours
            .FirstOrDefault(wh => wh.DayOfWeek == date.DayOfWeek);
        
        if (workingHours == null || !workingHours.IsWorkingDay)
            throw new BusinessException($"{date.DayOfWeek} is not a working day");
        
        return date.Date + workingHours.EndTime;
    }
    
    private bool IsWorkingDay(DateTime date, BusinessCalendar calendar)
    {
        // Check if it's a working day of week
        var workingHours = calendar.WorkingHours
            .FirstOrDefault(wh => wh.DayOfWeek == date.DayOfWeek);
        
        if (workingHours == null || !workingHours.IsWorkingDay)
            return false;
        
        // Check if it's a holiday
        var isHoliday = calendar.Holidays?.Any(h =>
        {
            if (h.IsRecurring)
            {
                // Recurring holiday - match month and day
                return h.Date.Month == date.Month && h.Date.Day == date.Day;
            }
            else
            {
                // One-time holiday - exact date match
                return h.Date.Date == date.Date;
            }
        }) ?? false;
        
        return !isHoliday;
    }
}
```

### 199.3 Holiday Provider

```csharp
public class HolidayProvider : IHolidayProvider
{
    // Predefined holidays for common countries
    private static readonly Dictionary<string, List<HolidayDefinition>> _holidayDefinitions = 
        new Dictionary<string, List<HolidayDefinition>>
    {
        ["US"] = new List<HolidayDefinition>
        {
            new() { Name = "New Year's Day", Month = 1, Day = 1, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Independence Day", Month = 7, Day = 4, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Christmas Day", Month = 12, Day = 25, Type = HolidayType.National },
            // Martin Luther King Jr. Day - 3rd Monday of January
            new() { Name = "Martin Luther King Jr. Day", Month = 1, WeekOfMonth = 3, 
                   DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday, Type = HolidayType.National },
            // Presidents' Day - 3rd Monday of February
            new() { Name = "Presidents' Day", Month = 2, WeekOfMonth = 3,
                   DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday, Type = HolidayType.National },
            // Memorial Day - Last Monday of May
            new() { Name = "Memorial Day", Month = 5, WeekOfMonth = -1,
                   DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday, Type = HolidayType.National },
            // Labor Day - 1st Monday of September
            new() { Name = "Labor Day", Month = 9, WeekOfMonth = 1,
                   DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Monday, Type = HolidayType.National },
            // Thanksgiving - 4th Thursday of November
            new() { Name = "Thanksgiving Day", Month = 11, WeekOfMonth = 4,
                   DayOfWeek = DayOfWeek.Thursday, Type = HolidayType.National },
        },
        
        ["GB"] = new List<HolidayDefinition>
        {
            new() { Name = "New Year's Day", Month = 1, Day = 1, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Christmas Day", Month = 12, Day = 25, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Boxing Day", Month = 12, Day = 26, Type = HolidayType.National },
        },
        
        ["CA"] = new List<HolidayDefinition>
        {
            new() { Name = "New Year's Day", Month = 1, Day = 1, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Canada Day", Month = 7, Day = 1, Type = HolidayType.National },
            new() { Name = "Christmas Day", Month = 12, Day = 25, Type = HolidayType.National },
        }
    };
    
    public async Task<List<Holiday>> GetHolidaysAsync(string countryCode, int year)
    {
        if (!_holidayDefinitions.TryGetValue(countryCode, out var definitions))
        {
            // Try to fetch from external API if available
            return await FetchFromExternalApiAsync(countryCode, year);
        }
        
        var holidays = new List<Holiday>();
        
        foreach (var definition in definitions)
        {
            var date = CalculateHolidayDate(definition, year);
            
            holidays.Add(new Holiday
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Name = definition.Name,
                Date = date,
                Type = definition.Type,
                IsRecurring = true
            });
        }
        
        return holidays;
    }
    
    private DateTime CalculateHolidayDate(HolidayDefinition definition, int year)
    {
        if (definition.Day.HasValue)
        {
            // Fixed date holiday
            return new DateTime(year, definition.Month, definition.Day.Value);
        }
        
        if (definition.WeekOfMonth.HasValue && definition.DayOfWeek.HasValue)
        {
            // Nth weekday of month
            return GetNthWeekdayOfMonth(
                year,
                definition.Month,
                definition.DayOfWeek.Value,
                definition.WeekOfMonth.Value);
        }
        
        throw new InvalidOperationException("Invalid holiday definition");
    }
    
    private DateTime GetNthWeekdayOfMonth(
        int year,
        int month,
        DayOfWeek targetDayOfWeek,
        int weekNumber)
    {
        if (weekNumber == -1)
        {
            // Last occurrence in month
            var lastDay = new DateTime(year, month, 
                DateTime.DaysInMonth(year, month));
            
            while (lastDay.DayOfWeek != targetDayOfWeek)
            {
                lastDay = lastDay.AddDays(-1);
            }
            
            return lastDay;
        }
        else
        {
            // Nth occurrence in month
            var firstDay = new DateTime(year, month, 1);
            var firstTargetDay = firstDay;
            
            while (firstTargetDay.DayOfWeek != targetDayOfWeek)
            {
                firstTargetDay = firstTargetDay.AddDays(1);
            }
            
            return firstTargetDay.AddDays(7 * (weekNumber - 1));
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<List<Holiday>> FetchFromExternalApiAsync(
        string countryCode,
        int year)
    {
        // Placeholder for external API integration
        // Could integrate with services like:
        // - Calendarific API
        // - Abstract API Holidays
        // - Nager.Date API
        
        return new List<Holiday>();
    }
}

public class HolidayDefinition
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public int Month { get; set; }
    public int? Day { get; set; }
    public int? WeekOfMonth { get; set; } // 1-4 for 1st-4th, -1 for last
    public DayOfWeek? DayOfWeek { get; set; }
    public HolidayType Type { get; set; }
}
```

## **Chapter 200 - Meeting Scheduling**

### 200.1 Meeting Scheduler Service

```csharp
public class MeetingSchedulerService : IMeetingSchedulerService
{
    private readonly IAvailabilityService _availabilityService;
    private readonly IEventService _eventService;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    
    public async Task<MeetingScheduleResult> ScheduleMeetingAsync(
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command)
    {
        // Validate attendees
        var attendees = await ValidateAttendeesAsync(command.AttendeeEmails);
        
        if (command.PreferredTimeSlots?.Any() == true)
        {
            // User provided preferred times
            return await ScheduleWithPreferredTimesAsync(command, attendees);
        }
        else
        {
            // Find best available time
            return await FindAndScheduleBestTimeAsync(command, attendees);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<MeetingScheduleResult> ScheduleWithPreferredTimesAsync(
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command,
        List<User> attendees)
    {
        foreach (var preferredSlot in command.PreferredTimeSlots)
        {
            // Check if all required attendees are available
            var availability = await _availabilityService.FindGroupAvailabilityAsync(
                attendees.Select(a => a.Id).ToList(),
                preferredSlot.StartTime,
                preferredSlot.EndTime,
                preferredSlot.EndTime - preferredSlot.StartTime,
                new GroupAvailabilityOptions
                {
                    RequireAllAttendees = true,
                    BufferMinutes = command.BufferMinutes ?? 0
                });
            
            if (availability.CommonSlots.Any())
            {
                // Found a time that works - create the event
                var evt = await CreateMeetingEventAsync(
                    command,
                    attendees,
                    preferredSlot.StartTime,
                    preferredSlot.EndTime);
                
                return new MeetingScheduleResult
                {
                    Success = true,
                    EventId = evt.Id,
                    ScheduledStartTime = evt.StartTime,
                    ScheduledEndTime = evt.EndTime,
                    ConflictingAttendees = new List<AttendeeConflict>()
                };
            }
        }
        
        // None of the preferred times work
        return await HandleNoAvailableTimesAsync(command, attendees);
    }
    
    private async Task<MeetingScheduleResult> FindAndScheduleBestTimeAsync(
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command,
        List<User> attendees)
    {
        var startDate = command.SearchStartDate ?? DateTime.UtcNow;
        var endDate = command.SearchEndDate ?? startDate.AddDays(14);
        var duration = command.Duration;
        
        // Get group availability
        var availability = await _availabilityService.FindGroupAvailabilityAsync(
            attendees.Select(a => a.Id).ToList(),
            startDate,
            endDate,
            duration,
            new GroupAvailabilityOptions
            {
                RequireAllAttendees = !command.AllowPartialAvailability,
                BufferMinutes = command.BufferMinutes ?? 15
            });
        
        if (!availability.CommonSlots.Any())
        {
            return await HandleNoAvailableTimesAsync(command, attendees);
        }
        
        // Score and rank available slots
        var scoredSlots = await ScoreAvailableSlotsAsync(
            availability.CommonSlots,
            command,
            attendees);
        
        // Pick best slot
        var bestSlot = scoredSlots.OrderByDescending(s => s.Score).First();
        
        // Create meeting
        var evt = await CreateMeetingEventAsync(
            command,
            attendees,
            bestSlot.Slot.StartTime,
            bestSlot.Slot.EndTime);
        
        return new MeetingScheduleResult
        {
            Success = true,
            EventId = evt.Id,
            ScheduledStartTime = evt.StartTime,
            ScheduledEndTime = evt.EndTime,
            Score = bestSlot.Score,
            AlternativeSlots = scoredSlots
                .OrderByDescending(s => s.Score)
                .Skip(1)
                .Take(5)
                .Select(s => s.Slot)
                .ToList()
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<List<ScoredTimeSlot>> ScoreAvailableSlotsAsync(
        List<TimeSlot> slots,
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command,
        List<User> attendees)
    {
        var scored = new List<ScoredTimeSlot>();
        
        foreach (var slot in slots)
        {
            double score = 0;
            
            // Prefer earlier times over later times
            var hoursFromStart = (slot.StartTime - command.SearchStartDate.Value).TotalHours;
            score += Math.Max(0, 100 - hoursFromStart);
            
            // Prefer mid-morning or mid-afternoon
            var hour = slot.StartTime.Hour;
            if (hour >= 10 && hour <= 11) // Mid-morning
                score += 50;
            else if (hour >= 14 && hour <= 15) // Mid-afternoon
                score += 40;
            else if (hour >= 9 && hour <= 16) // Normal working hours
                score += 20;
            
            // Avoid start/end of day
            if (hour < 9 || hour > 16)
                score -= 30;
            
            // Prefer specific days if specified
            if (command.PreferredDaysOfWeek?.Any() == true)
            {
                if (command.PreferredDaysOfWeek.Contains(slot.StartTime.DayOfWeek))
                    score += 30;
            }
            
            // Prefer round hours
            if (slot.StartTime.Minute == 0)
                score += 10;
            else if (slot.StartTime.Minute == 30)
                score += 5;
            
            // Check if it's immediately after lunch (less preferred)
            if (hour == 13 && slot.StartTime.Minute == 0)
                score -= 10;
            
            scored.Add(new ScoredTimeSlot
            {
                Slot = slot,
                Score = score
            });
        }
        
        return scored;
    }
    
    private async Task<CalendarEvent> CreateMeetingEventAsync(
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command,
        List<User> attendees,
        DateTime startTime,
        DateTime endTime)
    {
        var createCommand = new CreateEventCommand
        {
            CalendarId = command.OrganizerCalendarId,
            Title = command.Title,
            Description = command.Description,
            StartTime = startTime,
            EndTime = endTime,
            TimeZone = command.TimeZone,
            Location = command.Location,
            MeetingUrl = command.GenerateMeetingUrl 
                ? await GenerateMeetingUrlAsync() 
                : command.MeetingUrl,
            Attendees = attendees.Select(a => new AttendeeDto
            {
                Email = a.Email,
                Name = a.FullName,
                Role = a.Id == command.OrganizerId 
                    ? AttendeeRole.Organizer 
                    : AttendeeRole.Attendee,
                IsOptional = command.OptionalAttendeeEmails?.Contains(a.Email) ?? false
            }).ToList(),
            Reminders = new List<ReminderDto>
            {
                new ReminderDto
                {
                    Type = ReminderType.BeforeStart,
                    MinutesBefore = 15,
                    Method = ReminderMethod.Notification
                }
            }
        };
        
        return await _eventService.CreateEventAsync(createCommand);
    }
    
    private async Task<MeetingScheduleResult> HandleNoAvailableTimesAsync(
        ScheduleMeetingCommand command,
        List<User> attendees)
    {
        // Find conflicts for each attendee
        var conflicts = new List<AttendeeConflict>();
        
        var searchStart = command.SearchStartDate ?? DateTime.UtcNow;
        var searchEnd = command.SearchEndDate ?? searchStart.AddDays(14);
        
        foreach (var attendee in attendees)
        {
            var availability = await _availabilityService.GetAvailableSlotsAsync(
                attendee.Id,
                searchStart,
                searchEnd,
                command.Duration);
            
            if (!availability.Any())
            {
                conflicts.Add(new AttendeeConflict
                {
                    UserId = attendee.Id,
                    UserName = attendee.FullName,
                    Email = attendee.Email,
                    Reason = "No availability in requested time range",
                    NextAvailableSlot = await FindNextAvailabilityAsync(
                        attendee.Id,
                        searchEnd,
                        command.Duration)
                });
            }
        }
        
        return new MeetingScheduleResult
        {
            Success = false,
            ConflictingAttendees = conflicts,
            SuggestedAction = conflicts.Count == attendees.Count
                ? "No attendees are available. Consider extending search window."
                : "Some attendees have conflicts. Consider making them optional or finding alternative times.",
            AlternativeSlots = await FindPartialAvailabilitySlotsAsync(
                attendees,
                searchStart,
                searchEnd,
                command.Duration)
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<TimeSlot> FindNextAvailabilityAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateTime afterDate,
        TimeSpan duration)
    {
        // Search next 60 days
        var slots = await _availabilityService.GetAvailableSlotsAsync(
            userId,
            afterDate,
            afterDate.AddDays(60),
            duration);
        
        return slots.FirstOrDefault();
    }
    
    private async Task<List<TimeSlot>> FindPartialAvailabilitySlotsAsync(
        List<User> attendees,
        DateTime startDate,
        DateTime endDate,
        TimeSpan duration)
    {
        // Find slots where at least 80% of attendees are available
        var threshold = (int)Math.Ceiling(attendees.Count * 0.8);
        
        var availability = await _availabilityService.FindGroupAvailabilityAsync(
            attendees.Select(a => a.Id).ToList(),
            startDate,
            endDate,
            duration,
            new GroupAvailabilityOptions
            {
                RequireAllAttendees = false,
                MinimumAttendees = threshold
            });
        
        return availability.CommonSlots
            .OrderBy(s => s.StartTime)
            .Take(5)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private async Task<string> GenerateMeetingUrlAsync()
    {
        // Integration with video conferencing services
        // Could integrate with: Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, etc.
        
        // Placeholder implementation
        return $"https://meet.example.com/{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
    }
}
```

### 200.2 Meeting Poll Service

```csharp
public class MeetingPollService : IMeetingPollService
{
    public async Task<MeetingPoll> CreatePollAsync(CreateMeetingPollCommand command)
    {
        var poll = new MeetingPoll
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = command.Title,
            Description = command.Description,
            OrganizerId = _currentUser.UserId.Value,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ExpiresAt = command.ExpiresAt ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(7),
            Status = MeetingPollStatus.Open,
            TimeSlots = command.ProposedTimeSlots.Select(ts => new PollTimeSlot
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                StartTime = ts.StartTime,
                EndTime = ts.EndTime,
                Votes = new List<PollVote>()
            }).ToList(),
            Participants = command.ParticipantEmails.Select(email => new PollParticipant
            {
                Email = email,
                HasVoted = false,
                ResponseToken = GenerateResponseToken()
            }).ToList()
        };
        
        await _pollRepo.InsertAsync(poll);
        
        // Send poll invitations
        await SendPollInvitationsAsync(poll);
        
        return poll;
    }
    
    public async Task VoteAsync(Guid pollId, string responseToken, List<Guid> selectedSlotIds)
    {
        var poll = await _pollRepo.GetAsync(pollId);
        
        if (poll.Status != MeetingPollStatus.Open)
            throw new BusinessException("Poll is closed");
        
        if (DateTime.UtcNow > poll.ExpiresAt)
            throw new BusinessException("Poll has expired");
        
        var participant = poll.Participants
            .FirstOrDefault(p => p.ResponseToken == responseToken);
        
        if (participant == null)
            throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid response token");
        
        if (participant.HasVoted && !poll.AllowChangeVote)
            throw new BusinessException("You have already voted");
        
        // Clear previous votes if changing
        foreach (var slot in poll.TimeSlots)
        {
            slot.Votes.RemoveAll(v => v.ParticipantEmail == participant.Email);
        }
        
        // Record new votes
        foreach (var slotId in selectedSlotIds)
        {
            var slot = poll.TimeSlots.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == slotId);
            if (slot != null)
            {
                slot.Votes.Add(new PollVote
                {
                    ParticipantEmail = participant.Email,
                    VotedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }
        
        participant.HasVoted = true;
        participant.VotedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        await _pollRepo.UpdateAsync(poll);
        
        // Check if all participants have voted
        if (poll.Participants.All(p => p.HasVoted) && poll.AutoFinalize)
        {
            await FinalizePollAsync(pollId);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<MeetingPollResults> GetPollResultsAsync(Guid pollId)
    {
        var poll = await _pollRepo.GetAsync(pollId);
        
        var results = new MeetingPollResults
        {
            PollId = poll.Id,
            Title = poll.Title,
            Status = poll.Status,
            TotalParticipants = poll.Participants.Count,
            ParticipantsVoted = poll.Participants.Count(p => p.HasVoted),
            TimeSlotResults = poll.TimeSlots.Select(slot => new TimeSlotResult
            {
                SlotId = slot.Id,
                StartTime = slot.StartTime,
                EndTime = slot.EndTime,
                VoteCount = slot.Votes.Count,
                VotePercentage = poll.Participants.Count > 0
                    ? (double)slot.Votes.Count / poll.Participants.Count * 100
                    : 0,
                Voters = slot.Votes.Select(v => v.ParticipantEmail).ToList()
            })
            .OrderByDescending(r => r.VoteCount)
            .ToList()
        };
        
        // Identify best slot(s)
        var maxVotes = results.TimeSlotResults.Max(r => r.VoteCount);
        results.BestSlots = results.TimeSlotResults
            .Where(r => r.VoteCount == maxVotes)
            .ToList();
        
        return results;
    }
    
    public async Task FinalizePollAsync(Guid pollId)
    {
        var poll = await _pollRepo.GetAsync(pollId);
        
        if (poll.Status != MeetingPollStatus.Open)
            throw new BusinessException("Poll is already finalized");
        
        var results = await GetPollResultsAsync(pollId);
        
        if (!results.BestSlots.Any())
            throw new BusinessException("No votes received");
        
        // Select the best slot (highest votes, earliest time if tie)
        var selectedSlot = results.BestSlots
            .OrderBy(s => s.StartTime)
            .First();
        
        poll.Status = MeetingPollStatus.Finalized;
        poll.SelectedTimeSlotId = selectedSlot.SlotId;
        poll.FinalizedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        await _pollRepo.UpdateAsync(poll);
        
        // Create the actual meeting event
        var timeSlot = poll.TimeSlots.First(ts => ts.Id == selectedSlot.SlotId);
        
        await _meetingScheduler.ScheduleMeetingAsync(new ScheduleMeetingCommand
        {
            Title = poll.Title,
            Description = poll.Description,
            OrganizerId = poll.OrganizerId,
            AttendeeEmails = poll.Participants.Select(p => p.Email).ToList(),
            PreferredTimeSlots = new List<TimeSlot>
            {
                new TimeSlot
                {
                    StartTime = timeSlot.StartTime,
                    EndTime = timeSlot.EndTime
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Notify participants
        await NotifyPollFinalizedAsync(poll, selectedSlot);
    }
    
    private async Task SendPollInvitationsAsync(MeetingPoll poll)
    {
        foreach (var participant in poll.Participants)
        {
            await _notificationService.SendAsync(new MeetingPollInvitationNotification
            {
                PollId = poll.Id,
                Title = poll.Title,
                Description = poll.Description,
                OrganizerName = await GetUserNameAsync(poll.OrganizerId),
                ParticipantEmail = participant.Email,
                VoteUrl = GenerateVoteUrl(poll.Id, participant.ResponseToken),
                ExpiresAt = poll.ExpiresAt,
                TimeSlots = poll.TimeSlots.Select(ts => new
                {
                    ts.StartTime,
                    ts.EndTime
                }).ToList()
            });
        }
    }
    
    private string GenerateResponseToken()
    {
        return Convert.ToBase64String(
            System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(32));
    }
    
    private string GenerateVoteUrl(Guid pollId, string token)
    {
        return $"https://app.example.com/meeting-poll/{pollId}/vote?token={token}";
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 201 - Calendar Integration**

### 201.1 External Calendar Sync Service

```csharp
public class CalendarSyncService : ICalendarSyncService
{
    private readonly ICalendarRepository _calendarRepo;
    private readonly IEventRepository _eventRepo;
    private readonly IExternalCalendarProviderFactory _providerFactory;
    
    public async Task<CalendarSyncConnection> ConnectExternalCalendarAsync(
        ConnectExternalCalendarCommand command)
    {
        // Get provider for calendar type
        var provider = _providerFactory.GetProvider(command.ProviderType);
        
        // Authenticate and get access token
        var authResult = await provider.AuthenticateAsync(
            command.AuthorizationCode,
            command.RedirectUri);
        
        if (!authResult.Success)
            throw new BusinessException("Failed to authenticate with calendar provider");
        
        // Create sync connection
        var connection = new CalendarSyncConnection
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = _currentUser.UserId.Value,
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId.Value,
            ProviderType = command.ProviderType,
            ExternalCalendarId = command.ExternalCalendarId,
            AccessToken = await _encryption.EncryptAsync(authResult.AccessToken),
            RefreshToken = await _encryption.EncryptAsync(authResult.RefreshToken),
            TokenExpiresAt = authResult.ExpiresAt,
            SyncDirection = command.SyncDirection,
            IsActive = true,
            LastSyncAt = null,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        await _syncConnectionRepo.InsertAsync(connection);
        
        // Perform initial sync
        await PerformInitialSyncAsync(connection);
        
        return connection;
    }
    
    public async Task SyncCalendarAsync(Guid connectionId)
    {
        var connection = await _syncConnectionRepo.GetAsync(connectionId);
        
        if (!connection.IsActive)
            throw new BusinessException("Sync connection is not active");
        
        // Refresh token if needed
        if (connection.TokenExpiresAt <= DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(5))
        {
            await RefreshAccessTokenAsync(connection);
        }
        
        var provider = _providerFactory.GetProvider(connection.ProviderType);
        
        try
        {
            if (connection.SyncDirection == SyncDirection.Import ||
                connection.SyncDirection == SyncDirection.TwoWay)
            {
                await ImportEventsAsync(connection, provider);
            }
            
            if (connection.SyncDirection == SyncDirection.Export ||
                connection.SyncDirection == SyncDirection.TwoWay)
            {
                await ExportEventsAsync(connection, provider);
            }
            
            connection.LastSyncAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            connection.LastSyncStatus = SyncStatus.Success;
            connection.ConsecutiveFailures = 0;
            
            await _syncConnectionRepo.UpdateAsync(connection);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            connection.LastSyncStatus = SyncStatus.Failed;
            connection.LastSyncError = ex.Message;
            connection.ConsecutiveFailures++;
            
            await _syncConnectionRepo.UpdateAsync(connection);
            
            // Disable if too many failures
            if (connection.ConsecutiveFailures >= 5)
            {
                connection.IsActive = false;
                await _syncConnectionRepo.UpdateAsync(connection);
                
                await NotifySyncFailureAsync(connection);
            }
            
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ImportEventsAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        IExternalCalendarProvider provider)
    {
        var accessToken = await _encryption.DecryptAsync(connection.AccessToken);
        
        // Get changes since last sync
        var since = connection.LastSyncAt ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);
        
        var externalEvents = await provider.GetEventsAsync(
            accessToken,
            connection.ExternalCalendarId,
            since);
        
        foreach (var externalEvent in externalEvents)
        {
            // Check if event already exists
            var existingMapping = await _syncMappingRepo.Query()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(m => m.ConnectionId == connection.Id &&
                                        m.ExternalEventId == externalEvent.Id);
            
            if (existingMapping != null)
            {
                // Update existing event
                if (externalEvent.LastModified > existingMapping.LastSyncedAt)
                {
                    await UpdateImportedEventAsync(
                        existingMapping.LocalEventId,
                        externalEvent);
                    
                    existingMapping.LastSyncedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    await _syncMappingRepo.UpdateAsync(existingMapping);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Create new event
                var localEvent = await CreateImportedEventAsync(
                    connection,
                    externalEvent);
                
                // Create mapping
                await _syncMappingRepo.InsertAsync(new SyncMapping
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    ConnectionId = connection.Id,
                    LocalEventId = localEvent.Id,
                    ExternalEventId = externalEvent.Id,
                    LastSyncedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ExportEventsAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        IExternalCalendarProvider provider)
    {
        var accessToken = await _encryption.DecryptAsync(connection.AccessToken);
        
        // Get local events modified since last sync
        var since = connection.LastSyncAt ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30);
        
        var localEvents = await _eventRepo.Query()
            .Where(e => e.CalendarId == connection.LocalCalendarId &&
                       e.ModifiedAt > since)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var localEvent in localEvents)
        {
            // Check if event already synced
            var existingMapping = await _syncMappingRepo.Query()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(m => m.ConnectionId == connection.Id &&
                                        m.LocalEventId == localEvent.Id);
            
            if (existingMapping != null)
            {
                // Update external event
                await provider.UpdateEventAsync(
                    accessToken,
                    connection.ExternalCalendarId,
                    existingMapping.ExternalEventId,
                    MapToExternalEvent(localEvent));
                
                existingMapping.LastSyncedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await _syncMappingRepo.UpdateAsync(existingMapping);
            }
            else
            {
                // Create external event
                var externalEventId = await provider.CreateEventAsync(
                    accessToken,
                    connection.ExternalCalendarId,
                    MapToExternalEvent(localEvent));
                
                // Create mapping
                await _syncMappingRepo.InsertAsync(new SyncMapping
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    ConnectionId = connection.Id,
                    LocalEventId = localEvent.Id,
                    ExternalEventId = externalEventId,
                    LastSyncedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<CalendarEvent> CreateImportedEventAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        ExternalCalendarEvent externalEvent)
    {
        var evt = new CalendarEvent
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CalendarId = connection.LocalCalendarId,
            Title = externalEvent.Title,
            Description = externalEvent.Description,
            StartTime = externalEvent.StartTime,
            EndTime = externalEvent.EndTime,
            TimeZone = externalEvent.TimeZone ?? "UTC",
            IsAllDay = externalEvent.IsAllDay,
            Location = externalEvent.Location != null
                ? new Location
                {
                    Name = externalEvent.Location.Name,
                    Address = externalEvent.Location.Address
                }
                : null,
            Status = MapEventStatus(externalEvent.Status),
            IsImported = true,
            ImportedFrom = connection.ProviderType.ToString()
        };
        
        await _eventRepo.InsertAsync(evt);
        
        return evt;
    }
}
```

### 201.2 iCalendar Export/Import

```csharp
public class ICalendarService : IICalendarService
{
    public async Task<string> ExportToICalAsync(Guid calendarId, DateTime? start, DateTime? end)
    {
        var calendar = await _calendarRepo.GetAsync(calendarId);
        
        var events = await _eventRepo.Query()
            .Where(e => e.CalendarId == calendarId)
            .WhereIf(start.HasValue, e => e.EndTime >= start.Value)
            .WhereIf(end.HasValue, e => e.StartTime <= end.Value)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        
        // Calendar header
        sb.AppendLine("BEGIN:VCALENDAR");
        sb.AppendLine("VERSION:2.0");
        sb.AppendLine($"PRODID:-//YourApp//Calendar//EN");
        sb.AppendLine($"X-WR-CALNAME:{EscapeICalText(calendar.Name)}");
        sb.AppendLine($"X-WR-TIMEZONE:{calendar.TimeZone}");
        
        // Events
        foreach (var evt in events)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("BEGIN:VEVENT");
            sb.AppendLine($"UID:{evt.Id}@yourapp.com");
            sb.AppendLine($"DTSTAMP:{FormatICalDateTime(evt.CreatedAt)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"DTSTART:{FormatICalDateTime(evt.StartTime)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"DTEND:{FormatICalDateTime(evt.EndTime)}");
            sb.AppendLine($"SUMMARY:{EscapeICalText(evt.Title)}");
            
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(evt.Description))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"DESCRIPTION:{EscapeICalText(evt.Description)}");
            }
            
            if (evt.Location != null)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"LOCATION:{EscapeICalText(evt.Location.Name)}");
            }
            
            if (evt.Recurrence != null)
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"RRULE:{evt.Recurrence.RRule}");
            }
            
            // Attendees
            if (evt.Attendees?.Any() == true)
            {
                foreach (var attendee in evt.Attendees)
                {
                    var role = attendee.Role == AttendeeRole.Organizer ? "CHAIR" : "REQ-PARTICIPANT";
                    var partstat = MapAttendeeStatus(attendee.Status);
                    
                    sb.AppendLine($"ATTENDEE;ROLE={role};PARTSTAT={partstat};CN={attendee.Name}:mailto:{attendee.Email}");
                }
            }
            
            // Alarms/Reminders
            if (evt.Reminders?.Any() == true)
            {
                foreach (var reminder in evt.Reminders)
                {
                    sb.AppendLine("BEGIN:VALARM");
                    sb.AppendLine($"TRIGGER:-PT{reminder.MinutesBefore}M");
                    sb.AppendLine("ACTION:DISPLAY");
                    sb.AppendLine($"DESCRIPTION:Reminder");
                    sb.AppendLine("END:VALARM");
                }
            }
            
            sb.AppendLine("END:VEVENT");
        }
        
        sb.AppendLine("END:VCALENDAR");
        
        return sb.ToString();
    }
    
    public async Task<List<CalendarEvent>> ImportFromICalAsync(
        Guid calendarId,
        string iCalContent)
    {
        var importedEvents = new List<CalendarEvent>();
        
        // Parse iCal content
        var lines = iCalContent.Split(new[] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
        
        CalendarEvent currentEvent = null;
        
        foreach (var line in lines)
        {
            var trimmedLine = line.Trim();
            
            if (trimmedLine == "BEGIN:VEVENT")
            {
                currentEvent = new CalendarEvent
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    CalendarId = calendarId,
                    CreatedBy = _currentUser.UserId
                };
            }
            else if (trimmedLine == "END:VEVENT" && currentEvent != null)
            {
                await _eventRepo.InsertAsync(currentEvent);
                importedEvents.Add(currentEvent);
                currentEvent = null;
            }
            else if (currentEvent != null && trimmedLine.Contains(":"))
            {
                var colonIndex = trimmedLine.IndexOf(':');
                var property = trimmedLine.Substring(0, colonIndex);
                var value = trimmedLine.Substring(colonIndex + 1);
                
                ParseEventProperty(currentEvent, property, value);
            }
        }
        
        return importedEvents;
    }
    
    private void ParseEventProperty(CalendarEvent evt, string property, string value)
    {
        // Handle property parameters (e.g., DTSTART;TZID=America/New_York:...)
        var propParts = property.Split(';');
        var propName = propParts[0];
        
        switch (propName)
        {
            case "SUMMARY":
                evt.Title = UnescapeICalText(value);
                break;
                
            case "DESCRIPTION":
                evt.Description = UnescapeICalText(value);
                break;
                
            case "DTSTART":
                evt.StartTime = ParseICalDateTime(value);
                break;
                
            case "DTEND":
                evt.EndTime = ParseICalDateTime(value);
                break;
                
            case "LOCATION":
                evt.Location = new Location { Name = UnescapeICalText(value) };
                break;
                
            case "RRULE":
                evt.Recurrence = _recurrenceParser.Parse(value);
                break;
                
            case "UID":
                // Store as metadata for sync purposes
                evt.Metadata = evt.Metadata ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
                evt.Metadata["imported_uid"] = value;
                break;
        }
    }
    
    private string FormatICalDateTime(DateTime dt)
    {
        // Format: 20251209T143000Z (UTC)
        return dt.ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss'Z'");
    }
    
    private DateTime ParseICalDateTime(string value)
    {
        // Remove Z suffix if present
        value = value.TrimEnd('Z');
        
        // Parse: 20251209T143000
        return DateTime.ParseExact(
            value,
            "yyyyMMdd'T'HHmmss",
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal);
    }
    
    private string EscapeICalText(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return text;
        
        return text
            .Replace("\\", "\\\\")
            .Replace(";", "\\;")
            .Replace(",", "\\,")
            .Replace("\n", "\\n");
    }
    
    private string UnescapeICalText(string text)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
            return text;
        
        return text
            .Replace("\\n", "\n")
            .Replace("\\,", ",")
            .Replace("\\;", ";")
            .Replace("\\\\", "\\");
    }
    
    private string MapAttendeeStatus(AttendeeStatus status)
    {
        return status switch
        {
            AttendeeStatus.Accepted => "ACCEPTED",
            AttendeeStatus.Declined => "DECLINED",
            AttendeeStatus.Tentative => "TENTATIVE",
            AttendeeStatus.NeedsAction => "NEEDS-ACTION",
            _ => "NEEDS-ACTION"
        };
    }
}
```

### 201.3 Calendar Webhook Handler

```csharp
public class CalendarWebhookHandler : ICalendarWebhookHandler
{
    public async Task HandleWebhookAsync(
        CalendarProviderType providerType,
        string payload,
        Dictionary<string, string> headers)
    {
        // Verify webhook signature
        if (!await VerifyWebhookSignatureAsync(providerType, payload, headers))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedException("Invalid webhook signature");
        }
        
        // Parse webhook payload
        var webhookEvent = ParseWebhookPayload(providerType, payload);
        
        // Find affected sync connections
        var connections = await _syncConnectionRepo.Query()
            .Where(c => c.ProviderType == providerType &&
                       c.IsActive &&
                       c.ExternalCalendarId == webhookEvent.CalendarId)
            .ToListAsync();
        
        foreach (var connection in connections)
        {
            try
            {
                await ProcessWebhookEventAsync(connection, webhookEvent);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, 
                    "Failed to process webhook for connection {ConnectionId}", 
                    connection.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessWebhookEventAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        WebhookEvent webhookEvent)
    {
        switch (webhookEvent.Type)
        {
            case WebhookEventType.EventCreated:
                await HandleEventCreatedAsync(connection, webhookEvent.EventId);
                break;
                
            case WebhookEventType.EventUpdated:
                await HandleEventUpdatedAsync(connection, webhookEvent.EventId);
                break;
                
            case WebhookEventType.EventDeleted:
                await HandleEventDeletedAsync(connection, webhookEvent.EventId);
                break;
                
            case WebhookEventType.CalendarDeleted:
                await HandleCalendarDeletedAsync(connection);
                break;
        }
    }
    
    private async Task HandleEventCreatedAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        string externalEventId)
    {
        if (connection.SyncDirection != SyncDirection.Import &&
            connection.SyncDirection != SyncDirection.TwoWay)
            return;
        
        var provider = _providerFactory.GetProvider(connection.ProviderType);
        var accessToken = await _encryption.DecryptAsync(connection.AccessToken);
        
        var externalEvent = await provider.GetEventAsync(
            accessToken,
            connection.ExternalCalendarId,
            externalEventId);
        
        // Create local event
        await _syncService.ImportEventAsync(connection, externalEvent);
    }
    
    private async Task HandleEventUpdatedAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        string externalEventId)
    {
        var mapping = await _syncMappingRepo.Query()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(m => m.ConnectionId == connection.Id &&
                                    m.ExternalEventId == externalEventId);
        
        if (mapping == null)
        {
            // New event we haven't seen before
            await HandleEventCreatedAsync(connection, externalEventId);
            return;
        }
        
        var provider = _providerFactory.GetProvider(connection.ProviderType);
        var accessToken = await _encryption.DecryptAsync(connection.AccessToken);
        
        var externalEvent = await provider.GetEventAsync(
            accessToken,
            connection.ExternalCalendarId,
            externalEventId);
        
        // Update local event
        var localEvent = await _eventRepo.GetAsync(mapping.LocalEventId);
        
        // Avoid sync loops - check if we just updated it
        if (localEvent.ModifiedAt > mapping.LastSyncedAt)
            return; // We initiated this change
        
        await _syncService.UpdateImportedEventAsync(localEvent, externalEvent);
        
        mapping.LastSyncedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _syncMappingRepo.UpdateAsync(mapping);
    }
    
    private async Task HandleEventDeletedAsync(
        CalendarSyncConnection connection,
        string externalEventId)
    {
        var mapping = await _syncMappingRepo.Query()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(m => m.ConnectionId == connection.Id &&
                                    m.ExternalEventId == externalEventId);
        
        if (mapping == null)
            return;
        
        // Delete local event
        await _eventRepo.DeleteAsync(mapping.LocalEventId);
        
        // Delete mapping
        await _syncMappingRepo.DeleteAsync(mapping.Id);
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> VerifyWebhookSignatureAsync(
        CalendarProviderType providerType,
        string payload,
        Dictionary<string, string> headers)
    {
        // Provider-specific signature verification
        return providerType switch
        {
            CalendarProviderType.Google => VerifyGoogleWebhookSignature(payload, headers),
            CalendarProviderType.Microsoft => VerifyMicrosoftWebhookSignature(payload, headers),
            _ => true // Placeholder for other providers
        };
    }
}
```

# **PART XXI - SEARCH & INDEXING KERNEL**

## **Chapter 202 - Search Kernel Overview**

### 202.1 Purpose and Scope

The Search & Indexing Kernel provides **unified search and discovery capabilities** across all bounded contexts, enabling:

- Full-text search across all entities
- Faceted search and filtering
- Real-time index updates
- Search relevance and ranking
- Autocomplete and suggestions
- Advanced query syntax
- Search analytics and insights
- Multi-language support
- Fuzzy matching and typo tolerance
- Search result highlighting

**Used By:**
- All bounded contexts (universal search)
- Task & Project Management
- Document Management
- User Directory
- Knowledge Base
- Reporting & Analytics
- Mobile Applications
- API Clients

### 202.2 Core Value Proposition

**Problem Without Search Kernel:**
- Scattered search implementations
- Inconsistent search results
- Poor search performance
- No unified search experience
- Manual index management
- Limited search capabilities
- No search analytics

**Solution With Search Kernel:**
- Unified search API
- Centralized indexing
- High-performance search
- Consistent relevance ranking
- Automatic index updates
- Rich search features
- Search insights and analytics

## **Chapter 203 - Search Domain Model**

### 203.2 Search Invariants

**Document-Level Invariants:**
- Id must be unique across index
- EntityType and EntityId required
- TenantId required for multi-tenancy isolation
- Title is required (max 500 characters)
- Content max 1MB
- IndexedAt timestamp required

**Query-Level Invariants:**
- QueryText max 1000 characters
- Take cannot exceed 1000 results
- Skip cannot exceed 10,000 (use search_after for deep pagination)
- Filter values must match field type
- Sort fields must be indexed

**Access Control Invariants:**
- Search results must respect entity-level permissions
- Users only see documents they have access to
- Tenant isolation strictly enforced
