## **Chapter 204 - Indexing Service**

### 204.1 Index Builder

```csharp
public class SearchIndexBuilder : ISearchIndexBuilder
{
    private readonly IElasticsearchClient _elasticClient;
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepo;
    private readonly ILogger<SearchIndexBuilder> _logger;
    
    public async Task BuildIndexAsync(string indexName, IndexDefinition definition)
    {
        // Delete existing index if it exists
        if (await _elasticClient.Indices.ExistsAsync(indexName))
        {
            await _elasticClient.Indices.DeleteAsync(indexName);
        }
        
        // Create new index with mappings
        var createIndexResponse = await _elasticClient.Indices.CreateAsync(indexName, c => c
            .Settings(s => s
                .NumberOfShards(definition.Settings.NumberOfShards)
                .NumberOfReplicas(definition.Settings.NumberOfReplicas)
                .Analysis(a => ConfigureAnalyzers(a, definition.Analyzer))
            )
            .Map<SearchDocument>(m => ConfigureMappings(m, definition))
        );
        
        if (!createIndexResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Failed to create index: {createIndexResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Created search index: {IndexName}", indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task IndexDocumentAsync(SearchDocument document)
    {
        var indexName = GetIndexName(document.EntityType);
        
        // Enrich document with computed fields
        document = await EnrichDocumentAsync(document);
        
        var indexResponse = await _elasticClient.IndexAsync(document, idx => idx
            .Index(indexName)
            .Id(document.Id)
            .Refresh(Refresh.WaitFor)
        );
        
        if (!indexResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Failed to index document: {indexResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Indexed document: {DocumentId} in {Index}", 
            document.Id, indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task IndexBatchAsync(List<SearchDocument> documents)
    {
        if (!documents.Any())
            return;
        
        var indexName = GetIndexName(documents.First().EntityType);
        
        // Enrich all documents
        var enrichedDocs = new List<SearchDocument>();
        foreach (var doc in documents)
        {
            enrichedDocs.Add(await EnrichDocumentAsync(doc));
        }
        
        var bulkResponse = await _elasticClient.BulkAsync(b => b
            .Index(indexName)
            .IndexMany(enrichedDocs, (bd, doc) => bd
                .Id(doc.Id)
                .Document(doc)
            )
            .Refresh(Refresh.WaitFor)
        );
        
        if (!bulkResponse.IsValidResponse || bulkResponse.Errors)
        {
            var errors = bulkResponse.ItemsWithErrors
                .Select(i => $"{i.Id}: {i.Error?.Reason}")
                .ToList();
            
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Bulk indexing failed. Errors: {string.Join(", ", errors)}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Indexed {Count} documents in {Index}", 
            documents.Count, indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task UpdateDocumentAsync(string documentId, object partialUpdate)
    {
        var doc = await GetDocumentAsync(documentId);
        if (doc == null)
        {
            throw new NotFoundException($"Document not found: {documentId}");
        }
        
        var indexName = GetIndexName(doc.EntityType);
        
        var updateResponse = await _elasticClient.UpdateAsync<SearchDocument, object>(
            indexName, 
            documentId, 
            u => u
                .Doc(partialUpdate)
                .Refresh(Refresh.WaitFor)
        );
        
        if (!updateResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Failed to update document: {updateResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
    }
    
    public async Task DeleteDocumentAsync(string documentId, string entityType)
    {
        var indexName = GetIndexName(entityType);
        
        var deleteResponse = await _elasticClient.DeleteAsync(
            indexName,
            documentId,
            d => d.Refresh(Refresh.WaitFor)
        );
        
        if (!deleteResponse.IsValidResponse && deleteResponse.Result != Result.NotFound)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Failed to delete document: {deleteResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Deleted document: {DocumentId} from {Index}", 
            documentId, indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task ReindexEntityTypeAsync(string entityType)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting reindex for entity type: {EntityType}", entityType);
        
        var indexName = GetIndexName(entityType);
        
        // Get all entities of this type
        var entities = await GetAllEntitiesAsync(entityType);
        
        // Convert to search documents
        var documents = await ConvertToSearchDocumentsAsync(entities, entityType);
        
        // Index in batches
        var batches = documents.Chunk(1000);
        var totalIndexed = 0;
        
        foreach (var batch in batches)
        {
            await IndexBatchAsync(batch.ToList());
            totalIndexed += batch.Count();
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Indexed {Count}/{Total} documents", 
                totalIndexed, documents.Count);
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Completed reindex for {EntityType}. Indexed {Count} documents",
            entityType, totalIndexed);
    }
    
    private async Task<SearchDocument> EnrichDocumentAsync(SearchDocument document)
    {
        // Set indexed timestamp
        document.IndexedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        // Generate summary if content is long
        if (document.Content?.Length > 500)
        {
            document.Summary = GenerateSummary(document.Content, 200);
        }
        
        // Calculate boost based on entity type and metadata
        document.Boost = CalculateBoost(document);
        
        // Add computed fields
        document.Metadata.SearchableText = CombineSearchableText(document);
        
        return document;
    }
    
    private double CalculateBoost(SearchDocument document)
    {
        double boost = 1.0;
        
        // Boost by entity type
        boost *= document.EntityType switch
        {
            "Task" => 1.2,
            "Project" => 1.5,
            "Document" => 1.0,
            "User" => 0.8,
            _ => 1.0
        };
        
        // Boost by priority
        if (document.Metadata.Priority == "High")
            boost *= 1.3;
        else if (document.Metadata.Priority == "Critical")
            boost *= 1.5;
        
        // Boost recent items
        var age = DateTime.UtcNow - document.LastModifiedAt;
        if (age.TotalDays < 7)
            boost *= 1.2;
        else if (age.TotalDays < 30)
            boost *= 1.1;
        
        return boost;
    }
    
    private string CombineSearchableText(SearchDocument document)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>
        {
            document.Title,
            document.Content,
            document.Summary,
            document.Metadata.OwnerName,
            document.Metadata.AssigneeName,
            string.Join(" ", document.Tags ?? new List<string>())
        };
        
        return string.Join(" ", parts.Where(p => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p)));
    }
    
    private TypeMappingDescriptor<SearchDocument> ConfigureMappings(
        TypeMappingDescriptor<SearchDocument> m,
        IndexDefinition definition)
    {
        return m
            .Properties(p => p
                .Keyword(k => k.Name(d => d.Id))
                .Keyword(k => k.Name(d => d.TenantId))
                .Keyword(k => k.Name(d => d.EntityType))
                .Keyword(k => k.Name(d => d.EntityId))
                .Text(t => t
                    .Name(d => d.Title)
                    .Analyzer("standard")
                    .Fields(f => f
                        .Text(tt => tt
                            .Name("keyword")
                            .Analyzer("keyword")
                        )
                        .Text(tt => tt
                            .Name("autocomplete")
                            .Analyzer("autocomplete")
                            .SearchAnalyzer("autocomplete_search")
                        )
                    )
                )
                .Text(t => t
                    .Name(d => d.Content)
                    .Analyzer("standard")
                )
                .Text(t => t
                    .Name(d => d.Summary)
                    .Analyzer("standard")
                )
                .Date(d => d.Name(doc => doc.IndexedAt))
                .Date(d => d.Name(doc => doc.LastModifiedAt))
                .Keyword(k => k.Name(d => d.Tags))
                .Object<SearchableMetadata>(o => o
                    .Name(d => d.Metadata)
                    .Properties(mp => mp
                        .Keyword(k => k.Name(m => m.Status))
                        .Keyword(k => k.Name(m => m.Priority))
                        .Date(d => d.Name(m => m.DueDate))
                        .Date(d => d.Name(m => m.CreatedAt))
                        .Keyword(k => k.Name(m => m.Categories))
                    )
                )
                .Number(n => n
                    .Name(d => d.Boost)
                    .Type(NumberType.Double)
                )
            );
    }
    
    private AnalysisDescriptor ConfigureAnalyzers(
        AnalysisDescriptor a,
        AnalyzerSettings settings)
    {
        return a
            .Analyzers(an => an
                .Custom("autocomplete", ca => ca
                    .Tokenizer("standard")
                    .Filters("lowercase", "autocomplete_filter")
                )
                .Custom("autocomplete_search", ca => ca
                    .Tokenizer("standard")
                    .Filters("lowercase")
                )
            )
            .TokenFilters(tf => tf
                .EdgeNGram("autocomplete_filter", ng => ng
                    .MinGram(1)
                    .MaxGram(20)
                )
            );
    }
    
    private string GetIndexName(string entityType)
    {
        var environment = _configuration["Environment"] ?? "dev";
        return $"{environment}-{entityType.ToLower()}-v1";
    }
}
```

### 204.2 Index Synchronization Service

```csharp
public class IndexSynchronizationService : IIndexSynchronizationService
{
    private readonly ISearchIndexBuilder _indexBuilder;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    private readonly ILogger<IndexSynchronizationService> _logger;
    
    // Subscribe to domain events and update search index
    public async Task HandleDomainEventAsync(DomainEvent domainEvent)
    {
        try
        {
            switch (domainEvent)
            {
                case TaskCreatedEvent e:
                    await HandleTaskCreatedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                case TaskUpdatedEvent e:
                    await HandleTaskUpdatedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                case TaskDeletedEvent e:
                    await HandleTaskDeletedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                case ProjectCreatedEvent e:
                    await HandleProjectCreatedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                case ProjectUpdatedEvent e:
                    await HandleProjectUpdatedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                case DocumentUploadedEvent e:
                    await HandleDocumentUploadedAsync(e);
                    break;
                
                // Add more event handlers as needed
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Failed to sync search index for event {EventType}", 
                domainEvent.GetType().Name);
            
            // Queue for retry
            await QueueForRetryAsync(domainEvent);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task HandleTaskCreatedAsync(TaskCreatedEvent e)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(e.TaskId);
        if (task == null) return;
        
        var searchDoc = await ConvertTaskToSearchDocumentAsync(task);
        await _indexBuilder.IndexDocumentAsync(searchDoc);
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Indexed new task: {TaskId}", e.TaskId);
    }
    
    private async Task HandleTaskUpdatedAsync(TaskUpdatedEvent e)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(e.TaskId);
        if (task == null)
        {
            // Task might have been deleted
            await _indexBuilder.DeleteDocumentAsync(
                e.TaskId.ToString(), 
                "Task");
            return;
        }
        
        // Use partial update for efficiency
        var updates = new
        {
            title = task.Title,
            content = task.Description,
            lastModifiedAt = task.ModifiedAt,
            metadata = new
            {
                status = task.Status.ToString(),
                priority = task.Priority.ToString(),
                assigneeId = task.AssigneeId,
                assigneeName = await GetUserNameAsync(task.AssigneeId),
                dueDate = task.DueDate
            }
        };
        
        await _indexBuilder.UpdateDocumentAsync(
            e.TaskId.ToString(),
            updates);
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Updated task index: {TaskId}", e.TaskId);
    }
    
    private async Task HandleTaskDeletedAsync(TaskDeletedEvent e)
    {
        await _indexBuilder.DeleteDocumentAsync(
            e.TaskId.ToString(),
            "Task");
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Removed task from index: {TaskId}", e.TaskId);
    }
    
    private async Task<SearchDocument> ConvertTaskToSearchDocumentAsync(WorkTask task)
    {
        return new SearchDocument
        {
            Id = task.Id.ToString(),
            TenantId = task.TenantId,
            EntityType = "Task",
            EntityId = task.Id,
            Title = task.Title,
            Content = task.Description,
            LastModifiedAt = task.ModifiedAt ?? task.CreatedAt,
            Tags = task.Tags?.ToList() ?? new List<string>(),
            Metadata = new SearchableMetadata
            {
                OwnerId = task.CreatorId,
                OwnerName = await GetUserNameAsync(task.CreatorId),
                AssigneeId = task.AssigneeId,
                AssigneeName = await GetUserNameAsync(task.AssigneeId),
                Status = task.Status.ToString(),
                Priority = task.Priority.ToString(),
                DueDate = task.DueDate,
                CreatedAt = task.CreatedAt,
                Categories = task.Categories?.ToList() ?? new List<string>()
            },
            Access = new AccessControl
            {
                OwnerIds = new List<Guid> { task.CreatorId },
                AllowedUserIds = GetAllowedUserIds(task),
                AllowedRoleIds = GetAllowedRoleIds(task),
                IsPublic = task.Visibility == TaskVisibility.Public
            }
        };
    }
    
    // Batch synchronization for full reindex
    public async Task SynchronizeAllAsync(string entityType)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting full synchronization for {EntityType}", entityType);
        
        var startTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var successCount = 0;
        var errorCount = 0;
        
        try
        {
            await _indexBuilder.ReindexEntityTypeAsync(entityType);
            successCount++;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to synchronize {EntityType}", entityType);
            errorCount++;
        }
        
        var duration = DateTime.UtcNow - startTime;
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Completed synchronization. Duration: {Duration}s, Success: {Success}, Errors: {Errors}",
            duration.TotalSeconds, successCount, errorCount);
    }
    
    // Incremental sync - sync entities modified since last sync
    public async Task IncrementalSyncAsync(string entityType, DateTime since)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Starting incremental sync for {EntityType} since {Since}",
            entityType, since);
        
        var entities = await GetModifiedEntitiesAsync(entityType, since);
        
        var documents = await ConvertToSearchDocumentsAsync(entities, entityType);
        
        if (documents.Any())
        {
            await _indexBuilder.IndexBatchAsync(documents);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Incremental sync completed. Indexed {Count} documents",
                documents.Count);
        }
        else
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("No changes detected for incremental sync");
        }
    }
    
    private async Task QueueForRetryAsync(DomainEvent domainEvent)
    {
        var retryKey = $"search_index_retry:{domainEvent.Id}";
        
        var retryData = new IndexRetryData
        {
            Event = domainEvent,
            Attempts = 0,
            LastAttempt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            NextAttempt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(1)
        };
        
        await _cache.SetAsync(
            retryKey,
            JsonSerializer.SerializeToUtf8Bytes(retryData),
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = TimeSpan.FromHours(24)
            });
    }
}
```

### 204.3 Index Management Service

```csharp
public class IndexManagementService : IIndexManagementService
{
    private readonly IElasticsearchClient _elasticClient;
    private readonly ILogger<IndexManagementService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<IndexHealth> GetIndexHealthAsync(string indexName)
    {
        var healthResponse = await _elasticClient.Cluster.HealthAsync(h => h
            .Index(indexName)
        );
        
        var statsResponse = await _elasticClient.Indices.StatsAsync(indexName);
        
        return new IndexHealth
        {
            IndexName = indexName,
            Status = healthResponse.Status.ToString(),
            NumberOfShards = healthResponse.NumberOfDataNodes,
            NumberOfReplicas = healthResponse.NumberOfReplicas,
            DocumentCount = statsResponse.Indices[indexName].Total.Documents.Count,
            StoreSizeBytes = statsResponse.Indices[indexName].Total.Store.SizeInBytes,
            IsHealthy = healthResponse.Status != HealthStatus.Red
        };
    }
    
    public async Task OptimizeIndexAsync(string indexName)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting index optimization for {IndexName}", indexName);
        
        // Force merge to reduce segment count
        var forceMergeResponse = await _elasticClient.Indices.ForceMergeAsync(indexName, fm => fm
            .MaxNumSegments(1)
            .WaitForCompletion(true)
        );
        
        if (!forceMergeResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Force merge failed: {forceMergeResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Index optimization completed for {IndexName}", indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task CreateIndexAliasAsync(string indexName, string aliasName)
    {
        var aliasResponse = await _elasticClient.Indices.PutAliasAsync(indexName, aliasName);
        
        if (!aliasResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Failed to create alias: {aliasResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Created alias {AliasName} for index {IndexName}",
            aliasName, indexName);
    }
    
    public async Task ReindexWithZeroDowntimeAsync(string oldIndexName, string newIndexName)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Starting zero-downtime reindex from {OldIndex} to {NewIndex}",
            oldIndexName, newIndexName);
        
        // Step 1: Create new index
        await _indexBuilder.BuildIndexAsync(newIndexName, GetIndexDefinition());
        
        // Step 2: Reindex data from old to new
        var reindexResponse = await _elasticClient.ReindexOnServerAsync(r => r
            .Source(s => s.Index(oldIndexName))
            .Destination(d => d.Index(newIndexName))
            .WaitForCompletion(false) // Run async
        );
        
        if (!reindexResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Reindex failed: {reindexResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        // Step 3: Wait for reindex to complete
        var taskId = reindexResponse.Task;
        await WaitForTaskCompletionAsync(taskId);
        
        // Step 4: Get alias name
        var aliasName = GetAliasForIndex(oldIndexName);
        
        // Step 5: Atomic alias switch
        await _elasticClient.Indices.UpdateAliasesAsync(u => u
            .Actions(a => a
                .Remove(r => r.Index(oldIndexName).Alias(aliasName))
                .Add(ad => ad.Index(newIndexName).Alias(aliasName))
            )
        );
        
        // Step 6: Delete old index after grace period
        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));
        await _elasticClient.Indices.DeleteAsync(oldIndexName);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Zero-downtime reindex completed. New index {NewIndex} is live",
            newIndexName);
    }
    
    public async Task CleanupOldIndicesAsync(int keepDays = 30)
    {
        var allIndices = await _elasticClient.Cat.IndicesAsync();
        var cutoffDate = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-keepDays);
        
        foreach (var index in allIndices.Records)
        {
            // Parse creation date from index name if following naming convention
            if (TryParseIndexDate(index.Index, out var indexDate))
            {
                if (indexDate < cutoffDate)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("Deleting old index: {IndexName}", index.Index);
                    await _elasticClient.Indices.DeleteAsync(index.Index);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task WaitForTaskCompletionAsync(string taskId)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            var taskResponse = await _elasticClient.Tasks.GetAsync(taskId);
            
            if (taskResponse.Completed)
                break;
            
            await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
        }
    }
    
    private bool TryParseIndexDate(string indexName, out DateTime date)
    {
        // Example: dev-task-v1-20251209
        var parts = indexName.Split('-');
        if (parts.Length >= 4)
        {
            var datePart = parts[parts.Length - 1];
            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                datePart,
                "yyyyMMdd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out date);
        }
        
        date = DateTime.MinValue;
        return false;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 205 - Search Query Service**

### 205.1 Search Service

```csharp
public class SearchService : ISearchService
{
    private readonly IElasticsearchClient _elasticClient;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly ISearchAnalytics _analytics;
    private readonly ILogger<SearchService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<SearchResult> SearchAsync(SearchQuery query)
    {
        // Parse and validate query
        var parsedQuery = await ParseQueryAsync(query);
        
        // Build Elasticsearch query
        var searchRequest = BuildSearchRequest(parsedQuery);
        
        // Apply access control filters
        ApplyAccessControlFilters(searchRequest, _currentUser.UserId.Value);
        
        // Execute search
        var startTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var searchResponse = await _elasticClient.SearchAsync<SearchDocument>(searchRequest);
        var searchTime = (DateTime.UtcNow - startTime).TotalMilliseconds;
        
        if (!searchResponse.IsValidResponse)
        {
            throw new SearchException(
                $"Search failed: {searchResponse.DebugInformation}");
        }
        
        // Convert to result
        var result = ConvertToSearchResult(searchResponse, searchTime);
        
        // Track search analytics
        await _analytics.TrackSearchAsync(query, result);
        
        return result;
    }
    
    public async Task<SearchResult> SearchAcrossTypesAsync(
        string queryText,
        List<string> entityTypes = null,
        int take = 20)
    {
        var query = new SearchQuery
        {
            QueryText = queryText,
            Take = take,
            Filters = new List<SearchFilter>()
        };
        
        if (entityTypes?.Any() == true)
        {
            query.Filters.Add(new SearchFilter
            {
                Field = "entityType",
                Operator = FilterOperator.In,
                Values = entityTypes.Cast<object>().ToList()
            });
        }
        
        return await SearchAsync(query);
    }
    
    public async Task<SearchResult> AdvancedSearchAsync(AdvancedSearchQuery query)
    {
        var elasticQuery = BuildAdvancedSearchQuery(query);
        
        var searchResponse = await _elasticClient.SearchAsync<SearchDocument>(s => s
            .Index(GetIndexPattern(query.EntityTypes))
            .Query(elasticQuery)
            .From(query.Skip)
            .Size(query.Take)
            .Sort(BuildSortDescriptors(query.Sorting))
            .Highlight(h => ConfigureHighlighting(h))
            .Aggregations(BuildAggregations(query.Facets))
            .TrackTotalHits(new TrackHits(true))
        );
        
        return ConvertToSearchResult(searchResponse, 0);
    }
    
    private SearchRequest BuildSearchRequest(ParsedQuery parsedQuery)
    {
        var request = new SearchRequest(GetIndexPattern(parsedQuery.EntityTypes))
        {
            From = parsedQuery.Skip,
            Size = parsedQuery.Take,
            TrackTotalHits = new TrackHits(true)
        };
        
        // Build main query
        var queries = new List<Query>();
        
        // Text query
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsedQuery.QueryText))
        {
            queries.Add(new MultiMatchQuery
            {
                Query = parsedQuery.QueryText,
                Fields = new[]
                {
                    "title^3",           // Boost title matches
                    "content^1",
                    "summary^2",
                    "metadata.ownerName",
                    "metadata.assigneeName",
                    "tags^2"
                },
                Type = TextQueryType.BestFields,
                Fuzziness = Fuzziness.Auto,
                PrefixLength = 2
            });
        }
        
        // Filters
        foreach (var filter in parsedQuery.Filters)
        {
            queries.Add(BuildFilterQuery(filter));
        }
        
        // Combine queries
        if (queries.Count == 1)
        {
            request.Query = queries[0];
        }
        else if (queries.Count > 1)
        {
            request.Query = new BoolQuery
            {
                Must = queries
            };
        }
        
        // Sorting
        if (parsedQuery.Sorting?.Any() == true)
        {
            request.Sort = BuildSortDescriptors(parsedQuery.Sorting);
        }
        else
        {
            // Default sort by relevance, then by date
            request.Sort = new[]
            {
                SortOptions.Score(new ScoreSort { Order = SortOrder.Desc }),
                SortOptions.Field(new Field("lastModifiedAt"), new FieldSort { Order = SortOrder.Desc })
            };
        }
        
        // Highlighting
        request.Highlight = new Highlight
        {
            Fields = new Dictionary<Field, HighlightField>
            {
                ["title"] = new HighlightField { FragmentSize = 150, NumberOfFragments = 1 },
                ["content"] = new HighlightField { FragmentSize = 200, NumberOfFragments = 3 },
                ["summary"] = new HighlightField { FragmentSize = 150, NumberOfFragments = 1 }
            },
            PreTags = new[] { "<mark>" },
            PostTags = new[] { "</mark>" }
        };
        
        // Facets
        if (parsedQuery.Facets?.Any() == true)
        {
            request.Aggregations = BuildAggregations(parsedQuery.Facets);
        }
        
        return request;
    }
    
    private Query BuildFilterQuery(SearchFilter filter)
    {
        return filter.Operator switch
        {
            FilterOperator.Equals => new TermQuery(filter.Field)
            {
                Value = FieldValue.String(filter.Value?.ToString())
            },
            
            FilterOperator.In => new TermsQuery
            {
                Field = filter.Field,
                Terms = new TermsQueryField(filter.Values.Select(v => 
                    FieldValue.String(v?.ToString())).ToArray())
            },
            
            FilterOperator.Range => new RangeQuery(filter.Field)
            {
                Gte = filter.Value as double?,
                Lte = filter.Values?.FirstOrDefault() as double?
            },
            
            FilterOperator.DateRange => new DateRangeQuery(filter.Field)
            {
                Gte = filter.Value as DateTime?,
                Lte = filter.Values?.FirstOrDefault() as DateTime?
            },
            
            FilterOperator.Contains => new WildcardQuery(filter.Field)
            {
                Value = $"*{filter.Value}*"
            },
            
            FilterOperator.StartsWith => new PrefixQuery(filter.Field)
            {
                Value = filter.Value?.ToString()
            },
            
            FilterOperator.Exists => new ExistsQuery(filter.Field),
            
            _ => throw new ArgumentException($"Unsupported filter operator: {filter.Operator}")
        };
    }
    
    private void ApplyAccessControlFilters(SearchRequest request, Guid userId)
    {
        // Add tenant filter
        var tenantFilter = new TermQuery("tenantId")
        {
            Value = FieldValue.String(_currentUser.TenantId.Value.ToString())
        };
        
        // Add access control filter
        var accessFilter = new BoolQuery
        {
            Should = new Query[]
            {
                // Public documents
                new TermQuery("access.isPublic") { Value = FieldValue.Boolean(true) },
                
                // User is owner
                new TermQuery("access.ownerIds") 
                { 
                    Value = FieldValue.String(userId.ToString()) 
                },
                
                // User is in allowed users
                new TermQuery("access.allowedUserIds") 
                { 
                    Value = FieldValue.String(userId.ToString()) 
                },
                
                // User has allowed role
                new TermsQuery
                {
                    Field = "access.allowedRoleIds",
                    Terms = new TermsQueryField(
                        _currentUser.Roles.Select(r => 
                            FieldValue.String(r.ToString())).ToArray())
                }
            },
            MinimumShouldMatch = 1
        };
        
        // Combine with existing query
        if (request.Query != null)
        {
            request.Query = new BoolQuery
            {
                Must = new Query[] { request.Query },
                Filter = new Query[] { tenantFilter, accessFilter }
            };
        }
        else
        {
            request.Query = new BoolQuery
            {
                Filter = new Query[] { tenantFilter, accessFilter }
            };
        }
    }
    
    private SortOptions[] BuildSortDescriptors(List<SearchSort> sorts)
    {
        return sorts.Select(sort => sort.Direction == SortDirection.Ascending
            ? SortOptions.Field(new Field(sort.Field), new FieldSort { Order = SortOrder.Asc })
            : SortOptions.Field(new Field(sort.Field), new FieldSort { Order = SortOrder.Desc })
        ).ToArray();
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, Aggregation> BuildAggregations(List<string> facetFields)
    {
        var aggregations = new Dictionary<string, Aggregation>();
        
        foreach (var field in facetFields)
        {
            aggregations[field] = new TermsAggregation(field)
            {
                Field = field,
                Size = 20
            };
        }
        
        return aggregations;
    }
    
    private SearchResult ConvertToSearchResult(
        SearchResponse<SearchDocument> response,
        double searchTimeMs)
    {
        var result = new SearchResult
        {
            Hits = response.Documents.Select((doc, index) => new SearchHit
            {
                Id = doc.Id,
                EntityType = doc.EntityType,
                EntityId = doc.EntityId,
                Title = doc.Title,
                Score = response.Hits[index].Score ?? 0,
                Snippet = GenerateSnippet(doc),
                Highlights = ExtractHighlights(response.Hits[index]),
                Metadata = doc.Metadata
            }).ToList(),
            TotalCount = response.Total,
            MaxScore = response.MaxScore ?? 0,
            SearchTimeMs = (long)searchTimeMs,
            QueryId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
        };
        
        // Extract facets
        if (response.Aggregations != null)
        {
            result.Facets = ExtractFacets(response.Aggregations);
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, List<string>> ExtractHighlights(Hit<SearchDocument> hit)
    {
        var highlights = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
        
        if (hit.Highlight != null)
        {
            foreach (var kvp in hit.Highlight)
            {
                highlights[kvp.Key] = kvp.Value.ToList();
            }
        }
        
        return highlights;
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, Facet> ExtractFacets(
        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IAggregate> aggregations)
    {
        var facets = new Dictionary<string, Facet>();
        
        foreach (var agg in aggregations)
        {
            if (agg.Value is StringTermsAggregate termsAgg)
            {
                facets[agg.Key] = new Facet
                {
                    Field = agg.Key,
                    Values = termsAgg.Buckets.Select(b => new FacetValue
                    {
                        Value = b.Key.ToString(),
                        Count = b.DocCount ?? 0
                    }).ToList()
                };
            }
        }
        
        return facets;
    }
    
    private string GenerateSnippet(SearchDocument doc)
    {
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(doc.Summary))
            return TruncateText(doc.Summary, 200);
        
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(doc.Content))
            return TruncateText(doc.Content, 200);
        
        return string.Empty;
    }
    
    private string TruncateText(string text, int maxLength)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Length <= maxLength)
            return text;
        
        var truncated = text.Substring(0, maxLength);
        var lastSpace = truncated.LastIndexOf(' ');
        
        if (lastSpace > 0)
            truncated = truncated.Substring(0, lastSpace);
        
        return truncated + "...";
    }
    
    private string GetIndexPattern(List<string> entityTypes)
    {
        if (entityTypes == null || !entityTypes.Any())
            return "*"; // Search all indices
        
        var environment = _configuration["Environment"] ?? "dev";
        var indices = entityTypes.Select(et => 
            $"{environment}-{et.ToLower()}-v1");
        
        return string.Join(",", indices);
    }
}
```

### 205.2 Query Parser

```csharp
public class SearchQueryParser : ISearchQueryParser
{
    public async Task<ParsedQuery> ParseQueryAsync(SearchQuery query)
    {
        var parsed = new ParsedQuery
        {
            QueryText = query.QueryText?.Trim(),
            Skip = query.Skip,
            Take = Math.Min(query.Take, 1000), // Max 1000 results
            Filters = query.Filters ?? new List<SearchFilter>(),
            Sorting = query.Sorting ?? new List<SearchSort>(),
            Facets = query.Facets ?? new List<string>()
        };
        
        // Parse advanced query syntax
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(parsed.QueryText))
        {
            parsed = ParseAdvancedSyntax(parsed);
        }
        
        // Validate filters
        ValidateFilters(parsed.Filters);
        
        return parsed;
    }
    
    private ParsedQuery ParseAdvancedSyntax(ParsedQuery query)
    {
        var text = query.QueryText;
        
        // Extract field-specific queries: field:value
        var fieldPattern = @"(\w+):([^\s""]+|""[^""]+""?)";
        var fieldMatches = Regex.Matches(text, fieldPattern);
        
        foreach (Match match in fieldMatches)
        {
            var field = match.Groups[1].Value;
            var value = match.Groups[2].Value.Trim('"');
            
            // Add as filter
            query.Filters.Add(new SearchFilter
            {
                Field = MapFieldAlias(field),
                Operator = FilterOperator.Contains,
                Value = value
            });
            
            // Remove from query text
            text = text.Replace(match.Value, "");
        }
        
        // Extract quoted phrases
        var phrasePattern = @"""([^""]+)""";
        var phraseMatches = Regex.Matches(text, phrasePattern);
        var phrases = new List<string>();
        
        foreach (Match match in phraseMatches)
        {
            phrases.Add(match.Groups[1].Value);
            text = text.Replace(match.Value, "");
        }
        
        // Clean up remaining text
        query.QueryText = text.Trim();
        
        // Add phrases as must-match
        if (phrases.Any())
        {
            query.Phrases = phrases;
        }
        
        return query;
    }
    
    private string MapFieldAlias(string field)
    {
        // Map user-friendly field names to index fields
        return field.ToLower() switch
        {
            "owner" => "metadata.ownerName",
            "assignee" => "metadata.assigneeName",
            "status" => "metadata.status",
            "priority" => "metadata.priority",
            "due" => "metadata.dueDate",
            "created" => "metadata.createdAt",
            "tag" => "tags",
            "category" => "metadata.categories",
            _ => field
        };
    }
    
    private void ValidateFilters(List<SearchFilter> filters)
    {
        foreach (var filter in filters)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter.Field))
                throw new ValidationException("Filter field is required");
            
            if (filter.Operator == FilterOperator.In && 
                (filter.Values == null || !filter.Values.Any()))
            {
                throw new ValidationException(
                    "In operator requires at least one value");
            }
            
            if (filter.Operator != FilterOperator.In && 
                filter.Operator != FilterOperator.Exists &&
                filter.Value == null)
            {
                throw new ValidationException(
                    $"Filter value is required for {filter.Operator} operator");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

# **VOLUME IV - SHARED KERNELS**

# **PART XXI - STATE MACHINE KERNEL**

---

## **Chapter 88 - State Machine Kernel Overview**

### 88.1 Purpose and Scope

The **State Machine Kernel** is a foundational shared component providing a unified, reusable engine for modeling and executing state-based lifecycles across the entire platform.

**Primary Purpose:**
- Eliminate duplication of state management logic
- Ensure consistent state transition semantics
- Provide pluggable condition and action execution
- Enable workflow-driven behavior across all contexts

**Scope of Application:**
- Workflow status transitions (Task, Project, Case)
- Approval workflow step progression
- Multi-step process orchestration
- Lifecycle state management for any entity

### 88.2 Core Design Principles

**1. Separation of Definition and Execution**  
State machines are defined declaratively and executed by an independent engine.

**2. Immutability After Publication**  
Published state machine configurations are immutable, requiring versioning for changes.

**3. Pluggable Conditions and Actions**  
Transition guards and effects are implemented via strategy pattern.

**4. Event-Driven State Changes**  
All state transitions emit domain events for observability and integration.

**5. Validation at Design Time**  
State machine configurations are validated before activation to prevent runtime errors.

## **Chapter 89 - State Machine Core Model**

### 89.1 State Aggregate

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class State {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +string DisplayName
        +StateCategory Category
        +string Color
        +int OrderIndex
        +bool IsInitial
        +bool IsTerminal
        +Json Metadata
        +bool IsValid()
    }
    
    class StateCategory {
        <<enumeration>>
        Todo
        InProgress
        Done
        Blocked
        Cancelled
        OnHold
    }
    
    State --> StateCategory
```

**State Properties:**

| Property | Type | Purpose |
|----------|------|---------|
| Id | Guid | Unique identifier |
| Name | string | Machine-readable name (e.g., "IN_PROGRESS") |
| DisplayName | string | Human-readable label (e.g., "In Progress") |
| Category | StateCategory | Semantic grouping for queries |
| Color | string | UI visualization (hex color) |
| OrderIndex | int | Display ordering |
| IsInitial | bool | Marks starting state |
| IsTerminal | bool | Marks ending state (Done/Cancelled) |
| Metadata | Json | Extensible custom properties |

**State Invariants:**
- Name must be unique within a state machine
- Exactly one state must be marked IsInitial
- At least one state must be marked IsTerminal
- OrderIndex must be unique and sequential
- Color must be valid hex format (#RRGGBB)

**Derived Properties:**
```csharp
public bool IsTodo => Category == StateCategory.Todo;
public bool IsInProgress => Category == StateCategory.InProgress;
public bool IsDone => Category == StateCategory.Done;
public bool IsBlocked => Category == StateCategory.Blocked;
public bool IsActive => Category == StateCategory.InProgress;
```

### 89.2 Transition Aggregate

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class Transition {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +string DisplayName
        +Guid FromStateId
        +Guid ToStateId
        +int OrderIndex
        +bool IsGlobal
        +TransitionType Type
        +bool RequiresComment
        +bool RequiresResolution
        +List~Condition~ Conditions
        +List~Action~ Actions
        +List~Validator~ Validators
        +Json Metadata
    }
    
    class Condition {
        +Guid Id
        +string Type
        +int OrderIndex
        +Json Configuration
        +bool ContinueOnFailure
    }
    
    class Action {
        +Guid Id
        +string Type
        +int OrderIndex

    }
    
    class Validator {
        +string FieldName
        +ValidationType Type
        +Json Rules
    }
    
    Transition "1" --> "*" Condition
    Transition "1" --> "*" Action
    Transition "1" --> "*" Validator
```

**Transition Properties:**

| Property | Type | Purpose |
|----------|------|---------|
| FromStateId | Guid | Source state (null for global) |
| ToStateId | Guid | Target state |
| IsGlobal | bool | Available from any state |
| Type | TransitionType | Normal, Emergency, Escalation |
| RequiresComment | bool | Forces user to add comment |
| RequiresResolution | bool | Requires resolution code |
| Conditions | List | Guards that must pass |
| Actions | List | Side effects to execute |
| Validators | List | Field validation rules |

**Transition Types:**
```csharp
public enum TransitionType
{
    Normal,          // Standard workflow progression
    Emergency,       // Skip validation, elevated privileges
    Escalation,      // Triggered by timeout/policy
    System,          // Automated, no user action
    Rollback         // Revert to previous state
}
```

**Transition Invariants:**
- FromStateId and ToStateId must exist in the state machine
- FromStateId ≠ ToStateId (no self-transitions)
- Global transitions cannot have FromStateId
- OrderIndex must be unique per FromStateId
- Conditions are evaluated in OrderIndex sequence
- Actions are executed in OrderIndex sequence

### 89.3 State Machine Aggregate Root

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class StateMachine {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +string Description
        +StateMachineType Type
        +bool IsActive
        +int Version
        +List~State~ States
        +List~Transition~ Transitions
        +State GetInitialState()
        +List~Transition~ GetAvailableTransitions(stateId)
        +bool CanTransition(fromId, toId)
        +void Validate()
        +StateMachineVersion Publish()
    }
    
    class StateMachineType {
        <<enumeration>>
        TaskWorkflow
        ApprovalWorkflow
        ProjectLifecycle
        CaseStageFlow
        CustomProcess
    }
    
    StateMachine "1" --> "*" State
    StateMachine "1" --> "*" Transition
    StateMachine --> StateMachineType
```

**State Machine Invariants:**
1. Must have at least 2 states (initial and terminal)
2. Must have exactly 1 initial state
3. Must have at least 1 terminal state
4. All transition FromStateId/ToStateId must reference existing states
5. All states must be reachable from initial state
6. No orphaned states (unreachable from any transition)
7. Cannot create circular paths to initial state
8. Cannot transition from terminal states

**Validation Rules:**
```csharp
public class StateMachineValidator
{
    public ValidationResult Validate(StateMachine machine)
    {
        var errors = new List<string>();
        
        // Rule 1: Initial state exists
        if (!machine.States.Any(s => s.IsInitial))
            errors.Add("No initial state defined");
            
        // Rule 2: Terminal state exists
        if (!machine.States.Any(s => s.IsTerminal))
            errors.Add("No terminal state defined");
            
        // Rule 3: All states reachable
        var reachable = CalculateReachableStates(machine);
        var unreachable = machine.States
            .Where(s => !reachable.Contains(s.Id))
            .ToList();
        if (unreachable.Any())
            errors.Add($"Unreachable states: {string.Join(", ", unreachable)}");
            
        // Rule 4: No transitions from terminal states
        var terminalTransitions = machine.Transitions
            .Where(t => machine.States.First(s => s.Id == t.FromStateId).IsTerminal)
            .ToList();
        if (terminalTransitions.Any())
            errors.Add("Transitions defined from terminal states");
            
        return new ValidationResult 
        { 
            IsValid = !errors.Any(), 
            Errors = errors 
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 90 - State Machine Execution Engine**

### 90.1 Transition Engine Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Request[Transition Request] --> Engine[State Machine Engine]
    
    Engine --> Auth[Authorization Check]
    Auth -->|Denied| Reject[Reject Transition]
    Auth -->|Allowed| Cond[Condition Evaluator]
    
    Cond --> C1[Condition 1]
    Cond --> C2[Condition 2]
    Cond --> C3[Condition N]
    
    C1 --> Eval{All Pass?}
    C2 --> Eval
    C3 --> Eval
    
    Eval -->|No| Reject
    Eval -->|Yes| Valid[Validator]
    
    Valid --> V1[Field Validator 1]
    Valid --> V2[Field Validator 2]
    V1 --> VCheck{All Valid?}
    V2 --> VCheck
    
    VCheck -->|No| Reject
    VCheck -->|Yes| Actions[Action Executor]
    
    Actions --> A1[Action 1]
    Actions --> A2[Action 2]
    Actions --> A3[Action N]
    
    A1 --> State[Update State]
    A2 --> State
    A3 --> State
    
    State --> Event[Emit Events]
    Event --> Complete[Transition Complete]
    
    Reject --> Event
```

### 91.2 Built-in Condition Types

**1. Field Value Condition**
```csharp
public class FieldValueConditionEvaluator : IConditionEvaluator
{
    public async Task<ConditionResult> EvaluateAsync(
        Condition condition, 
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = condition.Configuration.ToObject<FieldValueConfig>();
        var actualValue = context.EntityData[config.FieldName];
        
        bool passes = config.Operator switch
        {
            ComparisonOperator.Equals => 
                Equals(actualValue, config.ExpectedValue),
            ComparisonOperator.NotEquals => 
                !Equals(actualValue, config.ExpectedValue),
            ComparisonOperator.GreaterThan => 
                Compare(actualValue, config.ExpectedValue) > 0,
            ComparisonOperator.LessThan => 
                Compare(actualValue, config.ExpectedValue) < 0,
            ComparisonOperator.Contains => 
                actualValue?.ToString().Contains(config.ExpectedValue?.ToString()) ?? false,
            _ => false
        };
        
        return new ConditionResult
        {
            Passed = passes,
            ConditionId = condition.Id,
            Message = passes 
                ? "Field value condition satisfied" 
                : $"Expected {config.FieldName} {config.Operator} {config.ExpectedValue}, got {actualValue}"
        };
    }
}
```

**2. Role-Based Condition**
```csharp
public class RoleBasedConditionEvaluator : IConditionEvaluator
{
    public async Task<ConditionResult> EvaluateAsync(
        Condition condition,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = condition.Configuration.ToObject<RoleBasedConfig>();
        
        bool passes = config.Mode switch
        {
            RoleMatchMode.Any => 
                config.RequiredRoles.Any(r => context.Roles.Contains(r)),
            RoleMatchMode.All => 
                config.RequiredRoles.All(r => context.Roles.Contains(r)),
            RoleMatchMode.None => 
                !config.RequiredRoles.Any(r => context.Roles.Contains(r)),
            _ => false
        };
        
        return new ConditionResult
        {
            Passed = passes,
            ConditionId = condition.Id,
            Message = passes
                ? "User has required roles"
                : $"User missing required roles: {string.Join(", ", config.RequiredRoles)}"
        };
    }
}
```

**3. Time-Based Condition**
```csharp
public class TimeBasedConditionEvaluator : IConditionEvaluator
{
    private readonly ICalendarService _calendarService;
    
    public async Task<ConditionResult> EvaluateAsync(
        Condition condition,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = condition.Configuration.ToObject<TimeBasedConfig>();
        var calendar = await _calendarService.GetCalendarAsync(context.TenantId);
        
        bool passes = config.Rule switch
        {
            TimeRule.BusinessHoursOnly => 
                calendar.IsBusinessHour(context.Timestamp),
            TimeRule.WithinTimeWindow => 
                context.Timestamp >= config.StartTime && 
                context.Timestamp <= config.EndTime,
            TimeRule.MinimumAge => 
                (context.Timestamp - context.EntityData["CreatedAt"]) >= config.MinAge,
            _ => false
        };
        
        return new ConditionResult
        {
            Passed = passes,
            ConditionId = condition.Id
        };
    }
}
```

### 91.3 Composite Condition Evaluation

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Start[Start Evaluation] --> Mode{Logic Mode}
    
    Mode -->|AND| And[AND Logic]
    Mode -->|OR| Or[OR Logic]
    Mode -->|Custom| Custom[Custom Expression]
    
    And --> Loop1[For Each Condition]
    Loop1 --> Eval1[Evaluate]
    Eval1 --> Check1{Passed?}
    Check1 -->|No| Fail[Return False]
    Check1 -->|Yes| Next1{More?}
    Next1 -->|Yes| Loop1
    Next1 -->|No| Pass[Return True]
    
    Or --> Loop2[For Each Condition]
    Loop2 --> Eval2[Evaluate]
    Eval2 --> Check2{Passed?}
    Check2 -->|Yes| Pass
    Check2 -->|No| Next2{More?}
    Next2 -->|Yes| Loop2
    Next2 -->|No| Fail
```

**Composite Evaluation Engine:**
```csharp
public class CompositeConditionEvaluator
{
    public async Task<ConditionResult> EvaluateAllAsync(
        List<Condition> conditions,
        LogicMode mode,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var results = new List<ConditionResult>();
        
        foreach (var condition in conditions.OrderBy(c => c.OrderIndex))
        {
            var evaluator = _evaluatorFactory.GetEvaluator(condition.Type);
            var result = await evaluator.EvaluateAsync(condition, context);
            results.Add(result);
            
            // Short-circuit evaluation
            if (mode == LogicMode.And && !result.Passed && !condition.ContinueOnFailure)
                break;
            if (mode == LogicMode.Or && result.Passed)
                break;
        }
        
        bool overallPassed = mode switch
        {
            LogicMode.And => results.All(r => r.Passed),
            LogicMode.Or => results.Any(r => r.Passed),
            _ => false
        };
        
        return new ConditionResult
        {
            Passed = overallPassed,
            Details = results,
            Message = overallPassed 
                ? "All conditions satisfied" 
                : $"Failed conditions: {string.Join(", ", results.Where(r => !r.Passed).Select(r => r.Message))}"
        };
    }
}
```

### 92.2 Action Execution Pipeline

```csharp
public class ActionExecutionPipeline
{
    private readonly IActionExecutorFactory _factory;
    private readonly ILogger<ActionExecutionPipeline> _logger;
    
    public async Task<ActionExecutionResult> ExecuteActionsAsync(
        List<Action> actions,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var results = new List<ActionResult>();
        var synchronousActions = actions.Where(a => !a.IsAsync).OrderBy(a => a.OrderIndex);
        var asynchronousActions = actions.Where(a => a.IsAsync).OrderBy(a => a.OrderIndex);
        
        // Execute synchronous actions sequentially
        foreach (var action in synchronousActions)
        {
            try
            {
                var executor = _factory.GetExecutor(action.Type);
                var result = await executor.ExecuteAsync(action, context);
                results.Add(result);
                
                // Stop if critical action failed
                if (!result.Success && !action.ContinueOnError)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Critical action {ActionId} failed: {Error}", 
                        action.Id, 
                        result.Error);
                    break;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Action {ActionId} threw exception", action.Id);
                if (!action.ContinueOnError)
                    throw;
            }
        }
        
        // Queue asynchronous actions for background execution
        foreach (var action in asynchronousActions)
        {
            await _backgroundQueue.QueueAsync(new ActionExecutionJob
            {
                ActionId = action.Id,
                Context = context,
                ScheduledAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        }
        
        return new ActionExecutionResult
        {
            Success = results.All(r => r.Success),
            Results = results,
            AsynchronousActionCount = asynchronousActions.Count()
        };
    }
}
```

### 92.3 Built-in Action Types

**1. Assignment Action**
```csharp
public class AssignmentActionExecutor : IActionExecutor
{
    public async Task<ActionResult> ExecuteAsync(
        Action action, 
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = action.Configuration.ToObject<AssignmentConfig>();
        var entityId = context.EntityId;
        
        switch (config.Mode)
        {
            case AssignmentMode.AssignToUser:
                await _assignmentService.AssignAsync(entityId, config.UserId);
                break;
                
            case AssignmentMode.AssignToTeam:
                await _assignmentService.AssignToTeamAsync(entityId, config.TeamId);
                break;
                
            case AssignmentMode.AssignToRequester:
                await _assignmentService.AssignAsync(entityId, context.UserId);
                break;
                
            case AssignmentMode.Unassign:
                await _assignmentService.UnassignAsync(entityId);
                break;
        }
        
        return ActionResult.Success(action.Id);
    }
}
```

**2. Field Update Action**
```csharp
public class FieldUpdateActionExecutor : IActionExecutor
{
    public async Task<ActionResult> ExecuteAsync(
        Action action,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = action.Configuration.ToObject<FieldUpdateConfig>();
        
        var newValue = config.ValueType switch
        {
            ValueType.Static => config.StaticValue,
            ValueType.Expression => await EvaluateExpression(config.Expression, context),
            ValueType.ContextField => context.EntityData[config.ContextFieldName],
            _ => null
        };
        
        await _entityService.UpdateFieldAsync(
            context.EntityId,
            config.FieldName,
            newValue);
        
        return ActionResult.Success(action.Id);
    }
}
```

**3. Webhook Action**
```csharp
public class WebhookActionExecutor : IActionExecutor
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    
    public async Task<ActionResult> ExecuteAsync(
        Action action,
        IExecutionContext context)
    {
        var config = action.Configuration.ToObject<WebhookConfig>();
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient();
        client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(config.TimeoutSeconds);
        
        var payload = BuildPayload(config.PayloadTemplate, context);
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(config.Method, config.Url)
        {
            Content = new StringContent(
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload),
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json")
        };
        
        // Add authentication if configured
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.ApiKey))
        {
            request.Headers.Add("Authorization", $"Bearer {config.ApiKey}");
        }
        
        var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
        
        return response.IsSuccessStatusCode
            ? ActionResult.Success(action.Id)
            : ActionResult.Failure(action.Id, $"HTTP {response.StatusCode}");
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 93 - State Machine Versioning**

### 93.1 Version Management

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class StateMachine {
        +Guid Id
        +string Name
        +int CurrentVersion
        +bool IsDraft
        +StateMachineVersion Publish()
    }
    
    class StateMachineVersion {
        +Guid Id
        +Guid StateMachineId
        +int VersionNumber
        +DateTime PublishedAt
        +Guid PublishedBy
        +bool IsActive
        +bool IsDeprecated
        +List~State~ States
        +List~Transition~ Transitions
    }
    
    class VersionUsage {
        +Guid VersionId
        +string EntityType
        +int EntityCount
        +DateTime FirstUsed
        +DateTime LastUsed
    }
    
    StateMachine "1" --> "*" StateMachineVersion
    StateMachineVersion "1" --> "*" VersionUsage
```

**Version Lifecycle:**
1. **Draft** - Editable, not used by entities
2. **Published** - Immutable snapshot created
3. **Active** - Available for new entities
4. **Deprecated** - No new usage, existing continues
5. **Archived** - Historical reference only

**Publishing Process:**
```csharp
public class StateMachineVersioningService
{
    public async Task<StateMachineVersion> PublishVersionAsync(
        Guid stateMachineId, 
        Guid userId)
    {
        var machine = await _repository.GetAsync(stateMachineId);
        
        // Validate before publishing
        var validation = _validator.Validate(machine);
        if (!validation.IsValid)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"Cannot publish invalid state machine: {string.Join(", ", validation.Errors)}");
        }
        
        // Create immutable snapshot
        var version = new StateMachineVersion
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            StateMachineId = machine.Id,
            VersionNumber = machine.CurrentVersion + 1,
            PublishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            PublishedBy = userId,
            IsActive = true,
            States = machine.States.Select(s => s.Clone()).ToList(),
            Transitions = machine.Transitions.Select(t => t.Clone()).ToList()
        };
        
        await _versionRepository.InsertAsync(version);
        
        // Update machine metadata
        machine.CurrentVersion = version.VersionNumber;
        machine.IsDraft = false;
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(machine);
        
        // Invalidate caches
        await _cache.InvalidateAsync($"statemachine:{machine.Id}");
        
        // Emit event
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new StateMachineVersionPublishedEto
        {
            StateMachineId = machine.Id,
            VersionId = version.Id,
            VersionNumber = version.VersionNumber
        });
        
        return version;
    }
}
```

### 93.2 Version Migration Strategy

**Graceful Migration Pattern:**
```csharp
public class StateMachineVersionMigrationService
{
    public async Task<MigrationResult> MigrateEntitiesAsync(
        Guid oldVersionId,
        Guid newVersionId,
        MigrationStrategy strategy)
    {
        var oldVersion = await _versionRepository.GetAsync(oldVersionId);
        var newVersion = await _versionRepository.GetAsync(newVersionId);
        
        // Build state mapping
        var stateMapping = BuildStateMapping(oldVersion, newVersion);
        
        // Find all entities using old version
        var entities = await _entityRepository.GetByVersionAsync(oldVersionId);
        
        var migrated = 0;
        var failed = 0;
        
        foreach (var entity in entities)
        {
            try
            {
                var currentStateId = entity.CurrentStateId;
                
                if (!stateMapping.TryGetValue(currentStateId, out var newStateId))
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "No mapping found for state {StateId} in entity {EntityId}",
                        currentStateId,
                        entity.Id);
                    failed++;
                    continue;
                }
                
                entity.StateMachineVersionId = newVersionId;
                entity.CurrentStateId = newStateId;
                
                if (strategy == MigrationStrategy.ValidateTransitions)
                {
                    // Verify entity can still perform necessary transitions
                    var validator = new TransitionCompatibilityValidator();
                    if (!validator.IsCompatible(entity, newVersion))
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "Entity {EntityId} incompatible with new version",
                            entity.Id);
                        failed++;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                
                await _entityRepository.UpdateAsync(entity);
                migrated++;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to migrate entity {EntityId}", entity.Id);
                failed++;
            }
        }
        
        return new MigrationResult
        {
            TotalEntities = entities.Count,
            SuccessfulMigrations = migrated,
            FailedMigrations = failed
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 94 - State Machine Graph Analysis**

### 94.1 Reachability Analysis

```csharp
public class StateMachineGraphAnalyzer
{
    public ReachabilityReport AnalyzeReachability(StateMachine machine)
    {
        var initialState = machine.States.First(s => s.IsInitial);
        var reachable = new HashSet<Guid>();
        var queue = new Queue<Guid>();
        
        queue.Enqueue(initialState.Id);
        reachable.Add(initialState.Id);
        
        while (queue.Count > 0)
        {
            var current = queue.Dequeue();
            var transitions = machine.Transitions
                .Where(t => t.FromStateId == current || t.IsGlobal);
            
            foreach (var transition in transitions)
            {
                if (!reachable.Contains(transition.ToStateId))
                {
                    reachable.Add(transition.ToStateId);
                    queue.Enqueue(transition.ToStateId);
                }
            }
        }
        
        var unreachable = machine.States
            .Where(s => !reachable.Contains(s.Id) && !s.IsInitial)
            .ToList();
        
        return new ReachabilityReport
        {
            TotalStates = machine.States.Count,
            ReachableStates = reachable.Count,
            UnreachableStates = unreachable,
            IsValid = unreachable.Count == 0
        };
    }
}
```

### 94.2 Cycle Detection

```csharp
public class CycleDetector
{
    public CycleDetectionResult DetectCycles(StateMachine machine)
    {
        var visited = new HashSet<Guid>();
        var recursionStack = new HashSet<Guid>();
        var cycles = new List<List<Guid>>();
        
        foreach (var state in machine.States.Where(s => !s.IsTerminal))
        {
            if (!visited.Contains(state.Id))
            {
                DetectCyclesDFS(
                    machine, 
                    state.Id, 
                    visited, 
                    recursionStack, 
                    cycles, 
                    new List<Guid>());
            }
        }
        
        return new CycleDetectionResult
        {
            HasCycles = cycles.Any(),
            Cycles = cycles,
            Message = cycles.Any() 
                ? $"Found {cycles.Count} cycle(s)" 
                : "No cycles detected"
        };
    }
    
    private bool DetectCyclesDFS(
        StateMachine machine,
        Guid stateId,
        HashSet<Guid> visited,
        HashSet<Guid> recursionStack,
        List<List<Guid>> cycles,
        List<Guid> currentPath)
    {
        visited.Add(stateId);
        recursionStack.Add(stateId);
        currentPath.Add(stateId);
        
        var transitions = machine.Transitions
            .Where(t => t.FromStateId == stateId);
        
        foreach (var transition in transitions)
        {
            if (!visited.Contains(transition.ToStateId))
            {
                if (DetectCyclesDFS(
                    machine, 
                    transition.ToStateId, 
                    visited, 
                    recursionStack, 
                    cycles, 
                    currentPath))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            else if (recursionStack.Contains(transition.ToStateId))
            {
                // Cycle detected
                var cycleStart = currentPath.IndexOf(transition.ToStateId);
                cycles.Add(currentPath.Skip(cycleStart).ToList());
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        recursionStack.Remove(stateId);
        currentPath.RemoveAt(currentPath.Count - 1);
        return false;
    }
}
```

### 94.3 Critical Path Analysis

```csharp
public class CriticalPathAnalyzer
{
    public CriticalPathResult AnalyzeCriticalPath(StateMachine machine)
    {
        var initialState = machine.States.First(s => s.IsInitial);
        var terminalStates = machine.States.Where(s => s.IsTerminal).ToList();
        
        var longestPaths = new Dictionary<Guid, PathInfo>();
        
        foreach (var terminal in terminalStates)
        {
            var path = FindLongestPath(machine, initialState.Id, terminal.Id);
            longestPaths[terminal.Id] = path;
        }
        
        var criticalPath = longestPaths.Values.OrderByDescending(p => p.Length).First();
        
        return new CriticalPathResult
        {
            Path = criticalPath.States,
            Length = criticalPath.Length,
            Transitions = criticalPath.Transitions,
            EstimatedDuration = CalculateDuration(criticalPath)
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 95 - State Machine Performance Optimization**

### 95.1 Caching Strategy

```csharp
public class StateMachineCacheService
{
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    private readonly TimeSpan _cacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);
    
    public async Task<StateMachineVersion> GetCachedVersionAsync(Guid versionId)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"statemachine:version:{versionId}";
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(cacheKey);
        
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<StateMachineVersion>(cached);
        }
        
        var version = await _repository.GetVersionAsync(versionId);
        
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            cacheKey,
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(version),
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheDuration
            });
        
        return version;
    }
    
    public async Task<List<Transition>> GetAvailableTransitionsAsync(
        Guid versionId, 
        Guid stateId)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"statemachine:transitions:{versionId}:{stateId}";
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(cacheKey);
        
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<Transition>>(cached);
        }
        
        var version = await GetCachedVersionAsync(versionId);
        var transitions = version.Transitions
            .Where(t => t.FromStateId == stateId || t.IsGlobal)
            .ToList();
        
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            cacheKey,
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(transitions),
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheDuration
            });
        
        return transitions;
    }
}
```

### 95.2 Transition Graph Precompilation

```csharp
public class TransitionGraphCompiler
{
    public CompiledTransitionGraph Compile(StateMachineVersion version)
    {
        // Build adjacency list for O(1) lookups
        var adjacencyList = version.States.ToDictionary(
            s => s.Id,
            s => new List<Transition>());
        
        foreach (var transition in version.Transitions)
        {
            if (transition.IsGlobal)
            {
                // Add to all states
                foreach (var state in adjacencyList.Keys)
                {
                    adjacencyList[state].Add(transition);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                adjacencyList[transition.FromStateId].Add(transition);
            }
        }
        
        // Precompute reachability matrix
        var reachability = ComputeReachabilityMatrix(version.States, adjacencyList);
        
        // Identify critical paths
        var criticalPaths = ComputeCriticalPaths(version, adjacencyList);
        
        return new CompiledTransitionGraph
        {
            VersionId = version.Id,
            AdjacencyList = adjacencyList,
            ReachabilityMatrix = reachability,
            CriticalPaths = criticalPaths,
            CompiledAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 96 - State Machine Usage Examples**

### 96.1 Task Workflow Integration

```csharp
public class TaskWorkflowService
{
    private readonly IStateMachineEngine _engine;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    
    public async Task<TransitionResult> TransitionTaskAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid transitionId,
        Guid userId,
        string comment)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(taskId);
        var workflowVersion = await _workflowRepository.GetVersionAsync(
            task.WorkflowVersionId);
        
        var context = new ExecutionContext
        {
            UserId = userId,
            TenantId = task.TenantId,
            Roles = await _identityService.GetUserRolesAsync(userId),
            EntityId = taskId,
            EntityType = "TaskInstance",
            EntityData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["Priority"] = task.Priority,
                ["ProjectId"] = task.ProjectId,
                ["AssigneeId"] = task.AssigneeId,
                ["CustomFields"] = task.CustomFieldValues
            },
            Comment = comment
        };
        
        var result = await _engine.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
            workflowVersion.StateMachine,
            task.CurrentStateId,
            transitionId,
            context);
        
        if (result.Success)
        {
            task.CurrentStateId = result.NewStateId.Value;
            task.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            task.UpdatedBy = userId;
            
            await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task);
            
            // Emit domain event
            await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TaskTransitionedEto
            {
                TaskId = taskId,
                FromStateId = task.CurrentStateId,
                ToStateId = result.NewStateId.Value,
                TransitionId = transitionId,
                UserId = userId,
                Comment = comment
            });
        }
        
        return result;
    }
}
```

### 96.2 Approval Workflow Integration

```csharp
public class ApprovalWorkflowService
{
    public async Task<TransitionResult> ProcessApprovalStepAsync(
        Guid approvalRequestId,
        Guid stepId,
        ApprovalDecision decision,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var request = await _approvalRepository.GetAsync(approvalRequestId);
        var workflowVersion = await _workflowRepository.GetVersionAsync(
            request.WorkflowVersionId);
        
        var context = new ExecutionContext
        {
            UserId = userId,
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            EntityId = approvalRequestId,
            EntityType = "ApprovalRequest",
            EntityData = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["RequesterId"] = request.RequestedBy,
                ["Priority"] = request.Priority,
                ["Decision"] = decision
            }
        };
        
        // Determine transition based on decision
        var transitionId = decision == ApprovalDecision.Approved
            ? workflowVersion.StateMachine.Transitions
                .First(t => t.Name == "Approve" && t.FromStateId == stepId).Id
            : workflowVersion.StateMachine.Transitions
                .First(t => t.Name == "Reject" && t.FromStateId == stepId).Id;
        
        var result = await _engine.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
            workflowVersion.StateMachine,
            stepId,
            transitionId,
            context);
        
        if (result.Success)
        {
            request.CurrentStepId = result.NewStateId;
            await _approvalRepository.UpdateAsync(request);
        }
        
        return result;
    }
}
```

# **PART XXII - IDENTITY & OWNERSHIP KERNEL**

---

## **Chapter 97 - Identity & Ownership Kernel Overview**

### 97.1 Purpose and Scope

The **Identity & Ownership Kernel** is a foundational shared component that provides a unified model for:
- Entity ownership and access control
- User identity resolution across contexts
- Multi-tenancy isolation enforcement
- Actor tracking for audit trails
- Permission and role integration points

**Primary Purpose:**
- Ensure consistent identity management across all contexts
- Provide single source of truth for "who owns what"
- Enable secure, tenant-isolated operations
- Support audit and compliance requirements

**Scope of Application:**
- All aggregates requiring ownership semantics
- All operations requiring actor identification
- All multi-tenant data isolation
- All authorization and permission checks
- All audit trail generation

### 97.2 Core Design Principles

**1. Identity as First-Class Citizen**  
Every significant entity and action is associated with an identity.

**2. Tenant Isolation by Default**  
All data is scoped to a tenant unless explicitly marked as global.

**3. Ownership Semantics**  
Clear distinction between creator, owner, and assignee roles.

**4. Immutable Actor Records**  
Historical actor information cannot be changed even if user is deleted.

**5. Role-Based Access Integration**  
Identity kernel integrates with but does not implement authorization.

**6. Federation-Ready**  
Supports external identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, Google, SAML).

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Marks entity as belonging to a specific tenant

public interface IHasTenant
{

    Guid? TenantId { get; set; }
```
