**Actor Implementation:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Represents an entity performing actions in the system
/// </summary>
public class Actor : ValueObject
{
    public Guid? UserId { get; private set; }
    public ActorType ActorType { get; private set; }
    public string DisplayName { get; private set; }
    public string Email { get; private set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; private set; }
    
    // Private constructor for EF Core
    private Actor() { }
    
    private Actor(
        Guid? userId,
        ActorType actorType,
        string displayName,
        string email,
        Dictionary<string, object> metadata = null)
    {
        UserId = userId;
        ActorType = actorType;
        DisplayName = displayName;
        Email = email;
        Metadata = metadata ?? new Dictionary<string, object>();
    }
    
    public bool IsSystem() => ActorType == ActorType.System;
    public bool IsUser() => ActorType == ActorType.User;
    public bool IsService() => ActorType == ActorType.Service;
    public bool IsAnonymous() => ActorType == ActorType.Anonymous;
    
    public static Actor FromUser(User user)
    {
        return new Actor(
            user.Id,
            ActorType.User,
            user.DisplayName,
            user.Email);
    }
    
    public static Actor FromSystem(string systemName)
    {
        return new Actor(
            null,
            ActorType.System,
            systemName,
            null,
            new Dictionary<string, object> { ["SystemName"] = systemName });
    }
    
    public static Actor FromService(Guid serviceId, string serviceName)
    {
        return new Actor(
            serviceId,
            ActorType.Service,
            serviceName,
            null,
            new Dictionary<string, object> { ["ServiceId"] = serviceId });
    }
    
    public static Actor Anonymous()
    {
        return new Actor(
            null,
            ActorType.Anonymous,
            "Anonymous",
            null);
    }
    
    protected override IEnumerable<object> GetEqualityComponents()
    {
        yield return UserId;
        yield return ActorType;
        yield return DisplayName;
    }
}

public enum ActorType
{
    User,
    System,
    Service,
    Anonymous,
    Impersonated
}
```

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Value object representing entity ownership
/// </summary>
public class OwnershipInfo : ValueObject
{
    public Guid OwnerId { get; private set; }
    public OwnershipType Type { get; private set; }
    public DateTime AcquiredAt { get; private set; }
    public Guid? TransferredFrom { get; private set; }
    public DateTime? TransferredAt { get; private set; }
    public bool CanTransfer { get; private set; }
    
    private OwnershipInfo() { }
    
    public static OwnershipInfo Create(Guid ownerId, OwnershipType type)
    {
        return new OwnershipInfo
        {
            OwnerId = ownerId,
            Type = type,
            AcquiredAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            CanTransfer = true
        };
    }
    
    public OwnershipInfo TransferTo(Guid newOwnerId, OwnershipType newType)
    {
        if (!CanTransfer)
        {
            throw new BusinessException("Ownership cannot be transferred");
        }
        
        return new OwnershipInfo
        {
            OwnerId = newOwnerId,
            Type = newType,
            AcquiredAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            TransferredFrom = this.OwnerId,
            TransferredAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            CanTransfer = true
        };
    }
    
    public OwnershipInfo MakePermanent()
    {
        var updated = this.Clone();
        updated.CanTransfer = false;
        return updated;
    }
    
    protected override IEnumerable<object> GetEqualityComponents()
    {
        yield return OwnerId;
        yield return Type;
        yield return AcquiredAt;
    }
}

public enum OwnershipType
{
    User,
    Team,
    OrganizationalUnit,
    System
}
```

**Tenant Context Implementation:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Provides access to current tenant context
/// </summary>
public class TenantContext : ITenantContext
{
    private Guid? _currentTenantId;
    private bool _isResolved;
    
    public Guid? CurrentTenantId
    {
        get
        {
            if (!_isResolved)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    "Tenant context has not been resolved");
            }
            return _currentTenantId;
        }
    }
    
    public bool IsTenantResolved => _isResolved;
    
    public void SetTenant(Guid? tenantId)
    {
        _currentTenantId = tenantId;
        _isResolved = true;
    }
    
    public void ClearTenant()
    {
        _currentTenantId = null;
        _isResolved = false;
    }
    
    public bool IsInTenant(Guid tenantId)
    {
        return _isResolved && _currentTenantId == tenantId;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Resolves tenant from various sources
/// </summary>
public interface ITenantResolver
{
    Task<Guid?> ResolveCurrentTenantAsync();
}

/// <summary>
/// Resolves tenant from HTTP context (headers, subdomain, etc.)
/// </summary>
public class HttpTenantResolver : ITenantResolver
{
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
    
    public async Task<Guid?> ResolveCurrentTenantAsync()
    {
        var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
        if (httpContext == null)
            return null;
        
        // Strategy 1: Check header
        if (httpContext.Request.Headers.TryGetValue("X-Tenant-Id", out var tenantIdHeader))
        {
            if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdHeader, out var tenantId))
                return tenantId;
        }
        
        // Strategy 2: Check subdomain
        var host = httpContext.Request.Host.Host;
        var subdomain = ExtractSubdomain(host);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(subdomain))
        {
            var tenant = await _tenantRepository.FindBySubdomainAsync(subdomain);
            return tenant?.Id;
        }
        
        // Strategy 3: Check user claims
        var userId = httpContext.User.FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
        if (Guid.TryParse(userId, out var userGuid))
        {
            var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(userGuid);
            return user?.TenantId;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    private string ExtractSubdomain(string host)
    {
        var parts = host.Split('.');
        return parts.Length > 2 ? parts[0] : null;
    }
}
```

### 99.2 Multi-Tenant Data Filtering

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Automatically applies tenant filtering to queries
/// </summary>
public class TenantDataFilter : IDataFilter
{
    private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
    
    public void ApplyFilter<TEntity>(IQueryable<TEntity> query) 
        where TEntity : class, IMultiTenant
    {
        if (_tenantContext.CurrentTenantId.HasValue)
        {
            var tenantId = _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId.Value;
            query = query.Where(e => e.TenantId == tenantId);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// EF Core configuration for automatic tenant filtering
/// </summary>
public static class TenantFilterConfiguration
{
    public static void ConfigureTenantFilter(this ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        foreach (var entityType in modelBuilder.Model.GetEntityTypes())
        {
            if (typeof(IMultiTenant).IsAssignableFrom(entityType.ClrType))
            {
                var parameter = Expression.Parameter(entityType.ClrType, "e");
                var property = Expression.Property(parameter, nameof(IMultiTenant.TenantId));
                var tenantIdProperty = Expression.Property(
                    Expression.Constant(GetTenantContext()),
                    nameof(ITenantContext.CurrentTenantId));
                
                var equals = Expression.Equal(property, tenantIdProperty);
                var lambda = Expression.Lambda(equals, parameter);
                
                modelBuilder.Entity(entityType.ClrType)
                    .HasQueryFilter(lambda);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 99.3 Tenant Isolation Enforcement

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Interceptor ensuring tenant isolation on all operations
/// </summary>
public class TenantIsolationInterceptor : SaveChangesInterceptor
{
    private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
    
    public override InterceptionResult<int> SavingChanges(
        DbContextEventData eventData,
        InterceptionResult<int> result)
    {
        if (eventData.Context == null)
            return result;
        
        foreach (var entry in eventData.Context.ChangeTracker.Entries<IMultiTenant>())
        {
            switch (entry.State)
            {
                case EntityState.Added:
                    // Set tenant on new entities
                    if (entry.Entity.TenantId == null && _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId.HasValue)
                    {
                        entry.Entity.TenantId = _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId;
                    }
                    break;
                    
                case EntityState.Modified:
                case EntityState.Deleted:
                    // Verify tenant on modifications/deletions
                    if (entry.Entity.TenantId != _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId)
                    {
                        throw new TenantMismatchException(
                            $"Cannot modify entity from different tenant. " +
                            $"Entity tenant: {entry.Entity.TenantId}, " +
                            $"Current tenant: {_tenantContext.CurrentTenantId}");
                    }
                    break;
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Exception thrown when tenant isolation is violated
/// </summary>
public class TenantMismatchException : BusinessException
{
    public TenantMismatchException(string message) : base(message)
    {
    }
}
```

**Identity Resolution Implementation:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Resolves complete user identity with roles, teams, and org structure
/// </summary>
public interface IIdentityResolver
{
    Task<ResolvedIdentity> ResolveAsync(Guid userId);
    Task<ResolvedIdentity> ResolveByEmailAsync(string email);
    Task<List<ResolvedIdentity>> ResolveManyAsync(IEnumerable<Guid> userIds);
}

public class ResolvedIdentity
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string Email { get; set; }
    public string DisplayName { get; set; }
    public string FirstName { get; set; }
    public string LastName { get; set; }
    public List<string> Roles { get; set; }
    public List<Guid> TeamIds { get; set; }
    public List<string> TeamNames { get; set; }
    public Guid? OrganizationalUnitId { get; set; }
    public string OrganizationalUnitName { get; set; }
    public Guid? ManagerId { get; set; }
    public string ManagerName { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; }
    
    public bool HasRole(string role) => Roles?.Contains(role) ?? false;
    public bool IsInTeam(Guid teamId) => TeamIds?.Contains(teamId) ?? false;
    public bool HasAnyRole(params string[] roles) => 
        Roles?.Any(r => roles.Contains(r)) ?? false;
    public bool HasAllRoles(params string[] roles) => 
        roles.All(r => Roles?.Contains(r) ?? false);
}

public class CachedIdentityResolver : IIdentityResolver
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepository;
    private readonly ITeamRepository _teamRepository;
    private readonly IOrganizationalUnitRepository _orgUnitRepository;
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    private readonly TimeSpan _cacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15);
    
    public async Task<ResolvedIdentity> ResolveAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"identity:{userId}";
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(cacheKey);
        
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ResolvedIdentity>(cached);
        }
        
        var identity = await BuildIdentityAsync(userId);
        
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            cacheKey,
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(identity),
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = _cacheDuration
            });
        
        return identity;
    }
    
    private async Task<ResolvedIdentity> BuildIdentityAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(userId);
        var roles = await _roleRepository.GetUserRolesAsync(userId);
        var teams = await _teamRepository.GetUserTeamsAsync(userId);
        var orgUnit = user.OrganizationalUnitId.HasValue
            ? await _orgUnitRepository.GetAsync(user.OrganizationalUnitId.Value)
            : null;
        var manager = user.ManagerId.HasValue
            ? await _userRepository.GetAsync(user.ManagerId.Value)
            : null;
        
        return new ResolvedIdentity
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TenantId = user.TenantId,
            Email = user.Email,
            DisplayName = user.DisplayName,
            FirstName = user.FirstName,
            LastName = user.LastName,
            Roles = roles.Select(r => r.Name).ToList(),
            TeamIds = teams.Select(t => t.Id).ToList(),
            TeamNames = teams.Select(t => t.Name).ToList(),
            OrganizationalUnitId = orgUnit?.Id,
            OrganizationalUnitName = orgUnit?.Name,
            ManagerId = manager?.Id,
            ManagerName = manager?.DisplayName,
            Metadata = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["Department"] = orgUnit?.Name,
                ["Title"] = user.JobTitle,
                ["Location"] = user.Location
            }
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<List<ResolvedIdentity>> ResolveManyAsync(
        IEnumerable<Guid> userIds)
    {
        var tasks = userIds.Select(id => ResolveAsync(id));
        return (await Task.WhenAll(tasks)).ToList();
    }
}
```

### 100.2 Current User Context

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Provides access to current authenticated user
/// </summary>
public interface ICurrentUser
{
    Guid? UserId { get; }
    Guid? TenantId { get; }
    string Email { get; }
    string DisplayName { get; }
    bool IsAuthenticated { get; }
    bool IsInRole(string role);
    bool IsInTeam(Guid teamId);
    Task<ResolvedIdentity> GetFullIdentityAsync();
}

public class CurrentUser : ICurrentUser
{
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    private ResolvedIdentity _cachedIdentity;
    
    public Guid? UserId
    {
        get
        {
            var userIdClaim = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User
                .FindFirst("sub")?.Value;
            return Guid.TryParse(userIdClaim, out var id) ? id : null;
        }
    }
    
    public Guid? TenantId
    {
        get
        {
            var tenantIdClaim = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User
                .FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
            return Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var id) ? id : null;
        }
    }
    
    public string Email => 
        _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User.FindFirst("email")?.Value;
    
    public string DisplayName => 
        _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User.FindFirst("name")?.Value;
    
    public bool IsAuthenticated => 
        _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.Identity?.IsAuthenticated ?? false;
    
    public bool IsInRole(string role)
    {
        return _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User.IsInRole(role) ?? false;
    }
    
    public bool IsInTeam(Guid teamId)
    {
        var teamsClaim = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User
            .FindFirst("teams")?.Value;
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(teamsClaim))
            return false;
        
        var teams = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<Guid>>(teamsClaim);
        return teams?.Contains(teamId) ?? false;
    }
    
    public async Task<ResolvedIdentity> GetFullIdentityAsync()
    {
        if (_cachedIdentity != null)
            return _cachedIdentity;
        
        if (!UserId.HasValue)
            return null;
        
        _cachedIdentity = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(UserId.Value);
        return _cachedIdentity;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 101 - Actor Tracking and Audit**

### 101.1 Audit Trail Enrichment

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Automatically captures actor information for audit purposes
/// </summary>
public class AuditEnrichmentInterceptor : SaveChangesInterceptor
{
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    
    public override async ValueTask<InterceptionResult<int>> SavingChangesAsync(
        DbContextEventData eventData,
        InterceptionResult<int> result,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (eventData.Context == null)
            return result;
        
        var actor = await GetCurrentActorAsync();
        var timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        foreach (var entry in eventData.Context.ChangeTracker.Entries())
        {
            // Handle creation tracking
            if (entry.State == EntityState.Added && entry.Entity is IHasCreator creator)
            {
                creator.CreatedBy = actor.UserId ?? Guid.Empty;
                creator.CreatedAt = timestamp;
            }
            
            // Handle modification tracking
            if (entry.State == EntityState.Modified && entry.Entity is IHasModifier modifier)
            {
                modifier.LastModifiedBy = actor.UserId;
                modifier.LastModifiedAt = timestamp;
            }
            
            // Handle ownership assignment
            if (entry.State == EntityState.Added && entry.Entity is IHasOwner owned)
            {
                if (owned.OwnerId == Guid.Empty)
                {
                    owned.OwnerId = actor.UserId ?? Guid.Empty;
                }
            }
            
            // Handle tenant assignment
            if (entry.State == EntityState.Added && entry.Entity is IMultiTenant tenanted)
            {
                if (tenanted.TenantId == null && _currentUser.TenantId.HasValue)
                {
                    tenanted.TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private async Task<Actor> GetCurrentActorAsync()
    {
        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || !_currentUser.UserId.HasValue)
        {
            return Actor.Anonymous();
        }
        
        var identity = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(_currentUser.UserId.Value);
        return Actor.FromUser(new User 
        { 
            Id = identity.UserId,
            Email = identity.Email,
            DisplayName = identity.DisplayName
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Represents a single change to an entity
/// </summary>
public class ChangeRecord : ValueObject
{
    public Guid EntityId { get; private set; }
    public string EntityType { get; private set; }
    public ChangeType Type { get; private set; }
    public Actor Actor { get; private set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; private set; }
    public string PropertyName { get; private set; }
    public string OldValue { get; private set; }
    public string NewValue { get; private set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Context { get; private set; }
    
    private ChangeRecord() { }
    
    public static ChangeRecord Create(
        Guid entityId,
        string entityType,
        ChangeType changeType,
        Actor actor,
        string propertyName = null,
        string oldValue = null,
        string newValue = null,
        Dictionary<string, object> context = null)
    {
        return new ChangeRecord
        {
            EntityId = entityId,
            EntityType = entityType,
            Type = changeType,
            Actor = actor,
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            PropertyName = propertyName,
            OldValue = oldValue,
            NewValue = newValue,
            Context = context ?? new Dictionary<string, object>()
        };
    }
    
    protected override IEnumerable<object> GetEqualityComponents()
    {
        yield return EntityId;
        yield return EntityType;
        yield return Type;
        yield return Actor;
        yield return Timestamp;
        yield return PropertyName;
    }
}

public enum ChangeType
{
    Created,
    Modified,
    Deleted,
    StatusChanged,
    OwnershipTransferred,
    PermissionChanged,
    Archived,
    Restored
}
```

```csharp
    public List<string> Reasons { get; set; }

    {
        return new PermissionResult
        {

            Source = source,
            Reasons = reason != null ? new List<string> { reason } : new List<string>()
        };
    }
```

### 102.2 Owner-Based Authorization

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Authorizes based on entity ownership
/// </summary>
public class OwnershipAuthorizationService
{
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    
    public async Task<bool> IsOwnerAsync<TEntity>(TEntity entity) 
        where TEntity : IHasOwner
    {
        if (!_currentUser.IsAuthenticated || !_currentUser.UserId.HasValue)
            return false;
        
        return entity.OwnerId == _currentUser.UserId.Value;
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> CanAccessAsync<TEntity>(TEntity entity)
        where TEntity : IHasOwner, IMultiTenant
    {
        // Check tenant match
        if (entity.TenantId != _currentUser.TenantId)
            return false;
        
        // Check if owner
        if (await IsOwnerAsync(entity))
            return true;
        
        // Check if admin
        if (_currentUser.IsInRole("Admin"))
            return true;
        
        return false;
    }
    
    public async Task EnsureOwnershipAsync<TEntity>(TEntity entity)
        where TEntity : IHasOwner
    {
        if (!await IsOwnerAsync(entity))
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedAccessException(
                $"User {_currentUser.UserId} is not the owner of {typeof(TEntity).Name} {entity.OwnerId}");
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Links internal user to external identity provider
/// </summary>
public class ExternalIdentity : Entity
{
    public Guid UserId { get; private set; }
    public string Provider { get; private set; }
    public string ProviderKey { get; private set; }

    public static ExternalIdentity Create(
        Guid userId,
        string provider,
        string providerKey,
        string providerDisplayName,
        Dictionary<string, string> claims = null)
    {
        return new ExternalIdentity
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            UserId = userId,
            Provider = provider,
            ProviderKey = providerKey,
            ProviderDisplayName = providerDisplayName,
            LinkedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Claims = claims ?? new Dictionary<string, string>()
        };

/// <summary>
/// Synchronizes external identity with internal user
/// </summary>
public class ExternalIdentitySyncService
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IExternalIdentityRepository _externalIdentityRepository;
    
    public async Task<User> SyncExternalIdentityAsync(
        string provider,
        string providerKey,
        ExternalUserInfo externalInfo)
    {
        // Find existing link
        var externalIdentity = await _externalIdentityRepository
            .FindByProviderAsync(provider, providerKey);
        
        if (externalIdentity != null)
        {
            // Update existing user
            var user = await _userRepository.GetAsync(externalIdentity.UserId);
            UpdateUserFromExternal(user, externalInfo);
            await _userRepository.UpdateAsync(user);
            return user;
        }
        
        // Try to find by email
        var existingUser = await _userRepository.FindByEmailAsync(externalInfo.Email);
        
        if (existingUser != null)
        {
            // Link to existing user
            var newLink = ExternalIdentity.Create(
                existingUser.Id,
                provider,
                providerKey,
                externalInfo.ProviderName,
                externalInfo.Claims);
            
            await _externalIdentityRepository.InsertAsync(newLink);
            return existingUser;
        }
        
        // Create new user
        var newUser = new User
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Email = externalInfo.Email,
            DisplayName = externalInfo.DisplayName,
            FirstName = externalInfo.FirstName,
            LastName = externalInfo.LastName,
            EmailConfirmed = externalInfo.EmailVerified,
            TenantId = await ResolveTenantAsync(externalInfo)
        };
        
        await _userRepository.InsertAsync(newUser);
        
        var identity = ExternalIdentity.Create(
            newUser.Id,
            provider,
            providerKey,
            externalInfo.ProviderName,
            externalInfo.Claims);
        
        await _externalIdentityRepository.InsertAsync(identity);
        
        return newUser;
    }
}
```

### 103.2 Federated Identity Claims Mapping

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Maps external identity provider claims to internal model
/// </summary>
public class ClaimsMappingService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Func<ClaimsPrincipal, string>> _mappings;
    
    public ClaimsMappingService()
    {
        _mappings = new Dictionary<string, Func<ClaimsPrincipal, string>>
        {
            ["AzureAD:email"] = p => p.FindFirst("http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress")?.Value,
            ["AzureAD:name"] = p => p.FindFirst("name")?.Value,
            ["AzureAD:given_name"] = p => p.FindFirst("given_name")?.Value,
            ["AzureAD:family_name"] = p => p.FindFirst("family_name")?.Value,
            ["AzureAD:tenant_id"] = p => p.FindFirst("http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/tenantid")?.Value,
            
            ["Google:email"] = p => p.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Email)?.Value,
            ["Google:name"] = p => p.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Name)?.Value,
            ["Google:given_name"] = p => p.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.GivenName)?.Value,
            ["Google:family_name"] = p => p.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.Surname)?.Value,
            
            ["Okta:email"] = p => p.FindFirst("email")?.Value,
            ["Okta:name"] = p => p.FindFirst("name")?.Value,
            ["Okta:groups"] = p => p.FindFirst("groups")?.Value
        };
    }
    
    public ExternalUserInfo MapClaims(string provider, ClaimsPrincipal principal)
    {
        return new ExternalUserInfo
        {
            Provider = provider,
            ProviderKey = principal.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)?.Value,
            Email = GetMappedClaim(provider, "email", principal),
            DisplayName = GetMappedClaim(provider, "name", principal),
            FirstName = GetMappedClaim(provider, "given_name", principal),
            LastName = GetMappedClaim(provider, "family_name", principal),
            EmailVerified = bool.Parse(GetMappedClaim(provider, "email_verified", principal) ?? "false"),
            Claims = principal.Claims.ToDictionary(c => c.Type, c => c.Value)
        };
    }
    
    private string GetMappedClaim(string provider, string claimType, ClaimsPrincipal principal)
    {
        var key = $"{provider}:{claimType}";
        if (_mappings.TryGetValue(key, out var mapping))
        {
            return mapping(principal);
        }
        return null;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 104 - Identity Kernel Usage Patterns**

### 104.1 Aggregate Integration Example

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Task Instance with full identity integration
/// </summary>
public class TaskInstance : AggregateRoot, IMultiTenant, IAuditable, IHasOwner
{
    // Identity & Ownership Kernel properties
    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid OwnerId { get; set; }
    public Guid CreatedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public Guid? LastModifiedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastModifiedAt { get; set; }
    
    // Business properties
    public string Title { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public Guid? AssigneeId { get; private set; }
    public TaskStatus Status { get; private set; }
    
    protected TaskInstance() { }
    
    public static TaskInstance Create(
        string title,
        string description,
        Guid ownerId,
        Guid createdBy,
        Guid tenantId)
    {
        var task = new TaskInstance
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = title,
            Description = description,
            OwnerId = ownerId,
            CreatedBy = createdBy,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            TenantId = tenantId,
            Status = TaskStatus.Todo
        };
        
        task.AddDomainEvent(new TaskCreatedEto
        {
            TaskId = task.Id,
            Title = title,
            OwnerId = ownerId,
            CreatedBy = createdBy,
            TenantId = tenantId
        });
        
        return task;
    }
    
    public void AssignTo(Guid assigneeId, Actor actor)
    {
        // Business validation
        if (Status == TaskStatus.Completed)
        {
            throw new BusinessException("Cannot assign completed task");
        }
        
        var previousAssignee = AssigneeId;
        AssigneeId = assigneeId;
        
        // Audit trail automatically captured by interceptor
        // LastModifiedBy and LastModifiedAt set automatically
        
        AddDomainEvent(new TaskAssignedEto
        {
            TaskId = Id,
            PreviousAssigneeId = previousAssignee,
            NewAssigneeId = assigneeId,
            AssignedBy = actor
        });
    }
}
```

### 104.2 Repository Pattern with Identity

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Repository automatically enforcing tenant isolation
/// </summary>
public class TaskInstanceRepository : RepositoryBase<TaskInstance, Guid>, ITaskInstanceRepository
{
    private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    
    public TaskInstanceRepository(
        IDbContextProvider<WorkManagementDbContext> dbContextProvider,
        ITenantContext tenantContext,
        ICurrentUser currentUser)
        : base(dbContextProvider)
    {
        _tenantContext = tenantContext;
        _currentUser = currentUser;
    }
    
    protected override IQueryable<TaskInstance> ApplyDefaultFilters(IQueryable<TaskInstance> query)
    {
        // Automatic tenant filtering
        if (_tenantContext.CurrentTenantId.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(t => t.TenantId == _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId);
        }
        
        return base.ApplyDefaultFilters(query);
    }
    
    public async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetUserTasksAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        // Additional ownership/assignment filtering
        return await (await GetQueryableAsync())
            .Where(t => t.OwnerId == userId || t.AssigneeId == userId)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    
    public async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetTeamTasksAsync(Guid teamId)
    {
        // Team-based filtering
        var teamMemberIds = await GetTeamMemberIdsAsync(teamId);
        
        return await (await GetQueryableAsync())
            .Where(t => teamMemberIds.Contains(t.AssigneeId.Value))
            .ToListAsync();
    }
}
```

### 104.3 Domain Service with Identity Context

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Domain service using identity resolution
/// </summary>
public class TaskAssignmentService : IDomainService
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    
    public async Task<AssignmentResult> AssignTaskAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid assigneeId,
        bool notifyAssignee = true)
    {
        // Resolve current actor
        var currentIdentity = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(
            _currentUser.UserId.Value);
        var actor = Actor.FromUser(new User 
        { 
            Id = currentIdentity.UserId,
            Email = currentIdentity.Email,
            DisplayName = currentIdentity.DisplayName
        });
        
        // Resolve target assignee
        var assigneeIdentity = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(assigneeId);
        
        // Validate same tenant
        if (assigneeIdentity.TenantId != currentIdentity.TenantId)
        {
            return AssignmentResult.Failure("Cannot assign across tenants");
        }
        
        // Get task and validate ownership/permissions
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(taskId);
        
        if (!await CanAssignAsync(task, currentIdentity))
        {
            return AssignmentResult.Failure("Insufficient permissions to assign task");
        }
        
        // Perform assignment
        task.AssignTo(assigneeId, actor);
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task);
        
        // Notification handled by event handler
        if (notifyAssignee)
        {
            await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TaskAssignmentNotificationRequestedEto
            {
                TaskId = taskId,
                AssigneeId = assigneeId,
                AssignedBy = actor
            });
        }
        
        return AssignmentResult.Success();
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> CanAssignAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        ResolvedIdentity identity)
    {
        // Owner can always assign
        if (task.OwnerId == identity.UserId)
            return true;
        
        // Admin can assign
        if (identity.HasRole("Admin"))
            return true;
        
        // Project manager can assign tasks in their projects
        if (identity.HasRole("ProjectManager"))
        {
            // Check if user is project manager for this task's project
            // Implementation depends on project context
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
}
```

# **PART XXIII - CROSS-CONTEXT INTEGRATION PATTERNS**

---

## **Chapter 105 - Integration Architecture Overview**

### 105.1 Integration Philosophy

The Work Management System follows a **loosely-coupled, event-driven integration architecture** where bounded contexts communicate through well-defined contracts while maintaining autonomy.

**Core Principles:**

1. **Autonomy** - Each context owns its data and behavior
2. **Decoupling** - Contexts don't have direct dependencies
3. **Eventual Consistency** - Cross-context operations are eventually consistent
4. **Contract-Based** - All integration points use explicit contracts
5. **Event Sovereignty** - Each context publishes its own events
6. **Resilience** - Integration failures don't cascade

### 105.2 Integration Patterns Matrix

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Patterns ["Integration Patterns"]
        Events[Event-Driven]
        Commands[Command Messages]
        Saga[Saga Orchestration]
        Query[Query Integration]
        ACL[Anti-Corruption Layer]
    end
    
    subgraph Use Cases
        Events --> UC1[Status Changes]
        Events --> UC2[Notifications]
        Events --> UC3[Projections]
        
        Commands --> UC4[Cross-Context Operations]
        Commands --> UC5[Transaction Coordination]
        
        Saga --> UC6[Long-Running Processes]
        Saga --> UC7[Compensating Actions]
        
        Query --> UC8[Read Models]
        Query --> UC9[Dashboards]
        
        ACL --> UC10[External Systems]
        ACL --> UC11[Legacy Integration]
    end
```

### 105.3 Integration Pattern Selection Guide

| Pattern | Use When | Avoid When | Example |
|---------|----------|------------|---------|
| **Domain Events** | Publishing facts about what happened | Need immediate response | Task completed → Update project |
| **Integration Events** | Cross-context notifications | Within same context | Approval completed → Unblock task |
| **Commands** | Requesting an action | Fire-and-forget scenarios | Request task transition |
| **Sagas** | Multi-step transactions | Simple single-step operations | Create project with tasks |
| **Query Integration** | Reading from other contexts | Writing data | Get project details for task |
| **ACL** | Protecting from external models | Internal contexts | Import from Jira |

## **Chapter 106 - Event-Driven Integration**

**Event Type Definitions:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base class for all domain events
/// </summary>
public abstract class DomainEvent
{
    public Guid EventId { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; set; } = DateTime.UtcNow;
    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
    public string EventType => GetType().Name;
    public int Version { get; set; } = 1;
}

/// <summary>
/// Base class for events published across contexts
/// </summary>
public abstract class IntegrationEvent : DomainEvent
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Identifies related events in a workflow
    /// </summary>
    public string CorrelationId { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Points to the event that caused this event
    /// </summary>
    public string CausationId { get; set; }
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Additional contextual information
    /// </summary>
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; } = new();
}
```

### 106.2 Event Publishing Infrastructure

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Aggregate
    participant UnitOfWork
    participant Outbox
    participant EventBus
    participant Handler1
    participant Handler2
    
    Aggregate->>Aggregate: AddDomainEvent()
    Aggregate->>UnitOfWork: SaveChanges()
    UnitOfWork->>Outbox: Write Events
    UnitOfWork->>Aggregate: Commit
    
    Note over Outbox: Transactional Outbox Pattern
    
    Outbox->>EventBus: Publish Events
    EventBus->>Handler1: Dispatch
    EventBus->>Handler2: Dispatch
    
    Handler1->>Handler1: Process
    Handler2->>Handler2: Process
```

**Outbox Pattern Implementation:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Ensures reliable event publishing using outbox pattern
/// </summary>
public class OutboxEvent : Entity
{
    public Guid EventId { get; set; }
    public string EventType { get; set; }
    public string EventData { get; set; }
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ProcessedAt { get; set; }
    public int RetryCount { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    public OutboxEventStatus Status { get; set; }
    
    public static OutboxEvent Create(DomainEvent domainEvent)
    {
        return new OutboxEvent
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            EventId = domainEvent.EventId,
            EventType = domainEvent.EventType,
            EventData = JsonSerializer.Serialize(domainEvent),
            OccurredAt = domainEvent.OccurredAt,
            Status = OutboxEventStatus.Pending,
            RetryCount = 0
        };
    }
}

public enum OutboxEventStatus
{
    Pending,
    Processing,
    Processed,
    Failed
}

/// <summary>
/// Saves domain events to outbox during transaction
/// </summary>
public class OutboxEventSaver
{
    private readonly IOutboxRepository _outboxRepository;
    
    public async Task SaveEventsAsync(
        IEnumerable<DomainEvent> events,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var outboxEvents = events.Select(e => OutboxEvent.Create(e));
        await _outboxRepository.InsertManyAsync(outboxEvents, cancellationToken);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Background worker processing outbox events
/// </summary>
public class OutboxEventProcessor : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<OutboxEventProcessor> _logger;
    private readonly TimeSpan _interval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
    
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                var processor = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IOutboxProcessor>();
                
                await processor.ProcessPendingEventsAsync(stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing outbox events");
            }
            
            await Task.Delay(_interval, stoppingToken);
        }
    }
}

public interface IOutboxProcessor
{
    Task ProcessPendingEventsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public class OutboxProcessor : IOutboxProcessor
{
    private readonly IOutboxRepository _outboxRepository;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    private readonly ILogger<OutboxProcessor> _logger;
    private const int BatchSize = 100;
    private const int MaxRetries = 5;
    
    public async Task ProcessPendingEventsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var pendingEvents = await _outboxRepository.GetPendingEventsAsync(
            BatchSize, 
            cancellationToken);
        
        foreach (var outboxEvent in pendingEvents)
        {
            try
            {
                // Mark as processing
                outboxEvent.Status = OutboxEventStatus.Processing;
                await _outboxRepository.UpdateAsync(outboxEvent);
                
                // Deserialize and publish
                var eventType = Type.GetType(outboxEvent.EventType);
                var domainEvent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(
                    outboxEvent.EventData, 
                    eventType) as DomainEvent;
                
                await _eventBus.PublishAsync(domainEvent, cancellationToken);
                
                // Mark as processed
                outboxEvent.Status = OutboxEventStatus.Processed;
                outboxEvent.ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await _outboxRepository.UpdateAsync(outboxEvent);
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Successfully processed outbox event {EventId} of type {EventType}",
                    outboxEvent.EventId,
                    outboxEvent.EventType);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex, 
                    "Error processing outbox event {EventId}", 
                    outboxEvent.EventId);
                
                outboxEvent.RetryCount++;
                outboxEvent.ErrorMessage = ex.Message;
                
                if (outboxEvent.RetryCount >= MaxRetries)
                {
                    outboxEvent.Status = OutboxEventStatus.Failed;
                    _logger.LogError(
                        "Outbox event {EventId} failed after {RetryCount} retries",
                        outboxEvent.EventId,
                        outboxEvent.RetryCount);
                }
                else
                {
                    outboxEvent.Status = OutboxEventStatus.Pending;
                }
                
                await _outboxRepository.UpdateAsync(outboxEvent);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 106.3 Event Handler Registration

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base class for event handlers
/// </summary>
public abstract class IntegrationEventHandler<TEvent> : IIntegrationEventHandler<TEvent>
    where TEvent : IntegrationEvent
{
    protected readonly ILogger Logger;
    
    protected IntegrationEventHandler(ILogger logger)
    {
        Logger = logger;
    }
    
    public abstract Task HandleAsync(TEvent @event, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

/// <summary>
/// Idempotent event handler using inbox pattern
/// </summary>
public abstract class IdempotentEventHandler<TEvent> : IntegrationEventHandler<TEvent>
    where TEvent : IntegrationEvent
{
    private readonly IInboxRepository _inboxRepository;
    
    protected IdempotentEventHandler(
        ILogger logger,
        IInboxRepository inboxRepository) : base(logger)
    {
        _inboxRepository = inboxRepository;
    }
    
    public override async Task HandleAsync(
        TEvent @event, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // Check if already processed
        var processed = await _inboxRepository.HasBeenProcessedAsync(
            @event.EventId,
            GetType().Name);
        
        if (processed)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Event {EventId} already processed by {Handler}",
                @event.EventId,
                GetType().Name);
            return;
        }
        
        try
        {
            // Process event
            await HandleEventAsync(@event, cancellationToken);
            
            // Mark as processed
            await _inboxRepository.MarkAsProcessedAsync(
                @event.EventId,
                GetType().Name);
            
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Successfully processed event {EventId} by {Handler}",
                @event.EventId,
                GetType().Name);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error processing event {EventId} by {Handler}",
                @event.EventId,
                GetType().Name);
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    protected abstract Task HandleEventAsync(
        TEvent @event,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### 106.4 Example Integration Event Flow

**Scenario: Task Completion Triggers Project Update**

```csharp
// 1. Task Context - Aggregate emits event
public class TaskInstance : AggregateRoot
{
    public void Complete(Actor actor)
    {
        if (Status == TaskStatus.Completed)
            throw new BusinessException("Task already completed");
        
        Status = TaskStatus.Completed;
        CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        CompletedBy = actor.UserId;
        
        AddDomainEvent(new TaskCompletedEto
        {
            TaskId = Id,
            ProjectId = ProjectId,
            Title = Title,
            CompletedBy = actor,
            CompletedAt = CompletedAt.Value,
            TenantId = TenantId
        });
    }
}

// 2. Event Definition
public class TaskCompletedEto : IntegrationEvent
{
    public Guid TaskId { get; set; }
    public Guid ProjectId { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public Actor CompletedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime CompletedAt { get; set; }
}

// 3. Project Context - Handler updates project
public class ProjectTaskCompletionHandler : IdempotentEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>
{
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private readonly IProjectHealthService _healthService;
    
    public ProjectTaskCompletionHandler(
        ILogger<ProjectTaskCompletionHandler> logger,
        IInboxRepository inboxRepository,
        IProjectRepository projectRepository,
        IProjectHealthService healthService)
        : base(logger, inboxRepository)
    {
        _projectRepository = projectRepository;
        _healthService = healthService;
    }
    
    protected override async Task HandleEventAsync(
        TaskCompletedEto @event,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(@event.ProjectId);
        
        // Update project metrics
        project.IncrementCompletedTasks();
        project.RecalculateProgress();
        
        // Recalculate health
        var health = await _healthService.CalculateHealthAsync(project);
        project.UpdateHealth(health);
        
        await _projectRepository.UpdateAsync(project);
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Updated project {ProjectId} after task {TaskId} completion",
            @event.ProjectId,
            @event.TaskId);
    }
}

// 4. Notification Context - Handler sends notification
public class TaskCompletionNotificationHandler : IntegrationEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>
{
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    
    protected override async Task HandleEventAsync(
        TaskCompletedEto @event,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var completedBy = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(@event.CompletedBy.UserId.Value);
        
        await _notificationService.NotifyAsync(new NotificationRequest
        {
            Type = NotificationType.TaskCompleted,
            Recipients = await GetInterestedPartiesAsync(@event.TaskId),
            Title = $"Task Completed: {@event.Title}",
            Message = $"{completedBy.DisplayName} completed task '{@event.Title}'",
            EntityId = @event.TaskId,
            EntityType = "Task"
        });
    }
}

// 5. Search Context - Handler updates search index
public class TaskCompletionSearchIndexHandler : IntegrationEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>
{
    private readonly ISearchIndexService _searchService;
    
    protected override async Task HandleEventAsync(
        TaskCompletedEto @event,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _searchService.UpdateDocumentAsync(new SearchDocument
        {
            Id = @event.TaskId.ToString(),
            Type = "Task",
            Fields = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["status"] = "Completed",
                ["completedAt"] = @event.CompletedAt,
                ["completedBy"] = @event.CompletedBy.DisplayName
            }
        });
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 107 - Command-Based Integration**

### 107.1 Command Pattern

Commands represent **requests to perform an action** and are used when:
- You need acknowledgment of success/failure
- The action should be synchronous
- You need to return data
- You want explicit error handling

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Sender as Sending Context
    participant Gateway as Command Gateway
    participant Handler as Target Context
    participant Aggregate
    
    Sender->>Gateway: Send Command
    Gateway->>Handler: Route to Handler
    Handler->>Aggregate: Execute Business Logic
    Aggregate-->>Handler: Result
    Handler-->>Gateway: CommandResult
    Gateway-->>Sender: Success/Failure
```

**Command Infrastructure:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base command interface
/// </summary>
public interface ICommand
{
    Guid CommandId { get; }
    Guid? TenantId { get; }
    Guid? UserId { get; }
    string CorrelationId { get; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Command with result
/// </summary>
public interface ICommand<TResult> : ICommand
{
}

/// <summary>
/// Base command implementation
/// </summary>
public abstract class Command : ICommand
{
    public Guid CommandId { get; set; } = Guid.NewGuid();
    public Guid? TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
    public string CorrelationId { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Command result
/// </summary>
public class CommandResult<T>
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public T Data { get; set; }
    public List<string> Errors { get; set; } = new();
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; } = new();
    
    public static CommandResult<T> Succeed(T data)
    {
        return new CommandResult<T>
        {
            Success = true,
            Data = data
        };
    }
    
    public static CommandResult<T> Fail(params string[] errors)
    {
        return new CommandResult<T>
        {
            Success = false,
            Errors = errors.ToList()
        };
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Command handler interface
/// </summary>
public interface ICommandHandler<in TCommand, TResult>
    where TCommand : ICommand<TResult>
{
    Task<CommandResult<TResult>> HandleAsync(
        TCommand command,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}
```

### 107.2 Command Gateway

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Central command routing and execution
/// </summary>
public interface ICommandGateway
{
    Task<CommandResult<TResult>> SendAsync<TResult>(
        ICommand<TResult> command,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public class CommandGateway : ICommandGateway
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<CommandGateway> _logger;
    private readonly ICommandAuditService _auditService;
    
    public async Task<CommandResult<TResult>> SendAsync<TResult>(
        ICommand<TResult> command,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var commandType = command.GetType();
        var resultType = typeof(TResult);
        var handlerType = typeof(ICommandHandler<,>).MakeGenericType(commandType, resultType);
        
        var handler = _serviceProvider.GetService(handlerType);
        
        if (handler == null)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                "No handler registered for command {CommandType}",
                commandType.Name);
            return CommandResult<TResult>.Fail($"No handler for {commandType.Name}");
        }
        
        try
        {
            // Audit command receipt
            await _auditService.LogCommandReceivedAsync(command);
            
            // Execute handler
            var handleMethod = handlerType.GetMethod("HandleAsync");
            var resultTask = (Task<CommandResult<TResult>>)handleMethod.Invoke(
                handler,
                new object[] { command, cancellationToken });
            
            var result = await resultTask;
            
            // Audit result
            await _auditService.LogCommandCompletedAsync(command, result.Success);
            
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error executing command {CommandType}", commandType.Name);
            await _auditService.LogCommandFailedAsync(command, ex);
            return CommandResult<TResult>.Fail($"Command execution failed: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
}
```

### 107.3 Example Command Flow

**Scenario: Workflow requests task transition**

```csharp
// 1. Command definition
public class ExecuteTaskTransitionCommand : Command, ICommand<TaskTransitionResult>
{
    public Guid TaskId { get; set; }
    public Guid TransitionId { get; set; }
    public string Comment { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> FieldUpdates { get; set; }
}

public class TaskTransitionResult
{
    public Guid TaskId { get; set; }
    public Guid NewStatusId { get; set; }
    public string NewStatusName { get; set; }
    public List<string> ActionsExecuted { get; set; }
}

// 2. Command handler in Task Context
public class ExecuteTaskTransitionCommandHandler 
    : ICommandHandler<ExecuteTaskTransitionCommand, TaskTransitionResult>
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly ITaskTransitionService _transitionService;
    private readonly ILogger<ExecuteTaskTransitionCommandHandler> _logger;
    
    public async Task<CommandResult<TaskTransitionResult>> HandleAsync(
        ExecuteTaskTransitionCommand command,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            // Get task
            var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(command.TaskId);
            
            // Validate tenant
            if (task.TenantId != command.TenantId)
            {
                return CommandResult<TaskTransitionResult>.Fail(
                    "Task belongs to different tenant");
            }
            
            // Execute transition
            var result = await _transitionService.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
                task,
                command.TransitionId,
                command.UserId.Value,
                command.Comment,
                command.FieldUpdates);
            
            if (!result.Success)
            {
                return CommandResult<TaskTransitionResult>.Fail(
                    result.Errors.ToArray());
            }
            
            // Save changes
            await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task);
            
            return CommandResult<TaskTransitionResult>.Succeed(
                new TaskTransitionResult
                {
                    TaskId = task.Id,
                    NewStatusId = task.StatusId,
                    NewStatusName = task.Status.Name,
                    ActionsExecuted = result.ActionsExecuted
                });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error executing transition for task {TaskId}",
                command.TaskId);
            return CommandResult<TaskTransitionResult>.Fail(ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

// 3. Sending command from Workflow Context
public class WorkflowExecutionService
{
    private readonly ICommandGateway _commandGateway;
    
    public async Task<bool> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid transitionId,
        Guid userId,
        string comment)
    {
        var command = new ExecuteTaskTransitionCommand
        {
            TaskId = taskId,
            TransitionId = transitionId,
            UserId = userId,
            Comment = comment,
            CorrelationId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString()
        };
        
        var result = await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
        
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Task transition failed for {TaskId}: {Errors}",
                taskId,
                string.Join(", ", result.Errors));
            return false;
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Task {TaskId} transitioned to {NewStatus}",
            result.Data.TaskId,
            result.Data.NewStatusName);
        
        return true;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 108 - Saga Pattern for Long-Running Processes**

### 108.1 Saga Orchestration

Sagas coordinate **multi-step business processes** spanning multiple contexts with compensating actions for failures.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> CreateProject
    CreateProject --> CreateWorkflowScheme
    CreateWorkflowScheme --> CreateDefaultTasks
    CreateDefaultTasks --> AssignTeam
    AssignTeam --> SendNotifications
    SendNotifications --> [*]
    
    CreateProject --> CompensateProject : Failure
    CreateWorkflowScheme --> CompensateScheme : Failure
    CreateDefaultTasks --> CompensateTasks : Failure
    AssignTeam --> CompensateAssignment : Failure
    
    CompensateProject --> [*]
    CompensateScheme --> CompensateProject
    CompensateTasks --> CompensateScheme
    CompensateAssignment --> CompensateTasks
```

**Saga Infrastructure:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base saga class
/// </summary>
public abstract class Saga
{
    public Guid SagaId { get; protected set; }
    public string SagaType { get; protected set; }
    public SagaStatus Status { get; protected set; }
    public DateTime StartedAt { get; protected set; }
    public DateTime? CompletedAt { get; protected set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Data { get; protected set; }
    public List<SagaStep> Steps { get; protected set; }
    public int CurrentStepIndex { get; protected set; }
    
    protected Saga()
    {
        SagaId = Guid.NewGuid();
        Status = SagaStatus.NotStarted;
        Data = new Dictionary<string, object>();
        Steps = new List<SagaStep>();
        CurrentStepIndex = 0;
    }
    
    public void Start()
    {
        Status = SagaStatus.Running;
        StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
    
    public void Complete()
    {
        Status = SagaStatus.Completed;
        CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
    
    public void Fail()
    {
        Status = SagaStatus.Failed;
        CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
    }
    
    public void Compensating()
    {
        Status = SagaStatus.Compensating;
    }
    
    public SagaStep GetCurrentStep()
    {
        if (CurrentStepIndex >= Steps.Count)
            return null;
        return Steps[CurrentStepIndex];
    }
    
    public void MoveToNextStep()
    {
        CurrentStepIndex++;
    }
    
    public void MoveToPreviousStep()
    {
        if (CurrentStepIndex > 0)
            CurrentStepIndex--;
    }
}

public enum SagaStatus
{
    NotStarted,
    Running,
    Completed,
    Failed,
    Compensating,
    Compensated
}

/// <summary>
/// Individual step in saga
/// </summary>
public class SagaStep
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public Func<Saga, Task<bool>> Action { get; set; }
    public Func<Saga, Task> CompensatingAction { get; set; }
    public SagaStepStatus Status { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ExecutedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CompensatedAt { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
}

public enum SagaStepStatus
{
    Pending,
    Executing,
    Completed,
    Failed,
    Compensating,
    Compensated
}
```

### 108.2 Saga Orchestrator

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Executes saga steps with compensation
/// </summary>
public class SagaOrchestrator
{
    private readonly ILogger<SagaOrchestrator> _logger;
    private readonly ISagaRepository _sagaRepository;
    
    public async Task<SagaExecutionResult> ExecuteAsync(Saga saga)
    {
        saga.Start();
        await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
        
        try
        {
            // Execute forward steps
            while (saga.CurrentStepIndex < saga.Steps.Count)
            {
                var step = saga.GetCurrentStep();
                step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Executing;
                await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Executing saga step {StepName} for saga {SagaId}",
                    step.Name,
                    saga.SagaId);
                
                try
                {
                    var success = await step.Action(saga);
                    
                    if (!success)
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "Saga step {StepName} failed for saga {SagaId}",
                            step.Name,
                            saga.SagaId);
                        
                        step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Failed;
                        await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                        
                        // Initiate compensation
                        await CompensateAsync(saga);
                        return SagaExecutionResult.Failed(saga.SagaId);
                    }
                    
                    step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Completed;
                    step.ExecutedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    saga.MoveToNextStep();
                    await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        ex,
                        "Exception in saga step {StepName} for saga {SagaId}",
                        step.Name,
                        saga.SagaId);
                    
                    step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Failed;
                    step.ErrorMessage = ex.Message;
                    await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                    
                    // Initiate compensation
                    await CompensateAsync(saga);
                    return SagaExecutionResult.Failed(saga.SagaId);
                }
            }
            
            // All steps completed successfully
            saga.Complete();
            await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Saga {SagaId} completed successfully",
                saga.SagaId);
            
            return SagaExecutionResult.Success(saga.SagaId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Fatal error in saga {SagaId}", saga.SagaId);
            saga.Fail();
            await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
            return SagaExecutionResult.Failed(saga.SagaId);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task CompensateAsync(Saga saga)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Starting compensation for saga {SagaId}",
            saga.SagaId);
        
        saga.Compensating();
        await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
        
        // Compensate in reverse order
        for (int i = saga.CurrentStepIndex; i >= 0; i--)
        {
            var step = saga.Steps[i];
            
            if (step.Status != SagaStepStatus.Completed)
                continue;
            
            if (step.CompensatingAction == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "No compensating action for step {StepName}",
                    step.Name);
                continue;
            }
            
            try
            {
                step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Compensating;
                await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                
                await step.CompensatingAction(saga);
                
                step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Compensated;
                step.CompensatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Compensated step {StepName} for saga {SagaId}",
                    step.Name,
                    saga.SagaId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error compensating step {StepName} for saga {SagaId}",
                    step.Name,
                    saga.SagaId);
            }
        }
        
        saga.Status = SagaStatus.Compensated;
        await _sagaRepository.SaveAsync(saga);
    }
}

public class SagaExecutionResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public Guid SagaId { get; set; }
    
    public static SagaExecutionResult Success(Guid sagaId)
    {
        return new SagaExecutionResult { Success = true, SagaId = sagaId };
    }
    
    public static SagaExecutionResult Failed(Guid sagaId)
    {
        return new SagaExecutionResult { Success = false, SagaId = sagaId };
    }
}
```

### 108.3 Example Saga: Project Creation

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Saga for creating a complete project with tasks
/// </summary>
public class CreateProjectSaga : Saga
{
    private readonly ICommandGateway _commandGateway;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    
    public CreateProjectSaga(
        ICommandGateway commandGateway,
        IEventBus eventBus)
    {
        _commandGateway = commandGateway;
        _eventBus = eventBus;
        SagaType = "CreateProject";
        
        ConfigureSteps();
    }
    
    private void ConfigureSteps()
    {
        // Step 1: Create project
        Steps.Add(new SagaStep
        {
            Name = "CreateProject",
            Action = async (saga) =>
            {
                var command = new CreateProjectCommand
                {
                    Title = (string)saga.Data["ProjectTitle"],
                    Description = (string)saga.Data["ProjectDescription"],
                    OwnerId = (Guid)saga.Data["OwnerId"],
                    TenantId = (Guid)saga.Data["TenantId"]
                };
                
                var result = await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
                
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    saga.Data["ProjectId"] = result.Data.ProjectId;
                    return true;
                }
                
                return false;
            },
            CompensatingAction = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var command = new DeleteProjectCommand { ProjectId = projectId };
                await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
            }
        });
        
        // Step 2: Create workflow scheme
        Steps.Add(new SagaStep
        {
            Name = "CreateWorkflowScheme",
            Action = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var command = new CreateWorkflowSchemeCommand
                {
                    ProjectId = projectId,
                    Name = $"Workflow Scheme for {saga.Data["ProjectTitle"]}",
                    DefaultWorkflowId = (Guid)saga.Data["DefaultWorkflowId"]
                };
                
                var result = await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
                
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    saga.Data["WorkflowSchemeId"] = result.Data.SchemeId;
                    return true;
                }
                
                return false;
            },
            CompensatingAction = async (saga) =>
            {
                var schemeId = (Guid)saga.Data["WorkflowSchemeId"];
                var command = new DeleteWorkflowSchemeCommand { SchemeId = schemeId };
                await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
            }
        });
        
        // Step 3: Create default tasks
        Steps.Add(new SagaStep
        {
            Name = "CreateDefaultTasks",
            Action = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var taskTemplates = (List<TaskTemplate>)saga.Data["TaskTemplates"];
                var createdTaskIds = new List<Guid>();
                
                foreach (var template in taskTemplates)
                {
                    var command = new CreateTaskCommand
                    {
                        ProjectId = projectId,
                        Title = template.Title,
                        Description = template.Description,
                        OwnerId = (Guid)saga.Data["OwnerId"]
                    };
                    
                    var result = await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
                    
                    if (result.Success)
                    {
                        createdTaskIds.Add(result.Data.TaskId);
                    }
                }
                
                saga.Data["CreatedTaskIds"] = createdTaskIds;
                return true;
            },
            CompensatingAction = async (saga) =>
            {
                var taskIds = (List<Guid>)saga.Data["CreatedTaskIds"];
                foreach (var taskId in taskIds)
                {
                    var command = new DeleteTaskCommand { TaskId = taskId };
                    await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
                }
            }
        });
        
        // Step 4: Assign team
        Steps.Add(new SagaStep
        {
            Name = "AssignTeam",
            Action = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var teamId = (Guid)saga.Data["TeamId"];
                
                var command = new AssignTeamToProjectCommand
                {
                    ProjectId = projectId,
                    TeamId = teamId
                };
                
                var result = await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
                return result.Success;
            },
            CompensatingAction = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var teamId = (Guid)saga.Data["TeamId"];
                
                var command = new RemoveTeamFromProjectCommand
                {
                    ProjectId = projectId,
                    TeamId = teamId
                };
                
                await _commandGateway.SendAsync(command);
            }
        });
        
        // Step 5: Send notifications
        Steps.Add(new SagaStep
        {
            Name = "SendNotifications",
            Action = async (saga) =>
            {
                var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
                var teamId = (Guid)saga.Data["TeamId"];
                
                await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new ProjectCreatedEto
                {
                    ProjectId = projectId,
                    Title = (string)saga.Data["ProjectTitle"],
                    TeamId = teamId,
                    OwnerId = (Guid)saga.Data["OwnerId"]
                });
                
                return true;
            },
            CompensatingAction = null // No compensation needed for notifications
        });
    }
}

// Usage
public class ProjectCreationService
{
    private readonly SagaOrchestrator _orchestrator;
    
    public async Task<Guid?> CreateCompleteProjectAsync(
        string title,
        string description,
        Guid ownerId,
        Guid teamId,
        Guid defaultWorkflowId,
        List<TaskTemplate> taskTemplates)
    {
        var saga = new CreateProjectSaga(_commandGateway, _eventBus);
        saga.Data["ProjectTitle"] = title;
        saga.Data["ProjectDescription"] = description;
        saga.Data["OwnerId"] = ownerId;
        saga.Data["TeamId"] = teamId;
        saga.Data["DefaultWorkflowId"] = defaultWorkflowId;
        saga.Data["TaskTemplates"] = taskTemplates;
        saga.Data["TenantId"] = _currentUser.TenantId;
        
        var result = await _orchestrator.ExecuteAsync(saga);
        
        if (result.Success)
        {
            return (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
        }
        
        return null;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 109 - Query Integration Pattern**

### 109.1 Read Model Projection

When one context needs to display data from another context, use **read model projection**.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Source ["Source Context"]
        Events[Domain Events]
    end
    
    subgraph Projector ["Projection Service"]
        Handler[Event Handler]
        Transform[Data Transform]
    end
    
    subgraph Target ["Target Context"]
        ReadModel[Read Model]
        Query[Query Service]
    end
    
    Events --> Handler
    Handler --> Transform
    Transform --> ReadModel
    Query --> ReadModel
```

**Read Model Example:**

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Read model for task overview displayed in project context
/// </summary>
public class ProjectTaskOverview
{
    public Guid TaskId { get; set; }
    public Guid ProjectId { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string StatusName { get; set; }
    public string AssigneeName { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    public int Priority { get; set; }
    public DateTime LastUpdated { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// Projection handler building read model from task events
/// </summary>
public class ProjectTaskOverviewProjector :
    IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskCreatedEto>,
    IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskUpdatedEto>,
    IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskAssignedEto>,
    IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskStatusChangedEto>
{
    private readonly IProjectTaskOverviewRepository _repository;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    
    public async Task HandleAsync(TaskCreatedEto @event, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var overview = new ProjectTaskOverview
        {
            TaskId = @event.TaskId,
            ProjectId = @event.ProjectId,
            Title = @event.Title,
            StatusName = @event.InitialStatusName,
            Priority = @event.Priority,
            DueDate = @event.DueDate,
            LastUpdated = @event.CreatedAt
        };
        
        await _repository.InsertAsync(overview);
    }
    
    public async Task HandleAsync(TaskAssignedEto @event, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var overview = await _repository.GetByTaskIdAsync(@event.TaskId);
        
        if (@event.AssigneeId.HasValue)
        {
            var assignee = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(@event.AssigneeId.Value);
            overview.AssigneeName = assignee.DisplayName;
        }
        else
        {
            overview.AssigneeName = null;
        }
        
        overview.LastUpdated = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(overview);
    }
    
    public async Task HandleAsync(TaskStatusChangedEto @event, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var overview = await _repository.GetByTaskIdAsync(@event.TaskId);
        overview.StatusName = @event.NewStatusName;
        overview.LastUpdated = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(overview);
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Query service in project context
/// </summary>
public class ProjectTaskQueryService
{
    private readonly IProjectTaskOverviewRepository _repository;
    
    public async Task<List<ProjectTaskOverview>> GetProjectTasksAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        return await _repository.GetByProjectIdAsync(projectId);
    }
    
    public async Task<ProjectTaskStatistics> GetTaskStatisticsAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        var tasks = await _repository.GetByProjectIdAsync(projectId);
        
        return new ProjectTaskStatistics
        {
            TotalTasks = tasks.Count,
            CompletedTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.StatusName == "Done"),
            InProgressTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.StatusName == "In Progress"),
            OverdueTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.DueDate < DateTime.UtcNow && t.StatusName != "Done")
        };
    }
}
```
