## **Chapter 110 - Anti-Corruption Layer Pattern**

### 110.1 ACL Purpose and Design

The **Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)** protects domain models from external systems by translating between different models and vocabularies.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph External ["External System"]
        ExtAPI[External API]
        ExtModel[External Model]
    end
    
    subgraph ACL ["Anti-Corruption Layer"]
        Adapter[Adapter]
        Translator[Model Translator]
        Validator[Data Validator]
    end
    
    subgraph Domain ["Our Domain"]
        Service[Domain Service]
        DomainModel[Domain Model]
    end
    
    ExtAPI --> Adapter
    ExtModel --> Translator
    Translator --> Validator
    Validator --> Service
    Service --> DomainModel
```

**ACL Design Principles:**

1. **Isolation** - Domain never sees external models
2. **Translation** - Convert external concepts to domain concepts
3. **Validation** - Reject invalid external data
4. **Enrichment** - Add missing domain-required data
5. **Simplification** - Hide external complexity

### 110.2 ACL Implementation Framework

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base interface for external system adapters
/// </summary>
public interface IExternalSystemAdapter<TExternal, TDomain>
{
    Task<TDomain> TranslateToDomainAsync(TExternal externalModel);
    Task<TExternal> TranslateFromDomainAsync(TDomain domainModel);
    Task<ValidationResult> ValidateExternalModelAsync(TExternal externalModel);
}

/// <summary>
/// Base adapter with common ACL functionality
/// </summary>
public abstract class ExternalSystemAdapterBase<TExternal, TDomain> 
    : IExternalSystemAdapter<TExternal, TDomain>
{
    protected readonly ILogger Logger;
    protected readonly IValidator<TExternal> Validator;
    
    protected ExternalSystemAdapterBase(
        ILogger logger,
        IValidator<TExternal> validator)
    {
        Logger = logger;
        Validator = validator;
    }
    
    public async Task<TDomain> TranslateToDomainAsync(TExternal externalModel)
    {
        // Validate external model
        var validationResult = await ValidateExternalModelAsync(externalModel);
        if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        {
            throw new ExternalModelValidationException(
                $"Invalid external model: {string.Join(", ", validationResult.Errors)}");
        }
        
        // Perform translation
        try
        {
            var domainModel = await PerformTranslationToDomainAsync(externalModel);
            
            // Enrich with domain-required data
            await EnrichDomainModelAsync(domainModel);
            
            return domainModel;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Error translating external model to domain model");
            throw new TranslationException("Failed to translate external model", ex);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<TExternal> TranslateFromDomainAsync(TDomain domainModel)
    {
        try
        {
            return await PerformTranslationFromDomainAsync(domainModel);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Logger.LogError(ex, "Error translating domain model to external model");
            throw new TranslationException("Failed to translate domain model", ex);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<ValidationResult> ValidateExternalModelAsync(TExternal externalModel)
    {
        return await Validator.ValidateAsync(externalModel);
    }
    
    protected abstract Task<TDomain> PerformTranslationToDomainAsync(TExternal externalModel);
    protected abstract Task<TExternal> PerformTranslationFromDomainAsync(TDomain domainModel);
    protected virtual Task EnrichDomainModelAsync(TDomain domainModel) => Task.CompletedTask;
}
```

### 110.3 Example: Jira Integration ACL

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// External Jira issue model
/// </summary>
public class JiraIssue
{
    public string Key { get; set; }
    public string Summary { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public JiraIssueType IssueType { get; set; }
    public JiraStatus Status { get; set; }
    public JiraUser Assignee { get; set; }
    public JiraUser Reporter { get; set; }
    public List<string> Labels { get; set; }
    public JiraPriority Priority { get; set; }
    public DateTime Created { get; set; }
    public DateTime Updated { get; set; }
    public string ProjectKey { get; set; }
    public int? StoryPoints { get; set; }
    public List<JiraComment> Comments { get; set; }
}

public class JiraStatus
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string StatusCategory { get; set; } // "To Do", "In Progress", "Done"
}

/// <summary>
/// ACL adapter for Jira to Task Instance
/// </summary>
public class JiraToTaskAdapter : ExternalSystemAdapterBase<JiraIssue, TaskInstance>
{
    private readonly ITaskBlueprintRepository _blueprintRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private readonly ITenantContext _tenantContext;
    
    public JiraToTaskAdapter(
        ILogger<JiraToTaskAdapter> logger,
        IValidator<JiraIssue> validator,
        ITaskBlueprintRepository blueprintRepository,
        IWorkflowRepository workflowRepository,
        IIdentityResolver identityResolver,
        IProjectRepository projectRepository,
        ITenantContext tenantContext)
        : base(logger, validator)
    {
        _blueprintRepository = blueprintRepository;
        _workflowRepository = workflowRepository;
        _identityResolver = identityResolver;
        _projectRepository = projectRepository;
        _tenantContext = tenantContext;
    }
    
    protected override async Task<TaskInstance> PerformTranslationToDomainAsync(
        JiraIssue jiraIssue)
    {
        // Map Jira project to our project
        var project = await FindOrCreateProjectAsync(jiraIssue.ProjectKey);
        
        // Map Jira issue type to task type
        var taskType = await MapIssueTypeToTaskTypeAsync(jiraIssue.IssueType);
        
        // Map Jira status to our workflow status
        var workflow = await _workflowRepository.GetDefaultAsync();
        var status = MapJiraStatusToWorkflowStatus(jiraIssue.Status, workflow);
        
        // Map assignee
        Guid? assigneeId = null;
        if (jiraIssue.Assignee != null)
        {
            assigneeId = await MapJiraUserToOurUserAsync(jiraIssue.Assignee);
        }
        
        // Create task instance
        var task = new TaskInstance
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = jiraIssue.Summary,
            Description = TranslateJiraMarkdown(jiraIssue.Description),
            ProjectId = project.Id,
            TaskTypeId = taskType.Id,
            StatusId = status.Id,
            AssigneeId = assigneeId,
            Priority = MapJiraPriority(jiraIssue.Priority),
            TenantId = _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId,
            CreatedAt = jiraIssue.Created,
            // Store external reference
            ExternalReferences = new List<ExternalReference>
            {
                new ExternalReference
                {
                    System = "Jira",
                    ExternalId = jiraIssue.Key,
                    ExternalUrl = $"https://jira.company.com/browse/{jiraIssue.Key}"
                }
            }
        };
        
        // Map story points to estimate
        if (jiraIssue.StoryPoints.HasValue)
        {
            task.EstimateHours = jiraIssue.StoryPoints.Value * 8; // Assume 8h per story point
        }
        
        // Map labels to tags
        if (jiraIssue.Labels?.Any() == true)
        {
            task.Tags = jiraIssue.Labels;
        }
        
        return task;
    }
    
    protected override async Task<JiraIssue> PerformTranslationFromDomainAsync(
        TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Reverse translation for syncing back to Jira
        var project = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(task.ProjectId);
        var jiraProject = await FindJiraProjectAsync(project);
        
        return new JiraIssue
        {
            Key = task.ExternalReferences
                .FirstOrDefault(r => r.System == "Jira")?.ExternalId,
            Summary = task.Title,
            Description = TranslateToJiraMarkdown(task.Description),
            ProjectKey = jiraProject.Key,
            Status = await MapOurStatusToJiraStatusAsync(task.StatusId),
            Assignee = task.AssigneeId.HasValue 
                ? await MapOurUserToJiraUserAsync(task.AssigneeId.Value)
                : null,
            Labels = task.Tags?.ToList() ?? new List<string>(),
            Priority = MapOurPriorityToJira(task.Priority),
            StoryPoints = task.EstimateHours.HasValue 
                ? (int?)(task.EstimateHours.Value / 8)
                : null
        };
    }
    
    protected override async Task EnrichDomainModelAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Ensure we have a valid blueprint
        if (task.TaskBlueprintId == null)
        {
            var defaultBlueprint = await _blueprintRepository.GetDefaultAsync(task.TaskTypeId);
            task.TaskBlueprintId = defaultBlueprint?.Id;
        }
        
        // Ensure workflow version is set
        if (task.WorkflowVersionId == null)
        {
            var workflow = await _workflowRepository.GetDefaultAsync();
            var activeVersion = await _workflowRepository.GetActiveVersionAsync(workflow.Id);
            task.WorkflowVersionId = activeVersion.Id;
        }
    }
    
    // Helper methods for mapping
    
    private async Task<Project> FindOrCreateProjectAsync(string jiraProjectKey)
    {
        // Try to find existing project linked to Jira project
        var existingProject = await _projectRepository.FindByExternalReferenceAsync(
            "Jira",
            jiraProjectKey);
        
        if (existingProject != null)
            return existingProject;
        
        // Create new project
        var jiraProjectDetails = await FetchJiraProjectDetailsAsync(jiraProjectKey);
        
        var project = new Project
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = jiraProjectDetails.Name,
            Description = jiraProjectDetails.Description,
            TenantId = _tenantContext.CurrentTenantId,
            ExternalReferences = new List<ExternalReference>
            {
                new ExternalReference
                {
                    System = "Jira",
                    ExternalId = jiraProjectKey
                }
            }
        };
        
        await _projectRepository.InsertAsync(project);
        return project;
    }
    
    private WorkflowStatus MapJiraStatusToWorkflowStatus(
        JiraStatus jiraStatus,
        Workflow workflow)
    {
        // Map based on Jira status category
        var categoryMapping = new Dictionary<string, string>
        {
            ["To Do"] = "Todo",
            ["In Progress"] = "InProgress",
            ["Done"] = "Done"
        };
        
        var ourCategory = categoryMapping.GetValueOrDefault(
            jiraStatus.StatusCategory,
            "Todo");
        
        return workflow.Statuses.FirstOrDefault(s => 
            s.Category.ToString() == ourCategory) 
            ?? workflow.InitialStatus;
    }
    
    private int MapJiraPriority(JiraPriority jiraPriority)
    {
        // Jira priorities: Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest
        // Our priorities: 1-10
        return jiraPriority?.Name switch
        {
            "Highest" => 10,
            "High" => 8,
            "Medium" => 5,
            "Low" => 3,
            "Lowest" => 1,
            _ => 5
        };
    }
    
    private string TranslateJiraMarkdown(string jiraMarkdown)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(jiraMarkdown))
            return string.Empty;
        
        // Jira uses a custom markup language
        // Convert to CommonMark markdown
        var markdown = jiraMarkdown
            .Replace("h1.", "# ")
            .Replace("h2.", "## ")
            .Replace("h3.", "### ")
            .Replace("{code}", "```")
            .Replace("{noformat}", "```")
            .Replace("*", "**") // Bold
            .Replace("_", "*"); // Italic
        
        return markdown;
    }
    
    private async Task<Guid?> MapJiraUserToOurUserAsync(JiraUser jiraUser)
    {
        // Try to find user by email
        var user = await _identityResolver.ResolveByEmailAsync(jiraUser.EmailAddress);
        
        if (user != null)
            return user.UserId;
        
        // Create placeholder user or return null
        Logger.LogWarning(
            "Could not map Jira user {Email} to system user",
            jiraUser.EmailAddress);
        
        return null;
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Validator for Jira issues
/// </summary>
public class JiraIssueValidator : AbstractValidator<JiraIssue>
{
    public JiraIssueValidator()
    {
        RuleFor(x => x.Key)
            .NotEmpty()
            .Matches(@"^[A-Z]+-\d+$")
            .WithMessage("Jira key must be in format PROJECT-123");
        
        RuleFor(x => x.Summary)
            .NotEmpty()
            .MaximumLength(500);
        
        RuleFor(x => x.ProjectKey)
            .NotEmpty()
            .WithMessage("Jira project key is required");
        
        RuleFor(x => x.Status)
            .NotNull()
            .WithMessage("Jira issue must have a status");
    }
}

### 110.4 ACL for External Approval Systems

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// External DocuSign envelope model
/// </summary>
public class DocuSignEnvelope
{
    public string EnvelopeId { get; set; }
    public string Status { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedDateTime { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CompletedDateTime { get; set; }
    public List<DocuSignRecipient> Recipients { get; set; }
    public string EmailSubject { get; set; }
    public List<DocuSignDocument> Documents { get; set; }
}

public class DocuSignRecipient
{
    public string Email { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Status { get; set; } // "sent", "delivered", "completed", "declined"
    public DateTime? SignedDateTime { get; set; }
}

/// <summary>
/// ACL adapter for DocuSign to Approval Context
/// </summary>
public class DocuSignToApprovalAdapter : ExternalSystemAdapterBase<DocuSignEnvelope, ApprovalRequest>
{
    private readonly IApprovalWorkflowRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly IIdentityResolver _identityResolver;
    
    protected override async Task<ApprovalRequest> PerformTranslationToDomainAsync(
        DocuSignEnvelope envelope)
    {
        // Create or find approval workflow for DocuSign
        var workflow = await FindOrCreateDocuSignWorkflowAsync();
        
        // Map envelope to approval request
        var approvalRequest = new ApprovalRequest
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            WorkflowVersionId = workflow.ActiveVersionId,
            EntityType = "ExternalDocument",
            EntityId = Guid.NewGuid(), // Create reference entity
            RequestedBy = await ResolveInitiatorAsync(envelope),
            Status = MapDocuSignStatus(envelope.Status),
            CreatedAt = envelope.CreatedDateTime,
            ExternalReferences = new List<ExternalReference>
            {
                new ExternalReference
                {
                    System = "DocuSign",
                    ExternalId = envelope.EnvelopeId,
                    ExternalUrl = $"https://app.docusign.com/documents/details/{envelope.EnvelopeId}"
                }
            }
        };
        
        // Map recipients to approval steps/decisions
        foreach (var recipient in envelope.Recipients)
        {
            var userId = await MapRecipientToUserAsync(recipient);
            
            if (userId.HasValue)
            {
                var decision = new ApprovalDecision
                {
                    Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                    ApproverId = userId.Value,
                    Action = MapRecipientStatusToDecision(recipient.Status),
                    DecidedAt = recipient.SignedDateTime,
                    Comments = $"Via DocuSign: {recipient.Status}"
                };
                
                approvalRequest.Decisions.Add(decision);
            }
        }
        
        return approvalRequest;
    }
    
    protected override async Task<DocuSignEnvelope> PerformTranslationFromDomainAsync(
        ApprovalRequest approvalRequest)
    {
        // Create DocuSign envelope from approval request
        var envelope = new DocuSignEnvelope
        {
            EmailSubject = $"Approval Request: {approvalRequest.EntityType}",
            Recipients = new List<DocuSignRecipient>(),
            Documents = new List<DocuSignDocument>()
        };
        
        // Map approval steps to recipients
        var workflow = await _workflowRepository.GetVersionAsync(
            approvalRequest.WorkflowVersionId);
        
        foreach (var step in workflow.Steps)
        {
            foreach (var approverId in step.UserApprovers)
            {
                var user = await _identityResolver.ResolveAsync(approverId);
                
                envelope.Recipients.Add(new DocuSignRecipient
                {
                    Email = user.Email,
                    Name = user.DisplayName,
                    Status = "sent"
                });
            }
        }
        
        return envelope;
    }
    
    private ApprovalStatus MapDocuSignStatus(string docuSignStatus)
    {
        return docuSignStatus?.ToLower() switch
        {
            "sent" => ApprovalStatus.Pending,
            "delivered" => ApprovalStatus.Pending,
            "completed" => ApprovalStatus.Approved,
            "declined" => ApprovalStatus.Rejected,
            "voided" => ApprovalStatus.Cancelled,
            _ => ApprovalStatus.Pending
        };
    }
    
    private ApprovalAction MapRecipientStatusToDecision(string recipientStatus)
    {
        return recipientStatus?.ToLower() switch
        {
            "completed" => ApprovalAction.Approved,
            "declined" => ApprovalAction.Rejected,
            _ => ApprovalAction.Pending
        };
    }
}

### 110.5 ACL Error Handling and Resilience

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Resilient ACL wrapper with retry and circuit breaker
/// </summary>
public class ResilientExternalAdapter<TExternal, TDomain>
{
    private readonly IExternalSystemAdapter<TExternal, TDomain> _adapter;
    private readonly IAsyncPolicy _retryPolicy;
    private readonly IAsyncPolicy _circuitBreakerPolicy;
    private readonly ILogger _logger;
    
    public ResilientExternalAdapter(
        IExternalSystemAdapter<TExternal, TDomain> adapter,
        ILogger logger)
    {
        _adapter = adapter;
        _logger = logger;
        
        // Configure retry policy
        _retryPolicy = Policy
            .Handle<HttpRequestException>()
            .Or<TimeoutException>()
            .WaitAndRetryAsync(
                3,
                retryAttempt => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, retryAttempt)),
                (exception, timeSpan, retryCount, context) =>
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        exception,
                        "Retry {RetryCount} after {Delay}ms",
                        retryCount,
                        timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds);
                });
        
        // Configure circuit breaker
        _circuitBreakerPolicy = Policy
            .Handle<Exception>()
            .CircuitBreakerAsync(
                5, // Break after 5 consecutive failures
                TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), // Stay open for 1 minute
                (exception, duration) =>
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        exception,
                        "Circuit breaker opened for {Duration}",
                        duration);
                },
                () =>
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation("Circuit breaker reset");
                });
    }
    
    public async Task<TDomain> TranslateToDomainWithResilienceAsync(
        TExternal externalModel)
    {
        return await _circuitBreakerPolicy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
        {
            return await _retryPolicy.ExecuteAsync(async () =>
            {
                return await _adapter.TranslateToDomainAsync(externalModel);
            });
        });
    }
}

## **Chapter 111 - Integration Testing Patterns**

### 111.1 Integration Test Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Test ["Integration Test"]
        Setup[Test Setup]
        Action[Execute Action]
        Verify[Verify Result]
    end
    
    subgraph Components ["System Components"]
        Context1[Context A]
        Context2[Context B]
        EventBus[Event Bus]
        DB[(Test Database)]
    end
    
    subgraph Mocks ["Test Doubles"]
        MockExt[External Systems]
        MockTime[Time Provider]
    end
    
    Setup --> Context1
    Setup --> Context2
    Setup --> DB
    Action --> Context1
    Context1 --> EventBus
    EventBus --> Context2
    Context2 --> DB
    Verify --> DB
    
    Context1 -.-> MockExt
    Context1 -.-> MockTime
```

### 111.2 Integration Test Base Classes

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Base class for integration tests
/// </summary>
public abstract class IntegrationTestBase : IAsyncLifetime
{
    protected IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; private set; }
    protected WorkManagementDbContext DbContext { get; private set; }
    protected IEventBus EventBus { get; private set; }
    protected TestEventCollector EventCollector { get; private set; }
    
    public async Task InitializeAsync()
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        
        // Configure test database
        services.AddDbContext<WorkManagementDbContext>(options =>
        {
            options.UseInMemoryDatabase($"TestDb_{Guid.NewGuid()}");
        });
        
        // Configure event bus with collector
        EventCollector = new TestEventCollector();
        services.AddSingleton<IEventBus>(sp => 
            new TestEventBus(EventCollector, sp.GetRequiredService<ILogger<TestEventBus>>()));
        
        // Configure domain services
        ConfigureServices(services);
        
        ServiceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        DbContext = ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<WorkManagementDbContext>();
        EventBus = ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IEventBus>();
        
        // Seed test data
        await SeedTestDataAsync();
    }
    
    protected virtual void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Override in derived classes to add context-specific services
    }
    
    protected virtual Task SeedTestDataAsync()
    {
        // Override to seed context-specific test data
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
    
    public async Task DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (DbContext != null)
        {
            await DbContext.DisposeAsync();
        }
        
        if (ServiceProvider is IDisposable disposable)
        {
            disposable.Dispose();
        }
    }
    
    protected async Task<T> GetServiceAsync<T>()
    {
        return ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<T>();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Collects events published during tests
/// </summary>
public class TestEventCollector
{
    private readonly List<DomainEvent> _events = new();
    
    public IReadOnlyList<DomainEvent> Events => _events.AsReadOnly();
    
    public void Collect(DomainEvent @event)
    {
        _events.Add(@event);
    }
    
    public void Clear()
    {
        _events.Clear();
    }
    
    public List<T> GetEvents<T>() where T : DomainEvent
    {
        return _events.OfType<T>().ToList();
    }
    
    public T GetEvent<T>() where T : DomainEvent
    {
        return _events.OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault();
    }
    
    public bool HasEvent<T>() where T : DomainEvent
    {
        return _events.OfType<T>().Any();
    }
    
    public int CountEvents<T>() where T : DomainEvent
    {
        return _events.OfType<T>().Count();
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// Test event bus that collects events
/// </summary>
public class TestEventBus : IEventBus
{
    private readonly TestEventCollector _collector;
    private readonly ILogger<TestEventBus> _logger;
    private readonly Dictionary<Type, List<object>> _handlers = new();
    
    public TestEventBus(
        TestEventCollector collector,
        ILogger<TestEventBus> logger)
    {
        _collector = collector;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task PublishAsync<TEvent>(
        TEvent @event,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        where TEvent : DomainEvent
    {
        _collector.Collect(@event);
        _logger.LogInformation("Published event: {EventType}", typeof(TEvent).Name);
        
        // Execute registered handlers
        if (_handlers.TryGetValue(typeof(TEvent), out var handlers))
        {
            foreach (var handler in handlers)
            {
                var handlerMethod = handler.GetType()
                    .GetMethod("HandleAsync");
                
                if (handlerMethod != null)
                {
                    await (Task)handlerMethod.Invoke(
                        handler,
                        new object[] { @event, cancellationToken });
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public void Subscribe<TEvent>(IIntegrationEventHandler<TEvent> handler)
        where TEvent : IntegrationEvent
    {
        var eventType = typeof(TEvent);
        
        if (!_handlers.ContainsKey(eventType))
        {
            _handlers[eventType] = new List<object>();
        }
        
        _handlers[eventType].Add(handler);
    }
}

### 111.3 Cross-Context Integration Tests

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Tests integration between Task and Project contexts
/// </summary>
public class TaskProjectIntegrationTests : IntegrationTestBase
{
    private ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private ITaskInstanceAppService _taskService;
    private Project _testProject;
    private User _testUser;
    
    protected override void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Register Task Context services
        services.AddScoped<ITaskInstanceRepository, TaskInstanceRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<ITaskInstanceAppService, TaskInstanceAppService>();
        
        // Register Project Context services
        services.AddScoped<IProjectRepository, ProjectRepository>();
        services.AddScoped<IProjectHealthService, ProjectHealthService>();
        
        // Register event handlers
        services.AddScoped<IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>, 
            ProjectTaskCompletionHandler>();
        services.AddScoped<IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskCreatedEto>,
            ProjectTaskCreationHandler>();
    }
    
    protected override async Task SeedTestDataAsync()
    {
        _taskRepository = await GetServiceAsync<ITaskInstanceRepository>();
        _projectRepository = await GetServiceAsync<IProjectRepository>();
        _taskService = await GetServiceAsync<ITaskInstanceAppService>();
        
        // Create test user
        _testUser = new User
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Email = "test@example.com",
            DisplayName = "Test User",
            TenantId = Guid.NewGuid()
        };
        
        // Create test project
        _testProject = new Project
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = "Test Project",
            OwnerId = _testUser.Id,
            TenantId = _testUser.TenantId,
            Status = ProjectStatus.Active,
            TotalTasks = 0,
            CompletedTasks = 0,
            Progress = 0
        };
        
        await _projectRepository.InsertAsync(_testProject);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public async Task WhenTaskCompleted_ShouldUpdateProjectMetrics()
    {
        // Arrange
        var task = new TaskInstance
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Title = "Test Task",
            ProjectId = _testProject.Id,
            Status = TaskStatus.InProgress,
            TenantId = _testUser.TenantId,
            OwnerId = _testUser.Id
        };
        
        await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(task);
        
        // Update project task count
        _testProject.TotalTasks = 1;
        await _projectRepository.UpdateAsync(_testProject);
        
        EventCollector.Clear();
        
        // Act
        await _taskService.CompleteAsync(task.Id, new CompleteTaskInput
        {
            Comment = "Completed"
        });
        
        // Assert - Verify event published
        Assert.True(EventCollector.HasEvent<TaskCompletedEto>());
        
        var taskCompletedEvent = EventCollector.GetEvent<TaskCompletedEto>();
        Assert.Equal(task.Id, taskCompletedEvent.TaskId);
        Assert.Equal(_testProject.Id, taskCompletedEvent.ProjectId);
        
        // Wait for async event processing
        await Task.Delay(100);
        
        // Assert - Verify project updated
        var updatedProject = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(_testProject.Id);
        Assert.Equal(1, updatedProject.CompletedTasks);
        Assert.True(updatedProject.Progress > 0);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public async Task WhenMultipleTasksCompleted_ShouldCalculateCorrectProgress()
    {
        // Arrange
        var tasks = new List<TaskInstance>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        {
            var task = new TaskInstance
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                Title = $"Task {i + 1}",
                ProjectId = _testProject.Id,
                Status = TaskStatus.InProgress,
                TenantId = _testUser.TenantId,
                OwnerId = _testUser.Id
            };
            
            tasks.Add(task);
            await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(task);
        }
        
        _testProject.TotalTasks = 5;
        await _projectRepository.UpdateAsync(_testProject);
        
        // Act - Complete 3 out of 5 tasks
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        {
            await _taskService.CompleteAsync(tasks[i].Id, new CompleteTaskInput());
            await Task.Delay(50); // Allow event processing
        }
        
        // Assert
        var updatedProject = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(_testProject.Id);
        Assert.Equal(3, updatedProject.CompletedTasks);
        Assert.Equal(60, updatedProject.Progress); // 3/5 = 60%
    }
}

        {

            task.Id,
            startTransition.Id,
            Guid.NewGuid()); // Current user
        
        // Assert
        Assert.True(result.Success);
        
        var updatedTask = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(task.Id);
        Assert.NotNull(updatedTask.AssigneeId); // Action assigned user
        Assert.Equal(
            _testWorkflow.Statuses.First(s => s.Name == "InProgress").Id,
            updatedTask.StatusId);
    }

### 111.4 Saga Integration Tests

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Tests saga orchestration
/// </summary>
public class SagaIntegrationTests : IntegrationTestBase
{
    private SagaOrchestrator _orchestrator;
    private ICommandGateway _commandGateway;
    
    protected override void ConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services)
    {
        services.AddScoped<SagaOrchestrator>();
        services.AddScoped<ICommandGateway, CommandGateway>();
        services.AddScoped<ISagaRepository, InMemorySagaRepository>();
        
        // Register all command handlers
        services.AddScoped<ICommandHandler<CreateProjectCommand, CreateProjectResult>,
            CreateProjectCommandHandler>();
        services.AddScoped<ICommandHandler<CreateTaskCommand, CreateTaskResult>,
            CreateTaskCommandHandler>();
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public async Task WhenSagaCompletes_AllStepsSucceed()
    {
        // Arrange
        var saga = new CreateProjectSaga(_commandGateway, EventBus);
        saga.Data["ProjectTitle"] = "Integration Test Project";
        saga.Data["OwnerId"] = Guid.NewGuid();
        saga.Data["TenantId"] = Guid.NewGuid();
        saga.Data["TaskTemplates"] = new List<TaskTemplate>
        {
            new TaskTemplate { Title = "Task 1" },
            new TaskTemplate { Title = "Task 2" }
        };
        
        // Act
        var result = await _orchestrator.ExecuteAsync(saga);
        
        // Assert
        Assert.True(result.Success);
        Assert.Equal(SagaStatus.Completed, saga.Status);
        Assert.All(saga.Steps, step => Assert.Equal(SagaStepStatus.Completed, step.Status));
        
        // Verify project was created
        Assert.True(saga.Data.ContainsKey("ProjectId"));
        var projectId = (Guid)saga.Data["ProjectId"];
        Assert.NotEqual(Guid.Empty, projectId);
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public async Task WhenStepFails_ShouldCompensate()
    {
        // Arrange
        var saga = new CreateProjectSaga(_commandGateway, EventBus);
        saga.Data["ProjectTitle"] = "Test";
        saga.Data["OwnerId"] = Guid.NewGuid();
        saga.Data["TenantId"] = Guid.NewGuid();
        saga.Data["InvalidData"] = true; // Cause failure
        
        // Act
        var result = await _orchestrator.ExecuteAsync(saga);
        
        // Assert
        Assert.False(result.Success);
        Assert.True(
            saga.Status == SagaStatus.Compensated ||
            saga.Status == SagaStatus.Failed);
        
        // Verify compensating actions executed
        var completedSteps = saga.Steps
            .Where(s => s.Status == SagaStepStatus.Completed)
            .ToList();
        
        var compensatedSteps = saga.Steps
            .Where(s => s.Status == SagaStepStatus.Compensated)
            .ToList();
        
        Assert.Equal(completedSteps.Count, compensatedSteps.Count);
    }
}

        await EventBus.PublishAsync(taskCompletedEvent);
        
        // Allow async processing
        await Task.Delay(100);
        
        // Assert
        // Verify project updated
        // Verify notification sent
        // Verify search index updated
    }
    
    [Fact]
    public async Task WhenEventFails_OtherHandlersContinue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var failingHandler = new Mock<IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>>();
        failingHandler
            .Setup(h => h.HandleAsync(It.IsAny<TaskCompletedEto>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .ThrowsAsync(new Exception("Handler failure"));
        
        var successHandler = new Mock<IIntegrationEventHandler<TaskCompletedEto>>();
        
        EventBus.Subscribe(failingHandler.Object);
        EventBus.Subscribe(successHandler.Object);
        
        var @event = new TaskCompletedEto { TaskId = Guid.NewGuid() };
        
        // Act
        await EventBus.PublishAsync(@event);
        
        // Assert
        successHandler.Verify(
            h => h.HandleAsync(@event, It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

## **Chapter 153 - Domain Services Architecture**

### 153.1 Domain Services vs Application Services

**Domain Services** encapsulate domain logic that:
- Spans multiple aggregates
- Doesn't naturally belong to any single aggregate
- Requires coordination between domain objects
- Implements pure business rules without infrastructure concerns

**Distinction from Application Services:**

| Aspect | Domain Service | Application Service |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| **Purpose** | Business logic coordination | Use case orchestration |
| **Dependencies** | Domain objects only | Infrastructure + Domain |
| **Transactions** | Not responsible | Manages transactions |
| **Testability** | Pure domain testing | Integration testing |
| **Layer** | Domain Layer | Application Layer |

### 153.2 Domain Service Categories

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Workflow ["Workflow Services"]
        WTS[Workflow Transition Service]
        WAE[Workflow Action Executor]
        WCE[Workflow Condition Evaluator]
        WVS[Workflow Validation Service]
    end
    
    subgraph Approval ["Approval Services"]
        AWE[Approval Workflow Engine]
        ATE[Approval Timeout Executor]
        AES[Approval Escalation Service]
        ASS[Approval Simulation Service]
    end
    
    subgraph Task ["Task Services"]
        TPS[Task Processing Service]
        TDS[Task Dependency Service]
        TRS[Task Recurrence Service]
        TVS[Task Validation Service]
    end
    
    subgraph Project ["Project Services"]
        PHS[Project Health Calculator]
        PFS[Project Forecasting Service]
        PDS[Project Dependency Service]
        PCS[Project Cost Aggregator]
    end
    
    subgraph Policy ["Policy Services"]
        PSE[Policy Set Evaluator]
        SPE[Start Policy Evaluator]
        CPE[Completion Policy Evaluator]
        TPE[Transition Policy Evaluator]
    end
```

### 153.3 Domain Service Design Principles

**1. Stateless Execution**  
Domain services should not maintain state between invocations.

**2. Pure Domain Logic**  
No infrastructure concerns (databases, caching, messaging).

**3. Rich Parameters**  
Accept domain objects, value objects, and domain primitives.

**4. Explicit Dependencies**  
Depend only on repositories, other domain services, and domain objects.

**5. Single Responsibility**  
Each service focused on one domain concern.

**6. Testability**  
Easily testable with mock repositories and in-memory objects.

## **Chapter 154 - Workflow Services**

### 154.1 Workflow Transition Service

**Purpose:** Orchestrates the execution of workflow transitions, validating all preconditions and executing all actions.

**Responsibilities:**
- Permission validation
- Condition evaluation
- Validator execution
- Pre-transition checks
- Status change coordination
- Action execution
- Event emission

**Execution Flow:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant WTS as Workflow Transition Service
    participant PE as Permission Evaluator
    participant CE as Condition Evaluator
    participant VE as Validator Engine
    participant AE as Action Executor
    participant TI as Task Instance
    participant Events as Event Publisher
    
    Client->>WTS: ExecuteTransition(taskId, transitionId, userId)
    
    WTS->>WTS: Load Workflow & Transition
    WTS->>PE: CheckPermission(transition, user)
    
    alt Permission Denied
        PE-->>WTS: Denied
        WTS-->>Client: TransitionDenied(reason)
    end
    
    WTS->>CE: EvaluateConditions(transition, context)
    
    alt Conditions Failed
        CE-->>WTS: Failed(failedConditions)
        WTS-->>Client: TransitionDenied(conditionFailures)
    end
    
    WTS->>VE: ValidateRequiredFields(transition, task)
    
    alt Validation Failed
        VE-->>WTS: Failed(missingFields)
        WTS-->>Client: TransitionDenied(validationErrors)
    end
    
    WTS->>TI: BeginTransition(newStatus)
    TI-->>WTS: TransitionStarted
    
    WTS->>AE: ExecuteActions(transition.Actions, context)
    AE-->>WTS: ActionsCompleted
    
    WTS->>TI: CommitTransition()
    TI-->>WTS: TransitionCommitted
    
    WTS->>Events: Publish(TransitionExecutedEto)
    
    WTS-->>Client: TransitionSuccessful(result)
```

**Implementation Pattern:**

```csharp
public class WorkflowTransitionService : IWorkflowTransitionService
{
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepo;
    private readonly ITransitionPermissionEvaluator _permissionEvaluator;
    private readonly IConditionEvaluationService _conditionService;
    private readonly IValidatorEngine _validatorEngine;
    private readonly IWorkflowActionExecutor _actionExecutor;
    private readonly IDomainEventPublisher _eventPublisher;
    
    public async Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        Guid taskInstanceId,
        Guid transitionId,
        Guid userId,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        // 1. Load transition definition
        var transition = await _workflowRepo
            .GetTransitionAsync(transitionId);
        
        // 2. Check permissions
        var permissionResult = await _permissionEvaluator
            .CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(userId, transition, context);
        
        if (!permissionResult.IsAllowed)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Denied(
                permissionResult.Reason);
        }
        
        // 3. Evaluate conditions
        var conditionResult = await _conditionService
            .EvaluateAllConditionsAsync(transition.Conditions, context);
        
        if (!conditionResult.AllPassed)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Denied(
                "Conditions not met", 
                conditionResult.FailedConditions);
        }
        
        // 4. Validate required fields
        var validationResult = await _validatorEngine
            .ValidateAsync(transition.Validators, context);
        
        if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Denied(
                "Validation failed", 
                validationResult.Errors);
        }
        
        // 5. Execute transition on aggregate
        var taskInstance = context.TaskInstance;
        taskInstance.BeginTransition(transition.ToStatusId);
        
        // 6. Execute actions
        var actionResults = await _actionExecutor
            .ExecuteActionsAsync(transition.Actions, context);
        
        // 7. Commit transition
        taskInstance.CommitTransition();
        
        // 8. Publish events
        await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(
            new WorkflowTransitionExecutedEto
            {
                TaskInstanceId = taskInstanceId,
                TransitionId = transitionId,
                FromStatusId = transition.FromStatusId,
                ToStatusId = transition.ToStatusId,
                UserId = userId,
                Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
                ActionResults = actionResults
            });
        
        return TransitionResult.Success(actionResults);
    }
}
```

### 154.2 Workflow Action Executor Service

**Purpose:** Executes workflow actions using a strategy pattern for extensibility.

**Action Types:**

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class IWorkflowAction {
        <<interface>>
        +Guid Id
        +string ActionType
        +int OrderIndex
        +bool ContinueOnError
        +Json Configuration
    }
    
    class IWorkflowActionExecutor {
        <<interface>>
        +bool CanExecute(action)
        +Task<ActionResult> ExecuteAsync(action, context)
    }
    
    class AssignUserActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class SetFieldValueActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class SendNotificationActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class TriggerWebhookActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class InitiateApprovalActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class CreateSubtaskActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    class ExecuteScriptActionExecutor {
        +ExecuteAsync()
    }
    
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. AssignUserActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. SetFieldValueActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. SendNotificationActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. TriggerWebhookActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. InitiateApprovalActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. CreateSubtaskActionExecutor
    IWorkflowActionExecutor <|.. ExecuteScriptActionExecutor
```

**Execution Pipeline:**

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Actions List] --> F[Filter Enabled]
    F --> S[Sort by OrderIndex]
    S --> G{Action Type}
    
    G -->|Sync| SE[Sync Executor]
    G -->|Async| AE[Async Queue]
    
    SE --> R[Result Collector]
    AE --> BG[Background Worker]
    BG --> R
    
    R --> H{Continue On Error?}
    H -->|Yes| Next[Next Action]
    H -->|No + Error| Stop[Stop Pipeline]
    
    Next --> G
```

**Implementation Pattern:**

```csharp
public class WorkflowActionExecutorService
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<IWorkflowActionExecutor> _executors;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobQueue _jobQueue;
    
    public async Task<ActionExecutionResults> ExecuteActionsAsync(
        IEnumerable<WorkflowAction> actions,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        var results = new ActionExecutionResults();
        
        // Filter and sort
        var enabledActions = actions
            .Where(a => a.IsEnabled)
            .OrderBy(a => a.OrderIndex)
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var action in enabledActions)
        {
            try
            {
                // Find executor
                var executor = _executors
                    .FirstOrDefault(e => e.CanExecute(action));
                
                if (executor == null)
                {
                    results.AddError(action.Id, 
                        $"No executor found for {action.ActionType}");
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Execute based on execution mode
                if (action.ExecutionMode == ActionExecutionMode.Synchronous)
                {
                    var result = await executor
                        .ExecuteAsync(action, context);
                    results.Add(result);
                }
                else
                {
                    // Queue for async execution
                    await _jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(
                        new WorkflowActionJob
                        {
                            ActionId = action.Id,
                            Context = context.Snapshot()
                        });
                    
                    results.AddQueued(action.Id);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                results.AddError(action.Id, ex.Message);
                
                if (!action.ContinueOnError)
                {
                    break; // Stop pipeline
                }
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}
```

### 154.3 Workflow Condition Evaluation Service

**Purpose:** Evaluates complex conditional logic before allowing transitions.

**Condition Types:**

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class ICondition {
        <<interface>>
        +Guid Id
        +ConditionType Type
        +string Expression
        +ConditionOperator Operator
        +bool IsNegated
    }
    
    class IConditionEvaluator {
        <<interface>>
        +bool CanEvaluate(condition)
        +Task<bool> EvaluateAsync(condition, context)
    }
    
    class FieldValueConditionEvaluator {
        +EvaluateAsync()
    }
    
    class RoleBasedConditionEvaluator {
        +EvaluateAsync()
    }
    
    class ScriptConditionEvaluator {
        +EvaluateAsync()
    }
    
    class TimeWindowConditionEvaluator {
        +EvaluateAsync()
    }
    
    class CustomFieldConditionEvaluator {
        +EvaluateAsync()
    }
    
    IConditionEvaluator <|.. FieldValueConditionEvaluator
    IConditionEvaluator <|.. RoleBasedConditionEvaluator
    IConditionEvaluator <|.. ScriptConditionEvaluator
    IConditionEvaluator <|.. TimeWindowConditionEvaluator
    IConditionEvaluator <|.. CustomFieldConditionEvaluator
```

**Evaluation Logic:**

```csharp
public class ConditionEvaluationService : IConditionEvaluationService
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<IConditionEvaluator> _evaluators;
    
    public async Task<ConditionEvaluationResult> EvaluateAllConditionsAsync(
        IEnumerable<WorkflowCondition> conditions,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        if (!conditions.Any())
        {
            return ConditionEvaluationResult.AllPassed();
        }
        
        var results = new List<IndividualConditionResult>();
        
        foreach (var condition in conditions)
        {
            var evaluator = _evaluators
                .FirstOrDefault(e => e.CanEvaluate(condition));
            
            if (evaluator == null)
            {
                results.Add(new IndividualConditionResult
                {
                    ConditionId = condition.Id,
                    Passed = false,
                    Reason = $"No evaluator for {condition.Type}"
                });
                continue;
            }
            
            var passed = await evaluator
                .EvaluateAsync(condition, context);
            
            // Apply negation if needed
            if (condition.IsNegated)
            {
                passed = !passed;
            }
            
            results.Add(new IndividualConditionResult
            {
                ConditionId = condition.Id,
                Passed = passed,
                Expression = condition.Expression,
                EvaluatedValue = context.GetFieldValue(condition.FieldName)
            });
        }
        
        // Aggregate based on logical operator (AND/OR)
        var allPassed = context.ConditionLogicOperator == LogicOperator.And
            ? results.All(r => r.Passed)
            : results.Any(r => r.Passed);
        
        return new ConditionEvaluationResult
        {
            AllPassed = allPassed,
            IndividualResults = results,
            FailedConditions = results.Where(r => !r.Passed).ToList()
        };
    }
}
```

### 154.4 Workflow Validation Service

**Purpose:** Validates workflow graph integrity and identifies structural issues.

**Validation Types:**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    WF[Workflow Definition] --> V1[Structural Validation]
    WF --> V2[Reachability Validation]
    WF --> V3[Consistency Validation]
    WF --> V4[Security Validation]
    
    V1 --> C1{Has Initial State?}
    V1 --> C2{Has Terminal States?}
    V1 --> C3{Valid Transitions?}
    
    V2 --> R1{All States Reachable?}
    V2 --> R2{No Dead Ends?}
    V2 --> R3{No Orphaned States?}
    
    V3 --> CO1{Conditions Valid?}
    V3 --> CO2{Actions Valid?}
    V3 --> CO3{Fields Exist?}
    
    V4 --> S1{Permissions Set?}
    V4 --> S2{No Security Gaps?}
    
    C1 --> Result[Validation Result]
    C2 --> Result
    C3 --> Result
    R1 --> Result
    R2 --> Result
    R3 --> Result
    CO1 --> Result
    CO2 --> Result
    CO3 --> Result
    S1 --> Result
    S2 --> Result
```

**Graph Analysis:**

```csharp
public class WorkflowValidationService : IWorkflowValidationService
{
    public WorkflowValidationResult ValidateWorkflow(Workflow workflow)
    {
        var result = new WorkflowValidationResult();
        
        // 1. Structural validation
        ValidateStructure(workflow, result);
        
        // 2. Reachability analysis
        ValidateReachability(workflow, result);
        
        // 3. Transition consistency
        ValidateTransitions(workflow, result);
        
        // 4. Security completeness
        ValidateSecurity(workflow, result);
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private void ValidateReachability(
        Workflow workflow, 
        WorkflowValidationResult result)
    {
        var initialState = workflow.States
            .FirstOrDefault(s => s.IsInitial);
        
        if (initialState == null)
        {
            result.AddError("No initial state defined");
            return;
        }
        
        // Build adjacency graph
        var graph = BuildTransitionGraph(workflow);
        
        // DFS from initial state
        var reachable = new HashSet<Guid>();
        var visited = new HashSet<Guid>();
        
        void DFS(Guid stateId)
        {
            if (visited.Contains(stateId)) return;
            
            visited.Add(stateId);
            reachable.Add(stateId);
            
            if (graph.TryGetValue(stateId, out var neighbors))
            {
                foreach (var neighbor in neighbors)
                {
                    DFS(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
        
        DFS(initialState.Id);
        
        // Check for unreachable states
        var unreachableStates = workflow.States
            .Where(s => !reachable.Contains(s.Id) && !s.IsInitial)
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var state in unreachableStates)
        {
            result.AddWarning(
                $"State '{state.Name}' is unreachable from initial state");
        }
        
        // Check for dead ends (non-terminal states with no outgoing transitions)
        var deadEnds = workflow.States
            .Where(s => !s.IsTerminal && 
                       (!graph.ContainsKey(s.Id) || !graph[s.Id].Any()))
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var state in deadEnds)
        {
            result.AddWarning(
                $"State '{state.Name}' is a dead end (no outgoing transitions)");
        }
    }
    
    private Dictionary<Guid, List<Guid>> BuildTransitionGraph(Workflow workflow)
    {
        return workflow.Transitions
            .GroupBy(t => t.FromStatusId)
            .ToDictionary(
                g => g.Key,
                g => g.Select(t => t.ToStatusId).Distinct().ToList()
            );
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 155 - Approval Services**

### 155.1 Approval Workflow Engine

**Purpose:** Executes multi-step approval processes with strategy-based step progression.

**Approval Strategies:**

```mermaid
classDiagram
    class IApprovalStrategy {
        <<interface>>
        +bool CanProceedToNextStep(step, decisions)
        +ApprovalStepResult EvaluateStep(step, decisions)
    }
    
    class SequentialStrategy {
        +CanProceedToNextStep()
        +EvaluateStep()
    }
    
    class ParallelStrategy {
        +CanProceedToNextStep()
        +EvaluateStep()
    }
    
    class MajorityStrategy {
        +CanProceedToNextStep()
        +EvaluateStep()
    }
    
    class AnyStrategy {
        +CanProceedToNextStep()
        +EvaluateStep()
    }
    
    class WeightedStrategy {
        +CanProceedToNextStep()
        +EvaluateStep()
    }
    
    IApprovalStrategy <|.. SequentialStrategy
    IApprovalStrategy <|.. ParallelStrategy
    IApprovalStrategy <|.. MajorityStrategy
    IApprovalStrategy <|.. AnyStrategy
    IApprovalStrategy <|.. WeightedStrategy
```

**Engine Flow:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant AR as Approval Request
    participant Engine as Approval Engine
    participant Strategy as Strategy Evaluator
    participant Step as Current Step
    participant Next as Next Step
    
    AR->>Engine: ProcessDecision(decision)
    Engine->>Engine: Validate Decision
    Engine->>Step: AddDecision(decision)
    Engine->>Strategy: EvaluateStep(step, decisions)
    
    alt Step Not Complete
        Strategy-->>Engine: AwaitingMore
        Engine-->>AR: StepInProgress
    end
    
    alt Step Complete - Approved
        Strategy-->>Engine: StepApproved
        Engine->>Next: ActivateNextStep()
        Engine-->>AR: StepCompleted, NextStepActive
    end
    
    alt Step Complete - Rejected
        Strategy-->>Engine: StepRejected
        Engine->>AR: RejectWorkflow()
        Engine-->>AR: WorkflowRejected
    end
    
    alt No More Steps
        Engine->>AR: CompleteWorkflow()
        Engine-->>AR: WorkflowCompleted
    end
```

**Implementation:**

```csharp
public class ApprovalWorkflowEngine : IApprovalWorkflowEngine
{
    private readonly IApprovalRequestRepository _requestRepo;
    private readonly IApprovalStrategyFactory _strategyFactory;
    private readonly IDomainEventPublisher _eventPublisher;
    
    public async Task<ApprovalDecisionResult> ProcessDecisionAsync(
        Guid approvalRequestId,
        Guid stepId,
        Guid approverId,
        ApprovalAction action,
        string comments)
    {
        // Load approval request
        var request = await _requestRepo
            .GetWithDetailsAsync(approvalRequestId);
        
        // Validate decision
        var step = request.GetStep(stepId);
        if (!step.CanUserDecide(approverId))
        {
            return ApprovalDecisionResult.Denied(
                "User not authorized to decide on this step");
        }
        
        if (step.HasUserDecided(approverId))
        {
            return ApprovalDecisionResult.Denied(
                "User has already decided on this step");
        }
        
        // Add decision
        var decision = new ApprovalDecision
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            StepId = stepId,
            ApproverId = approverId,
            Action = action,
            Comments = comments,
            DecidedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        request.AddDecision(decision);
        
        // Evaluate step using strategy
        var strategy = _strategyFactory.GetStrategy(step.Strategy);
        var stepResult = strategy.EvaluateStep(step, request.GetStepDecisions(stepId));
        
        if (stepResult.IsComplete)
        {
            if (stepResult.IsApproved)
            {
                // Move to next step or complete
                if (request.HasMoreSteps())
                {
                    request.MoveToNextStep();
                    
                    await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(
                        new ApprovalStepCompletedEto
                        {
                            RequestId = approvalRequestId,
                            StepId = stepId,
                            Result = ApprovalStepResult.Approved,
                            NextStepId = request.CurrentStepId
                        });
                }
                else
                {
                    request.Complete(ApprovalResult.Approved);
                    
                    await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(
                        new ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto
                        {
                            RequestId = approvalRequestId,
                            Result = ApprovalResult.Approved,
                            CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                        });
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Rejection terminates workflow
                request.Complete(ApprovalResult.Rejected);
                
                await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(
                    new ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto
                    {
                        RequestId = approvalRequestId,
                        Result = ApprovalResult.Rejected,
                        RejectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                        RejectedBy = approverId
                    });
            }
        }
        
        await _requestRepo.UpdateAsync(request);
        
        return ApprovalDecisionResult.Success(stepResult);
    }
}
```

### 155.2 Approval Timeout Executor Service

**Purpose:** Background service that processes approval timeouts and executes timeout policies.

**Timeout Detection:**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Worker[Timeout Worker] --> Query[Query Pending Requests]
    Query --> Filter[Filter by Timeout Threshold]
    Filter --> Check{Past Deadline?}
    
    Check -->|No| Skip[Skip]
    Check -->|Yes| Load[Load Timeout Policy]
    
    Load --> Policy{Policy Action}
    
    Policy -->|Auto-Approve| AA[Execute Auto-Approve]
    Policy -->|Auto-Reject| AR[Execute Auto-Reject]
    Policy -->|Escalate| ESC[Execute Escalation]
    Policy -->|Notify| NOT[Send Notifications]
    Policy -->|Custom| CUS[Execute Custom Script]
    
    AA --> Event[Publish Timeout Event]
    AR --> Event
    ESC --> Event
    NOT --> Event
    CUS --> Event
    
    Event --> Next[Process Next]
```

**Implementation:**

```csharp
public class ApprovalTimeoutExecutorService : IApprovalTimeoutExecutorService
{
    private readonly IApprovalRequestRepository _requestRepo;
    private readonly ITimeoutPolicyRepository _policyRepo;
    private readonly IApprovalWorkflowEngine _engine;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly IDomainEventPublisher _eventPublisher;
    
    public async Task ProcessTimeoutsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Find requests with timed-out steps
        var timedOutRequests = await _requestRepo
            .GetTimedOutRequestsAsync(DateTime.UtcNow);
        
        foreach (var request in timedOutRequests)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            var currentStep = request.GetCurrentStep();
            if (currentStep == null || !currentStep.HasTimeout)
                continue;
            
            var policy = currentStep.TimeoutPolicy;
            
            try
            {
                switch (policy.Action)
                {
                    case TimeoutAction.AutoApprove:
                        await ExecuteAutoApprove(request, currentStep);
                        break;
                    
                    case TimeoutAction.AutoReject:
                        await ExecuteAutoReject(request, currentStep);
                        break;
                    
                    case TimeoutAction.Escalate:
                        await ExecuteEscalation(request, currentStep, policy);
                        break;
                    
                    case TimeoutAction.Notify:
                        await SendTimeoutNotifications(request, currentStep, policy);
                        break;
                    
                    case TimeoutAction.CustomScript:
                        await ExecuteCustomScript(request, currentStep, policy);
                        break;
                }
                
                // Mark step as timed out
                currentStep.MarkTimedOut(DateTime.UtcNow);
                await _requestRepo.UpdateAsync(request);
                
                // Publish event
                await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(
                    new ApprovalStepTimedOutEto
                    {
                        RequestId = request.Id,
                        StepId = currentStep.Id,
                        TimeoutAction = policy.Action,
                        TimedOutAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                    });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log error but continue processing other requests
                // Error handling and retry logic here
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ExecuteAutoApprove(
        ApprovalRequest request, 
        ApprovalStep step)
    {
        // Create system approval decision
        var systemDecision = new ApprovalDecision
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            StepId = step.Id,
            ApproverId = SystemUser.Id,
            Action = ApprovalAction.Approve,
            Comments = "Auto-approved due to timeout",
            DecidedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            IsAutoDecision = true
        };
        
        // Process through engine
        await _engine.ProcessDecisionAsync(
            request.Id,
            step.Id,
            SystemUser.Id,
            ApprovalAction.Approve,
            systemDecision.Comments);
    }
    
    private async Task ExecuteEscalation(
        ApprovalRequest request,
        ApprovalStep step,
        TimeoutPolicy policy)
    {
        var escalationPolicy = policy.EscalationPolicy;
        
        // Add escalation approvers
        foreach (var userId in escalationPolicy.EscalateToUsers)
        {
            step.AddEscalationApprover(userId);
        }
        
        // Add watchers
        foreach (var watcherId in escalationPolicy.AddWatchers)
        {
            request.AddWatcher(watcherId);
        }
        
        // Increase priority
        if (escalationPolicy.IncreasePriority)
        {
            request.IncreasePriority();
        }
        
        // Send escalation notifications
        await _notificationService.SendEscalationNotificationsAsync(
            request,
            step,
            escalationPolicy);
        
        await _requestRepo.UpdateAsync(request);
    }
}
```

### 155.3 Approval Simulation Service

**Purpose:** Predicts approval workflow outcomes based on historical data and approver availability.

**Simulation Inputs:**
- Historical approval speed by approver
- Approver workload and availability
- Time of day/week patterns
- Approval complexity metrics
- Dependency on other approvals

**Simulation Outputs:**
- Estimated completion time (P50, P90, P99)
- Likelihood of timeout by step
- Bottleneck identification
- Optimal routing suggestions

```csharp
public class ApprovalSimulationService : IApprovalSimulationService
{
    private readonly IApprovalHistoryRepository _historyRepo;
    private readonly IUserWorkloadService _workloadService;
    private readonly IWorkingCalendarService _calendarService;
    
    public async Task<ApprovalForecast> SimulateWorkflowAsync(
        Guid workflowId,
        List<Guid> approverIds,
        DateTime startTime)
    {
        var workflow = await LoadWorkflowAsync(workflowId);
        var forecast = new ApprovalForecast();
        var currentTime = startTime;
        
        foreach (var step in workflow.Steps.OrderBy(s => s.Order))
        {
            var stepForecast = await SimulateStepAsync(
                step,
                approverIds,
                currentTime);
            
            forecast.AddStepForecast(stepForecast);
            currentTime = stepForecast.EstimatedCompletionTime;
        }
        
        return forecast;
    }
    
    private async Task<StepForecast> SimulateStepAsync(
        ApprovalStep step,
        List<Guid> approverIds,
        DateTime startTime)
    {
        // Get historical data for these approvers
        var historicalData = await _historyRepo
            .GetApproverPerformanceAsync(approverIds, step.Id);
        
        // Get current workload
        var workload = await _workloadService
            .GetWorkloadAsync(approverIds);
        
        // Calculate expected duration
        var baselineDuration = historicalData
            .Select(h => h.AverageDecisionTime)
            .DefaultIfEmpty(TimeSpan.FromHours(4))
            .Average();
        
        // Adjust for workload
        var workloadMultiplier = CalculateWorkloadMultiplier(workload);
        var adjustedDuration = baselineDuration * workloadMultiplier;
        
        // Account for business hours
        var completionTime = await _calendarService
            .AddBusinessDurationAsync(startTime, adjustedDuration);
        
        // Calculate timeout risk
        var timeoutRisk = step.HasTimeout
            ? CalculateTimeoutRisk(adjustedDuration, step.TimeoutHours)
            : 0.0;
        
        return new StepForecast
        {
            StepId = step.Id,
            EstimatedStartTime = startTime,
            EstimatedCompletionTime = completionTime,
            EstimatedDuration = adjustedDuration,
            TimeoutRisk = timeoutRisk,
            ConfidenceLevel = CalculateConfidence(historicalData)
        };
    }
}
```

### 156.1 Task Processing Service

**Purpose:** Orchestrates complex task operations spanning multiple aggregates.
