**Start Task Flow:**

```csharp
public class TaskProcessingService : ITaskProcessingService
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    private readonly IWorkflowTransitionService _workflowService;
    private readonly ITaskDependencyService _dependencyService;
    private readonly IPolicyEvaluator _policyEvaluator;
    private readonly IDomainEventPublisher _eventPublisher;
    
    public async Task<TaskOperationResult> StartTaskAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid userId,
        StartTaskOptions options)
    {
        // 1. Load task with all aggregates
        var task = await _taskRepo.GetWithDetailsAsync(taskId);
        
        if (task == null)
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.NotFound();
        }
        
        // 2. Validate current state
        if (!task.Progress.CanStart())
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.InvalidState(
                $"Cannot start task in {task.Progress.Category} state");
        }
        
        // 3. Check dependencies
        var dependencyCheck = await _dependencyService
            .CanStartTaskAsync(taskId);
        
        if (!dependencyCheck.CanStart)
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.Blocked(
                "Dependencies not satisfied",
                dependencyCheck.BlockingDependencies);
        }
        
        // 4. Evaluate start policies
        var policyResult = await _policyEvaluator
            .EvaluateStartPoliciesAsync(task, userId);
        
        if (!policyResult.CanProceed)
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.PolicyViolation(
                policyResult.Reason,
                policyResult.FailedPolicies);
        }
        
        // 5. Execute workflow transition to InProgress
        var transitionResult = await _workflowService
            .ExecuteTransitionAsync(
                taskId,
                task.GetStartTransitionId(),
                userId,
                new TransitionContext { TaskInstance = task });
        
        if (!transitionResult.IsSuccess)
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.TransitionFailed(
                transitionResult.Reason);
        }
        
        // 6. Update schedule aggregate
        task.Schedule.MarkStarted(DateTime.UtcNow);
        
        // 7. Update assignment if needed
        if (options.AutoAssign && task.Assignment.AssigneeId == null)
        {
            task.Assignment.Assign(userId);
        }
        
        // 8. Append to history
        task.History.Add(new HistoryEntry
        {
            Type = TaskHistoryChangeType.Started,
            ChangedBy = userId,
            ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Description = "Task started"
        });
        
        // 9. Persist changes
        await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
        
        // 10. Publish events
        await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(new TaskStartedEto
        {
            TaskId = taskId,
            ProjectId = task.ProjectId,
            StartedBy = userId,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            FromStatus = transitionResult.FromStatus,
            ToStatus = transitionResult.ToStatus
        });
        
        return TaskOperationResult.Success();
    }
}
```

**Complete Task Flow:**

```csharp
public async Task<TaskOperationResult> CompleteTaskAsync(
    Guid taskId,
    Guid userId,
    CompleteTaskOptions options)
{
    // 1. Load task
    var task = await _taskRepo.GetWithDetailsAsync(taskId);
    
    // 2. Validate completion policies
    var policyResult = await _policyEvaluator
        .EvaluateCompletionPoliciesAsync(task, options);
    
    if (!policyResult.CanProceed)
    {
        return TaskOperationResult.PolicyViolation(
            policyResult.Reason,
            policyResult.FailedPolicies);
    }
    
    // 3. Check approval status if required
    if (task.Approval.RequiresApproval)
    {
        if (task.Approval.Status != ApprovalStatus.Approved)
        {
            return TaskOperationResult.ApprovalRequired(
                $"Task requires approval. Current status: {task.Approval.Status}");
        }
    }
    
    // 4. Validate required action steps
    var blueprint = await LoadBlueprintAsync(task.TaskBlueprintVersionId);
    var requiredSteps = blueprint.ActionSteps
        .Where(s => s.IsRequired)
        .ToList();
    
    var completedSteps = options.CompletedSteps ?? new List<Guid>();
    var missingSteps = requiredSteps
        .Where(s => !completedSteps.Contains(s.Id))
        .ToList();
    
    if (missingSteps.Any())
    {
        return TaskOperationResult.RequiredStepsMissing(
            "Required action steps not completed",
            missingSteps.Select(s => s.Title).ToList());
    }
    
    // 5. Execute workflow transition to Done
    var transitionResult = await _workflowService
        .ExecuteTransitionAsync(
            taskId,
            task.GetCompleteTransitionId(),
            userId,
            new TransitionContext
            {
                TaskInstance = task,
                CompletionData = options
            });
    
    if (!transitionResult.IsSuccess)
    {
        return TaskOperationResult.TransitionFailed(
            transitionResult.Reason);
    }
    
    // 6. Update schedule
    task.Schedule.MarkCompleted(DateTime.UtcNow);
    
    // 7. Update progress to 100%
    task.Progress.MarkComplete();
    
    // 8. Record resolution if provided
    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.Resolution))
    {
        task.SetResolution(options.Resolution, options.ResolutionCode);
    }
    
    // 9. Update parent task progress if applicable
    if (task.Hierarchy.ParentTaskId.HasValue)
    {
        await UpdateParentProgressAsync(task.Hierarchy.ParentTaskId.Value);
    }
    
    // 10. History
    task.History.Add(new HistoryEntry
    {
        Type = TaskHistoryChangeType.Completed,
        ChangedBy = userId,
        ChangedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
        Description = "Task completed",
        NewValue = options.Resolution
    });
    
    // 11. Persist
    await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
    
    // 12. Events
    await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(new TaskCompletedEto
    {
        TaskId = taskId,
        ProjectId = task.ProjectId,
        CompletedBy = userId,
        CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
        Duration = task.Schedule.CompletedAt - task.Schedule.ActualStart,
        Resolution = options.Resolution
    });
    
    return TaskOperationResult.Success();
}
```

### 156.2 Task Dependency Service

**Purpose:** Manages dependency graph operations and critical path analysis.

**Core Capabilities:**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    TDS[Task Dependency Service]
    
    TDS --> Add[Add Dependency]
    TDS --> Remove[Remove Dependency]
    TDS --> Validate[Validate Graph]
    TDS --> Calculate[Calculate Dates]
    TDS --> Critical[Critical Path]
    
    Add --> A1[Check Cycles]
    Add --> A2[Update Graph]
    Add --> A3[Recalculate Dates]
    
    Validate --> V1[Cycle Detection]
    Validate --> V2[Type Validation]
    Validate --> V3[Constraint Check]
    
    Calculate --> C1[Earliest Start]
    Calculate --> C2[Latest Finish]
    Calculate --> C3[Slack Time]
    
    Critical --> CP1[Forward Pass]
    Critical --> CP2[Backward Pass]
    Critical --> CP3[Identify Path]
```

**Implementation:**

```csharp
public class TaskDependencyService : ITaskDependencyService
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    private readonly IDependencyGraphService _graphService;
    
    public async Task<DependencyOperationResult> AddDependencyAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid dependsOnTaskId,
        DependencyType type,
        int lagMinutes = 0)
    {
        // 1. Validate tasks exist
        var task = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(taskId);
        var dependsOnTask = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(dependsOnTaskId);
        
        if (task == null || dependsOnTask == null)
        {
            return DependencyOperationResult.NotFound();
        }
        
        // 2. Validate not self-dependency
        if (taskId == dependsOnTaskId)
        {
            return DependencyOperationResult.Invalid(
                "Task cannot depend on itself");
        }
        
        // 3. Check for circular dependency
        var graph = await BuildDependencyGraphAsync(task.ProjectId);
        
        if (graph.WouldCreateCycle(taskId, dependsOnTaskId))
        {
            return DependencyOperationResult.CircularDependency(
                "Adding this dependency would create a cycle");
        }
        
        // 4. Add dependency
        var dependency = new TaskDependency
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            DependsOnTaskId = dependsOnTaskId,
            Type = type,
            LagMinutes = lagMinutes,
            IsBlocking = true
        };
        
        task.Dependency.AddDependency(dependency);
        
        // 5. Recalculate dates
        await RecalculateDependentDatesAsync(taskId, graph);
        
        // 6. Update critical path
        await UpdateCriticalPathAsync(task.ProjectId);
        
        // 7. Persist
        await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
        
        return DependencyOperationResult.Success(dependency.Id);
    }
    
    public async Task<CanStartResult> CanStartTaskAsync(Guid taskId)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepo.GetWithDependenciesAsync(taskId);
        var dependencies = task.Dependency.Dependencies
            .Where(d => d.IsBlocking)
            .ToList();
        
        if (!dependencies.Any())
        {
            return CanStartResult.Yes();
        }
        
        var blockingDependencies = new List<BlockingDependency>();
        
        foreach (var dep in dependencies)
        {
            var dependsOnTask = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(dep.DependsOnTaskId);
            
            var canProceed = dep.Type switch
            {
                DependencyType.FinishToStart => 
                    dependsOnTask.Progress.IsComplete(),
                
                DependencyType.StartToStart => 
                    dependsOnTask.Progress.IsStarted(),
                
                DependencyType.FinishToFinish => 
                    true, // Doesn't block start
                
                DependencyType.StartToFinish => 
                    dependsOnTask.Progress.IsStarted(),
                
                _ => false
            };
            
            if (!canProceed)
            {
                blockingDependencies.Add(new BlockingDependency
                {
                    DependencyId = dep.Id,
                    BlockingTaskId = dep.DependsOnTaskId,
                    BlockingTaskTitle = dependsOnTask.Title,
                    DependencyType = dep.Type,
                    Reason = GetBlockingReason(dep.Type, dependsOnTask)
                });
            }
        }
        
        if (blockingDependencies.Any())
        {
            return CanStartResult.Blocked(blockingDependencies);
        }
        
        return CanStartResult.Yes();
    }
    
    public async Task<CriticalPathResult> CalculateCriticalPathAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        // Get all tasks in project
        var tasks = await _taskRepo.GetByProjectAsync(projectId);
        
        // Build graph
        var graph = new DependencyGraph();
        foreach (var task in tasks)
        {
            graph.AddNode(task.Id, task.Schedule.EstimatedDuration);
            
            foreach (var dep in task.Dependency.Dependencies)
            {
                graph.AddEdge(dep.DependsOnTaskId, task.Id, dep.LagMinutes);
            }
        }
        
        // Forward pass - calculate earliest start/finish
        var earliestTimes = new Dictionary<Guid, (DateTime Start, DateTime Finish)>();
        var sortedTasks = graph.TopologicalSort();
        
        foreach (var taskId in sortedTasks)
        {
            var task = tasks.First(t => t.Id == taskId);
            var predecessors = graph.GetPredecessors(taskId);
            
            DateTime earliestStart;
            if (!predecessors.Any())
            {
                earliestStart = task.Schedule.PlannedStart ?? DateTime.UtcNow;
            }
            else
            {
                earliestStart = predecessors
                    .Select(p => earliestTimes[p.NodeId].Finish.AddMinutes(p.Lag))
                    .Max();
            }
            
            var earliestFinish = earliestStart.Add(task.Schedule.EstimatedDuration);
            earliestTimes[taskId] = (earliestStart, earliestFinish);
        }
        
        // Backward pass - calculate latest start/finish
        var latestTimes = new Dictionary<Guid, (DateTime Start, DateTime Finish)>();
        var projectEndDate = earliestTimes.Values.Max(t => t.Finish);
        
        foreach (var taskId in sortedTasks.Reverse())
        {
            var task = tasks.First(t => t.Id == taskId);
            var successors = graph.GetSuccessors(taskId);
            
            DateTime latestFinish;
            if (!successors.Any())
            {
                latestFinish = projectEndDate;
            }
            else
            {
                latestFinish = successors
                    .Select(s => latestTimes[s.NodeId].Start.AddMinutes(-s.Lag))
                    .Min();
            }
            
            var latestStart = latestFinish.Subtract(task.Schedule.EstimatedDuration);
            latestTimes[taskId] = (latestStart, latestFinish);
        }
        
        // Calculate slack and identify critical path
        var criticalPath = new List<Guid>();
        
        foreach (var taskId in sortedTasks)
        {
            var slack = latestTimes[taskId].Start - earliestTimes[taskId].Start;
            
            if (slack.TotalMinutes <= 0) // Zero or negative slack = critical
            {
                criticalPath.Add(taskId);
            }
        }
        
        return new CriticalPathResult
        {
            CriticalPath = criticalPath,
            EarliestTimes = earliestTimes,
            LatestTimes = latestTimes,
            ProjectDuration = projectEndDate - earliestTimes.Values.Min(t => t.Start),
            EstimatedCompletionDate = projectEndDate
        };
    }
}
```

### 156.3 Task Recurrence Service

**Purpose:** Manages automated creation of recurring tasks based on recurrence rules.

**Recurrence Processing:**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Worker[Recurrence Worker] --> Query[Query Active Blueprints with Recurrence]
    Query --> Check[Check Last Instance Created]
    Check --> Calc[Calculate Next Occurrence]
    Calc --> Due{Due for Creation?}
    
    Due -->|No| Skip[Skip to Next]
    Due -->|Yes| Create[Create Task Instance]
    
    Create --> Apply[Apply Blueprint]
    Apply --> Custom[Apply Custom Defaults]
    Custom --> Schedule[Set Calculated Dates]
    Schedule --> Save[Save Instance]
    Save --> Event[Publish Event]
    Event --> Update[Update Last Created Timestamp]
    Update --> Skip
```

```csharp
public class TaskRecurrenceService : ITaskRecurrenceService
{
    private readonly ITaskBlueprintRepository _blueprintRepo;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    private readonly IWorkingCalendarService _calendarService;
    private readonly IDomainEventPublisher _eventPublisher;
    
    public async Task ProcessRecurringTasksAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Get all active recurring blueprints
        var recurringBlueprints = await _blueprintRepo
            .GetActiveRecurringBlueprintsAsync();
        
        foreach (var blueprint in recurringBlueprints)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                await ProcessBlueprintRecurrenceAsync(blueprint);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log and continue with next blueprint
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessBlueprintRecurrenceAsync(TaskBlueprint blueprint)
    {
        var rule = blueprint.Recurrence;
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        // Get last created instance
        var lastInstance = await _taskRepo
            .GetLastInstanceFromBlueprintAsync(blueprint.Id);
        
        var lastCreatedDate = lastInstance?.CreatedAt ?? blueprint.CreatedAt;
        
        // Calculate next occurrence
        var nextOccurrence = CalculateNextOccurrence(
            rule,
            lastCreatedDate,
            now);
        
        if (nextOccurrence == null || nextOccurrence > now)
        {
            return; // Not due yet
        }
        
        // Check if already created for this occurrence
        var existingForOccurrence = await _taskRepo
            .GetInstanceForOccurrenceAsync(blueprint.Id, nextOccurrence.Value);
        
        if (existingForOccurrence != null)
        {
            return; // Already created
        }
        
        // Create new instance
        var taskInstance = await CreateInstanceFromBlueprintAsync(
            blueprint,
            nextOccurrence.Value);
        
        await _taskRepo.InsertAsync(taskInstance);
        
        // Publish event
        await _eventPublisher.PublishAsync(new RecurringTaskCreatedEto
        {
            TaskInstanceId = taskInstance.Id,
            BlueprintId = blueprint.Id,
            Occurrence = nextOccurrence.Value,
            CreatedAt = now
        });
    }
    
    private DateTime? CalculateNextOccurrence(
        RecurrenceRule rule,
        DateTime lastCreated,
        DateTime now)
    {
        if (rule.EndDate.HasValue && now > rule.EndDate.Value)
        {
            return null; // Recurrence has ended
        }
        
        DateTime nextDate;
        
        switch (rule.Frequency)
        {
            case RecurrenceFrequency.Daily:
                nextDate = lastCreated.AddDays(rule.Interval);
                break;
            
            case RecurrenceFrequency.Weekly:
                nextDate = CalculateNextWeeklyOccurrence(
                    lastCreated,
                    rule.Interval,
                    rule.DaysOfWeek);
                break;
            
            case RecurrenceFrequency.Monthly:
                nextDate = lastCreated.AddMonths(rule.Interval);
                if (rule.DayOfMonth.HasValue)
                {
                    nextDate = new DateTime(
                        nextDate.Year,
                        nextDate.Month,
                        Math.Min(rule.DayOfMonth.Value, 
                                DateTime.DaysInMonth(nextDate.Year, nextDate.Month)));
                }
                break;
            
            case RecurrenceFrequency.Yearly:
                nextDate = lastCreated.AddYears(rule.Interval);
                break;
            
            default:
                return null;
        }
        
        // Apply calendar adjustments
        nextDate = await _calendarService
            .AdjustToBusinessDayAsync(nextDate, rule.CalendarId);
        
        // Check count limit
        if (rule.Count.HasValue)
        {
            var instanceCount = await _taskRepo
                .CountInstancesFromBlueprintAsync(blueprint.Id);
            
            if (instanceCount >= rule.Count.Value)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        return nextDate;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 157 - Policy System Architecture**

### 157.1 Policy Framework Overview

**Purpose:** Provide a pluggable, extensible system for enforcing business rules across operations.

**Policy Categories:**

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Policies[Policy System]
    
    Policies --> Start[Start Policies]
```

### 157.2 Policy Interface Design

**Base Policy Interface:**

```csharp
public interface IPolicy<TContext>
{
    string Name { get; }
    int Priority { get; }
    bool IsEnabled { get; }
    
    Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TContext context);
}

public class PolicyResult
{
    public bool CanProceed { get; set; }
    public string Reason { get; set; }
    public List<string> FailedRules { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; }
    
    public static PolicyResult Allow() => new() { CanProceed = true };
    public static PolicyResult Deny(string reason) => new() 
    { 
        CanProceed = false, 
        Reason = reason 
    };
}
```

### 157.3 Start Policy System

**Start Policy Evaluator:**

```csharp
public class StartPolicyEvaluator : IPolicyEvaluator<TaskStartContext>
{
    private readonly IEnumerable<IPolicy<TaskStartContext>> _policies;
    
    public async Task<PolicyEvaluationResult> EvaluateStartPoliciesAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var context = new TaskStartContext
        {
            TaskInstance = task,
            UserId = userId,
            StartTime = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        var results = new List<PolicyResult>();
        
        // Evaluate all enabled policies in priority order
        var orderedPolicies = _policies
            .Where(p => p.IsEnabled)
            .OrderBy(p => p.Priority);
        
        foreach (var policy in orderedPolicies)
        {
            var result = await policy.EvaluateAsync(context);
            results.Add(result);
            
            if (!result.CanProceed)
            {
                // Stop on first failure
                break;
            }
        }
        
        var allPassed = results.All(r => r.CanProceed);
        
        return new PolicyEvaluationResult
        {
            CanProceed = allPassed,
            Reason = allPassed 
                ? null 
                : results.First(r => !r.CanProceed).Reason,
            FailedPolicies = results
                .Where(r => !r.CanProceed)
                .Select(r => r.Reason)
                .ToList()
        };
    }
}
```

**Dependency Start Policy:**

```csharp
public class DependencyStartPolicy : IPolicy<TaskStartContext>
{
    public string Name => "Dependency Start Policy";
    public int Priority => 100;
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    private readonly ITaskDependencyService _dependencyService;
    
    public async Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TaskStartContext context)
    {
        var canStartResult = await _dependencyService
            .CanStartTaskAsync(context.TaskInstance.Id);
        
        if (!canStartResult.CanStart)
        {
            return PolicyResult.Deny(
                $"Task blocked by {canStartResult.BlockingDependencies.Count} " +
                $"dependencies: {string.Join(", ", canStartResult.BlockingDependencies.Select(d => d.BlockingTaskTitle))}");
        }
        
        return PolicyResult.Allow();
    }
}
```

**Schedule Window Policy:**

```csharp
public class ScheduleWindowPolicy : IPolicy<TaskStartContext>
{
    public string Name => "Schedule Window Policy";
    public int Priority => 200;
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    private readonly IWorkingCalendarService _calendarService;
    
    public async Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TaskStartContext context)
    {
        var task = context.TaskInstance;
        var now = context.StartTime;
        
        // Check if task has planned start date
        if (!task.Schedule.PlannedStart.HasValue)
        {
            return PolicyResult.Allow(); // No constraint
        }
        
        var plannedStart = task.Schedule.PlannedStart.Value;
        
        // Can't start before planned start (with grace period)
        var gracePeriod = TimeSpan.FromHours(1);
        if (now < plannedStart.Subtract(gracePeriod))
        {
            return PolicyResult.Deny(
                $"Task cannot start before planned start date: {plannedStart:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}");
        }
        
        // Check if within working hours
        var calendar = await _calendarService
            .GetCalendarForTaskAsync(task.Id);
        
        if (!calendar.IsBusinessHour(now))
        {
            return PolicyResult.Deny(
                "Task can only be started during business hours");
        }
        
        return PolicyResult.Allow();
    }
}
```

### 157.4 Completion Policy System

**Required Steps Policy:**

```csharp
public class RequiredStepsCompletionPolicy : IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>
{
    public string Name => "Required Steps Completion Policy";
    public int Priority => 100;
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    private readonly ITaskBlueprintRepository _blueprintRepo;
    
    public async Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TaskCompletionContext context)
    {
        var task = context.TaskInstance;
        var completedSteps = context.CompletedSteps ?? new List<Guid>();
        
        // Load blueprint to get required steps
        var blueprint = await _blueprintRepo
            .GetVersionAsync(task.TaskBlueprintVersionId);
        
        var requiredSteps = blueprint.ActionSteps
            .Where(s => s.IsRequired)
            .ToList();
        
        if (!requiredSteps.Any())
        {
            return PolicyResult.Allow(); // No requirements
        }
        
        var missingSteps = requiredSteps
            .Where(s => !completedSteps.Contains(s.Id))
            .Select(s => s.Title)
            .ToList();
        
        if (missingSteps.Any())
        {
            return PolicyResult.Deny(
                $"Required action steps not completed: {string.Join(", ", missingSteps)}");
        }
        
        return PolicyResult.Allow();
    }
}
```

**Approval Required Policy:**

```csharp
public class ApprovalRequiredCompletionPolicy : IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>
{
    public string Name => "Approval Required Policy";
    public int Priority => 50; // Higher priority than steps
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    public Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TaskCompletionContext context)
    {
        var task = context.TaskInstance;
        
        if (!task.Approval.RequiresApproval)
        {
            return Task.FromResult(PolicyResult.Allow());
        }
        
        if (task.Approval.Status != ApprovalStatus.Approved)
        {
            return Task.FromResult(PolicyResult.Deny(
                $"Task requires approval. Current status: {task.Approval.Status}"));
        }
        
        return Task.FromResult(PolicyResult.Allow());
    }
}
```

**Parent Task Policy:**

```csharp
public class ParentTaskCompletionPolicy : IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>
{
    public string Name => "Parent Task Completion Policy";
    public int Priority => 150;
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    
    public async Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TaskCompletionContext context)
    {
        var task = context.TaskInstance;
        
        // If this is a parent task, check all subtasks
        if (task.Hierarchy.SubtaskCount > 0)
        {
            var subtasks = await _taskRepo
                .GetSubtasksAsync(task.Id);
            
            var incompleteSubtasks = subtasks
                .Where(st => !st.Progress.IsComplete())
                .ToList();
            
            if (incompleteSubtasks.Any())
            {
                return PolicyResult.Deny(
                    $"Cannot complete parent task while {incompleteSubtasks.Count} " +
                    $"subtasks are incomplete");
            }
        }
        
        return PolicyResult.Allow();
    }
}
```

### 157.5 Transition Policy System

**Permission Policy:**

```csharp
public class TransitionPermissionPolicy : IPolicy<TransitionContext>
{
    public string Name => "Transition Permission Policy";
    public int Priority => 10; // Highest priority
    public bool IsEnabled => true;
    
    private readonly ITransitionPermissionEvaluator _permissionEvaluator;
    
    public async Task<PolicyResult> EvaluateAsync(TransitionContext context)
    {
        var result = await _permissionEvaluator
            .CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(
                context.UserId,
                context.Transition,
                context);
        
        if (!result.IsAllowed)
        {
            return PolicyResult.Deny(result.Reason);
        }
        
        return PolicyResult.Allow();
    }
}
```

### 157.6 Policy Registration and Management

**Policy Registry:**

```csharp
public class PolicyRegistry
{
    private readonly Dictionary<Type, List<object>> _policies = new();
    
    public void RegisterPolicy<TContext>(IPolicy<TContext> policy)
    {
        var contextType = typeof(TContext);
        
        if (!_policies.ContainsKey(contextType))
        {
            _policies[contextType] = new List<object>();
        }
        
        _policies[contextType].Add(policy);
    }
    
    public IEnumerable<IPolicy<TContext>> GetPolicies<TContext>()
    {
        var contextType = typeof(TContext);
        
        if (!_policies.ContainsKey(contextType))
        {
            return Enumerable.Empty<IPolicy<TContext>>();
        }
        
        return _policies[contextType]
            .Cast<IPolicy<TContext>>()
            .Where(p => p.IsEnabled)
            .OrderBy(p => p.Priority);
    }
}

// Registration in DI container
services.AddSingleton<PolicyRegistry>();

services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskStartContext>, DependencyStartPolicy>();
services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskStartContext>, ScheduleWindowPolicy>();
services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskStartContext>, AssignmentStartPolicy>();

services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>, RequiredStepsCompletionPolicy>();
services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>, ApprovalRequiredCompletionPolicy>();
services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TaskCompletionContext>, ParentTaskCompletionPolicy>();

services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TransitionContext>, TransitionPermissionPolicy>();
services.AddTransient<IPolicy<TransitionContext>, ConditionEvaluationPolicy>();
```

# **PART XXV - SECURITY, PERMISSIONS & AUTHORIZATION**

## **Chapter 158 - Security Architecture Overview**

### 158.1 Security Principles

The platform implements defense-in-depth security based on these foundational principles:

**1. Zero Trust Architecture**
- Never trust, always verify
- Authenticate and authorize every request
- Assume breach and limit blast radius
- Continuous verification throughout session

**2. Principle of Least Privilege**
- Grant minimum necessary permissions
- Time-bound elevated access
- Explicit deny by default
- Require explicit allow rules

**3. Defense in Depth**
- Multiple security layers
- No single point of failure
- Redundant controls
- Compensating controls where needed

**4. Separation of Duties**
- No user has complete control
- Critical operations require multiple parties
- Audit trails for accountability
- Role segregation enforcement

**5. Secure by Design**
- Security requirements in domain model
- Encrypted data at rest and in transit
- Secure defaults
- Privacy by design (GDPR compliance)

```mermaid
    Domain --> Data
```

### 159.2 Local Authentication Implementation

```csharp
public class LocalAuthenticationService : IAuthenticationService
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    private readonly IPasswordHasher _passwordHasher;
    private readonly IMfaService _mfaService;
    private readonly IJwtTokenGenerator _tokenGenerator;
    private readonly ISecurityEventPublisher _securityEvents;
    
    public async Task<AuthenticationResult> AuthenticateAsync(
        string username,
        string password,
        string ipAddress,
        string userAgent)
    {
        // 1. Find user
        var user = await _userRepo.FindByUsernameAsync(username);
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            await LogFailedAttempt(username, ipAddress, "User not found");
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid credentials");
        }
        
        // 2. Check if account is locked
        if (user.IsLocked)
        {
            await LogFailedAttempt(username, ipAddress, "Account locked");
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Account is locked");
        }
        
        // 3. Verify password
        var passwordValid = _passwordHasher.VerifyPassword(
            password, 
            user.PasswordHash);
        
        if (!passwordValid)
        {
            await HandleFailedLogin(user, ipAddress);
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid credentials");
        }
        
        // 4. Check MFA requirement
        if (user.MfaEnabled)
        {
            // Generate MFA challenge
            var mfaChallenge = await _mfaService
                .GenerateChallengeAsync(user.Id);
            
            return AuthenticationResult.MfaRequired(
                mfaChallenge.ChallengeId,
                user.MfaMethod);
        }
        
        // 5. Generate session token
        var token = await GenerateAuthTokenAsync(user, ipAddress, userAgent);
        
        // 6. Reset failed attempts
        await ResetFailedAttemptsAsync(user);
        
        // 7. Log successful login
        await _securityEvents.PublishAsync(new UserAuthenticatedEto
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TenantId = user.TenantId,
            IPAddress = ipAddress,
            AuthMethod = AuthenticationMethod.Local,
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
        
        return AuthenticationResult.Success(token);
    }
    
    public async Task<AuthenticationResult> CompleteMfaAsync(
        Guid challengeId,
        string code)
    {
        // 1. Validate MFA code
        var validation = await _mfaService
            .ValidateCodeAsync(challengeId, code);
        
        if (!validation.IsValid)
        {
            await LogFailedMfaAttempt(challengeId);
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid MFA code");
        }
        
        // 2. Load user
        var user = await _userRepo.GetAsync(validation.UserId);
        
        // 3. Generate token
        var token = await GenerateAuthTokenAsync(
            user, 
            validation.IPAddress, 
            validation.UserAgent);
        
        // 4. Mark MFA challenge as completed
        await _mfaService.CompleteChallengeAsync(challengeId);
        
        return AuthenticationResult.Success(token);
    }
    
    private async Task HandleFailedLogin(User user, string ipAddress)
    {
        user.IncrementFailedAttempts();
        
        // Lock account after threshold
        if (user.FailedAttempts >= 5)
        {
            user.LockAccount(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30));
            
            await _securityEvents.PublishAsync(new AccountLockedEto
            {
                UserId = user.Id,
                Reason = "Too many failed login attempts",
                LockDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30)
            });
        }
        
        await _userRepo.UpdateAsync(user);
        
        await _securityEvents.PublishAsync(new LoginFailedEto
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            IPAddress = ipAddress,
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
    }
}
```

### 159.3 Single Sign-On Integration

**SSO Flow:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant App as Application
    participant Gateway as API Gateway
    participant IDP as Identity Provider (Azure AD/Okta)
    participant Auth as Auth Service
    
    User->>App: Access Protected Resource
    App->>Gateway: Request without Token
    Gateway-->>App: 401 Unauthorized + SSO Redirect
    App->>IDP: Redirect to SSO Login
    User->>IDP: Enter Credentials
    IDP->>IDP: Validate Credentials
    IDP-->>App: Return SAML Token/OAuth Code
    App->>Auth: Exchange Token for JWT
    Auth->>IDP: Validate Token
    IDP-->>Auth: Token Valid + User Info
    Auth->>Auth: Create/Update User
    Auth->>Auth: Load Roles & Permissions
    Auth-->>App: Return JWT + Refresh Token
    App->>Gateway: Request with JWT
    Gateway->>Auth: Validate JWT
    Auth-->>Gateway: Valid + Security Context
    Gateway-->>App: Resource Data
```

**SSO Authentication Service:**

```csharp
public class SsoAuthenticationService : ISsoAuthenticationService
{
    private readonly IIdentityProviderFactory _idpFactory;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    private readonly IJwtTokenGenerator _tokenGenerator;
    
    public async Task<AuthenticationResult> AuthenticateWithSsoAsync(
        string provider,
        string ssoToken,
        string ipAddress)
    {
        // 1. Get identity provider client
        var idp = _idpFactory.GetProvider(provider);
        
        // 2. Validate SSO token with provider
        var validation = await idp.ValidateTokenAsync(ssoToken);
        
        if (!validation.IsValid)
        {
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid SSO token");
        }
        
        // 3. Extract user claims
        var claims = validation.Claims;
        var externalUserId = claims.GetClaim("sub");
        var email = claims.GetClaim("email");
        var name = claims.GetClaim("name");
        
        // 4. Find or create user
        var user = await _userRepo.FindByExternalIdAsync(provider, externalUserId);
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            // Just-in-time provisioning
            user = await CreateUserFromSsoAsync(
                provider,
                externalUserId,
                email,
                name,
                claims);
        }
        else
        {
            // Update user info from SSO
            await UpdateUserFromSsoAsync(user, claims);
        }
        
        // 5. Sync roles and permissions from IDP groups
        await SyncRolesFromIdpGroupsAsync(user, claims);
        
        // 6. Generate JWT
        var token = await GenerateAuthTokenAsync(user, ipAddress);
        
        // 7. Log SSO authentication
        await PublishSsoAuthenticationEventAsync(user, provider);
        
        return AuthenticationResult.Success(token);
    }
    
    private async Task<User> CreateUserFromSsoAsync(
        string provider,
        string externalUserId,
        string email,
        string name,
        ClaimsPrincipal claims)
    {
        // Extract tenant from email domain or custom claim
        var tenantId = await ResolveTenantFromEmailAsync(email);
        
        var user = new User
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = tenantId,
            Email = email,
            DisplayName = name,
            UserName = email,
            IsActive = true,
            AuthProvider = provider,
            ExternalUserId = externalUserId,
            EmailVerified = true // Trust SSO provider
        };
        
        // Link external identity
        user.LinkExternalIdentity(new ExternalIdentity
        {
            Provider = provider,
            ExternalId = externalUserId,
            Email = email,
            Claims = claims.ToDictionary()
        });
        
        await _userRepo.InsertAsync(user);
        
        return user;
    }
    
    private async Task SyncRolesFromIdpGroupsAsync(
        User user,
        ClaimsPrincipal claims)
    {
        // Get groups from claims
        var groups = claims.GetMultiValueClaim("groups");
        
        if (!groups.Any())
        {
            return;
        }
        
        // Map IDP groups to application roles
        var roleMappings = await _roleRepo
            .GetIdpGroupMappingsAsync(user.AuthProvider);
        
        var newRoles = new List<Guid>();
        
        foreach (var group in groups)
        {
            if (roleMappings.TryGetValue(group, out var roleId))
            {
                newRoles.Add(roleId);
            }
        }
        
        // Update user roles
        user.UpdateRoles(newRoles);
        await _userRepo.UpdateAsync(user);
    }
}
```

### 159.4 API Key Authentication

**API Key Model:**

```csharp
public class ApiKey : Entity<Guid>
{
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string KeyHash { get; set; }
    public string Prefix { get; set; } // e.g., "wm_live_"
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ExpiresAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastUsedAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    public List<string> AllowedScopes { get; set; }
    public List<string> AllowedIpAddresses { get; set; }
    public ApiKeyType Type { get; set; } // ReadOnly, ReadWrite, Admin
    
    public bool IsExpired() => 
        ExpiresAt.HasValue && ExpiresAt.Value < DateTime.UtcNow;
    
    public bool IsIpAllowed(string ipAddress)
    {
        if (!AllowedIpAddresses.Any())
        {
            return true; // No IP restriction
        }
        
        return AllowedIpAddresses.Contains(ipAddress);
    }
}
```

**API Key Authentication:**

```csharp
public class ApiKeyAuthenticationService : IApiKeyAuthenticationService
{
    private readonly IApiKeyRepository _apiKeyRepo;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    
    public async Task<AuthenticationResult> AuthenticateWithApiKeyAsync(
        string apiKey,
        string ipAddress)
    {
        // 1. Parse key format (prefix_checksum_secret)
        if (!TryParseApiKey(apiKey, out var prefix, out var keyHash))
        {
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid API key format");
        }
        
        // 2. Find API key by hash
        var key = await _apiKeyRepo.FindByHashAsync(keyHash);
        
        if (key == null)
        {
            await LogInvalidApiKeyAttempt(ipAddress, prefix);
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("Invalid API key");
        }
        
        // 3. Validate key status
        if (!key.IsActive)
        {
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("API key is inactive");
        }
        
        if (key.IsExpired())
        {
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("API key has expired");
        }
        
        // 4. Validate IP address
        if (!key.IsIpAllowed(ipAddress))
        {
            await LogUnauthorizedIpAttempt(key.Id, ipAddress);
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("IP address not allowed");
        }
        
        // 5. Load user
        var user = await _userRepo.GetAsync(key.UserId);
        
        if (user == null || !user.IsActive)
        {
            return AuthenticationResult.Failed("User account is inactive");
        }
        
        // 6. Update last used timestamp
        key.LastUsedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _apiKeyRepo.UpdateAsync(key);
        
        // 7. Create security context with API key scopes
        var securityContext = new SecurityContext
        {
            UserId = user.Id,
            TenantId = user.TenantId,
            Roles = user.Roles,
            Permissions = FilterPermissionsByScopes(
                user.Permissions, 
                key.AllowedScopes),
            AuthenticationMethod = AuthenticationMethod.ApiKey,
            ApiKeyId = key.Id
        };
        
        return AuthenticationResult.Success(securityContext);
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 160 - Authorization System**

### 160.1 Multi-Level Authorization Model

The platform implements a **hybrid authorization model** combining:

1. **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)** - Coarse-grained permissions via roles
2. **Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)** - Fine-grained context-aware decisions
3. **Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC)** - Complex business rules
4. **Resource-Based Access Control** - Ownership and sharing

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Request[Authorization Request] --> Identity[Extract Identity]
    Identity --> Context[Build Auth Context]
    
    Context --> RBAC[RBAC Check]
    Context --> ABAC[ABAC Check]
    Context --> PBAC[PBAC Check]
    Context --> Resource[Resource Check]
    
    RBAC --> Merge[Merge Results]
    ABAC --> Merge
    PBAC --> Merge
    Resource --> Merge
    
    Merge --> Decision{All Passed?}
    
    Decision -->|Yes| Grant[Grant Access]
    Decision -->|No| Deny[Deny Access]
    
    Grant --> Audit[Audit Log]
    Deny --> Audit
```

### 160.3 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

**Role Model:**

```csharp
public class Role : AggregateRoot<Guid>
{
    public string Name { get; private set; }
    public string Description { get; private set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; private set; }
    public bool IsSystemRole { get; private set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; private set; }
    public int Priority { get; private set; } // Higher = more permissions
    public List<RolePermission> Permissions { get; private set; }
    
    public void GrantPermission(string permission, PermissionScope scope)
    {
        if (Permissions.Any(p => p.Permission == permission))
        {
            throw new BusinessException("Permission already granted");
        }
        
        Permissions.Add(new RolePermission
        {
            Permission = permission,
            Scope = scope,
            GrantedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
    }
    
    public void RevokePermission(string permission)
    {
        var rolePermission = Permissions
            .FirstOrDefault(p => p.Permission == permission);
        
        if (rolePermission != null)
        {
            Permissions.Remove(rolePermission);
        }
    }
    
    public bool HasPermission(string permission)
    {
        return Permissions.Any(p => p.Permission == permission);
    }
}

public class RolePermission
{
    public string Permission { get; set; }
    public PermissionScope Scope { get; set; }
    public DateTime GrantedAt { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Constraints { get; set; }
}
```

### 160.4 Permission Checker Service

**Core Authorization Service:**

```csharp
public class PermissionCheckerService : IPermissionChecker
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    private readonly IRoleRepository _roleRepo;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly IAbacEngine _abacEngine;
    private readonly IResourceOwnershipService _ownershipService;
    
    public async Task<bool> IsGrantedAsync(string permission)
    {
        var context = await BuildAuthorizationContextAsync();
        return await IsGrantedAsync(permission, context);
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> IsGrantedAsync(
        string permission,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        // 1. System administrators always granted
        if (context.IsSystemAdministrator)
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 2. Check if user has permission through roles
        var hasRolePermission = await CheckRolePermissionAsync(
            context.UserId,
            permission,
            context);
        
        if (hasRolePermission)
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 3. Check attribute-based rules
        var abacResult = await _abacEngine.EvaluateAsync(
            context.UserId,
            permission,
            context);
        
        if (abacResult.IsGranted)
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 4. Check resource-specific permissions
        if (context.ResourceId.HasValue)
        {
            var hasResourcePermission = await CheckResourcePermissionAsync(
                context.UserId,
                permission,
                context.ResourceType,
                context.ResourceId.Value);
            
            if (hasResourcePermission)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    public async Task CheckAsync(string permission)
    {
        var isGranted = await IsGrantedAsync(permission);
        
        if (!isGranted)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedException(
                $"User does not have permission: {permission}");
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> CheckRolePermissionAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string permission,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        // Get user's roles
        var user = await _userRepo.GetWithRolesAsync(userId);
        
        if (user == null)
        {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Load role permissions
        var roles = await _roleRepo.GetByIdsAsync(user.RoleIds);
        
        foreach (var role in roles.Where(r => r.IsActive))
        {
            var rolePermission = role.Permissions
                .FirstOrDefault(p => p.Permission == permission);
            
            if (rolePermission == null)
            {
                continue;
            }
            
            // Check scope
            var scopeMatches = rolePermission.Scope switch
            {
                PermissionScope.Global => true,
                
                PermissionScope.Tenant => 
                    context.TenantId == user.TenantId,
                
                PermissionScope.Project => 
                    context.ProjectId.HasValue && 
                    await IsUserInProjectAsync(userId, context.ProjectId.Value),
                
                PermissionScope.Team => 
                    context.TeamId.HasValue && 
                    user.TeamIds.Contains(context.TeamId.Value),
                
                PermissionScope.Owner => 
                    context.OwnerId.HasValue && 
                    context.OwnerId.Value == userId,
                
                _ => false
            };
            
            if (scopeMatches)
            {
                // Check additional constraints
                if (rolePermission.Constraints != null && 
                    rolePermission.Constraints.Any())
                {
                    var constraintsSatisfied = EvaluateConstraints(
                        rolePermission.Constraints,
                        context);
                    
                    if (!constraintsSatisfied)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> CheckResourcePermissionAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string permission,
        string resourceType,
        Guid resourceId)
    {
        // Check if user is owner
        var isOwner = await _ownershipService
            .IsOwnerAsync(userId, resourceType, resourceId);
        
        if (isOwner && PermissionAllowsOwner(permission))
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check explicit resource sharing
        var hasSharedAccess = await _ownershipService
            .HasSharedAccessAsync(userId, resourceType, resourceId, permission);
        
        return hasSharedAccess;
    }
}
```

### 160.5 Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)

**ABAC Engine:**

```csharp
public class AbacEngine : IAbacEngine
{
    public async Task<AbacResult> EvaluateAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string permission,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        var rules = await LoadAbacRulesAsync(permission);
        
        foreach (var rule in rules.Where(r => r.IsActive))
        {
            var result = await EvaluateRuleAsync(rule, userId, context);
            
            if (result.IsGranted)
            {
                return result;
            }
        }
        
        return AbacResult.Denied();
    }
    
    private async Task<AbacResult> EvaluateRuleAsync(
        AbacRule rule,
        Guid userId,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        // Evaluate all conditions
        foreach (var condition in rule.Conditions)
        {
            var conditionMet = condition.Type switch
            {
                ConditionType.UserAttribute => 
                    EvaluateUserAttribute(condition, userId, context),
                
                ConditionType.ResourceAttribute => 
                    EvaluateResourceAttribute(condition, context),
                
                ConditionType.EnvironmentAttribute => 
                    EvaluateEnvironmentAttribute(condition, context),
                
                ConditionType.TimeWindow => 
                    EvaluateTimeWindow(condition, context),
                
                ConditionType.Script => 
                    await EvaluateScriptConditionAsync(condition, context),
                
                _ => false
            };
            
            if (!conditionMet)
            {
                return AbacResult.Denied();
            }
        }
        
        return AbacResult.Granted(rule.Name);
    }
    
    private bool EvaluateUserAttribute(
        AbacCondition condition,
        Guid userId,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        var attributeValue = context.UserAttributes
            .GetValueOrDefault(condition.AttributeName);
        
        return CompareValues(
            attributeValue,
            condition.ExpectedValue,
            condition.Operator);
    }
    
    private bool EvaluateTimeWindow(
        AbacCondition condition,
        AuthorizationContext context)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        // Parse time window from condition
        var (startHour, endHour) = ParseTimeWindow(condition.ExpectedValue);
        
        var currentHour = now.Hour;
        
        if (startHour <= endHour)
        {
            return currentHour >= startHour && currentHour < endHour;
        }
        else
        {
            // Overnight window
            return currentHour >= startHour || currentHour < endHour;
        }
    }
}

public class AbacRule
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Permission { get; set; }
    public List<AbacCondition> Conditions { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    public int Priority { get; set; }
}

public class AbacCondition
{
    public ConditionType Type { get; set; }
    public string AttributeName { get; set; }
    public ComparisonOperator Operator { get; set; }
    public object ExpectedValue { get; set; }
}

public enum ConditionType
{
    UserAttribute,
    ResourceAttribute,
    EnvironmentAttribute,
    TimeWindow,
    Script
}

public enum ComparisonOperator
{
    Equals,
    NotEquals,
    GreaterThan,
    LessThan,
    Contains,
    In,
    NotIn,
    Matches // Regex
}
```

### 160.6 Workflow Transition Permissions

**Transition Permission Policy:**

```csharp
public class TransitionPermissionPolicy : AggregateRoot<Guid>
{
    public Guid WorkflowId { get; private set; }
    public Guid TransitionId { get; private set; }
    public Guid? ProjectId { get; private set; } // Null = global
    public PermissionPolicyScope Scope { get; private set; }
    public int Priority { get; private set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; private set; }
    
    public List<string> AllowedRoles { get; private set; }
    public List<Guid> AllowedUsers { get; private set; }
    public List<Guid> AllowedTeams { get; private set; }
    public List<TransitionCondition> AdditionalConditions { get; private set; }
    
    public async Task<bool> CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(
        Guid userId,
        TransitionContext context,
        IUserRepository userRepo)
    {
        // 1. Check if user is explicitly allowed
        if (AllowedUsers.Contains(userId))
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 2. Load user with roles and teams
        var user = await userRepo.GetWithRolesAndTeamsAsync(userId);
        
        // 3. Check role membership
        if (AllowedRoles.Any() && 
            user.Roles.Any(r => AllowedRoles.Contains(r)))
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 4. Check team membership
        if (AllowedTeams.Any() && 
            user.TeamIds.Any(t => AllowedTeams.Contains(t)))
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        // 5. Evaluate additional conditions
        if (AdditionalConditions.Any())
        {
            foreach (var condition in AdditionalConditions)
            {
                if (!await EvaluateConditionAsync(condition, context))
                {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    }
}
```

**Transition Permission Evaluator:**

```csharp
public class TransitionPermissionEvaluator : ITransitionPermissionEvaluator
{
    private readonly ITransitionPermissionPolicyRepository _policyRepo;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepo;
    
    public async Task<PermissionEvaluationResult> CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(
        Guid userId,
        WorkflowTransition transition,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        // 1. Load applicable policies
        var policies = await _policyRepo
            .GetPoliciesForTransitionAsync(
                transition.WorkflowId,
                transition.Id,
                context.ProjectId);
        
        if (!policies.Any())
        {
            // No policies = allow all (default open)
            return PermissionEvaluationResult.Allow();
        }
        
        // 2. Sort by priority (project-specific > global, higher priority > lower)
        var orderedPolicies = policies
            .Where(p => p.IsActive)
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.Scope == PermissionPolicyScope.Project ? 1 : 0)
            .ThenByDescending(p => p.Priority);
        
        // 3. Check each policy
        foreach (var policy in orderedPolicies)
        {
            var canPerform = await policy
                .CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(userId, context, _userRepo);
            
            if (canPerform)
            {
                return PermissionEvaluationResult.Allow(policy.Id);
            }
        }
        
        return PermissionEvaluationResult.Deny(
            "User does not have permission to perform this transition");
    }
}
```

### 161.1 Ownership Model

**Resource Ownership:**

```mermaid
    }

    IOwnable <|.. Project
    TaskInstance "1" --> "*" SharedAccess
    Project "1" --> "*" SharedAccess
```

**Ownership Service:**

```csharp
public class ResourceOwnershipService : IResourceOwnershipService
{
    private readonly ISharedAccessRepository _sharedAccessRepo;
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepo;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    
    public async Task<bool> IsOwnerAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string resourceType,
        Guid resourceId)
    {
        return resourceType switch
        {
            "Task" => await IsTaskOwnerAsync(userId, resourceId),
            "Project" => await IsProjectOwnerAsync(userId, resourceId),
            _ => false
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> HasAccessAsync(
        Guid userId,
        string resourceType,
        Guid resourceId,
        string permission)
    {
        // 1. Check ownership
        var isOwner = await IsOwnerAsync(userId, resourceType, resourceId);
        if (isOwner)
        {
            return true; // Owners have all permissions
        }
        
        // 2. Check shared access
        var sharedAccess = await _sharedAccessRepo
            .GetSharedAccessAsync(resourceType, resourceId, userId);
        
        if (sharedAccess != null && !sharedAccess.IsExpired())
        {
            return sharedAccess.HasPermission(permission);
        }
        
        // 3. Check team access (for projects)
        if (resourceType == "Project")
        {
            var hasTeamAccess = await HasProjectTeamAccessAsync(
                userId, 
                resourceId, 
                permission);
            
            if (hasTeamAccess)
            {
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        // 4. Check visibility rules
        var hasVisibilityAccess = await CheckVisibilityAccessAsync(
            userId,
            resourceType,
            resourceId);
        
        return hasVisibilityAccess;
    }
    
    public async Task ShareResourceAsync(
        Guid resourceId,
        string resourceType,
        Guid ownerId,
        Guid shareWithUserId,
        List<string> permissions,
        DateTime? expiresAt = null)
    {
        // Verify owner
        var isOwner = await IsOwnerAsync(ownerId, resourceType, resourceId);
        if (!isOwner)
        {
            throw new UnauthorizedException(
                "Only the owner can share this resource");
        }
        
        // Create or update shared access
        var existingAccess = await _sharedAccessRepo
            .GetSharedAccessAsync(resourceType, resourceId, shareWithUserId);
        
        if (existingAccess != null)
        {
            existingAccess.UpdatePermissions(permissions);
            existingAccess.ExpiresAt = expiresAt;
            await _sharedAccessRepo.UpdateAsync(existingAccess);
        }
        else
        {
            var sharedAccess = new SharedAccess
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                ResourceType = resourceType,
                ResourceId = resourceId,
                SharedWithUserId = shareWithUserId,
                GrantedPermissions = permissions,
                SharedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                SharedBy = ownerId,
                ExpiresAt = expiresAt
            };
            
            await _sharedAccessRepo.InsertAsync(sharedAccess);
        }
        
        // Publish event
        await PublishResourceSharedEventAsync(
            resourceType, 
            resourceId, 
            shareWithUserId, 
            permissions);
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> HasProjectTeamAccessAsync(
        Guid userId,
        Guid projectId,
        string permission)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepo.GetAsync(projectId);
        
        if (project == null)
        {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check if user is in a team that has project access
        var user = await _userRepo.GetWithTeamsAsync(userId);
        
        foreach (var teamAccess in project.TeamAccess)
        {
            if (user.TeamIds.Contains(teamAccess.TeamId))
            {
                if (teamAccess.Permissions.Contains(permission) ||
                    teamAccess.Permissions.Contains("*"))
                {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return false;
    }
}
```

### 161.2 Visibility Levels

**Visibility Model:**

```csharp
public enum VisibilityLevel
{
    Private,        // Only owner
    Team,           // Owner + team members
    Project,        // All project members
    Organization,   // All tenant users
    Public          // Anyone with link (for external sharing)
}

public class VisibilityChecker : IVisibilityChecker
{
    public async Task<bool> CanUserViewAsync(
        Guid userId,
        IOwnable resource)
    {
        // Owner always has access
        if (resource.OwnerId == userId)
        {
            return true;
        }
        
        return resource.Visibility switch
        {
            VisibilityLevel.Private => false,
            
            VisibilityLevel.Team => 
                await IsInSameTeamAsync(userId, resource.OwnerId),
            
            VisibilityLevel.Project => 
                await IsInSameProjectAsync(userId, resource),
            
            VisibilityLevel.Organization => 
                await IsInSameTenantAsync(userId, resource),
            
            VisibilityLevel.Public => true,
            
            _ => false
        };
    }
}
```

### 162.2 Anomaly Detection

**Anomaly Detection Service:**

```csharp
public class SecurityAnomalyDetector : ISecurityAnomalyDetector
{
    public async Task AnalyzeUserActivityAsync(Guid userId)
    {
        var recentActivity = await LoadRecentActivityAsync(userId);
        
        // Check for anomalies
        await CheckLoginLocationAnomalyAsync(userId, recentActivity);
        await CheckUnusualAccessPatternsAsync(userId, recentActivity);
        await CheckBulkDataAccessAsync(userId, recentActivity);
        await CheckOffHoursActivityAsync(userId, recentActivity);
    }
    
    private async Task CheckLoginLocationAnomalyAsync(
        Guid userId,
        UserActivity activity)
    {
        // Get user's typical locations
        var typicalLocations = await GetTypicalLocationsAsync(userId);
        
        // Check if current location is anomalous
        var currentLocation = GeoIP.Lookup(activity.IPAddress);
        
        if (!typicalLocations.Any(l => 
            l.Country == currentLocation.Country))
        {
            await PublishAnomalyAsync(new SuspiciousActivityDetectedEto
            {
                UserId = userId,
                ActivityType = "Unusual login location",
                Indicators = new Dictionary<string, object>
                {
                    ["CurrentCountry"] = currentLocation.Country,
                    ["TypicalCountries"] = typicalLocations.Select(l => l.Country)
                },
                RiskScore = 0.7,
                Severity = SecurityEventSeverity.Medium
            });
        }
    }
    
    private async Task CheckUnusualAccessPatternsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        UserActivity activity)
    {
        // Machine learning model to detect unusual patterns
        var features = ExtractActivityFeatures(activity);
        var prediction = await _mlModel.PredictAsync(features);
        
        if (prediction.IsAnomalous && prediction.Confidence > 0.8)
        {
            await PublishAnomalyAsync(new SuspiciousActivityDetectedEto
            {
                UserId = userId,
                ActivityType = "Unusual access pattern",
                RiskScore = prediction.Confidence,
                Severity = SecurityEventSeverity.High
            });
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
public static class LogCategories

    public const string System = "System";
```

### 164.2 Domain Logging Service

**Contextual Logger:**

```csharp
public class DomainLogger : IDomainLogger
{
    private readonly ILogger _logger;
    private readonly ICurrentUser _currentUser;
    private readonly ICorrelationIdProvider _correlationId;
    
    public void LogTaskOperation(
        Guid taskId,
        string operation,
        Dictionary<string, object> properties = null)
    {
        var entry = new StructuredLogEntry
        {
            Level = "Information",
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Category = LogCategories.Task,
            EntityType = "TaskInstance",
            EntityId = taskId,
            Operation = operation,
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId,
            UserId = _currentUser.UserId,
            CorrelationId = _correlationId.Get(),
            Properties = properties ?? new Dictionary<string, object>()
        };
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Task operation: {Operation} on Task {TaskId} by User {UserId}",
            operation,
            taskId,
            _currentUser.UserId);
        
        // Also log to structured sink
        LogToStructuredSink(entry);
    }
    
    public void LogWorkflowTransition(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid workflowId,
        Guid transitionId,
        string fromStatus,
        string toStatus,
        long durationMs)
    {
        var entry = new StructuredLogEntry
        {
            Level = "Information",
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Category = LogCategories.Workflow,
            EntityType = "TaskInstance",
            EntityId = taskId,
            Operation = "Transition",
            DurationMs = durationMs,
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId,
            UserId = _currentUser.UserId,
            Properties = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["WorkflowId"] = workflowId,
                ["TransitionId"] = transitionId,
                ["FromStatus"] = fromStatus,
                ["ToStatus"] = toStatus
            }
        };
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Workflow transition: {FromStatus} -> {ToStatus} for Task {TaskId} completed in {Duration}ms",
            fromStatus,
            toStatus,
            taskId,
            durationMs);
        
        LogToStructuredSink(entry);
    }
    
    public void LogApprovalDecision(
        Guid approvalRequestId,
        Guid stepId,
        Guid approverId,
        ApprovalAction action,
        long durationMs)
    {
        var entry = new StructuredLogEntry
        {
            Level = "Information",
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            Category = LogCategories.Approval,
            EntityType = "ApprovalRequest",
            EntityId = approvalRequestId,
            Operation = "Decision",
            DurationMs = durationMs,
            TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId,
            UserId = approverId,
            Properties = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["StepId"] = stepId,
                ["Action"] = action.ToString(),
                ["ApproverId"] = approverId
            }
        };
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Approval decision: {Action} by {ApproverId} for Request {RequestId} Step {StepId}",
            action,
            approverId,
            approvalRequestId,
            stepId);
        
        LogToStructuredSink(entry);
    }
    
    public void LogPerformanceMetric(
        string operation,
        long durationMs,
        Dictionary<string, object> metadata = null)
    {
        if (durationMs > 1000) // Log slow operations
        {
            var entry = new StructuredLogEntry
            {
                Level = durationMs > 5000 ? "Warning" : "Information",
                Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
                Category = LogCategories.Performance,
                Operation = operation,
                DurationMs = durationMs,
                TenantId = _currentUser.TenantId,
                Properties = metadata ?? new Dictionary<string, object>()
            };
            
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Slow operation detected: {Operation} took {Duration}ms",
                operation,
                durationMs);
            
            LogToStructuredSink(entry);
        }
    }
}
```

### 164.3 Log Correlation

**Correlation ID Middleware:**

```csharp
public class CorrelationIdMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private const string CorrelationIdHeader = "X-Correlation-ID";
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(
        HttpContext context,
        ICorrelationIdProvider correlationIdProvider)
    {
        // Get or generate correlation ID
        var correlationId = context.Request.Headers[CorrelationIdHeader]
            .FirstOrDefault() ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        
        // Set in provider for access throughout request
        correlationIdProvider.Set(correlationId);
        
        // Add to response headers
        context.Response.Headers.Add(CorrelationIdHeader, correlationId);
        
        // Add to log context
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("CorrelationId", correlationId))
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
    }
}

public interface ICorrelationIdProvider
{
    string Get();
    void Set(string correlationId);
}

public class CorrelationIdProvider : ICorrelationIdProvider
{
    private readonly AsyncLocal<string> _correlationId = new();
    
    public string Get() => _correlationId.Value ?? Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
    
    public void Set(string correlationId) => _correlationId.Value = correlationId;
}
```

```csharp
public class TaskMetrics
{

    private readonly Counter _tasksCompleted;
    private readonly Counter _tasksCancelled;
    private readonly Counter _tasksBlocked;
    
    // Gauges

    private readonly Gauge _blockedTasks;
    private readonly Gauge _tasksByPriority;
    
    // Histograms

    private readonly Histogram _taskCycleTime;
    private readonly Histogram _taskLeadTime;
    
    public TaskMetrics(IMetricsCollector metrics)
    {
        _metrics = metrics;
        
        // Initialize counters
        _tasksCreated = _metrics.CreateCounter(
            "tasks_created_total",
            "Total number of tasks created",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "project_id", "task_type" });
        
        _tasksStarted = _metrics.CreateCounter(
            "tasks_started_total",
            "Total number of tasks started",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "project_id", "task_type" });
        
        _tasksCompleted = _metrics.CreateCounter(
            "tasks_completed_total",
            "Total number of tasks completed",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "project_id", "task_type", "resolution" });
        
        // Initialize gauges
        _activeTasks = _metrics.CreateGauge(
            "active_tasks_count",
            "Current number of active tasks",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "project_id", "status" });
        
        _overdueTasks = _metrics.CreateGauge(
            "overdue_tasks_count",
            "Current number of overdue tasks",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "project_id" });
        
        // Initialize histograms
        _taskCompletionDuration = _metrics.CreateHistogram(
            "task_completion_duration_seconds",
            "Time from task start to completion",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "task_type" });
        
        _taskCycleTime = _metrics.CreateHistogram(
            "task_cycle_time_seconds",
            "Time from task creation to completion",
            new[] { "tenant_id", "task_type" });
    }
    
    public void RecordTaskCreated(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid projectId,
        string taskType)
    {
        _tasksCreated.WithLabels(
            tenantId.ToString(),
            projectId.ToString(),
            taskType
        ).Inc();
    }
    
    public void RecordTaskCompleted(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid projectId,
        string taskType,
        string resolution,
        TimeSpan completionDuration,
        TimeSpan cycleTime)
    {
        _tasksCompleted.WithLabels(
            tenantId.ToString(),
            projectId.ToString(),
            taskType,
            resolution
        ).Inc();
        
        _taskCompletionDuration.WithLabels(
            tenantId.ToString(),
            taskType
        ).Observe(completionDuration.TotalSeconds);
        
        _taskCycleTime.WithLabels(
            tenantId.ToString(),
            taskType
        ).Observe(cycleTime.TotalSeconds);
    }
    
    public void UpdateActiveTasksCount(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid projectId,
        string status,
        int count)
    {
        _activeTasks.WithLabels(
            tenantId.ToString(),
            projectId.ToString(),
            status
        ).Set(count);
    }
}
```
