### 166.1 Tracing Architecture

**OpenTelemetry Integration:**

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Gateway as API Gateway
    participant AppSvc as Application Service
    participant DomainSvc as Domain Service
    participant Repo as Repository
    participant DB as Database
    participant EventBus as Event Bus
    participant External as External API
    
    Note over Client,External: TraceId: abc123
    
    Client->>Gateway: HTTP Request
    Note over Gateway: SpanId: span-001
    
    Gateway->>AppSvc: CompleteTask(taskId)
    Note over AppSvc: SpanId: span-002<br/>ParentSpan: span-001
    
    AppSvc->>DomainSvc: EvaluateCompletionPolicies
    Note over DomainSvc: SpanId: span-003<br/>ParentSpan: span-002
    
    DomainSvc->>Repo: GetTaskInstance(taskId)
    Note over Repo: SpanId: span-004<br/>ParentSpan: span-003
    
    Repo->>DB: SELECT * FROM Tasks
    Note over DB: SpanId: span-005<br/>ParentSpan: span-004
    
    DB-->>Repo: Task Data
    Repo-->>DomainSvc: TaskInstance
    
    DomainSvc->>AppSvc: Policy Result
    
    AppSvc->>EventBus: Publish TaskCompletedEto
    Note over EventBus: SpanId: span-006<br/>ParentSpan: span-002
    
    AppSvc->>External: Webhook Notification
    Note over External: SpanId: span-007<br/>ParentSpan: span-002
    
    External-->>AppSvc: 200 OK
    AppSvc-->>Gateway: Success
    Gateway-->>Client: 200 OK
```

### 166.2 Tracing Implementation

**Trace Instrumentation:**

```csharp
public class TracingService : ITracingService
{
    private readonly ActivitySource _activitySource;
    
    public TracingService()
    {
        _activitySource = new ActivitySource(
            "WorkManagement.Platform",
            "1.0.0");
    }
    
    public IDisposable StartActivity(
        string name,
        ActivityKind kind = ActivityKind.Internal,
        Dictionary<string, object> tags = null)
    {
        var activity = _activitySource.StartActivity(
            name,
            kind);
        
        if (activity != null && tags != null)
        {
            foreach (var tag in tags)
            {
                activity.SetTag(tag.Key, tag.Value);
            }
        }
        
        return activity;
    }
    
    public void AddEvent(string name, Dictionary<string, object> attributes = null)
    {
        var currentActivity = Activity.Current;
        if (currentActivity != null)
        {
            var activityEvent = new ActivityEvent(
                name,
                DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                attributes != null
                    ? new ActivityTagsCollection(attributes)
                    : null);
            
            currentActivity.AddEvent(activityEvent);
        }
    }
    
    public void SetError(Exception exception)
    {
        var currentActivity = Activity.Current;
        if (currentActivity != null)
        {
            currentActivity.SetStatus(ActivityStatusCode.Error, exception.Message);
            currentActivity.SetTag("exception.type", exception.GetType().FullName);
            currentActivity.SetTag("exception.message", exception.Message);
            currentActivity.SetTag("exception.stacktrace", exception.StackTrace);
        }
    }
}
```

**Domain Service Tracing:**

```csharp
public class TaskProcessingService : ITaskProcessingService
{
    private readonly ITracingService _tracing;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    private readonly IWorkflowTransitionService _workflowService;
    
    public async Task<TaskOperationResult> CompleteTaskAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid userId,
        CompleteTaskOptions options)
    {
        using var activity = _tracing.StartActivity(
            "TaskProcessingService.CompleteTask",
            ActivityKind.Internal,
            new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["task.id"] = taskId,
                ["user.id"] = userId,
                ["operation"] = "CompleteTask"
            });
        
        try
        {
            _tracing.AddEvent("LoadingTask", new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["task.id"] = taskId
            });
            
            var task = await _taskRepo.GetWithDetailsAsync(taskId);
            
            if (task == null)
            {
                activity?.SetTag("result", "NotFound");
                return TaskOperationResult.NotFound();
            }
            
            _tracing.AddEvent("EvaluatingPolicies");
            
            var policyResult = await EvaluateCompletionPoliciesAsync(task, options);
            
            if (!policyResult.CanProceed)
            {
                activity?.SetTag("result", "PolicyViolation");
                activity?.SetTag("policy.reason", policyResult.Reason);
                return TaskOperationResult.PolicyViolation(policyResult.Reason);
            }
            
            _tracing.AddEvent("ExecutingTransition");
            
            var transitionResult = await _workflowService.ExecuteTransitionAsync(
                taskId,
                task.GetCompleteTransitionId(),
                userId,
                new TransitionContext { TaskInstance = task });
            
            if (!transitionResult.IsSuccess)
            {
                activity?.SetTag("result", "TransitionFailed");
                return TaskOperationResult.TransitionFailed(transitionResult.Reason);
            }
            
            task.Schedule.MarkCompleted(DateTime.UtcNow);
            task.Progress.MarkComplete();
            
            _tracing.AddEvent("PersistingChanges");
            
            await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
            
            _tracing.AddEvent("PublishingEvents");
            
            await PublishTaskCompletedEventAsync(task, userId);
            
            activity?.SetTag("result", "Success");
            
            return TaskOperationResult.Success();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _tracing.SetError(ex);
            throw;
        }
    }
}
```

### 167.2 Task Analytics Model

**Task Analytics Service:**

```csharp
public class TaskAnalyticsService : ITaskAnalyticsService
{
    private readonly IAnalyticsRepository _analyticsRepo;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    
    public async Task<TaskAnalytics> GetTaskAnalyticsAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        DateRange dateRange,
        AnalyticsFilters filters = null)
    {
        // Get raw data
        var tasks = await _taskRepo.GetForAnalyticsAsync(
            tenantId,
            dateRange,
            filters);
        
        // Calculate metrics
        var analytics = new TaskAnalytics
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            DateRange = dateRange,
            
            // Volume metrics
            TotalCreated = tasks.Count,
            TotalCompleted = tasks.Count(t => t.IsCompleted),
            TotalCancelled = tasks.Count(t => t.IsCancelled),
            CompletionRate = CalculateCompletionRate(tasks),
            
            // Time metrics
            AverageCycleTime = CalculateAverageCycleTime(tasks),
            AverageLeadTime = CalculateAverageLeadTime(tasks),
            MedianCycleTime = CalculateMedianCycleTime(tasks),
            P90CycleTime = CalculatePercentile(tasks, 0.90, t => t.CycleTime),
            
            // Status distribution
            TasksByStatus = tasks.GroupBy(t => t.Status)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),
            
            // Priority distribution
            TasksByPriority = tasks.GroupBy(t => t.Priority)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),
            
            // Throughput
            Throughput = CalculateThroughput(tasks, dateRange),
            ThroughputTrend = CalculateThroughputTrend(tasks, dateRange),
            
            // Quality metrics
            RejectionRate = CalculateRejectionRate(tasks),
            ReopenRate = CalculateReopenRate(tasks),
            
            // Overdue metrics
            OverdueTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.IsOverdue),
            OverdueRate = CalculateOverdueRate(tasks),
            AverageOverdueTime = CalculateAverageOverdueTime(tasks),
            
            // Assignee metrics
            TasksByAssignee = CalculateTasksByAssignee(tasks),
            TopPerformers = IdentifyTopPerformers(tasks),
            
            // Bottleneck detection
            Bottlenecks = DetectBottlenecks(tasks)
        };
        
        return analytics;
    }
    
    private TimeSpan CalculateAverageCycleTime(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var completedTasks = tasks.Where(t => t.IsCompleted).ToList();
        
        if (!completedTasks.Any())
            return TimeSpan.Zero;
        
        var totalSeconds = completedTasks
            .Where(t => t.Schedule.ActualStart.HasValue && 
                       t.Schedule.CompletedAt.HasValue)
            .Sum(t => (t.Schedule.CompletedAt.Value - 
                      t.Schedule.ActualStart.Value).TotalSeconds);
        
        return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(totalSeconds / completedTasks.Count);
    }
    
    private TimeSpan CalculateAverageLeadTime(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var completedTasks = tasks.Where(t => t.IsCompleted).ToList();
        
        if (!completedTasks.Any())
            return TimeSpan.Zero;
        
        var totalSeconds = completedTasks
            .Sum(t => (t.Schedule.CompletedAt.Value - 
                      t.CreatedAt).TotalSeconds);
        
        return TimeSpan.FromSeconds(totalSeconds / completedTasks.Count);
    }
    
    private double CalculateThroughput(
        List<TaskInstance> tasks,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var completedCount = tasks.Count(t => t.IsCompleted);
        var days = (dateRange.End - dateRange.Start).TotalDays;
        
        return completedCount / Math.Max(days, 1);
    }
    
    private List<ThroughputDataPoint> CalculateThroughputTrend(
        List<TaskInstance> tasks,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        return tasks
            .Where(t => t.IsCompleted)
            .GroupBy(t => t.Schedule.CompletedAt.Value.Date)
            .Select(g => new ThroughputDataPoint
            {
                Date = g.Key,
                Count = g.Count(),
                CumulativeCount = tasks
                    .Count(t => t.IsCompleted && 
                               t.Schedule.CompletedAt.Value.Date <= g.Key)
            })
            .OrderBy(dp => dp.Date)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private List<Bottleneck> DetectBottlenecks(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var bottlenecks = new List<Bottleneck>();
        
        // Analyze time spent in each status
        var statusDurations = tasks
            .Where(t => t.History.Entries.Any())
            .SelectMany(t => CalculateStatusDurations(t))
            .GroupBy(sd => sd.Status)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                Status = g.Key,
                AverageDuration = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                    g.Average(sd => sd.Duration.TotalSeconds)),
                TaskCount = g.Count()
            })
            .OrderByDescending(x => x.AverageDuration)
            .ToList();
        
        // Identify bottlenecks (statuses with unusually long durations)
        var overallAverage = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
            statusDurations.Average(sd => sd.AverageDuration.TotalSeconds));
        
        foreach (var statusDuration in statusDurations)
        {
            if (statusDuration.AverageDuration > overallAverage.Multiply(2))
            {
                bottlenecks.Add(new Bottleneck
                {
                    Type = BottleneckType.Status,
                    Identifier = statusDuration.Status,
                    AverageDuration = statusDuration.AverageDuration,
                    TaskCount = statusDuration.TaskCount,
                    Severity = CalculateBottleneckSeverity(
                        statusDuration.AverageDuration,
                        overallAverage)
                });
            }
        }
        
        return bottlenecks;
    }
    
    public async Task<CumulativeFlowDiagram> GetCumulativeFlowDiagramAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        Guid projectId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        // Get historical snapshots or reconstruct from events
        var snapshots = await _analyticsRepo
            .GetTaskStatusSnapshotsAsync(tenantId, projectId, dateRange);
        
        var diagram = new CumulativeFlowDiagram
        {
            DateRange = dateRange,
            DataPoints = snapshots
                .GroupBy(s => s.Date)
                .Select(g => new CumulativeFlowDataPoint
                {
                    Date = g.Key,
                    Counts = g.GroupBy(s => s.Status)
                        .ToDictionary(
                            sg => sg.Key,
                            sg => sg.Sum(s => s.Count))
                })
                .OrderBy(dp => dp.Date)
                .ToList()
        };
        
        return diagram;
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class ProjectAnalyticsService : IProjectAnalyticsService
{
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepo;
    private readonly ITaskAnalyticsService _taskAnalytics;
    
    public async Task<ProjectAnalytics> GetProjectAnalyticsAsync(
        Guid projectId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepo.GetWithDetailsAsync(projectId);
        
        if (project == null)
            return null;
        
        var analytics = new ProjectAnalytics
        {
            ProjectId = projectId,
            DateRange = dateRange,
            
            // Health
            CurrentHealth = project.CalculateHealth(),
            HealthTrend = await CalculateHealthTrendAsync(projectId, dateRange),
            
            // Progress
            Progress = project.Progress,
            ProgressTrend = await CalculateProgressTrendAsync(projectId, dateRange),
            
            // Tasks
            TaskMetrics = await _taskAnalytics.GetTaskAnalyticsAsync(
                project.TenantId,
                dateRange,
                new AnalyticsFilters { ProjectId = projectId }),
            
            // Timeline
            PlannedDuration = project.Schedule.PlannedDuration,
            ActualDuration = project.Schedule.ActualDuration,
            TimelineVariance = CalculateTimelineVariance(project),
            EstimatedCompletionDate = await CalculateEstimatedCompletionAsync(project),
            
            // Velocity
            CurrentVelocity = await CalculateCurrentVelocityAsync(projectId),
            VelocityTrend = await CalculateVelocityTrendAsync(projectId, dateRange),
            
            // Dependencies
            DependencyMetrics = await CalculateDependencyMetricsAsync(projectId),
            CriticalPath = await CalculateCriticalPathAsync(projectId),
            
            // Success Criteria
            SuccessCriteriaProgress = CalculateSuccessCriteriaProgress(project),
            
            // Risks
            IdentifiedRisks = await IdentifyProjectRisksAsync(project),
            
            // Resources
            ResourceUtilization = await CalculateResourceUtilizationAsync(projectId),
            
            // Cost (if enabled)
            CostMetrics = await CalculateCostMetricsAsync(projectId)
        };
        
        return analytics;
    }
    
    private async Task<ProjectHealthScore> CalculateHealthTrendAsync(
        Guid projectId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var historicalScores = await _analyticsRepo
            .GetHistoricalHealthScoresAsync(projectId, dateRange);
        
        return new ProjectHealthScore
        {
            Current = historicalScores.LastOrDefault()?.Score ?? 0,
            Trend = historicalScores,
            Direction = CalculateTrendDirection(historicalScores)
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<DateTime?> CalculateEstimatedCompletionAsync(
        Project project)
    {
        // Use forecasting service
        var forecast = await _forecastingService
            .ForecastProjectCompletionAsync(project.Id);
        
        return forecast.EstimatedCompletionDate;
    }
    
    private async Task<double> CalculateCurrentVelocityAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        // Get last 2 weeks of completed tasks
        var recentCompletions = await _taskRepo
            .GetCompletedTasksAsync(
                projectId,
                DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-14),
                DateTime.UtcNow);
        
        var totalStoryPoints = recentCompletions
            .Sum(t => t.StoryPoints ?? 0);
        
        return totalStoryPoints / 2.0; // Per week
    }
    
    private async Task<List<ProjectRisk>> IdentifyProjectRisksAsync(
        Project project)
    {
        var risks = new List<ProjectRisk>();
        
        // Timeline risk
        if (project.IsOverdue() || 
            project.EstimatedCompletionDate > project.Schedule.DueDate)
        {
            risks.Add(new ProjectRisk
            {
                Type = ProjectRiskType.Timeline,
                Severity = RiskSeverity.High,
                Description = "Project is at risk of missing deadline",
                Impact = CalculateTimelineImpact(project)
            });
        }
        
        // Dependency risk
        var blockedDependencies = await _dependencyService
            .GetBlockedDependenciesAsync(project.Id);
        
        if (blockedDependencies.Any())
        {
            risks.Add(new ProjectRisk
            {
                Type = ProjectRiskType.Dependency,
                Severity = RiskSeverity.Medium,
                Description = $"{blockedDependencies.Count} dependencies are blocked",
                Impact = CalculateDependencyImpact(blockedDependencies)
            });
        }
        
        // Velocity risk
        var velocityTrend = await CalculateVelocityTrendAsync(
            project.Id,
            new DateRange(DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-30), DateTime.UtcNow));
        
        if (velocityTrend.IsDecreasing)
        {
            risks.Add(new ProjectRisk
            {
                Type = ProjectRiskType.Velocity,
                Severity = RiskSeverity.Medium,
                Description = "Team velocity is decreasing",
                Impact = CalculateVelocityImpact(velocityTrend)
            });
        }
        
        // Resource risk
        var resourceUtilization = await CalculateResourceUtilizationAsync(project.Id);
        
        if (resourceUtilization.OverallUtilization > 0.9)
        {
            risks.Add(new ProjectRisk
            {
                Type = ProjectRiskType.Resource,
                Severity = RiskSeverity.High,
                Description = "Team is over-allocated",
                Impact = "Burnout risk, potential delays"
            });
        }
        
        return risks;
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class WorkflowAnalyticsService : IWorkflowAnalyticsService
{
    public async Task<WorkflowAnalytics> GetWorkflowAnalyticsAsync(
        Guid workflowId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var transitions = await _analyticsRepo
            .GetWorkflowTransitionsAsync(workflowId, dateRange);
        
        var analytics = new WorkflowAnalytics
        {
            WorkflowId = workflowId,
            DateRange = dateRange,
            
            // Transition metrics
            TotalTransitions = transitions.Count,
            TransitionsByType = transitions
                .GroupBy(t => t.TransitionId)
                .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count()),
            
            // Status distribution
            TimeInStatus = CalculateTimeInStatus(transitions),
            StatusDistribution = CalculateCurrentStatusDistribution(workflowId),
            
            // Efficiency
            AverageTransitionTime = CalculateAverageTransitionTime(transitions),
            TransitionSuccessRate = CalculateSuccessRate(transitions),
            
            // Paths
            MostCommonPaths = IdentifyCommonPaths(transitions),
            BacktrackingRate = CalculateBacktrackingRate(transitions),
            
            // Bottlenecks
            StatusBottlenecks = IdentifyStatusBottlenecks(transitions),
            
            // Condition failures
            FailedConditions = await GetFailedConditionsAsync(workflowId, dateRange),
            
            // Action metrics
            ActionExecutionMetrics = await GetActionExecutionMetricsAsync(
                workflowId,
                dateRange),
            
            // Heatmap
            TransitionHeatmap = GenerateTransitionHeatmap(transitions)
        };
        
        return analytics;
    }
    
    private Dictionary<string, TimeSpan> CalculateTimeInStatus(
        List<WorkflowTransitionRecord> transitions)
    {
        var timeInStatus = new Dictionary<string, List<TimeSpan>>();
        
        // Group by task and calculate duration in each status
        var taskTransitions = transitions
            .GroupBy(t => t.TaskId)
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var taskGroup in taskTransitions)
        {
            var orderedTransitions = taskGroup
                .OrderBy(t => t.TransitionedAt)
                .ToList();
            
            for (int i = 0; i < orderedTransitions.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                var current = orderedTransitions[i];
                var next = orderedTransitions[i + 1];
                
                var duration = next.TransitionedAt - current.TransitionedAt;
                var status = current.ToStatus;
                
                if (!timeInStatus.ContainsKey(status))
                {
                    timeInStatus[status] = new List<TimeSpan>();
                }
                
                timeInStatus[status].Add(duration);
            }
        }
        
        // Calculate averages
        return timeInStatus.ToDictionary(
            kvp => kvp.Key,
            kvp => TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                kvp.Value.Average(ts => ts.TotalSeconds)));
    }
    
    private List<WorkflowPath> IdentifyCommonPaths(
        List<WorkflowTransitionRecord> transitions)
    {
        // Group by task and extract paths
        var paths = transitions
            .GroupBy(t => t.TaskId)
            .Select(g => new
            {
                TaskId = g.Key,
                Path = string.Join(" → ", 
                    g.OrderBy(t => t.TransitionedAt)
                     .Select(t => $"{t.FromStatus}→{t.ToStatus}"))
            })
            .GroupBy(p => p.Path)
            .Select(g => new WorkflowPath
            {
                Path = g.Key,
                Count = g.Count(),
                Percentage = (double)g.Count() / transitions.Count * 100,
                AverageDuration = CalculatePathDuration(g.Select(p => p.TaskId).ToList())
            })
            .OrderByDescending(p => p.Count)
            .Take(10)
            .ToList();
        
        return paths;
    }
    
    private TransitionHeatmap GenerateTransitionHeatmap(
        List<WorkflowTransitionRecord> transitions)
    {
        var heatmap = new TransitionHeatmap();
        
        // Build matrix of from-status to to-status counts
        foreach (var transition in transitions)
        {
            var key = $"{transition.FromStatus}→{transition.ToStatus}";
            
            if (!heatmap.Data.ContainsKey(key))
            {
                heatmap.Data[key] = new HeatmapCell
                {
                    FromStatus = transition.FromStatus,
                    ToStatus = transition.ToStatus,
                    Count = 0,
                    AverageDuration = TimeSpan.Zero
                };
            }
            
            heatmap.Data[key].Count++;
        }
        
        // Calculate percentages
        var total = transitions.Count;
        foreach (var cell in heatmap.Data.Values)
        {
            cell.Percentage = (double)cell.Count / total * 100;
        }
        
        return heatmap;
    }
}

public class WorkflowAnalytics
{
    public Guid WorkflowId { get; set; }
    public DateRange DateRange { get; set; }
    
    // Transitions
    public int TotalTransitions { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<Guid, int> TransitionsByType { get; set; }
    
    // Status
    public Dictionary<string, TimeSpan> TimeInStatus { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, int> StatusDistribution { get; set; }
    
    // Efficiency
    public TimeSpan AverageTransitionTime { get; set; }
    public double TransitionSuccessRate { get; set; }
    
    // Paths

    public double BacktrackingRate { get; set; }
    
    // Bottlenecks

    // Conditions

    // Actions

    public TransitionHeatmap TransitionHeatmap { get; set; }
}
```

### 168.2 Project Completion Forecasting

**Forecasting Service:**

```csharp
public class ProjectForecastingService : IProjectForecastingService
{
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepo;
    private readonly ITaskAnalyticsService _taskAnalytics;
    private readonly IVelocityCalculator _velocityCalculator;
    
    public async Task<ProjectForecast> ForecastProjectCompletionAsync(
        Guid projectId)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepo.GetWithDetailsAsync(projectId);
        
        if (project == null)
            return null;
        
        // Get historical velocity
        var historicalVelocity = await _velocityCalculator
            .CalculateHistoricalVelocityAsync(projectId);
        
        // Get remaining work
        var remainingTasks = await _taskRepo
            .GetIncompleteTasksAsync(projectId);
        
        var remainingStoryPoints = remainingTasks
            .Sum(t => t.StoryPoints ?? 0);
        
        var remainingTaskCount = remainingTasks.Count;
        
        // Calculate forecasts using multiple methods
        var velocityBasedForecast = ForecastUsingVelocity(
            remainingStoryPoints,
            historicalVelocity);
        
        var historicalAverageForecast = await ForecastUsingHistoricalAverage(
            projectId,
            remainingTaskCount);
        
        var monteCarloForecast = await ForecastUsingMonteCarlo(
            projectId,
            remainingTasks);
        
        var mlBasedForecast = await ForecastUsingMachineLearning(
            projectId,
            remainingTasks,
            historicalVelocity);
        
        // Combine forecasts with weighted average
        var combinedForecast = CombineForecasts(new[]
        {
            (velocityBasedForecast, 0.3),
            (historicalAverageForecast, 0.2),
            (monteCarloForecast, 0.3),
            (mlBasedForecast, 0.2)
        });
        
        // Calculate confidence intervals
        var confidence = CalculateConfidenceIntervals(new[]
        {
            velocityBasedForecast,
            historicalAverageForecast,
            monteCarloForecast,
            mlBasedForecast
        });
        
        return new ProjectForecast
        {
            ProjectId = projectId,
            ForecastDate = DateTime.UtcNow,
            
            // Best estimate
            EstimatedCompletionDate = combinedForecast.CompletionDate,
            
            // Confidence intervals
            EarliestCompletionDate = confidence.P10,
            LatestCompletionDate = confidence.P90,
            MostLikelyCompletionDate = confidence.P50,
            
            // Probabilities
            ProbabilityOfOnTime = CalculateProbabilityOfOnTime(
                project.Schedule.DueDate,
                combinedForecast),
            
            ProbabilityOfDelay = 1 - CalculateProbabilityOfOnTime(
                project.Schedule.DueDate,
                combinedForecast),
            
            // Risk assessment
            RiskLevel = DetermineRiskLevel(combinedForecast, project),
            RiskFactors = IdentifyRiskFactors(project, remainingTasks),
            
            // Recommendations
            Recommendations = GenerateRecommendations(
                project,
                combinedForecast,
                remainingTasks),
            
            // Forecast details
            ForecastDetails = new ForecastDetails
            {
                VelocityBased = velocityBasedForecast,
                HistoricalAverage = historicalAverageForecast,
                MonteCarlo = monteCarloForecast,
                MachineLearning = mlBasedForecast
            },
            
            Confidence = confidence.OverallConfidence
        };
    }
    
    private ForecastResult ForecastUsingVelocity(
        double remainingStoryPoints,
        VelocityMetrics velocity)
    {
        // Use average velocity to estimate remaining sprints
        var remainingSprints = Math.Ceiling(
            remainingStoryPoints / velocity.AverageVelocity);
        
        var estimatedWeeks = remainingSprints * velocity.SprintLengthWeeks;
        
        var completionDate = DateTime.UtcNow
            .AddDays(estimatedWeeks * 7);
        
        return new ForecastResult
        {
            CompletionDate = completionDate,
            Method = ForecastMethod.Velocity,
            Confidence = CalculateVelocityConfidence(velocity)
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<ForecastResult> ForecastUsingMonteCarlo(
        Guid projectId,
        List<TaskInstance> remainingTasks)
    {
        const int simulations = 10000;
        var completionDates = new List<DateTime>();
        
        // Get historical completion time distributions
        var historicalData = await _analyticsRepo
            .GetCompletionTimeDistributionsAsync(projectId);
        
        // Run Monte Carlo simulations
        for (int i = 0; i < simulations; i++)
        {
            var simulatedDate = SimulateProjectCompletion(
                remainingTasks,
                historicalData);
            
            completionDates.Add(simulatedDate);
        }
        
        // Calculate percentiles
        var sortedDates = completionDates.OrderBy(d => d).ToList();
        var medianIndex = simulations / 2;
        
        return new ForecastResult
        {
            CompletionDate = sortedDates[medianIndex],
            Method = ForecastMethod.MonteCarlo,
            Confidence = 0.85,
            Distribution = new ForecastDistribution
            {
                P10 = sortedDates[(int)(simulations * 0.1)],
                P50 = sortedDates[medianIndex],
                P90 = sortedDates[(int)(simulations * 0.9)]
            }
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<ForecastResult> ForecastUsingMachineLearning(
        Guid projectId,
        List<TaskInstance> remainingTasks,
        VelocityMetrics velocity)
    {
        // Extract features
        var features = new ProjectFeatures
        {
            RemainingTaskCount = remainingTasks.Count,
            RemainingStoryPoints = remainingTasks.Sum(t => t.StoryPoints ?? 0),
            AverageVelocity = velocity.AverageVelocity,
            VelocityTrend = velocity.Trend,
            TeamSize = await GetTeamSizeAsync(projectId),
            HistoricalAccuracy = await GetHistoricalForecastAccuracyAsync(projectId),
            DependencyComplexity = CalculateDependencyComplexity(remainingTasks),
            BlockedTaskRatio = CalculateBlockedRatio(remainingTasks),
            OverdueRatio = CalculateOverdueRatio(remainingTasks)
        };
        
        // Use trained ML model for prediction
        var prediction = await _mlModelService
            .PredictCompletionDateAsync(features);
        
        return new ForecastResult
        {
            CompletionDate = prediction.PredictedDate,
            Method = ForecastMethod.MachineLearning,
            Confidence = prediction.Confidence
        };
    }
    
    private List<Recommendation> GenerateRecommendations(
        Project project,
        ForecastResult forecast,
        List<TaskInstance> remainingTasks)
    {
        var recommendations = new List<Recommendation>();
        
        // Check if forecast exceeds deadline
        if (project.Schedule.DueDate.HasValue &&
            forecast.CompletionDate > project.Schedule.DueDate.Value)
        {
            var delay = forecast.CompletionDate - project.Schedule.DueDate.Value;
            
            recommendations.Add(new Recommendation
            {
                Priority = RecommendationPriority.High,
                Category = RecommendationCategory.Timeline,
                Title = "Project forecasted to miss deadline",
                Description = $"Based on current trajectory, project will be delayed by {delay.TotalDays:F0} days",
                Actions = new List<string>
                {
                    "Reduce scope by deferring low-priority tasks",
                    "Increase team capacity",
                    "Negotiate deadline extension",
                    "Parallelize more work streams"
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Check velocity trends
        var velocityTrend = await _velocityCalculator
            .CalculateTrendAsync(project.Id);
        
        if (velocityTrend.IsDecreasing)
        {
            recommendations.Add(new Recommendation
            {
                Priority = RecommendationPriority.Medium,
                Category = RecommendationCategory.Velocity,
                Title = "Team velocity is declining",
                Description = "Velocity has decreased by {velocityTrend.DecreasePercentage:F0}% over last 3 sprints",
                Actions = new List<string>
                {
                    "Identify and remove blockers",
                    "Review team workload and reduce meeting overhead",
                    "Address technical debt",
                    "Provide additional training or support"
                }
            });
        }
        
        // Check for bottlenecks
        var blockedTasks = remainingTasks.Count(t => t.Blocking.IsBlocked);
        if (blockedTasks > remainingTasks.Count * 0.2)
        {
            recommendations.Add(new Recommendation
            {
                Priority = RecommendationPriority.High,
                Category = RecommendationCategory.Blockers,
                Title = "High number of blocked tasks",
                Description = $"{blockedTasks} of {remainingTasks.Count} remaining tasks are blocked",
                Actions = new List<string>
                {
                    "Resolve blocking dependencies urgently",
                    "Assign dedicated resources to unblock tasks",
                    "Escalate external blockers to stakeholders"
                }
            });
        }
        
        return recommendations;
    }
}

public class ProjectForecast
{
    public Guid ProjectId { get; set; }
    public DateTime ForecastDate { get; set; }
    
    // Best estimate
    public DateTime EstimatedCompletionDate { get; set; }
    
    // Confidence intervals
    public DateTime EarliestCompletionDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime MostLikelyCompletionDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime LatestCompletionDate { get; set; }
    
    // Probabilities
    public double ProbabilityOfOnTime { get; set; }
    public double ProbabilityOfDelay { get; set; }
    
    // Risk
    public RiskLevel RiskLevel { get; set; }
    public List<RiskFactor> RiskFactors { get; set; }
    
    // Recommendations
    public List<Recommendation> Recommendations { get; set; }
    
    // Details
    public ForecastDetails ForecastDetails { get; set; }
    public double Confidence { get; set; }
}
```

## **Chapter 169 - Performance Architecture Overview**

### 169.1 Performance Philosophy

**Core Principles:**

1. **Performance by Design** - Build performance in from the start, not as an afterthought
2. **Measure Everything** - Instrument comprehensively to understand bottlenecks
3. **Optimize Judiciously** - Focus on actual bottlenecks, not premature optimization
4. **Scale Horizontally** - Design for horizontal scaling over vertical scaling
5. **Embrace Asynchrony** - Offload non-critical operations to background processing
6. **Cache Intelligently** - Cache frequently accessed, rarely changed data

### 169.2 Performance Targets

**Response Time SLAs:**

| Operation Type | Target (P50) | Target (P95) | Target (P99) | Max Acceptable |
|---------------|--------------|--------------|--------------|----------------|
| Simple GET | 50ms | 100ms | 200ms | 500ms |
| Task Creation | 100ms | 200ms | 400ms | 1000ms |
| Task Transition | 80ms | 150ms | 300ms | 800ms |
| Approval Decision | 120ms | 250ms | 500ms | 1200ms |
| Project Overview | 150ms | 300ms | 600ms | 1500ms |
| Complex Analytics | 500ms | 1000ms | 2000ms | 5000ms |
| Report Generation | 2000ms | 5000ms | 10000ms | 30000ms |

**Throughput Targets:**

| Metric | Target | Sustained |
|--------|--------|-----------|
| Task Operations/sec | 1000 | 500 |
| Workflow Transitions/sec | 500 | 250 |
| Approval Decisions/sec | 200 | 100 |
| API Requests/sec | 5000 | 2500 |
| Database Queries/sec | 10000 | 5000 |

**Scalability Targets:**

| Resource | Per Tenant | System-wide |
|----------|-----------|-------------|
| Active Tasks | 10M | 500M |
| Total Tasks | 50M | 5B |
| Active Projects | 100K | 5M |
| Concurrent Users | 10K | 500K |
| Monthly Workflow Transitions | 50M | 2.5B |
| Daily Approval Decisions | 1M | 50M |

### 170.2 Index Strategy

**Critical Indexes:**

```sql
-- Task Instance Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_tenant_project_status 
    ON TaskInstances(TenantId, ProjectId, StatusId)
    INCLUDE (Title, AssigneeId, DueDate);

    ON TaskInstances(AssigneeId, StatusId)
    WHERE IsDeleted = 0;

    WHERE StatusId NOT IN (SELECT Id FROM Statuses WHERE IsTerminal = 1);

    ON TaskInstances(TenantId, ProjectId, DueDate)

-- Workflow Transition Indexes
```

**Index Maintenance Strategy:**

```csharp
public class IndexMaintenanceService : IIndexMaintenanceService
{
    private readonly IDbConnection _connection;
    
    public async Task AnalyzeAndOptimizeIndexesAsync()
    {
        // Identify missing indexes
        var missingIndexes = await IdentifyMissingIndexesAsync();
        
        foreach (var recommendation in missingIndexes)
        {
            if (recommendation.ImpactScore > 80)
            {
                await CreateIndexAsync(recommendation);
            }
        }
        
        // Identify unused indexes
        var unusedIndexes = await IdentifyUnusedIndexesAsync();
        
        foreach (var index in unusedIndexes)
        {
            if (index.DaysSinceLastUsed > 90)
            {
                await DropIndexAsync(index);
            }
        }
        
        // Rebuild fragmented indexes
        var fragmentedIndexes = await IdentifyFragmentedIndexesAsync();
        
        foreach (var index in fragmentedIndexes)
        {
            if (index.FragmentationPercent > 30)
            {
                await RebuildIndexAsync(index);
            }
            else if (index.FragmentationPercent > 10)
            {
                await ReorganizeIndexAsync(index);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<List<IndexRecommendation>> IdentifyMissingIndexesAsync()
    {
        var sql = @"
            SELECT 
                d.statement AS TableName,
                gs.avg_user_impact AS ImpactScore,
                gs.avg_total_user_cost * (gs.avg_user_impact / 100.0) AS ImprovementMeasure,
                'CREATE INDEX idx_' + 
                    REPLACE(REPLACE(d.statement, '[', ''), ']', '') + '_' +
                    CONVERT(VARCHAR, gs.index_handle) + 
                    ' ON ' + d.statement + 
                    ' (' + ISNULL(d.equality_columns, '') + 
                    CASE WHEN d.inequality_columns IS NOT NULL 
                         THEN ',' + d.inequality_columns 
                         ELSE '' END + ')' +
                    CASE WHEN d.included_columns IS NOT NULL 
                         THEN ' INCLUDE (' + d.included_columns + ')' 
                         ELSE '' END AS CreateStatement
            FROM sys.dm_db_missing_index_groups g
            INNER JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_group_stats gs 
                ON g.index_group_handle = gs.group_handle
            INNER JOIN sys.dm_db_missing_index_details d 
                ON g.index_handle = d.index_handle
            WHERE d.database_id = DB_ID()
            AND gs.avg_user_impact > 50
            ORDER BY gs.avg_user_impact DESC;
        ";
        
        return await _connection.QueryAsync<IndexRecommendation>(sql);
    }
}
```

### 170.3 Query Optimization

**N+1 Query Prevention:**

```csharp
// BAD: N+1 Query Problem
public async Task<List<TaskDto>> GetTasksWithProjectAsync(Guid tenantId)
{
    var tasks = await _taskRepo.GetByTenantAsync(tenantId);
    
    foreach (var task in tasks)
    {
        // This causes N additional queries!
        task.Project = await _projectRepo.GetAsync(task.ProjectId);
    }
    
    return tasks;
}

// GOOD: Eager Loading
public async Task<List<TaskDto>> GetTasksWithProjectAsync(Guid tenantId)
{
    var sql = @"
        SELECT 
            t.*,
            p.Id AS Project_Id,
            p.Title AS Project_Title,
            p.Status AS Project_Status
        FROM TaskInstances t
        INNER JOIN Projects p ON t.ProjectId = p.Id
        WHERE t.TenantId = @TenantId
        AND t.IsDeleted = 0;
    ";
    
    var tasks = await _connection.QueryAsync<TaskInstance, Project, TaskInstance>(
        sql,
        (task, project) => 
        {
            task.Project = project;
            return task;
        },
        new { TenantId = tenantId },
        splitOn: "Project_Id");
    
    return tasks.ToList();
}

// BETTER: Projection to DTO
public async Task<List<TaskDto>> GetTasksWithProjectAsync(Guid tenantId)
{
    var sql = @"
        SELECT 
            t.Id,
            t.Title,
            t.StatusId,
            t.DueDate,
            p.Id AS ProjectId,
            p.Title AS ProjectTitle
        FROM TaskInstances t
        INNER JOIN Projects p ON t.ProjectId = p.Id
        WHERE t.TenantId = @TenantId
        AND t.IsDeleted = 0;
    ";
    
    return await _connection.QueryAsync<TaskDto>(sql, new { TenantId = tenantId });
}
```

**Pagination Strategy:**

```csharp
public class PaginationHelper
{
    // BAD: Offset-based pagination (slow for large offsets)
    public async Task<PagedResult<Task>> GetPagedTasksBad(
        int page, 
        int pageSize)
    {
        var offset = (page - 1) * pageSize;
        
        var sql = @"
            SELECT * FROM TaskInstances
            WHERE TenantId = @TenantId
            ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC
            OFFSET @Offset ROWS
            FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY;
        ";
        
        // This gets slower as offset increases
        var tasks = await _connection.QueryAsync<Task>(sql, 
            new { TenantId, Offset = offset, PageSize = pageSize });
        
        return new PagedResult<Task>(tasks, page, pageSize);
    }
    
    // GOOD: Keyset-based pagination (consistent performance)
    public async Task<PagedResult<Task>> GetPagedTasksGood(
        DateTime? lastCreatedAt,
        Guid? lastId,
        int pageSize)
    {
        var sql = @"
            SELECT TOP (@PageSize) * 
            FROM TaskInstances
            WHERE TenantId = @TenantId
            AND (
                CreatedAt < @LastCreatedAt
                OR (CreatedAt = @LastCreatedAt AND Id < @LastId)
            )
            ORDER BY CreatedAt DESC, Id DESC;
        ";
        
        var tasks = await _connection.QueryAsync<Task>(sql, 
            new { 
                TenantId, 
                LastCreatedAt = lastCreatedAt ?? DateTime.MaxValue,
                LastId = lastId ?? Guid.Empty,
                PageSize = pageSize + 1 // Fetch one extra to check if there's more
            });
        
        var taskList = tasks.ToList();
        var hasMore = taskList.Count > pageSize;
        
        if (hasMore)
        {
            taskList = taskList.Take(pageSize).ToList();
        }
        
        return new PagedResult<Task>(
            taskList, 
            hasMore,
            taskList.LastOrDefault()?.CreatedAt,
            taskList.LastOrDefault()?.Id);
    }
}
```

**Batch Operations:**

```csharp
public class BatchOperationService
{
    // BAD: Individual inserts
    public async Task CreateTasksBad(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        foreach (var task in tasks)
        {
            await _taskRepo.InsertAsync(task); // N round trips to DB
        }
    }
    
    // GOOD: Bulk insert
    public async Task CreateTasksGood(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync(@"
            INSERT INTO TaskInstances 
            (Id, TenantId, Title, ProjectId, StatusId, CreatedAt, ...)
            VALUES 
            (@Id, @TenantId, @Title, @ProjectId, @StatusId, @CreatedAt, ...)",
            tasks);
    }
    
    // BETTER: Table-valued parameters (SQL Server)
    public async Task CreateTasksBest(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var table = new DataTable();
        table.Columns.Add("Id", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("TenantId", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("Title", typeof(string));
        // ... other columns
        
        foreach (var task in tasks)
        {
            table.Rows.Add(task.Id, task.TenantId, task.Title, ...);
        }
        
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync(@"
            INSERT INTO TaskInstances 
            SELECT * FROM @TaskTable",
            new { TaskTable = table.AsTableValuedParameter("TaskTableType") });
    }
}
```

### 170.4 Database Partitioning

**Partition Strategy for Large Tables:**

```sql
-- Partition by TenantId for multi-tenant isolation
CREATE PARTITION FUNCTION PF_TenantId (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)
AS RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES (
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002',
    -- ... up to 1000 tenant boundaries
);

CREATE PARTITION SCHEME PS_TenantId
AS PARTITION PF_TenantId
ALL TO ([PRIMARY]);

-- Apply to large tables
CREATE TABLE TaskInstances (
    Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
    -- ... other columns
    CONSTRAINT PK_TaskInstances PRIMARY KEY (TenantId, Id)
) ON PS_TenantId(TenantId);

-- Partition history/timeline by date
CREATE PARTITION FUNCTION PF_TimelineDate (DATETIME2)
AS RANGE RIGHT FOR VALUES (
    '2024-01-01', '2024-02-01', '2024-03-01', -- monthly partitions
    -- ... continuing monthly
);

CREATE PARTITION SCHEME PS_TimelineDate
AS PARTITION PF_TimelineDate
TO (
    [FG_2023], [FG_202401], [FG_202402], [FG_202403], -- ...
);

CREATE TABLE TimelineEntries (
    Id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,
    Timestamp DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    -- ... other columns
    CONSTRAINT PK_TimelineEntries PRIMARY KEY (Timestamp, Id)
) ON PS_TimelineDate(Timestamp);
```

**Partition Management:**

```csharp
public class PartitionManagementService
{
    public async Task MaintainTimelinePartitionsAsync()
    {
        // Create next month's partition
        var nextMonth = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMonths(1).Date;
        await CreatePartitionIfNotExistsAsync("TimelineEntries", nextMonth);
        
        // Archive and drop old partitions (older than 2 years)
        var archiveThreshold = DateTime.UtcNow.AddYears(-2).Date;
        await ArchiveAndDropOldPartitionsAsync("TimelineEntries", archiveThreshold);
    }
    
    private async Task CreatePartitionIfNotExistsAsync(string tableName, DateTime date)
    {
        var sql = $@"
            IF NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM sys.partition_range_values prv
                INNER JOIN sys.partition_functions pf ON prv.function_id = pf.function_id
                WHERE pf.name = 'PF_TimelineDate'
                AND CONVERT(DATE, prv.value) = @Date
            )
            BEGIN
                -- Create filegroup
                ALTER DATABASE CURRENT 
                ADD FILEGROUP FG_{date:yyyyMM};
                
                -- Add file to filegroup
                ALTER DATABASE CURRENT 
                ADD FILE (
                    NAME = N'Timeline_{date:yyyyMM}',
                    FILENAME = N'/data/timeline_{date:yyyyMM}.ndf',
                    SIZE = 1GB,
                    FILEGROWTH = 512MB
                ) TO FILEGROUP FG_{date:yyyyMM};
                
                -- Split partition
                ALTER PARTITION SCHEME PS_TimelineDate
                NEXT USED FG_{date:yyyyMM};
                
                ALTER PARTITION FUNCTION PF_TimelineDate()
                SPLIT RANGE (@Date);
            END
        ";
        
        await _connection.ExecuteAsync(sql, new { Date = date });
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 171 - Caching Strategy**

### 171.1 Multi-Layer Cache Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Request[API Request] --> L1[L1: In-Memory Cache]
    
    L1 -->|Cache Hit| Response[Return Response]
    L1 -->|Cache Miss| L2[L2: Distributed Cache<br/>Redis]
    
    L2 -->|Cache Hit| L1Update[Update L1]
    L1Update --> Response
    
    L2 -->|Cache Miss| DB[(Database)]
    DB --> L2Update[Update L2]
    L2Update --> L1Update
    
    Invalidation[Cache Invalidation] --> L1Invalid[Invalidate L1]
    Invalidation --> L2Invalid[Invalidate L2]
```

### 171.3 Cache Implementation

**L1 Cache (In-Memory):**

```csharp
public class MemoryCacheService : ICacheService
{
    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private readonly ILogger<MemoryCacheService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<T> GetOrCreateAsync<T>(
        string key,
        Func<Task<T>> factory,
        TimeSpan? expiration = null)
    {
        if (_cache.TryGetValue(key, out T cached))
        {
            return cached;
        }
        
        var value = await factory();
        
        var cacheOptions = new MemoryCacheEntryOptions
        {
            AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = expiration ?? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
            SlidingExpiration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2)
        };
        
        // Set size limit (in units)
        cacheOptions.SetSize(1);
        
        // Register post-eviction callback
        cacheOptions.RegisterPostEvictionCallback(OnCacheEviction);
        
        _cache.Set(key, value, cacheOptions);
        
        return value;
    }
    
    public void Remove(string key)
    {
        _cache.Remove(key);
    }
    
    public void RemoveByPattern(string pattern)
    {
        // Not natively supported by IMemoryCache
        // Need to track keys separately
        var keysToRemove = _trackedKeys
            .Where(k => Regex.IsMatch(k, pattern))
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var key in keysToRemove)
        {
            _cache.Remove(key);
        }
    }
    
    private void OnCacheEviction(
        object key, 
        object value, 
        EvictionReason reason, 
        object state)
    {
        _logger.LogDebug(
            "Cache entry evicted. Key: {Key}, Reason: {Reason}",
            key,
            reason);
    }
}
```

**L2 Cache (Distributed Redis):**

```csharp
public class RedisCacheService : IDistributedCacheService
{
    private readonly IConnectionMultiplexer _redis;
    private readonly ILogger<RedisCacheService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<T> GetOrCreateAsync<T>(
        string key,
        Func<Task<T>> factory,
        TimeSpan? expiration = null)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        
        // Try to get from cache
        var cached = await db.StringGetAsync(key);
        
        if (!cached.IsNullOrEmpty)
        {
            try
            {
                return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(cached);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to deserialize cached value for key: {Key}", key);
                await db.KeyDeleteAsync(key); // Remove corrupted cache entry
            }
        }
        
        // Cache miss - get from factory
        var value = await factory();
        
        // Store in cache
        var serialized = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
        await db.StringSetAsync(
            key,
            serialized,
            expiration ?? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30));
        
        return value;
    }
    
    public async Task SetAsync<T>(
        string key,
        T value,
        TimeSpan? expiration = null)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        var serialized = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
        
        await db.StringSetAsync(
            key,
            serialized,
            expiration ?? TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30));
    }
    
    public async Task RemoveAsync(string key)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        await db.KeyDeleteAsync(key);
    }
    
    public async Task RemoveByPatternAsync(string pattern)
    {
        var server = _redis.GetServer(_redis.GetEndPoints().First());
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        
        var keys = server.Keys(pattern: pattern).ToArray();
        
        if (keys.Any())
        {
            await db.KeyDeleteAsync(keys);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> ExistsAsync(string key)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        return await db.KeyExistsAsync(key);
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class CachingWorkflowRepository : IWorkflowRepository
```

**Cache Invalidation Strategy:**

```csharp
public class CacheInvalidationService : IEventHandler<DomainEvent>
{
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(WorkflowPublishedEto eventData)
    {
        // Invalidate workflow cache
        var workflowKey = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildWorkflowKey(eventData.WorkflowId);
        _cache.Remove(workflowKey);
        
        // Invalidate all versions of this workflow
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync($"workflow:*:{eventData.WorkflowId}:*");
    }
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(TaskTypeUpdatedEto eventData)
    {
        // Invalidate task type cache
        var taskTypeKey = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildTaskTypeKey(eventData.TaskTypeId);
        _cache.Remove(taskTypeKey);
        
        // Invalidate custom field schemas for this task type
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync($"customfields:TaskType:{eventData.TaskTypeId}");
    }
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(UserRoleChangedEto eventData)
    {
        // Invalidate user permissions cache
        var permissionsKey = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildUserPermissionsKey(eventData.UserId);
        _cache.Remove(permissionsKey);
    }
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(TaskCompletedEto eventData)
    {
        // Invalidate project health cache (project metrics changed)
        var healthKey = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildProjectHealthKey(eventData.ProjectId);
        _cache.Remove(healthKey);
    }
}
```

### 171.5 Cache Warming

**Pre-populate Cache on Startup:**

```csharp
public class CacheWarmingService : IHostedService
{
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepo;
    private readonly ITaskTypeRepository _taskTypeRepo;
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task StartAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Warm workflow cache
        await WarmWorkflowCacheAsync();
        
        // Warm task type cache
        await WarmTaskTypeCacheAsync();
        
        // Warm frequently accessed data
        await WarmFrequentlyAccessedDataAsync();
    }
    
    private async Task WarmWorkflowCacheAsync()
    {
        // Get all active workflows
        var workflows = await _workflowRepo.GetActiveWorkflowsAsync();
        
        foreach (var workflow in workflows)
        {
            var key = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildWorkflowKey(workflow.Id);
            await _cache.SetAsync(key, workflow, TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
            
            // Also cache transitions
            var transitions = await _workflowRepo.GetTransitionsAsync(workflow.Id);
            var transKey = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildWorkflowTransitionsKey(workflow.Id);
            await _cache.SetAsync(transKey, transitions, TimeSpan.FromDays(7));
        }
    }
    
    private async Task WarmTaskTypeCacheAsync()
    {
        var taskTypes = await _taskTypeRepo.GetAllAsync();
        
        foreach (var taskType in taskTypes)
        {
            var key = CacheKeyBuilder.BuildTaskTypeKey(taskType.Id);
            await _cache.SetAsync(key, taskType, TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 172 - Concurrency & Locking**

### 172.1 Optimistic Concurrency Control

**Entity Framework Core Version Tracking:**

```csharp
public class TaskInstance : AggregateRoot<Guid>
{
    // ... other properties
    
    [Timestamp]
    public byte[] RowVersion { get; set; }
}

public class TaskInstanceRepository : ITaskInstanceRepository
{
    private readonly DbContext _context;
    
    public async Task UpdateAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        try
        {
            _context.TaskInstances.Update(task);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
        catch (DbUpdateConcurrencyException ex)
        {
            // Handle concurrency conflict
            var entry = ex.Entries.Single();
            var databaseValues = await entry.GetDatabaseValuesAsync();
            
            if (databaseValues == null)
            {
                throw new EntityNotFoundException(
                    "Task was deleted by another user");
            }
            
            var databaseTask = (TaskInstance)databaseValues.ToObject();
            
            // Decide how to resolve conflict
            throw new ConcurrencyException(
                $"Task was modified by another user. " +
                $"Current version in database has been updated at {databaseTask.ModifiedAt}",
                task,
                databaseTask);
        }
    }
}
```

**Manual Version Checking:**

```csharp
public class VersionedUpdateService
{
    public async Task<UpdateResult> UpdateWithVersionCheckAsync<T>(
        Guid id,
        int expectedVersion,
        Action<T> updateAction)
        where T : IVersionedEntity
    {
        var entity = await _repository.GetAsync(id);
        
        if (entity.Version != expectedVersion)
        {
            return UpdateResult.VersionMismatch(
                entity.Version,
                expectedVersion);
        }
        
        updateAction(entity);
        entity.Version++;
        
        await _repository.UpdateAsync(entity);
        
        return UpdateResult.Success(entity.Version);
    }
}
```

### 172.2 Pessimistic Locking (When Necessary)

**Distributed Locks with Redis:**

```csharp
public class DistributedLockService : IDistributedLockService
{
    private readonly IConnectionMultiplexer _redis;
    
    public async Task<IDisposable> AcquireLockAsync(
        string resource,
        TimeSpan timeout,
        TimeSpan expiry)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        var lockKey = $"lock:{resource}";
        var lockValue = Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
        
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        while (stopwatch.Elapsed < timeout)
        {
            // Try to acquire lock
            var acquired = await db.StringSetAsync(
                lockKey,
                lockValue,
                expiry,
                When.NotExists);
            
            if (acquired)
            {
                return new DistributedLock(db, lockKey, lockValue);
            }
            
            // Wait before retry
            await Task.Delay(100);
        }
        
        throw new TimeoutException(
            $"Failed to acquire lock on resource '{resource}' within {timeout}");
    }
}

public class DistributedLock : IDisposable
{
    private readonly IDatabase _db;
    private readonly string _key;
    private readonly string _value;
    private bool _disposed;
    
    public DistributedLock(IDatabase db, string key, string value)
    {
        _db = db;
        _key = key;
        _value = value;
    }
    
    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed) return;
        
        // Release lock using Lua script to ensure atomicity
        var script = @"
            if redis.call('get', KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then
                return redis.call('del', KEYS[1])
            else
                return 0
            end
        ";
        
        _db.ScriptEvaluate(script, new RedisKey[] { _key }, new RedisValue[] { _value });
        
        _disposed = true;
    }
}
```

**Use Case for Distributed Locks:**

```csharp
public class CriticalOperationService
{
    private readonly IDistributedLockService _lockService;
    
    public async Task ProcessCriticalOperationAsync(Guid entityId)
    {
        // Use lock for operations that must be serialized
        using (await _lockService.AcquireLockAsync(
            $"entity:{entityId}",
            timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),
            expiry: TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2)))
        {
            // Perform critical operation
            // Only one process can execute this at a time
            await PerformCriticalUpdateAsync(entityId);
        }
    }
    
    // Example: Generating unique sequence numbers
    public async Task<int> GenerateSequenceNumberAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        using (await _lockService.AcquireLockAsync(
            $"sequence:project:{projectId}",
            timeout: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5),
            expiry: TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30)))
        {
            var sequence = await _sequenceRepo.GetAsync(projectId);
            sequence.Increment();
            await _sequenceRepo.UpdateAsync(sequence);
            return sequence.CurrentValue;
        }
    }
}
```

### 172.3 Saga Pattern for Distributed Transactions

**Saga Orchestrator:**

```csharp
public class TaskCompletionSaga : ISaga
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepo;
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepo;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    
    public async Task ExecuteAsync(TaskCompletionCommand command)
    {
        var sagaState = new SagaState
        {
            SagaId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TaskId = command.TaskId,
            Steps = new List<SagaStep>()
        };
        
        try
        {
            // Step 1: Update task status
            await ExecuteStepAsync(sagaState, async () =>
            {
                var task = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(command.TaskId);
                task.Complete();
                await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
            },
            compensate: async () =>
            {
                var task = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(command.TaskId);
                task.Reopen();
                await _taskRepo.UpdateAsync(task);
            });
            
            // Step 2: Update project metrics
            await ExecuteStepAsync(sagaState, async () =>
            {
                var task = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(command.TaskId);
                var project = await _projectRepo.GetAsync(task.ProjectId);
                project.RecalculateProgress();
                await _projectRepo.UpdateAsync(project);
            },
            compensate: async () =>
            {
                var task = await _taskRepo.GetAsync(command.TaskId);
                var project = await _projectRepo.GetAsync(task.ProjectId);
                project.RecalculateProgress();
                await _projectRepo.UpdateAsync(project);
            });
            
            // Step 3: Send notifications (idempotent, no compensation needed)
            await ExecuteStepAsync(sagaState, async () =>
            {
                await _notificationService.NotifyTaskCompletedAsync(command.TaskId);
            });
            
            // Saga completed successfully
            sagaState.Status = SagaStatus.Completed;
            await _eventBus.PublishAsync(new TaskCompletionSagaCompletedEto
            {
                SagaId = sagaState.SagaId,
                TaskId = command.TaskId
            });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Saga failed - execute compensating transactions
            await CompensateAsync(sagaState);
            sagaState.Status = SagaStatus.Failed;
            
            throw new SagaExecutionException(
                $"Saga {sagaState.SagaId} failed", ex);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ExecuteStepAsync(
        SagaState state,
        Func<Task> action,
        Func<Task> compensate = null)
    {
        var step = new SagaStep
        {
            StepId = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Order = state.Steps.Count + 1,
            Status = SagaStepStatus.Pending
        };
        
        state.Steps.Add(step);
        
        try
        {
            await action();
            step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Completed;
            step.CompensatingAction = compensate;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Failed;
            step.Error = ex.Message;
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    private async Task CompensateAsync(SagaState state)
    {
        // Execute compensating actions in reverse order
        var completedSteps = state.Steps
            .Where(s => s.Status == SagaStepStatus.Completed &&
                       s.CompensatingAction != null)
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.Order);
        
        foreach (var step in completedSteps)
        {
            try
            {
                await step.CompensatingAction();
                step.Status = SagaStepStatus.Compensated;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                // Log compensation failure
                step.Status = SagaStepStatus.CompensationFailed;
                step.Error = ex.Message;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 173 - Asynchronous Processing**

### 173.1 Background Job Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Synchronous ["Synchronous Request Path"]
        API[API Request] --> Validate[Validate]
        Validate --> Quick[Quick Operations]
        Quick --> QueueJob[Queue Background Job]
        QueueJob --> Response[Return Response]
    end
    
    subgraph Asynchronous ["Asynchronous Processing"]
        Queue[(Message Queue)] --> Worker1[Worker 1]
        Queue --> Worker2[Worker 2]
        Queue --> Worker3[Worker 3]
        
        Worker1 --> Process[Process Job]
        Worker2 --> Process
        Worker3 --> Process
        
        Process --> Update[Update Database]
        Update --> Event[Publish Events]
    end
    
    QueueJob --> Queue
```

### 173.2 Background Job Implementation

**Job Queue Service:**

```csharp
public interface IBackgroundJobQueue
{
    Task EnqueueAsync<TJob>(TJob job) where TJob : IBackgroundJob;
    Task<IBackgroundJob> DequeueAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}

public class BackgroundJobQueue : IBackgroundJobQueue
{
    private readonly Channel<IBackgroundJob> _queue;
    
    public BackgroundJobQueue(int capacity = 10000)
    {
        var options = new BoundedChannelOptions(capacity)
        {
            FullMode = BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait
        };
        
        _queue = Channel.CreateBounded<IBackgroundJob>(options);
    }
    
    public async Task EnqueueAsync<TJob>(TJob job) where TJob : IBackgroundJob
    {
        await _queue.Writer.WriteAsync(job);
    }
    
    public async Task<IBackgroundJob> DequeueAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _queue.Reader.ReadAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

**Background Job Worker:**

```csharp
public class BackgroundJobWorker : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IBackgroundJobQueue _queue;
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<BackgroundJobWorker> _logger;
    
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Background Job Worker started");
        
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                var job = await _queue.DequeueAsync(stoppingToken);
                
                using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
                
                await ProcessJobAsync(job, scope.ServiceProvider);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing background job");
            }
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Background Job Worker stopped");
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessJobAsync(
        IBackgroundJob job,
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Processing job {JobType} - {JobId}",
                job.GetType().Name,
                job.Id);
            
            await job.ExecuteAsync(serviceProvider);
            
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Job {JobType} - {JobId} completed in {Duration}ms",
                job.GetType().Name,
                job.Id,
                stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            _logger.LogError(ex,
                "Job {JobType} - {JobId} failed after {Duration}ms",
                job.GetType().Name,
                job.Id,
                stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
            
            // Implement retry logic or dead letter queue
            await HandleJobFailureAsync(job, ex);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task HandleJobFailureAsync(
        IBackgroundJob job,
        Exception exception)
    {
        job.FailureCount++;
        
        if (job.FailureCount < job.MaxRetries)
        {
            // Re-queue with exponential backoff
            var delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, job.FailureCount));
            await Task.Delay(delay);
            await _queue.EnqueueAsync(job);
        }
        else
        {
            // Move to dead letter queue
            await _deadLetterQueue.EnqueueAsync(new DeadLetterJob
            {
                OriginalJob = job,
                Exception = exception,
                FailedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        }
    }
}
```

### 173.3 Scheduled Jobs

**Recurring Job Scheduler:**

```csharp
public class RecurringJobScheduler : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<RecurringJobScheduler> _logger;
    
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            // Schedule jobs based on time
            await ScheduleJobsAsync(now, stoppingToken);
            
            // Wait until next minute
            var nextMinute = now.AddMinutes(1)
                .AddSeconds(-now.Second)
                .AddMilliseconds(-now.Millisecond);
            
            var delay = nextMinute - DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            if (delay > TimeSpan.Zero)
            {
                await Task.Delay(delay, stoppingToken);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ScheduleJobsAsync(
        DateTime now,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var jobQueue = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IBackgroundJobQueue>();
        
        // Every minute: Check approval timeouts
        await jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new CheckApprovalTimeoutsJob
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            CheckTime = now
        });
        
        // Every 5 minutes: Recalculate project health
        if (now.Minute % 5 == 0)
        {
            await jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new RecalculateAllProjectHealthJob
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid()
            });
        }
        
        // Every 15 minutes: Process recurring tasks
        if (now.Minute % 15 == 0)
        {
            await jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new ProcessRecurringTasksJob
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                ProcessTime = now
            });
        }
        
        // Hourly: Archive old timeline entries
        if (now.Minute == 0)
        {
            await jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new ArchiveTimelineEntriesJob
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                ArchiveThreshold = now.AddDays(-90)
            });
        }
        
        // Daily at 2 AM: Database maintenance
        if (now.Hour == 2 && now.Minute == 0)
        {
            await jobQueue.EnqueueAsync(new DatabaseMaintenanceJob
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid()
            });
        }
    }
}
```

# **PART XXVIII - INFRASTRUCTURE & REPOSITORY PATTERNS**

---

## **Chapter 178 - Infrastructure Layer Architecture**

### 178.1 Infrastructure Layer Responsibilities

The infrastructure layer provides technical implementations that support the domain model without being part of domain logic itself.

**Core Responsibilities:**
- **Persistence** - Database access and ORM mappings
- **Repositories** - Data access abstractions for aggregates
- **Specifications** - Query composition and filtering
- **Caching** - Multi-layer caching strategies
- **Multi-Tenancy** - Tenant isolation enforcement
- **Background Workers** - Scheduled and queued tasks
- **Event Infrastructure** - Outbox/inbox patterns
- **Search Indexing** - Full-text and semantic search
- **File Storage** - Document and attachment management
- **Audit Logging** - Compliance and history tracking

**Architectural Principle:**
> Infrastructure depends on Domain. Domain never references Infrastructure.

### 178.2 Infrastructure Architecture Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Application ["Application Layer"]
        AppSvc[Application Services]
        Queries[Query Services]
    end
    
    subgraph Domain ["Domain Layer"]
        Agg[Aggregates]
        DomainSvc[Domain Services]
        Events[Domain Events]
    end
    
    subgraph Infrastructure ["Infrastructure Layer"]
        Repo[Repositories]
        Spec[Specifications]
        Cache[Caching Layer]
        Outbox[Event Outbox]
        Workers[Background Workers]
        Storage[File Storage]
        Search[Search Index]
        Audit[Audit Logger]
    end
    
    subgraph Persistence ["Persistence"]
        DB[(Primary Database)]
        ReadDB[(Read Replicas)]
        Redis[(Redis Cache)]
        Blob[(Blob Storage)]
        ES[(ElasticSearch)]
    end
    
    AppSvc --> Repo
    Queries --> Repo
    DomainSvc --> Repo
    
    Repo --> Spec
    Repo --> Cache
    Repo --> DB
    Queries --> ReadDB
    
    Events --> Outbox
    Outbox --> DB
    Workers --> Outbox
    
    Cache --> Redis
    Storage --> Blob
    Search --> ES
    Audit --> DB
```

## **Chapter 179 - Repository Pattern Implementation**

### 179.1 Repository Design Principles

**1. Aggregate Root Repositories Only**  
Repositories exist only for aggregate roots, not for entities within aggregates.

**2. Collection-Like Interface**  
Repositories present an in-memory collection abstraction.

**3. No Business Logic**  
Repositories contain zero business rules—only data access.

**4. Specification Support**  
Complex queries use the Specification pattern, not custom repository methods.

**5. Tenant Isolation**  
All repositories automatically filter by current tenant context.

### 179.2 Generic Repository Interface

```csharp
public interface IRepository<TAggregateRoot, TKey> 
    where TAggregateRoot : class, IAggregateRoot<TKey>
{
    // Basic CRUD
    Task<TAggregateRoot> GetAsync(TKey id, bool includeDetails = false);
    Task<TAggregateRoot> FindAsync(TKey id);
    Task<List<TAggregateRoot>> GetListAsync(bool includeDetails = false);
    
    // Specification-based queries
    Task<List<TAggregateRoot>> GetListAsync(
        ISpecification<TAggregateRoot> specification);
    Task<long> GetCountAsync(
        ISpecification<TAggregateRoot> specification);
    Task<TAggregateRoot> GetFirstOrDefaultAsync(
        ISpecification<TAggregateRoot> specification);
    
    // Modifications
    Task<TAggregateRoot> InsertAsync(
        TAggregateRoot entity, 
        bool autoSave = false);
    Task<TAggregateRoot> UpdateAsync(
        TAggregateRoot entity, 
        bool autoSave = false);
    Task DeleteAsync(
        TAggregateRoot entity, 
        bool autoSave = false);
    Task DeleteAsync(TKey id, bool autoSave = false);
    
    // Batch operations
    Task InsertManyAsync(
        IEnumerable<TAggregateRoot> entities, 
        bool autoSave = false);
    Task UpdateManyAsync(
        IEnumerable<TAggregateRoot> entities, 
        bool autoSave = false);
    Task DeleteManyAsync(
        IEnumerable<TAggregateRoot> entities, 
        bool autoSave = false);
}
```

```csharp
public class TaskInstanceRepository 
    : EfCoreRepository<TaskManagementDbContext, TaskInstance, Guid>, 
      ITaskInstanceRepository
{
    public TaskInstanceRepository(
        IDbContextProvider<TaskManagementDbContext> dbContextProvider)
        : base(dbContextProvider)
    {
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstance> GetWithAllDetailsAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var dbContext = await GetDbContextAsync();
        
        return await dbContext.TaskInstances
            .Include(t => t.Progress)
            .Include(t => t.Schedule)
            .Include(t => t.Assignment)
            .Include(t => t.Delegation)
            .Include(t => t.Blocking)
            .Include(t => t.Dependency)
                .ThenInclude(d => d.Dependencies)
            .Include(t => t.Discussion)
            .Include(t => t.Approval)
            .Include(t => t.TimeTracking)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(t => t.Id == id);
    }
    
    public async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetByProjectAsync(Guid projectId)
    {
        var dbContext = await GetDbContextAsync();
        
        return await dbContext.TaskInstances
            .Where(t => t.ProjectId == projectId)
            .OrderBy(t => t.CreatedAt)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
    
    public async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetOverdueTasksAsync()
    {
        var dbContext = await GetDbContextAsync();
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        return await dbContext.TaskInstances
            .Where(t => t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate < now)
            .Where(t => t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Done)
            .Where(t => t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Cancelled)
            .OrderBy(t => t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate)
            .ToListAsync();
    }
}
```
