## **Chapter 180 - Specification Pattern**

### 180.1 Specification Pattern Purpose

The Specification pattern allows complex business queries without polluting repositories with custom methods. It provides:

- **Composability** - Combine specifications with AND/OR logic
- **Reusability** - Share specifications across queries
- **Testability** - Unit test query logic independently
- **Expressiveness** - Readable, business-focused query definition

### 180.2 Specification Base Class

```csharp
public abstract class Specification<T>
{
    public IQueryable<T> Query { get; protected set; }
    
    protected Specification()
    {
        Query = new InMemoryQueryable<T>();
    }
    
    public virtual IQueryable<T> Apply(IQueryable<T> query)
    {
        return Query.Apply(query);
    }
    
    protected void AddCriteria(Expression<Func<T, bool>> criteria)
    {
        Query = Query.Where(criteria);
    }
    
    protected void AddInclude(Expression<Func<T, object>> include)
    {
        Query = Query.Include(include);
    }
    
    protected void AddOrderBy(Expression<Func<T, object>> orderBy)
    {
        Query = Query.OrderBy(orderBy);
    }
    
    protected void AddOrderByDescending(
        Expression<Func<T, object>> orderByDesc)
    {
        Query = Query.OrderByDescending(orderByDesc);
    }
    
    protected void ApplyPaging(int skip, int take)
    {
        Query = Query.Skip(skip).Take(take);
    }
}
```

### 180.3 Example Specifications

**Task Instance Specifications:**

```csharp
public class OverdueTasksSpecification : Specification<TaskInstance>
{
    public OverdueTasksSpecification(DateTime asOfDate)
    {
        AddCriteria(t => t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate < asOfDate);
        AddCriteria(t => t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Done);
        AddCriteria(t => t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Cancelled);
        AddOrderBy(t => t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate);
    }
}

public class TasksByAssigneeSpecification : Specification<TaskInstance>
{
    public TasksByAssigneeSpecification(
        Guid assigneeId, 
        bool includeCompleted = false)
    {
        AddCriteria(t => t.Assignment.AssigneeId == assigneeId);
        
        if (!includeCompleted)
        {
            AddCriteria(t => t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Done);
        }
        
        AddOrderByDescending(t => t.CreatedAt);
    }
}

public class BlockedTasksSpecification : Specification<TaskInstance>
{
    public BlockedTasksSpecification(Guid? projectId = null)
    {
        AddCriteria(t => t.Blocking.IsBlocked);
        
        if (projectId.HasValue)
        {
            AddCriteria(t => t.ProjectId == projectId.Value);
        }
        
        AddInclude(t => t.Blocking);
        AddInclude(t => t.Assignment);
        AddOrderBy(t => t.Blocking.BlockedAt);
    }
}

public class TasksRequiringApprovalSpecification 
    : Specification<TaskInstance>
{
    public TasksRequiringApprovalSpecification()
    {
        AddCriteria(t => t.Approval.RequiresApproval);
        AddCriteria(t => t.Approval.Status == ApprovalStatusEnum.Pending);
        AddInclude(t => t.Approval);
        AddInclude(t => t.Progress);
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class ActiveProjectsSpecification : Specification<Project>
{
    public ActiveProjectsSpecification(Guid? ownerId = null)
    {
        AddCriteria(p => p.Status == ProjectStatus.Active);
        AddCriteria(p => !p.IsArchived);
        
        if (ownerId.HasValue)
        {
            AddCriteria(p => p.OwnerId == ownerId.Value);

        AddOrderBy(p => p.DueDate);

                        p.Health == ProjectHealth.Critical);
```

### 180.4 Specification Composition

```csharp
public class CompositeSpecification<T> : Specification<T>
{
    public static Specification<T> And(
        Specification<T> left, 
        Specification<T> right)
    {
        var composite = new CompositeSpecification<T>();
        composite.Query = left.Query.Concat(right.Query);
        return composite;
    }
    
    public static Specification<T> Or(
        Specification<T> left, 
        Specification<T> right)
    {
        // Implementation for OR logic
        // This requires more complex expression tree manipulation
        throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

// Usage:
var myTasksSpec = new TasksByAssigneeSpecification(currentUserId);
var overdueSpec = new OverdueTasksSpecification(DateTime.UtcNow);
var myOverdueTasks = CompositeSpecification<TaskInstance>
    .And(myTasksSpec, overdueSpec);

var tasks = await _taskRepository.GetListAsync(myOverdueTasks);
```

### 180.5 Specification Usage in Repositories

```csharp
public async Task<List<T>> GetListAsync(ISpecification<T> specification)
{
    var dbContext = await GetDbContextAsync();
    var query = dbContext.Set<T>().AsQueryable();
    
    // Apply tenant filter
    query = ApplyTenantFilter(query);
    
    // Apply specification
    query = specification.Apply(query);
    
    return await query.ToListAsync();
}

public async Task<long> GetCountAsync(ISpecification<T> specification)
{
    var dbContext = await GetDbContextAsync();
    var query = dbContext.Set<T>().AsQueryable();
    
    query = ApplyTenantFilter(query);
    query = specification.Apply(query);
    
    return await query.LongCountAsync();
}
```

## **Chapter 181 - Event Outbox & Inbox Pattern**

### 181.1 Problem Statement

**Challenge:** Ensuring reliable event delivery across bounded contexts in a distributed system.

**Issues with Direct Event Publishing:**
- Events may be lost if message bus is down
- Database transaction may commit but event fails to publish
- No guarantee of exactly-once delivery
- Difficult to replay events for recovery

**Solution:** Transactional Outbox/Inbox Pattern

### 181.2 Outbox Pattern Architecture

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Agg as Aggregate
    participant Repo as Repository
    participant DB as Database
    participant Worker as Outbox Worker
    participant Bus as Event Bus
    participant Handler as Event Handler
    
    Agg->>Agg: Raise Domain Event
    Repo->>DB: Save Aggregate + Outbox Entry (Same Transaction)
    activate DB
    DB-->>Repo: Transaction Committed
    deactivate DB
    
    Worker->>DB: Poll for Unprocessed Events
    DB-->>Worker: Return Events
    Worker->>Bus: Publish Event
    Bus->>Handler: Deliver Event
    Handler-->>Bus: Acknowledgment
    Bus-->>Worker: Success
    Worker->>DB: Mark Event as Processed
```

### 181.3 Outbox Table Schema

```csharp
public class OutboxEvent
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string EventType { get; set; }
    public string EventData { get; set; } // JSON serialized
    public DateTime OccurredAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ProcessedAt { get; set; }
    public int ProcessAttempts { get; set; }
    public string LastError { get; set; }
    public DateTime? NextRetryAt { get; set; }
    
    // Metadata
    public string AggregateType { get; set; }
    public Guid AggregateId { get; set; }
    public int AggregateVersion { get; set; }
    public string CorrelationId { get; set; }
    public string CausationId { get; set; }
}
```

**Database Table:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE OutboxEvents (
    Id uniqueidentifier PRIMARY KEY,
    TenantId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    EventType nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,
    EventData nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    OccurredAt datetime2 NOT NULL,
    ProcessedAt datetime2 NULL,
    ProcessAttempts int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    LastError nvarchar(max) NULL,
    NextRetryAt datetime2 NULL,
    AggregateType nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,
    AggregateId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    AggregateVersion int NOT NULL,
    CorrelationId nvarchar(200) NULL,
    CausationId nvarchar(200) NULL,
    
    INDEX IX_OutboxEvents_ProcessedAt (ProcessedAt) 
        WHERE ProcessedAt IS NULL,
    INDEX IX_OutboxEvents_NextRetryAt (NextRetryAt) 
        WHERE ProcessedAt IS NULL,
    INDEX IX_OutboxEvents_TenantId (TenantId)
);
```

### 181.4 Outbox Worker Implementation

```csharp
public class OutboxEventProcessor : BackgroundService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<OutboxEventProcessor> _logger;
    private readonly TimeSpan _pollingInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
    
    public OutboxEventProcessor(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<OutboxEventProcessor> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
        CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                await ProcessPendingEventsAsync(stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing outbox events");
            }
            
            await Task.Delay(_pollingInterval, stoppingToken);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessPendingEventsAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var scope = _serviceProvider.CreateScope();
        var dbContext = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<WorkManagementDbContext>();
        var eventBus = scope.ServiceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IDistributedEventBus>();
        
        // Get unprocessed events
        var events = await dbContext.OutboxEvents
            .Where(e => e.ProcessedAt == null)
            .Where(e => e.NextRetryAt == null || 
                       e.NextRetryAt <= DateTime.UtcNow)
            .OrderBy(e => e.OccurredAt)
            .Take(100)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
        
        foreach (var outboxEvent in events)
        {
            await ProcessEventAsync(
                outboxEvent, 
                eventBus, 
                dbContext, 
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessEventAsync(
        OutboxEvent outboxEvent,
        IDistributedEventBus eventBus,
        WorkManagementDbContext dbContext,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            // Deserialize event
            var eventType = Type.GetType(outboxEvent.EventType);
            var @event = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(
                outboxEvent.EventData, 
                eventType);
            
            // Publish to event bus
            await eventBus.PublishAsync(@event);
            
            // Mark as processed
            outboxEvent.ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            await dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Successfully processed outbox event {EventId} of type {EventType}",
                outboxEvent.Id,
                outboxEvent.EventType);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Failed to process outbox event {EventId}",
                outboxEvent.Id);
            
            // Update retry information
            outboxEvent.ProcessAttempts++;
            outboxEvent.LastError = ex.Message;
            outboxEvent.NextRetryAt = CalculateNextRetry(
                outboxEvent.ProcessAttempts);
            
            await dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
        }
    }
    
    private DateTime CalculateNextRetry(int attemptNumber)
    {
        // Exponential backoff: 1min, 2min, 4min, 8min, 16min, max 1hr
        var delayMinutes = Math.Min(
            Math.Pow(2, attemptNumber - 1), 
            60);
        return DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(delayMinutes);
    }
}
```

### 181.5 Inbox Pattern for Idempotency

```csharp
public class InboxEvent
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid MessageId { get; set; } // Original event ID
    public string EventType { get; set; }
    public string HandlerName { get; set; }
    public DateTime ProcessedAt { get; set; }
    public string ProcessingResult { get; set; }
}
```

**Database Table:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE InboxEvents (
    Id uniqueidentifier PRIMARY KEY,
    MessageId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    EventType nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,
    HandlerName nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,
    ProcessedAt datetime2 NOT NULL,
    ProcessingResult nvarchar(50) NOT NULL,
    
    UNIQUE INDEX UX_InboxEvents_MessageId_Handler 
        (MessageId, HandlerName)
);
```

**Idempotent Event Handler:**
```csharp
public class TaskStatusChangedEventHandler 
    : IDistributedEventHandler<TaskStatusChangedEto>
{
    private readonly WorkManagementDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IProjectProgressUpdater _progressUpdater;
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(TaskStatusChangedEto eventData)
    {
        // Check if already processed
        var handlerName = this.GetType().FullName;
        var alreadyProcessed = await _dbContext.InboxEvents
            .AnyAsync(i => i.MessageId == eventData.Id && 
                          i.HandlerName == handlerName);
        
        if (alreadyProcessed)
        {
            // Event already processed, skip
            return;
        }
        
        try
        {
            // Process event
            await _progressUpdater.UpdateProjectProgressAsync(
                eventData.ProjectId);
            
            // Record as processed
            await _dbContext.InboxEvents.AddAsync(new InboxEvent
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                MessageId = eventData.Id,
                EventType = eventData.GetType().FullName,
                HandlerName = handlerName,
                ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                ProcessingResult = "Success"
            });
            
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Record failure
            await _dbContext.InboxEvents.AddAsync(new InboxEvent
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                MessageId = eventData.Id,
                EventType = eventData.GetType().FullName,
                HandlerName = handlerName,
                ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                ProcessingResult = $"Failed: {ex.Message}"
            });
            
            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync();
            throw; // Re-throw for retry logic
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 182 - Multi-Tenancy Infrastructure**

### 182.1 Multi-Tenancy Strategies

The platform supports multiple tenancy isolation strategies based on security, performance, and cost requirements:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Strategy{Choose Strategy}
    
    Strategy -->|Low Isolation| SharedDB[Shared Database<br/>Shared Schema]
    Strategy -->|Medium Isolation| SepSchema[Shared Database<br/>Separate Schema]
    Strategy -->|High Isolation| SepDB[Separate Database<br/>Per Tenant]
    Strategy -->|Maximum Isolation| DedCluster[Dedicated Cluster<br/>Per Tenant]
    
    SharedDB -->|Pros| SharedPros[Lowest cost<br/>Simplest management<br/>Best resource sharing]
    SharedDB -->|Cons| SharedCons[Lowest isolation<br/>Performance impact<br/>Data leak risk]
    
    SepSchema -->|Pros| SchemaPros[Better isolation<br/>Per-tenant backup<br/>Independent migration]
    SepSchema -->|Cons| SchemaCons[Schema management overhead<br/>Connection pooling complexity]
    
    SepDB -->|Pros| DBPros[Strong isolation<br/>Performance isolation<br/>Independent scaling]
    SepDB -->|Cons| DBCons[Higher cost<br/>Management overhead]
    
    DedCluster -->|Pros| ClusterPros[Maximum isolation<br/>Custom configuration<br/>Dedicated resources]
    DedCluster -->|Cons| ClusterCons[Highest cost<br/>Complex management]
```

### 182.2 Tenant Resolution

```csharp
public interface ITenantResolver
{
    Guid? CurrentTenantId { get; }
    Task<Guid?> ResolveFromContextAsync();
}

public class HttpTenantResolver : ITenantResolver
{
    private readonly IHttpContextAccessor _httpContextAccessor;
    private readonly ITenantRepository _tenantRepository;
    
    public Guid? CurrentTenantId { get; private set; }
    
    public async Task<Guid?> ResolveFromContextAsync()
    {
        var httpContext = _httpContextAccessor.HttpContext;
        
        // Try to resolve from JWT claims
        var tenantIdClaim = httpContext?.User
            .FindFirst("tenant_id")?.Value;
        
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantIdClaim, out var tenantId))
        {
            CurrentTenantId = tenantId;
            return tenantId;
        }
        
        // Try to resolve from subdomain
        var host = httpContext?.Request.Host.Value;
        if (host != null)
        {
            var subdomain = ExtractSubdomain(host);
            var tenant = await _tenantRepository
                .GetBySubdomainAsync(subdomain);
            
            if (tenant != null)
            {
                CurrentTenantId = tenant.Id;
                return tenant.Id;
            }
        }
        
        // Try to resolve from custom header
        var tenantHeader = httpContext?.Request
            .Headers["X-Tenant-Id"].FirstOrDefault();
        
        if (Guid.TryParse(tenantHeader, out var headerTenantId))
        {
            CurrentTenantId = headerTenantId;
            return headerTenantId;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
}
```

### 182.3 Tenant Filter in Repositories

```csharp
public abstract class TenantAwareRepository<T> 
    where T : class, ITenantEntity
{
    protected readonly ITenantResolver _tenantResolver;
    
    protected IQueryable<T> ApplyTenantFilter(IQueryable<T> query)
    {
        var tenantId = _tenantResolver.CurrentTenantId;
        
        if (tenantId.HasValue)
        {
            query = query.Where(e => e.TenantId == tenantId.Value);
        }
        else
        {
            // No tenant context - return empty
            query = query.Where(e => false);
        }
        
        return query;
    }
}
```

### 182.4 Tenant-Scoped Caching

```csharp
public class TenantScopedCache
{
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    private readonly ITenantResolver _tenantResolver;
    
    public async Task<T> GetOrCreateAsync<T>(
        string key,
        Func<Task<T>> factory,
        TimeSpan? expiration = null)
    {
        var scopedKey = GetTenantScopedKey(key);
        
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(scopedKey);
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(cached);
        }
        
        var value = await factory();
        var serialized = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
        
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            scopedKey,
            serialized,
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = 
                    expiration ?? TimeSpan.FromHours(1)
            });
        
        return value;
    }
    
    private string GetTenantScopedKey(string key)
    {
        var tenantId = _tenantResolver.CurrentTenantId;
        return $"tenant:{tenantId}:{key}";
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 183 - Caching Infrastructure**

### 183.1 Multi-Layer Cache Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    App[Application Layer]
    
    App --> L1{L1: In-Memory Cache}
    L1 -->|Hit| L1Return[Return Cached]
    L1 -->|Miss| L2{L2: Redis Cache}
    
    L2 -->|Hit| L2Return[Return & Cache L1]
    L2 -->|Miss| DB[(Database)]
    
    DB --> L2Update[Cache in L2]
    L2Update --> L1Update[Cache in L1]
    L1Update --> Return[Return to App]
    
    style L1 fill:#90EE90
    style L2 fill:#FFD700
    style DB fill:#87CEEB
```

### 183.2 Cache Strategy by Entity Type

| Entity Type | Cache Layer | TTL | Invalidation Strategy |
|-------------|-------------|-----|----------------------|
| Workflow Definition | L1 + L2 | 1 hour | On workflow publish |
| Workflow Version | L1 + L2 | 24 hours | On version activation |
| Workflow Transitions | L1 | 30 min | On workflow change |
| Task Blueprint Version | L2 | 6 hours | On blueprint publish |
| Custom Field Schema | L2 | 1 hour | On schema update |
| Task Type Metadata | L1 | 1 hour | On type modification |
| User Profile | L2 | 15 min | On profile update |
| Team Membership | L2 | 30 min | On membership change |
| Project Health Score | L2 | 5 min | On task/project update |
| Analytics Snapshots | L2 | 1 hour | On metric recalculation |

### 183.3 Distributed Cache Implementation

```csharp
public interface ICacheService
{
    Task<T> GetAsync<T>(string key);
    Task SetAsync<T>(string key, T value, TimeSpan? expiration = null);
    Task RemoveAsync(string key);
    Task RemoveByPatternAsync(string pattern);
}

public class RedisCacheService : ICacheService
{
    private readonly IConnectionMultiplexer _redis;
    private readonly ITenantResolver _tenantResolver;
    
    public async Task<T> GetAsync<T>(string key)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        var scopedKey = GetScopedKey(key);
        
        var value = await db.StringGetAsync(scopedKey);
        
        if (value.IsNullOrEmpty)
            return default;
        
        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(value);
    }
    
    public async Task SetAsync<T>(
        string key, 
        T value, 
        TimeSpan? expiration = null)
    {
        var db = _redis.GetDatabase();
        var scopedKey = GetScopedKey(key);
        var serialized = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
        
        await db.StringSetAsync(
            scopedKey,
            serialized,
            expiration ?? TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
    }
    
    public async Task RemoveByPatternAsync(string pattern)
    {
        var server = _redis.GetServer(
            _redis.GetEndPoints().First());
        var scopedPattern = GetScopedKey(pattern);
        
        await foreach (var key in server.KeysAsync(
            pattern: scopedPattern))
        {
            await _redis.GetDatabase().KeyDeleteAsync(key);
        }
    }
    
    private string GetScopedKey(string key)
    {
        var tenantId = _tenantResolver.CurrentTenantId;
        return $"wms:{tenantId}:{key}";
    }
}
```

### 183.4 Cache-Aside Pattern

```csharp
public class WorkflowVersionCachedRepository
{
    private readonly IWorkflowVersionRepository _repository;
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task<WorkflowVersion> GetActiveVersionAsync(
        Guid workflowId)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"workflow:version:active:{workflowId}";
        
        var cached = await _cache.GetAsync<WorkflowVersion>(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null)
            return cached;
        
        var version = await _repository.GetActiveVersionAsync(workflowId);
        
        if (version != null)
        {
            await _cache.SetAsync(
                cacheKey, 
                version, 
                TimeSpan.FromHours(24));
        }
        
        return version;
    }
}
```

### 183.5 Cache Invalidation Strategies

**Event-Based Invalidation:**
```csharp
public class WorkflowCacheInvalidator 
    : ILocalEventHandler<WorkflowPublishedEto>
{
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task HandleEventAsync(WorkflowPublishedEto eventData)
    {
        // Invalidate all workflow-related caches
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync(
            $"workflow:{eventData.WorkflowId}:*");
        
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync(
            $"workflow:version:active:{eventData.WorkflowId}");
        
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync(
            $"workflow:transitions:{eventData.WorkflowId}:*");
    }
}
```

**Time-Based Invalidation:**
Handled automatically by TTL settings in cache entries.

**Manual Invalidation:**
```csharp
public class CacheManagementService
{
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task InvalidateWorkflowCacheAsync(Guid workflowId)
    {
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync($"workflow:{workflowId}:*");
    }
    
    public async Task ClearAllCachesAsync()
    {
        await _cache.RemoveByPatternAsync("wms:*");
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 184 - Application Layer Architecture**

### 184.1 Application Layer Purpose

The Application Layer sits between the presentation layer (UI/API) and the domain layer, serving as the **coordination and orchestration hub** for business operations.

**Primary Responsibilities:**
- **Use Case Orchestration** - Coordinate multiple domain operations
- **Transaction Management** - Ensure consistency across aggregates
- **Authorization Enforcement** - Apply application-level security
- **DTO Transformation** - Convert domain models to view models
- **Cross-Context Coordination** - Manage interactions between bounded contexts
- **Event Publishing** - Emit integration events
- **Background Job Queuing** - Schedule asynchronous operations
- **Validation** - Input validation before domain invocation

**Key Principle:**
> Application services are thin coordinators. Business logic lives in the domain.

### 185.2 Task Application Service Implementation

```csharp
public class TaskInstanceAppService : ApplicationService, ITaskInstanceAppService
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly ITaskProcessingOrchestrator _taskOrchestrator;
    private readonly ITaskTransitionOrchestrator _transitionOrchestrator;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceFactory _taskFactory;
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly IAuthorizationService _authService;
    
    public TaskInstanceAppService(
        ITaskInstanceRepository taskRepository,
        ITaskProcessingOrchestrator taskOrchestrator,
        ITaskTransitionOrchestrator transitionOrchestrator,
        ITaskInstanceFactory taskFactory,
        IMapper mapper,
        IAuthorizationService authService)
    {
        _taskRepository = taskRepository;
        _taskOrchestrator = taskOrchestrator;
        _transitionOrchestrator = transitionOrchestrator;
        _taskFactory = taskFactory;
        _mapper = mapper;
        _authService = authService;
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstanceDto> CreateAsync(CreateTaskInstanceInput input)
    {
        // Authorization
        await _authService.CheckAsync("Tasks.Create");
        
        // Validation
        await ValidateCreateInputAsync(input);
        
        // Create task through factory
        var task = await _taskFactory.CreateAsync(
            input.ProjectId,
            input.TaskBlueprintId,
            input.Title,
            input.Description,
            input.AssigneeId,
            input.DueDate);
        
        // Save
        await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        // Publish event
        await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
            new TaskInstanceCreatedEto
            {
                TaskId = task.Id,
                ProjectId = task.ProjectId,
                Title = task.Title,
                CreatedBy = CurrentUser.Id.Value
            });
        
        return _mapper.Map<TaskInstanceDto>(task);
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstanceDto> StartAsync(Guid id)
    {
        // Get task
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(id);
        
        // Authorization
        await _authService.CheckTaskAccessAsync(
            task, 
            "Tasks.Start");
        
        // Orchestrate start operation
        var result = await _taskOrchestrator.StartTaskAsync(task);
        
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(result.ErrorMessage);
        }
        
        // Save changes
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        return _mapper.Map<TaskInstanceDto>(task);
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstanceDto> CompleteAsync(
        Guid id, 
        CompleteTaskInput input)
    {
        // Get task with all details
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetWithAllDetailsAsync(id);
        
        // Authorization
        await _authService.CheckTaskAccessAsync(
            task, 
            "Tasks.Complete");
        
        // Orchestrate completion
        var result = await _taskOrchestrator.CompleteTaskAsync(
            task,
            input.ResolutionCode,
            input.CompletionNotes,
            input.CustomFieldValues);
        
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(result.ErrorMessage);
        }
        
        // Save changes
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        return _mapper.Map<TaskInstanceDto>(task);
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstanceDto> AssignAsync(
        Guid id, 
        AssignTaskInput input)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(id);
        
        await _authService.CheckTaskAccessAsync(
            task, 
            "Tasks.Assign");
        
        // Domain operation
        task.Assignment.Assign(
            input.AssigneeId, 
            CurrentUser.Id.Value);
        
        // Add history
        task.History.AddEntry(
            TaskHistoryChangeType.Assigned,
            CurrentUser.Id.Value,
            $"Assigned to user {input.AssigneeId}");
        
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        // Publish event
        await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
            new TaskAssignedEto
            {
                TaskId = task.Id,
                AssigneeId = input.AssigneeId,
                AssignedBy = CurrentUser.Id.Value
            });
        
        return _mapper.Map<TaskInstanceDto>(task);
    }
    
    public async Task<TaskInstanceDto> DelegateAsync(
        Guid id, 
        DelegateTaskInput input)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(id);
        
        await _authService.CheckTaskAccessAsync(
            task, 
            "Tasks.Delegate");
        
        // Validate delegation is allowed
        if (!await CanDelegateAsync(task, input.DelegateToUserId))
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "DelegationNotAllowed",
                "Delegation to this user is not permitted");
        }
        
        // Domain operation
        task.Delegation.Delegate(
            CurrentUser.Id.Value,
            input.DelegateToUserId,
            input.Note);
        
        task.History.AddEntry(
            TaskHistoryChangeType.Delegated,
            CurrentUser.Id.Value,
            $"Delegated to user {input.DelegateToUserId}");
        
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        // Publish event and send notification
        await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
            new TaskDelegatedEto
            {
                TaskId = task.Id,
                DelegatedFrom = CurrentUser.Id.Value,
                DelegatedTo = input.DelegateToUserId,
                Note = input.Note
            });
        
        return _mapper.Map<TaskInstanceDto>(task);
    }
    
    private async Task ValidateCreateInputAsync(CreateTaskInstanceInput input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.Title))
        {
            throw new BusinessException("TaskTitleRequired");
        }
        
        if (input.Title.Length > 500)
        {
            throw new BusinessException("TaskTitleTooLong");
        }
        
        // Validate project exists
        var projectExists = await _projectRepository
            .AnyAsync(p => p.Id == input.ProjectId);
        
        if (!projectExists)
        {
            throw new BusinessException("ProjectNotFound");
        }
        
        // Additional validations...
    }
}
```

### 185.3 Task Start Flow with Orchestration

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant API as API Controller
    participant AppSvc as Task App Service
    participant Auth as Authorization
    participant Orch as Task Orchestrator
    participant DomSvc as Domain Services
    participant Task as Task Aggregate
    participant WF as Workflow Engine
    participant Events as Event Bus
    
    API->>AppSvc: StartAsync(taskId)
    AppSvc->>AppSvc: Get Task
    AppSvc->>Auth: Check Permissions
    Auth-->>AppSvc: Authorized
    
    AppSvc->>Orch: StartTaskAsync(task)
    Orch->>DomSvc: Validate Start Policies
    DomSvc-->>Orch: Validation Result
    
    alt Policies Pass
        Orch->>WF: Get Available Transitions
        WF-->>Orch: Start Transition
        Orch->>WF: Execute Transition
        WF->>Task: Update Status
        Task->>Task: Update Schedule
        Task->>Task: Add History
        WF-->>Orch: Success
        Orch-->>AppSvc: Success Result
        
        AppSvc->>Events: TaskStartedEto
        AppSvc-->>API: TaskDto
    else Policies Fail
        Orch-->>AppSvc: Failure Result
        AppSvc-->>API: BusinessException
    end
```

### 186.2 Workflow Publishing Flow

```csharp
public class WorkflowAppService : ApplicationService, IWorkflowAppService
{
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowVersionRepository _versionRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowValidator _workflowValidator;
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    
    public async Task<WorkflowVersionDto> PublishVersionAsync(
        Guid workflowId)
    {
        // Check permission
        await AuthorizationService.CheckAsync("Workflows.Publish");
        
        // Get workflow with all details
        var workflow = await _workflowRepository
            .GetWithDetailsAsync(workflowId);
        
        if (workflow == null)
        {
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(typeof(Workflow), workflowId);
        }
        
        // Validate before publishing
        var validationResult = await _workflowValidator
            .ValidateAsync(workflow);
        
        if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "WorkflowValidationFailed",
                string.Join(", ", validationResult.Errors));
        }
        
        // Create version
        var version = workflow.CreateVersion();
        await _versionRepository.InsertAsync(version, autoSave: true);
        
        // Invalidate cache
        await InvalidateWorkflowCacheAsync(workflowId);
        
        // Publish event
        await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
            new WorkflowVersionPublishedEto
            {
                WorkflowId = workflowId,
                VersionNumber = version.VersionNumber,
                PublishedBy = CurrentUser.Id.Value
            });
        
        return ObjectMapper.Map<WorkflowVersionDto>(version);
    }
    
    private async Task InvalidateWorkflowCacheAsync(Guid workflowId)
    {
        await _cache.RemoveAsync($"workflow:{workflowId}");
        await _cache.RemoveAsync($"workflow:version:active:{workflowId}");
        await _cache.RemoveAsync($"workflow:transitions:{workflowId}");
    }
}
```

### 187.2 Approval Decision Processing

```csharp
public class ApprovalAppService : ApplicationService, IApprovalAppService
{
    private readonly IApprovalRequestRepository _requestRepository;
    private readonly IApprovalWorkflowEngine _approvalEngine;
    private readonly INotificationService _notificationService;
    
    public async Task<ApprovalRequestDto> ApproveAsync(
        Guid requestId,
        ApproveInput input)
    {
        // Get request with details
        var request = await _requestRepository
            .GetWithDecisionsAsync(requestId);
        
        if (request == null)
        {
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(
                typeof(ApprovalRequest), 
                requestId);
        }
        
        // Check if user can approve current step
        var canApprove = await CanUserApproveStepAsync(
            request,
            CurrentUser.Id.Value);
        
        if (!canApprove)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "UserNotAuthorizedToApprove",
                "You are not authorized to approve this step");
        }
        
        // Process approval through engine
        var result = await _approvalEngine.ProcessDecisionAsync(
            request,
            new ApprovalDecision
            {
                ApproverId = CurrentUser.Id.Value,
                Action = ApprovalAction.Approve,
                Comments = input.Comments,
                DecidedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        
        // Save changes
        await _requestRepository.UpdateAsync(request, autoSave: true);
        
        // Send notifications
        if (result.IsStepCompleted)
        {
            await _notificationService.NotifyApprovalStepCompletedAsync(
                request,
                result.CompletedStepId);
        }
        
        if (result.IsWorkflowCompleted)
        {
            await _notificationService.NotifyApprovalCompletedAsync(
                request);
            
            // Publish integration event
            await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
                new ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto
                {
                    RequestId = request.Id,
                    EntityType = request.EntityType,
                    EntityId = request.EntityId,
                    FinalStatus = request.Status,
                    CompletedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
        }
        
        return ObjectMapper.Map<ApprovalRequestDto>(request);
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> CanUserApproveStepAsync(
        ApprovalRequest request,
        Guid userId)
    {
        if (request.CurrentStep == null)
            return false;
        
        var step = request.CurrentStep;
        
        // Check if user is directly listed
        if (step.UserApprovers.Contains(userId))
            return true;
        
        // Check if user has required role
        var userRoles = await GetUserRolesAsync(userId);
        if (step.RoleApprovers.Any(r => userRoles.Contains(r)))
            return true;
        
        // Check if user is in required team
        var userTeams = await GetUserTeamsAsync(userId);
        if (step.TeamApprovers.Any(t => userTeams.Contains(t)))
            return true;
        
        return false;
    }
}
```

### 187.3 Approval Processing Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as Approver
    participant API
    participant AppSvc as Approval App Service
    participant Auth as Authorization
    participant Engine as Approval Engine
    participant Request as ApprovalRequest
    participant Events as Event Bus
    participant Notify as Notification Service
    
    User->>API: Approve Request
    API->>AppSvc: ApproveAsync(requestId, input)
    AppSvc->>AppSvc: Get Request
    AppSvc->>Auth: Check Can Approve
    Auth-->>AppSvc: Authorized
    
    AppSvc->>Engine: ProcessDecisionAsync(request, decision)
    Engine->>Request: Add Decision
    Engine->>Engine: Evaluate Step Completion
    
    alt Step Completed
        Engine->>Request: Complete Current Step
        Engine->>Engine: Calculate Next Step
        
        alt More Steps
            Engine->>Request: Move to Next Step
            Engine-->>AppSvc: Step Completed
            AppSvc->>Notify: Notify Next Approvers
        else Workflow Complete
            Engine->>Request: Complete Workflow
            Engine-->>AppSvc: Workflow Completed
            AppSvc->>Events: ApprovalWorkflowCompletedEto
            AppSvc->>Notify: Notify Requester
        end
    else More Decisions Needed
        Engine-->>AppSvc: Decision Recorded
    end
    
    AppSvc->>AppSvc: Save Changes
    AppSvc-->>API: ApprovalRequestDto
    API-->>User: Success Response
```

### 188.2 Project Health Calculation

```csharp
public class ProjectAppService : ApplicationService, IProjectAppService
{
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private readonly IProjectHealthCalculationService _healthService;
    private readonly IProjectForecastingService _forecastService;
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    
    public async Task<ProjectHealthDto> GetHealthAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepository
            .GetWithDetailsAsync(id);
        
        if (project == null)
        {
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(typeof(Project), id);
        }
        
        // Calculate health through domain service
        var healthReport = await _healthService
            .CalculateHealthAsync(project);
        
        // Get additional metrics
        var tasks = await _taskRepository.GetByProjectAsync(id);
        
        var metrics = new ProjectHealthMetrics
        {
            TotalTasks = tasks.Count,
            CompletedTasks = tasks.Count(
                t => t.Progress.Category == WorkflowStatusCategory.Done),
            BlockedTasks = tasks.Count(t => t.Blocking.IsBlocked),
            OverdueTasks = tasks.Count(
                t => t.Schedule.IsOverdue() && 
                     t.Progress.Category != WorkflowStatusCategory.Done),
            AverageTaskAge = CalculateAverageTaskAge(tasks),
            VelocityTrend = await CalculateVelocityTrendAsync(id)
        };
        
        return new ProjectHealthDto
        {
            ProjectId = id,
            OverallHealth = healthReport.OverallHealth,
            RiskScore = healthReport.RiskScore,
            Metrics = metrics,
            Recommendations = healthReport.Recommendations,
            BlockingDependencies = healthReport.BlockedDependenciesCount,
            SuccessCriteriaCompletion = 
                healthReport.SuccessCriteriaCompletionPercentage
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<ProjectForecastDto> GetForecastAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var project = await _projectRepository
            .GetWithDetailsAsync(id);
        
        if (project == null)
        {
            throw new EntityNotFoundException(typeof(Project), id);
        }
        
        // Use forecasting service
        var forecast = await _forecastService
            .ForecastProjectCompletionAsync(project);
        
        return new ProjectForecastDto
        {
            ProjectId = id,
            ExpectedCompletionDate = forecast.ExpectedCompletionDate,
            ConfidenceLevel = forecast.Confidence,
            ProbabilityOfDelay = forecast.ProbabilityOfDelay,
            EstimatedOverrunDays = forecast.EstimatedOverrunDays,
            CriticalPathTasks = forecast.CriticalPathTaskIds,
            RiskFactors = forecast.RiskFactors,
            Recommendations = forecast.Recommendations
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 189 - Cross-Context Orchestrators**

### 189.1 Task Transition Orchestrator

The Task Transition Orchestrator is the **most complex orchestrator** in the system, coordinating workflow transitions, approval workflows, and task state updates.

```csharp
public interface ITaskTransitionOrchestrator
{
    Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid transitionId,
        TransitionContext context);
    
    Task<List<AvailableTransition>> GetAvailableTransitionsAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid userId);
}

public class TaskTransitionOrchestrator : ITaskTransitionOrchestrator
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowVersionRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowTransitionService _transitionService;
    private readonly IWorkflowConditionEvaluator _conditionEvaluator;
    private readonly IWorkflowActionExecutor _actionExecutor;
    private readonly IApprovalAppService _approvalService;
    private readonly ITransitionPermissionChecker _permissionChecker;
    private readonly IEventBus _eventBus;
    
    public async Task<TransitionResult> ExecuteTransitionAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid transitionId,
        TransitionContext context)
    {
        // 1. Load task with all details
        var task = await _taskRepository
            .GetWithAllDetailsAsync(taskId);
        
        if (task == null)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Failed(
                "TaskNotFound",
                "Task not found");
        }
        
        // 2. Load workflow version
        var workflowVersion = await _workflowRepository
            .GetAsync(task.WorkflowVersionId);
        
        // 3. Get transition
        var transition = workflowVersion.Transitions
            .FirstOrDefault(t => t.Id == transitionId);
        
        if (transition == null)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Failed(
                "TransitionNotFound",
                "Transition not found in workflow");
        }
        
        // 4. Check permissions
        var hasPermission = await _permissionChecker
            .CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(
                context.UserId,
                transition,
                task.ProjectId);
        
        if (!hasPermission)
        {
            await _eventBus.PublishAsync(
                new WorkflowTransitionDeniedEto
                {
                    TaskId = taskId,
                    TransitionId = transitionId,
                    Reason = "InsufficientPermissions",
                    UserId = context.UserId
                });
            
            return TransitionResult.Failed(
                "InsufficientPermissions",
                "You don't have permission to perform this transition");
        }
        
        // 5. Evaluate conditions
        var conditionsResult = await _conditionEvaluator
            .EvaluateAllAsync(transition.Conditions, task, context);
        
        if (!conditionsResult.AllConditionsMet)
        {
            await _eventBus.PublishAsync(
                new WorkflowTransitionDeniedEto
                {
                    TaskId = taskId,
                    TransitionId = transitionId,
                    Reason = "ConditionsNotMet",
                    FailedConditions = conditionsResult.FailedConditions
                });
            
            return TransitionResult.Failed(
                "ConditionsNotMet",
                $"Conditions not met: {string.Join(", ", conditionsResult.FailedConditions)}");
        }
        
        // 6. Validate required fields
        var validationResult = await ValidateRequiredFieldsAsync(
            transition,
            task,
            context);
        
        if (!validationResult.IsValid)
        {
            return TransitionResult.Failed(
                "RequiredFieldsMissing",
                string.Join(", ", validationResult.MissingFields));
        }
        
        // 7. Update task status (domain operation)
        var fromStatus = task.Progress.WorkflowStatusId;
        task.Progress.UpdateStatus(
            transition.ToStatusId,
            workflowVersion.Statuses.First(
                s => s.Id == transition.ToStatusId).Category);
        
        // 8. Add history entry
        task.History.AddEntry(
            TaskHistoryChangeType.StatusChanged,
            context.UserId,
            $"Status changed from {transition.FromStatusId} to {transition.ToStatusId} via transition {transition.Name}",
            new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["TransitionId"] = transitionId,
                ["TransitionName"] = transition.Name,
                ["FromStatusId"] = fromStatus,
                ["ToStatusId"] = transition.ToStatusId
            });
        
        // 9. Execute transition actions
        var actionResults = await _actionExecutor.ExecuteActionsAsync(
            transition.Actions,
            task,
            context);
        
        // Handle action-specific results
        foreach (var actionResult in actionResults)
        {
            if (actionResult.ActionType == WorkflowActionType.InitiateApproval)
            {
                // Start approval workflow
                var approvalWorkflowId = (Guid)actionResult.Result;
                await _approvalService.CreateRequestAsync(
                    new CreateApprovalRequestInput
                    {
                        WorkflowId = approvalWorkflowId,
                        EntityType = "Task",
                        EntityId = taskId,
                        RequestedBy = context.UserId
                    });
                
                // Block task until approval completes
                task.Blocking.Block("Pending approval");
            }
        }
        
        // 10. Save changes
        await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task, autoSave: true);
        
        // 11. Publish events
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(
            new WorkflowTransitionExecutedEto
            {
                TaskId = taskId,
                TransitionId = transitionId,
                FromStatusId = fromStatus,
                ToStatusId = transition.ToStatusId,
                ExecutedBy = context.UserId,
                ExecutedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            });
        
        await _eventBus.PublishAsync(
            new TaskStatusChangedEto
            {
                TaskId = taskId,
                ProjectId = task.ProjectId,
                OldStatusId = fromStatus,
                NewStatusId = transition.ToStatusId,
                ChangedBy = context.UserId
            });
        
        return TransitionResult.Success(
            task,
            actionResults);
    }
    
    public async Task<List<AvailableTransition>> GetAvailableTransitionsAsync(
        Guid taskId,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var task = await _taskRepository.GetAsync(taskId);
        var workflowVersion = await _workflowRepository
            .GetAsync(task.WorkflowVersionId);
        
        var currentStatusId = task.Progress.WorkflowStatusId;
        var transitions = workflowVersion.Transitions
            .Where(t => t.FromStatusId == currentStatusId)
            .ToList();
        
        var availableTransitions = new List<AvailableTransition>();
        
        foreach (var transition in transitions)
        {
            var hasPermission = await _permissionChecker
                .CanUserPerformTransitionAsync(
                    userId,
                    transition,
                    task.ProjectId);
            
            if (!hasPermission)
                continue;
            
            var context = new TransitionContext
            {
                UserId = userId,
                Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            
            var conditionsResult = await _conditionEvaluator
                .EvaluateAllAsync(transition.Conditions, task, context);
            
            availableTransitions.Add(new AvailableTransition
            {
                TransitionId = transition.Id,
                Name = transition.Name,
                ToStatusId = transition.ToStatusId,
                ToStatusName = workflowVersion.Statuses
                    .First(s => s.Id == transition.ToStatusId).Name,
                CanExecute = conditionsResult.AllConditionsMet,
                FailureReason = conditionsResult.AllConditionsMet 
                    ? null 
                    : string.Join(", ", conditionsResult.FailedConditions),
                RequiresComment = transition.RequiresComment,
                RequiresResolution = transition.RequiresResolution
            });
        }
        
        return availableTransitions;
    }
}
```

### 189.2 Transition Orchestration Flow

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Orch as Task Transition Orchestrator
    participant Task as Task Aggregate
    participant WF as Workflow Version
    participant Perm as Permission Checker
    participant Cond as Condition Evaluator
    participant Act as Action Executor
    participant Appr as Approval Service
    participant Events as Event Bus
    
    User->>Orch: ExecuteTransition(taskId, transitionId)
    Orch->>Task: Load Task
    Orch->>WF: Load Workflow Version
    Orch->>WF: Get Transition
    
    Orch->>Perm: Check Permissions
    alt No Permission
        Perm-->>Orch: Denied
        Orch->>Events: TransitionDeniedEto
        Orch-->>User: Permission Error
    end
    
    Orch->>Cond: Evaluate Conditions
    alt Conditions Fail
        Cond-->>Orch: Conditions Not Met
        Orch->>Events: TransitionDeniedEto
        Orch-->>User: Condition Error
    end
    
    Orch->>Task: Update Status
    Orch->>Task: Add History
    
    Orch->>Act: Execute Actions
    loop For Each Action
        Act->>Act: Execute Action
        alt Action = InitiateApproval
            Act->>Appr: Create Approval Request
            Act->>Task: Block Task
        end
    end
    
    Orch->>Task: Save Changes
    Orch->>Events: TransitionExecutedEto
    Orch->>Events: TaskStatusChangedEto
    Orch-->>User: Success Result
```

## **Chapter 190 - Query Services & CQRS**

### 190.1 CQRS Pattern Overview

The platform uses **Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS)** to separate read and write operations:

**Commands:**
- Modify state
- Go through domain model
- Enforce business rules
- Trigger events

**Queries:**
- Read-only operations
- Bypass domain model
- Use optimized read models
- No side effects

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Write Side
        Cmd[Commands] --> AppSvc[Application Service]
        AppSvc --> Domain[Domain Model]
        Domain --> WriteDB[(Write Database)]
        Domain --> Events[Domain Events]
    end
    
    subgraph Read Side
        Events --> Projector[Event Projector]
        Projector --> ReadDB[(Read Models)]
        Query[Queries] --> ReadDB
    end
    
    style WriteDB fill:#FFB6C1
    style ReadDB fill:#90EE90
```

```csharp
// Task board query implementation
public class TaskQueryService : ITaskQueryService
{
    private readonly IRepository<TaskBoardReadModel, Guid> _readModelRepo;
    
    public async Task<TaskBoardDto> GetTaskBoardAsync(
        TaskBoardQuery query)
    {
        var specification = new TaskBoardSpecification(
            query.ProjectId,
            query.StatusIds,
            query.AssigneeIds,
            query.IncludeCompleted);
        
        var tasks = await _readModelRepo.GetListAsync(specification);
        
        // Group by status
        var groupedTasks = tasks
            .GroupBy(t => new { t.StatusId, t.StatusName, t.StatusOrder })
            .OrderBy(g => g.Key.StatusOrder)
            .Select(g => new TaskBoardColumn
            {
                StatusId = g.Key.StatusId,
                StatusName = g.Key.StatusName,
                Tasks = g.Select(t => ObjectMapper.Map<TaskCardDto>(t))
                    .ToList()
            })
            .ToList();
        
        return new TaskBoardDto
        {
            ProjectId = query.ProjectId,
            Columns = groupedTasks,
            TotalTasks = tasks.Count
        };
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 191 - Background Workers & Scheduled Tasks**

### 191.1 Background Worker Architecture

Background workers handle asynchronous, scheduled, and long-running operations that should not block user requests.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Triggers ["Worker Triggers"]
        Sched[Scheduled/Cron]
        Queue[Message Queue]
        Event[Domain Events]
    end
    
    subgraph Workers ["Background Workers"]
        Recur[Recurrence Worker]
        Timeout[Timeout Worker]
        Index[Search Indexer]
        Notify[Notification Worker]
        Proj[Projection Builder]
        Forecast[Forecast Worker]
        Cleanup[Cleanup Worker]
    end
    
    subgraph Resources ["Resources"]
        DB[(Database)]
        Cache[(Cache)]
        ExtSys[External Systems]
        EventBus[Event Bus]
    end
    
    Sched --> Recur
    Sched --> Timeout
    Sched --> Forecast
    Sched --> Cleanup
    
    Queue --> Index
    Queue --> Notify
    
    Event --> Proj
    Event --> Index
    
    Recur --> DB
    Timeout --> DB
    Timeout --> EventBus
    Index --> ExtSys
    Notify --> ExtSys
    Proj --> Cache
    Forecast --> DB
    Cleanup --> DB
```

### 191.2 Base Worker Implementation

```csharp
public abstract class BackgroundWorkerBase : BackgroundService
{
    protected readonly IServiceProvider ServiceProvider;
    protected readonly ILogger Logger;
    protected readonly string WorkerName;
    
    protected BackgroundWorkerBase(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger logger,
        string workerName)
    {
        ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
        Logger = logger;
        WorkerName = workerName;
    }
    
    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
        CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "{WorkerName} is starting",
            WorkerName);
        
        while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            try
            {
                using var scope = ServiceProvider.CreateScope();
                
                await DoWorkAsync(scope.ServiceProvider, stoppingToken);
                
                await WaitForNextExecutionAsync(stoppingToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                Logger.LogInformation(
                    "{WorkerName} is stopping",
                    WorkerName);
                break;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "{WorkerName} encountered an error",
                    WorkerName);
                
                await HandleErrorAsync(ex, stoppingToken);
            }
        }
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "{WorkerName} has stopped",
            WorkerName);
    }
    
    protected abstract Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    
    protected abstract Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    
    protected virtual async Task HandleErrorAsync(
        Exception exception,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Default: wait 1 minute before retry
        await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1), cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

### 191.3 Recurring Task Worker

```csharp
public class RecurringTaskWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly TimeSpan _executionInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
    
    public RecurringTaskWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<RecurringTaskWorker> logger)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "RecurringTaskWorker")
    {
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var blueprintRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITaskBlueprintRepository>();
        var instanceRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITaskInstanceRepository>();
        var recurrenceService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITaskRecurrenceService>();
        var taskFactory = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITaskInstanceFactory>();
        
        // Get all active recurring blueprints
        var recurringBlueprints = await blueprintRepo
            .GetRecurringBlueprintsAsync();
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Processing {Count} recurring task blueprints",
            recurringBlueprints.Count);
        
        foreach (var blueprint in recurringBlueprints)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                await ProcessRecurringBlueprintAsync(
                    blueprint,
                    instanceRepo,
                    recurrenceService,
                    taskFactory);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error processing recurring blueprint {BlueprintId}",
                    blueprint.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task ProcessRecurringBlueprintAsync(
        TaskBlueprint blueprint,
        ITaskInstanceRepository instanceRepo,
        ITaskRecurrenceService recurrenceService,
        ITaskInstanceFactory taskFactory)
    {
        if (!blueprint.IsRecurring || blueprint.Recurrence == null)
            return;
        
        // Get last created instance for this blueprint
        var lastInstance = await instanceRepo
            .GetLastCreatedInstanceForBlueprintAsync(blueprint.Id);
        
        var lastCreatedDate = lastInstance?.CreatedAt 
            ?? blueprint.Recurrence.StartDate 
            ?? DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-1);
        
        // Calculate next occurrence
        var nextOccurrences = recurrenceService
            .CalculateNextOccurrences(
                blueprint.Recurrence,
                lastCreatedDate,
                DateTime.UtcNow);
        
        foreach (var occurrence in nextOccurrences)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Creating recurring task instance for blueprint {BlueprintId} at {Occurrence}",
                blueprint.Id,
                occurrence);
            
            // Create task instance
            var task = await taskFactory.CreateFromBlueprintAsync(
                blueprint,
                new CreateFromBlueprintOptions
                {
                    PlannedStartDate = occurrence,
                    DueDate = occurrence.Add(
                        TimeSpan.FromMinutes(blueprint.EstimateMinutes ?? 0)),
                    IsRecurringInstance = true
                });
            
            await instanceRepo.InsertAsync(task);
            
            // Publish event
            await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
                new RecurringTaskGeneratedEto
                {
                    BlueprintId = blueprint.Id,
                    TaskInstanceId = task.Id,
                    OccurrenceDate = occurrence,
                    GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
        }
    }
    
    protected override async Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await Task.Delay(_executionInterval, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

### 191.4 Approval Timeout Worker

```csharp
public class ApprovalTimeoutWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly TimeSpan _executionInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2);
    
    public ApprovalTimeoutWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<ApprovalTimeoutWorker> logger)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "ApprovalTimeoutWorker")
    {
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var requestRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IApprovalRequestRepository>();
        var workflowRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IApprovalWorkflowVersionRepository>();
        var escalationService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IApprovalEscalationService>();
        var calendarService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IWorkingCalendarService>();
        
        // Get pending approval requests
        var pendingRequests = await requestRepo
            .GetPendingRequestsAsync();
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Checking {Count} pending approval requests for timeouts",
            pendingRequests.Count);
        
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var timedOutCount = 0;
        
        foreach (var request in pendingRequests)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                if (request.CurrentStep == null)
                    continue;
                
                // Get workflow to check timeout policy
                var workflow = await workflowRepo
                    .GetAsync(request.WorkflowVersionId);
                
                var step = workflow.Steps
                    .FirstOrDefault(s => s.Id == request.CurrentStepId);
                
                if (step?.TimeoutPolicy == null)
                    continue;
                
                // Calculate deadline using working calendar
                var calendar = await calendarService
                    .GetCalendarForRequestAsync(request);
                
                var stepStartTime = request.CurrentStepStartedAt 
                    ?? request.CreatedAt;
                
                var deadline = calendar.AddBusinessHours(
                    stepStartTime,
                    step.TimeoutPolicy.HoursUntilTimeout);
                
                if (now > deadline)
                {
                    Logger.LogWarning(
                        "Approval request {RequestId} step {StepId} has timed out",
                        request.Id,
                        step.Id);
                    
                    // Execute timeout policy
                    await escalationService.ExecuteTimeoutPolicyAsync(
                        request,
                        step);
                    
                    timedOutCount++;
                    
                    // Publish event
                    await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
                        new ApprovalStepTimedOutEto
                        {
                            RequestId = request.Id,
                            StepId = step.Id,
                            TimeoutAction = step.TimeoutPolicy.TimeoutAction,
                            TimedOutAt = now
                        });
                }
                else if (now > deadline.AddHours(-2))
                {
                    // Warning: approaching timeout
                    await escalationService.SendTimeoutWarningAsync(
                        request,
                        step,
                        deadline);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error processing timeout for approval request {RequestId}",
                    request.Id);
            }
        }
        
        if (timedOutCount > 0)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "Processed {Count} timed out approval steps",
                timedOutCount);
        }
    }
    
    protected override async Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await Task.Delay(_executionInterval, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

### 191.5 Search Indexing Worker

```csharp
public class SearchIndexWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly IBlockingCollection<IndexOperation> _indexQueue;
    
    public SearchIndexWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<SearchIndexWorker> logger,
        IBlockingCollection<IndexOperation> indexQueue)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "SearchIndexWorker")
    {
        _indexQueue = indexQueue;
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var searchService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ISearchIndexService>();
        
        // Process items from queue
        while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            if (!_indexQueue.TryTake(
                out var operation, 
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5)))
            {
                continue;
            }
            
            try
            {
                switch (operation.OperationType)
                {
                    case IndexOperationType.Index:
                        await searchService.IndexDocumentAsync(
                            operation.EntityType,
                            operation.EntityId,
                            operation.Document);
                        break;
                    
                    case IndexOperationType.Update:
                        await searchService.UpdateDocumentAsync(
                            operation.EntityType,
                            operation.EntityId,
                            operation.Document);
                        break;
                    
                    case IndexOperationType.Delete:
                        await searchService.DeleteDocumentAsync(
                            operation.EntityType,
                            operation.EntityId);
                        break;
                }
                
                Logger.LogDebug(
                    "Processed index operation {OperationType} for {EntityType} {EntityId}",
                    operation.OperationType,
                    operation.EntityType,
                    operation.EntityId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error processing index operation for {EntityType} {EntityId}",
                    operation.EntityType,
                    operation.EntityId);
                
                // Optionally re-queue for retry
                if (operation.RetryCount < 3)
                {
                    operation.RetryCount++;
                    _indexQueue.Add(operation);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    protected override Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // This worker runs continuously processing the queue
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}
```

### 191.6 Project Forecasting Worker

```csharp
public class ProjectForecastingWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly TimeSpan _executionInterval = TimeSpan.FromHours(1);
    
    public ProjectForecastingWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<ProjectForecastingWorker> logger)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "ProjectForecastingWorker")
    {
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var projectRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IProjectRepository>();
        var forecastService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IProjectForecastingService>();
        var cacheService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ICacheService>();
        
        // Get active projects
        var activeProjects = await projectRepo
            .GetActiveProjectsAsync();
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Updating forecasts for {Count} active projects",
            activeProjects.Count);
        
        foreach (var project in activeProjects)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                // Calculate forecast
                var forecast = await forecastService
                    .ForecastProjectCompletionAsync(project);
                
                // Cache forecast result
                await cacheService.SetAsync(
                    $"project:forecast:{project.Id}",
                    forecast,
                    TimeSpan.FromHours(6));
                
                // Update project risk score
                project.RiskScore = forecast.RiskScore;
                await projectRepo.UpdateAsync(project);
                
                Logger.LogDebug(
                    "Updated forecast for project {ProjectId}: Expected completion {Date}, Confidence {Confidence}",
                    project.Id,
                    forecast.ExpectedCompletionDate,
                    forecast.Confidence);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error forecasting project {ProjectId}",
                    project.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    protected override async Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await Task.Delay(_executionInterval, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

### 191.7 SLA Monitoring Worker

```csharp
public class SLAMonitoringWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly TimeSpan _executionInterval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5);
    
    public SLAMonitoringWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<SLAMonitoringWorker> logger)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "SLAMonitoringWorker")
    {
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var taskRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITaskInstanceRepository>();
        var slaService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ISLATrackingService>();
        var notificationService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<INotificationService>();
        
        // Get tasks with SLA policies
        var tasksWithSLA = await taskRepo
            .GetTasksWithSLAPoliciesAsync();
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Monitoring {Count} tasks with SLA policies",
            tasksWithSLA.Count);
        
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var warningCount = 0;
        var breachedCount = 0;
        
        foreach (var task in tasksWithSLA)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                var slaStatus = await slaService
                    .CalculateSLAStatusAsync(task, now);
                
                if (slaStatus.IsBreached)
                {
                    // SLA breached
                    breachedCount++;
                    
                    await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
                        new SLOBreachedEto
                        {
                            TaskId = task.Id,
                            SLOType = slaStatus.SLOType,
                            TargetDuration = slaStatus.Target,
                            ActualDuration = slaStatus.Actual,
                            BreachedAt = now
                        });
                    
                    // Execute escalation
                    await slaService.ExecuteSLABreachEscalationAsync(task);
                }
                else if (slaStatus.PercentageConsumed >= 70 
                         && !slaStatus.WarningIssued)
                {
                    // SLA warning (70% consumed)
                    warningCount++;
                    
                    await LocalEventBus.PublishAsync(
                        new SLOWarningEto
                        {
                            TaskId = task.Id,
                            SLOType = slaStatus.SLOType,
                            PercentageConsumed = slaStatus.PercentageConsumed,
                            TimeRemaining = slaStatus.TimeRemaining
                        });
                    
                    await notificationService.NotifySLAWarningAsync(
                        task,
                        slaStatus);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error monitoring SLA for task {TaskId}",
                    task.Id);
            }
        }
        
        if (warningCount > 0 || breachedCount > 0)
        {
            Logger.LogInformation(
                "SLA monitoring: {WarningCount} warnings, {BreachedCount} breaches",
                warningCount,
                breachedCount);
        }
    }
    
    protected override async Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await Task.Delay(_executionInterval, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

### 191.8 Data Cleanup Worker

```csharp
public class DataCleanupWorker : BackgroundWorkerBase
{
    private readonly TimeSpan _executionInterval = TimeSpan.FromHours(24);
    
    public DataCleanupWorker(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        ILogger<DataCleanupWorker> logger)
        : base(serviceProvider, logger, "DataCleanupWorker")
    {
    }
    
    protected override async Task DoWorkAsync(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var tenantRepo = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<ITenantRepository>();
        var retentionService = serviceProvider
            .GetRequiredService<IDataRetentionService>();
        
        var tenants = await tenantRepo.GetAllAsync();
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Running data cleanup for {Count} tenants",
            tenants.Count);
        
        foreach (var tenant in tenants)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                break;
            
            try
            {
                // Get retention policy for tenant
                var policy = tenant.Configuration.RetentionPolicy;
                
                // Clean up old tasks
                var tasksDeleted = await retentionService
                    .CleanupOldTasksAsync(
                        tenant.Id,
                        policy.TaskRetentionDays);
                
                // Clean up old audit logs
                var logsDeleted = await retentionService
                    .CleanupOldAuditLogsAsync(
                        tenant.Id,
                        policy.AuditLogRetentionDays);
                
                // Clean up old events from outbox
                var eventsDeleted = await retentionService
                    .CleanupProcessedOutboxEventsAsync(
                        tenant.Id,
                        policy.OutboxRetentionDays);
                
                // Archive completed projects
                var projectsArchived = await retentionService
                    .ArchiveOldProjectsAsync(
                        tenant.Id,
                        policy.ProjectArchiveAfterDays);
                
                Logger.LogInformation(
                    "Cleanup for tenant {TenantId}: Tasks={Tasks}, Logs={Logs}, Events={Events}, Projects={Projects}",
                    tenant.Id,
                    tasksDeleted,
                    logsDeleted,
                    eventsDeleted,
                    projectsArchived);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error cleaning up data for tenant {TenantId}",
                    tenant.Id);
            }
        }
    }
    
    protected override async Task WaitForNextExecutionAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        // Run once per day at 2 AM
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var next2AM = now.Date.AddDays(1).AddHours(2);
        var delay = next2AM - now;
        
        if (delay < TimeSpan.Zero)
        {
            delay = TimeSpan.FromHours(24) + delay;
        }
        
        Logger.LogInformation(
            "Next cleanup scheduled in {Hours} hours",
            delay.TotalHours);
        
        await Task.Delay(delay, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```
