```csharp
public static class BackgroundWorkerExtensions
{
    public static IServiceCollection AddBackgroundWorkers(
        this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Register workers as hosted services
        services.AddHostedService<RecurringTaskWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<ApprovalTimeoutWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<SearchIndexWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<ProjectForecastingWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<SLAMonitoringWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<DataCleanupWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<NotificationDispatchWorker>();
        services.AddHostedService<OutboxEventProcessor>();
        
        // Register blocking collection for search indexing
        services.AddSingleton<IBlockingCollection<IndexOperation>>(
            new BlockingCollection<IndexOperation>(
                boundedCapacity: 10000));
        
        return services;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 192 - DTO Mapping & Data Transfer**

### 192.1 DTO Design Principles

**DTOs (Data Transfer Objects)** serve as the contract between the application layer and presentation layer.

**Key Principles:**
1. **Never expose domain objects directly**
2. **DTOs are flat, simple, serializable structures**
3. **One DTO per use case** (create, update, list, detail)
4. **Include only what the client needs**
5. **Use primitive types when possible**
6. **Version DTOs for API stability**

### 192.2 DTO Categories

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph Input DTOs
        Create[Create Input]
        Update[Update Input]
        Filter[Filter/Query Input]
    end
    
    subgraph Output DTOs
        List[List Item DTO]
        Detail[Detail DTO]
        Summary[Summary DTO]
    end
    
    subgraph Specialized
        Board[Board View DTO]
        Chart[Chart Data DTO]
        Export[Export DTO]
    end
    
    Input --> AppSvc[Application Service]
    AppSvc --> Domain[Domain Model]
    Domain --> Mapper[AutoMapper]
    Mapper --> Output
    Mapper --> Specialized
```

### 192.4 AutoMapper Configuration

```csharp
public class TaskMappingProfile : Profile
{
    public TaskMappingProfile()
    {
        // TaskInstance -> TaskListItemDto
        CreateMap<TaskInstance, TaskListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.StatusId,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Progress.WorkflowStatusId))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.StatusName,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Progress.StatusName))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.StatusColor,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Progress.StatusColor))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.StatusCategory,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Progress.Category))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.AssigneeId,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Assignment.AssigneeId))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.DueDate,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.PlannedDueDate))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.IsOverdue,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.IsOverdue()))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.IsBlocked,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Blocking.IsBlocked))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.BlockedReason,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Blocking.Reason))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.CommentCount,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Discussion.CommentsCount))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.AttachmentCount,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Discussion.AttachmentsCount))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.SubtaskCount,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Hierarchy.SubtaskCount))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.CompletedSubtasks,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Hierarchy.CompletedSubtasks))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.Progress,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Progress.Percent));
        
        // TaskInstance -> TaskDetailDto
        CreateMap<TaskInstance, TaskDetailDto>()
            .IncludeBase<TaskInstance, TaskListItemDto>()
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.Description,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Description))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.PlannedStartDate,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.PlannedStart))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.ActualStartDate,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.ActualStart))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.CompletedAt,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.CompletedAt))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.IsDelegated,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => 
                    src.Delegation != null && 
                    src.Delegation.Status == DelegationStatus.Accepted))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.EstimatedMinutes,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.EstimateMinutes ?? 0))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.ActualMinutes,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.TimeTracking.ActualMinutes))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.RequiresApproval,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Approval.RequiresApproval))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.ApprovalRequestId,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Approval.ApprovalRequestId))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.ApprovalStatus,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Approval.Status));
        
        // TaskInstance -> TaskCardDto (for board view)
        CreateMap<TaskInstance, TaskCardDto>()
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.DueDate,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.PlannedDueDate))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.IsOverdue,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Schedule.IsOverdue()))
            .ForMember(
                dest => dest.IsBlocked,
                opt => opt.MapFrom(src => src.Blocking.IsBlocked));
    }
}
```

### 192.5 Manual Mapping for Complex Scenarios

```csharp
public class TaskDtoMapper
{
    private readonly IMapper _mapper;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowVersionRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly ITaskTransitionOrchestrator _transitionOrchestrator;
    
    public async Task<TaskDetailDto> MapToDetailDtoAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        Guid currentUserId)
    {
        // Use AutoMapper for base mapping
        var dto = _mapper.Map<TaskDetailDto>(task);
        
        // Manually enrich with additional data
        
        // Project details
        var project = await _projectRepository.GetAsync(task.ProjectId);
        dto.ProjectName = project.Title;
        
        // Assignee details
        if (task.Assignment.AssigneeId.HasValue)
        {
            var assignee = await _userRepository
                .GetAsync(task.Assignment.AssigneeId.Value);
            dto.AssigneeName = assignee.DisplayName;
            dto.AssigneeEmail = assignee.Email;
            dto.AssigneeAvatar = assignee.AvatarUrl;
        }
        
        // Watchers
        var watchers = await _userRepository
            .GetByIdsAsync(task.Discussion.Watchers);
        dto.Watchers = _mapper.Map<List<UserDto>>(watchers);
        
        // Dependencies
        if (task.Dependency?.Dependencies?.Any() == true)
        {
            var dependencyTasks = await _taskRepository
                .GetByIdsAsync(
                    task.Dependency.Dependencies
                        .Select(d => d.DependsOnTaskId));
            
            dto.Dependencies = dependencyTasks.Select(t => new TaskDependencyDto
            {
                TaskId = t.Id,
                TaskTitle = t.Title,
                TaskStatus = t.Progress.StatusName,
                DependencyType = task.Dependency.Dependencies
                    .First(d => d.DependsOnTaskId == t.Id).Type,
                IsBlocking = task.Dependency.Dependencies
                    .First(d => d.DependsOnTaskId == t.Id).IsBlocking
            }).ToList();
        }
        
        // Available transitions
        var transitions = await _transitionOrchestrator
            .GetAvailableTransitionsAsync(task.Id, currentUserId);
        dto.AvailableTransitions = _mapper
            .Map<List<AvailableTransitionDto>>(transitions);
        
        // Available actions based on permissions
        dto.AvailableActions = await DetermineAvailableActionsAsync(
            task,
            currentUserId);
        
        return dto;
    }
    
    private async Task<List<string>> DetermineAvailableActionsAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        Guid userId)
    {
        var actions = new List<string>();
        
        // Check permissions for each action
        if (await CanEditAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("edit");
        
        if (await CanAssignAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("assign");
        
        if (await CanDelegateAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("delegate");
        
        if (await CanBlockAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("block");
        
        if (await CanDeleteAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("delete");
        
        if (await CanCommentAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("comment");
        
        if (await CanAttachAsync(task, userId))
            actions.Add("attach");
        
        return actions;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 193 - Error Handling & Result Patterns**

### 193.1 Result Pattern Implementation

```csharp
public class Result
{
    public bool Success { get; protected set; }
    public string ErrorCode { get; protected set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; protected set; }
    public List<string> Errors { get; protected set; }
    
    protected Result(bool success, string errorCode = null, string errorMessage = null)
    {
        Success = success;
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
        ErrorMessage = errorMessage;
        Errors = new List<string>();
    }
    
    public static Result Ok() => new Result(true);
    
    public static Result Fail(string errorCode, string errorMessage)
        => new Result(false, errorCode, errorMessage);
    
    public static Result Fail(string errorCode, List<string> errors)
    {
        var result = new Result(false, errorCode, errors.FirstOrDefault());
        result.Errors = errors;
        return result;
    }
}

public class Result<T> : Result
{
    public T Value { get; private set; }
    
    private Result(T value) : base(true)
    {
        Value = value;
    }
    
    private Result(string errorCode, string errorMessage) 
        : base(false, errorCode, errorMessage)
    {
    }
    
    public static Result<T> Ok(T value) => new Result<T>(value);
    
    public new static Result<T> Fail(string errorCode, string errorMessage)
        => new Result<T>(errorCode, errorMessage);
}

// Usage in orchestrators
public class TransitionResult : Result<TaskInstance>
{
    public List<ActionExecutionResult> ActionResults { get; set; }
    
    public static TransitionResult Success(
        TaskInstance task,
        List<ActionExecutionResult> actionResults)
    {
        var result = Ok(task);
        result.ActionResults = actionResults ?? new List<ActionExecutionResult>();
        return result;
    }
    
    public new static TransitionResult Failed(string errorCode, string message)
    {
        return (TransitionResult)Fail(errorCode, message);
    }
}
```

### 193.2 Application Exception Hierarchy

```csharp
// Base application exception
public class WorkManagementException : Exception
{
    public string ErrorCode { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Details { get; set; }
    
    public WorkManagementException(
        string errorCode,
        string message,
        Exception innerException = null)
        : base(message, innerException)
    {
        ErrorCode = errorCode;
        Details = new Dictionary<string, object>();
    }
}

// Business rule violations
public class BusinessException : WorkManagementException
{
    public BusinessException(string errorCode, string message)
        : base(errorCode, message)
    {
    }
}

// Validation errors
public class ValidationException : WorkManagementException
{
    public List<ValidationError> ValidationErrors { get; set; }
    
    public ValidationException(List<ValidationError> errors)
        : base("ValidationFailed", "One or more validation errors occurred")
    {
        ValidationErrors = errors;
    }
}

// Authorization errors
public class UnauthorizedException : WorkManagementException
{
    public UnauthorizedException(string message = "Unauthorized access")
        : base("Unauthorized", message)
    {
    }
}

// Not found errors
public class EntityNotFoundException : WorkManagementException
{
    public EntityNotFoundException(Type entityType, object id)
        : base(
            "EntityNotFound",
            $"Entity of type {entityType.Name} with id {id} was not found")
    {
        Details["EntityType"] = entityType.Name;
        Details["EntityId"] = id;
    }
}

// Concurrency errors
public class ConcurrencyException : WorkManagementException
{
    public ConcurrencyException(string message = "The entity has been modified by another user")
        : base("ConcurrencyConflict", message)
    {
    }
}
```

### 193.3 Global Exception Handler

```csharp
public class GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware> _logger;
    
    public GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware(
        RequestDelegate next,
        ILogger<GlobalExceptionHandlerMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await HandleExceptionAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task HandleExceptionAsync(
        HttpContext context,
        Exception exception)
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        
        var response = new ErrorResponse
        {
            TraceId = context.TraceIdentifier,
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        switch (exception)
        {
            case ValidationException validationEx:
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest;
                response.ErrorCode = "ValidationFailed";
                response.Message = "Validation errors occurred";
                response.Errors = validationEx.ValidationErrors
                    .Select(e => new ErrorDetail
                    {
                        Field = e.PropertyName,
                        Message = e.ErrorMessage
                    })
                    .ToList();
                break;
            
            case BusinessException businessEx:
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest;
                response.ErrorCode = businessEx.ErrorCode;
                response.Message = businessEx.Message;
                response.Details = businessEx.Details;
                break;
            
            case UnauthorizedException unauthorizedEx:
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden;
                response.ErrorCode = "Unauthorized";
                response.Message = unauthorizedEx.Message;
                break;
            
            case EntityNotFoundException notFoundEx:
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status404NotFound;
                response.ErrorCode = "EntityNotFound";
                response.Message = notFoundEx.Message;
                response.Details = notFoundEx.Details;
                break;
            
            case ConcurrencyException concurrencyEx:
                context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status409Conflict;
                response.ErrorCode = "ConcurrencyConflict";
                response.Message = concurrencyEx.Message;
                break;
            
            default:
                _logger.LogError(
                    exception,
                    "Unhandled exception occurred");
                
                context.Response.StatusCode = 
                    StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
                response.ErrorCode = "InternalServerError";
                response.Message = "An unexpected error occurred";
                
                // Don't expose internal details in production
                if (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT") 
                    == "Development")
                {
                    response.Details = new Dictionary<string, object>
                    {
                        ["ExceptionType"] = exception.GetType().Name,
                        ["StackTrace"] = exception.StackTrace
                    };
                }
                break;
        }
        
        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }
}

public class ErrorResponse
{
    public string ErrorCode { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
    public string TraceId { get; set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }
    public List<ErrorDetail> Errors { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Details { get; set; }
}

public class ErrorDetail
{
    public string Field { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
}
```

## **Chapter 194 - Integration Architecture Overview**

### 194.1 Integration Philosophy

The platform follows **"Secure, Observable, Decoupled, Resilient" (SODR)** integration principles:

**1. Decoupled**  
External systems must not pollute the domain model. Use Anti-Corruption Layers (ACL).

**2. Observable**  
All external interactions emit events and are fully traced.

**3. Secure**  
OAuth 2.0, API keys, HMAC signatures, JWT verification at every integration point.

**4. Resilient**  
Circuit breakers, exponential backoff, dead-letter queues, fallback strategies.

**5. Extensible**  
New integrations added via plugin architecture without core modification.

### 194.2 Integration Architecture Layers

```mermaid

        AppSvc[Application Services]
        Orch[Orchestrators]
    end
    
    subgraph Integration ["Integration Layer"]
```

### 194.3 Integration Types

**Push Integrations (Outbound):**
- Webhooks to external systems
- Email notifications
- Slack/Teams messages
- Real-time status updates
- Event streaming

**Pull Integrations (Inbound):**
- Import from Jira/Azure DevOps
- Sync user directories (LDAP/AD)
- Fetch calendar events
- Poll external API status

**Bidirectional Sync:**
- Task ↔ Jira Issue synchronization
- Approval ↔ DocuSign workflow
- Calendar ↔ Task schedule
- Comments ↔ External discussions

**Automation Triggers:**
- HTTP request execution
- Script execution
- Workflow rule triggers
- Third-party API calls

## **Chapter 195 - Anti-Corruption Layer (ACL)**

### 195.1 ACL Purpose

The Anti-Corruption Layer protects the domain model from external schemas, ensuring:

- **Model Translation** - External models → Domain models
- **Data Validation** - Reject invalid external data
- **Conflict Detection** - Identify sync conflicts
- **Security Enforcement** - Validate and sanitize inputs
- **Schema Mapping** - Handle version differences

### 195.2 ACL Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    ExtSys[External System] -->|Raw Data| ACL[Anti-Corruption Layer]
    
    subgraph ACL
        Validate[Validate & Sanitize]
        Transform[Transform Schema]
        Map[Field Mapping]
        Enrich[Data Enrichment]
    end
    
    Validate --> Transform
    Transform --> Map
    Map --> Enrich
    
    Enrich -->|Clean Domain Model| Domain[Domain Layer]
    
    Domain -->|Domain Events| Reverse[Reverse ACL]
    Reverse -->|External Schema| ExtSys
    
    style ACL fill:#FFD700
```

### 195.3 ACL Base Interface

```csharp
public interface IAntiCorruptionLayer<TExternal, TDomain>
{
    // Inbound: External → Domain
    Task<Result<TDomain>> TransformToDomainAsync(
        TExternal externalModel,
        TransformationContext context);
    
    Task<Result<List<TDomain>>> TransformManyToDomainAsync(
        List<TExternal> externalModels,
        TransformationContext context);
    
    // Outbound: Domain → External
    Task<Result<TExternal>> TransformToExternalAsync(
        TDomain domainModel,
        TransformationContext context);
    
    // Validation
    Task<ValidationResult> ValidateExternalModelAsync(
        TExternal externalModel);
    
    // Conflict Detection
    Task<ConflictDetectionResult> DetectConflictsAsync(
        TExternal externalModel,
        TDomain existingDomain);
}

public class TransformationContext
{
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public Guid? UserId { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; }
    public bool IsInitialImport { get; set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }
}

public class ConflictDetectionResult
{
    public bool HasConflict { get; set; }
    public List<ConflictDetail> Conflicts { get; set; }
    public ConflictResolutionStrategy RecommendedStrategy { get; set; }
}

public class ConflictDetail
{
    public string PropertyName { get; set; }
    public object ExternalValue { get; set; }
    public object DomainValue { get; set; }
    public DateTime? ExternalLastModified { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DomainLastModified { get; set; }
}

public enum ConflictResolutionStrategy
{
    UseExternal,
    UseDomain,
    Manual,
    Merge
}
```

### 195.4 Jira ACL Implementation Example

```csharp
// External Jira models
public class JiraIssue
{
    public string Key { get; set; }
    public string Summary { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public JiraIssueType IssueType { get; set; }
    public JiraUser Assignee { get; set; }
    public JiraStatus Status { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    public int? StoryPoints { get; set; }
    public List<string> Labels { get; set; }
    public JiraPriority Priority { get; set; }
    public List<JiraComment> Comments { get; set; }
    public string ProjectKey { get; set; }
}

// ACL for Jira → Task
public class JiraTaskAntiCorruptionLayer 
    : IAntiCorruptionLayer<JiraIssue, TaskInstance>
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceFactory _taskFactory;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IProjectRepository _projectRepository;
    private readonly IWorkflowRepository _workflowRepository;
    private readonly ILogger<JiraTaskAntiCorruptionLayer> _logger;
    
    public async Task<Result<TaskInstance>> TransformToDomainAsync(
        JiraIssue jiraIssue,
        TransformationContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            // 1. Validate external model
            var validationResult = await ValidateExternalModelAsync(jiraIssue);
            if (!validationResult.IsValid)
            {
                return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail(
                    "ValidationFailed",
                    string.Join(", ", validationResult.Errors));
            }
            
            // 2. Map project
            var project = await MapJiraProjectToProjectAsync(
                jiraIssue.ProjectKey,
                context.TenantId);
            
            if (project == null)
            {
                return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail(
                    "ProjectNotFound",
                    $"Cannot find project mapping for Jira project {jiraIssue.ProjectKey}");
            }
            
            // 3. Map assignee
            Guid? assigneeId = null;
            if (jiraIssue.Assignee != null)
            {
                assigneeId = await MapJiraUserToUserAsync(
                    jiraIssue.Assignee,
                    context.TenantId);
            }
            
            // 4. Map status
            var statusId = await MapJiraStatusToWorkflowStatusAsync(
                jiraIssue.Status,
                project.Id);
            
            // 5. Transform data
            var task = await _taskFactory.CreateAsync(
                projectId: project.Id,
                taskBlueprintId: null,
                title: SanitizeTitle(jiraIssue.Summary),
                description: SanitizeDescription(jiraIssue.Description),
                assigneeId: assigneeId,
                dueDate: jiraIssue.DueDate);
            
            // 6. Map additional fields
            task.Progress.UpdateStatus(statusId, GetStatusCategory(jiraIssue.Status));
            
            if (jiraIssue.StoryPoints.HasValue)
            {
                task.EstimateMinutes = jiraIssue.StoryPoints.Value * 60; // 1 point = 1 hour
            }
            
            task.Tags = jiraIssue.Labels ?? new List<string>();
            
            // 7. Map priority
            (task.Importance, task.Urgency) = MapJiraPriorityToImportanceUrgency(
                jiraIssue.Priority);
            
            // 8. Store external reference
            task.SetExternalReference("Jira", jiraIssue.Key);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Successfully transformed Jira issue {JiraKey} to task {TaskId}",
                jiraIssue.Key,
                task.Id);
            
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Ok(task);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error transforming Jira issue {JiraKey}",
                jiraIssue.Key);
            
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail(
                "TransformationError",
                $"Failed to transform Jira issue: {ex.Message}");
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<ValidationResult> ValidateExternalModelAsync(
        JiraIssue jiraIssue)
    {
        var errors = new List<string>();
        
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jiraIssue.Key))
            errors.Add("Jira issue key is required");
        
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jiraIssue.Summary))
            errors.Add("Jira issue summary is required");
        
        if (jiraIssue.Summary?.Length > 500)
            errors.Add("Jira issue summary exceeds maximum length");
        
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(jiraIssue.ProjectKey))
            errors.Add("Jira project key is required");
        
        return new ValidationResult
        {
            IsValid = errors.Count == 0,
            Errors = errors
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<ConflictDetectionResult> DetectConflictsAsync(
        JiraIssue jiraIssue,
        TaskInstance existingTask)
    {
        var conflicts = new List<ConflictDetail>();
        
        // Check title conflict
        if (jiraIssue.Summary != existingTask.Title)
        {
            conflicts.Add(new ConflictDetail
            {
                PropertyName = "Title",
                ExternalValue = jiraIssue.Summary,
                DomainValue = existingTask.Title,
                ExternalLastModified = jiraIssue.Updated,
                DomainLastModified = existingTask.UpdatedAt
            });
        }
        
        // Check description conflict
        if (jiraIssue.Description != existingTask.Description)
        {
            conflicts.Add(new ConflictDetail
            {
                PropertyName = "Description",
                ExternalValue = jiraIssue.Description,
                DomainValue = existingTask.Description
            });
        }
        
        // Check assignee conflict
        var jiraAssigneeId = jiraIssue.Assignee != null
            ? await MapJiraUserToUserAsync(jiraIssue.Assignee, existingTask.TenantId)
            : null;
        
        if (jiraAssigneeId != existingTask.Assignment.AssigneeId)
        {
            conflicts.Add(new ConflictDetail
            {
                PropertyName = "Assignee",
                ExternalValue = jiraAssigneeId,
                DomainValue = existingTask.Assignment.AssigneeId
            });
        }
        
        // Determine resolution strategy
        var strategy = ConflictResolutionStrategy.UseDomain; // Default: keep our data
        
        if (conflicts.Any())
        {
            // If Jira was modified more recently, prefer external
            if (jiraIssue.Updated > existingTask.UpdatedAt)
            {
                strategy = ConflictResolutionStrategy.UseExternal;
            }
        }
        
        return new ConflictDetectionResult
        {
            HasConflict = conflicts.Any(),
            Conflicts = conflicts,
            RecommendedStrategy = strategy
        };
    }
    
    // Reverse transformation: Task → Jira
    public async Task<Result<JiraIssue>> TransformToExternalAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        TransformationContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            var jiraIssue = new JiraIssue
            {
                Summary = task.Title,
                Description = task.Description,
                DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
                Labels = task.Tags,
                StoryPoints = task.EstimateMinutes.HasValue 
                    ? task.EstimateMinutes.Value / 60 
                    : null
            };
            
            // Map assignee
            if (task.Assignment.AssigneeId.HasValue)
            {
                jiraIssue.Assignee = await MapUserToJiraUserAsync(
                    task.Assignment.AssigneeId.Value);
            }
            
            // Map status
            jiraIssue.Status = await MapWorkflowStatusToJiraStatusAsync(
                task.Progress.WorkflowStatusId);
            
            // Map priority
            jiraIssue.Priority = MapImportanceUrgencyToJiraPriority(
                task.Importance,
                task.Urgency);
            
            return Result<JiraIssue>.Ok(jiraIssue);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error transforming task {TaskId} to Jira issue",
                task.Id);
            
            return Result<JiraIssue>.Fail(
                "TransformationError",
                ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    // Helper methods
    private string SanitizeTitle(string title)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(title))
            return "Untitled";
        
        // Remove HTML tags
        title = Regex.Replace(title, "<.*?>", string.Empty);
        
        // Truncate if needed
        if (title.Length > 500)
            title = title.Substring(0, 497) + "...";
        
        return title.Trim();
    }
    
    private string SanitizeDescription(string description)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
            return null;
        
        // Convert Jira wiki markup to markdown (simplified)
        description = ConvertJiraMarkupToMarkdown(description);
        
        return description.Trim();
    }
    
    private (double Importance, double Urgency) MapJiraPriorityToImportanceUrgency(
        JiraPriority priority)
    {
        return priority?.Name switch
        {
            "Highest" => (1.0, 1.0),
            "High" => (0.8, 0.8),
            "Medium" => (0.5, 0.5),
            "Low" => (0.3, 0.3),
            "Lowest" => (0.1, 0.1),
            _ => (0.5, 0.5)
        };
    }
}
```

### 196.2 Slack Integration Adapter

```csharp
public class SlackAdapter : IIntegrationAdapter
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<SlackAdapter> _logger;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    
    public string Name => "Slack";
    public string Version => "1.0";
    public bool IsEnabled => _configuration.GetValue<bool>("Integrations:Slack:Enabled");
    
    public async Task<Result> SendMessageAsync(
        string channel,
        string message,
        SlackMessageOptions options = null)
    {
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Slack");
            
            var payload = new
            {
                channel,
                text = message,
                username = options?.Username ?? "Work Management System",
                icon_emoji = options?.IconEmoji ?? ":clipboard:",
                attachments = options?.Attachments
            };
            
            var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
                "chat.postMessage",
                payload);
            
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                _logger.LogError(
                    "Failed to send Slack message. Status: {StatusCode}, Error: {Error}",
                    response.StatusCode,
                    error);
                
                return Result.Fail(
                    "SlackSendFailed",
                    $"Failed to send message to Slack: {error}");
            }
            
            return Result.Ok();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error sending Slack message");
            return Result.Fail("SlackError", ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<Result> SendRichMessageAsync(
        string channel,
        SlackBlock[] blocks,
        SlackMessageOptions options = null)
    {
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Slack");
            
            var payload = new
            {
                channel,
                blocks,
                username = options?.Username ?? "Work Management System",
                icon_emoji = options?.IconEmoji ?? ":clipboard:"
            };
            
            var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
                "chat.postMessage",
                payload);
            
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                return Result.Fail("SlackSendFailed", error);
            }
            
            return Result.Ok();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error sending rich Slack message");
            return Result.Fail("SlackError", ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> TestConnectionAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Slack");
            var response = await client.PostAsync("auth.test", null);
            return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<IntegrationHealth> GetHealthAsync()
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var isHealthy = await TestConnectionAsync();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        
        return new IntegrationHealth
        {
            IsHealthy = isHealthy,
            Status = isHealthy ? "Connected" : "Disconnected",
            LastChecked = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ResponseTime = stopwatch.Elapsed,
            ErrorMessage = isHealthy ? null : "Failed to connect to Slack API"
        };
    }
}
```

### 196.4 Jira Integration Adapter

```csharp
public class JiraAdapter : IIntegrationAdapter<TaskInstance>
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly JiraTaskAntiCorruptionLayer _acl;
    private readonly ILogger<JiraAdapter> _logger;
    
    public string Name => "Jira";
    public string Version => "1.0";
    public bool IsEnabled { get; set; }
    
    public async Task<Result<TaskInstance>> PushAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        IntegrationContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            // Transform to Jira model
            var transformResult = await _acl.TransformToExternalAsync(
                task,
                new TransformationContext
                {
                    TenantId = context.TenantId,
                    UserId = context.UserId
                });
            
            if (!transformResult.Success)
            {
                return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail(
                    transformResult.ErrorCode,
                    transformResult.ErrorMessage);
            }
            
            var jiraIssue = transformResult.Value;
            
            // Check if task already exists in Jira
            var externalRef = task.GetExternalReference("Jira");
            
            if (externalRef != null)
            {
                // Update existing issue
                return await UpdateJiraIssueAsync(
                    externalRef.ExternalId,
                    jiraIssue,
                    context);
            }
            else
            {
                // Create new issue
                return await CreateJiraIssueAsync(
                    jiraIssue,
                    task,
                    context);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error pushing task {TaskId} to Jira", task.Id);
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail("JiraPushError", ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<Result<TaskInstance>> CreateJiraIssueAsync(
        JiraIssue jiraIssue,
        TaskInstance task,
        IntegrationContext context)
    {
        var client = CreateAuthenticatedClient(context);
        
        var payload = new
        {
            fields = new
            {
                project = new { key = jiraIssue.ProjectKey },
                summary = jiraIssue.Summary,
                description = jiraIssue.Description,
                issuetype = new { name = jiraIssue.IssueType?.Name ?? "Task" },
                assignee = jiraIssue.Assignee != null 
                    ? new { accountId = jiraIssue.Assignee.AccountId } 
                    : null,
                duedate = jiraIssue.DueDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                labels = jiraIssue.Labels,
                priority = jiraIssue.Priority != null 
                    ? new { name = jiraIssue.Priority.Name } 
                    : null
            }
        };
        
        var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "rest/api/3/issue",
            payload);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            _logger.LogError(
                "Failed to create Jira issue. Status: {StatusCode}, Error: {Error}",
                response.StatusCode,
                error);
            
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail("JiraCreateFailed", error);
        }
        
        var createdIssue = await response.Content
            .ReadFromJsonAsync<JiraIssueCreateResponse>();
        
        // Store external reference
        task.SetExternalReference("Jira", createdIssue.Key);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Created Jira issue {JiraKey} for task {TaskId}",
            createdIssue.Key,
            task.Id);
        
        return Result<TaskInstance>.Ok(task);
    }
    
    private async Task<Result<TaskInstance>> UpdateJiraIssueAsync(
        string jiraKey,
        JiraIssue jiraIssue,
        IntegrationContext context)
    {
        var client = CreateAuthenticatedClient(context);
        
        var payload = new
        {
            fields = new
            {
                summary = jiraIssue.Summary,
                description = jiraIssue.Description,
                assignee = jiraIssue.Assignee != null 
                    ? new { accountId = jiraIssue.Assignee.AccountId } 
                    : null,
                duedate = jiraIssue.DueDate?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd"),
                labels = jiraIssue.Labels
            }
        };
        
        var response = await client.PutAsJsonAsync(
            $"rest/api/3/issue/{jiraKey}",
            payload);
        
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            var error = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail("JiraUpdateFailed", error);
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Updated Jira issue {JiraKey}",
            jiraKey);
        
        return Result<TaskInstance>.Ok(null); // Task unchanged
    }
    
    public async Task<Result<TaskInstance>> PullAsync(
        string jiraKey,
        IntegrationContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            var client = CreateAuthenticatedClient(context);
            
            var response = await client.GetAsync(
                $"rest/api/3/issue/{jiraKey}");
            
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail(
                    "JiraPullFailed",
                    $"Failed to fetch Jira issue {jiraKey}");
            }
            
            var jiraIssue = await response.Content
                .ReadFromJsonAsync<JiraIssue>();
            
            // Transform through ACL
            var transformResult = await _acl.TransformToDomainAsync(
                jiraIssue,
                new TransformationContext
                {
                    TenantId = context.TenantId,
                    UserId = context.UserId
                });
            
            return transformResult;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error pulling Jira issue {JiraKey}", jiraKey);
            return Result<TaskInstance>.Fail("JiraPullError", ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<Result<List<TaskInstance>>> PullManyAsync(
        PullCriteria criteria,
        IntegrationContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            var client = CreateAuthenticatedClient(context);
            
            // Build JQL query
            var jql = BuildJqlQuery(criteria);
            
            var response = await client.GetAsync(
                $"rest/api/3/search?jql={Uri.EscapeDataString(jql)}&maxResults=100");
            
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                return Result<List<TaskInstance>>.Fail(
                    "JiraSearchFailed",
                    "Failed to search Jira issues");
            }
            
            var searchResult = await response.Content
                .ReadFromJsonAsync<JiraSearchResponse>();
            
            var tasks = new List<TaskInstance>();
            
            foreach (var jiraIssue in searchResult.Issues)
            {
                var transformResult = await _acl.TransformToDomainAsync(
                    jiraIssue,
                    new TransformationContext
                    {
                        TenantId = context.TenantId,
                        UserId = context.UserId
                    });
                
                if (transformResult.Success)
                {
                    tasks.Add(transformResult.Value);
                }
            }
            
            return Result<List<TaskInstance>>.Ok(tasks);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error pulling multiple Jira issues");
            return Result<List<TaskInstance>>.Fail("JiraPullManyError", ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> TestConnectionAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Jira");
            var response = await client.GetAsync("rest/api/3/myself");
            return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<IntegrationHealth> GetHealthAsync()
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var isHealthy = await TestConnectionAsync();
        stopwatch.Stop();
        
        return new IntegrationHealth
        {
            IsHealthy = isHealthy,
            Status = isHealthy ? "Connected" : "Disconnected",
            LastChecked = DateTime.UtcNow,
            ResponseTime = stopwatch.Elapsed,
            ErrorMessage = isHealthy ? null : "Failed to connect to Jira API"
        };
    }
    
    private HttpClient CreateAuthenticatedClient(IntegrationContext context)
    {
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Jira");
        
        // Add authentication headers
        var email = context.Credentials["Email"];
        var apiToken = context.Credentials["ApiToken"];
        var authValue = Convert.ToBase64String(
            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes($"{email}:{apiToken}"));
        
        client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = 
            new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Basic", authValue);
        
        return client;
    }
    
    private string BuildJqlQuery(PullCriteria criteria)
    {
        var conditions = new List<string>();
        
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(criteria.ProjectKey))
        {
            conditions.Add($"project = {criteria.ProjectKey}");
        }
        
        if (criteria.UpdatedSince.HasValue)
        {
            conditions.Add(
                $"updated >= '{criteria.UpdatedSince.Value:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm}'");
        }
        
        if (criteria.StatusNames?.Any() == true)
        {
            var statuses = string.Join(", ", 
                criteria.StatusNames.Select(s => $"'{s}'"));
            conditions.Add($"status IN ({statuses})");
        }
        
        return string.Join(" AND ", conditions);
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 197 - Webhook Management**

### 197.1 Webhook Architecture

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph Outbound ["Outbound Webhooks"]
        Event[Domain Event] --> WM[Webhook Manager]
        WM --> Queue[Webhook Queue]
        Queue --> Worker[Webhook Worker]
        Worker --> Retry[Retry Handler]
        Retry --> ExtAPI[External API]
    end
    
    subgraph Inbound ["Inbound Webhooks"]
        ExtSys[External System] --> Endpoint[Webhook Endpoint]
        Endpoint --> Auth[Signature Verification]
        Auth --> ACL[Anti-Corruption Layer]
        ACL --> Handler[Event Handler]
    end
    
    Worker --> Log[(Delivery Log)]
    Endpoint --> Log
    
    style Queue fill:#FFD700
    style Auth fill:#FFB6C1
```

### 197.2 Outbound Webhook Manager

```csharp
public class WebhookManager
{
    private readonly IWebhookSubscriptionRepository _subscriptionRepo;
    private readonly IWebhookDeliveryLogRepository _deliveryLogRepo;
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<WebhookManager> _logger;
    
    public async Task<Result> DeliverWebhookAsync(
        string eventType,
        object payload,
        Guid tenantId)
    {
        // Get active subscriptions for this event type
        var subscriptions = await _subscriptionRepo
            .GetActiveSubscriptionsAsync(tenantId, eventType);
        
        if (!subscriptions.Any())
        {
            _logger.LogDebug(
                "No active webhook subscriptions for event {EventType}",
                eventType);
            return Result.Ok();
        }
        
        var tasks = subscriptions.Select(subscription =>
            DeliverToSubscriptionAsync(
                subscription,
                eventType,
                payload));
        
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
        
        return Result.Ok();
    }
    
    private async Task DeliverToSubscriptionAsync(
        WebhookSubscription subscription,
        string eventType,
        object payload)
    {
        var deliveryLog = new WebhookDeliveryLog
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            SubscriptionId = subscription.Id,
            EventType = eventType,
            Payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload),
            Url = subscription.Url,
            AttemptedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        try
        {
            var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Webhook");
            client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
            
            var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, subscription.Url);
            
            // Add signature for security
            var signature = GenerateSignature(
                payload,
                subscription.Secret);
            request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Signature", signature);
            request.Headers.Add("X-Event-Type", eventType);
            request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Id", subscription.Id.ToString());
            
            // Serialize payload
            request.Content = new StringContent(
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload),
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json");
            
            var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            deliveryLog.StatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode;
            deliveryLog.ResponseTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;
            deliveryLog.Success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
            
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
            {
                deliveryLog.ErrorMessage = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Webhook delivery failed for subscription {SubscriptionId}. Status: {StatusCode}",
                    subscription.Id,
                    response.StatusCode);
                
                // Schedule retry
                await ScheduleRetryAsync(subscription, deliveryLog);
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Webhook delivered successfully to {Url} in {ResponseTime}ms",
                    subscription.Url,
                    stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            deliveryLog.Success = false;
            deliveryLog.ErrorMessage = ex.Message;
            
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error delivering webhook to subscription {SubscriptionId}",
                subscription.Id);
            
            await ScheduleRetryAsync(subscription, deliveryLog);
        }
        finally
        {
            await _deliveryLogRepo.InsertAsync(deliveryLog);
        }
    }
    
    private string GenerateSignature(object payload, string secret)
    {
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
        var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret);
        var messageBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
        
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(keyBytes);
        var hashBytes = hmac.ComputeHash(messageBytes);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(hashBytes);
    }
    
    private async Task ScheduleRetryAsync(
        WebhookSubscription subscription,
        WebhookDeliveryLog failedDelivery)
    {
        if (failedDelivery.AttemptNumber >= subscription.MaxRetries)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Max retries reached for webhook subscription {SubscriptionId}",
                subscription.Id);
            
            // Optionally disable subscription
            if (subscription.AutoDisableOnFailure)
            {
                subscription.IsActive = false;
                await _subscriptionRepo.UpdateAsync(subscription);
            }
            
            return;
        }
        
        // Calculate retry delay with exponential backoff
        var delayMinutes = Math.Pow(2, failedDelivery.AttemptNumber);
        var retryAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(delayMinutes);
        
        // Queue for retry (implementation depends on job system)
        await QueueWebhookRetryAsync(
            subscription,
            failedDelivery,
            retryAt);
    }
}
```

### 197.3 Inbound Webhook Handler

```csharp
[ApiController]
[Route("api/webhooks")]
public class WebhookController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IWebhookAuthenticationService _authService;
    private readonly IWebhookEventDispatcher _eventDispatcher;
    private readonly ILogger<WebhookController> _logger;
    
    [HttpPost("jira")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> HandleJiraWebhook(
        [FromBody] JiraWebhookPayload payload)
    {
        // 1. Verify signature
        var signature = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature"].FirstOrDefault();
        if (!await _authService.VerifyJiraSignatureAsync(
            signature,
            payload))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Invalid Jira webhook signature");
            return Unauthorized();
        }
        
        // 2. Process based on event type
        try
        {
            switch (payload.WebhookEvent)
            {
                case "jira:issue_updated":
                    await _eventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(
                        new JiraIssueUpdatedEvent(payload));
                    break;
                
                case "jira:issue_created":
                    await _eventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(
                        new JiraIssueCreatedEvent(payload));
                    break;
                
                case "jira:issue_deleted":
                    await _eventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(
                        new JiraIssueDeletedEvent(payload));
                    break;
                
                default:
                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "Unhandled Jira webhook event: {EventType}",
                        payload.WebhookEvent);
                    break;
            }
            
            return Ok();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing Jira webhook");
            return StatusCode(500);
        }
    }
    
    [HttpPost("github")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> HandleGitHubWebhook(
        [FromBody] GitHubWebhookPayload payload)
    {
        // Verify GitHub signature
        var signature = Request.Headers["X-Hub-Signature-256"].FirstOrDefault();
        if (!await _authService.VerifyGitHubSignatureAsync(
            signature,
            payload))
        {
            return Unauthorized();
        }
        
        var eventType = Request.Headers["X-GitHub-Event"].FirstOrDefault();
        
        try
        {
            await _eventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(
                new GitHubWebhookEvent(eventType, payload));
            
            return Ok();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing GitHub webhook");
            return StatusCode(500);
        }
    }
    
    [HttpPost("generic/{integrationName}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> HandleGenericWebhook(
        string integrationName,
        [FromBody] JsonElement payload)
    {
        // Generic webhook handler for custom integrations
        try
        {
            await _eventDispatcher.DispatchAsync(
                new GenericWebhookEvent(integrationName, payload));
            
            return Ok();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error processing generic webhook for {IntegrationName}",
                integrationName);
            return StatusCode(500);
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 198 - Circuit Breakers & Resilience Patterns**

### 198.1 Resilience Strategy Overview

External system integrations require robust resilience patterns to handle failures gracefully:

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    Request[Integration Request] --> CB{Circuit Breaker}
    
    CB -->|Closed| Retry[Retry Policy]
    CB -->|Open| Fallback[Fallback Response]
    CB -->|Half-Open| Test[Test Request]
    
    Retry -->|Success| Success[Success Response]
    Retry -->|Failure| Backoff[Exponential Backoff]
    Backoff -->|Max Retries| OpenCircuit[Open Circuit]
    Backoff -->|Retry| Retry
    
    Test -->|Success| CloseCircuit[Close Circuit]
    Test -->|Failure| KeepOpen[Keep Open]
    
    OpenCircuit --> Fallback
    
    Success --> Monitor[Monitor Metrics]
    Fallback --> Monitor
    
    style CB fill:#FFD700
    style Fallback fill:#FFB6C1
    style Monitor fill:#90EE90
```

### 198.2 Circuit Breaker Implementation

```csharp
public interface ICircuitBreaker
{
    Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Func<Task<T>> operation,
        string operationName);
    
    CircuitState State { get; }
    CircuitBreakerMetrics GetMetrics();
    void Reset();
}

public enum CircuitState
{
    Closed,      // Normal operation
    Open,        // Failing, reject requests
    HalfOpen     // Testing recovery
}

public class CircuitBreaker : ICircuitBreaker
{
    private readonly CircuitBreakerOptions _options;
    private readonly ILogger<CircuitBreaker> _logger;
    private readonly object _lock = new object();
    
    private CircuitState _state = CircuitState.Closed;
    private int _failureCount = 0;
    private DateTime? _lastFailureTime;
    private DateTime? _circuitOpenedAt;
    
    public CircuitState State => _state;
    
    public CircuitBreaker(
        CircuitBreakerOptions options,
        ILogger<CircuitBreaker> logger)
    {
        _options = options;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Func<Task<T>> operation,
        string operationName)
    {
        // Check circuit state
        lock (_lock)
        {
            if (_state == CircuitState.Open)
            {
                // Check if we should attempt recovery
                if (DateTime.UtcNow - _circuitOpenedAt >= _options.BreakDuration)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} entering half-open state",
                        operationName);
                    _state = CircuitState.HalfOpen;
                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} is open, rejecting request",
                        operationName);
                    throw new CircuitBreakerOpenException(
                        $"Circuit breaker is open for {operationName}");
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Execute operation
        try
        {
            var result = await operation();
            
            // Success - reset failure count
            lock (_lock)
            {
                if (_state == CircuitState.HalfOpen)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} closing after successful test",
                        operationName);
                    _state = CircuitState.Closed;
                }
                
                _failureCount = 0;
                _lastFailureTime = null;
            }
            
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            // Failure - increment count and check threshold
            lock (_lock)
            {
                _failureCount++;
                _lastFailureTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
                
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} recorded failure {FailureCount}/{Threshold}",
                    operationName,
                    _failureCount,
                    _options.FailureThreshold);
                
                if (_failureCount >= _options.FailureThreshold)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} opening after {FailureCount} failures",
                        operationName,
                        _failureCount);
                    
                    _state = CircuitState.Open;
                    _circuitOpenedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    _failureCount = 0;
                }
                else if (_state == CircuitState.HalfOpen)
                {
                    // Failed during test, reopen circuit
                    _logger.LogWarning(
                        "Circuit breaker for {OperationName} reopening after failed test",
                        operationName);
                    
                    _state = CircuitState.Open;
                    _circuitOpenedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                }
            }
            
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    public CircuitBreakerMetrics GetMetrics()
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            return new CircuitBreakerMetrics
            {
                State = _state,
                FailureCount = _failureCount,
                LastFailureTime = _lastFailureTime,
                CircuitOpenedAt = _circuitOpenedAt
            };
        }
    }
    
    public void Reset()
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            _state = CircuitState.Closed;
            _failureCount = 0;
            _lastFailureTime = null;
            _circuitOpenedAt = null;
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Circuit breaker manually reset");
        }
    }
}

public class CircuitBreakerOptions
{
    public int FailureThreshold { get; set; } = 5;
    public TimeSpan BreakDuration { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1);
}

public class CircuitBreakerMetrics
{
    public CircuitState State { get; set; }
    public int FailureCount { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastFailureTime { get; set; }
    public DateTime? CircuitOpenedAt { get; set; }
}

public class CircuitBreakerOpenException : Exception
{
    public CircuitBreakerOpenException(string message) : base(message)
    {
    }
}
```

### 198.3 Retry Policy with Exponential Backoff

```csharp
public interface IRetryPolicy
{
    Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Func<Task<T>> operation,
        RetryOptions options = null);
}

public class RetryPolicy : IRetryPolicy
{
    private readonly ILogger<RetryPolicy> _logger;
    
    public RetryPolicy(ILogger<RetryPolicy> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task<T> ExecuteAsync<T>(
        Func<Task<T>> operation,
        RetryOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= RetryOptions.Default;
        
        var attemptNumber = 0;
        Exception lastException = null;
        
        while (attemptNumber < options.MaxAttempts)
        {
            attemptNumber++;
            
            try
            {
                return await operation();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (IsTransientError(ex))
            {
                lastException = ex;
                
                if (attemptNumber >= options.MaxAttempts)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        ex,
                        "Operation failed after {Attempts} attempts",
                        attemptNumber);
                    throw;
                }
                
                var delay = CalculateDelay(attemptNumber, options);
                
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Operation failed on attempt {Attempt}/{MaxAttempts}. Retrying in {Delay}ms",
                    attemptNumber,
                    options.MaxAttempts,
                    delay.TotalMilliseconds);
                
                await Task.Delay(delay);
            }
        }
        
        throw lastException ?? new Exception("Operation failed");
    }
    
    private bool IsTransientError(Exception exception)
    {
        // Determine if error is transient and worth retrying
        return exception is HttpRequestException
            || exception is TaskCanceledException
            || exception is TimeoutException
            || (exception is ApiException apiEx && 
                apiEx.StatusCode >= 500);
    }
    
    private TimeSpan CalculateDelay(int attemptNumber, RetryOptions options)
    {
        // Exponential backoff with jitter
        var exponentialDelay = Math.Pow(2, attemptNumber - 1) * 1000;
        var maxDelay = options.MaxDelay.TotalMilliseconds;
        var delay = Math.Min(exponentialDelay, maxDelay);
        
        // Add jitter (random ±20%)
        var jitter = Random.Shared.NextDouble() * 0.4 - 0.2; // -0.2 to +0.2
        delay += delay * jitter;
        
        return TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(delay);
    }
}

public class RetryOptions
{
    public int MaxAttempts { get; set; } = 3;
    public TimeSpan MaxDelay { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    
    public static RetryOptions Default => new RetryOptions();
    
    public static RetryOptions Aggressive => new RetryOptions
    {
        MaxAttempts = 5,
        MaxDelay = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(1)
    };
    
    public static RetryOptions Conservative => new RetryOptions
    {
        MaxAttempts = 2,
        MaxDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10)
    };
}
```

### 198.4 Combined Resilient HTTP Client

```csharp
public class ResilientHttpClient
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ICircuitBreaker _circuitBreaker;
    private readonly IRetryPolicy _retryPolicy;
    private readonly ILogger<ResilientHttpClient> _logger;
    
    public ResilientHttpClient(
        IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory,
        ICircuitBreaker circuitBreaker,
        IRetryPolicy retryPolicy,
        ILogger<ResilientHttpClient> logger)
    {
        _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
        _circuitBreaker = circuitBreaker;
        _retryPolicy = retryPolicy;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(
        string clientName,
        HttpRequestMessage request,
        ResilienceOptions options = null)
    {
        options ??= ResilienceOptions.Default;
        
        return await _circuitBreaker.ExecuteAsync(
            async () =>
            {
                return await _retryPolicy.ExecuteAsync(
                    async () =>
                    {
                        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient(clientName);
                        
                        // Set timeout
                        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource(options.Timeout);
                        
                        _logger.LogDebug(
                            "Sending {Method} request to {Uri}",
                            request.Method,
                            request.RequestUri);
                        
                        var response = await client.SendAsync(request, cts.Token);
                        
                        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode && !options.AllowedStatusCodes.Contains(response.StatusCode))
                        {
                            var content = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
                            throw new ApiException(
                                (int)response.StatusCode,
                                $"API request failed: {content}");
                        }
                        
                        return response;
                    },
                    options.RetryOptions);
            },
            $"{clientName}:{request.Method}:{request.RequestUri}");
    }
    
    public async Task<T> GetAsync<T>(
        string clientName,
        string url,
        ResilienceOptions options = null)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, url);
        var response = await SendAsync(clientName, request, options);
        return await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<T>();
    }
    
    public async Task<T> PostAsync<T>(
        string clientName,
        string url,
        object body,
        ResilienceOptions options = null)
    {
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, url)
        {
            Content = JsonContent.Create(body)
        };
        
        var response = await SendAsync(clientName, request, options);
        return await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<T>();
    }
}

public class ResilienceOptions
{
    public TimeSpan Timeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    public RetryOptions RetryOptions { get; set; } = RetryOptions.Default;
    public List<HttpStatusCode> AllowedStatusCodes { get; set; } = new();
    
    public static ResilienceOptions Default => new ResilienceOptions();
    
    public static ResilienceOptions LongRunning => new ResilienceOptions
    {
        Timeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
        RetryOptions = RetryOptions.Aggressive
    };
}

public class ApiException : Exception
{
    public int StatusCode { get; }
    
    public ApiException(int statusCode, string message) 
        : base(message)
    {
        StatusCode = statusCode;
    }
}
```

### 198.5 Fallback Strategies

```csharp
public interface IFallbackStrategy<T>
{
    Task<T> ExecuteAsync(Exception exception);
    bool CanHandle(Exception exception);
}

public class CachedFallbackStrategy<T> : IFallbackStrategy<T>
{
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    private readonly string _cacheKey;
    
    public CachedFallbackStrategy(ICacheService cache, string cacheKey)
    {
        _cache = cache;
        _cacheKey = cacheKey;
    }
    
    public async Task<T> ExecuteAsync(Exception exception)
    {
        var cached = await _cache.GetAsync<T>(_cacheKey);
        
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return cached;
        }
        
        throw exception; // Re-throw if no cache available
    }
    
    public bool CanHandle(Exception exception)
    {
        return exception is HttpRequestException 
            || exception is CircuitBreakerOpenException;
    }
}

public class DefaultValueFallbackStrategy<T> : IFallbackStrategy<T>
{
    private readonly T _defaultValue;
    
    public DefaultValueFallbackStrategy(T defaultValue)
    {
        _defaultValue = defaultValue;
    }
    
    public Task<T> ExecuteAsync(Exception exception)
    {
        return Task.FromResult(_defaultValue);
    }
    
    public bool CanHandle(Exception exception)
    {
        return true;
    }
}

public class ResilientOperation<T>
{
    private readonly Func<Task<T>> _operation;
    private readonly List<IFallbackStrategy<T>> _fallbackStrategies = new();
    
    public ResilientOperation(Func<Task<T>> operation)
    {
        _operation = operation;
    }
    
    public ResilientOperation<T> WithFallback(IFallbackStrategy<T> strategy)
    {
        _fallbackStrategies.Add(strategy);
        return this;
    }
    
    public async Task<T> ExecuteAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            return await _operation();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            foreach (var strategy in _fallbackStrategies)
            {
                if (strategy.CanHandle(ex))
                {
                    try
                    {
                        return await strategy.ExecuteAsync(ex);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        // Try next strategy
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // No fallback worked, re-throw
            throw;
        }
    }
}

// Usage example
public class JiraIntegrationService
{
    private readonly ResilientHttpClient _httpClient;
    private readonly ICacheService _cache;
    
    public async Task<JiraIssue> GetIssueWithFallbackAsync(string issueKey)
    {
        var operation = new ResilientOperation<JiraIssue>(
            async () => await FetchIssueFromJiraAsync(issueKey))
            .WithFallback(new CachedFallbackStrategy<JiraIssue>(
                _cache, 
                $"jira:issue:{issueKey}"))
            .WithFallback(new DefaultValueFallbackStrategy<JiraIssue>(
                new JiraIssue { Key = issueKey, Summary = "Unavailable" }));
        
        return await operation.ExecuteAsync();
    }
    
    private async Task<JiraIssue> FetchIssueFromJiraAsync(string issueKey)
    {
        return await _httpClient.GetAsync<JiraIssue>(
            "Jira",
            $"rest/api/3/issue/{issueKey}");
    }
}
```
