### 199.1 Notification Orchestrator

```csharp
public interface INotificationOrchestrator
{
    Task NotifyTaskAssignedAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        User assignee,
        User assignedBy);
    
    Task NotifyTaskCompletedAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        User completedBy);
    
    Task NotifyApprovalRequestedAsync(
        ApprovalRequest request,
        List<User> approvers);
    
    Task NotifyDeadlineApproachingAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        TimeSpan timeUntilDeadline);
}

public class NotificationOrchestrator : INotificationOrchestrator
{
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IUserPreferencesRepository _preferencesRepository;
    private readonly SlackAdapter _slackAdapter;
    private readonly MicrosoftTeamsAdapter _teamsAdapter;
    private readonly IEmailService _emailService;
    private readonly IPushNotificationService _pushService;
    private readonly ILogger<NotificationOrchestrator> _logger;
    
    public async Task NotifyTaskAssignedAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        User assignee,
        User assignedBy)
    {
        // Get user notification preferences
        var preferences = await _preferencesRepository
            .GetByUserIdAsync(assignee.Id);
        
        var channels = DetermineChannels(
            preferences,
            NotificationType.TaskAssigned);
        
        // Prepare notification content
        var notification = new TaskAssignedNotification
        {
            TaskId = task.Id,
            TaskTitle = task.Title,
            ProjectName = task.ProjectName,
            AssignedByName = assignedBy.DisplayName,
            DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
            Priority = task.Quadrant,
            TaskUrl = $"https://app.workmanagement.com/tasks/{task.Id}"
        };
        
        // Send to each enabled channel
        var tasks = new List<Task>();
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Email))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendEmailNotificationAsync(assignee, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Slack) && 
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(assignee.SlackUserId))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendSlackNotificationAsync(assignee, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Teams) && 
            !string.IsNullOrEmpty(assignee.TeamsUserId))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendTeamsNotificationAsync(assignee, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Push))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendPushNotificationAsync(assignee, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.InApp))
        {
            tasks.Add(CreateInAppNotificationAsync(assignee, notification));
        }
        
        // Execute all notifications in parallel
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    }
    
    public async Task NotifyApprovalRequestedAsync(
        ApprovalRequest request,
        List<User> approvers)
    {
        var tasks = approvers.Select(approver =>
            NotifyApprovalToUserAsync(request, approver));
        
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    }
    
    private async Task NotifyApprovalToUserAsync(
        ApprovalRequest request,
        User approver)
    {
        var preferences = await _preferencesRepository
            .GetByUserIdAsync(approver.Id);
        
        var channels = DetermineChannels(
            preferences,
            NotificationType.ApprovalRequested);
        
        var notification = new ApprovalRequestedNotification
        {
            RequestId = request.Id,
            EntityType = request.EntityType,
            EntityTitle = await GetEntityTitleAsync(
                request.EntityType,
                request.EntityId),
            RequestedByName = (await _userRepository
                .GetAsync(request.RequestedBy)).DisplayName,
            DueDate = request.DueDate,
            ApprovalUrl = $"https://app.workmanagement.com/approvals/{request.Id}"
        };
        
        var tasks = new List<Task>();
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Email))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendApprovalEmailAsync(approver, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.Slack))
        {
            tasks.Add(SendApprovalSlackMessageAsync(approver, notification));
        }
        
        if (channels.Contains(NotificationChannel.InApp))
        {
            tasks.Add(CreateApprovalInAppNotificationAsync(approver, notification));
        }
        
        await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
    }
    
    public async Task NotifyDeadlineApproachingAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        TimeSpan timeUntilDeadline)
    {
        if (!task.Assignment.AssigneeId.HasValue)
            return;
        
        var assignee = await _userRepository.GetAsync(
            task.Assignment.AssigneeId.Value);
        
        var preferences = await _preferencesRepository
            .GetByUserIdAsync(assignee.Id);
        
        // Check if user wants deadline reminders
        if (!preferences.EnableDeadlineReminders)
            return;
        
        // Check reminder threshold
        if (timeUntilDeadline > preferences.DeadlineReminderThreshold)
            return;
        
        var notification = new DeadlineApproachingNotification
        {
            TaskId = task.Id,
            TaskTitle = task.Title,
            DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.Value,
            TimeUntilDeadline = timeUntilDeadline,
            TaskUrl = $"https://app.workmanagement.com/tasks/{task.Id}"
        };
        
        // Send through preferred urgent channel
        await SendUrgentNotificationAsync(assignee, notification, preferences);
    }
    
    private List<NotificationChannel> DetermineChannels(
        UserNotificationPreferences preferences,
        NotificationType notificationType)
    {
        var channels = new List<NotificationChannel>();
        
        var rule = preferences.Rules
            .FirstOrDefault(r => r.NotificationType == notificationType);
        
        if (rule == null)
        {
            // Use defaults
            channels.Add(NotificationChannel.InApp);
            channels.Add(NotificationChannel.Email);
        }
        else
        {
            channels.AddRange(rule.EnabledChannels);
        }
        
        // Apply do-not-disturb
        if (preferences.DoNotDisturbEnabled && 
            IsWithinDoNotDisturbWindow(preferences))
        {
            // Only allow non-intrusive channels during DND
            channels.RemoveAll(c => 
                c == NotificationChannel.Push || 
                c == NotificationChannel.Slack ||
                c == NotificationChannel.Teams);
        }
        
        return channels;
    }
    
    private bool IsWithinDoNotDisturbWindow(
        UserNotificationPreferences preferences)
    {
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var userLocalTime = TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc(
            now,
            preferences.TimeZone);
        
        var currentTime = userLocalTime.TimeOfDay;
        
        return currentTime >= preferences.DoNotDisturbStart &&
               currentTime <= preferences.DoNotDisturbEnd;
    }
}
```

### 199.2 Sync Orchestrator

```csharp
public interface ISyncOrchestrator
{
    Task<SyncResult> SyncTaskToExternalSystemAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        string externalSystem);
    
    Task<SyncResult> SyncFromExternalSystemAsync(
        string externalSystem,
        string externalId);
    
    Task<BidirectionalSyncResult> BidirectionalSyncAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        string externalSystem);
}

public class SyncOrchestrator : ISyncOrchestrator
{
    private readonly ITaskInstanceRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, IIntegrationAdapter<TaskInstance>> _adapters;
    private readonly ISyncConflictResolver _conflictResolver;
    private readonly ILogger<SyncOrchestrator> _logger;
    
    public async Task<SyncResult> SyncTaskToExternalSystemAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        string externalSystem)
    {
        if (!_adapters.TryGetValue(externalSystem, out var adapter))
        {
            return SyncResult.Failed(
                $"No adapter found for system: {externalSystem}");
        }
        
        try
        {
            var context = new IntegrationContext
            {
                TenantId = task.TenantId,
                UserId = task.OwnerId
            };
            
            var result = await adapter.PushAsync(task, context);
            
            if (result.Success)
            {
                // Update last sync timestamp
                task.SetLastSyncTime(externalSystem, DateTime.UtcNow);
                await _taskRepository.UpdateAsync(task);
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Successfully synced task {TaskId} to {ExternalSystem}",
                    task.Id,
                    externalSystem);
            }
            
            return new SyncResult
            {
                Success = result.Success,
                Direction = SyncDirection.Outbound,
                ExternalSystem = externalSystem,
                ErrorMessage = result.ErrorMessage
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error syncing task {TaskId} to {ExternalSystem}",
                task.Id,
                externalSystem);
            
            return SyncResult.Failed(ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<SyncResult> SyncFromExternalSystemAsync(
        string externalSystem,
        string externalId)
    {
        if (!_adapters.TryGetValue(externalSystem, out var adapter))
        {
            return SyncResult.Failed(
                $"No adapter found for system: {externalSystem}");
        }
        
        try
        {
            var context = new IntegrationContext();
            
            var result = await adapter.PullAsync(externalId, context);
            
            if (!result.Success)
            {
                return new SyncResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Direction = SyncDirection.Inbound,
                    ExternalSystem = externalSystem,
                    ErrorMessage = result.ErrorMessage
                };
            }
            
            var externalTask = result.Value;
            
            // Check if task already exists locally
            var existingTask = await _taskRepository
                .GetByExternalReferenceAsync(externalSystem, externalId);
            
            if (existingTask != null)
            {
                // Update existing task
                await UpdateTaskFromExternalAsync(existingTask, externalTask);
            }
            else
            {
                // Create new task
                await _taskRepository.InsertAsync(externalTask);
            }
            
            return new SyncResult
            {
                Success = true,
                Direction = SyncDirection.Inbound,
                ExternalSystem = externalSystem
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error syncing from {ExternalSystem} id {ExternalId}",
                externalSystem,
                externalId);
            
            return SyncResult.Failed(ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<BidirectionalSyncResult> BidirectionalSyncAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        string externalSystem)
    {
        if (!_adapters.TryGetValue(externalSystem, out var adapter))
        {
            return BidirectionalSyncResult.Failed(
                $"No adapter found for system: {externalSystem}");
        }
        
        var externalRef = task.GetExternalReference(externalSystem);
        if (externalRef == null)
        {
            // No external reference, just push
            var pushResult = await SyncTaskToExternalSystemAsync(task, externalSystem);
            return new BidirectionalSyncResult
            {
                Success = pushResult.Success,
                Direction = SyncDirection.Outbound,
                ExternalSystem = externalSystem,
                ConflictsDetected = false
            };
        }
        
        try
        {
            // Pull latest from external system
            var context = new IntegrationContext
            {
                TenantId = task.TenantId
            };
            
            var pullResult = await adapter.PullAsync(
                externalRef.ExternalId,
                context);
            
            if (!pullResult.Success)
            {
                return BidirectionalSyncResult.Failed(pullResult.ErrorMessage);
            }
            
            var externalTask = pullResult.Value;
            
            // Detect conflicts
            var acl = GetAntiCorruptionLayer(externalSystem);
            var conflictResult = await acl.DetectConflictsAsync(
                externalTask,
                task);
            
            if (conflictResult.HasConflict)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Sync conflicts detected for task {TaskId} with {ExternalSystem}",
                    task.Id,
                    externalSystem);
                
                // Resolve conflicts
                var resolution = await _conflictResolver.ResolveAsync(
                    conflictResult,
                    task,
                    externalTask);
                
                // Apply resolution
                if (resolution.Strategy == ConflictResolutionStrategy.UseExternal)
                {
                    await UpdateTaskFromExternalAsync(task, externalTask);
                }
                else if (resolution.Strategy == ConflictResolutionStrategy.UseDomain)
                {
                    await SyncTaskToExternalSystemAsync(task, externalSystem);
                }
                else if (resolution.Strategy == ConflictResolutionStrategy.Merge)
                {
                    await ApplyMergedChangesAsync(task, externalTask, resolution.MergedData);
                }
                
                return new BidirectionalSyncResult
                {
                    Success = true,
                    Direction = SyncDirection.Bidirectional,
                    ExternalSystem = externalSystem,
                    ConflictsDetected = true,
                    ConflictsResolved = true,
                    ResolutionStrategy = resolution.Strategy
                };
            }
            else
            {
                // No conflicts, sync both ways if needed
                if (task.UpdatedAt > externalTask.UpdatedAt)
                {
                    await SyncTaskToExternalSystemAsync(task, externalSystem);
                }
                else if (externalTask.UpdatedAt > task.UpdatedAt)
                {
                    await UpdateTaskFromExternalAsync(task, externalTask);
                }
                
                return new BidirectionalSyncResult
                {
                    Success = true,
                    Direction = SyncDirection.Bidirectional,
                    ExternalSystem = externalSystem,
                    ConflictsDetected = false
                };
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(
                ex,
                "Error during bidirectional sync for task {TaskId} with {ExternalSystem}",
                task.Id,
                externalSystem);
            
            return BidirectionalSyncResult.Failed(ex.Message);
        }
    }
}

public class SyncResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public SyncDirection Direction { get; set; }
    public string ExternalSystem { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    
    public static SyncResult Failed(string errorMessage)
    {
        return new SyncResult
        {
            Success = false,
            ErrorMessage = errorMessage
        };
    }
}

public class BidirectionalSyncResult : SyncResult
{
    public bool ConflictsDetected { get; set; }
    public bool ConflictsResolved { get; set; }
    public ConflictResolutionStrategy? ResolutionStrategy { get; set; }
    
    public new static BidirectionalSyncResult Failed(string errorMessage)
    {
        return new BidirectionalSyncResult
        {
            Success = false,
            ErrorMessage = errorMessage
        };
    }
}

public enum SyncDirection
{
    Outbound,
    Inbound,
    Bidirectional
}
```

```csharp
    public string IntegrationName { get; set; }
    public string EntityType { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string> FieldMappings { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string> StatusMappings { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, string> UserMappings { get; set; }
}
```

### 200.2 Integration Management Service

```csharp
public interface IIntegrationManagementService
{
    Task<IntegrationConfiguration> EnableIntegrationAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        string integrationName,
        Dictionary<string, string> credentials,
        Dictionary<string, object> settings);
    
    Task DisableIntegrationAsync(Guid tenantId, string integrationName);
    
    Task<IntegrationHealth> TestIntegrationAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        string integrationName);
    
    Task<List<IntegrationConfiguration>> GetEnabledIntegrationsAsync(
        Guid tenantId);
    
    Task UpdateIntegrationSettingsAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        string integrationName,
        Dictionary<string, object> settings);
}

public class IntegrationManagementService : IIntegrationManagementService
{
    private readonly IIntegrationConfigurationRepository _configRepo;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, IIntegrationAdapter> _adapters;
    private readonly IEncryptionService _encryptionService;
    private readonly ILogger<IntegrationManagementService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<IntegrationConfiguration> EnableIntegrationAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        string integrationName,
        Dictionary<string, string> credentials,
        Dictionary<string, object> settings)
    {
        // Validate adapter exists
        if (!_adapters.ContainsKey(integrationName))
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "IntegrationNotFound",
                $"Integration {integrationName} not found");
        }
        
        // Encrypt credentials
        var encryptedCredentials = credentials.ToDictionary(
            kvp => kvp.Key,
            kvp => _encryptionService.Encrypt(kvp.Value));
        
        // Test connection
        var adapter = _adapters[integrationName];
        var testResult = await adapter.TestConnectionAsync();
        
        if (!testResult)
        {
            throw new BusinessException(
                "IntegrationTestFailed",
                $"Failed to connect to {integrationName}");
        }
        
        // Save configuration
        var config = new IntegrationConfiguration
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = tenantId,
            IntegrationName = integrationName,
            IsEnabled = true,
            Credentials = encryptedCredentials,
            Settings = settings,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        await _configRepo.InsertAsync(config);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Enabled integration {IntegrationName} for tenant {TenantId}",
            integrationName,
            tenantId);
        
        return config;
    }
    
    public async Task<IntegrationHealth> TestIntegrationAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        string integrationName)
    {
        var config = await _configRepo.GetAsync(tenantId, integrationName);
        
        if (config == null)
        {
            return new IntegrationHealth
            {
                IsHealthy = false,
                Status = "Not Configured",
                LastChecked = DateTime.UtcNow,
                ErrorMessage = "Integration not configured"
            };
        }
        
        if (!_adapters.TryGetValue(integrationName, out var adapter))
        {
            return new IntegrationHealth
            {
                IsHealthy = false,
                Status = "Adapter Not Found",
                LastChecked = DateTime.UtcNow,
                ErrorMessage = "Integration adapter not found"
            };
        }
        
        var health = await adapter.GetHealthAsync();
        
        // Update configuration with health status
        config.Health = health;
        config.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
        await _configRepo.UpdateAsync(config);
        
        return health;
    }
}
```

# **Part XXXI - Deployment, DevOps & Operations**

## **Chapter 201 - CI/CD Pipeline Architecture**

### 201.1 Pipeline Overview

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Code[Code Commit] --> Build[Build Stage]
    Build --> UnitTest[Unit Tests]
    UnitTest --> IntTest[Integration Tests]
    IntTest --> SecScan[Security Scan]
    SecScan --> Package[Package Artifacts]
    
    Package --> Dev[Deploy to Dev]
    Dev --> DevTest[Smoke Tests]
    
    DevTest --> Staging[Deploy to Staging]
    Staging --> E2E[E2E Tests]
    E2E --> PerfTest[Performance Tests]
    
    PerfTest --> Approval{Manual Approval}
    Approval -->|Approved| Prod[Deploy to Production]
    Approval -->|Rejected| End[End]
    
    Prod --> Monitor[Monitor Metrics]
    Monitor --> Health{Health Check}
    Health -->|Healthy| Success[Success]
    Health -->|Unhealthy| Rollback[Automatic Rollback]
    
    style Build fill:#87CEEB
    style Package fill:#90EE90
    style Prod fill:#FFD700
    style Rollback fill:#FF6B6B
```

### 201.2 GitHub Actions Workflow

```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: '8.0.x'
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0  # For GitVersion
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}
    
    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore
    
    - name: Build
      run: dotnet build --configuration Release --no-restore
    
    - name: Run unit tests
      run: |
        dotnet test \
          --configuration Release \
          --no-build \
          --verbosity normal \
          --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" \
          --results-directory ./coverage \
          -- DataCollectionRunSettings.DataCollectors.DataCollector.Configuration.Format=opencover
    
    - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v3
      with:
        files: ./coverage/*/coverage.opencover.xml
        fail_ci_if_error: true
    
    - name: Run integration tests
      run: |
        docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d
        dotnet test tests/Integration.Tests \
          --configuration Release \
          --no-build \
          --filter Category=Integration
        docker-compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down
    
    - name: Security scan
      uses: securego/gosec@master
      with:
        args: '-no-fail -fmt sarif -out results.sarif ./...'
    
    - name: Upload SARIF file
      uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v2
      with:
        sarif_file: results.sarif

  build-docker:
    name: Build Docker Image
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
    
    - name: Log in to Container Registry
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
        username: ${{ github.actor }}
        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    
    - name: Extract metadata
      id: meta
      uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
      with:
        images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
        tags: |
          type=ref,event=branch
          type=ref,event=pr
          type=semver,pattern={{version}}
          type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
          type=sha,prefix={{branch}}-
    
    - name: Build and push Docker image
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        context: .
        file: ./src/Api/Dockerfile
        push: true
        tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
        labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
        cache-from: type=gha
        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
        build-args: |
          BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.sha }}
          BUILD_DATE=${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}

  deploy-dev:
    name: Deploy to Development
    needs: build-docker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    environment:
      name: development
      url: https://dev.workmanagement.com
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup kubectl
      uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v3
      with:
        version: 'latest'
    
    - name: Configure kubectl
      run: |
        echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG_DEV }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
        export KUBECONFIG=./kubeconfig
    
    - name: Deploy to Kubernetes
      run: |
        kubectl set image deployment/workmanagement-api \
          api=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:develop-${{ github.sha }} \
          --namespace=development
        
        kubectl rollout status deployment/workmanagement-api \
          --namespace=development \
          --timeout=5m
    
    - name: Run smoke tests
      run: |
        chmod +x ./scripts/smoke-tests.sh
        ./scripts/smoke-tests.sh https://dev.workmanagement.com

  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    needs: build-docker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.workmanagement.com
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Deploy to staging
      run: |
        echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG_STAGING }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
        export KUBECONFIG=./kubeconfig
        
        kubectl set image deployment/workmanagement-api \
          api=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:main-${{ github.sha }} \
          --namespace=staging
        
        kubectl rollout status deployment/workmanagement-api \
          --namespace=staging \
          --timeout=5m
    
    - name: Run E2E tests
      run: |
        npm ci
        npx playwright install --with-deps
        npx playwright test --config=playwright.staging.config.ts
    
    - name: Run performance tests
      run: |
        docker run --rm -i \
          -e K6_CLOUD_TOKEN=${{ secrets.K6_CLOUD_TOKEN }} \
          grafana/k6:latest run - < tests/performance/load-test.js

  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    needs: deploy-staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.workmanagement.com
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Deploy to production with blue-green
      run: |
        echo "${{ secrets.KUBE_CONFIG_PROD }}" | base64 -d > kubeconfig
        export KUBECONFIG=./kubeconfig
        
        # Deploy to green environment
        kubectl set image deployment/workmanagement-api-green \
          api=${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:main-${{ github.sha }} \
          --namespace=production
        
        kubectl rollout status deployment/workmanagement-api-green \
          --namespace=production \
          --timeout=10m
        
        # Run smoke tests on green
        chmod +x ./scripts/smoke-tests.sh
        ./scripts/smoke-tests.sh https://green.workmanagement.com
        
        # Switch traffic to green
        kubectl patch service workmanagement-api \
          --namespace=production \
          --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"green"}}}'
        
        # Wait for traffic to stabilize
        sleep 60
        
        # Scale down blue
        kubectl scale deployment/workmanagement-api-blue \
          --replicas=0 \
          --namespace=production
    
    - name: Monitor deployment
      run: |
        chmod +x ./scripts/monitor-deployment.sh
        ./scripts/monitor-deployment.sh production 300
    
    - name: Rollback on failure
      if: failure()
      run: |
        echo "Deployment failed, rolling back"
        kubectl patch service workmanagement-api \
          --namespace=production \
          --patch '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"blue"}}}'
        
        kubectl scale deployment/workmanagement-api-blue \
          --replicas=3 \
          --namespace=production
```

### 201.3 Dockerfile Multi-Stage Build

```dockerfile
# src/Api/Dockerfile
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src

# Copy csproj files and restore dependencies
COPY ["src/Api/Api.csproj", "src/Api/"]
COPY ["src/Application/Application.csproj", "src/Application/"]
COPY ["src/Domain/Domain.csproj", "src/Domain/"]
COPY ["src/Infrastructure/Infrastructure.csproj", "src/Infrastructure/"]
RUN dotnet restore "src/Api/Api.csproj"

# Copy source code and build
COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/src/Api"
RUN dotnet build "Api.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

# Publish
FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "Api.csproj" \
    -c Release \
    -o /app/publish \
    --no-restore \
    /p:UseAppHost=false

# Final runtime image
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0 AS final

# Install curl for health checks
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Create non-root user
RUN groupadd -r appuser && \
    useradd -r -g appuser appuser && \
    chown -R appuser:appuser /app

# Copy published files
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .

# Switch to non-root user
USER appuser

# Expose port
EXPOSE 8080

# Health check
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
    CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1

# Entry point
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "Api.dll"]
```

### 201.4 Docker Compose for Local Development

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3.8'

services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: src/Api/Dockerfile
      target: build
    ports:
      - "5000:8080"
    environment:
      - ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development
      - ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection=Host=postgres;Database=WorkManagement;Username=postgres;Password=postgres
      - ConnectionStrings__Redis=redis:6379
      - RabbitMQ__Host=rabbitmq
      - RabbitMQ__Username=guest
      - RabbitMQ__Password=guest
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      rabbitmq:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./src:/src
      - ~/.nuget/packages:/root/.nuget/packages
    command: dotnet watch run --project /src/src/Api/Api.csproj

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: WorkManagement
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  rabbitmq:
    image: rabbitmq:3-management-alpine
    ports:
      - "5672:5672"
      - "15672:15672"
    environment:
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER: guest
      RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS: guest
    volumes:
      - rabbitmq-data:/var/lib/rabbitmq
    healthcheck:
      test: rabbitmq-diagnostics -q ping
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5

  seq:
    image: datalust/seq:latest
    ports:
      - "5341:80"
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: Y
    volumes:
      - seq-data:/data

  prometheus:
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/prometheus.yml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
      - prometheus-data:/prometheus
    command:
      - '--config.file=/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml'
      - '--storage.tsdb.path=/prometheus'

  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_USER: admin
      GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      GF_INSTALL_PLUGINS: grafana-clock-panel
    volumes:
      - ./monitoring/grafana/dashboards:/etc/grafana/provisioning/dashboards
      - ./monitoring/grafana/datasources:/etc/grafana/provisioning/datasources
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana
    depends_on:
      - prometheus

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:
  rabbitmq-data:
  seq-data:
  prometheus-data:
  grafana-data:
```

## **Chapter 202 - Kubernetes Deployment**

### 202.1 Kubernetes Deployment Configuration

```yaml
# k8s/deployment.yml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: workmanagement-api
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: workmanagement-api
    version: blue
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: workmanagement-api
      version: blue
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: workmanagement-api
        version: blue
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
        prometheus.io/port: "8080"
        prometheus.io/path: "/metrics"
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: workmanagement-api
      
      # Init containers for migrations
      initContainers:
      - name: database-migration
        image: ghcr.io/myorg/workmanagement:latest
        command: ['dotnet', 'Api.dll', '--migrate']
        env:
        - name: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: database-secrets
              key: connection-string
        - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
          value: "Production"
      
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: ghcr.io/myorg/workmanagement:latest
        imagePullPolicy: Always
        
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
          protocol: TCP
        
        env:
        - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
          value: "Production"
        - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
          value: "http://+:8080"
        
        # Database connection
        - name: ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: database-secrets
              key: connection-string
        
        # Redis connection
        - name: ConnectionStrings__Redis
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: redis-secrets
              key: connection-string
        
        # RabbitMQ configuration
        - name: RabbitMQ__Host
          value: rabbitmq.production.svc.cluster.local
        - name: RabbitMQ__Username
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: rabbitmq-secrets
              key: username
        - name: RabbitMQ__Password
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: rabbitmq-secrets
              key: password
        
        # JWT configuration
        - name: Jwt__Secret
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: jwt-secrets
              key: secret
        - name: Jwt__Issuer
          value: "https://api.workmanagement.com"
        - name: Jwt__Audience
          value: "https://app.workmanagement.com"
        
        # Application Insights
        - name: ApplicationInsights__ConnectionString
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: appinsights-secrets
              key: connection-string
        
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "1Gi"
            cpu: "1000m"
        
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/live
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 3
        
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 3
        
        startupProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health/startup
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 0
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 30
        
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config
          mountPath: /app/config
          readOnly: true
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /app/logs
      
      # Sidecar for log forwarding
      - name: fluentd
        image: fluent/fluentd:v1.16-1
        volumeMounts:
        - name: logs
          mountPath: /app/logs
          readOnly: true
        - name: fluentd-config
          mountPath: /fluentd/etc
      
      volumes:
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: workmanagement-config
      - name: logs
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: fluentd-config
        configMap:
          name: fluentd-config
      
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                - key: app
                  operator: In
                  values:
                  - workmanagement-api
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      
      topologySpreadConstraints:
      - maxSkew: 1
        topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
        whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
        labelSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: workmanagement-api
```

### 202.2 Service and Ingress Configuration

```yaml
# k8s/service.yml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: workmanagement-api
  namespace: production
  labels:
    app: workmanagement-api
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 8080
    protocol: TCP
    name: http
  selector:
    app: workmanagement-api
    version: blue

---
# k8s/ingress.yml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: workmanagement-api
  namespace: production
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rate-limit: "100"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/limit-rps: "10"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-body-size: "10m"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-connect-timeout: "600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-send-timeout: "600"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/proxy-read-timeout: "600"
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - api.workmanagement.com
    secretName: workmanagement-api-tls
  rules:
  - host: api.workmanagement.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: workmanagement-api
            port:
              number: 80

---
# k8s/hpa.yml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: workmanagement-api
  namespace: production
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: workmanagement-api
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 80
  - type: Pods
    pods:
      metric:
        name: http_requests_per_second
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "1000"
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 50
        periodSeconds: 60
    scaleUp:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 0
      policies:
      - type: Percent
        value: 100
        periodSeconds: 30
      - type: Pods
        value: 2
        periodSeconds: 30
      selectPolicy: Max
```

## **Chapter 203 - Health Checks & Observability**

### 203.1 Advanced Health Checks

```csharp
public class DatabaseHealthCheck : IHealthCheck
{
    private readonly IDbConnectionFactory _connectionFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<DatabaseHealthCheck> _logger;
    
    public DatabaseHealthCheck(
        IDbConnectionFactory connectionFactory,
        ILogger<DatabaseHealthCheck> logger)
    {
        _connectionFactory = connectionFactory;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task<HealthCheckResult> CheckHealthAsync(
        HealthCheckContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            using var connection = await _connectionFactory.CreateConnectionAsync();
            
            var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            
            // Test basic connectivity
            await connection.ExecuteScalarAsync<int>("SELECT 1");
            
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            var responseTime = stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;
            
            // Check response time threshold
            if (responseTime > 1000)
            {
                return HealthCheckResult.Degraded(
                    $"Database response time is slow: {responseTime}ms",
                    data: new Dictionary<string, object>
                    {
                        ["responseTime"] = responseTime,
                        ["threshold"] = 1000
                    });
            }
            
            // Check connection pool
            var poolInfo = await GetConnectionPoolInfoAsync(connection);
            
            if (poolInfo.ActiveConnections > poolInfo.MaxConnections * 0.8)
            {
                return HealthCheckResult.Degraded(
                    "Connection pool is near capacity",
                    data: new Dictionary<string, object>
                    {
                        ["activeConnections"] = poolInfo.ActiveConnections,
                        ["maxConnections"] = poolInfo.MaxConnections,
                        ["utilization"] = poolInfo.ActiveConnections / (double)poolInfo.MaxConnections
                    });
            }
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Healthy(
                "Database is responsive",
                data: new Dictionary<string, object>
                {
                    ["responseTime"] = responseTime,
                    ["activeConnections"] = poolInfo.ActiveConnections,
                    ["maxConnections"] = poolInfo.MaxConnections
                });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Database health check failed");
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy(
                "Database is not responding",
                ex,
                data: new Dictionary<string, object>
                {
                    ["error"] = ex.Message
                });
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<ConnectionPoolInfo> GetConnectionPoolInfoAsync(
        IDbConnection connection)
    {
        var query = @"
            SELECT 
                numbackends as active_connections,
                setting::int as max_connections
            FROM pg_stat_database, pg_settings
            WHERE datname = current_database()
            AND name = 'max_connections'";
        
        var result = await connection.QueryFirstAsync<dynamic>(query);
        
        return new ConnectionPoolInfo
        {
            ActiveConnections = result.active_connections,
            MaxConnections = result.max_connections
        };
    }
}

public class RedisHealthCheck : IHealthCheck
{
    private readonly IConnectionMultiplexer _redis;
    private readonly ILogger<RedisHealthCheck> _logger;
    
    public async Task<HealthCheckResult> CheckHealthAsync(
        HealthCheckContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var database = _redis.GetDatabase();
            
            var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            
            // Test PING
            var ping = await database.PingAsync();
            
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            // Get server info
            var server = _redis.GetServer(_redis.GetEndPoints().First());
            var info = await server.InfoAsync("stats");
            
            var totalConnections = info.First(x => x.Key == "total_connections_received").Value;
            var connectedClients = info.First(x => x.Key == "connected_clients").Value;
            var usedMemory = info.First(x => x.Key == "used_memory").Value;
            var maxMemory = info.First(x => x.Key == "maxmemory").Value;
            
            var data = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["pingTime"] = ping.TotalMilliseconds,
                ["connectedClients"] = connectedClients,
                ["totalConnections"] = totalConnections,
                ["usedMemory"] = usedMemory,
                ["maxMemory"] = maxMemory
            };
            
            if (ping.TotalMilliseconds > 100)
            {
                return HealthCheckResult.Degraded(
                    $"Redis response time is slow: {ping.TotalMilliseconds}ms",
                    data: data);
            }
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Healthy(
                "Redis is responsive",
                data: data);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Redis health check failed");
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy(
                "Redis is not responding",
                ex);
        }
    }
}

public class RabbitMQHealthCheck : IHealthCheck
{
    private readonly IConnectionFactory _connectionFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<RabbitMQHealthCheck> _logger;
    
    public async Task<HealthCheckResult> CheckHealthAsync(
        HealthCheckContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            using var connection = _connectionFactory.CreateConnection();
            using var channel = connection.CreateModel();
            
            // Check if we can declare a temporary queue
            var queueName = $"health-check-{Guid.NewGuid()}";
            channel.QueueDeclare(
                queue: queueName,
                durable: false,
                exclusive: true,
                autoDelete: true);
            
            channel.QueueDelete(queueName);
            
            var data = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["isOpen"] = connection.IsOpen,
                ["endpoint"] = connection.Endpoint.ToString()
            };
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Healthy(
                "RabbitMQ is responsive",
                data: data);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "RabbitMQ health check failed");
            
            return HealthCheckResult.Unhealthy(
                "RabbitMQ is not responding",
                ex);
        }
    }
}
```

### 203.2 Custom Health Check Endpoints

```csharp
// Program.cs
builder.Services
    .AddHealthChecks()
    .AddCheck<DatabaseHealthCheck>(
        "database",
        failureStatus: HealthStatus.Unhealthy,
        tags: new[] { "db", "sql", "ready" })
    .AddCheck<RedisHealthCheck>(
        "redis",
        failureStatus: HealthStatus.Degraded,
        tags: new[] { "cache", "redis", "ready" })
    .AddCheck<RabbitMQHealthCheck>(
        "rabbitmq",
        failureStatus: HealthStatus.Degraded,
        tags: new[] { "messaging", "rabbitmq", "ready" })
    .AddCheck("self",
        () => HealthCheckResult.Healthy("API is running"),
        tags: new[] { "live" });

var app = builder.Build();

// Liveness probe - simple check that app is running
app.MapHealthChecks("/health/live", new HealthCheckOptions
{
    Predicate = (check) => check.Tags.Contains("live"),
    ResponseWriter = async (context, report) =>
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        
        var result = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            status = report.Status.ToString(),
            timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow
        });
        
        await context.Response.WriteAsync(result);
    }
});

// Readiness probe - check if app can handle requests
app.MapHealthChecks("/health/ready", new HealthCheckOptions
{
    Predicate = (check) => check.Tags.Contains("ready"),
    ResponseWriter = async (context, report) =>
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        
        var result = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            status = report.Status.ToString(),
            timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new
            {
                name = e.Key,
                status = e.Value.Status.ToString(),
                description = e.Value.Description,
                duration = e.Value.Duration.TotalMilliseconds,
                data = e.Value.Data
            })
        }, new JsonSerializerOptions
        {
            WriteIndented = true
        });
        
        await context.Response.WriteAsync(result);
    }
});

// Startup probe - check if app has fully initialized
app.MapHealthChecks("/health/startup", new HealthCheckOptions
{
    Predicate = _ => true,
    ResponseWriter = async (context, report) =>
    {
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        
        var result = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            status = report.Status.ToString(),
            timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            totalDuration = report.TotalDuration.TotalMilliseconds,
            checks = report.Entries.Select(e => new
            {
                name = e.Key,
                status = e.Value.Status.ToString()
            })
        });
        
        await context.Response.WriteAsync(result);
    }
});

// Detailed health UI for monitoring
app.MapHealthChecksUI(options =>
{
    options.UIPath = "/health-ui";
    options.ApiPath = "/health-api";
});
```

## **Chapter 204 - Monitoring & Metrics**

### 204.1 Application Metrics with Prometheus

```csharp
public class MetricsService
{
    private readonly Counter _requestCounter;
    private readonly Histogram _requestDuration;
    private readonly Gauge _activeUsers;
    private readonly Counter _taskCreatedCounter;
    private readonly Counter _taskCompletedCounter;
    private readonly Histogram _taskDuration;
    
    public MetricsService()
    {
        _requestCounter = Metrics.CreateCounter(
            "http_requests_total",
            "Total number of HTTP requests",
            new CounterConfiguration
            {
                LabelNames = new[] { "method", "endpoint", "status" }
            });
        
        _requestDuration = Metrics.CreateHistogram(
            "http_request_duration_seconds",
            "Duration of HTTP requests in seconds",
            new HistogramConfiguration
            {
                LabelNames = new[] { "method", "endpoint" },
                Buckets = Histogram.ExponentialBuckets(0.001, 2, 10)
            });
        
        _activeUsers = Metrics.CreateGauge(
            "active_users",
            "Number of currently active users");
        
        _taskCreatedCounter = Metrics.CreateCounter(
            "tasks_created_total",
            "Total number of tasks created",
            new CounterConfiguration
            {
                LabelNames = new[] { "tenant", "quadrant" }
            });
        
        _taskCompletedCounter = Metrics.CreateCounter(
            "tasks_completed_total",
            "Total number of tasks completed",
            new CounterConfiguration
            {
                LabelNames = new[] { "tenant", "quadrant" }
            });
        
        _taskDuration = Metrics.CreateHistogram(
            "task_duration_seconds",
            "Duration from task creation to completion",
            new HistogramConfiguration
            {
                LabelNames = new[] { "quadrant" },
                Buckets = Histogram.ExponentialBuckets(60, 2, 15) // Starts at 1 min
            });
    }
    
    public void RecordRequest(string method, string endpoint, int statusCode, double durationSeconds)
    {
        _requestCounter
            .WithLabels(method, endpoint, statusCode.ToString())
            .Inc();
        
        _requestDuration
            .WithLabels(method, endpoint)
            .Observe(durationSeconds);
    }
    
    public void SetActiveUsers(int count)
    {
        _activeUsers.Set(count);
    }
    
    public void RecordTaskCreated(string tenantId, EisenhowerQuadrant quadrant)
    {
        _taskCreatedCounter
            .WithLabels(tenantId, quadrant.ToString())
            .Inc();
    }
    
    public void RecordTaskCompleted(
        string tenantId,
        EisenhowerQuadrant quadrant,
        TimeSpan duration)
    {
        _taskCompletedCounter
            .WithLabels(tenantId, quadrant.ToString())
            .Inc();
        
        _taskDuration
            .WithLabels(quadrant.ToString())
            .Observe(duration.TotalSeconds);
    }
}

// Middleware to track HTTP metrics
public class MetricsMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly MetricsService _metrics;
    
    public MetricsMiddleware(RequestDelegate next, MetricsService metrics)
    {
        _next = next;
        _metrics = metrics;
    }
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        finally
        {
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            _metrics.RecordRequest(
                context.Request.Method,
                context.Request.Path,
                context.Response.StatusCode,
                stopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
        }
    }
}

// Program.cs
app.UseMetricServer(); // Exposes /metrics endpoint
app.UseHttpMetrics();  // Automatic HTTP metrics
app.UseMiddleware<MetricsMiddleware>();
```

### 204.3 Alert Rules

```yaml
# monitoring/alerts/application.yml
groups:
  - name: application
    interval: 30s
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: |
          sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (endpoint)
          /
          sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (endpoint)
          > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High error rate on {{ $labels.endpoint }}"
          description: "Error rate is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} on endpoint {{ $labels.endpoint }}"

      - alert: HighResponseTime
        expr: |
          histogram_quantile(0.95,
            sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, endpoint)
          ) > 1
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High response time on {{ $labels.endpoint }}"
          description: "95th percentile response time is {{ $value }}s on endpoint {{ $labels.endpoint }}"

      - alert: ServiceDown
        expr: up{job="workmanagement-api"} == 0
        for: 2m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Service {{ $labels.instance }} is down"
          description: "{{ $labels.instance }} has been down for more than 2 minutes"

      - alert: DatabaseConnectionPoolExhausted
        expr: |
          (database_active_connections / database_max_connections) > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "Database connection pool is nearly exhausted"
          description: "Connection pool utilization is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}"

      - alert: HighMemoryUsage
        expr: |
          container_memory_usage_bytes{container="api"}
          /
          container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{container="api"}
          > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory usage on {{ $labels.pod }}"
          description: "Memory usage is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} on pod {{ $labels.pod }}"

      - alert: PodCrashLooping
        expr: |
          rate(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[15m]) > 0
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "Pod {{ $labels.pod }} is crash looping"
          description: "Pod {{ $labels.pod }} has restarted {{ $value }} times in the last 15 minutes"
```

```csharp
Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()

    .CreateLogger();
```

### 205.2 Correlation ID and Request Logging

```csharp
public class CorrelationIdMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private const string CorrelationIdHeader = "X-Correlation-ID";
    
    public CorrelationIdMiddleware(RequestDelegate next)
    {
        _next = next;
    }
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var correlationId = GetCorrelationId(context);
        
        // Add to response headers
        context.Response.OnStarting(() =>
        {
            context.Response.Headers[CorrelationIdHeader] = correlationId;
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
        
        // Add to log context
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("CorrelationId", correlationId))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("RequestPath", context.Request.Path))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("RequestMethod", context.Request.Method))
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
    }
    
    private string GetCorrelationId(HttpContext context)
    {
        // Check if correlation ID exists in request headers
        if (context.Request.Headers.TryGetValue(CorrelationIdHeader, out var correlationId))
        {
            return correlationId.ToString();
        }
        
        // Generate new correlation ID
        return Guid.NewGuid().ToString();
    }
}

public class RequestLoggingMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<RequestLoggingMiddleware> _logger;
    
    public RequestLoggingMiddleware(
        RequestDelegate next,
        ILogger<RequestLoggingMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        // Enable request body buffering for logging
        context.Request.EnableBuffering();
        
        var requestBody = await ReadRequestBodyAsync(context.Request);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "HTTP Request: {Method} {Path} {QueryString}",
            context.Request.Method,
            context.Request.Path,
            context.Request.QueryString);
        
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(requestBody))
        {
            _logger.LogDebug("Request Body: {RequestBody}", requestBody);
        }
        
        // Capture response
        var originalBodyStream = context.Response.Body;
        using var responseBody = new MemoryStream();
        context.Response.Body = responseBody;
        
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        finally
        {
            stopwatch.Stop();
            
            var responseBodyText = await ReadResponseBodyAsync(responseBody);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "HTTP Response: {Method} {Path} {StatusCode} in {ElapsedMilliseconds}ms",
                context.Request.Method,
                context.Request.Path,
                context.Response.StatusCode,
                stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
            
            if (context.Response.StatusCode >= 400)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "HTTP Error Response: {StatusCode} {ResponseBody}",
                    context.Response.StatusCode,
                    responseBodyText);
            }
            
            // Copy response back to original stream
            responseBody.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.Begin);
            await responseBody.CopyToAsync(originalBodyStream);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<string> ReadRequestBodyAsync(HttpRequest request)
    {
        request.Body.Position = 0;
        using var reader = new StreamReader(request.Body, leaveOpen: true);
        var body = await reader.ReadToEndAsync();
        request.Body.Position = 0;
        return body;
    }
    
    private async Task<string> ReadResponseBodyAsync(MemoryStream responseBody)
    {
        responseBody.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        var text = await new StreamReader(responseBody).ReadToEndAsync();
        responseBody.Seek(0, SeekOrigin.Begin);
        return text;
    }
}
```

### 205.3 Domain Event Logging

```csharp
public class DomainEventLogger : IDomainEventHandler<IDomainEvent>
{
    private readonly ILogger<DomainEventLogger> _logger;
    
    public DomainEventLogger(ILogger<DomainEventLogger> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public Task Handle(IDomainEvent domainEvent, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Domain Event: {EventType} {EventData}",
            domainEvent.GetType().Name,
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(domainEvent, new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = false
            }));
        
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

public class AuditLogger
{
    private readonly ILogger<AuditLogger> _logger;
    
    public AuditLogger(ILogger<AuditLogger> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public void LogUserAction(
        Guid userId,
        string action,
        string entityType,
        Guid entityId,
        object? oldValue = null,
        object? newValue = null)
    {
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("AuditLog", true))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("UserId", userId))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("Action", action))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("EntityType", entityType))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("EntityId", entityId))
        {
            var message = $"User {userId} performed {action} on {entityType} {entityId}";
            
            if (oldValue != null || newValue != null)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    message + " - Old: {OldValue}, New: {NewValue}",
                    oldValue != null ? JsonSerializer.Serialize(oldValue) : "null",
                    newValue != null ? JsonSerializer.Serialize(newValue) : "null");
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogInformation(message);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public void LogSecurityEvent(
        string eventType,
        Guid? userId,
        string ipAddress,
        string userAgent,
        bool success,
        string? reason = null)
    {
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("SecurityEvent", true))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("EventType", eventType))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("UserId", userId))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("IpAddress", ipAddress))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("UserAgent", userAgent))
        using (LogContext.PushProperty("Success", success))
        {
            if (success)
            {
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Security Event: {EventType} succeeded for user {UserId} from {IpAddress}",
                    eventType,
                    userId,
                    ipAddress);
            }
            else
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Security Event: {EventType} failed for user {UserId} from {IpAddress}. Reason: {Reason}",
                    eventType,
                    userId,
                    ipAddress,
                    reason ?? "Unknown");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```yaml
# logstash/pipeline/logstash.conf
input {
  beats {
    port => 5044
  }
  tcp {
    port => 5000
    codec => json
  }
}

filter {
  if [type] == "docker" {
    json {
      source => "message"
    }
    
    date {
      match => [ "Timestamp", "ISO8601" ]
      target => "@timestamp"
    }
    
    mutate {
      rename => { "Level" => "log_level" }
      rename => { "MessageTemplate" => "message_template" }
      rename => { "CorrelationId" => "correlation_id" }
      rename => { "RequestPath" => "request_path" }
      rename => { "RequestMethod" => "request_method" }
    }
    
    # Extract structured data
    if [Properties] {
      ruby {
        code => "
          properties = event.get('Properties')
          if properties.is_a?(Hash)
            properties.each do |key, value|
              event.set(key.downcase, value)
            end
          end
        "
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Parse exception stack traces
  if [Exception] {
    mutate {
      add_field => { "has_exception" => true }
    }
  }
  
  # Geo IP lookup
  if [ipaddress] {
    geoip {
      source => "ipaddress"
      target => "geoip"
    }
  }
}

output {
  elasticsearch {
    hosts => ["elasticsearch:9200"]
    index => "workmanagement-logs-%{+YYYY.MM.dd}"
    user => "elastic"
    password => "changeme"
  }
  
  # Output errors to separate index
  if [log_level] == "Error" or [log_level] == "Fatal" {
    elasticsearch {
      hosts => ["elasticsearch:9200"]
      index => "workmanagement-errors-%{+YYYY.MM.dd}"
      user => "elastic"
      password => "changeme"
    }
  }
  
  # Output audit logs to separate index
  if [auditlog] {

      hosts => ["elasticsearch:9200"]
      index => "workmanagement-audit-%{+YYYY.MM.dd}"
      user => "elastic"
      password => "changeme"
    }
  }
  
  stdout {
    codec => rubydebug
  }
}
```

## **Chapter 206 - Database Migrations**

### 206.1 Migration Management System

```csharp
public interface IMigrationService
{
    Task<MigrationResult> MigrateAsync(string targetVersion = null);
    Task<MigrationResult> RollbackAsync(string targetVersion);
    Task<List<MigrationInfo>> GetPendingMigrationsAsync();
    Task<List<MigrationInfo>> GetAppliedMigrationsAsync();
}

public class FluentMigratorService : IMigrationService
{
    private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<FluentMigratorService> _logger;
    private readonly string _connectionString;
    
    public FluentMigratorService(
        IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
        IConfiguration configuration,
        ILogger<FluentMigratorService> logger)
    {
        _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        _logger = logger;
        _connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
    }
    
    public async Task<MigrationResult> MigrateAsync(string targetVersion = null)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Starting database migration");
            
            var runner = CreateMigrationRunner();
            
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetVersion))
            {
                runner.MigrateUp();
            }
            else
            {
                runner.MigrateUp(long.Parse(targetVersion));
            }
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Database migration completed successfully");
            
            return new MigrationResult
            {
                Success = true,
                Message = "Migration completed successfully"
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Database migration failed");
            
            return new MigrationResult
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = $"Migration failed: {ex.Message}",
                Exception = ex
            };
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<MigrationResult> RollbackAsync(string targetVersion)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Starting database rollback to version {Version}", targetVersion);
            
            var runner = CreateMigrationRunner();
            runner.MigrateDown(long.Parse(targetVersion));
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Database rollback completed successfully");
            
            return new MigrationResult
            {
                Success = true,
                Message = "Rollback completed successfully"
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Database rollback failed");
            
            return new MigrationResult
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = $"Rollback failed: {ex.Message}",
                Exception = ex
            };
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<List<MigrationInfo>> GetPendingMigrationsAsync()
    {
        var runner = CreateMigrationRunner();
        var versionLoader = _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IVersionLoader>();
        
        var allMigrations = versionLoader.VersionInfo.All();
        var appliedVersions = new HashSet<long>(
            runner.VersionLoader.VersionInfo.AppliedMigrations());
        
        return allMigrations
            .Where(m => !appliedVersions.Contains(m.Version))
            .Select(m => new MigrationInfo
            {
                Version = m.Version,
                Description = m.Description,
                AppliedOn = null
            })
            .ToList();
    }
    
    public async Task<List<MigrationInfo>> GetAppliedMigrationsAsync()
    {
        var runner = CreateMigrationRunner();
        
        return runner.VersionLoader.VersionInfo.AppliedMigrations()
            .Select(version =>
            {
                var migration = runner.MigrationLoader.LoadMigration(version);
                return new MigrationInfo
                {
                    Version = version,
                    Description = migration.GetType().Name,
                    AppliedOn = DateTime.UtcNow // Would need to query VersionInfo table
                };
            })
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private IMigrationRunner CreateMigrationRunner()
    {
        return _serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMigrationRunner>();
    }
}

public class MigrationResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
    public Exception Exception { get; set; }
}

public class MigrationInfo
{
    public long Version { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public DateTime? AppliedOn { get; set; }
}
```

```csharp
[Migration(20240201000001)]
public class AddFullTextSearch : Migration
{
    public override void Up()
    {
        // Add full-text search columns
        Alter.Table("TaskInstances")
            .AddColumn("SearchVector").AsCustom("tsvector").Nullable();
        
        // Create GIN index for full-text search
        Execute.Sql(@"
            CREATE INDEX IX_TaskInstances_SearchVector 
            ON ""TaskInstances"" 
            USING GIN (""SearchVector"");
        ");
        
        // Create trigger to maintain search vector
        Execute.Sql(@"
            CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_task_search_vector()
            RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
            BEGIN
                NEW.""SearchVector"" := 
                    setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.""Title"", '')), 'A') ||
                    setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(NEW.""Description"", '')), 'B');
                RETURN NEW;
            END;
            $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
            
            CREATE TRIGGER trg_update_task_search_vector
            BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF ""Title"", ""Description""
            ON ""TaskInstances""
            FOR EACH ROW
            EXECUTE FUNCTION update_task_search_vector();
        ");
        
        // Update existing rows
        Execute.Sql(@"
            UPDATE ""TaskInstances""
            SET ""SearchVector"" = 
                setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(""Title"", '')), 'A') ||
                setweight(to_tsvector('english', COALESCE(""Description"", '')), 'B');
        ");
    }
    
    public override void Down()
    {
        Execute.Sql(@"
            DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_update_task_search_vector ON ""TaskInstances"";
            DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS update_task_search_vector();
        ");
        
        Delete.Index("IX_TaskInstances_SearchVector").OnTable("TaskInstances");
        Delete.Column("SearchVector").FromTable("TaskInstances");
    }
}
```

### 206.3 Migration CLI Tool

```csharp
// MigrationCli/Program.cs
public class Program
{
    public static async Task<int> Main(string[] args)
    {
        var app = new CommandLineApplication
        {
            Name = "dbmigrate",
            Description = "Database migration tool for Work Management"
        };
        
        app.HelpOption("-?|-h|--help");
        
        app.Command("migrate", cmd =>
        {
            cmd.Description = "Apply pending migrations";
            
            var targetOption = cmd.Option(
                "-t|--target <VERSION>",
                "Target version to migrate to",
                CommandOptionType.SingleValue);
            
            cmd.OnExecute(async () =>
            {
                var services = BuildServiceProvider();
                var migrationService = services.GetRequiredService<IMigrationService>();
                
                var result = await migrationService.MigrateAsync(
                    targetOption.Value());
                
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine("✓ " + result.Message);
                    return 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("✗ " + result.Message);
                    return 1;
                }
            });
        });
        
        app.Command("rollback", cmd =>
        {
            cmd.Description = "Rollback to a specific version";
            
            var versionArg = cmd.Argument(
                "<VERSION>",
                "Version to rollback to");
            
            cmd.OnExecute(async () =>
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(versionArg.Value))
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("Version argument is required");
                    return 1;
                }
                
                var services = BuildServiceProvider();
                var migrationService = services.GetRequiredService<IMigrationService>();
                
                var result = await migrationService.RollbackAsync(versionArg.Value);
                
                if (result.Success)
                {
                    Console.WriteLine("✓ " + result.Message);
                    return 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    Console.Error.WriteLine("✗ " + result.Message);
                    return 1;
                }
            });
        });
        
        app.Command("status", cmd =>
        {
            cmd.Description = "Show migration status";
            
            cmd.OnExecute(async () =>
            {
                var services = BuildServiceProvider();
                var migrationService = services.GetRequiredService<IMigrationService>();
                
                var applied = await migrationService.GetAppliedMigrationsAsync();
                var pending = await migrationService.GetPendingMigrationsAsync();
                
                Console.WriteLine($"Applied Migrations: {applied.Count}");
                foreach (var migration in applied.OrderBy(m => m.Version))
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"  ✓ {migration.Version} - {migration.Description}");
                }
                
                Console.WriteLine($"\nPending Migrations: {pending.Count}");
                foreach (var migration in pending.OrderBy(m => m.Version))
                {
                    Console.WriteLine($"  ○ {migration.Version} - {migration.Description}");
                }
                
                return 0;
            });
        });
        
        return await app.ExecuteAsync(args);
    }
    
    private static ServiceProvider BuildServiceProvider()
    {
        var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
            .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
            .AddEnvironmentVariables()
            .Build();
        
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        
        services.AddSingleton<IConfiguration>(configuration);
        services.AddLogging(builder => builder.AddConsole());
        
        // Add FluentMigrator services
        services.AddFluentMigratorCore()
            .ConfigureRunner(rb => rb
                .AddPostgres()
                .WithGlobalConnectionString(
                    configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection"))
                .ScanIn(typeof(Program).Assembly).For.Migrations())
            .AddLogging(lb => lb.AddFluentMigratorConsole());
        
        services.AddScoped<IMigrationService, FluentMigratorService>();
        
        return services.BuildServiceProvider();
    }
}
```
