## **Chapter 207 - Infrastructure as Code**

### 207.1 Terraform Configuration

```hcl
# terraform/main.tf
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"
  
  required_providers {
    azurerm = {
      source  = "hashicorp/azurerm"
      version = "~> 3.0"
    }
    kubernetes = {
      source  = "hashicorp/kubernetes"
      version = "~> 2.0"
    }
  }
  
  backend "azurerm" {
    resource_group_name  = "terraform-state-rg"
    storage_account_name = "tfstate"
    container_name       = "tfstate"
    key                  = "workmanagement.tfstate"
  }
}

provider "azurerm" {
  features {}
}

# Variables
variable "environment" {
  description = "Environment name"
  type        = string
}

variable "location" {
  description = "Azure region"
  type        = string
  default     = "eastus"
}

variable "project_name" {
  description = "Project name"
  type        = string
  default     = "workmanagement"
}

# Resource Group
resource "azurerm_resource_group" "main" {
  name     = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-rg"
  location = var.location
  
  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
    Project     = var.project_name
    ManagedBy   = "Terraform"
  }
}

# Virtual Network
resource "azurerm_virtual_network" "main" {
  name                = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-vnet"
  address_space       = ["10.0.0.0/16"]
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.main.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
}

resource "azurerm_subnet" "aks" {
  name                 = "aks-subnet"
  resource_group_name  = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.main.name
  address_prefixes     = ["10.0.1.0/24"]
}

resource "azurerm_subnet" "database" {
  name                 = "database-subnet"
  resource_group_name  = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  virtual_network_name = azurerm_virtual_network.main.name
  address_prefixes     = ["10.0.2.0/24"]
  
  service_endpoints = ["Microsoft.Sql"]
}

# AKS Cluster
resource "azurerm_kubernetes_cluster" "main" {
  name                = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-aks"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.main.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  dns_prefix          = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}"
  
  kubernetes_version = "1.28"
  
  default_node_pool {
    name                = "default"
    node_count          = 3
    vm_size             = "Standard_D4s_v3"
    vnet_subnet_id      = azurerm_subnet.aks.id
    enable_auto_scaling = true
    min_count           = 3
    max_count           = 10
    
    upgrade_settings {
      max_surge = "33%"
    }
  }
  
  identity {
    type = "SystemAssigned"
  }
  
  network_profile {
    network_plugin     = "azure"
    load_balancer_sku  = "standard"
    network_policy     = "calico"
  }
  
  azure_policy_enabled = true
  
  oms_agent {
    log_analytics_workspace_id = azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.main.id
  }
  
  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

# PostgreSQL Database
resource "azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server" "main" {
  name                = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-psql"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.main.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  
  version                      = "15"
  administrator_login          = "psqladmin"
  administrator_password       = random_password.db_password.result
  
  sku_name   = "GP_Standard_D4s_v3"
  storage_mb = 524288
  
  backup_retention_days        = 7
  geo_redundant_backup_enabled = true
  
  high_availability {
    mode                      = "ZoneRedundant"
    standby_availability_zone = "2"
  }
  
  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

resource "azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server_database" "main" {
  name      = "workmanagement"
  server_id = azurerm_postgresql_flexible_server.main.id
  charset   = "UTF8"
  collation = "en_US.utf8"
}

# Redis Cache
resource "azurerm_redis_cache" "main" {
  name                = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-redis"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.main.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.main.name
  
  capacity            = 2
  family              = "P"
  sku_name            = "Premium"
  enable_non_ssl_port = false
  minimum_tls_version = "1.2"
  
  redis_configuration {
    maxmemory_policy = "allkeys-lru"
  }
  
  tags = {
    Environment = var.environment
  }
}

# Application Insights
resource "azurerm_application_insights" "main" {
  name                = "${var.project_name}-${var.environment}-appinsights"
  location            = azurerm_resource_group.main.location
```

### 208.2 Plugin Interface Definition

```csharp
public interface IPlugin
{
    string Id { get; }
    string Name { get; }
    string Version { get; }
    string Description { get; }
    string Author { get; }
    PluginMetadata Metadata { get; }
    
    Task<PluginInitializationResult> InitializeAsync(
        IPluginContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
    
    Task<PluginHealthStatus> GetHealthAsync();
    Task ShutdownAsync();
}

public interface IPluginContext
{
    Guid TenantId { get; }
    IServiceProvider Services { get; }
    IPluginConfiguration Configuration { get; }
    IPluginLogger Logger { get; }
    IPluginStorage Storage { get; }
    IEventBus EventBus { get; }
}

public abstract class PluginBase : IPlugin
{
    public abstract string Id { get; }
    public abstract string Name { get; }
    public abstract string Version { get; }
    public abstract string Description { get; }
    public abstract string Author { get; }
    public virtual PluginMetadata Metadata => new();
    
    protected IPluginContext Context { get; private set; }
    
    public virtual async Task<PluginInitializationResult> InitializeAsync(
        IPluginContext context,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        Context = context;
        
        try
        {
            await OnInitializeAsync(cancellationToken);
            
            return PluginInitializationResult.Success();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            Context.Logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to initialize plugin {PluginId}", Id);
            return PluginInitializationResult.Failed(ex.Message);
        }
    }
    
    protected abstract Task OnInitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    
    public virtual Task<PluginHealthStatus> GetHealthAsync()
    {
        return Task.FromResult(new PluginHealthStatus
        {
            IsHealthy = true,
            Message = "Plugin is healthy"
        });
    }
    
    public virtual Task ShutdownAsync()
    {
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

public class PluginMetadata
{
    public List<string> RequiredPermissions { get; set; } = new();
    public List<PluginDependency> Dependencies { get; set; } = new();
    public Dictionary<string, string> Settings { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> SupportedPlatforms { get; set; } = new() { "Windows", "Linux", "MacOS" };
    public string MinimumApiVersion { get; set; }
    public string IconUrl { get; set; }
    public string DocumentationUrl { get; set; }
    public List<string> Tags { get; set; } = new();
}

public class PluginDependency
{
    public string PluginId { get; set; }
    public string MinVersion { get; set; }
    public string MaxVersion { get; set; }
    public bool Optional { get; set; }
}

public class PluginInitializationResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Data { get; set; } = new();
    
    public static PluginInitializationResult Success() => new() { Success = true };
    public static PluginInitializationResult Failed(string error) => 
        new() { Success = false, ErrorMessage = error };
}

public class PluginHealthStatus
{
    public bool IsHealthy { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Diagnostics { get; set; } = new();
}
```

### 208.3 Plugin Engine Implementation

```csharp
public interface IPluginEngine
{
    Task LoadPluginAsync(string pluginPath);
    Task UnloadPluginAsync(string pluginId);
    Task<IPlugin> GetPluginAsync(string pluginId);
    Task<List<IPlugin>> GetAllPluginsAsync();
    Task<bool> IsPluginEnabledAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId);
    Task EnablePluginAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId);
    Task DisablePluginAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId);
}

public class PluginEngine : IPluginEngine
{
    private readonly IPluginRegistry _registry;
    private readonly IPluginLoader _loader;
    private readonly IPluginConfigurationService _configService;
    private readonly ILogger<PluginEngine> _logger;
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, IPlugin> _loadedPlugins = new();
    
    public PluginEngine(
        IPluginRegistry registry,
        IPluginLoader loader,
        IPluginConfigurationService configService,
        ILogger<PluginEngine> logger)
    {
        _registry = registry;
        _loader = loader;
        _configService = configService;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task LoadPluginAsync(string pluginPath)
    {
        try
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Loading plugin from {PluginPath}", pluginPath);
            
            // Load plugin assembly
            var pluginAssembly = await _loader.LoadAssemblyAsync(pluginPath);
            
            // Find plugin types
            var pluginTypes = pluginAssembly
                .GetTypes()
                .Where(t => typeof(IPlugin).IsAssignableFrom(t) && !t.IsAbstract)
                .ToList();
            
            if (!pluginTypes.Any())
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"No plugin implementation found in {pluginPath}");
            }
            
            foreach (var pluginType in pluginTypes)
            {
                // Create plugin instance
                var plugin = (IPlugin)Activator.CreateInstance(pluginType);
                
                // Validate plugin
                await ValidatePluginAsync(plugin);
                
                // Register plugin
                await _registry.RegisterAsync(new PluginRegistration
                {
                    Id = plugin.Id,
                    Name = plugin.Name,
                    Version = plugin.Version,
                    Type = pluginType,
                    AssemblyPath = pluginPath,
                    Metadata = plugin.Metadata,
                    RegisteredAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                });
                
                _loadedPlugins[plugin.Id] = plugin;
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Successfully loaded plugin {PluginName} ({PluginId}) v{Version}",
                    plugin.Name,
                    plugin.Id,
                    plugin.Version);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to load plugin from {PluginPath}", pluginPath);
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    public async Task UnloadPluginAsync(string pluginId)
    {
        if (!_loadedPlugins.TryRemove(pluginId, out var plugin))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Plugin {pluginId} is not loaded");
        }
        
        try
        {
            await plugin.ShutdownAsync();
            await _registry.UnregisterAsync(pluginId);
            
            _logger.LogInformation("Successfully unloaded plugin {PluginId}", pluginId);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error unloading plugin {PluginId}", pluginId);
            throw;
        }
    }
    
    public Task<IPlugin> GetPluginAsync(string pluginId)
    {
        if (!_loadedPlugins.TryGetValue(pluginId, out var plugin))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Plugin {pluginId} is not loaded");
        }
        
        return Task.FromResult(plugin);
    }
    
    public Task<List<IPlugin>> GetAllPluginsAsync()
    {
        return Task.FromResult(_loadedPlugins.Values.ToList());
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> IsPluginEnabledAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId)
    {
        var config = await _configService.GetTenantPluginConfigAsync(tenantId, pluginId);
        return config?.IsEnabled ?? false;
    }
    
    public async Task EnablePluginAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId)
    {
        var plugin = await GetPluginAsync(pluginId);
        
        var context = new PluginContext
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            // ... initialize context
        };
        
        var result = await plugin.InitializeAsync(context);
        
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Failed to initialize plugin: {result.ErrorMessage}");
        }
        
        await _configService.SetPluginEnabledAsync(tenantId, pluginId, true);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Enabled plugin {PluginId} for tenant {TenantId}",
            pluginId,
            tenantId);
    }
    
    public async Task DisablePluginAsync(Guid tenantId, string pluginId)
    {
        await _configService.SetPluginEnabledAsync(tenantId, pluginId, false);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Disabled plugin {PluginId} for tenant {TenantId}",
            pluginId,
            tenantId);
    }
    
    private async Task ValidatePluginAsync(IPlugin plugin)
    {
        // Validate plugin ID format
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(plugin.Id))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Plugin ID cannot be empty");
        }
        
        // Check for ID conflicts
        if (_loadedPlugins.ContainsKey(plugin.Id))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Plugin with ID {plugin.Id} is already loaded");
        }
        
        // Validate version format
        if (!Version.TryParse(plugin.Version, out _))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Invalid version format: {plugin.Version}");
        }
        
        // Validate dependencies
        foreach (var dependency in plugin.Metadata.Dependencies)
        {
            if (!dependency.Optional && !_loadedPlugins.ContainsKey(dependency.PluginId))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Required dependency {dependency.PluginId} is not loaded");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 208.4 Plugin Hooks System

```csharp
public interface IPluginHook<TArgs>
{
    Task ExecuteAsync(TArgs args, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public interface IPluginHookRegistry
{
    void RegisterHook<TArgs>(string hookName, IPluginHook<TArgs> hook);
    void UnregisterHook(string hookName, string pluginId);
    Task<List<THookResult>> ExecuteHooksAsync<TArgs, THookResult>(
        string hookName,
        TArgs args,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
}

public class PluginHookRegistry : IPluginHookRegistry
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, List<object>> _hooks = new();
    private readonly ILogger<PluginHookRegistry> _logger;
    
    public PluginHookRegistry(ILogger<PluginHookRegistry> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public void RegisterHook<TArgs>(string hookName, IPluginHook<TArgs> hook)
    {
        var hooks = _hooks.GetOrAdd(hookName, _ => new List<object>());
        
        lock (hooks)
        {
            hooks.Add(hook);
        }
        
        _logger.LogDebug("Registered hook {HookName}", hookName);
    }
    
    public void UnregisterHook(string hookName, string pluginId)
    {
        if (_hooks.TryGetValue(hookName, out var hooks))
        {
            lock (hooks)
            {
                hooks.RemoveAll(h => 
                    h.GetType().Assembly.GetName().Name == pluginId);
            }
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<List<THookResult>> ExecuteHooksAsync<TArgs, THookResult>(
        string hookName,
        TArgs args,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (!_hooks.TryGetValue(hookName, out var hooks))
        {
            return new List<THookResult>();
        }
        
        var results = new List<THookResult>();
        
        List<object> hooksCopy;
        lock (hooks)
        {
            hooksCopy = hooks.ToList();
        }
        
        foreach (var hook in hooksCopy.OfType<IPluginHook<TArgs>>())
        {
            try
            {
                await hook.ExecuteAsync(args, cancellationToken);
                
                if (hook is IPluginHook<TArgs, THookResult> typedHook)
                {
                    // If hook returns a result, add it to results
                    results.Add(default(THookResult));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Error executing hook {HookName} from plugin",
                    hookName);
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}

// Hook argument types
public class TaskCreatedHookArgs
{
    public TaskInstance Task { get; set; }
    public User CreatedBy { get; set; }
}

public class TaskUpdatedHookArgs
{
    public TaskInstance Task { get; set; }
    public TaskInstance PreviousState { get; set; }
    public User UpdatedBy { get; set; }
    public List<string> ChangedProperties { get; set; }
}

public class TaskCompletedHookArgs
{
    public TaskInstance Task { get; set; }
    public User CompletedBy { get; set; }
    public DateTime CompletedAt { get; set; }
}

// Example hook implementation in a plugin
public class TimeTrackingPlugin : PluginBase, IPluginHook<TaskCreatedHookArgs>
{
    public override string Id => "time-tracking";
    public override string Name => "Time Tracking";
    public override string Version => "1.0.0";
    public override string Description => "Adds time tracking capabilities to tasks";
    public override string Author => "WorkManagement Team";
    
    private IPluginHookRegistry _hookRegistry;
    
    protected override Task OnInitializeAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _hookRegistry = Context.Services.GetRequiredService<IPluginHookRegistry>();
        
        // Register hooks
        _hookRegistry.RegisterHook("task.created", this);
        
        Context.Logger.LogInformation("Time Tracking plugin initialized");
        
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
    
    public async Task ExecuteAsync(
        TaskCreatedHookArgs args,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // Initialize time tracking for the task
        var timeEntry = new TimeEntry
        {
            TaskId = args.Task.Id,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
            StartedBy = args.CreatedBy.Id
        };
        
        await Context.Storage.SaveAsync(
            $"time-entry:{args.Task.Id}",
            timeEntry);
        
        Context.Logger.LogInformation(
            "Started time tracking for task {TaskId}",
            args.Task.Id);
    }
}
```

### 209.1 Webhook Infrastructure

```csharp
public interface IWebhookService
{
    Task<Webhook> CreateWebhookAsync(CreateWebhookRequest request);
    Task DeleteWebhookAsync(Guid webhookId);
    Task<Webhook> GetWebhookAsync(Guid webhookId);
    Task<List<Webhook>> GetWebhooksAsync(Guid tenantId);
    Task<WebhookDelivery> DeliverWebhookAsync(
        string eventType,
        object payload,
        Guid tenantId);
}

public class Webhook
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string Url { get; set; }
    public string Secret { get; set; }
    public List<string> Events { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    public WebhookConfiguration Configuration { get; set; }
    public WebhookStatistics Statistics { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
}

public class WebhookConfiguration
{
    public int MaxRetries { get; set; } = 3;
    public int TimeoutSeconds { get; set; } = 30;
    public bool VerifySSL { get; set; } = true;
    public Dictionary<string, string> CustomHeaders { get; set; } = new();
    public List<string> AllowedIPAddresses { get; set; } = new();
}

public class WebhookStatistics
{
    public int TotalDeliveries { get; set; }
    public int SuccessfulDeliveries { get; set; }
    public int FailedDeliveries { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastDeliveryAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastSuccessAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? LastFailureAt { get; set; }
    public double AverageResponseTime { get; set; }
}

public class WebhookDelivery
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid WebhookId { get; set; }
    public string EventType { get; set; }
    public string Payload { get; set; }
    public WebhookDeliveryStatus Status { get; set; }
    public int Attempts { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DeliveredAt { get; set; }
    public string ResponseBody { get; set; }
    public int? ResponseStatusCode { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
}

public enum WebhookDeliveryStatus
{
    Pending,
    Delivered,
    Failed,
    Cancelled
}

public class WebhookService : IWebhookService
{
    private readonly IWebhookRepository _repository;
    private readonly IWebhookDeliveryRepository _deliveryRepository;
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobService _backgroundJobService;
    private readonly ILogger<WebhookService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<WebhookDelivery> DeliverWebhookAsync(
        string eventType,
        object payload,
        Guid tenantId)
    {
        // Find webhooks subscribed to this event
        var webhooks = await _repository.GetByEventTypeAsync(tenantId, eventType);
        
        var deliveries = new List<WebhookDelivery>();
        
        foreach (var webhook in webhooks.Where(w => w.IsActive))
        {
            var delivery = new WebhookDelivery
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                WebhookId = webhook.Id,
                EventType = eventType,
                Payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload),
                Status = WebhookDeliveryStatus.Pending,
                Attempts = 0,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            
            await _deliveryRepository.InsertAsync(delivery);
            
            // Queue delivery job
            await _backgroundJobService.EnqueueAsync<WebhookDeliveryJob>(
                job => job.DeliverAsync(delivery.Id));
            
            deliveries.Add(delivery);
        }
        
        return deliveries.FirstOrDefault();
    }
    
    public async Task<Webhook> CreateWebhookAsync(CreateWebhookRequest request)
    {
        // Validate webhook URL
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(request.Url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri))
        {
            throw new BusinessException("InvalidWebhookUrl", "Invalid webhook URL");
        }
        
        // Generate secret for signature verification
        var secret = GenerateWebhookSecret();
        
        var webhook = new Webhook
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            Url = request.Url,
            Secret = secret,
            Events = request.Events,
            IsActive = true,
            Configuration = request.Configuration ?? new WebhookConfiguration(),
            Statistics = new WebhookStatistics(),
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        await _repository.InsertAsync(webhook);
        
        // Test webhook delivery
        await TestWebhookAsync(webhook);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Created webhook {WebhookId} for tenant {TenantId}",
            webhook.Id,
            request.TenantId);
        
        return webhook;
    }
    
    private async Task TestWebhookAsync(Webhook webhook)
    {
        var testPayload = new
        {
            type = "webhook.test",
            timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
            data = new
            {
                message = "This is a test webhook delivery"
            }
        };
        
        try
        {
            await DeliverWebhookDirectAsync(webhook, "webhook.test", testPayload);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                ex,
                "Test webhook delivery failed for {WebhookId}",
                webhook.Id);
        }
    }
    
    private async Task DeliverWebhookDirectAsync(
        Webhook webhook,
        string eventType,
        object payload)
    {
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Webhook");
        client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(webhook.Configuration.TimeoutSeconds);
        
        var payloadJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(payload);
        var signature = GenerateSignature(payloadJson, webhook.Secret);
        
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, webhook.Url)
        {
            Content = new StringContent(payloadJson, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
        };
        
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Signature", signature);
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Event", eventType);
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Id", webhook.Id.ToString());
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Timestamp", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds().ToString());
        
        // Add custom headers
        foreach (var header in webhook.Configuration.CustomHeaders)
        {
            request.Headers.Add(header.Key, header.Value);
        }
        
        var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    }
    
    private string GenerateWebhookSecret()
    {
        var bytes = new byte[32];
        using var rng = RandomNumberGenerator.Create();
        rng.GetBytes(bytes);
        return Convert.ToBase64String(bytes);
    }
    
    private string GenerateSignature(string payload, string secret)
    {
        var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret);
        var payloadBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload);
        
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(keyBytes);
        var hash = hmac.ComputeHash(payloadBytes);
        
        return $"sha256={Convert.ToHexString(hash).ToLower()}";
    }
}
```

### 209.2 Webhook Delivery Job

```csharp
public class WebhookDeliveryJob
{
    private readonly IWebhookRepository _webhookRepository;
    private readonly IWebhookDeliveryRepository _deliveryRepository;
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<WebhookDeliveryJob> _logger;
    
    public async Task DeliverAsync(Guid deliveryId)
    {
        var delivery = await _deliveryRepository.GetAsync(deliveryId);
        if (delivery == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Delivery {DeliveryId} not found", deliveryId);
            return;
        }
        
        var webhook = await _webhookRepository.GetAsync(delivery.WebhookId);
        if (webhook == null || !webhook.IsActive)
        {
            delivery.Status = WebhookDeliveryStatus.Cancelled;
            await _deliveryRepository.UpdateAsync(delivery);
            return;
        }
        
        var maxRetries = webhook.Configuration.MaxRetries;
        var attempt = 0;
        var success = false;
        
        while (attempt < maxRetries && !success)
        {
            attempt++;
            delivery.Attempts = attempt;
            
            try
            {
                var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                
                await DeliverWebhookAsync(webhook, delivery);
                
                stopwatch.Stop();
                
                delivery.Status = WebhookDeliveryStatus.Delivered;
                delivery.DeliveredAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                success = true;
                
                // Update statistics
                webhook.Statistics.TotalDeliveries++;
                webhook.Statistics.SuccessfulDeliveries++;
                webhook.Statistics.LastDeliveryAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                webhook.Statistics.LastSuccessAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                webhook.Statistics.AverageResponseTime = 
                    (webhook.Statistics.AverageResponseTime * 
                     (webhook.Statistics.SuccessfulDeliveries - 1) + 
                     stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds) / 
                    webhook.Statistics.SuccessfulDeliveries;
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Successfully delivered webhook {DeliveryId} on attempt {Attempt}",
                    deliveryId,
                    attempt);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                delivery.ErrorMessage = ex.Message;
                
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    ex,
                    "Failed to deliver webhook {DeliveryId} on attempt {Attempt}/{MaxRetries}",
                    deliveryId,
                    attempt,
                    maxRetries);
                
                if (attempt >= maxRetries)
                {
                    delivery.Status = WebhookDeliveryStatus.Failed;
                    
                    webhook.Statistics.TotalDeliveries++;
                    webhook.Statistics.FailedDeliveries++;
                    webhook.Statistics.LastDeliveryAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    webhook.Statistics.LastFailureAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
                    
                    // Check if we should auto-disable
                    if (ShouldAutoDisableWebhook(webhook))
                    {
                        webhook.IsActive = false;
                        
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "Auto-disabled webhook {WebhookId} due to repeated failures",
                            webhook.Id);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Exponential backoff
                    var delay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Pow(2, attempt));
                    await Task.Delay(delay);
                }
            }
            
            await _deliveryRepository.UpdateAsync(delivery);
        }
        
        await _webhookRepository.UpdateAsync(webhook);
    }
    
    private async Task DeliverWebhookAsync(Webhook webhook, WebhookDelivery delivery)
    {
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("Webhook");
        client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(webhook.Configuration.TimeoutSeconds);
        
        var signature = GenerateSignature(delivery.Payload, webhook.Secret);
        
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, webhook.Url)
        {
            Content = new StringContent(
                delivery.Payload,
                Encoding.UTF8,
                "application/json")
        };
        
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Signature", signature);
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Event", delivery.EventType);
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Delivery", delivery.Id.ToString());
        request.Headers.Add("X-Webhook-Timestamp", 
            DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds().ToString());
        
        foreach (var header in webhook.Configuration.CustomHeaders)
        {
            request.Headers.Add(header.Key, header.Value);
        }
        
        var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
        
        delivery.ResponseStatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode;
        delivery.ResponseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
    }
    
    private bool ShouldAutoDisableWebhook(Webhook webhook)
    {
        // Auto-disable if failure rate is > 90% over last 100 deliveries
        if (webhook.Statistics.TotalDeliveries < 100)
            return false;
        
        var failureRate = webhook.Statistics.FailedDeliveries / 
                         (double)webhook.Statistics.TotalDeliveries;
        
        return failureRate > 0.9;
    }
    
    private string GenerateSignature(string payload, string secret)
    {
        var keyBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(secret);
        var payloadBytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(payload);
        
        using var hmac = new HMACSHA256(keyBytes);
        var hash = hmac.ComputeHash(payloadBytes);
        
        return $"sha256={Convert.ToHexString(hash).ToLower()}";
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 210 - Custom Fields System**

### 210.1 Custom Field Definition

```csharp
public interface ICustomFieldDefinition
{
    Guid Id { get; }
    string Name { get; }
    string Key { get; }
    CustomFieldType Type { get; }
    bool IsRequired { get; }
    object DefaultValue { get; }
    CustomFieldValidation Validation { get; }
}

public enum CustomFieldType
{
    Text,
    Number,
    Boolean,
    Date,
    DateTime,
    SingleSelect,
    MultiSelect,
    User,
    Url,
    Email,
    Phone,
    Currency,
    Percentage,
    Duration,
    Formula,
    Relation
}

public class CustomField
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid TenantId { get; set; }
    public string EntityType { get; set; } // "Task", "Project", etc.
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Key { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public CustomFieldType Type { get; set; }
    public bool IsRequired { get; set; }
    public bool IsSearchable { get; set; }
    public bool ShowInList { get; set; }
    public int DisplayOrder { get; set; }
    public object DefaultValue { get; set; }
    public CustomFieldOptions Options { get; set; }
    public CustomFieldValidation Validation { get; set; }
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; }
}

public class CustomFieldOptions
{
    // For Select fields
    public List<SelectOption> SelectOptions { get; set; } = new();
    
    // For Number fields
    public decimal? MinValue { get; set; }
    public decimal? MaxValue { get; set; }
    public int? DecimalPlaces { get; set; }
    
    // For Text fields
    public int? MaxLength { get; set; }
    public bool IsMultiline { get; set; }
    
    // For Date fields
    public DateTime? MinDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime? MaxDate { get; set; }
    
    // For Formula fields
    public string Formula { get; set; }
    
    // For Relation fields
    public string RelatedEntityType { get; set; }
    public bool AllowMultiple { get; set; }
}

public class SelectOption
{
    public string Value { get; set; }
    public string Label { get; set; }
    public string Color { get; set; }
    public int Order { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; } = true;
}

public class CustomFieldValidation
{
    public string Pattern { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    public List<CustomFieldRule> Rules { get; set; } = new();
}

{
    public string Type { get; set; } // "min", "max", "pattern", "custom"
    public object Value { get; set; }

}
```

### 210.2 Custom Field Service

```csharp
public interface ICustomFieldService
{
    Task<CustomField> CreateFieldAsync(CreateCustomFieldRequest request);
    Task UpdateFieldAsync(Guid fieldId, UpdateCustomFieldRequest request);
    Task DeleteFieldAsync(Guid fieldId);
    Task<List<CustomField>> GetFieldsAsync(Guid tenantId, string entityType);
    
    Task SetFieldValueAsync(Guid entityId, Guid fieldId, object value);
    Task<object> GetFieldValueAsync(Guid entityId, Guid fieldId);
    Task<Dictionary<Guid, object>> GetAllFieldValuesAsync(Guid entityId);
}

public class CustomFieldService : ICustomFieldService
{
    private readonly ICustomFieldRepository _fieldRepository;
    private readonly ICustomFieldValueRepository _valueRepository;
    private readonly ICustomFieldValidator _validator;
    private readonly ILogger<CustomFieldService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<CustomField> CreateFieldAsync(CreateCustomFieldRequest request)
    {
        // Validate field definition
        await _validator.ValidateDefinitionAsync(request);
        
        // Generate unique key
        var key = GenerateFieldKey(request.Name);
        
        var field = new CustomField
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            TenantId = request.TenantId,
            EntityType = request.EntityType,
            Name = request.Name,
            Key = key,
            Description = request.Description,
            Type = request.Type,
            IsRequired = request.IsRequired,
            IsSearchable = request.IsSearchable,
            ShowInList = request.ShowInList,
            DisplayOrder = request.DisplayOrder,
            DefaultValue = request.DefaultValue,
            Options = request.Options,
            Validation = request.Validation,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        await _fieldRepository.InsertAsync(field);
        
        // Create database column if needed
        if (field.IsSearchable)
        {
            await CreateDatabaseColumnAsync(field);
        }
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Created custom field {FieldName} ({FieldId}) for {EntityType}",
            field.Name,
            field.Id,
            field.EntityType);
        
        return field;
    }
    
    public async Task SetFieldValueAsync(Guid entityId, Guid fieldId, object value)
    {
        var field = await _fieldRepository.GetAsync(fieldId);
        if (field == null)
        {
            throw new BusinessException("FieldNotFound", "Custom field not found");
        }
        
        // Validate value
        await _validator.ValidateValueAsync(field, value);
        
        // Get or create field value
        var fieldValue = await _valueRepository.GetAsync(entityId, fieldId);
        
        if (fieldValue == null)
        {
            fieldValue = new CustomFieldValue
            {
                Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                EntityId = entityId,
                CustomFieldId = fieldId,
                Value = value,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            
            await _valueRepository.InsertAsync(fieldValue);
        }
        else
        {
            fieldValue.Value = value;
            fieldValue.UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            await _valueRepository.UpdateAsync(fieldValue);
        }
        
        // Update searchable column if applicable
        if (field.IsSearchable)
        {
            await UpdateSearchableColumnAsync(entityId, field, value);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<object> GetFieldValueAsync(Guid entityId, Guid fieldId)
    {
        var fieldValue = await _valueRepository.GetAsync(entityId, fieldId);
        
        if (fieldValue != null)
        {
            return fieldValue.Value;
        }
        
        // Return default value if no value set
        var field = await _fieldRepository.GetAsync(fieldId);
        return field?.DefaultValue;
    }
    
    public async Task<Dictionary<Guid, object>> GetAllFieldValuesAsync(Guid entityId)
    {
        var values = await _valueRepository.GetByEntityAsync(entityId);
        
        return values.ToDictionary(v => v.CustomFieldId, v => v.Value);
    }
    
    private string GenerateFieldKey(string name)
    {
        // Convert to lowercase and replace spaces with underscores
        var key = name.ToLowerInvariant()
            .Replace(" ", "_")
            .Replace("-", "_");
        
        // Remove invalid characters
        key = Regex.Replace(key, "[^a-z0-9_]", "");
        
        return key;
    }
    
    private async Task CreateDatabaseColumnAsync(CustomField field)
    {
        // This would create a JSONB column or similar for searchable fields
        // Implementation depends on database strategy
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Creating searchable column for field {FieldId}",
            field.Id);
    }
    
    private async Task UpdateSearchableColumnAsync(
        Guid entityId,
        CustomField field,
        object value)
    {
        // Update the searchable column with the new value
        _logger.LogDebug(
            "Updating searchable column for field {FieldId}, entity {EntityId}",
            field.Id,
            entityId);
    }
}
```

### 210.3 Custom Field Validator

```csharp
public interface ICustomFieldValidator
{
    Task ValidateDefinitionAsync(CreateCustomFieldRequest request);
    Task ValidateValueAsync(CustomField field, object value);
}

public class CustomFieldValidator : ICustomFieldValidator
{
    public async Task ValidateDefinitionAsync(CreateCustomFieldRequest request)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Name))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Field name is required");
        }
        
        // Validate options based on field type
        switch (request.Type)
        {
            case CustomFieldType.SingleSelect:
            case CustomFieldType.MultiSelect:
                if (request.Options?.SelectOptions == null || 
                    !request.Options.SelectOptions.Any())
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(
                        "Select fields must have at least one option");
                }
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Formula:
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Options?.Formula))
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(
                        "Formula fields must have a formula defined");
                }
                
                // Validate formula syntax
                ValidateFormulaSyntax(request.Options.Formula);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Relation:
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Options?.RelatedEntityType))
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(
                        "Relation fields must specify a related entity type");
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    
    public async Task ValidateValueAsync(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        // Check required
        if (field.IsRequired && value == null)
        {
            throw new ValidationException($"{field.Name} is required");
        }
        
        if (value == null)
            return;
        
        // Type-specific validation
        switch (field.Type)
        {
            case CustomFieldType.Number:
                ValidateNumber(field, value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Text:
                ValidateText(field, value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Email:
                ValidateEmail(value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Url:
                ValidateUrl(value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.Date:
            case CustomFieldType.DateTime:
                ValidateDate(field, value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.SingleSelect:
                ValidateSingleSelect(field, value);
                break;
            
            case CustomFieldType.MultiSelect:
                ValidateMultiSelect(field, value);
                break;
        }
        
        // Custom validation rules
        if (field.Validation?.Rules != null)
        {
            foreach (var rule in field.Validation.Rules)
            {
                ValidateRule(rule, value);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateNumber(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        if (!decimal.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var number))
        {
            throw new ValidationException($"{field.Name} must be a number");
        }
        
        if (field.Options?.MinValue.HasValue == true && 
            number < field.Options.MinValue.Value)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"{field.Name} must be at least {field.Options.MinValue}");
        }
        
        if (field.Options?.MaxValue.HasValue == true && 
            number > field.Options.MaxValue.Value)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"{field.Name} must be at most {field.Options.MaxValue}");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateText(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        var text = value.ToString();
        
        if (field.Options?.MaxLength.HasValue == true && 
            text.Length > field.Options.MaxLength.Value)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"{field.Name} must be at most {field.Options.MaxLength} characters");
        }
        
        // Validate pattern if specified
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(field.Validation?.Pattern))
        {
            var regex = new Regex(field.Validation.Pattern);
            if (!regex.IsMatch(text))
            {
                throw new ValidationException(
                    field.Validation.ErrorMessage ?? 
                    $"{field.Name} format is invalid");
            }
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateEmail(object value)
    {
        var email = value.ToString();
        var emailRegex = new Regex(@"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$");
        
        if (!emailRegex.IsMatch(email))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Invalid email format");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateUrl(object value)
    {
        if (!Uri.TryCreate(value.ToString(), UriKind.Absolute, out _))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Invalid URL format");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateDate(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        if (!DateTime.TryParse(value.ToString(), out var date))
        {
            throw new ValidationException($"{field.Name} must be a valid date");
        }
        
        if (field.Options?.MinDate.HasValue == true && 
            date < field.Options.MinDate.Value)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"{field.Name} must be on or after {field.Options.MinDate:d}");
        }
        
        if (field.Options?.MaxDate.HasValue == true && 
            date > field.Options.MaxDate.Value)
        {
            throw new ValidationException(
                $"{field.Name} must be on or before {field.Options.MaxDate:d}");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateSingleSelect(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        var selectedValue = value.ToString();
        var validOptions = field.Options.SelectOptions
            .Where(o => o.IsActive)
            .Select(o => o.Value);
        
        if (!validOptions.Contains(selectedValue))
        {
            throw new ValidationException($"Invalid option for {field.Name}");
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateMultiSelect(CustomField field, object value)
    {
        var selectedValues = value as List<string> ?? 
            JsonSerializer.Deserialize<List<string>>(value.ToString());
        
        var validOptions = field.Options.SelectOptions
            .Where(o => o.IsActive)
            .Select(o => o.Value)
            .ToHashSet();
        
        foreach (var selected in selectedValues)
        {
            if (!validOptions.Contains(selected))
            {
                throw new ValidationException($"Invalid option for {field.Name}");
            }
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateRule(CustomFieldRule rule, object value)
    {
        // Custom rule validation logic
        switch (rule.Type)
        {
            case "min":
                if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) < Convert.ToDecimal(rule.Value))
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(rule.ErrorMessage);
                }
                break;
            
            case "max":
                if (Convert.ToDecimal(value) > Convert.ToDecimal(rule.Value))
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(rule.ErrorMessage);
                }
                break;
            
            case "pattern":
                var regex = new Regex(rule.Value.ToString());
                if (!regex.IsMatch(value.ToString()))
                {
                    throw new ValidationException(rule.ErrorMessage);
                }
                break;
        }
    }
    
    private void ValidateFormulaSyntax(string formula)
    {
        // Validate formula syntax - implementation would parse and validate
        // the formula expression
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(formula))
        {
            throw new ValidationException("Formula cannot be empty");
        }
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 211 - API Versioning Strategy**

### 211.1 Version Management

```csharp
public class ApiVersion
{
    public int Major { get; set; }
    public int Minor { get; set; }
    public int? Patch { get; set; }
    
    public string VersionString => Patch.HasValue 
        ? $"{Major}.{Minor}.{Patch}" 
        : $"{Major}.{Minor}";
    
    public bool IsDeprecated { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DeprecationDate { get; set; }
    public DateTime? SunsetDate { get; set; }
    
    public static ApiVersion Parse(string version)
    {
        var parts = version.Split('.');
        return new ApiVersion
        {
            Major = int.Parse(parts[0]),
            Minor = int.Parse(parts[1]),
            Patch = parts.Length > 2 ? int.Parse(parts[2]) : null
        };
    }
    
    public bool IsCompatibleWith(ApiVersion other)
    {
        return Major == other.Major && Minor >= other.Minor;
    }
}

// Versioning strategies
public enum VersioningStrategy
{
    UrlPath,        // /api/v1/tasks
    QueryString,    // /api/tasks?api-version=1.0
    Header,         // Header: Api-Version: 1.0
    MediaType       // Accept: application/vnd.workmanagement.v1+json
}

// Version configuration
public class ApiVersionConfiguration
{
    public ApiVersion CurrentVersion { get; set; } = new ApiVersion { Major = 1, Minor = 0 };
    public ApiVersion MinimumSupportedVersion { get; set; } = new ApiVersion { Major = 1, Minor = 0 };
    public VersioningStrategy Strategy { get; set; } = VersioningStrategy.UrlPath;
    public bool ReportApiVersions { get; set; } = true;
    public List<ApiVersion> DeprecatedVersions { get; set; } = new();
}

// API versioning middleware
public class ApiVersioningMiddleware
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ApiVersionConfiguration _config;
    private readonly ILogger<ApiVersioningMiddleware> _logger;
    
    public ApiVersioningMiddleware(
        RequestDelegate next,
        ApiVersionConfiguration config,
        ILogger<ApiVersioningMiddleware> logger)
    {
        _next = next;
        _config = config;
        _logger = logger;
    }
    
    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        var requestedVersion = ExtractVersion(context.Request);
        
        if (requestedVersion == null)
        {
            requestedVersion = _config.CurrentVersion;
        }
        
        // Validate version
        if (!IsVersionSupported(requestedVersion))
        {
            context.Response.StatusCode = 400;
            await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new
            {
                error = "UnsupportedApiVersion",
                message = $"API version {requestedVersion.VersionString} is not supported",
                supportedVersions = GetSupportedVersions()
            });
            return;
        }
        
        // Check if deprecated
        if (IsVersionDeprecated(requestedVersion))
        {
            var deprecatedVersion = _config.DeprecatedVersions
                .First(v => v.Major == requestedVersion.Major && v.Minor == requestedVersion.Minor);
            
            context.Response.Headers.Add("Api-Deprecated", "true");
            context.Response.Headers.Add("Api-Deprecation-Date", 
                deprecatedVersion.DeprecationDate?.ToString("O"));
            
            if (deprecatedVersion.SunsetDate.HasValue)
            {
                context.Response.Headers.Add("Api-Sunset-Date", 
                    deprecatedVersion.SunsetDate.Value.ToString("O"));
            }
            
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Client using deprecated API version {Version}",
                requestedVersion.VersionString);
        }
        
        // Add version info to response
        if (_config.ReportApiVersions)
        {
            context.Response.Headers.Add("Api-Version", requestedVersion.VersionString);
            context.Response.Headers.Add("Api-Supported-Versions", 
                string.Join(", ", GetSupportedVersions()));
        }
        
        // Store version in context
        context.Items["ApiVersion"] = requestedVersion;
        
        await _next(context);
    }
    
    private ApiVersion ExtractVersion(HttpRequest request)
    {
        switch (_config.Strategy)
        {
            case VersioningStrategy.UrlPath:
                var match = Regex.Match(request.Path, @"/v(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?/");
                if (match.Success)
                {
                    return new ApiVersion
                    {
                        Major = int.Parse(match.Groups[1].Value),
                        Minor = match.Groups[2].Success ? int.Parse(match.Groups[2].Value) : 0
                    };
                }
                break;
            
            case VersioningStrategy.QueryString:
                if (request.Query.TryGetValue("api-version", out var versionString))
                {
                    return ApiVersion.Parse(versionString);
                }
                break;
            
            case VersioningStrategy.Header:
                if (request.Headers.TryGetValue("Api-Version", out var headerVersion))
                {
                    return ApiVersion.Parse(headerVersion);
                }
                break;
            
            case VersioningStrategy.MediaType:
                var accept = request.Headers.Accept.ToString();
                var mediaMatch = Regex.Match(accept, @"application/vnd\.workmanagement\.v(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?\+json");
                if (mediaMatch.Success)
                {
                    return new ApiVersion
                    {
                        Major = int.Parse(mediaMatch.Groups[1].Value),
                        Minor = mediaMatch.Groups[2].Success ? int.Parse(mediaMatch.Groups[2].Value) : 0
                    };
                }
                break;
        }
        
        return null;
    }
    
    private bool IsVersionSupported(ApiVersion version)
    {
        return version.IsCompatibleWith(_config.MinimumSupportedVersion) &&
               version.Major <= _config.CurrentVersion.Major;
    }
    
    private bool IsVersionDeprecated(ApiVersion version)
    {
        return _config.DeprecatedVersions.Any(v => 
            v.Major == version.Major && v.Minor == version.Minor);
    }
    
    private List<string> GetSupportedVersions()
    {
        var versions = new List<string>();
        
        for (int major = _config.MinimumSupportedVersion.Major; 
             major <= _config.CurrentVersion.Major; 
             major++)
        {
            versions.Add($"{major}.0");
        }
        
        return versions;
    }
}
```

### 211.2 Version-Specific Controllers

```csharp
// V1 Controller
[ApiController]
[Route("api/v1/[controller]")]
[ApiVersion("1.0")]
public class TasksV1Controller : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITaskService _taskService;
    
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<ActionResult<List<TaskDtoV1>>> GetTasksAsync(
        [FromQuery] TaskQueryV1 query)
    {
        var tasks = await _taskService.GetTasksAsync(query.ToQuery());
        return Ok(tasks.Select(t => TaskDtoV1.FromDomain(t)).ToList());
    }
    
    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TaskDtoV1>> GetTaskAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var task = await _taskService.GetTaskAsync(id);
        if (task == null)
            return NotFound();
        
        return Ok(TaskDtoV1.FromDomain(task));
    }
    
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TaskDtoV1>> CreateTaskAsync(
        [FromBody] CreateTaskRequestV1 request)
    {
        var command = request.ToCommand();
        var result = await _taskService.CreateTaskAsync(command);
        
        return CreatedAtAction(
            nameof(GetTaskAsync),
            new { id = result.Id },
            TaskDtoV1.FromDomain(result));
    }
}

// V2 Controller with breaking changes
[ApiController]
[Route("api/v2/[controller]")]
[ApiVersion("2.0")]
public class TasksV2Controller : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ITaskService _taskService;
    
    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<ActionResult<PagedResultV2<TaskDtoV2>>> GetTasksAsync(
        [FromQuery] TaskQueryV2 query)
    {
        var tasks = await _taskService.GetTasksAsync(query.ToQuery());
        
        // V2 returns paginated results with metadata
        return Ok(new PagedResultV2<TaskDtoV2>
        {
            Items = tasks.Select(t => TaskDtoV2.FromDomain(t)).ToList(),
            Page = query.Page,
            PageSize = query.PageSize,
            TotalCount = tasks.Count,
            HasNextPage = tasks.Count == query.PageSize
        });
    }
    
    [HttpGet("{id}")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TaskDtoV2>> GetTaskAsync(Guid id)
    {
        var task = await _taskService.GetTaskAsync(id);
        if (task == null)
            return NotFound();
        
        return Ok(TaskDtoV2.FromDomain(task));
    }
    
    [HttpPost]
    public async Task<ActionResult<TaskDtoV2>> CreateTaskAsync(
        [FromBody] CreateTaskRequestV2 request)
    {
        var command = request.ToCommand();
        var result = await _taskService.CreateTaskAsync(command);
        
        return CreatedAtAction(
            nameof(GetTaskAsync),
            new { id = result.Id },
            TaskDtoV2.FromDomain(result));
    }
    
    // V2 adds batch operations
    [HttpPost("batch")]
    public async Task<ActionResult<BatchOperationResultV2>> CreateTasksBatchAsync(
        [FromBody] List<CreateTaskRequestV2> requests)
    {
        var results = new BatchOperationResultV2();
        
        foreach (var request in requests)
        {
            try
            {
                var command = request.ToCommand();
                var result = await _taskService.CreateTaskAsync(command);
                results.Succeeded.Add(TaskDtoV2.FromDomain(result));
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                results.Failed.Add(new BatchOperationError
                {
                    Request = request,
                    Error = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }
        
        return Ok(results);
    }
}

// DTOs for different versions
public class TaskDtoV1
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public string Status { get; set; }
    public DateTime? DueDate { get; set; }
    public Guid? AssigneeId { get; set; }
    
    public static TaskDtoV1 FromDomain(TaskInstance task)
    {
        return new TaskDtoV1
        {
            Id = task.Id,
            Title = task.Title,
            Description = task.Description,
            Status = task.Status.ToString(),
            DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
            AssigneeId = task.Assignment.AssigneeId
        };
    }
}

public class TaskDtoV2
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Title { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    
    // V2 breaks status into detailed status
    public TaskStatusV2 Status { get; set; }
    
    // V2 includes schedule object
    public TaskScheduleV2 Schedule { get; set; }
    
    // V2 includes assignment object
    public TaskAssignmentV2 Assignment { get; set; }
    
    // V2 adds metadata
    public TaskMetadataV2 Metadata { get; set; }
    
    public static TaskDtoV2 FromDomain(TaskInstance task)
    {
        return new TaskDtoV2
        {
            Id = task.Id,
            Title = task.Title,
            Description = task.Description,
            Status = new TaskStatusV2
            {
                Current = task.Status.ToString(),
                UpdatedAt = task.UpdatedAt ?? task.CreatedAt,
                UpdatedBy = task.OwnerId
            },
            Schedule = new TaskScheduleV2
            {
                PlannedStart = task.Schedule.PlannedStartDate,
                PlannedDue = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
                ActualStart = task.Schedule.ActualStartDate,
                ActualCompletion = task.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate
            },
            Assignment = new TaskAssignmentV2
            {
                AssigneeId = task.Assignment.AssigneeId,
                AssignedAt = task.Assignment.AssignedAt,
                AssignedBy = task.OwnerId
            },
            Metadata = new TaskMetadataV2
            {
                CreatedAt = task.CreatedAt,
                CreatedBy = task.OwnerId,
                UpdatedAt = task.UpdatedAt
            }
        };
    }
}

public class PagedResultV2<T>
{
    public List<T> Items { get; set; }
    public int Page { get; set; }
    public int PageSize { get; set; }
    public int TotalCount { get; set; }
    public bool HasNextPage { get; set; }
    public bool HasPreviousPage => Page > 1;
}

public class BatchOperationResultV2
{
    public List<TaskDtoV2> Succeeded { get; set; } = new();
    public List<BatchOperationError> Failed { get; set; } = new();
}

public class BatchOperationError
{
    public object Request { get; set; }
    public string Error { get; set; }
}
```

### 211.3 Version Migration Service

```csharp
public interface IVersionMigrationService
{
    Task<object> MigrateToVersionAsync(object data, ApiVersion from, ApiVersion to);
    Task<bool> CanMigrateAsync(ApiVersion from, ApiVersion to);
}

public class VersionMigrationService : IVersionMigrationService
{
    private readonly Dictionary<(int, int), Func<object, Task<object>>> _migrations;
    private readonly ILogger<VersionMigrationService> _logger;
    
    public VersionMigrationService(ILogger<VersionMigrationService> logger)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _migrations = new Dictionary<(int, int), Func<object, Task<object>>>
        {
            [(1, 2)] = MigrateV1ToV2Async,
            [(2, 3)] = MigrateV2ToV3Async
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<object> MigrateToVersionAsync(
        object data,
        ApiVersion from,
        ApiVersion to)
    {
        if (from.Major == to.Major && from.Minor == to.Minor)
            return data;
        
        var current = data;
        var currentVersion = from;
        
        // Apply migrations step by step
        while (currentVersion.Major < to.Major || 
               (currentVersion.Major == to.Major && currentVersion.Minor < to.Minor))
        {
            var nextVersion = GetNextVersion(currentVersion);
            
            if (_migrations.TryGetValue(
                (currentVersion.Major, nextVersion.Major), 
                out var migration))
            {
                current = await migration(current);
                currentVersion = nextVersion;
                
                _logger.LogDebug(
                    "Migrated data from v{From} to v{To}",
                    $"{currentVersion.Major}.{currentVersion.Minor}",
                    $"{nextVersion.Major}.{nextVersion.Minor}");
            }
            else
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"No migration path from v{currentVersion.Major} to v{nextVersion.Major}");
            }
        }
        
        return current;
    }
    
    public Task<bool> CanMigrateAsync(ApiVersion from, ApiVersion to)
    {
        try
        {
            var current = from;
            
            while (current.Major < to.Major)
            {
                var next = GetNextVersion(current);
                if (!_migrations.ContainsKey((current.Major, next.Major)))
                    return Task.FromResult(false);
                
                current = next;
            }
            
            return Task.FromResult(true);
        }
        catch
        {
            return Task.FromResult(false);
        }
    }
    
    private ApiVersion GetNextVersion(ApiVersion current)
    {
        return new ApiVersion
        {
            Major = current.Major + 1,
            Minor = 0
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<object> MigrateV1ToV2Async(object data)
    {
        if (data is TaskDtoV1 v1Task)
        {
            return new TaskDtoV2
            {
                Id = v1Task.Id,
                Title = v1Task.Title,
                Description = v1Task.Description,
                Status = new TaskStatusV2
                {
                    Current = v1Task.Status,
                    UpdatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                    UpdatedBy = Guid.Empty
                },
                Schedule = new TaskScheduleV2
                {
                    PlannedDue = v1Task.DueDate
                },
                Assignment = new TaskAssignmentV2
                {
                    AssigneeId = v1Task.AssigneeId
                },
                Metadata = new TaskMetadataV2
                {
                    CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
                }
            };
        }
        
        return data;
    }
    
    private async Task<object> MigrateV2ToV3Async(object data)
    {
        // Future migration logic
        return data;
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class WorkManagementQuery : ObjectGraphType
{
    public WorkManagementQuery(
        ITaskService taskService,
        IProjectService projectService,
        IUserService userService)
    {
        Name = "Query";
        Description = "The root query for WorkManagement";
        
        // Task queries
        Field<ListGraphType<TaskType>>("tasks")
            .Description("Get all tasks")
            .Argument<TaskFilterInputType>("filter")
            .Argument<IntGraphType>("page")
            .Argument<IntGraphType>("pageSize")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var filter = context.GetArgument<TaskFilter>("filter");
                var page = context.GetArgument<int>("page", 1);
                var pageSize = context.GetArgument<int>("pageSize", 20);
                
                return await taskService.GetTasksAsync(filter, page, pageSize);
            });
        
        Field<TaskType>("task")
            .Description("Get a task by ID")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<IdGraphType>>("id")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var id = context.GetArgument<Guid>("id");
                return await taskService.GetTaskAsync(id);
            });
        
        // Project queries
        Field<ListGraphType<ProjectType>>("projects")
            .Description("Get all projects")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var tenantId = context.GetUserContext<GraphQLUserContext>().TenantId;
                return await projectService.GetProjectsAsync(tenantId);
            });
        
        Field<ProjectType>("project")
            .Description("Get a project by ID")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<IdGraphType>>("id")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var id = context.GetArgument<Guid>("id");
                return await projectService.GetProjectAsync(id);
            });
        
        // User queries
        Field<UserType>("me")
            .Description("Get current user")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var userId = context.GetUserContext<GraphQLUserContext>().UserId;
                return await userService.GetUserAsync(userId);
            });
    }
}

public class WorkManagementMutation : ObjectGraphType
{
    public WorkManagementMutation(
        ITaskService taskService,
        IProjectService projectService)
    {
        Name = "Mutation";
        Description = "The root mutation for WorkManagement";
        
        // Task mutations
        Field<TaskType>("createTask")
            .Description("Create a new task")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<CreateTaskInputType>>("input")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var input = context.GetArgument<CreateTaskInput>("input");
                return await taskService.CreateTaskAsync(input.ToCommand());
            });
        
        Field<TaskType>("updateTask")
            .Description("Update an existing task")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<IdGraphType>>("id")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<UpdateTaskInputType>>("input")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var id = context.GetArgument<Guid>("id");
                var input = context.GetArgument<UpdateTaskInput>("input");
                return await taskService.UpdateTaskAsync(id, input.ToCommand());
            });
        
        Field<BooleanGraphType>("deleteTask")
            .Description("Delete a task")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<IdGraphType>>("id")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var id = context.GetArgument<Guid>("id");
                await taskService.DeleteTaskAsync(id);
                return true;
            });
        
        // Project mutations
        Field<ProjectType>("createProject")
            .Description("Create a new project")
            .Argument<NonNullGraphType<CreateProjectInputType>>("input")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var input = context.GetArgument<CreateProjectInput>("input");
                return await projectService.CreateProjectAsync(input.ToCommand());
            });
    }
}

public class WorkManagementSubscription : ObjectGraphType
{
    public WorkManagementSubscription(IEventAggregator eventAggregator)
    {
        Name = "Subscription";
        Description = "The root subscription for WorkManagement";
        
        AddField(new EventStreamFieldType
        {
            Name = "taskUpdated",
            Description = "Subscribe to task updates",
            Arguments = new QueryArguments(
                new QueryArgument<IdGraphType> { Name = "taskId" }
            ),
            Type = typeof(TaskType),
            Resolver = new FuncFieldResolver<TaskInstance>(context => 
                context.Source as TaskInstance),
            Subscriber = new EventStreamResolver<TaskInstance>(context =>
            {
                var taskId = context.GetArgument<Guid?>("taskId");
                var stream = eventAggregator.GetObservable<TaskUpdatedEvent>();
                
                if (taskId.HasValue)
                {
                    stream = stream.Where(e => e.Task.Id == taskId.Value);
                }
                
                return stream.Select(e => e.Task);
            })
        });
        
        AddField(new EventStreamFieldType
        {
            Name = "taskCreated",
            Description = "Subscribe to new tasks",
            Type = typeof(TaskType),
            Resolver = new FuncFieldResolver<TaskInstance>(context => 
                context.Source as TaskInstance),
            Subscriber = new EventStreamResolver<TaskInstance>(context =>
            {
                return eventAggregator
                    .GetObservable<TaskCreatedEvent>()
                    .Select(e => e.Task);
            })
        });
    }
}
```

```csharp
public class TaskType : ObjectGraphType<TaskInstance>
{
    public TaskType(
        ITaskService taskService,
        IUserService userService,
        ICommentService commentService)
    {
        Name = "Task";
        Description = "A work task";
        
        Field(t => t.Id, type: typeof(IdGraphType))
            .Description("The unique identifier");
        
        Field(t => t.Title)
            .Description("The task title");
        
        Field(t => t.Description, nullable: true)
            .Description("The task description");
        
        Field<TaskStatusEnum>("status")
            .Description("The current status")
            .Resolve(context => context.Source.Status);
        
        Field<EisenhowerQuadrantEnum>("quadrant")
            .Description("The Eisenhower quadrant")
            .Resolve(context => context.Source.Quadrant);
        
        Field<UserType>("assignee")
            .Description("The user assigned to this task")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                if (!context.Source.Assignment.AssigneeId.HasValue)
                    return null;
                
                return await userService.GetUserAsync(
                    context.Source.Assignment.AssigneeId.Value);
            });
        
        Field<UserType>("owner")
            .Description("The task owner")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                return await userService.GetUserAsync(context.Source.OwnerId);
            });
        
        Field<ProjectType>("project")
            .Description("The project this task belongs to")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                if (!context.Source.ProjectId.HasValue)
                    return null;
                
                var projectService = context.RequestServices
                    .GetRequiredService<IProjectService>();
                
                return await projectService.GetProjectAsync(
                    context.Source.ProjectId.Value);
            });
        
        Field<ListGraphType<CommentType>>("comments")
            .Description("Comments on this task")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                return await commentService.GetCommentsAsync(context.Source.Id);
            });
        
        Field<ListGraphType<TaskType>>("subtasks")
            .Description("Subtasks of this task")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                return await taskService.GetSubtasksAsync(context.Source.Id);
            });
        
        Field<ListGraphType<TaskType>>("dependencies")
            .Description("Tasks that this task depends on")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var dependencyIds = context.Source.Dependencies
                    .Select(d => d.DependsOnTaskId);
                
                return await taskService.GetTasksByIdsAsync(dependencyIds);
            });
        
        Field(t => t.CreatedAt, type: typeof(DateTimeGraphType))
            .Description("When the task was created");
        
        Field(t => t.UpdatedAt, nullable: true, type: typeof(DateTimeGraphType))
            .Description("When the task was last updated");
    }
}

public class ProjectType : ObjectGraphType<Project>
{
    public ProjectType(ITaskService taskService, IUserService userService)
    {
        Name = "Project";
        Description = "A project containing tasks";
        
        Field(p => p.Id, type: typeof(IdGraphType));
        Field(p => p.Name);
        Field(p => p.Description, nullable: true);
        
        Field<ProjectStatusEnum>("status")
            .Resolve(context => context.Source.Status);
        
        Field<UserType>("owner")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                return await userService.GetUserAsync(context.Source.OwnerId);
            });
        
        Field<ListGraphType<TaskType>>("tasks")
            .Argument<TaskFilterInputType>("filter")
            .ResolveAsync(async context =>
            {
                var filter = context.GetArgument<TaskFilter>("filter") 
                    ?? new TaskFilter();
                filter.ProjectId = context.Source.Id;
                
                return await taskService.GetTasksAsync(filter);
            });
        
        Field(p => p.CreatedAt, type: typeof(DateTimeGraphType));
        Field(p => p.UpdatedAt, nullable: true, type: typeof(DateTimeGraphType));
    }
```
