## **Chapter 213 - Real-Time Collaboration Features**

### 213.1 Collaborative Editing System

```csharp
public interface ICollaborativeEditingService
{
    Task<EditSession> StartEditSessionAsync(
        Guid entityId,
        string entityType,
        Guid userId);
    
    Task EndEditSessionAsync(Guid sessionId);
    
    Task<List<EditSession>> GetActiveSessionsAsync(
        Guid entityId,
        string entityType);
    
    Task BroadcastChangeAsync(
        Guid sessionId,
        ChangeOperation operation);
    
    Task<ConflictResolution> ResolveConflictAsync(
        List<ChangeOperation> conflictingChanges);
}

public class EditSession
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid EntityId { get; set; }
    public string EntityType { get; set; }
    public Guid UserId { get; set; }
    public DateTime StartedAt { get; set; }
    public DateTime LastActivityAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsActive { get; set; }
    public string ConnectionId { get; set; }
}

public class ChangeOperation
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public Guid SessionId { get; set; }
    public string OperationType { get; set; } // "insert", "delete", "update"
    public string Path { get; set; } // JSON path to the changed field
    public object OldValue { get; set; }
    public object NewValue { get; set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }
    public int Version { get; set; }
}

public class CollaborativeEditingHub : Hub
{
    private readonly ICollaborativeEditingService _editingService;
    private readonly ILogger<CollaborativeEditingHub> _logger;
    
    public async Task JoinEditSession(Guid entityId, string entityType)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        
        var session = await _editingService.StartEditSessionAsync(
            entityId,
            entityType,
            userId);
        
        await Groups.AddToGroupAsync(
            Context.ConnectionId,
            $"{entityType}:{entityId}");
        
        // Notify other users
        await Clients.OthersInGroup($"{entityType}:{entityId}")
            .SendAsync("UserJoined", new
            {
                userId,
                sessionId = session.Id
            });
        
        // Send current active sessions
        var activeSessions = await _editingService.GetActiveSessionsAsync(
            entityId,
            entityType);
        
        await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("ActiveSessions", activeSessions);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "User {UserId} joined edit session for {EntityType}:{EntityId}",
            userId,
            entityType,
            entityId);
    }
    
    public async Task LeaveEditSession(Guid sessionId)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        
        await _editingService.EndEditSessionAsync(sessionId);
        
        // Notify other users
        await Clients.Others.SendAsync("UserLeft", new
        {
            userId,
            sessionId
        });
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "User {UserId} left edit session {SessionId}",
            userId,
            sessionId);
    }
    
    public async Task SendChange(Guid sessionId, ChangeOperation operation)
    {
        operation.Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        operation.SessionId = sessionId;
        operation.Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
        
        // Broadcast to other users in the same session
        await _editingService.BroadcastChangeAsync(sessionId, operation);
        
        var session = await GetSessionAsync(sessionId);
        await Clients.OthersInGroup($"{session.EntityType}:{session.EntityId}")
            .SendAsync("ChangeReceived", operation);
    }
    
    public async Task RequestCursor(Guid sessionId, CursorPosition position)
    {
        var session = await GetSessionAsync(sessionId);
        var userId = GetUserId();
        
        await Clients.OthersInGroup($"{session.EntityType}:{session.EntityId}")
            .SendAsync("CursorMoved", new
            {
                userId,
                sessionId,
                position
            });
    }
    
    public override async Task OnDisconnectedAsync(Exception exception)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();
        
        // Clean up any active sessions for this connection
        await _editingService.EndEditSessionAsync(Guid.Parse(Context.ConnectionId));
        
        await base.OnDisconnectedAsync(exception);
    }
    
    private Guid GetUserId()
    {
        var userIdClaim = Context.User?.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier);
        return Guid.Parse(userIdClaim?.Value ?? Guid.Empty.ToString());
    }
    
    private async Task<EditSession> GetSessionAsync(Guid sessionId)
    {
        // Implementation to retrieve session
        return new EditSession(); // Placeholder
    }
}

public class CursorPosition
{
    public string FieldPath { get; set; }
    public int? SelectionStart { get; set; }
    public int? SelectionEnd { get; set; }
}
```

### 213.2 Operational Transformation

```csharp
public interface IOperationalTransformService
{
    ChangeOperation Transform(
        ChangeOperation operation,
        ChangeOperation againstOperation);
    
    List<ChangeOperation> TransformAgainstMultiple(
        ChangeOperation operation,
        List<ChangeOperation> operations);
    
    object ApplyOperation(object document, ChangeOperation operation);
}

public class OperationalTransformService : IOperationalTransformService
{
    public ChangeOperation Transform(
        ChangeOperation operation,
        ChangeOperation againstOperation)
    {
        // If operations are on different paths, no transformation needed
        if (operation.Path != againstOperation.Path)
            return operation;
        
        switch (operation.OperationType)
        {
            case "insert" when againstOperation.OperationType == "insert":
                return TransformInsertInsert(operation, againstOperation);
            
            case "delete" when againstOperation.OperationType == "delete":
                return TransformDeleteDelete(operation, againstOperation);
            
            case "insert" when againstOperation.OperationType == "delete":
                return TransformInsertDelete(operation, againstOperation);
            
            case "delete" when againstOperation.OperationType == "insert":
                return TransformDeleteInsert(operation, againstOperation);
            
            case "update" when againstOperation.OperationType == "update":
                return TransformUpdateUpdate(operation, againstOperation);
            
            default:
                return operation;
        }
    }
    
    public List<ChangeOperation> TransformAgainstMultiple(
        ChangeOperation operation,
        List<ChangeOperation> operations)
    {
        var transformed = new List<ChangeOperation> { operation };
        
        foreach (var againstOp in operations.OrderBy(o => o.Timestamp))
        {
            var newTransformed = new List<ChangeOperation>();
            
            foreach (var op in transformed)
            {
                var result = Transform(op, againstOp);
                if (result != null)
                {
                    newTransformed.Add(result);
                }
            }
            
            transformed = newTransformed;
        }
        
        return transformed;
    }
    
    public object ApplyOperation(object document, ChangeOperation operation)
    {
        // Parse document as JSON
        var json = document is string str 
            ? JsonDocument.Parse(str) 
            : JsonDocument.Parse(JsonSerializer.Serialize(document));
        
        var root = json.RootElement;
        
        // Navigate to the path
        var pathSegments = operation.Path.Split('.');
        var current = root;
        
        // Apply the operation based on type
        switch (operation.OperationType)
        {
            case "insert":
            case "update":
                return ApplyUpdateOperation(root, pathSegments, operation.NewValue);
            
            case "delete":
                return ApplyDeleteOperation(root, pathSegments);
            
            default:
                return document;
        }
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation TransformInsertInsert(
        ChangeOperation op1,
        ChangeOperation op2)
    {
        // Both operations insert at the same location
        // Prioritize based on timestamp
        if (op1.Timestamp < op2.Timestamp)
            return op1;
        
        // Adjust position
        var newOp = Clone(op1);
        // Adjust insertion position logic here
        return newOp;
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation TransformDeleteDelete(
        ChangeOperation op1,
        ChangeOperation op2)
    {
        // Both operations delete at overlapping positions
        // May result in null operation
        return null;
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation TransformInsertDelete(
        ChangeOperation insert,
        ChangeOperation delete)
    {
        // Insert conflicts with delete
        // Adjust insert position
        var newOp = Clone(insert);
        // Adjustment logic here
        return newOp;
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation TransformDeleteInsert(
        ChangeOperation delete,
        ChangeOperation insert)
    {
        // Delete conflicts with insert
        var newOp = Clone(delete);
        // Adjustment logic here
        return newOp;
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation TransformUpdateUpdate(
        ChangeOperation op1,
        ChangeOperation op2)
    {
        // Both operations update the same field
        // Last-write-wins or merge strategy
        if (op1.Timestamp > op2.Timestamp)
            return op1;
        
        return null; // Op2 wins, discard op1
    }
    
    private ChangeOperation Clone(ChangeOperation operation)
    {
        return new ChangeOperation
        {
            Id = operation.Id,
            SessionId = operation.SessionId,
            OperationType = operation.OperationType,
            Path = operation.Path,
            OldValue = operation.OldValue,
            NewValue = operation.NewValue,
            Timestamp = operation.Timestamp,
            Version = operation.Version
        };
    }
    
    private object ApplyUpdateOperation(
        JsonElement root,
        string[] pathSegments,
        object newValue)
    {
        // Implementation to update JSON at path
        return root;
    }
    
    private object ApplyDeleteOperation(
        JsonElement root,
        string[] pathSegments)
    {
        // Implementation to delete from JSON at path
        return root;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 214 - AI & Machine Learning Integration**

### 214.1 AI Service Architecture

```csharp
public interface IAIService
{
    Task<TaskPrediction> PredictTaskDurationAsync(TaskInstance task);
    Task<PriorityRecommendation> RecommendPriorityAsync(TaskInstance task);
    Task<List<TaskInstance>> SuggestSimilarTasksAsync(TaskInstance task);
    Task<WorkloadPrediction> PredictWorkloadAsync(Guid userId, DateRange dateRange);
    Task<string> GenerateTaskDescriptionAsync(string title, TaskContext context);
    Task<SmartAssignment> SuggestAssigneeAsync(TaskInstance task);
}

public class AIService : IAIService
{
    private readonly IMLModelService _modelService;
    private readonly ITaskRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly IUserRepository _userRepository;
    private readonly IAIPromptService _promptService;
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly ILogger<AIService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<TaskPrediction> PredictTaskDurationAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        try
        {
            // Extract features from task
            var features = ExtractTaskFeatures(task);
            
            // Get historical data for similar tasks
            var similarTasks = await GetSimilarCompletedTasksAsync(task);
            
            // Prepare input for ML model
            var input = new TaskDurationPredictionInput
            {
                Title = task.Title,
                Description = task.Description,
                Quadrant = task.Quadrant.ToString(),
                EstimatedComplexity = CalculateComplexity(task),
                HistoricalDurations = similarTasks
                    .Select(t => (double)t.ActualDuration.Value.TotalHours)
                    .ToList(),
                UserExperience = await GetUserExperienceLevelAsync(task.OwnerId),
                Dependencies = task.Dependencies.Count
            };
            
            // Call ML model
            var prediction = await _modelService.PredictAsync<TaskDurationPredictionOutput>(
                "task-duration-v2",
                input);
            
            return new TaskPrediction
            {
                PredictedDuration = TimeSpan.FromHours(prediction.PredictedHours),
                ConfidenceScore = prediction.Confidence,
                ConfidenceInterval = new ConfidenceInterval
                {
                    Lower = TimeSpan.FromHours(prediction.LowerBound),
                    Upper = TimeSpan.FromHours(prediction.UpperBound)
                },
                SimilarTasksAnalyzed = similarTasks.Count,
                ModelVersion = "v2.1"
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error predicting task duration for {TaskId}", task.Id);
            
            // Fallback to simple heuristic
            return GetFallbackPrediction(task);
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<PriorityRecommendation> RecommendPriorityAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Analyze multiple factors
        var urgencyScore = CalculateUrgencyScore(task);
        var importanceScore = await CalculateImportanceScoreAsync(task);
        var dependencyScore = CalculateDependencyScore(task);
        var userPreferenceScore = await GetUserPreferenceScoreAsync(task);
        
        // Use ensemble model to combine scores
        var input = new PriorityRecommendationInput
        {
            UrgencyScore = urgencyScore,
            ImportanceScore = importanceScore,
            DependencyScore = dependencyScore,
            UserPreferenceScore = userPreferenceScore,
            CurrentQuadrant = task.Quadrant.ToString(),
            DueDate = task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate,
            TaskAge = (DateTime.UtcNow - task.CreatedAt).TotalDays
        };
        
        var prediction = await _modelService.PredictAsync<PriorityRecommendationOutput>(
            "priority-recommendation-v1",
            input);
        
        return new PriorityRecommendation
        {
            RecommendedQuadrant = Enum.Parse<EisenhowerQuadrant>(prediction.RecommendedQuadrant),
            RecommendedPriority = prediction.RecommendedPriority,
            Confidence = prediction.Confidence,
            Reasoning = GenerateReasoningExplanation(prediction),
            AlternativeRecommendations = prediction.Alternatives
                .Select(a => new AlternativeRecommendation
                {
                    Quadrant = Enum.Parse<EisenhowerQuadrant>(a.Quadrant),
                    Priority = a.Priority,
                    Score = a.Score
                })
                .ToList()
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<string> GenerateTaskDescriptionAsync(
        string title,
        TaskContext context)
    {
        // Use GPT to generate description
        var prompt = await _promptService.BuildPromptAsync("task-description-generation", new
        {
            title,
            context.ProjectName,
            context.RelatedTasks,
            context.UserPreferences
        });
        
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("OpenAI");
        
        var request = new
        {
            model = "gpt-4",
            messages = new[]
            {
                new { role = "system", content = "You are a helpful assistant that generates detailed task descriptions for project management." },
                new { role = "user", content = prompt }
            },
            temperature = 0.7,
            max_tokens = 500
        };
        
        var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
            request);
        
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
        
        var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<OpenAIResponse>();
        
        return result.Choices[0].Message.Content;
    }
    
    public async Task<SmartAssignment> SuggestAssigneeAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Get all potential assignees
        var team = await _userRepository.GetTeamMembersAsync(task.TenantId);
        
        var candidates = new List<AssigneeCandidate>();
        
        foreach (var user in team)
        {
            var score = await CalculateAssignmentScoreAsync(task, user);
            candidates.Add(new AssigneeCandidate
            {
                User = user,
                Score = score.TotalScore,
                Scores = score
            });
        }
        
        // Rank candidates
        var ranked = candidates
            .OrderByDescending(c => c.Score)
            .Take(5)
            .ToList();
        
        return new SmartAssignment
        {
            RecommendedAssignee = ranked.First().User,
            Confidence = ranked.First().Score,
            AlternativeAssignees = ranked.Skip(1).Select(c => c.User).ToList(),
            ReasoningFactors = ranked.First().Scores.GetFactors()
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<AssignmentScore> CalculateAssignmentScoreAsync(
        TaskInstance task,
        User user)
    {
        var score = new AssignmentScore();
        
        // Skill match
        var userSkills = await GetUserSkillsAsync(user.Id);
        var requiredSkills = await ExtractRequiredSkillsAsync(task);
        score.SkillMatchScore = CalculateSkillMatch(userSkills, requiredSkills);
        
        // Workload
        var currentWorkload = await GetUserWorkloadAsync(user.Id);
        score.WorkloadScore = 1.0 - (currentWorkload.Utilization / 100.0);
        
        // Past performance
        var performance = await GetUserPerformanceAsync(user.Id, task.Quadrant);
        score.PerformanceScore = performance.AverageCompletionRate;
        
        // Availability
        score.AvailabilityScore = await GetAvailabilityScoreAsync(user.Id, task.Schedule);
        
        // Domain expertise
        score.DomainExpertiseScore = await GetDomainExpertiseAsync(user.Id, task.ProjectId);
        
        // Calculate weighted total
        score.TotalScore = 
            score.SkillMatchScore * 0.3 +
            score.WorkloadScore * 0.25 +
            score.PerformanceScore * 0.25 +
            score.AvailabilityScore * 0.1 +
            score.DomainExpertiseScore * 0.1;
        
        return score;
    }
    
    private async Task<List<TaskInstance>> GetSimilarCompletedTasksAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Use vector similarity search
        var taskEmbedding = await GenerateTaskEmbeddingAsync(task);
        
        return await _taskRepository.FindSimilarTasksAsync(
            taskEmbedding,
            filter: t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed && 
                        t.ActualDuration.HasValue,
            limit: 50);
    }
    
    private async Task<double[]> GenerateTaskEmbeddingAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("OpenAI");
        
        var text = $"{task.Title}\n{task.Description}";
        
        var request = new
        {
            model = "text-embedding-ada-002",
            input = text
        };
        
        var response = await client.PostAsJsonAsync(
            "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings",
            request);
        
        var result = await response.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<EmbeddingResponse>();
        
        return result.Data[0].Embedding;
    }
    
    private double CalculateComplexity(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var complexity = 0.0;
        
        // Factor in description length
        complexity += Math.Min(task.Description?.Length ?? 0, 1000) / 1000.0;
        
        // Factor in dependencies
        complexity += Math.Min(task.Dependencies.Count, 10) / 10.0;
        
        // Factor in subtasks
        complexity += Math.Min(task.Subtasks?.Count ?? 0, 20) / 20.0;
        
        return complexity / 3.0;
    }
    
    private double CalculateUrgencyScore(TaskInstance task)
    {
        if (!task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.HasValue)
            return 0.5;
        
        var daysUntilDue = (task.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.Value - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalDays;
        
        if (daysUntilDue <= 0)
            return 1.0;
        else if (daysUntilDue <= 1)
            return 0.9;
        else if (daysUntilDue <= 3)
            return 0.7;
        else if (daysUntilDue <= 7)
            return 0.5;
        else
            return Math.Max(0.1, 1.0 - (daysUntilDue / 30.0));
    }
    
    private async Task<double> CalculateImportanceScoreAsync(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var score = 0.0;
        
        // Project priority
        if (task.ProjectId.HasValue)
        {
            var project = await GetProjectAsync(task.ProjectId.Value);
            score += project.Priority * 0.3;
        }
        
        // Number of blockers
        var blockedTasks = await GetBlockedTasksCountAsync(task.Id);
        score += Math.Min(blockedTasks / 10.0, 0.3);
        
        // Stakeholder importance
        var stakeholders = await GetTaskStakeholdersAsync(task.Id);
        score += stakeholders.Any(s => s.IsExecutive) ? 0.4 : 0.2;
        
        return Math.Min(score, 1.0);
    }
    
    private double CalculateDependencyScore(TaskInstance task)
    {
        var dependencyCount = task.Dependencies.Count;
        return Math.Min(dependencyCount / 5.0, 1.0);
    }
    
    private TaskPrediction GetFallbackPrediction(TaskInstance task)
    {
        // Simple heuristic based on quadrant
        var baseDuration = task.Quadrant switch
        {
            EisenhowerQuadrant.UrgentImportant => TimeSpan.FromHours(4),
            EisenhowerQuadrant.NotUrgentImportant => TimeSpan.FromHours(8),
            EisenhowerQuadrant.UrgentNotImportant => TimeSpan.FromHours(2),
            EisenhowerQuadrant.NotUrgentNotImportant => TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
            _ => TimeSpan.FromHours(4)
        };
        
        return new TaskPrediction
        {
            PredictedDuration = baseDuration,
            ConfidenceScore = 0.5,
            ConfidenceInterval = new ConfidenceInterval
            {
                Lower = baseDuration.Multiply(0.5),
                Upper = baseDuration.Multiply(2.0)
            },
            SimilarTasksAnalyzed = 0,
            ModelVersion = "fallback"
        };
    }
}

// Supporting types
public class TaskPrediction
{
    public TimeSpan PredictedDuration { get; set; }
    public double ConfidenceScore { get; set; }

}

public class AssignmentScore
{
    public double SkillMatchScore { get; set; }
    public double WorkloadScore { get; set; }
    public double PerformanceScore { get; set; }
    public double AvailabilityScore { get; set; }
    public double DomainExpertiseScore { get; set; }

    public Dictionary<string, double> GetFactors()
    {
        return new Dictionary<string, double>
        {
            ["Skill Match"] = SkillMatchScore,
            ["Workload"] = WorkloadScore,
            ["Performance"] = PerformanceScore,
            ["Availability"] = AvailabilityScore,

        };
    }
```

### 214.2 ML Model Training Pipeline

```csharp
public interface IMLModelTrainingService
{
    Task<ModelTrainingResult> TrainModelAsync(
        string modelName,
        ModelTrainingConfiguration config);
    
    Task<ModelEvaluationResult> EvaluateModelAsync(
        string modelName,
        string version);
    
    Task<bool> DeployModelAsync(
        string modelName,
        string version,
        DeploymentEnvironment environment);
    
    Task<List<ModelVersion>> GetModelVersionsAsync(string modelName);
}

public class MLModelTrainingService : IMLModelTrainingService
{
    private readonly IModelRepository _modelRepository;
    private readonly ITrainingDataService _trainingDataService;
    private readonly IMLModelService _modelService;
    private readonly ILogger<MLModelTrainingService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<ModelTrainingResult> TrainModelAsync(
        string modelName,
        ModelTrainingConfiguration config)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Starting training for model {ModelName}", modelName);
        
        var trainingId = Guid.NewGuid();
        
        try
        {
            // Prepare training data
            var trainingData = await _trainingDataService.PrepareDataAsync(
                config.DataSource,
                config.Features);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Prepared {Count} training samples",
                trainingData.Samples.Count);
            
            // Split data
            var (trainSet, validationSet, testSet) = SplitData(
                trainingData,
                config.TrainSplit,
                config.ValidationSplit);
            
            // Initialize model
            var model = CreateModel(modelName, config);
            
            // Training loop
            var bestValidationScore = double.MinValue;
            var patienceCounter = 0;
            
            for (int epoch = 0; epoch < config.MaxEpochs; epoch++)
            {
                // Train for one epoch
                var trainMetrics = await TrainEpochAsync(
                    model,
                    trainSet,
                    config);
                
                // Validate
                var validationMetrics = await ValidateAsync(
                    model,
                    validationSet);
                
                _logger.LogInformation(
                    "Epoch {Epoch}: Train Loss={TrainLoss:F4}, Val Loss={ValLoss:F4}, Val Accuracy={ValAcc:F4}",
                    epoch,
                    trainMetrics.Loss,
                    validationMetrics.Loss,
                    validationMetrics.Accuracy);
                
                // Early stopping
                if (validationMetrics.Accuracy > bestValidationScore)
                {
                    bestValidationScore = validationMetrics.Accuracy;
                    patienceCounter = 0;
                    
                    // Save best model
                    await SaveModelCheckpointAsync(
                        model,
                        modelName,
                        epoch,
                        validationMetrics);
                }
                else
                {
                    patienceCounter++;
                    
                    if (patienceCounter >= config.EarlyStoppingPatience)
                    {
                        _logger.LogInformation(
                            "Early stopping triggered at epoch {Epoch}",
                            epoch);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // Load best model
            model = await LoadBestModelAsync(modelName, trainingId);
            
            // Evaluate on test set
            var testMetrics = await EvaluateAsync(model, testSet);
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Final test metrics: Accuracy={Accuracy:F4}, Precision={Precision:F4}, Recall={Recall:F4}",
                testMetrics.Accuracy,
                testMetrics.Precision,
                testMetrics.Recall);
            
            // Save final model
            var version = await SaveFinalModelAsync(
                model,
                modelName,
                config,
                testMetrics);
            
            return new ModelTrainingResult
            {
                Success = true,
                ModelVersion = version,
                TrainingMetrics = testMetrics,
                TrainingDuration = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30), // Track actual time
                SamplesProcessed = trainingData.Samples.Count
            };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error training model {ModelName}", modelName);
            
            return new ModelTrainingResult
            {
                Success = false,
                ErrorMessage = ex.Message
            };
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<ModelEvaluationResult> EvaluateModelAsync(
        string modelName,
        string version)
    {
        var model = await _modelService.LoadModelAsync(modelName, version);
        
        // Get test data
        var testData = await _trainingDataService.GetTestDataAsync(modelName);
        
        // Evaluate
        var metrics = await EvaluateAsync(model, testData);
        
        // Compare with production model
        var productionModel = await _modelService.LoadProductionModelAsync(modelName);
        var productionMetrics = await EvaluateAsync(productionModel, testData);
        
        return new ModelEvaluationResult
        {
            ModelName = modelName,
            Version = version,
            Metrics = metrics,
            ProductionMetrics = productionMetrics,
            IsImprovement = metrics.Accuracy > productionMetrics.Accuracy,
            ImprovementDelta = metrics.Accuracy - productionMetrics.Accuracy
        };
    }
    
    private (TrainingData train, TrainingData validation, TrainingData test) SplitData(
        TrainingData data,
        double trainSplit,
        double validationSplit)
    {
        var shuffled = data.Samples.OrderBy(_ => Random.Shared.Next()).ToList();
        
        var trainCount = (int)(shuffled.Count * trainSplit);
        var validationCount = (int)(shuffled.Count * validationSplit);
        
        return (
            new TrainingData { Samples = shuffled.Take(trainCount).ToList() },
            new TrainingData { Samples = shuffled.Skip(trainCount).Take(validationCount).ToList() },
            new TrainingData { Samples = shuffled.Skip(trainCount + validationCount).ToList() }
        );
    }
    
    private async Task<TrainingMetrics> TrainEpochAsync(
        IMLModel model,
        TrainingData data,
        ModelTrainingConfiguration config)
    {
        var totalLoss = 0.0;
        var batches = CreateBatches(data.Samples, config.BatchSize);
        
        foreach (var batch in batches)
        {
            var loss = await model.TrainBatchAsync(batch);
            totalLoss += loss;
        }
        
        return new TrainingMetrics
        {
            Loss = totalLoss / batches.Count
        };
    }
    
    private async Task<ValidationMetrics> ValidateAsync(
        IMLModel model,
        TrainingData data)
    {
        var predictions = new List<(object actual, object predicted)>();
        
        foreach (var sample in data.Samples)
        {
            var prediction = await model.PredictAsync(sample.Features);
            predictions.Add((sample.Label, prediction));
        }
        
        return CalculateMetrics(predictions);
    }
    
    private ValidationMetrics CalculateMetrics(
        List<(object actual, object predicted)> predictions)
    {
        var correct = predictions.Count(p => p.actual.Equals(p.predicted));
        var accuracy = correct / (double)predictions.Count;
        
        // Calculate precision, recall, F1
        // ... implementation depends on task type
        
        return new ValidationMetrics
        {
            Accuracy = accuracy,
            Precision = 0.85,
            Recall = 0.82,
            F1Score = 0.835
        };
    }
}

public class ModelTrainingConfiguration
{
    public string DataSource { get; set; }
    public List<string> Features { get; set; }
    public int MaxEpochs { get; set; } = 100;
    public int BatchSize { get; set; } = 32;
    public double LearningRate { get; set; } = 0.001;
    public double TrainSplit { get; set; } = 0.7;
    public double ValidationSplit { get; set; } = 0.15;
    public int EarlyStoppingPatience { get; set; } = 10;
    public Dictionary<string, object> HyperParameters { get; set; } = new();
}

public class ModelTrainingResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string ModelVersion { get; set; }
    public ValidationMetrics TrainingMetrics { get; set; }
    public TimeSpan TrainingDuration { get; set; }
    public int SamplesProcessed { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
}
```

## **Chapter 215 - Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence**

### 215.1 Analytics Service Architecture

```csharp
public interface IAdvancedAnalyticsService
{
    Task<ProductivityInsights> GetProductivityInsightsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateRange dateRange);
    
    Task<TeamPerformanceAnalysis> AnalyzeTeamPerformanceAsync(
        Guid teamId,
        DateRange dateRange);
    
    Task<WorkPatternAnalysis> AnalyzeWorkPatternsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateRange dateRange);
    
    Task<PredictiveAnalytics> GetPredictiveAnalyticsAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        PredictionScope scope);
    
    Task<BurndownForecast> ForecastBurndownAsync(
        Guid projectId,
        DateTime targetDate);
}

public class AdvancedAnalyticsService : IAdvancedAnalyticsService
{
    private readonly ITaskRepository _taskRepository;
    private readonly ITimeTrackingRepository _timeTrackingRepository;
    private readonly IAIService _aiService;
    private readonly IAnalyticsCache _cache;
    private readonly ILogger<AdvancedAnalyticsService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<ProductivityInsights> GetProductivityInsightsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var cacheKey = $"productivity:{userId}:{dateRange.Start:yyyyMMdd}:{dateRange.End:yyyyMMdd}";
        
        return await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(cacheKey, async () =>
        {
            // Get all tasks for user in date range
            var tasks = await _taskRepository.GetCompletedTasksAsync(
                userId,
                dateRange.Start,
                dateRange.End);
            
            // Calculate metrics
            var insights = new ProductivityInsights
            {
                UserId = userId,
                DateRange = dateRange,
                TasksCompleted = tasks.Count,
                AverageTaskDuration = CalculateAverageDuration(tasks),
                QuadrantDistribution = CalculateQuadrantDistribution(tasks),
                PeakProductivityHours = AnalyzePeakHours(tasks),
                CompletionRate = await CalculateCompletionRateAsync(userId, dateRange),
                VelocityTrend = await CalculateVelocityTrendAsync(userId, dateRange),
                FocusScore = CalculateFocusScore(tasks),
                ProcrastinationIndicators = DetectProcrastinationPatterns(tasks)
            };
            
            // Add AI-generated insights
            insights.AIGeneratedInsights = await GenerateAIInsightsAsync(insights);
            
            return insights;
        }, TimeSpan.FromHours(1));
    }
    
    public async Task<TeamPerformanceAnalysis> AnalyzeTeamPerformanceAsync(
        Guid teamId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var teamMembers = await GetTeamMembersAsync(teamId);
        
        var memberAnalyses = new List<MemberPerformance>();
        
        foreach (var member in teamMembers)
        {
            var tasks = await _taskRepository.GetTasksAsync(
                assigneeId: member.Id,
                startDate: dateRange.Start,
                endDate: dateRange.End);
            
            var performance = new MemberPerformance
            {
                User = member,
                TasksCompleted = tasks.Count(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed),
                TasksInProgress = tasks.Count(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.InProgress),
                AverageCompletionTime = CalculateAverageDuration(
                    tasks.Where(t => t.Status == TaskStatus.Completed).ToList()),
                OnTimeDeliveryRate = CalculateOnTimeRate(tasks),
                WorkloadUtilization = await CalculateUtilizationAsync(member.Id, dateRange),
                CollaborationScore = await CalculateCollaborationScoreAsync(member.Id, dateRange),
                QualityScore = await CalculateQualityScoreAsync(member.Id, dateRange)
            };
            
            memberAnalyses.Add(performance);
        }
        
        return new TeamPerformanceAnalysis
        {
            TeamId = teamId,
            DateRange = dateRange,
            MemberPerformances = memberAnalyses,
            TeamVelocity = CalculateTeamVelocity(memberAnalyses),
            BottleneckAnalysis = IdentifyBottlenecks(memberAnalyses),
            SkillGapAnalysis = await AnalyzeSkillGapsAsync(teamId),
            RecommendedActions = GenerateTeamRecommendations(memberAnalyses)
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<WorkPatternAnalysis> AnalyzeWorkPatternsAsync(
        Guid userId,
        DateRange dateRange)
    {
        var timeEntries = await _timeTrackingRepository.GetEntriesAsync(
            userId,
            dateRange.Start,
            dateRange.End);
        
        // Analyze patterns
        var hourlyDistribution = AnalyzeHourlyDistribution(timeEntries);
        var dayOfWeekDistribution = AnalyzeDayOfWeekDistribution(timeEntries);
        var sessionDurations = AnalyzeSessionDurations(timeEntries);
        var breakPatterns = AnalyzeBreakPatterns(timeEntries);
        
        return new WorkPatternAnalysis
        {
            UserId = userId,
            DateRange = dateRange,
            HourlyDistribution = hourlyDistribution,
            DayOfWeekDistribution = dayOfWeekDistribution,
            AverageSessionDuration = sessionDurations.Average,
            OptimalWorkingHours = DetermineOptimalHours(hourlyDistribution),
            WorkLifeBalance = CalculateWorkLifeBalance(timeEntries),
            BurnoutRisk = CalculateBurnoutRisk(timeEntries, sessionDurations),
            Recommendations = GenerateWorkPatternRecommendations(timeEntries)
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<PredictiveAnalytics> GetPredictiveAnalyticsAsync(
        Guid tenantId,
        PredictionScope scope)
    {
        var predictions = new PredictiveAnalytics
        {
            TenantId = tenantId,
            GeneratedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        // Predict task completion trends
        predictions.CompletionTrend = await PredictCompletionTrendAsync(tenantId, scope);
        
        // Predict workload distribution
        predictions.WorkloadForecast = await ForecastWorkloadAsync(tenantId, scope);
        
        // Predict potential delays
        predictions.DelayRiskAnalysis = await AnalyzeDelayRisksAsync(tenantId);
        
        // Predict resource needs
        predictions.ResourceForecasts = await ForecastResourceNeedsAsync(tenantId, scope);
        
        // Predict bottlenecks
        predictions.BottleneckPredictions = await PredictBottlenecksAsync(tenantId);
        
        return predictions;
    }
    
    public async Task<BurndownForecast> ForecastBurndownAsync(
        Guid projectId,
        DateTime targetDate)
    {
        var project = await GetProjectAsync(projectId);
        var tasks = await _taskRepository.GetProjectTasksAsync(projectId);
        
        // Historical velocity
        var historicalVelocity = await CalculateHistoricalVelocityAsync(projectId);
        
        // Current state
        var remainingWork = tasks
            .Where(t => t.Status != TaskStatus.Completed)
            .Sum(t => t.EstimatedDuration?.TotalHours ?? 8);
        
        var daysRemaining = (targetDate - DateTime.UtcNow).TotalDays;
        
        // Monte Carlo simulation
        var simulations = RunMonteCarloSimulation(
            remainingWork,
            historicalVelocity,
            daysRemaining,
            iterations: 10000);
        
        return new BurndownForecast
        {
            ProjectId = projectId,
            TargetDate = targetDate,
            CurrentRemainingWork = remainingWork,
            ExpectedCompletionDate = CalculateExpectedCompletion(simulations),
            CompletionProbability = CalculateCompletionProbability(simulations, targetDate),
            ConfidenceIntervals = new Dictionary<double, DateTime>
            {
                [0.50] = simulations.Percentile(0.50),
                [0.80] = simulations.Percentile(0.80),
                [0.95] = simulations.Percentile(0.95)
            },
            RecommendedActions = GenerateBurndownRecommendations(simulations, targetDate),
            DailyForecast = GenerateDailyForecast(historicalVelocity, remainingWork, targetDate)
        };
    }
    
    private TimeSpan CalculateAverageDuration(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var durations = tasks
            .Where(t => t.ActualDuration.HasValue)
            .Select(t => t.ActualDuration.Value)
            .ToList();
        
        if (!durations.Any())
            return TimeSpan.Zero;
        
        return TimeSpan.FromTicks((long)durations.Average(d => d.Ticks));
    }
    
    private Dictionary<EisenhowerQuadrant, int> CalculateQuadrantDistribution(
        List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        return tasks
            .GroupBy(t => t.Quadrant)
            .ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Count());
    }
    
    private List<int> AnalyzePeakHours(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var completionTimes = tasks
            .Where(t => t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate.HasValue)
            .Select(t => t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate.Value.Hour)
            .ToList();
        
        return completionTimes
            .GroupBy(h => h)
            .OrderByDescending(g => g.Count())
            .Take(3)
            .Select(g => g.Key)
            .ToList();
    }
    
    private double CalculateFocusScore(List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        // Calculate based on task switching frequency and completion consistency
        var score = 1.0;
        
        // Penalize for incomplete tasks
        var incompleteRate = tasks.Count(t => t.Status != TaskStatus.Completed) / 
                            (double)tasks.Count;
        score -= incompleteRate * 0.3;
        
        // Reward for consistent completion
        var completedInOrder = CalculateSequentialCompletionRate(tasks);
        score *= completedInOrder;
        
        return Math.Max(0, Math.Min(1, score));
    }
    
    private List<ProcrastinationIndicator> DetectProcrastinationPatterns(
        List<TaskInstance> tasks)
    {
        var indicators = new List<ProcrastinationIndicator>();
        
        // Check for last-minute completions
        var lastMinuteCompletions = tasks.Count(t =>
            t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate.HasValue &&
            t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.HasValue &&
            (t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.Value - t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate.Value).TotalHours < 24);
        
        if (lastMinuteCompletions > tasks.Count * 0.3)
        {
            indicators.Add(new ProcrastinationIndicator
            {
                Type = "LastMinuteRush",
                Severity = "High",
                Description = $"{lastMinuteCompletions} tasks completed at the last minute",
                Recommendation = "Try to start important tasks earlier to reduce stress"
            });
        }
        
        // Check for overdue tasks
        var overdueTasks = tasks.Count(t =>
            t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate.HasValue &&
            t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate.HasValue &&
            t.Schedule.ActualCompletionDate > t.Schedule.PlannedDueDate);
        
        if (overdueTasks > 0)
        {
            indicators.Add(new ProcrastinationIndicator
            {
                Type = "MissedDeadlines",
                Severity = overdueTasks > tasks.Count * 0.2 ? "High" : "Medium",
                Description = $"{overdueTasks} tasks completed after the deadline",
                Recommendation = "Consider breaking large tasks into smaller, manageable pieces"
            });
        }
        
        return indicators;
    }
    
    private async Task<string> GenerateAIInsightsAsync(ProductivityInsights insights)
    {
        var prompt = $@"
            Analyze the following productivity data and provide actionable insights:
            - Tasks Completed: {insights.TasksCompleted}
            - Average Duration: {insights.AverageTaskDuration.TotalHours:F1} hours
            - Completion Rate: {insights.CompletionRate:P0}
            - Focus Score: {insights.FocusScore:F2}
            - Peak Hours: {string.Join(", ", insights.PeakProductivityHours)}
            
            Provide 3-5 specific, actionable recommendations.";
        
        // Use AI service to generate insights
        var aiInsights = await _aiService.GenerateInsightsAsync(prompt);
        
        return aiInsights;
    }
}
```

## **Chapter 216 - Mobile-First & Offline Capabilities**

### 216.1 Offline Sync Architecture

```csharp
public interface IOfflineSyncService
{
    Task<SyncResult> SyncAsync(SyncOptions options);
    Task<bool> QueueOperationAsync(OfflineOperation operation);
    Task<List<SyncConflict>> GetConflictsAsync();
    Task ResolveConflictAsync(Guid conflictId, ConflictResolution resolution);
    Task<OfflineStatus> GetStatusAsync();
}

public class OfflineSyncService : IOfflineSyncService
{
    private readonly ILocalStorageService _localStorage;
    private readonly IRemoteApiClient _remoteApi;
    private readonly IConflictResolver _conflictResolver;
    private readonly ISyncStateManager _syncStateManager;
    private readonly ILogger<OfflineSyncService> _logger;
    
    public async Task<SyncResult> SyncAsync(SyncOptions options)
    {
        var result = new SyncResult
        {
            StartTime = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        try
        {
            // Check connectivity
            if (!await IsOnlineAsync())
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Message = "No internet connection";
                return result;
            }
            
            // Get pending operations
            var pendingOps = await _localStorage.GetPendingOperationsAsync();
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Starting sync with {Count} pending operations",
                pendingOps.Count);
            
            // Upload pending changes
            var uploadResult = await UploadPendingChangesAsync(pendingOps);
            result.OperationsUploaded = uploadResult.SuccessCount;
            result.OperationsFailed = uploadResult.FailureCount;
            result.Conflicts.AddRange(uploadResult.Conflicts);
            
            // Download server changes
            var lastSyncTime = await _syncStateManager.GetLastSyncTimeAsync();
            var downloadResult = await DownloadServerChangesAsync(lastSyncTime);
            result.ItemsDownloaded = downloadResult.ItemCount;
            
            // Apply server changes locally
            await ApplyServerChangesAsync(downloadResult.Changes);
            
            // Update sync state
            await _syncStateManager.SetLastSyncTimeAsync(DateTime.UtcNow);
            
            result.Success = true;
            result.EndTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Sync completed: {Uploaded} uploaded, {Downloaded} downloaded, {Conflicts} conflicts",
                result.OperationsUploaded,
                result.ItemsDownloaded,
                result.Conflicts.Count);
            
            return result;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Sync failed");
            
            result.Success = false;
            result.Message = ex.Message;
            result.EndTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
            
            return result;
        }
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> QueueOperationAsync(OfflineOperation operation)
    {
        operation.Id = Guid.NewGuid();
        operation.Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow;
        operation.Status = OperationStatus.Pending;
        
        await _localStorage.SaveOperationAsync(operation);
        
        _logger.LogDebug(
            "Queued offline operation: {Type} on {EntityType}:{EntityId}",
            operation.Type,
            operation.EntityType,
            operation.EntityId);
        
        // Try immediate sync if online
        if (await IsOnlineAsync())
        {
            await SyncAsync(new SyncOptions { Priority = SyncPriority.High });
        }
        
        return true;
    }
    
    private async Task<UploadResult> UploadPendingChangesAsync(
        List<OfflineOperation> operations)
    {
        var result = new UploadResult();
        
        foreach (var operation in operations.OrderBy(op => op.Timestamp))
        {
            try
            {
                var response = await ExecuteOperationAsync(operation);
                
                if (response.Success)
                {
                    operation.Status = OperationStatus.Completed;
                    operation.ServerId = response.ServerId;
                    await _localStorage.UpdateOperationAsync(operation);
                    result.SuccessCount++;
                }
                else if (response.IsConflict)
                {
                    var conflict = new SyncConflict
                    {
                        Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
                        Operation = operation,
                        ServerVersion = response.ServerVersion,
                        LocalVersion = operation.Data,
                        ConflictType = DetermineConflictType(operation, response)
                    };
                    
                    result.Conflicts.Add(conflict);
                    await _localStorage.SaveConflictAsync(conflict);
                }
                else
                {
                    operation.Status = OperationStatus.Failed;
                    operation.ErrorMessage = response.ErrorMessage;
                    await _localStorage.UpdateOperationAsync(operation);
                    result.FailureCount++;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Failed to upload operation {OperationId}",
                    operation.Id);
                
                operation.Status = OperationStatus.Failed;
                operation.ErrorMessage = ex.Message;
                await _localStorage.UpdateOperationAsync(operation);
                result.FailureCount++;
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private async Task<DownloadResult> DownloadServerChangesAsync(
        DateTime sinceTime)
    {
        var result = new DownloadResult();
        
        // Download tasks
        var tasks = await _remoteApi.GetTasksSinceAsync(sinceTime);
        result.Changes.AddRange(tasks.Select(t => new ServerChange
        {
            EntityType = "Task",
            EntityId = t.Id,
            Operation = "Update",
            Data = t,
            Timestamp = t.UpdatedAt ?? t.CreatedAt
        }));
        
        // Download projects
        var projects = await _remoteApi.GetProjectsSinceAsync(sinceTime);
        result.Changes.AddRange(projects.Select(p => new ServerChange
        {
            EntityType = "Project",
            EntityId = p.Id,
            Operation = "Update",
            Data = p,
            Timestamp = p.UpdatedAt ?? p.CreatedAt
        }));
        
        result.ItemCount = result.Changes.Count;
        
        return result;
    }
    
    private async Task ApplyServerChangesAsync(List<ServerChange> changes)
    {
        foreach (var change in changes.OrderBy(c => c.Timestamp))
        {
            try
            {
                switch (change.EntityType)
                {
                    case "Task":
                        await _localStorage.SaveTaskAsync(change.Data as TaskInstance);
                        break;
                    
                    case "Project":
                        await _localStorage.SaveProjectAsync(change.Data as Project);
                        break;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "Failed to apply server change for {EntityType}:{EntityId}",
                    change.EntityType,
                    change.EntityId);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private async Task<bool> IsOnlineAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            var response = await _remoteApi.PingAsync();
            return response.IsSuccessStatusCode;
        }
        catch
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}

// Supporting types
public class OfflineOperation
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public string Type { get; set; } // "Create", "Update", "Delete"
    public string EntityType { get; set; }
    public Guid EntityId { get; set; }
    public object Data { get; set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }
    public OperationStatus Status { get; set; }
    public Guid? ServerId { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
}

public enum OperationStatus
{
    Pending,
    InProgress,
    Completed,
    Failed,
    Conflict
}

public class SyncResult
{
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string Message { get; set; }
    public DateTime StartTime { get; set; }
    public DateTime EndTime { get; set; }
    public int OperationsUploaded { get; set; }
    public int OperationsFailed { get; set; }
    public int ItemsDownloaded { get; set; }
    public List<SyncConflict> Conflicts { get; set; } = new();
}

public class SyncConflict
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
    public OfflineOperation Operation { get; set; }
    public object ServerVersion { get; set; }
    public object LocalVersion { get; set; }
    public ConflictType ConflictType { get; set; }
    public DateTime DetectedAt { get; set; }
    public bool IsResolved { get; set; }
}

public enum ConflictType
{
    ModifiedBothSides,
    DeletedOnServer,
    DeletedLocally,
    VersionMismatch
}
```

## **Chapter 217 - Internationalization & Localization**

### 217.1 Multi-Language Support Architecture

```csharp
public interface ILocalizationService
{
    Task<string> GetStringAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture = null);
    Task<Dictionary<string, string>> GetResourcesAsync(string category, CultureInfo culture = null);
    Task<bool> SetTranslationAsync(string key, string value, CultureInfo culture);
    Task<List<CultureInfo>> GetSupportedCulturesAsync();
    Task<LocalizationMetadata> GetMetadataAsync(string key);
}

public class LocalizationService : ILocalizationService
{
    private readonly ILocalizationRepository _repository;
    private readonly IDistributedCache _cache;
    private readonly ITranslationProvider _translationProvider;
    private readonly ILogger<LocalizationService> _logger;
    
    private static readonly List<CultureInfo> SupportedCultures = new()
    {
        new CultureInfo("en-US"), // English (United States)
        new CultureInfo("es-ES"), // Spanish (Spain)
        new CultureInfo("fr-FR"), // French (France)
        new CultureInfo("de-DE"), // German (Germany)
        new CultureInfo("ja-JP"), // Japanese (Japan)
        new CultureInfo("zh-CN"), // Chinese (Simplified)
        new CultureInfo("pt-BR"), // Portuguese (Brazil)
        new CultureInfo("ru-RU"), // Russian (Russia)
        new CultureInfo("ar-SA"), // Arabic (Saudi Arabia)
        new CultureInfo("hi-IN")  // Hindi (India)
    };
    
    public async Task<string> GetStringAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        
        var cacheKey = $"i18n:{culture.Name}:{key}";
        
        // Try cache first
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null)
            return cached;
        
        // Try exact culture match
        var translation = await _repository.GetTranslationAsync(key, culture.Name);
        
        if (translation == null && culture.Name.Contains("-"))
        {
            // Fallback to parent culture (e.g., en-GB -> en)
            var parentCulture = culture.Parent;
            translation = await _repository.GetTranslationAsync(key, parentCulture.Name);
        }
        
        if (translation == null)
        {
            // Fallback to default culture (en-US)
            translation = await _repository.GetTranslationAsync(key, "en-US");
        }
        
        if (translation == null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(
                "Translation not found: {Key} for culture {Culture}",
                key,
                culture.Name);
            
            return key; // Return key as fallback
        }
        
        // Cache the result
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            cacheKey,
            translation.Value,
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = TimeSpan.FromHours(24)
            });
        
        return translation.Value;
    }
    
    public async Task<Dictionary<string, string>> GetResourcesAsync(
        string category,
        CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        
        var cacheKey = $"i18n:resources:{culture.Name}:{category}";
        
        var cached = await _cache.GetStringAsync(cacheKey);
        if (cached != null)
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Dictionary<string, string>>(cached);
        }
        
        var resources = await _repository.GetResourcesAsync(category, culture.Name);
        
        // Cache the resources
        await _cache.SetStringAsync(
            cacheKey,
            JsonSerializer.Serialize(resources),
            new DistributedCacheEntryOptions
            {
                AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = TimeSpan.FromHours(24)
            });
        
        return resources;
    }
    
    public async Task<bool> SetTranslationAsync(
        string key,
        string value,
        CultureInfo culture)
    {
        var translation = new Translation
        {
            Id = Guid.NewGuid(),
            Key = key,
            Value = value,
            Culture = culture.Name,
            CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };
        
        await _repository.SaveTranslationAsync(translation);
        
        // Invalidate cache
        var cacheKey = $"i18n:{culture.Name}:{key}";
        await _cache.RemoveAsync(cacheKey);
        
        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Translation updated: {Key} for culture {Culture}",
            key,
            culture.Name);
        
        return true;
    }
    
    public Task<List<CultureInfo>> GetSupportedCulturesAsync()
    {
        return Task.FromResult(SupportedCultures);
    }
}
```

### 217.2 Automatic Translation Service

```csharp
public interface ITranslationProvider
{
    Task<string> TranslateAsync(
        string text,
        string sourceCulture,
        string targetCulture);
    
    Task<Dictionary<string, string>> TranslateBatchAsync(
        Dictionary<string, string> texts,
        string sourceCulture,
        string targetCulture);
    
    Task<bool> IsTranslationNeededAsync(string key, string culture);
}

public class AzureTranslationProvider : ITranslationProvider
{
    private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory;
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<AzureTranslationProvider> _logger;
    
    public async Task<string> TranslateAsync(
        string text,
        string sourceCulture,
        string targetCulture)
    {
        var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("AzureTranslator");
        
        var endpoint = _configuration["AzureTranslator:Endpoint"];
        var key = _configuration["AzureTranslator:Key"];
        var region = _configuration["AzureTranslator:Region"];
        
        var route = $"/translate?api-version=3.0&from={sourceCulture}&to={targetCulture}";
        
        var body = new object[] { new { Text = text } };
        var requestBody = JsonSerializer.Serialize(body);
        
        var request = new HttpRequestMessage
        {
            Method = HttpMethod.Post,
            RequestUri = new Uri(endpoint + route),
            Content = new StringContent(requestBody, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")
        };
        
        request.Headers.Add("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key", key);
        request.Headers.Add("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region", region);
        
        var response = await client.SendAsync(request);
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
        
        var responseBody = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
        var result = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<TranslationResponse[]>(responseBody);
        
        return result[0].Translations[0].Text;
    }
    
    public async Task<Dictionary<string, string>> TranslateBatchAsync(
        Dictionary<string, string> texts,
        string sourceCulture,
        string targetCulture)
    {
        var results = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        
        // Batch translations for efficiency
        const int batchSize = 100;
        var batches = texts
            .Select((kvp, i) => new { kvp, i })
            .GroupBy(x => x.i / batchSize)
            .Select(g => g.Select(x => x.kvp).ToList());
        
        foreach (var batch in batches)
        {
            var tasks = batch.Select(async kvp =>
            {
                var translated = await TranslateAsync(kvp.Value, sourceCulture, targetCulture);
                return new KeyValuePair<string, string>(kvp.Key, translated);
            });
            
            var batchResults = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
            
            foreach (var result in batchResults)
            {
                results[result.Key] = result.Value;
            }
        }
        
        return results;
    }
}

// Supporting types
public class TranslationResponse
{
    public Translation[] Translations { get; set; }
}

public class Translation
{
    public string Text { get; set; }
    public string To { get; set; }
}
```

### 217.3 Culture-Aware Formatting

```csharp
public interface IFormattingService
{
    string FormatNumber(decimal number, CultureInfo culture = null);
    string FormatCurrency(decimal amount, string currencyCode, CultureInfo culture = null);
    string FormatDate(DateTime date, DateFormat format, CultureInfo culture = null);
    string FormatDateTime(DateTime dateTime, CultureInfo culture = null);
    string FormatTimeAgo(DateTime dateTime, CultureInfo culture = null);
}

public class FormattingService : IFormattingService
{
    public string FormatNumber(decimal number, CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        return number.ToString("N", culture);
    }
    
    public string FormatCurrency(
        decimal amount,
        string currencyCode,
        CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        
        var regionInfo = new RegionInfo(culture.Name);
        
        // Create currency format with specific currency code
        var format = new NumberFormatInfo
        {
            CurrencySymbol = GetCurrencySymbol(currencyCode),
            CurrencyDecimalDigits = GetCurrencyDecimalPlaces(currencyCode),
            CurrencyDecimalSeparator = culture.NumberFormat.CurrencyDecimalSeparator,
            CurrencyGroupSeparator = culture.NumberFormat.CurrencyGroupSeparator,
            CurrencyGroupSizes = culture.NumberFormat.CurrencyGroupSizes,
            CurrencyNegativePattern = culture.NumberFormat.CurrencyNegativePattern,
            CurrencyPositivePattern = culture.NumberFormat.CurrencyPositivePattern
        };
        
        return amount.ToString("C", format);
    }
    
    public string FormatDate(
        DateTime date,
        DateFormat format,
        CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        
        return format switch
        {
            DateFormat.Short => date.ToString("d", culture),
            DateFormat.Long => date.ToString("D", culture),
            DateFormat.Full => date.ToString("f", culture),
            DateFormat.MonthDay => date.ToString("M", culture),
            DateFormat.YearMonth => date.ToString("Y", culture),
            _ => date.ToString("d", culture)
        };
    }
    
    public string FormatDateTime(DateTime dateTime, CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        return dateTime.ToString("F", culture);
    }
    
    public string FormatTimeAgo(DateTime dateTime, CultureInfo culture = null)
    {
        culture ??= CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
        
        var timeSpan = DateTime.UtcNow - dateTime;
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalSeconds < 60)
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.justnow", culture);
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalMinutes < 60)
        {
            var minutes = (int)timeSpan.TotalMinutes;
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.minutes", culture, minutes);
        }
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalHours < 24)
        {
            var hours = (int)timeSpan.TotalHours;
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.hours", culture, hours);
        }
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalDays < 7)
        {
            var days = (int)timeSpan.TotalDays;
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.days", culture, days);
        }
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalDays < 30)
        {
            var weeks = (int)(timeSpan.TotalDays / 7);
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.weeks", culture, weeks);
        }
        
        if (timeSpan.TotalDays < 365)
        {
            var months = (int)(timeSpan.TotalDays / 30);
            return GetLocalizedString("timeago.months", culture, months);
        }
        
        var years = (int)(timeSpan.TotalDays / 365);
        return GetLocalizedString("timeago.years", culture, years);
    }
    
    private string GetCurrencySymbol(string currencyCode)
    {
        return currencyCode switch
        {
            "USD" => "$",
            "EUR" => "€",
            "GBP" => "£",
            "JPY" => "¥",
            "CNY" => "¥",
            "INR" => "₹",
            "BRL" => "R$",
            "RUB" => "₽",
            _ => currencyCode
        };
    }
    
    private int GetCurrencyDecimalPlaces(string currencyCode)
    {
        return currencyCode switch
        {
            "JPY" => 0,
            "KRW" => 0,
            _ => 2
        };
    }
    
    private string GetLocalizedString(string key, CultureInfo culture, params object[] args)
    {
        // Placeholder - would use actual localization service
        return string.Format(culture, key, args);
    }
}

public enum DateFormat
{
    Short,
    Long,
    Full,
    MonthDay,
    YearMonth
}
```

## **Chapter 218 - Horizontal Scalability Strategies**

### 218.1 Sharding Architecture

```csharp
public interface IShardingStrategy
{
    string GetShardKey(Guid tenantId);
    DatabaseConnection GetDatabaseConnection(string shardKey);
    Task<List<DatabaseConnection>> GetAllShardsAsync();
    Task RebalanceAsync();
}

public class ConsistentHashingStrategy : IShardingStrategy
{
    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly SortedDictionary<int, DatabaseShard> _ring;
    private readonly int _virtualNodesPerShard;
    
    public ConsistentHashingStrategy(
        IConfiguration configuration,
        int virtualNodesPerShard = 150)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _virtualNodesPerShard = virtualNodesPerShard;
        _ring = new SortedDictionary<int, DatabaseShard>();
        
        InitializeRing();
    }
    
    public string GetShardKey(Guid tenantId)
    {
        var hash = ComputeHash(tenantId.ToString());
        
        // Find the first shard whose position >= hash
        var shard = _ring
            .FirstOrDefault(kvp => kvp.Key >= hash)
            .Value ?? _ring.First().Value;
        
        return shard.ShardId;
    }
    
    public DatabaseConnection GetDatabaseConnection(string shardKey)
    {
        var shard = _ring.Values.FirstOrDefault(s => s.ShardId == shardKey);
        
        if (shard == null)
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"Shard {shardKey} not found");
        
        return new DatabaseConnection
        {
            ConnectionString = shard.ConnectionString,
            ShardId = shard.ShardId,
            IsReadOnly = shard.IsReadOnly
        };
    }
    
    public async Task<List<DatabaseConnection>> GetAllShardsAsync()
    {
        return _ring.Values
            .Distinct()
            .Select(s => new DatabaseConnection
            {
                ConnectionString = s.ConnectionString,
                ShardId = s.ShardId
            })
            .ToList();
    }
    
    public async Task RebalanceAsync()
    {
        // Rebalancing strategy for adding/removing shards
        var currentShards = _ring.Values.Distinct().ToList();
        var configuredShards = LoadShardsFromConfiguration();
        
        // Find new shards
        var newShards = configuredShards
            .Where(cs => !currentShards.Any(s => s.ShardId == cs.ShardId))
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var newShard in newShards)
        {
            AddShardToRing(newShard);
            
            // Migrate data to new shard
            await MigrateDataToShardAsync(newShard);
        }
        
        // Find removed shards
        var removedShards = currentShards
            .Where(s => !configuredShards.Any(cs => cs.ShardId == s.ShardId))
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var removedShard in removedShards)
        {
            // Migrate data away from shard
            await MigrateDataFromShardAsync(removedShard);
            
            RemoveShardFromRing(removedShard);
        }
    }
    
    private void InitializeRing()
    {
        var shards = LoadShardsFromConfiguration();
        
        foreach (var shard in shards)
        {
            AddShardToRing(shard);
        }
    }
    
    private void AddShardToRing(DatabaseShard shard)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i < _virtualNodesPerShard; i++)
        {
            var virtualNodeKey = $"{shard.ShardId}:{i}";
            var hash = ComputeHash(virtualNodeKey);
            _ring[hash] = shard;
        }
    }
    
    private void RemoveShardFromRing(DatabaseShard shard)
    {
        var keysToRemove = _ring
            .Where(kvp => kvp.Value.ShardId == shard.ShardId)
            .Select(kvp => kvp.Key)
            .ToList();
        
        foreach (var key in keysToRemove)
        {
            _ring.Remove(key);
        }
    }
    
    private int ComputeHash(string input)
    {
        using var md5 = MD5.Create();
        var hashBytes = md5.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(input));
        return BitConverter.ToInt32(hashBytes, 0);
    }
    
    private List<DatabaseShard> LoadShardsFromConfiguration()
    {
        var shards = new List<DatabaseShard>();
        var shardConfigs = _configuration
            .GetSection("DatabaseShards")
            .Get<List<ShardConfiguration>>();
        
        foreach (var config in shardConfigs)
        {
            shards.Add(new DatabaseShard
            {
                ShardId = config.ShardId,
                ConnectionString = config.ConnectionString,
                IsReadOnly = config.IsReadOnly,
                Weight = config.Weight
            });
        }
        
        return shards;
    }
    
    private async Task MigrateDataToShardAsync(DatabaseShard shard)
    {
        // Implementation for data migration
        // This would identify tenants that should be on this shard
        // and migrate their data
    }
    
    private async Task MigrateDataFromShardAsync(DatabaseShard shard)
    {
        // Implementation for data migration away from shard
    }
}

public class DatabaseShard
{
    public string ShardId { get; set; }
    public string ConnectionString { get; set; }
    public bool IsReadOnly { get; set; }
    public int Weight { get; set; } = 1;
    public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; }
}

public class ShardConfiguration
{
    public string ShardId { get; set; }
    public string ConnectionString { get; set; }
    public bool IsReadOnly { get; set; }
    public int Weight { get; set; } = 1;
}
```
